live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:1: The second book of the prophet Esdras, the son of Saraias, the son of Azarias, the son of Helchias, the son of Sadamias, the son of Sadoc, the son of Achitob,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:2: The son of Achias, the son of Phinees, the son of Heli, the son of Amarias, the son of Aziei, the son of Marimoth, the son of Arna, the son of Ozias, the son of Borith, the son of Abisei, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:3: The son of Aaron, of the tribe of Levi; which was captive in the land of the Medes, in the reign of Artexerxes king of the Persians.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:4: And the word of Yahuah (God) came to me, saying,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:5: Go your way, and shew my people their sinful deeds, and their children their wickedness which they have done against me; that they may tell their children’s children:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:6: Because the sins of their fathers are increased in them: for they have forgotten me, and have offered to strange gods.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:7: Am not I even he that brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage? but they have provoked me to wrath, and despised my counsels.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:8: Pull you off then the hair of your head, and cast all evil upon them, for they have not been obedient to my law, but it is a rebellious people.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:9: How long shall I forbear them, into whom I have done so much good?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:10: Many kings have I destroyed for their sakes; Pharaoh with his servants and all his power have I struck down.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:11: All the nations have I destroyed before them, and in the east I have scattered the people of two provinces, even of Tyrus and Sidon, and have slain all their enemies.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:12: Speak you therefore to them, saying, Thus says Yahuah (God),
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:13: I led you through the sea and in the beginning gave you a large and safe passage; I gave you Moses for a leader, and Aaron for a priest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:14: I gave you light in a pillar of fire, and great wonders have I done among you; yet have you forgotten me, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:15: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), The quails were as a token to you; I gave you tents for your safeguard: nevertheless you murmured there,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:16: And triumphed not in my name for the destruction of your enemies, but ever to this day do you yet murmur.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:17: Where are the benefits that I have done for you? when you were hungry and thirsty in the wilderness, did you not cry to me,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:18: Saying, Why have you brought us into this wilderness to kill us? it had been better for us to have served the Egyptians, than to die in this wilderness.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:19: Then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels’ bread.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:20: When you were thirsty, did I not cleave the rock, and waters flowed out to your fill? for the heat I covered you with the leaves of the trees.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:21: I divided among you a fruitful land, I cast out the Canaanites, the Pherezites, and the Philistines, before you: what shall I yet do more for you? says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:22: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), When you were in the wilderness, in the river of the Amorites, being athirst, and blaspheming my name,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:23: I gave you not fire for your blasphemies, but cast a tree in the water, and made the river sweet.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:24: What shall I do to you, O Jacob? you, Juda, wouldest not obey me: I will turn me to other nations, and to those will I give my name, that they may keep my statutes.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:25: Seeing you have forsaken me, I will forsake you also; when you desire me to be gracious to you, I shall have no mercy upon you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:26: Whenever you shall call upon me, I will not hear you: for you have defiled your hands with blood, and your feet are swift to commit manslaughter.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:27: You have not as it were forsaken me, but your own selves, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:28: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Have I not prayed you as a father his sons, as a mother her daughters, and a nurse her young babes,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:29: That you would be my people, and I should be your Elohim (God); that you would be my children, and I should be your father?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:30: I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings: but now, what shall I do to you? I will cast you out from my face.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:31: When you offer to me, I will turn my face from you: for your solemn feastdays, your new moons, and your circumcisions, have I forsaken.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:32: I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:33: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:34: And your children shall not be fruitful; for they have despised my commandment, and done the thing that is an evil before me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:35: Your houses will I give to a people that shall come; which not having heard of me yet shall believe me; to whom I have shewed no signs, yet they shall do that I have commanded them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:36: They have seen no prophets, yet they shall call their sins to remembrance, and acknowledge them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:37: I take to witness the grace of the people to come, whose little ones rejoice in gladness: and though they have not seen me with bodily eyes, yet in spirit they believe the thing that I say.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:38: And now, brother, behold what glory; and see the people that come from the east:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:39: To whom I will give for leaders, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Oseas, Amos, and Micheas, Joel, Abdias, and Jonas,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|1:40: Nahum, and Abacuc, Sophonias, Aggeus, Zachary, and Malachy, which is called also an angel of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:1: Thus says Yahuah (God), I brought this people out of bondage, and I gave them my commandments by my servants the prophets; whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:2: The mother that bare them says to them, Go your way, you children; for I am a widow and forsaken.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:3: I brought you up with gladness; but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for you have sinned before Yahuah (God), your Elohim (God), and done that thing that is evil before him.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:4: But what shall I now do to you? I am a widow and forsaken: go your way, O my children, and ask mercy of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:5: As for me, O father, I call upon you for a witness over the mother of these children, which would not keep my covenant,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:6: That you bring them to confusion, and their mother to a spoil, that there may be no offspring of them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:7: Let them be scattered abroad among the heathen, let their names be put out of the earth: for they have despised my covenant.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:8: Woe be to you, Assur, you that hidest the unrighteous in you! O you wicked people, remember what I did to Sodom and Gomorrha;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:9: Whose land lieth in clods of pitch and heaps of ashes: even so also will I do to them that hear me not, says the Almighty Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:10: Thus says Yahuah (God) to Esdras, Tell my people that I will give them the kingdom of Jerusalem, which I would have given to Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:11: Their glory also will I take to me, and give these the everlasting tabernacles, which I had prepared for them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:12: They shall have the tree of life for an ointment of sweet savour; they shall neither labour, nor be weary.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:13: Go, and you shall receive: pray for few days to you, that they may be shortened: the kingdom is already prepared for you: watch.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:14: Take heaven and earth to witness; for I have broken the evil in pieces, and created the good: for I live, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:15: Mother, embrace your children, and bring them up with gladness, make their feet as fast as a pillar: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:16: And those that be dead will I raise up again from their places, and bring them out of the graves: for I have known my name in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:17: Fear not, you mother of the children: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:18: For your help will I send my servants Esay and Jeremy, after whose counsel I have sanctified and prepared for you twelve trees laden with divers fruits,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:19: And as many fountains flowing with milk and honey, and seven mighty mountains, whereupon there grow roses and lilies, by which I will fill your children with joy.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:20: Do right to the widow, judge for the fatherless, give to the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:21: Heal the broken and the weak, laugh not a lame man to scorn, defend the maimed, and let the blind man come into the sight of my clearness.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:22: Keep the old and young within your walls.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:23: Wherever you findest the dead, take them and bury them, and I will give you the first place in my resurrection.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:24: Abide still, O my people, and take your rest, for your quietness still come.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:25: Nourish your children, O you good nurse; stablish their feet.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:26: As for the servants whom I have given you, there shall not one of them perish; for I will require them from among your number.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:27: Be not weary: for when the day of trouble and heaviness comes, others shall weep and be sorrowful, but you shall be merry and have abundance.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:28: The heathen shall envy you, but they shall be able to do nothing against you, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:29: My hands shall cover you, so that your children shall not see hell.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:30: Be joyful, O you mother, with your children; for I will deliver you, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:31: Remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy to them: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (God) Almighty.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:32: Embrace your children until I come and shew mercy to them: for my wells run over, and my grace shall not fail.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:33: I Esdras received a charge of Yahuah (God) upon the mount Oreb, that I should go to Yashar'el (Israel); but when I came to them, they set me at nought, and despised the commandment of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:34: And therefore I say to you, O you heathen, that hear and understand, look for your Shepherd, he shall give you everlasting rest; for he is nigh at hand, that shall come in the end of the world.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:35: Be ready to the reward of the kingdom, for the everlasting light shall shine upon you for evermore.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:36: Flee the shadow of this world, receive the joyfulness of your glory: I testify my Saviour openly.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:37: O receive the gift that is given you, and be glad, giving thanks to him that has led you to the heavenly kingdom.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:38: Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of Yahuah (God);
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:39: Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:40: Take your number, O Sion, and shut up those of yours that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:41: The number of your children, whom you longedst for, is fulfilled: beseech the power of Yahuah (God), that your people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:42: I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised Yahuah (God) with songs.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:43: And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted; which I marvelled at greatly.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:44: So I asked the angel, and said, Sir, what are these?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:45: He answered and said to me, These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of Yahuah (God): now are they crowned, and receive palms.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:46: Then said I to the angel, What young person is it that crowneth them, and gives them palms in their hands?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:47: So he answered and said to me, It is the Son of Yahuah (God), whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|2:48: Then the angel said to me, Go your way, and tell my people what manner of things, and how great wonders of Yahuah (God), your Elohim (God), you have seen.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:1: In the thirtieth year after the ruin of the city I was in Babylon, and lay troubled upon my bed, and my thoughts came up over my heart:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:2: For I saw the desolation of Sion, and the wealth of them that dwelt at Babylon.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:3: And my spirit was sore moved, so that I began to speak words full of fear to the Most High, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:4: O Yahuah (God), who bearest rule, you spakest at the beginning, when you did plant the earth, and that thyself alone, and commandedst the people,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:5: And gavest a body to Adam without soul, which was the workmanship of yours hands, and did breathe into him the breath of life, and he was made living before you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:6: And you leadest him into paradise, which your right hand had planted, before ever the earth came forward.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:7: And to him you gavest commandment to love your way: which he transgressed, and immediately you appointedst death in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds, out of number.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:8: And every people walked after their own will, and did wonderful things before you, and despised your commandments.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:9: And again in process of time you broughtest the flood upon those that dwelt in the world, and destroyedst them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:10: And it came to pass in every of them, that as death was to Adam, so was the flood to these.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:11: Nevertheless one of them you leftest, namely, Noah with his household, of whom came all righteous men.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:12: And it happened, that when they that dwelt upon the earth began to multiply, and had gotten them many children, and were a great people, they began again to be more ungodly than the first.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:13: Now when they lived so wickedly before you, you did choose you a man from among them, whose name was Abraham.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:14: Him you lovedst, and to him only you shewedst your will:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:15: And madest an everlasting covenant with him, promising him that you would never forsake his seed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:16: And to him you gavest Isaac, and to Isaac also you gavest Jacob and Esau. As for Jacob, you did choose him to you, and put by Esau: and so Jacob became a great multitude.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:17: And it came to pass, that when you leadest his seed out of Egypt, you broughtest them up to the mount Sinai.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:18: And bowing the heavens, you did set fast the earth, movedst the whole world, and madest the depths to tremble, and troubledst the men of that age.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:19: And your glory went through four gates, of fire, and of earthquake, and of wind, and of cold; that you might give the law to the seed of Jacob, and diligence to the generation of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:20: And yet tookest you not away from them a wicked heart, that your law might bring forth fruit in them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:21: For the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:22: Thus infirmity was made permanent; and the law (also) in the heart of the people with the malignity of the root; so that the good departed away, and the evil abode still.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:23: So the times passed away, and the years were brought to an end: then did you raise you up a servant, called David:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:24: Whom you commandedst to build a city to your name, and to offer incense and oblations to you in it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:25: When this was done many years, then they that inhabited the city forsook you,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:26: And in all things did even as Adam and all his generations had done: for they also had a wicked heart:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:27: And so you gavest your city over into the hands of your enemies.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:28: Are their deeds then any better that inhabit Babylon, that they should therefore have the dominion over Sion?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:29: For when I came thither, and had seen impieties without number, then my soul saw many evildoers in this thirtieth year, so that my heart failed me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:30: For I have seen how you sufferest them sinning, and have spared wicked doers: and have destroyed your people, and have preserved your enemies, and have not signified it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:31: I do not remember how this way may be left: Are they then of Babylon better than they of Sion?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:32: Or is there any other people that knoweth you beside Yashar'el (Israel)? or what generation has so believed your covenants as Jacob?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:33: And yet their reward appears not, and their labour has no fruit: for I have gone here and there through the heathen, and I see that they flow in wealth, and think not upon your commandments.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:34: Weigh you therefore our wickedness now in the balance, and their’s also that dwell the world; and so shall your name no where be found but in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:35: Or when was it that they which dwell upon the earth have not sinned in your sight? or what people have so kept your commandments?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|3:36: You shall find that Yashar'el (Israel) by name has kept your precepts; but not the heathen.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:1: And the angel that was sent to me, whose name was Uriel, gave me an answer,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:2: And said, Your heart has gone to far in this world, and thinkest you to comprehend the way of the Most High?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:3: Then said I, Yea, my lord. And he answered me, and said, I am sent to shew you three ways, and to set forth three similitudes before you:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:4: Of which if you can declare me one, I will shew you also the way that you desirest to see, and I shall shew you from whence the wicked heart comes.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:5: And I said, Tell on, my lord. Then said he to me, Go your way, weigh me the weight of the fire, or measure me the blast of the wind, or call me again the day that is past.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:6: Then answered I and said, What man is able to do that, that you should ask such things of me?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:7: And he said to me, If I should ask you how great dwellings are in the midst of the sea, or how many springs are in the beginning of the deep, or how many springs are above the firmament, or which are the outgoings of paradise:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:8: Perhaps you would say to me, I never went down into the deep, nor as yet into hell, neither did I ever climb up into heaven.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:9: Nevertheless now have I asked you but only of the fire and wind, and of the day wherethrough you have passed, and of things from which you can not be separated, and yet can you give me no answer of them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:10: He said moreover to me, Your own things, and such as are grown up with you, can you not know;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:11: How should your vessel then be able to comprehend the way of the Highest, and, the world being now outwardly corrupted to understand the corruption that is evident in my sight?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:12: Then said I to him, It were better that we were not at all, than that we should live still in wickedness, and to suffer, and not to know wherefore.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:13: He answered me, and said, I went into a forest into a plain, and the trees took counsel,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:14: And said, Come, let us go and make war against the sea that it may depart away before us, and that we may make us more woods.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:15: The floods of the sea also in like manner took counsel, and said, Come, let us go up and subdue the woods of the plain, that there also we may make us another country.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:16: The thought of the wood was in vain, for the fire came and consumed it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:17: The thought of the floods of the sea came likewise to nought, for the sand stood up and stopped them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:18: If you were judge now between these two, whom wouldest you begin to justify? or whom wouldest you condemn?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:19: I answered and said, Verily it is a foolish thought that they both have devised, for the ground is given to the wood, and the sea also has his place to bear his floods.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:20: Then answered he me, and said, You have given a right judgment, but why judgest you not thyself also?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:21: For like as the ground is given to the wood, and the sea to his floods: even so they that dwell upon the earth may understand nothing but that which is upon the earth: and he that dwells above the heavens may only understand the things that are above the height of the heavens.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:22: Then answered I and said, I beseech you, O Yahuah (God), let me have understanding:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:23: For it was not my mind to be curious of the high things, but of such as pass by us daily, namely, wherefore Yashar'el (Israel) is given up as a reproach to the heathen, and for what cause the people whom you have loved is given over to ungodly nations, and why the law of our forefathers is brought to nought, and the written covenants come to none effect,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:24: And we pass away out of the world as grasshoppers, and our life is astonishment and fear, and we are not worthy to obtain mercy.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:25: What will he then do to his name by which we are called? of these things have I asked.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:26: Then answered he me, and said, The more you searchest, the more you shall marvel; for the world hasteth fast to pass away,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:27: And cannot comprehend the things that are promised to the righteous in time to come: for this world is full of unrighteousness and infirmities.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:28: But as concerning the things of which you ask me, I will tell you; for the evil is sown, but the destruction thereof is not yet come.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:29: If therefore that which is sown be not turned upside down, and if the place where the evil is sown pass not away, then cannot it come that is sown with good.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:30: For the grain of evil seed has been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness has it brought up to this time? and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:31: Ponder now by thyself, how great fruit of wickedness the grain of evil seed has brought forth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:32: And when the ears shall be cut down, which are without number, how great a floor shall they fill?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:33: Then I answered and said, How, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:34: And he answered me, saying, Do not you hasten above the most Highest: for your haste is in vain to be above him, for you have much exceeded.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:35: Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:36: And to these things Uriel the archangel gave them answer, and said, Even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:37: By measure has he measured the times; and by number has he numbered the times; and he does not move nor stir them, until the said measure be fulfilled.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:38: Then answered I and said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, even we all are full of impiety.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:39: And for our sakes perhaps it is that the floors of the righteous are not filled, because of the sins of them that dwell upon the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:40: So he answered me, and said, Go your way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she has fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the birth any longer within her.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:41: Then said I, No, Yahuah (God), that can she not. And he said to me, In the grave the chambers of souls are like the womb of a woman:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:42: For like as a woman that travaileth makes haste to escape the necessity of the travail: even so do these places haste to deliver those things that are committed to them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:43: From the beginning, look, what you desirest to see, it shall be shewed you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:44: Then answered I and said, If I have found favour in your sight, and if it be possible, and if I be meet therefore,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:45: Shew me then whether there be more to come than is past, or more past than is to come.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:46: What is past I know, but what is for to come I know not.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:47: And he said to me, Stand up upon the right side, and I shall expound the similitude to you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:48: So I stood, and saw, and, behold, an hot burning oven passed by before me: and it happened that when the flame was gone by I looked, and, behold, the smoke remained still.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:49: After this there passed by before me a watery cloud, and sent down much rain with a storm; and when the stormy rain was past, the drops remained still.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:50: Then said he to me, Consider with thyself; as the rain is more than the drops, and as the fire is greater than the smoke; but the drops and the smoke remain behind: so the quantity which is past did more exceed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:51: Then I prayed, and said, May I live, thinkest you, until that time? or what shall happen in those days?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|4:52: He answered me, and said, As for the tokens of which you ask me, I may tell you of them in part: but as touching your life, I am not sent to shew you; for I do not know it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:1: Nevertheless as concerning the tokens, behold, the days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number, and the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:2: But iniquity shall be increased above that which now you see, or that you have heard long ago.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:3: And the land, that you see now to have root, shall you see wasted suddenly.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:4: But if the Most High grant you to live, you shall see after the third trumpet that the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:5: And blood shall drop out of wood, and the stone shall give his voice, and the people shall be troubled:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:6: And even he shall rule, whom they look not for that dwell upon the earth, and the fowls shall take their flight away together:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:7: And the Sodomitish sea shall cast out fish, and make a noise in the night, which many have not known: but they shall all hear the voice thereof.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:8: There shall be a confusion also in many places, and the fire shall be oft sent out again, and the wild beasts shall change their places, and menstruous women shall bring forth monsters:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:9: And salt waters shall be found in the sweet, and all friends shall destroy one another; then shall wit hide itself, and understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:10: And shall be sought of many, and yet not be found: then shall unrighteousness and incontinency be multiplied upon earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:11: One land also shall ask another, and say, Is righteousness that makes a man righteous gone through you? And it shall say, No.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:12: At the same time shall men hope, but nothing obtain: they shall labour, but their ways shall not prosper.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:13: To shew you such tokens I have leave; and if you will pray again, and weep as now, and fast even days, you shall hear yet greater things.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:14: Then I awaked, and an extreme fearfulness went through all my body, and my mind was troubled, so that it fainted.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:15: So the angel that was come to talk with me held me, comforted me, and set me up upon my feet.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:16: And in the second night it came to pass, that Salathiel the captain of the people came to me, saying, Where have you been? and why is your countenance so heavy?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:17: Knowest you not that Yashar'el (Israel) is committed to you in the land of their captivity?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:18: Up then, and eat bread, and forsake us not, as the shepherd that leaveth his flock in the hands of cruel wolves.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:19: Then said I to him, Go your ways from me, and come not nigh me. And he heard what I said, and went from me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:20: And so I fasted seven days, mourning and weeping, like as Uriel the angel commanded me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:21: And after seven days so it was, that the thoughts of my heart were very grievous to me again,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:22: And my soul recovered the spirit of understanding, and I began to talk with the Most High again,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:23: And said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:24: And of all lands of the whole world you have chosen you one pit: and of all the flowers thereof one lily:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:25: And of all the depths of the sea you have filled you one river: and of all builded cities you have hallowed Sion to thyself:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:26: And of all the fowls that are created you have named you one dove: and of all the cattle that are made you have provided you one sheep:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:27: And among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:28: And now, O Yahuah (God), why have you given this one people over to many? and upon the one root have you prepared others, and why have you scattered your only one people among many?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:29: And they which did gainsay your promises, and believed not your covenants, have trodden them down.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:30: If you did so much hate your people, yet shouldest you punish them with your own hands.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:31: Now when I had spoken these words, the angel that came to me the night afore was sent to me,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:32: And said to me, Hear me, and I will instruct you; hearken to the thing that I say, and I shall tell you more.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:33: And I said, Speak on, my Elohim (God). Then said he to me, You are sore troubled in mind for Yashar'el (Israel)’s sake: lovest you that people better than he that made them?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:34: And I said, No, Yahuah (God): but of very grief have I spoken: for my reins pain me every hour, while I labour to comprehend the way of the Most High, and to seek out part of his judgment.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:35: And he said to me, You can not. And I said, Wherefore, Yahuah (God)? to which was I born then? or why was not my mother’s womb then my grave, that I might not have seen the travail of Jacob, and the wearisome toil of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:36: And he said to me, Number me the things that are not yet come, gather me together the dross that are scattered abroad, make me the flowers green again that are withered,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:37: Open me the places that are closed, and bring me forth the winds that in them are shut up, shew me the image of a voice: and then I will declare to you the thing that you labourest to know.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:38: And I said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, who may know these things, but he that has not his dwelling with men?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:39: As for me, I am unwise: how may I then speak of these things of which you ask me?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:40: Then said he to me, Like as you can do none of these things that I have spoken of, even so can you not find out my judgment, or in the end the love that I have promised to my people.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:41: And I said, Behold, O Yahuah (God), yet art you nigh to them that be reserved till the end: and what shall they do that have been before me, or we that be now, or they that shall come after us?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:42: And he said to me, I will liken my judgment to a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:43: So I answered and said, Couldest you not make those that have been made, and be now, and that are for to come, at once; that you might shew your judgment the sooner?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:44: Then answered he me, and said, The creature may not haste above the maker; neither may the world hold them at once that shall be created in it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:45: And I said, As you have said to your servant, that you, which givest life to all, have given life at once to the creature that you have created, and the creature bare it: even so it might now also bear them that now be present at once.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:46: And he said to me, Ask the womb of a woman, and say to her, If you bring forth children, why do you it not together, but one after another? pray her therefore to bring forth ten children at once.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:47: And I said, She cannot: but must do it by distance of time.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:48: Then said he to me, Even so have I given the womb of the earth to those that be sown in it in their times.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:49: For like as a young child may not bring forth the things that belong to the aged, even so have I disposed the world which I created.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:50: And I asked, and said, Seeing you have now given me the way, I will proceed to speak before you: for our mother, of whom you have told me that she is young, draws now nigh to age.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:51: He answered me, and said, Ask a woman that bears children, and she shall tell you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:52: Say to her, Wherefore are to they whom you have now brought forth like those that were before, but less of stature?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:53: And she shall answer you, They that be born in the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb fails, are otherwise.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:54: Consider you therefore also, how that you are less of stature than those that were before you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:55: And so are they that come after you less than you, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|5:56: Then said I, Yahuah (God), I beseech you, if I have found favour in your sight, shew your servant by whom you visitest your creature.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:1: And he said to me, In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:2: Before it thundered and lightened, or ever the foundations of paradise were laid,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:3: Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:4: Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:5: And ere the present years were sought out, and or ever the inventions of them that now sin were turned, before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:6: Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:7: Then answered I and said, What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:8: And he said to me, From Abraham to Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:9: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:10: The hand of man is between the heel and the hand: other question, Esdras, ask you not.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:11: I answered then and said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, if I have found favour in your sight,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:12: I beseech you, shew your servant the end of your tokens, of which you shewedst me part the last night.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:13: So he answered and said to me, Stand up upon your feet, and hear a mighty sounding voice.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:14: And it shall be as it were a great motion; but the place where you standest shall not be moved.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:15: And therefore when it speaks be not afraid: for the word is of the end, and the foundation of the earth is understood.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:16: And why? because the speech of these things trembles and is moved: for it knoweth that the end of these things must be changed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:17: And it happened, that when I had heard it I stood up upon my feet, and hearkened, and, behold, there was a voice that spoke, and the sound of it was like the sound of many waters.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:18: And it said, Behold, the days come, that I will begin to draw nigh, and to visit them that dwell upon the earth,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:19: And will begin to make inquisition of them, what they be that have hurt unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Sion shall be fulfilled;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:20: And when the world, that shall begin to vanish away, shall be finished, then will I shew these tokens: the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:21: And the children of a year old shall speak with their voices, the women with child shall bring forth untimely children of three or four months old, and they shall live, and be raised up.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:22: And suddenly shall the sown places appear unsown, the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:23: And the trumpet shall give a sound, which when every man heareth, they shall be suddenly afraid.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:24: At that time shall friends fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear with those that dwell in it, the springs of the fountains shall stand still, and in three hours they shall not run.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:25: Whoever remains from all these that I have told you shall escape, and see my salvation, and the end of your world.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:26: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:27: For evil shall be put out, and deceit shall be quenched.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:28: As for faith, it shall flourish, corruption shall be overcome, and the truth, which has been so long without fruit, shall be declared.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:29: And when he talked with me, behold, I looked by little and little upon him before whom I stood.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:30: And these words said he to me; I am come to shew you the time of the night to come.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:31: If you will pray yet more, and fast seven days again, I shall tell you greater things by day than I have heard.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:32: For your voice is heard before the Most High: for the Mighty has seen your righteous dealing, he has seen also your chastity, which you have had ever since your youth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:33: And therefore has he sent me to shew you all these things, and to say to you, Be of good comfort and fear not
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:34: And hasten not with the times that are past, to think vain things, that you may not hasten from the latter times.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:35: And it came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfil the three weeks which he told me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:36: And in the eighth night was my heart vexed within me again, and I began to speak before the Most High.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:37: For my spirit was greatly set on fire, and my soul was in distress.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:38: And I said, O Yahuah (God), you spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and your word was a perfect work.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:39: And then was the spirit, and darkness and silence were on every side; the sound of man’s voice was not yet formed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:40: Then commandedst you a fair light to come forth of your treasures, that your work might appear.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:41: Upon the second day you madest the spirit of the firmament, and commandedst it to part asunder, and to make a division between the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:42: Upon the third day you did command that the waters should be gathered in the seventh part of the earth: six parts have you dried up, and kept them, to the intent that of these some being planted of Yahuah (God) and tilled might serve you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:43: For as soon as your word went forth the work was made.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:44: For immediately there was great and innumerable fruit, and many and divers pleasures for the taste, and flowers of unchangeable colour, and odours of wonderful smell: and this was done the third day.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:45: Upon the fourth day you commandedst that the sun should shine, and the moon give her light, and the stars should be in order:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:46: And gavest them a charge to do service to man, that was to be made.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:47: Upon the fifth day you saidst to the seventh part, where the waters were gathered that it should bring forth living creatures, fowls and fishes: and so it came to pass.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:48: For the dumb water and without life brought forth living things at the commandment of Yahuah (God), that all people might praise your wondrous works.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:49: Then did you ordain two living creatures, the one you calledst Enoch, and the other Leviathan;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:50: And did separate the one from the other: for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:51: To Enoch you gavest one part, which was dried up the third day, that he should dwell in the same part, in which are a thousand hills:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:52: But to Leviathan you gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and have kept him to be devoured of whom you will, and when.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:53: Upon the sixth day you gavest commandment to the earth, that before you it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:54: And after these, Adam also, whom you madest lord of all your creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom you have chosen.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:55: All this have I spoken before you, O Yahuah (God), because you madest the world for our sakes
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:56: As for the other people, which also come of Adam, you have said that they are nothing, but be like to spittle: and have likened the abundance of them to a drop that falls from a vessel.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:57: And now, O Yahuah (God), behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:58: But we your people, whom you have called your firstborn, your only begotten, and your fervent lover, are given into their hands.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|6:59: If the world now be made for our sakes, why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:1: And when I had made an end of speaking these words, there was sent to me the angel which had been sent to me the nights afore:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:2: And he said to me, Up, Esdras, and hear the words that I am come to tell you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:3: And I said, Speak on, my Elohim (God). Then said he to me, The sea is set in a wide place, that it might be deep and great.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:4: But put the case the entrance were narrow, and like a river;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:5: Who then could go into the sea to look upon it, and to rule it? if he went not through the narrow, how could he come into the broad?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:6: There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:7: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:8: And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:9: If this city now were given to a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:10: And I said, It is so, Yahuah (God). Then said he to me, Even so also is Yashar'el (Israel)’s portion.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:11: Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:12: Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail: they are but few and evil, full of perils, and very painful.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:13: For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:14: If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:15: Now therefore why disquietest you thyself, seeing you are but a corruptible man? and why art you moved, whereas you are but mortal?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:16: Why have you not considered in your mind this thing that is to come, rather than that which is present?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:17: Then answered I and said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, you have ordained in your law, that the righteous should inherit these things, but that the ungodly should perish.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:18: Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide: for they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:19: And he said to me. There is no judge above Yahuah (God), and none that has understanding above the Highest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:20: For there be many that perish in this life, because they despise the law of Yahuah (God) that is set before them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:21: For Yahuah (God) has given strait commandment to such as came, what they should do to live, even as they came, and what they should observe to avoid punishment.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:22: Nevertheless they were not obedient to him; but spoke against him, and imagined vain things;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:23: And deceived themselves by their wicked deeds; and said of the Most High, that he is not; and knew not his ways:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:24: But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:25: And therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:26: Behold, the time shall come, that these tokens which I have told you shall come to pass, and the bride shall appear, and she coming forth shall be seen, that now is withdrawn from the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:27: And whoever is delivered from the foresaid evils shall see my wonders.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:29: After these years shall my son Messiah (Christ) die, and all men that have life.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:30: And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:31: And after seven days the world, that yet awakes not, shall be raised up, and that shall die that is corrupt
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:32: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:33: And the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:34: But judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:35: And the work shall follow, and the reward shall be shewed, and the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:36: Then said I, Abraham prayed first for the Sodomites, and Moses for the fathers that sinned in the wilderness:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:37: And Jesus after him for Yashar'el (Israel) in the time of Achan:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:38: And Samuel and David for the destruction: and Solomon for them that should come to the sanctuary:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:39: And Helias for those that received rain; and for the dead, that he might live:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:40: And Ezechias for the people in the time of Sennacherib: and many for many.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:41: Even so now, seeing corruption is grown up, and wickedness increased, and the righteous have prayed for the ungodly: wherefore shall it not be so now also?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:42: He answered me, and said, This present life is not the end where much glory does abide; therefore have they prayed for the weak.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:43: But the day of doom shall be the end of this time, and the beginning of the immortality for to come, in which corruption is past,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:44: Intemperance is at an end, infidelity is cut off, righteousness is grown, and truth is sprung up.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:45: Then shall no man be able to save him that is destroyed, nor to oppress him that has gotten the victory.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:46: I answered then and said, This is my first and last saying, that it had been better not to have given the earth to Adam: or else, when it was given him, to have restrained him from sinning.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:47: For what profit is it for men now in this present time to live in heaviness, and after death to look for punishment?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:48: O you Adam, what have you done? for though it was you that sinned, you are not fallen alone, but we all that come of you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:49: For what profit is it to us, if there be promised us an immortal time, whereas we have done the works that bring death?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:50: And that there is promised us an everlasting hope, whereas ourselves being most wicked are made vain?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:51: And that there are laid up for us dwellings of health and safety, whereas we have lived wickedly?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:52: And that the glory of the Most High is kept to defend them which have led a wary life, whereas we have walked in the most wicked ways of all?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:53: And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, in which is security and medicine, since we shall not enter into it?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:54: (For we have walked in unpleasant places.)
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:55: And that the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars, whereas our faces shall be blacker than darkness?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:56: For while we lived and committed iniquity, we considered not that we should begin to suffer for it after death.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:57: Then answered he me, and said, This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:58: That, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as you have said: but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:59: For this is the life of which Moses spoke to the people while he lived, saying, Choose you life, that you may live.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:60: Nevertheless they believed not him, nor yet the prophets after him, no nor me which have spoken to them,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:61: That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:62: I answered then, and said, I know, Yahuah (God), that the Most High is called merciful, in that he has mercy upon them which are not yet come into the world,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:63: And upon those also that turn to his law;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:64: And that he is patient, and long suffers those that have sinned, as his creatures;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:65: And that he is bountiful, for he is ready to give where it needeth;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:66: And that he is of great mercy, for he multiplieth more and more mercies to them that are present, and that are past, and also to them which are to come.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:67: For if he shall not multiply his mercies, the world would not continue with them that inherit in it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:68: And he pardoneth; for if he did not so of his goodness, that they which have committed iniquities might be eased of them, the ten thousandth part of men should not remain living.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:69: And being judge, if he should not forgive them that are cured with his word, and put out the multitude of contentions,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:70: There should be very few left perhaps in an innumerable multitude.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|7:28: For my son the Messiah shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:1: And he answered me, saying, The most High has made this world for many, but the world to come for few.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:2: I will tell you a similitude, Esdras; As when you ask the earth, it shall say to you, that it gives much mould of which earthen vessels are made, but little dust that gold comes of: even so is the course of this present world.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:3: There be many created, but few shall be saved.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:4: So answered I and said, Swallow then down, O my soul, understanding, and devour wisdom.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:5: For you have agreed to give ear, and art willing to prophesy: for you have no longer space than only to live.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:6: O Yahuah (God), if you suffer not your servant, that we may pray before you, and you give us seed to our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it; how shall each man live that is corrupt, who bears the place of a man?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:7: For you are alone, and we all one workmanship of yours hands, like as you have said.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:8: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and you give it members, your creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months does your workmanship endure your creature which is created in her.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:9: But that which keepeth and is kept shall both be preserved: and when the time comes, the womb preserved delivers up the things that grew in it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:10: For you have commanded out of the parts of the body, that is to say, out of the breasts, milk to be given, which is the fruit of the breasts,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:11: That the thing which is fashioned may be nourished for a time, till you disposest it to your mercy.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:12: You broughtest it up with your righteousness, and nurturedst it in your law, and reformedst it with your judgment.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:13: And you shall mortify it as your creature, and quicken it as your work.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:14: If therefore you shall destroy him which with so great labour was fashioned, it is an easy thing to be ordained by your commandment, that the thing which was made might be preserved.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:15: Now therefore, Yahuah (God), I will speak; touching man in general, you know best; but touching your people, for whose sake I am sorry;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:16: And for your inheritance, for whose cause I mourn; and for Yashar'el (Israel), for whom I am heavy; and for Jacob, for whose sake I am troubled;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:17: Therefore will I begin to pray before you for myself and for them: for I see the falls of us that dwell in the land.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:18: But I have heard the swiftness of the judge which is to come.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:19: Therefore hear my voice, and understand my words, and I shall speak before you. This is the beginning of the words of Esdras, before he was taken up: and I said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:20: O Yahuah (God), you that dwellest in everlastingness which beholdest from above things in the heaven and in the air;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:21: Whose throne is inestimable; whose glory may not be comprehended; before whom the hosts of angels stand with trembling,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:22: Whose service is conversant in wind and fire; whose word is true, and sayings constant; whose commandment is strong, and ordinance fearful;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:23: Whose look drieth up the depths, and indignation makes the mountains to melt away; which the truth witnesseth:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:24: O hear the prayer of your servant, and give ear to the petition of your creature.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:25: For while I live I will speak, and so long as I have understanding I will answer.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:26: O look not upon the sins of your people; but on them which serve you in truth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:27: Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen, but the desire of those that keep your testimonies in afflictions.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:28: Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before you: but remember them, which according to your will have known your fear.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:29: Let it not be your will to destroy them which have lived like beasts; but to look upon them that have clearly taught your law.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:30: Take you no indignation at them which are deemed worse than beasts; but love them that always put their trust in your righteousness and glory.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:31: For we and our fathers do languish of such diseases: but because of us sinners you shall be called merciful.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:32: For if you have a desire to have mercy upon us, you shall be called merciful, to us namely, that have no works of righteousness.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:33: For the just, which have many good works laid up with you, shall out of their own deeds receive reward.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:34: For what is man, that you should take displeasure at him? or what is a corruptible generation, that you should be so bitter toward it?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:35: For in truth them is no man among them that be born, but he has dealt wickedly; and among the faithful there is none which has not done amiss.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:36: For in this, O Yahuah (God), your righteousness and your goodness shall be declared, if you be merciful to them which have not the confidence of good works.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:37: Then answered he me, and said, Some things have you spoken aright, and according to your words it shall be.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:38: For indeed I will not think on the disposition of them which have sinned before death, before judgment, before destruction:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:39: But I will rejoice over the disposition of the righteous, and I will remember also their pilgrimage, and the salvation, and the reward, that they shall have.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:40: Like as I have spoken now, so shall it come to pass.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:41: For as the husbandman sows much seed upon the ground, and planteth many trees, and yet the thing that is sown good in his season comes not up, neither does all that is planted take root: even so is it of them that are sown in the world; they shall not all be saved.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:42: I answered then and said, If I have found grace, let me speak.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:43: Like as the husbandman’s seed perishes, if it come not up, and receive not your rain in due season; or if there come too much rain, and corrupt it:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:44: Even so perishes man also, which is formed with your hands, and is called your own image, because you are like to him, for whose sake you have made all things, and likened him to the husbandman’s seed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:45: Be not wroth with us but spare your people, and have mercy upon your own inheritance: for you are merciful to your creature.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:46: Then answered he me, and said, Things present are for the present, and things to comes for such as be to come.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:47: For you come far short that you should be able to love my creature more than I: but I have ofttimes drawn nigh to you, and to it, but never to the unrighteous.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:48: In this also you are marvellous before the Most High:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:49: In that you have humbled thyself, as it becometh you, and have not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:50: For many great miseries shall be done to them that in the latter time shall dwell in the world, because they have walked in great pride.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:51: But understand you for thyself, and seek out the glory for such as be like you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:52: For to you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yes, perfect goodness and wisdom.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:53: The root of evil is sealed up from you, weakness and the moth is hid from you, and corruption is fled into hell to be forgotten:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:54: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:55: And therefore ask you no more questions concerning the multitude of them that perish.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:56: For when they had taken liberty, they despised the Most High, thought scorn of his law, and forsook his ways.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:57: Moreover they have trodden down his righteous,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:58: And said in their heart, that there is no Yahuah (God); yes, and that knowing they must die.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:59: For as the things aforesaid shall receive you, so thirst and pain are prepared for them: for it was not his will that men should come to nought:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:60: But they which be created have defiled the name of him that made them, and were unthankful to him which prepared life for them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:61: And therefore is my judgment now at hand.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:62: These things have I not shewed to all men, but to you, and a few like you. Then answered I and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|8:63: Behold, O Yahuah (God), now have you shewed me the multitude of the wonders, which you will begin to do in the last times: but at what time, you have not shewed me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:1: He answered me then, and said, Measure you the time diligently in itself: and when you see part of the signs past, which I have told you before,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:2: Then shall you understand, that it is the very same time, in which the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:3: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:4: Then shall you well understand, that the Most High spoke of those things from the days that were before you, even from the beginning.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:5: For like as all that is made in the world has a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:6: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:7: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, by which you have believed,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:8: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:9: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:10: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:11: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open to them, understood not, but despised it;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:12: The same must know it after death by pain.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:13: And therefore be you not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:15: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:16: Like as a wave is greater than a drop.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:17: And he answered me, saying, Like as the field is, so is also the seed; as the flowers be, such are the colours also; such as the workman is, such also is the work; and as the husbandman is himself, so is his husbandry also: for it was the time of the world.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:18: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spoke against me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:19: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed, and by a law which is unsearchable rid themselves.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:20: So I considered the world, and, behold, there was peril because of the devices that were come into it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:21: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:22: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:23: Nevertheless, if you will cease yet seven days more, (but you shall not fast in them,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:24: But go into a field of flowers, where no house is builded, and eat only the flowers of the field; taste no flesh, drink no wine, but eat flowers only;)
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:25: And pray to the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:26: So I went my way into the field which is called Ardath, like as he commanded me; and there I sat among the flowers, and did eat of the herbs of the field, and the meat of the same satisfied me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:27: After seven days I sat upon the grass, and my heart was vexed within me, like as before:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:28: And I opened my mouth, and began to talk before the Most High, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:29: O Yahuah (God), you that shewest thyself to us, you were shewed to our fathers in the wilderness, in a place where no man treadeth, in a barren place, when they came out of Egypt.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:30: And you spakest saying, Hear me, O Yashar'el (Israel); and mark my words, you seed of Jacob.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:31: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and you shall be honoured in it for ever.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:32: But our fathers, which received the law, kept it not, and observed not your ordinances: and though the fruit of your law did not perish, neither could it, for it was yours;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:33: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:34: And, lo, it is a custom, when the ground has received seed, or the sea a ship, or any vessel meat or drink, that, that being perished in which it was sown or cast into,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:35: That thing also which was sown, or cast in it, or received, does perish, and remains not with us: but with us it has not happened so.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:36: For we that have received the law perish by sin, and our heart also which received it
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:37: Notwithstanding the law perishes not, but remains in his force.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:38: And when I spoke these things in my heart, I looked back with my eyes, and upon the right side I saw a woman, and, behold, she mourned and wept with a loud voice, and was much grieved in heart, and her clothes were rent, and she had ashes upon her head.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:39: Then let I my thoughts go that I was in, and turned me to her,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:40: And said to her, Wherefore weepest you? why art you so grieved in your mind?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:41: And she said to me, Sir, let me alone, that I may bewail myself, and add to my sorrow, for I am sore vexed in my mind, and brought very low.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:42: And I said to her, What aileth you? tell me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:43: She said to me, I your servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:44: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:45: After thirty years Yahuah (God) heard me yours handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour to the Almighty.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:46: And I nourished him with great travail.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|9:47: So when he grew up, and came to the time that he should have a wife, I made a feast.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:1: And it so came to pass, that when my son was entered into his wedding chamber, he fell down, and died.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:2: Then we all overthrew the lights, and all my neighbours rose up to comfort me: so I took my rest to the second day at night.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:3: And it came to pass, when they had all left off to comfort me, to the end I might be quiet; then rose I up by night and fled, and came hither into this field, as you see.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:4: And I do now purpose not to return into the city, but here to stay, and neither to eat nor drink, but continually to mourn and to fast until I die.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:5: Then left I the meditations in which I was, and spoke to her in anger, saying,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:6: You foolish woman above all other, seest you not our mourning, and what happeneth to us?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:7: How that Sion our mother is full of all heaviness, and much humbled, mourning very sore?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:8: And now, seeing we all mourn and are sad, for we are all in heaviness, art you grieved for one son?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:9: For ask the earth, and she shall tell you, that it is she which ought to mourn for the fall of so many that grow upon her.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:10: For out of her came all at the first, and out of her shall all others come, and, behold, they walk almost all into destruction, and a multitude of them is utterly rooted out.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:11: Who then should make more mourning than she, that has lost so great a multitude; and not you, which are sorry but for one?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:12: But if you say to me, My lamentation is not like the earth’s, because I have lost the fruit of my womb, which I brought forth with pains, and bare with sorrows;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:13: But the earth not so: for the multitude present in it according to the course of the earth is gone, as it came:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:14: Then say I to you, Like as you have brought forth with labour; even so the earth also has given her fruit, namely, man, ever since the beginning to him that made her.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:15: Now therefore keep your sorrow to thyself, and bear with a good courage that which has befallen you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:16: For if you shall acknowledge the determination of Yahuah (God) to be just, you shall both receive your son in time, and shall be commended among women.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:17: Go your way then into the city to yours husband.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:18: And she said to me, That will I not do: I will not go into the city, but here will I die.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:19: So I proceeded to speak further to her, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:20: Do not so, but be counselled. by me: for how many are the adversities of Sion? be comforted in regard of the sorrow of Jerusalem.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:21: For you see that our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:22: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:23: And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion has now lost her honour; for she is delivered into the hands of them that hate us.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:24: And therefore shake off your great heaviness, and put away the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful to you again, and the Highest shall give you rest and ease from your labour.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:25: And it came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face upon a sudden shined exceedingly, and her countenance glistered, so that I was afraid of her, and mused what it might be.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:26: And, behold, suddenly she made a great cry very fearful: so that the earth shook at the noise of the woman.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:27: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared to me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:28: Where is Uriel the angel, who came to me at the first? for he has caused me to fall into many trances, and my end is turned into corruption, and my prayer to rebuke.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:29: And as I was speaking these words behold, he came to me, and looked upon me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:30: And, lo, I lay as one that had been dead, and my understanding was taken from me: and he took me by the right hand, and comforted me, and set me upon my feet, and said to me,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:31: What aileth you? and why art you so disquieted? and why is your understanding troubled, and the thoughts of yours heart?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:32: And I said, Because you have forsaken me, and yet I did according to your words, and I went into the field, and, lo, I have seen, and yet see, that I am not able to express.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:33: And he said to me, Stand up manfully, and I will advise you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:34: Then said I, Speak on, my lord, in me; only forsake me not, lest I die frustrate of my hope.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:35: For I have seen that I knew not, and hear that I do not know.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:36: Or is my sense deceived, or my soul in a dream?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:37: Now therefore I beseech you that you will shew your servant of this vision.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:38: He answered me then, and said, Hear me, and I shall inform you, and tell you wherefore you are afraid: for the Highest will reveal many secret things to you.
