live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:39: He has seen that your way is right: for that you sorrowest continually for your people, and makest great lamentation for Sion.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:40: This therefore is the meaning of the vision which you lately sawest:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:41: You sawest a woman mourning, and you begannest to comfort her:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:42: But now seest you the likeness of the woman no more, but there appeared to you a city builded.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:43: And whereas she told you of the death of her son, this is the solution:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:44: This woman, whom you sawest is Sion: and whereas she said to you, even she whom you see as a city builded,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:45: Whereas, I say, she said to you, that she has been thirty years barren: those are the thirty years in which there was no offering made in her.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:46: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:47: And whereas she told you that she nourished him with labour: that was the dwelling in Jerusalem.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:48: But whereas she said to you, That my son coming into his marriage chamber happened to have a fail, and died: this was the destruction that came to Jerusalem.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:49: And, behold, you sawest her likeness, and because she mourned for her son, you begannest to comfort her: and of these things which have chanced, these are to be opened to you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:50: For now the Most High seeth that you are grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from your whole heart for her, so has he shewed you the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:51: And therefore I told you remain in the field where no house was builded:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:52: For I knew that the Highest would shew this to you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:53: Therefore I commanded you to go into the field, where no foundation of any building was.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:54: For in the place in which the Highest begins to shew his city, there can no man’s building be able to stand.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:55: And therefore fear not, let not yours heart be affrighted, but go your way in, and see the beauty and greatness of the building, as much as your eyes be able to see:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:56: And then shall you hear as much as your ears may comprehend.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:57: For you are blessed above many other, and art called with the Highest; and so are but few.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:58: But to morrow at night you shall remain here;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|10:59: And so shall the Highest shew you visions of the high things, which the Most High will do to them that dwell upon the earth in the last days. So I slept that night and another, like as he commanded me.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:1: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:2: And I saw, and, behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her, and were gathered together.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:3: And I beheld, and out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:4: But her heads were at rest: the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:5: Moreover I beheld, and, lo, the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt in it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:6: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject to her, and no man spoke against her, no, not one creature upon earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:7: And I beheld, and, lo, the eagle rose upon her talons, and spoke to her feathers, saying,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:8: Watch not all at once: sleep every one in his own place, and watch by course:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:9: But let the heads be preserved for the last.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:10: And I beheld, and, lo, the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:11: And I numbered her contrary feathers, and, behold, there were eight of them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:12: And I looked, and, behold, on the right side there arose one feather, and reigned over all the earth;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:13: And so it was, that when it reigned, the end of it came, and the place thereof appeared no more: so the next following stood up. and reigned, and had a great time;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:14: And it happened, that when it reigned, the end of it came also, like as the first, so that it appeared no more.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:15: Then came there a voice to it, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:16: Hear you that have borne rule over the earth so long: this I say to you, before you beginnest to appear no more,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:17: There shall none after you attain to your time, neither to the half thereof.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:18: Then arose the third, and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:19: So went it with all the residue one after another, as that every one reigned, and then appeared no more.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:20: Then I beheld, and, lo, in process of time the feathers that followed stood up upon the right side, that they might rule also; and some of them ruled, but within a while they appeared no more:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:21: For some of them were set up, but ruled not.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:22: After this I looked, and, behold, the twelve feathers appeared no more, nor the two little feathers:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:23: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:24: Then saw I also that two little feathers divided themselves from the six, and remained under the head that was upon the right side: for the four continued in their place.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:25: And I beheld, and, lo, the feathers that were under the wing thought to set up themselves and to have the rule.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:26: And I beheld, and, lo, there was one set up, but shortly it appeared no more.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:27: And the second was sooner away than the first.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:28: And I beheld, and, lo, the two that remained thought also in themselves to reign:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:29: And when they so thought, behold, there awaked one of the heads that were at rest, namely, it that was in the midst; for that was greater than the two other heads.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:30: And then I saw that the two other heads were joined with it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:31: And, behold, the head was turned with them that were with it, and did eat up the two feathers under the wing that would have reigned.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:32: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:33: And after this I beheld, and, lo, the head that was in the midst suddenly appeared no more, like as the wings.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:34: But there remained the two heads, which also in like sort ruled upon the earth, and over those that dwelt in it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:35: And I beheld, and, lo, the head upon the right side devoured it that was upon the left side.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:36: Then I head a voice, which said to me, Look before you, and consider the thing that you see.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:37: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice to the eagle, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:38: Hear you, I will talk with you, and the Highest shall say to you,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:39: Art not you it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:40: And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:41: For the earth have you not judged with truth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:42: For you have afflicted the meek, you have hurt the peaceable, you have loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and have cast down the walls of such as did you no harm.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:43: Therefore is your wrongful dealing come up to the Highest, and your pride to the Mighty.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:44: The Highest also has looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:45: And therefore appear no more, you eagle, nor your horrible wings, nor your wicked feathers nor your malicious heads, nor your hurtful claws, nor all your vain body:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|11:46: That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from your violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:1: And it came to pass, whiles the lion spoke these words to the eagle, I saw,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:2: And, behold, the head that remained and the four wings appeared no more, and the two went to it and set themselves up to reign, and their kingdom was small, and fill of uproar.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:3: And I saw, and, behold, they appeared no more, and the whole body of the eagle was burnt so that the earth was in great fear: then awaked I out of the trouble and trance of my mind, and from great fear, and said to my spirit,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:4: Lo, this have you done to me, in that you searchest out the ways of the Highest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:5: Lo, yet am I weary in my mind, and very weak in my spirit; and little strength is there in me, for the great fear with which I was afflicted this night.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:6: Therefore will I now beseech the Highest, that he will comfort me to the end.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:7: And I said, Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, if I have found grace before your sight, and if I am justified with you before many others, and if my prayer indeed be come up before your face;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:8: Comfort me then, and shew me your servant the interpretation and plain difference of this fearful vision, that you may perfectly comfort my soul.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:9: For you have judged me worthy to shew me the last times.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:10: And he said to me, This is the interpretation of the vision:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:11: The eagle, whom you sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of your brother Daniel.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:12: But it was not expounded to him, therefore now I declare it to you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:13: Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:14: In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:15: Of which the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:16: And this do the twelve wings signify, which you sawest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:17: As for the voice which you heardest speak, and that you sawest not to go out from the heads but from the midst of the body thereof, this is the interpretation:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:18: That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of failing: nevertheless it shall not then fall, but shall be restored again to his beginning.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:19: And whereas you sawest the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings, this is the interpretation:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:20: That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:21: And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching: four shall be kept until their end begin to approach: but two shall be kept to the end.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:22: And whereas you sawest three heads resting, this is the interpretation:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:23: In his last days shall the Most High raise up three kingdoms, and renew many things in it, and they shall have the dominion of the earth,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:24: And of those that dwell in it, with much oppression, above all those that were before them: therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:25: For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness, and that shall finish his last end.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:26: And whereas you sawest that the great head appeared no more, it signifieth that one of them shall die upon his bed, and yet with pain.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:27: For the two that remain shall be slain with the sword.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:28: For the sword of the one shall devour the other: but at the last shall he fall through the sword himself.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:29: And whereas you sawest two feathers under the wings passing over the head that is on the right side;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:30: It signifieth that these are they, whom the Highest has kept to their end: this is the small kingdom and full of trouble, as you sawest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:31: And the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which you have heard;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:32: This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them and for their wickedness to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:33: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:34: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:35: This is the dream that you sawest, and these are the interpretations.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:36: You only have been meet to know this secret of the Highest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:37: Therefore write all these things that you have seen in a book, and hide them:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:38: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts you know may comprehend and keep these secrets.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:39: But wait you here thyself yet seven days more, that it may be shewed you, whatsoever it pleaseth the Highest to declare to you. And with that he went his way.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:40: And it came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I not come again into the city, they gathered them all together, from the least to the greatest, and came to me, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:41: What have we offended you? and what evil have we done against you, that you forsakest us, and sittest here in this place?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:42: For of all the prophets you only art left us, as a cluster of the vintage, and as a candle in a dark place, and as a haven or ship preserved from the tempest.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:43: Are not the evils which are come to us sufficient?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:44: If you shall forsake us, how much better had it been for us, if we also had been burned in the midst of Sion?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:45: For we are not better than they that died there. And they wept with a loud voice. Then answered I them, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:46: Be of good comfort, O Yashar'el (Israel); and be not heavy, you house of Jacob:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:47: For the Highest has you in remembrance, and the Mighty has not forgotten you in temptation.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:48: As for me, I have not forsaken you, neither am I departed from you: but am come into this place, to pray for the desolation of Sion, and that I might seek mercy for the low estate of your sanctuary.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:49: And now go your way home every man, and after these days will I come to you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:50: So the people went their way into the city, like as I commanded them:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|12:51: But I remained still in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me; and did eat only in those days of the flowers of the field, and had my meat of the herbs.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:1: And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:2: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:3: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:4: And whenever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth fails when it feeleth the fire.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:5: And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:6: But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:7: But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:8: And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:9: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:10: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:11: And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke: when I saw this I was afraid.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:12: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call to him another peaceable Multitude.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:13: And there came much people to him, of which some were glad, some were sorry, and some of them were bound, and other some brought of them that were offered: then was I sick through great fear, and I awaked, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:14: You have shewed your servant these wonders from the beginning, and have counted me worthy that you should receive my prayer:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:15: Shew me now yet the interpretation of this dream.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:16: For as I conceive in my understanding, woe to them that shall be left in those days and much more woe to them that are not left behind!
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:17: For they that were not left were in heaviness.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:18: Now understand I the things that are laid up in the latter days, which shall happen to them, and to those that are left behind.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:19: Therefore are they come into great perils and many necessities, like as these dreams declare.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:20: Yet is it easier for him that is in danger to come into these things, than to pass away as a cloud out of the world, and not to see the things that happen in the last days. And he answered to me, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:21: The interpretation of the vision shall I shew you, and I will open to you the thing that you have required.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:22: Whereas you have spoken of them that are left behind, this is the interpretation:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:23: He that shall endure the peril in that time has kept himself: they that be fallen into danger are such as have works, and faith toward the Almighty.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:24: Know this therefore, that they which be left behind are more blessed than they that be dead.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:25: This is the meaning of the vision: Whereas you sawest a man coming up from the midst of the sea:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:26: The same is he whom Yahuah (God) the Highest has kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:27: And whereas you sawest, that out of his mouth there came as a blast of wind, and fire, and storm;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:28: And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war, but that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:29: Behold, the days come, when the Most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:30: And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:31: And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:32: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed you before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom you sawest as a man ascending.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:33: And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:34: And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as you sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:35: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:36: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as you sawest the hill graven without hands.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:37: And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:38: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments with which they shall begin to be tormented, which are like to a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like to fire.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:39: And whereas you sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude to him;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:40: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:41: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:42: That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:43: And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:44: For the Most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:45: For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:46: Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:47: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:48: But those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:49: Now when he destroys the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:50: And then shall he shew them great wonders.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:51: Then said I, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, shew me this: Wherefore have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:52: And he said to me, Like as you can neither seek out nor know the things that are in the deep of the sea: even so can no man upon earth see my Son, or those that be with him, but in the day time.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:53: This is the interpretation of the dream which you sawest, and by which you only art here lightened.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:54: For you have forsaken your own way, and applied your diligence to my law, and sought it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:55: Your life have you ordered in wisdom, and have called understanding your mother.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:56: And therefore have I shewed you the treasures of the Highest: after other three days I will speak other things to you, and declare to you mighty and wondrous things.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:57: Then went I forth into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly to the Most High because of his wonders which he did in time;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|13:58: And because he governeth the same, and such things as fall in their seasons: and there I sat three days.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:1: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:2: And I said, Here am I, Yahuah (God) And I stood up upon my feet.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:3: Then said he to me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself to Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:4: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:5: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:6: These words shall you declare, and these shall you hide.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:7: And now I say to you,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:8: That you lay up in your heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that you have seen, and the interpretations which you have heard:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:9: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:10: For the world has lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:11: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:12: And there remains that which is after the half of the tenth part.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:13: Now therefore set yours house in order, and reprove your people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:14: Let go from you mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:15: And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy to you, and haste you to flee from these times.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:16: For yet greater evils than those which you have seen happen shall be done hereafter.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:17: For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell in it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:18: For the time is fled far away, and leasing is hard at hand: for now hasteth the vision to come, which you have seen.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:19: Then answered I before you, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:20: Behold, Yahuah (God), I will go, as you have commanded me, and reprove the people which are present: but they that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? thus the world is set in darkness, and they that dwell in it are without light.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:21: For your law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of you, or the work that shall begin.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:22: But if I have found grace before you, send the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) into me, and I shall write all that has been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in your law, that men may find your path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:23: And he answered me, saying, Go your way, gather the people together, and say to them, that they seek you not for forty days.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:24: But look you prepare you many box trees, and take with you Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ecanus, and Asiel, these five which are ready to write swiftly;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:25: And come hither, and I shall light a candle of understanding in yours heart, which shall not be put out, till the things be performed which you shall begin to write.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:26: And when you have done, some things shall you publish, and some things shall you shew secretly to the wise: to morrow this hour shall you begin to write.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:27: Then went I forth, as he commanded, and gathered all the people together, and said,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:29: Our fathers at the beginning were strangers in Egypt, from whence they were delivered:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:30: And received the law of life, which they kept not, which you also have transgressed after them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:31: Then was the land, even the land of Sion, parted among you by lot: but your fathers, and you yourselves, have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Highest commanded you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:32: And forasmuch as he is a righteous judge, he took from you in time the thing that he had given you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:33: And now are you here, and your brothers among you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:34: Therefore if so be that you will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, you shall be kept alive and after death you shall obtain mercy.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:35: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:36: Let no man therefore come to me now, nor seek after me these forty days.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:37: So I took the five men, as he commanded me, and we went into the field, and remained there.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:38: And the next day, behold, a voice called me, saying, Esdras, open your mouth, and drink that I give you to drink.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:39: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:40: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:41: And my mouth was opened, and shut no more.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:42: The Highest gave understanding to the five men, and they wrote the wonderful visions of the night that were told, which they knew not: and they sat forty days, and they wrote in the day, and at night they ate bread.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:43: As for me. I spoke in the day, and I held not my tongue by night.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:44: In forty days they wrote two hundred and four books.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:45: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spoke, saying, The first that you have written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:46: But keep the seventy last, that you may deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|14:47: For in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:1: Behold, speak you in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in your mouth, says Yahuah (God):
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:2: And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:3: Fear not the imaginations against you, let not the incredulity of them trouble you, that speak against you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:4: For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:5: Behold, says Yahuah (God), I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:6: For wickedness has exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:8: I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness, which they profanely commit, neither will I suffer them in those things, in which they wickedly exercise themselves: behold, the innocent and righteous blood cries to me, and the souls of the just complain continually.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:9: And therefore, says Yahuah (God), I will surely avenge them, and receive to me all the innocent blood from among them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:10: Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:11: But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:12: Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be struck with the plague and punishment that Yahuah (God) shall bring upon it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:13: They that till the ground shall mourn: for their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:14: Woe to the world and them that dwell in it!
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:15: For the sword and their destruction draws nigh, and one people shall stand up and fight against another, and swords in their hands.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:16: For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:17: A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:18: For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:19: A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:20: Behold, says Yahuah (God), I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus; to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:21: Like as they do yet this day to my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Thus says Yahuah (God);
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:22: My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:23: The fire is gone forth from his wrath, and has consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:24: Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:25: I will not spare them: go your way, you children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:26: For Yahuah (God) knoweth all them that sin against him, and therefore delivers he them to death and destruction.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:27: For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth and you shall remain in them: for Yahuah (God) shall not deliver you, because you have sinned against him.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:28: Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:29: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:30: Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:31: And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature; and if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:32: Then these shall be troubled bled, and keep silence through their power, and shall flee.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:33: And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:34: Behold clouds from the east and from the north to the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:35: They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star; and blood shall be from the sword to the belly,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:36: And dung of men to the camel’s hough.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:37: And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:38: And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:39: And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall open it; and the cloud which he raised up in wrath, and the star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind, shall be destroyed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:40: The great and mighty clouds shall be puffed up full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell in it; and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:41: Fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:42: And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:43: And they shall go stedfastly to Babylon, and make her afraid.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:44: They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up to the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:45: And they that remain under her shall do service to them that have put her in fear.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:46: And you, Asia, that are partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:47: Woe be to you, you wretch, because you have made thyself like to her; and have decked your daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in your lovers, which have always desired to commit whoredom with you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:48: You have followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions: therefore says Yahuah (God),
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:49: I will send plagues upon you; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste your houses with destruction and death.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:50: And the glory of your Power shall be dried up as a flower, the heat shall arise that is sent over you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:51: You shall be weakened as a poor woman with stripes, and as one chastised with wounds, so that the mighty and lovers shall not be able to receive you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:52: Would I with jealousy have so proceeded against you, says Yahuah (God),
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:53: If you had not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of yours hands, and saying over their dead, when you were drunken,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:54: Set forth the beauty of your countenance?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:55: The reward of your whoredom shall be in your bosom, therefore shall you receive recompence.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:56: Like as you have done to my chosen, says Yahuah (God), even so shall Yahuah (God) do to you, and shall deliver you into mischief
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:57: Your children shall die of hunger, and you shall fall through the sword: your cities shall be broken down, and all yours shall perish with the sword in the field.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:58: They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread, and thirst of water.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:59: You as unhappy shall come through the sea, and receive plagues again.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:60: And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of your land, and consume part of your glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:61: And you shall be cast down by them as stubble, and they shall be to you as fire;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:62: And shall consume you, and your cities, your land, and your mountains; all your woods and your fruitful trees shall they burn up with fire.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|15:63: Your children shall they carry away captive, and, look, what you have, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of your face.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:1: Woe be to you, Babylon, and Asia! woe be to you, Egypt and Syria!
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:2: Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:3: A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:4: A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:5: Plagues are sent to you, and what is he that may drive them away?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:6: May any man drive away an hungry lion in the wood? or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it has begun to burn?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:7: May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:8: The mighty Yahuah (God) sends the plagues and who is he that can drive them away?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:9: A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:10: He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:11: Yahuah (God) shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:12: The earth quakes, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep, and the waves of it are troubled, and the fishes thereof also, before Yahuah (God), and before the glory of his power:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:13: For strong is his right hand that bendeth the bow, his arrows that he shooteth are sharp, and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:14: Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:15: The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:16: Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returns not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:17: Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:18: The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:19: Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:20: But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:21: Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:22: For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:23: And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them: for the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:24: There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:25: The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:26: The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:27: So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:28: For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field, which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:29: As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives;
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:30: Or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are left some clusters of them that diligently seek through the vineyard:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:31: Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:32: And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel therethrough.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:33: The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:34: In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed, and their husbands shall perish of famine.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:35: Hear now these things and understand them, you servants of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:36: Behold, the word of Yahuah (God), receive it: believe not the gods of whom Yahuah (God) spoke.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:37: Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:38: As when a woman with child in the ninth month brings forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child comes forth, they slack not a moment:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:39: Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:40: O my people, hear my word: make you ready to your battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:41: He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:42: He that occupieth merchandise, as he that has no profit by it: and he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell in it:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:43: He that sows, as if he should not reap: so also he that planteth the vineyard, as he that shall not gather the grapes:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:44: They that marry, as they that shall get no children; and they that marry not, as the widowers.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:45: And therefore they that labour labour in vain:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:46: For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives, for in captivity and famine shall they get children.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:47: And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery, the more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:48: The more will I be angry with them for their sin, says Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:49: Like as a whore envies a right honest and virtuous woman:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:50: So shall righteousness hate iniquity, when she decketh herself, and shall accuse her to her face, when he comes that shall defend him that diligently searcheth out every sin upon earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:51: And therefore be you not like to it, nor to the works thereof.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:52: For yet a little, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign among you.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:53: Let not the sinner say that he has not sinned: for Yahuah (God) shall burn coals of fire upon his head, which says before Yahuah (God) and his glory, I have not sinned.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:54: Behold, Yahuah (God) knoweth all the works of men, their imaginations, their thoughts, and their hearts:
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:55: Which spoke but the word, Let the earth be made; and it was made: Let the heaven be made; and it was created.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:56: In his word were the stars made, and he knoweth the number of them.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:57: He searcheth the deep, and the treasures thereof; he has measured the sea, and what it containeth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:58: He has shut the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word has he hanged the earth upon the waters.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:59: He spreadeth out the heavens like a vault; upon the waters has he founded it.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:60: In the desert has he made springs of water, and pools upon the tops of the mountains, that the floods might pour down from the high rocks to water the earth.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:61: He made man, and put his heart in the midst of the body, and gave him breath, life, and understanding.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:62: Yea and the Spirit of Almighty Yahuah (God), which made all things, and searcheth out all hidden things in the secrets of the earth,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:63: Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what you think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:64: Therefore has Yahuah (God) exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:65: And when your sins are brought forth, you shall be ashamed before men, and your own sins shall be your accusers in that day.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:66: What will you do? or how will you hide your sins before Yahuah (God) and his angels?
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:67: Behold, Yahuah (God) himself is the judge, fear him: leave off from your sins, and forget your iniquities, to meddle no more with them for ever: so shall Yahuah (God) lead you forth, and deliver you from all trouble.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:68: For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered to idols.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:69: And they that consent to them shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:70: For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:71: They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:72: For they shall waste and take away their goods, and cast them out of their houses.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:73: Then shall they be known, who are my chosen; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:74: Hear, O you my beloved, says Yahuah (God): behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:75: Be you not afraid neither doubt; for Yahuah (God) is your guide,
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:76: And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, says Yahuah (God): let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:77: Woe be to them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through!
live.apocrypha|2-esdras|16:78: It is left undressed, and is cast into the fire to be consumed with it.
live.apocrypha|baruch-with-the-letter-of-jere: And these are the words of the book, which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maasias, the son of Sedecias, the son of Asadias, the son of Chelcias, wrote in Babylon,
In the fifth year, and in the seventh day of the month, what time as the Chaldeans took Jerusalem, and burnt it with fire.
And Baruch did read the words of this book in the hearing of Jechonias the son of Joachim king of Juda, and in the ears of all the people that came to hear the book,

And in the hearing of the nobles, and of the king’s sons, and in the hearing of the elders, and of all the people, from the lowest to the highest, even of all them that dwelt at Babylon by the river Sud.
Whereupon they wept, fasted, and prayed before Yahuah (God).
They made also a collection of money according to every man’s power:
And they sent it to Jerusalem to Joachim the high priest, the son of Chelcias, son of Salom, and to the priests, and to all the people which were found with him at Jerusalem,

At the same time when he received the vessels of the house of Yahuah (God), that were carried out of the temple, to return them into the land of Juda, the tenth day of the month Sivan, namely, silver vessels, which Sedecias the son of Josias king of Juda had made,
After that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried away Jechonias, and the princes, and the captives, and the mighty men, and the people of the land, from Jerusalem, and brought them to Babylon.
And they said, Behold, we have sent you money to buy you burnt offerings, and sin offerings, and incense, and prepare you manna, and offer upon the altar of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God);
And pray for the life of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and for the life of Balthasar his son, that their days may be upon earth as the days of heaven:

And Yahuah (God) will give us strength, and lighten our eyes, and we shall live under the shadow of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and under the shadow of Balthasar his son, and we shall serve them many days, and find favour in their sight.
Pray for us also to Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), for we have sinned against Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God); and to this day the fury of Yahuah (God) and his wrath is not turned from us.
And you shall read this book which we have sent to you, to make confession in the house of Yahuah (God), upon the feasts and solemn days.
And you shall say, To Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) belongeth righteousness, but to us the confusion of faces, as it is come to pass this day, to them of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
And to our kings, and to our princes, and to our priests, and to our prophets, and to our fathers:
For we have sinned before Yahuah (God),
And disobeyed him, and have not hearkened to the voice of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), to walk in the commandments that he gave us openly:

Since the day that Yahuah (God) brought our forefathers out of the land of Egypt, to this present day, we have been disobedient to Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and we have been negligent in not hearing his voice.

Wherefore the evils cleaved to us, and the curse, which Yahuah (God) appointed by Moses his servant at the time that he brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt, to give us a land that floweth with milk and honey, like as it is to see this day.
Nevertheless we have not hearkened to the voice of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), according to all the words of the prophets, whom he sent to us:
But every man followed the imagination of his own wicked heart, to serve strange gods, and to do evil in the sight of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God).

Therefore Yahuah (God) has made good his word, which he pronounced against us, and against our judges that judged Yashar'el (Israel), and against our kings, and against our princes, and against the men of Yashar'el (Israel) and Juda,
To bring upon us great plagues, such as never happened under the whole heaven, as it came to pass in Jerusalem, according to the things that were written in the law of Moses;
That a man should eat the flesh of his own son, and the flesh of his own daughter.

Moreover he has delivered them to be in subjection to all the kingdoms that are round about us, to be as a reproach and desolation among all the people round about, where Yahuah (God) has scattered them.
Thus we were cast down, and not exalted, because we have sinned against Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and have not been obedient to his voice.
To Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) appertaineth righteousness: but to us and to our fathers open shame, as appears this day.
For all these plagues are come upon us, which Yahuah (God) has pronounced against us
Yet have we not prayed before Yahuah (God), that we might turn every one from the imaginations of his wicked heart.
Wherefore Yahuah (God) watched over us for evil, and Yahuah (God) has brought it upon us: for Yahuah (God) is righteous in all his works which he has commanded us.
Yet we have not hearkened to his voice, to walk in the commandments of Yahuah (God), that he has set before us.

And now, O Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), that have brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and high arm, and with signs, and with wonders, and with great power, and have gotten thyself a name, as appears this day:
O Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), we have sinned, we have done ungodly, we have dealt unrighteously in all your ordinances.
Let your wrath turn from us: for we are but a few left among the heathen, where you have scattered us.
Hear our prayers, O Yahuah (God), and our petitions, and deliver us for your own sake, and give us favour in the sight of them which have led us away:
That all the earth may know that you are Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), because Yashar'el (Israel) and his posterity is called by your name.
O Yahuah (God), look down from yours holy house, and consider us: bow down your ear, O Yahuah (God), to hear us.
Open your eyes, and behold; for the dead that are in the graves, whose souls are taken from their bodies, will give to Yahuah (God) neither praise nor righteousness:
But the soul that is greatly vexed, which goes stooping and feeble, and the eyes that fail, and the hungry soul, will give you praise and righteousness, O Yahuah (God).
Therefore we do not make our humble supplication before you, O Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), for the righteousness of our fathers, and of our kings.
For you have sent out your wrath and indignation upon us, as you have spoken by your servants the prophets, saying,
Thus says Yahuah (God), Bow down your shoulders to serve the king of Babylon: so shall you remain in the land that I gave to your fathers.
But if you will not hear the voice of Yahuah (God), to serve the king of Babylon,

I will cause to cease out of the cites of Yahudah (Judah), and from without Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: and the whole land shall be desolate of inhabitants.

But we would not hearken to your voice, to serve the king of Babylon: therefore have you made good the words that you spakest by your servants the prophets, namely, that the bones of our kings, and the bones of our fathers, should be taken out of their place.
And, lo, they are cast out to the heat of the day, and to the frost of the night, and they died in great miseries by famine, by sword, and by pestilence.
And the house which is called by your name have you laid waste, as it is to be seen this day, for the wickedness of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Juda.
O Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), you have dealt with us after all your goodness, and according to all that great mercy of yours,
As you spakest by your servant Moses in the day when you did command him to write the law before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying,
If you will not hear my voice, surely this very great multitude shall be turned into a small number among the nations, where I will scatter them.
For I knew that they would not hear me, because it is a stiffnecked people: but in the land of their captivities they shall remember themselves.
And shall know that I am Yahuah (God), their Elohim (God): for I will give them an heart, and ears to hear:
And they shall praise me in the land of their captivity, and think upon my name,
And return from their stiff neck, and from their wicked deeds: for they shall remember the way of their fathers, which sinned before Yahuah (God).

And I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and they shall be lords of it: and I will increase them, and they shall not be diminished.

And I will make an everlasting covenant with them to be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people: and I will no more drive my people of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land that I have given them.
O Yahuah (God) Almighty, Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), the soul in anguish the troubled spirit, cries to you.
Hear, O Yahuah (God), and have mercy; for you are merciful: and have pity upon us, because we have sinned before you.
For you endurest for ever, and we perish utterly.

O Yahuah (God) Almighty, you Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites, and of their children, which have sinned before you, and not hearkened to the voice of you their Elohim (God): for the which cause these plagues cleave to us.
Remember not the iniquities of our forefathers: but think upon your power and your name now at this time.
For you are Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and you, O Yahuah (God), will we praise.

And for this cause you have put your fear in our hearts, to the intent that we should call upon your name, and praise you in our captivity: for we have called to mind all the iniquity of our forefathers, that sinned before you.

Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where you have scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God).
Hear, Yashar'el (Israel), the commandments of life: give ear to understand wisdom.
How happeneth it Yashar'el (Israel), that you are in your enemies’ land, that you are waxen old in a strange country, that you are defiled with the dead,
That you are counted with them that go down into the grave?
You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom.
For if you had walked in the way of Yahuah (God), you should have dwelled in peace for ever.
Learn where is wisdom, where is strength, where is understanding; that you may know also where is length of days, and life, where is the light of the eyes, and peace.
Who has found out her place? or who has come into her treasures?
Where are the princes of the heathen become, and such as ruled the beasts upon the earth;
They that had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and they that hoarded up silver and gold, in which men trust, and made no end of their getting?
For they that wrought in silver, and were so careful, and whose works are unsearchable,
They are vanished and gone down to the grave, and others are come up in their steads.
Young men have seen light, and dwelt upon the earth: but the way of knowledge have they not known,
Nor understood the paths thereof, nor laid hold of it: their children were far off from that way.
It has not been heard of in Chanaan, neither has it been seen in Theman.

The Agarenes that seek wisdom upon earth, the merchants of Meran and of Theman, the authors of fables, and searchers out of understanding; none of these have known the way of wisdom, or remember her paths.
O Yashar'el (Israel), how great is the house of Yahuah (God)! and how large is the place of his possession!
Great, and has none end; high, and unmeasurable.
There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war.
Those did not Yahuah (God) choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge to them:
But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.
Who has gone up into heaven, and taken her, and brought her down from the clouds?
Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?
No man knoweth her way, nor thinketh of her path.
But he that knoweth all things knoweth her, and has found her out with his understanding: he that prepared the earth for evermore has filled it with fourfooted beasts:
He that sends forth light, and it goes, calls it again, and it obeyeth him with fear.
The stars shined in their watches, and rejoiced: when he calls them, they say, Here we be; and so with cheerfulness they shewed light to him that made them.
This is our Elohim (God), and there shall none other be accounted of in comparison of him
He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.
Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men.
This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.
Turn you, O Jacob, and take hold of it: walk in the presence of the light thereof, that you may be illuminated.
Give not yours honour to another, nor the things that are profitable to you to a strange nation.
O Yashar'el (Israel), happy are we: for things that are pleasing to Yahuah (God) are made known to us.
Be of good cheer, my people, the memorial of Yashar'el (Israel).
You were sold to the nations, not for your destruction: but because you moved Yahuah (God) to wrath, you were delivered to the enemies.
For you provoked him that made you by sacrificing to devils, and not to Yahuah (God).
You have forgotten the everlasting Yahuah (God), that brought you up; and you have grieved Jerusalem, that nursed you.
For when she saw the wrath of Yahuah (God) coming upon you, she said, Hearken, O you that dwell about Sion: Yahuah (God) has brought upon me great mourning;
For I saw the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting brought upon them.
With joy did I nourish them; but sent them away with weeping and mourning.
Let no man rejoice over me, a widow, and forsaken of many, who for the sins of my children am left desolate; because they departed from the law of Yahuah (God).
They knew not his statutes, nor walked in the ways of his commandments, nor trod in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.
Let them that dwell about Sion come, and remember you the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting has brought upon them.
For he has brought a nation upon them from far, a shameless nation, and of a strange language, who neither reverenced old man, nor pitied child.
These have carried away the dear beloved children of the widow, and left her that was alone desolate without daughters.
But what can I help you?
For he that brought these plagues upon you will deliver you from the hands of your enemies.
Go your way, O my children, go your way: for I am left desolate.
I have put off the clothing of peace, and put upon me the sackcloth of my prayer: I will cry to the Everlasting in my days.
Be of good cheer, O my children, cry to Yahuah (God), and he will deliver you from the power and hand of the enemies.
For my hope is in the Everlasting, that he will save you; and joy is come to me from the Holy One, because of the mercy which shall soon come to you from the Everlasting our Saviour.
For I sent you out with mourning and weeping: but Yahuah (God) will give you to me again with joy and gladness for ever.

Like as now the neighbours of Sion have seen your captivity: so shall they see shortly your salvation from our Elohim (God) which shall come upon you with great glory, and brightness of the Everlasting.
My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from Yahuah (God): for your enemy has persecuted you; but shortly you shall see his destruction, and shall tread upon his neck.
My delicate ones have gone rough ways, and were taken away as a flock caught of the enemies.
Be of good comfort, O my children, and cry to Yahuah (God): for you shall be remembered of him that brought these things upon you.
For as it was your mind to go astray from Yahuah (God): so, being returned, seek him ten times more.
For he that has brought these plagues upon you shall bring you everlasting joy with your salvation.
Take a good heart, O Jerusalem: for he that gave you that name will comfort you.
Miserable are they that afflicted you, and rejoiced at your fall.
Miserable are the cities which your children served: miserable is she that received your sons.
For as she rejoiced at your ruin, and was glad of your fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.
For I will take away the rejoicing of her great multitude, and her pride shall be turned into mourning.
For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure; and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time.
O Jerusalem, look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).
Lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of Yahuah (God).
Put off, O Jerusalem, the garment of mourning and affliction, and put on the comeliness of the glory that comes from Yahuah (God) for ever.
Cast about you a double garment of the righteousness which comes from Yahuah (God); and set a diadem on yours head of the glory of the Everlasting.
For Yahuah (God) will shew your brightness to every country under heaven.
For your name shall be called of Yahuah (God) for ever The peace of righteousness, and The glory of the worship of Yahuah (God).

Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east, and behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the remembrance of Yahuah (God).
For they departed from you on foot, and were led away of their enemies: but Yahuah (God) brings them to you exalted with glory, as children of the kingdom.

For Yahuah (God) has appointed that every high hill, and banks of long continuance, should be cast down, and valleys filled up, to make even the ground, that Yashar'el (Israel) may go safely in the glory of Yahuah (God),
Moreover even the woods and every sweetsmelling tree shall overshadow Yashar'el (Israel) by the commandment of Yahuah (God).
For Yahuah (God) shall lead Yashar'el (Israel) with joy in the light of his glory with the mercy and righteousness that comes from him.
A copy of an epistle, which Jeremy sent to them which were to be led captives into Babylon by the king of the Babylonians, to certify them, as it was commanded him of Yahuah (God).
Because of the sins which you have committed before Yahuah (God), you shall be led away captives into Babylon by Nabuchodonosor king of the Babylonians.
So when you be come to Babylon, you shall remain there many years, and for a long season, namely, seven generations: and after that I will bring you away peaceably from thence.
Now shall you see in Babylon gods of silver, and of gold, and of wood, borne upon shoulders, which cause the nations to fear.
Beware therefore that you in no wise be like to strangers, neither be you afraid of them, when you see the multitude before them and behind them, worshipping them.
But say you in your hearts, O Yahuah (God), we must worship you.
For my angel is with you, and I myself caring for your souls.
As for their tongue, it is polished by the workman, and they themselves are gilded and laid over with silver; yet are they but false, and cannot speak.
And taking gold, as it were for a virgin that loves to go gay, they make crowns for the heads of their gods.
Sometimes also the priests convey from their gods gold and silver, and bestow it upon themselves.
Yea, they will give thereof to the common harlots, and deck them as men with garments, being gods of silver, and gods of gold, and wood.
Yet cannot these gods save themselves from rust and moth, though they be covered with purple raiment.
They wipe their faces because of the dust of the temple, when there is much upon them.
And he that cannot put to death one that offendeth him holdeth a sceptre, as though he were a judge of the country.
He has also in his right hand a dagger and an ax: but cannot deliver himself from war and thieves.
By which they are known not to be gods: therefore fear them not.

For like as a vessel that a man useth is nothing worth when it is broken; even so it is with their gods: when they be set up in the temple, their eyes be full of dust through the feet of them that come in.

And as the doors are made sure on every side upon him that offendeth the king, as being committed to suffer death: even so the priests make fast their temples with doors, with locks, and bars, lest their gods be spoiled with robbers.
They light them candles, yes, more than for themselves, of which they cannot see one.
They are as one of the beams of the temple, yet they say their hearts are gnawed upon by things creeping out of the earth; and when they eat them and their clothes, they feel it not.
Their faces are blacked through the smoke that comes out of the temple.
Upon their bodies and heads sit bats, swallows, and birds, and the cats also.
By this you may know that they are no gods: therefore fear them not.
Notwithstanding the gold that is about them to make them beautiful, except they wipe off the rust, they will not shine: for neither when they were molten did they feel it.
The things in which there is no breath are bought for a most high price.
They are borne upon shoulders, having no feet by which they declare to men that they be nothing worth.

They also that serve them are ashamed: for if they fall to the ground at any time, they cannot rise up again of themselves: neither, if one set them upright, can they move of themselves: neither, if they be bowed down, can they make themselves straight: but they set gifts before them as to dead men.
As for the things that are sacrificed to them, their priests sell and abuse; in like manner their wives lay up part thereof in salt; but to the poor and impotent they give nothing of it.
Menstruous women and women in childbed eat their sacrifices: by these things you may know that they are no gods: fear them not.
For how can they be called gods? because women set meat before the gods of silver, gold, and wood.
And the priests sit in their temples, having their clothes rent, and their heads and beards shaven, and nothing upon their heads.
They roar and cry before their gods, as men do at the feast when one is dead.
The priests also take off their garments, and clothe their wives and children.
Whether it be evil that one doeth to them, or good, they are not able to recompense it: they can neither set up a king, nor put him down.
In like manner, they can neither give riches nor money: though a man make a vow to them, and keep it not, they will not require it.
They can save no man from death, neither deliver the weak from the mighty.
They cannot restore a blind man to his sight, nor help any man in his distress.
They can shew no mercy to the widow, nor do good to the fatherless.
Their gods of wood, and which are overlaid with gold and silver, are like the stones that be hewn out of the mountain: they that worship them shall be confounded.
How should a man then think and say that they are gods, when even the Chaldeans themselves dishonour them?
Who if they shall see one dumb that cannot speak, they bring him, and intreat Bel that he may speak, as though he were able to understand.
Yet they cannot understand this themselves, and leave them: for they have no knowledge.

The women also with cords about them, sitting in the ways, burn bran for perfume: but if any of them, drawn by some that passeth by, lie with him, she reproacheth her fellow, that she was not thought as worthy as herself, nor her cord broken.
Whatsoever is done among them is false: how may it then be thought or said that they are gods?
They are made of carpenters and goldsmiths: they can be nothing else than the workmen will have them to be.
And they themselves that made them can never continue long; how should then the things that are made of them be gods?
For they left lies and reproaches to them that come after.
For when there comes any war or plague upon them, the priests consult with themselves, where they may be hidden with them.
How then cannot men perceive that they be no gods, which can neither save themselves from war, nor from plague?
For seeing they be but of wood, and overlaid with silver and gold, it shall be known hereafter that they are false:
And it shall manifestly appear to all nations and kings that they are no gods, but the works of men’s hands, and that there is no work of Yahuah (God) in them.
Who then may not know that they are no gods?
For neither can they set up a king in the land, nor give rain to men.
Neither can they judge their own cause, nor redress a wrong, being unable: for they are as crows between heaven and earth.
Whereupon when fire falls upon the house of gods of wood, or laid over with gold or silver, their priests will flee away, and escape; but they themselves shall be burned asunder like beams.
Moreover they cannot withstand any king or enemies: how can it then be thought or said that they be gods?
Neither are those gods of wood, and laid over with silver or gold, able to escape either from thieves or robbers.
Whose gold, and silver, and garments with which they are clothed, they that are strong take, and go away withal: neither are they able to help themselves.

Therefore it is better to be a king that sheweth his power, or else a profitable vessel in an house, which the owner shall have use of, than such false gods; or to be a door in an house, to keep such things in it, than such false gods. or a pillar of wood in a a palace, than such false gods.
For sun, moon, and stars, being bright and sent to do their offices, are obedient.
In like manner the lightning when it breaks forth is easy to be seen; and after the same manner the wind bloweth in every country.
