live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:10: All that are of the earth shall turn to earth again: so the ungodly shall go from a curse to destruction.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:11: The mourning of men is about their bodies: but an ill name of sinners shall be blotted out.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:12: Have regard to your name; for that shall continue with you above a thousand great treasures of gold.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:13: A good life has but few days: but a good name endureth for ever.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:14: My children, keep discipline in peace: for wisdom that is hid, and a treasure that is not seen, what profit is in them both?
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:15: A man that hideth his foolishness is better than a man that hideth his wisdom.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:16: Therefore be shamefaced according to my word: for it is not good to retain all shamefacedness; neither is it altogether approved in every thing.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:17: Be ashamed of whoredom before father and mother: and of a lie before a prince and a mighty man;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:18: Of an offence before a judge and ruler; of iniquity before a congregation and people; of unjust dealing before your partner and friend;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:19: And of theft in regard of the place where you sojournest, and in regard of the truth of Yahuah (God) and his covenant; and to lean with your elbow upon the meat; and of scorning to give and take;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:20: And of silence before them that salute you; and to look upon an harlot;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:21: And to turn away your face from your kinsman; or to take away a portion or a gift; or to gaze upon another man’s wife.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:22: Or to be overbusy with his maid, and come not near her bed; or of upbraiding speeches before friends; and after you have given, upbraid not;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:23: Or of iterating and speaking again that which you have heard; and of revealing of secrets.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|41:24: So shall you be truly shamefaced and find favour before all men.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:1: Of these things be not you ashamed, and accept no person to sin thereby:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:2: Of the law of the Most High, and his covenant; and of judgment to justify the ungodly;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:3: Of reckoning with your partners and travellers; or of the gift of the heritage of friends;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:4: Of exactness of balance and weights; or of getting much or little;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:5: And of merchants’ indifferent selling; of much correction of children; and to make the side of an evil servant to bleed.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:6: Sure keeping is good, where an evil wife is; and shut up, where many hands are.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:7: Deliver all things in number and weight; and put all in writing that you give out, or receivest in.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:8: Be not ashamed to inform the unwise and foolish, and the extreme aged that contendeth with those that are young: thus shall you be truly learned, and approved of all men living.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:9: The father waketh for the daughter, when no man knoweth; and the care for her takes away sleep: when she is young, lest she pass away the flower of her age; and being married, lest she should be hated:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:10: In her virginity, lest she should be defiled and gotten with child in her father’s house; and having an husband, lest she should misbehave herself; and when she is married, lest she should be barren.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:11: Keep a sure watch over a shameless daughter, lest she make you a laughingstock to your enemies, and a byword in the city, and a reproach among the people, and make you ashamed before the multitude.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:12: Behold not every body’s beauty, and sit not in the midst of women.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:13: For from garments comes a moth, and from women wickedness.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:14: Better is the churlishness of a man than a courteous woman, a woman, I say, which brings shame and reproach.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:15: I will now remember the works of Yahuah (God), and declare the things that I have seen: In the words of Yahuah (God) are his works.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:16: The sun that gives light looketh upon all things, and the work thereof is full of the glory of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:17: Yahuah (God) has not given power to the saints to declare all his marvellous works, which the Almighty Yahuah (God) firmly settled, that whatsoever is might be established for his glory.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:18: He seeks out the deep, and the heart, and considereth their crafty devices: for Yahuah (God) knoweth all that may be known, and he beholds the signs of the world.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:19: He declareth the things that are past, and for to come, and revealeth the steps of hidden things.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:20: No thought escapeth him, neither any word is hidden from him.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:21: He has garnished the excellent works of his wisdom, and he is from everlasting to everlasting: to him may nothing be added, neither can he be diminished, and he has no need of any counsellor.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:22: Oh how desirable are all his works! and that a man may see even to a spark.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:23: All these things live and remain for ever for all uses, and they are all obedient.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:24: All things are double one against another: and he has made nothing imperfect.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|42:25: One thing establishes the good or another: and who shall be filled with beholding his glory?
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:1: The pride of the height, the clear firmament, the beauty of heaven, with his glorious shew;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:2: The sun when it appears, declaring at his rising a marvellous instrument, the work of the Most High:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:3: At noon it parcheth the country, and who can abide the burning heat thereof?
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:4: A man blowing a furnace is in works of heat, but the sun burneth the mountains three times more; breathing out fiery vapours, and sending forth bright beams, it dimmeth the eyes.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:5: Great is Yahuah (God) that made it; and at his commandment runs hastily.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:6: He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:7: From the moon is the sign of feasts, a light that decreaseth in her perfection.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:8: The month is called after her name, increasing wonderfully in her changing, being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:9: The beauty of heaven, the glory of the stars, an ornament giving light in the highest places of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:10: At the commandment of the Holy One they will stand in their order, and never faint in their watches.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:11: Look upon the rainbow, and praise him that made it; very beautiful it is in the brightness thereof.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:12: It compasseth the heaven about with a glorious circle, and the hands of the Most High have bended it.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:13: By his commandment he makes the snow to fall aplace, and sends swiftly the lightnings of his judgment.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:14: Through this the treasures are opened: and clouds fly forth as fowls.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:15: By his great power he makes the clouds firm, and the hailstones are broken small.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:16: At his sight the mountains are shaken, and at his will the south wind bloweth.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:17: The noise of the thunder makes the earth to tremble: so does the northern storm and the whirlwind: as birds flying he scatters the snow, and the falling down thereof is as the lighting of grasshoppers:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:18: The eye marvelleth at the beauty of the whiteness thereof, and the heart is astonished at the raining of it.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:19: The hoarfrost also as salt he poureth on the earth, and being congealed, it lieth on the top of sharp stakes.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:20: When the cold north wind bloweth, and the water is congealed into ice, it abideth upon every gathering together of water, and clothes the water as with a breastplate.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:21: It devoureth the mountains, and burneth the wilderness, and consumeth the grass as fire.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:22: A present remedy of all is a mist coming speedily, a dew coming after heat refresheth.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:23: By his counsel he appeaseth the deep, and planteth islands in it.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:24: They that sail on the sea tell of the danger thereof; and when we hear it with our ears, we marvel thereat.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:25: For in it be strange and wondrous works, variety of all kinds of beasts and whales created.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:26: By him the end of them has prosperous success, and by his word all things consist.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:27: We may speak much, and yet come short: wherefore in sum, he is all.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:28: How shall we be able to magnify him? for he is great above all his works.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:29: Yahuah (God) is terrible and very great, and marvellous is his power.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:30: When you glorify Yahuah (God), exalt him as much as you can; for even yet will he far exceed: and when you exalt him, put forth all your strength, and be not weary; for you can never go far enough.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:31: Who has seen him, that he might tell us? and who can magnify him as he is?
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:32: There are yet hid greater things than these be, for we have seen but a few of his works.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|43:33: For Yahuah (God) has made all things; and to the godly has he given wisdom.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:1: Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that begat us.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:2: Yahuah (God) has wrought great glory by them through his great power from the beginning.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:3: Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:4: Leaders of the people by their counsels, and by their knowledge of learning meet for the people, wise and eloquent are their instructions:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:5: Such as found out musical tunes, and recited verses in writing:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:6: Rich men furnished with ability, living peaceably in their habitations:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:7: All these were honoured in their generations, and were the glory of their times.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:8: There be of them, that have left a name behind them, that their praises might be reported.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:9: And some there be, which have no memorial; who are perished, as though they had never been; and are become as though they had never been born; and their children after them.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:10: But these were merciful men, whose righteousness has not been forgotten.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:11: With their seed shall continually remain a good inheritance, and their children are within the covenant.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:12: Their seed stands fast, and their children for their sakes.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:13: Their seed shall remain for ever, and their glory shall not be blotted out.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:14: Their bodies are buried in peace; but their name lives for evermore.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:15: The people will tell of their wisdom, and the congregation will shew forth their praise.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:16: Enoch pleased Yahuah (God), and was translated, being an example of repentance to all generations.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:17: Noah was found perfect and righteous; in the time of wrath he was taken in exchange for the world; therefore was he left as a remnant to the earth, when the flood came.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:18: An everlasting covenant was made with him, that all flesh should perish no more by the flood.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:19: Abraham was a great father of many people: in glory was there none like to him;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:20: Who kept the law of the Most High, and was in covenant with him: he established the covenant in his flesh; and when he was proved, he was found faithful.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:21: Therefore he assured him by an oath, that he would bless the nations in his seed, and that he would multiply him as the dust of the earth, and exalt his seed as the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea, and from the river to the utmost part of the land.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:22: With Isaac did he establish likewise for Abraham his father’s sake the blessing of all men, and the covenant,
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|44:23: And made it rest upon the head of Jacob. He acknowledged him in his blessing, and gave him an heritage, and divided his portions; among the twelve tribes did he part them.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:1: And he brought out of him a merciful man, which found favour in the sight of all flesh, even Moses, beloved of Yahuah (God) and men, whose memorial is blessed.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:2: He made him like to the glorious saints, and magnified him, so that his enemies stood in fear of him.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:3: By his words he caused the wonders to cease, and he made him glorious in the sight of kings, and gave him a commandment for his people, and shewed him part of his glory.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:4: He sanctified him in his faithfuless and meekness, and chose him out of all men.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:5: He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Yashar'el (Israel) his judgments.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:6: He exalted Aaron, an holy man like to him, even his brother, of the tribe of Levi.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:7: An everlasting covenant he made with him and gave him the priesthood among the people; he beautified him with comely ornaments, and clothed him with a robe of glory.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:8: He put upon him perfect glory; and strengthened him with rich garments, with breeches, with a long robe, and the ephod.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:9: And he compassed him with pomegranates, and with many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound, and a noise made that might be heard in the temple, for a memorial to the children of his people;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:10: With an holy garment, with gold, and blue silk, and purple, the work of the embroiderer, with a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:11: With twisted scarlet, the work of the cunning workman, with precious stones graven like seals, and set in gold, the work of the jeweller, with a writing engraved for a memorial, after the number of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:12: He set a crown of gold upon the mitre, in which was engraved Holiness, an ornament of honour, a costly work, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:13: Before him there were none such, neither did ever any stranger put them on, but only his children and his children’s children perpetually.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:14: Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:15: Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil: this was appointed to him by an everlasting covenant, and to his seed, so long as the heavens should remain, that they should minister to him, and execute the office of the priesthood, and bless the people in his name.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:16: He chose him out of all men living to offer sacrifices to Yahuah (God), incense, and a sweet savour, for a memorial, to make reconciliation for his people.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:17: He gave to him his commandments, and authority in the statutes of judgments, that he should teach Jacob the testimonies, and inform Yashar'el (Israel) in his laws.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:18: Strangers conspired together against him, and maligned him in the wilderness, even the men that were of Dathan’s and Abiron’s side, and the congregation of Core, with fury and wrath.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:19: This Yahuah (God) saw, and it displeased him, and in his wrathful indignation were they consumed: he did wonders upon them, to consume them with the fiery flame.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:20: But he made Aaron more honourable, and gave him an heritage, and divided to him the firstfruits of the increase; especially he prepared bread in abundance:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:21: For they eat of the sacrifices of Yahuah (God), which he gave to him and his seed.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:22: Howbeit in the land of the people he had no inheritance, neither had he any portion among the people: for Yahuah (God) himself is his portion and inheritance.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:23: The third in glory is Phinees the son of Eleazar, because he had zeal in the fear of Yahuah (God), and stood up with good courage of heart: when the people were turned back, and made reconciliation for Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:24: Therefore was there a covenant of peace made with him, that he should be the chief of the sanctuary and of his people, and that he and his posterity should have the dignity of the priesthood for ever:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:25: According to the covenant made with David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Juda, that the inheritance of the king should be to his posterity alone: so the inheritance of Aaron should also be to his seed.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|45:26: Yahuah (God) give you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, that their good things be not abolished, and that their glory may endure for ever.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:1: Jesus the son a Nave was valiant in the wars, and was the successor of Moses in prophecies, who according to his name was made great for the saving of the elect of Yahuah (God), and taking vengeance of the enemies that rose up against them, that he might set Yashar'el (Israel) in their inheritance.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:2: How great glory got he, when he did lift up his hands, and stretched out his sword against the cities!
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:3: Who before him so stood to it? for Yahuah (God) himself brought his enemies to him.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:4: Did not the sun go back by his means? and was not one day as long as two?
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:5: He called upon the most high Yahuah (God), when the enemies pressed upon him on every side; and the great Yahuah (God) heard him.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:6: And with hailstones of mighty power he made the battle to fall violently upon the nations, and in the descent of Beth-horon he destroyed them that resisted, that the nations might know all their strength, because he fought in the sight of Yahuah (God), and he followed the Mighty One.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:7: In the time of Moses also he did a work of mercy, he and Caleb the son of Jephunne, in that they withstood the congregation, and withheld the people from sin, and appeased the wicked murmuring.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:8: And of six hundred thousand people on foot, they two were preserved to bring them in to the heritage, even to the land that floweth with milk and honey.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:9: Yahuah (God) gave strength also to Caleb, which remained with him to his old age: so that he entered upon the high places of the land, and his seed obtained it for an heritage:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:10: That all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) might see that it is good to follow Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:11: And concerning the judges, every one by name, whose heart went not a whoring, nor departed from Yahuah (God), let their memory be blessed.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:12: Let their bones flourish out of their place, and let the name of them that were honoured be continued upon their children.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:13: Samuel, the prophet of Yahuah (God), beloved of his Elohim (God), established a kingdom, and anointed princes over his people.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:14: By the law of Yahuah (God) he judged the congregation, and Yahuah (God) had respect to Jacob.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:15: By his faithfulness he was found a true prophet, and by his word he was known to be faithful in vision.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:16: He called upon the mighty Yahuah (God), when his enemies pressed upon him on every side, when he offered the sucking lamb.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:17: And Yahuah (God) thundered from heaven, and with a great noise made his voice to be heard.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:18: And he destroyed the rulers of the Tyrians, and all the princes of the Philistines.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:19: And before his long sleep he made protestations in the sight of Yahuah (God) and his anointed, I have not taken any man’s goods, so much as a shoe: and no man did accuse him.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|46:20: And after his death he prophesied, and shewed the king his end, and lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the wickedness of the people.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:1: And after him rose up Nathan to prophesy in the time of David.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:2: As is the fat taken away from the peace offering, so was David chosen out of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:3: He played with lions as with kids, and with bears as with lambs.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:4: Slew he not a giant, when he was yet but young? and did he not take away reproach from the people, when he lifted up his hand with the stone in the sling, and beat down the boasting of Goliath?
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:5: For he called upon the most high Yahuah (God); and he gave him strength in his right hand to slay that mighty warrior, and set up the horn of his people.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:6: So the people honoured him with ten thousands, and praised him in the blessings of Yahuah (God), in that he gave him a crown of glory.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:7: For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and brought to nought the Philistines his adversaries, and brake their horn in sunder to this day.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:8: In all his works he praised the Holy One most high with words of glory; with his whole heart he sung songs, and loved him that made him.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:9: He set singers also before the altar, that by their voices they might make sweet melody, and daily sing praises in their songs.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:10: He beautified their feasts, and set in order the solemn times until the end, that they might praise his holy name, and that the temple might sound from morning.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:11: Yahuah (God) took away his sins, and exalted his horn for ever: he gave him a covenant of kings, and a throne of glory in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:12: After him rose up a wise son, and for his sake he dwelt at large.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:13: Solomon reigned in a peaceable time, and was honoured; for Yahuah (God) made all quiet round about him, that he might build an house in his name, and prepare his sanctuary for ever.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:14: How wise were you in your youth and, as a flood, filled with understanding!
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:15: Your soul covered the whole earth, and you filledst it with dark parables.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:16: Your name went far to the islands; and for your peace you were beloved.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:17: The countries marvelled at you for your songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:18: By the name of Yahuah (God), which is called Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), you did gather gold as tin and did multiply silver as lead.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:19: You did bow your loins to women, and by your body you were brought into subjection.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:20: You did stain your honour, and pollute your seed: so that you broughtest wrath upon your children, and were grieved for your folly.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:21: So the kingdom was divided, and out of Ephraim ruled a rebellious kingdom.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:22: But Yahuah (God) will never leave off his mercy, neither shall any of his works perish, neither will he abolish the posterity of his elect, and the seed of him that loves him he will not take away: wherefore he gave a remnant to Jacob, and out of him a root to David.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:23: Thus rested Solomon with his fathers, and of his seed he left behind him Roboam, even the foolishness of the people, and one that had no understanding, who turned away the people through his counsel. There was also Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who caused Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, and shewed Ephraim the way of sin:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:24: And their sins were multiplied exceedingly, that they were driven out of the land.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|47:25: For they sought out all wickedness, till the vengeance came upon them.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:1: Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:2: He brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:3: By the word of Yahuah (God) he shut up the heaven, and also three times brought down fire.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:4: O Elias, how were you honoured in your wondrous deeds! and who may glory like to you!
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:5: Who did raise up a dead man from death, and his soul from the place of the dead, by the word of the Most High:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:6: Who broughtest kings to destruction, and honorable men from their bed:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:7: Who heardest the rebuke of Yahuah (God) in Sinai, and in Horeb the judgment of vengeance:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:8: Who annointedst kings to take revenge, and prophets to succeed after him:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:9: Who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and in a chariot of fiery horses:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:10: Who were ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the judgment of Yahuah (God), before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:11: Blessed are they that saw you, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:12: Elias it was, who was covered with a whirlwind: and Eliseus was filled with his spirit: while he lived, he was not moved with the presence of any prince, neither could any bring him into subjection.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:13: No word could overcome him; and after his death his body prophesied.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:14: He did wonders in his life, and at his death were his works marvellous.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:15: For all this the people repented not, neither departed they from their sins, till they were spoiled and carried out of their land, and were scattered through all the earth: yet there remained a small people, and a ruler in the house of David:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:16: Of whom some did that which was pleasing to Yahuah (God), and some multiplied sins.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:17: Ezekias fortified his city, and brought in water into the midst thereof: he digged the hard rock with iron, and made wells for waters.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:18: In his time Sennacherib came up, and sent Rabsaces, and lifted up his hand against Sion, and boasted proudly.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:19: Then trembled their hearts and hands, and they were in pain, as women in travail.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:20: But they called upon Yahuah (God) which is merciful, and stretched out their hands toward him: and immediately the Holy One heard them out of heaven, and delivered them by the ministry of Esay.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:21: He struck the host of the Assyrians, and his angel destroyed them.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:22: For Ezekias had done the thing that pleased Yahuah (God), and was strong in the ways of David his father, as Esay the prophet, who was great and faithful in his vision, had commanded him.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:23: In his time the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king’s life.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:24: He saw by an excellent spirit what should come to pass at the last, and he comforted them that mourned in Sion.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|48:25: He shewed what should come to pass for ever, and secret things or ever they came.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:1: The remembrance of Josias is like the composition of the perfume that is made by the art of the apothecary: it is sweet as honey in all mouths, and as musick at a banquet of wine.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:2: He behaved himself uprightly in the conversion of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:3: He directed his heart to Yahuah (God), and in the time of the ungodly he established the worship of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:4: All, except David and Ezekias and Josias, were defective: for they forsook the law of the Most High, even the kings of Juda failed.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:5: Therefore he gave their power to others, and their glory to a strange nation.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:6: They burnt the chosen city of the sanctuary, and made the streets desolate, according to the prophecy of Jeremias.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:7: For they entreated him evil, who nevertheless was a prophet, sanctified in his mother’s womb, that he might root out, and afflict, and destroy; and that he might build up also, and plant.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:8: It was Ezekiel who saw the glorious vision, which was shewed him upon the chariot of the cherubims.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:9: For he made mention of the enemies under the figure of the rain, and directed them that went right.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:10: And of the twelve prophets let the memorial be blessed, and let their bones flourish again out of their place: for they comforted Jacob, and delivered them by assured hope.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:11: How shall we magnify Zorobabel? even he was as a signet on the right hand:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:12: So was Jesus the son of Josedec: who in their time builded the house, and set up an holy temple to Yahuah (God), which was prepared for everlasting glory.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:13: And among the elect was Neemias, whose renown is great, who raised up for us the walls that were fallen, and set up the gates and the bars, and raised up our ruins again.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:14: But upon the earth was no man created like Enoch; for he was taken from the earth.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:15: Neither was there a young man born like Joseph, a governor of his brothers, a stay of the people, whose bones were regarded of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|49:16: Sem and Seth were in great honour among men, and so was Adam above every living thing in creation.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:1: Simon the high priest, the son of Onias, who in his life repaired the house again, and in his days fortified the temple:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:2: And by him was built from the foundation the double height, the high fortress of the wall about the temple:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:3: In his days the cistern to receive water, being in compass as the sea, was covered with plates of brass:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:4: He took care of the temple that it should not fall, and fortified the city against besieging:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:5: How was he honoured in the midst of the people in his coming out of the sanctuary!
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:6: He was as the morning star in the midst of a cloud, and as the moon at the full:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:7: As the sun shining upon the temple of the Most High, and as the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:8: And as the flower of roses in the spring of the year, as lilies by the rivers of waters, and as the branches of the frankincense tree in the time of summer:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:9: As fire and incense in the censer, and as a vessel of beaten gold set with all manner of precious stones:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:10: And as a fair olive tree budding forth fruit, and as a cypress tree which grows up to the clouds.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:11: When he put on the robe of honour, and was clothed with the perfection of glory, when he went up to the holy altar, he made the garment of holiness honourable.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:12: When he took the portions out of the priests’ hands, he himself stood by the hearth of the altar, compassed about, as a young cedar in Libanus; and as palm trees compassed they him round about.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:13: So were all the sons of Aaron in their glory, and the oblations of Yahuah (God) in their hands, before all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:14: And finishing the service at the altar, that he might adorn the offering of the most high Almighty,
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:15: He stretched out his hand to the cup, and poured of the blood of the grape, he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour to the most high King of all.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:16: Then shouted the sons of Aaron, and sounded the silver trumpets, and made a great noise to be heard, for a remembrance before the Most High.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:17: Then all the people together hasted, and fell down to the earth upon their faces to worship their Elohim (God) Almighty, the Most High.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:18: The singers also sang praises with their voices, with great variety of sounds was there made sweet melody.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:19: And the people besought Yahuah (God), the Most High, by prayer before him that is merciful, till the solemnity of Yahuah (God) was ended, and they had finished his service.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:20: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), to give the blessing of Yahuah (God) with his lips, and to rejoice in his name.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:21: And they bowed themselves down to worship the second time, that they might receive a blessing from the Most High.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:22: Now therefore bless you Yahuah (God) of all, which only doeth wondrous things every where, which exalteth our days from the womb, and dealeth with us according to his mercy.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:23: He grant us joyfulness of heart, and that peace may be in our days in Yashar'el (Israel) for ever:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:24: That he would confirm his mercy with us, and deliver us at his time!
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:25: There be two manner of nations which my heart abhorreth, and the third is no nation:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:26: They that sit upon the mountain of Samaria, and they that dwell among the Philistines, and that foolish people that dwell in Sichem.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:27: Jesus the son of Sirach of Jerusalem has written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, who out of his heart poured forth wisdom.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:28: Blessed is he that shall be exercised in these things; and he that layeth them up in his heart shall become wise.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|50:29: For if he do them, he shall be strong to all things: for the light of Yahuah (God) leadeth him, who gives wisdom to the godly. Blessed be the name of Yahuah (God) for ever. Amen, Amen.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:1: I will thank you, O Yahuah (God) and King, and praise you, O Yahuah (God) my Saviour: I do give praise to your name:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:2: For you are my defender and helper, and has preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and has been my helper against my adversaries:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:3: And have delivered me, according to the multitude of your mercies and greatness of your name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:4: From the choking of fire on every side, and from the midst of the fire which I kindled not;
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:5: From the depth of the belly of hell, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:6: By an accusation to the king from an unrighteous tongue my soul drew near even to death, my life was near to the hell beneath.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:7: They compassed me on every side, and there was no man to help me: I looked for the succour of men, but there was none.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:8: Then thought I upon your mercy, O Yahuah (God), and upon your acts of old, how you deliverest such as wait for you, and savest them out of the hands of the enemies.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:9: Then lifted I up my supplications from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:10: I called upon Yahuah (God), the Father of my Elohim (God), that he would not leave me in the days of my trouble, and in the time of the proud, when there was no help.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:11: I will praise your name continually, and will sing praises with thanksgiving; and so my prayer was heard:
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:12: For you savedst me from destruction, and deliveredst me from the evil time: therefore will I give thanks, and praise you, and bless they name, O Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:13: When I was yet young, or ever I went abroad, I desired wisdom openly in my prayer.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:14: I prayed for her before the temple, and will seek her out even to the end.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:15: Even from the flower till the grape was ripe has my heart delighted in her: my foot went the right way, from my youth up sought I after her.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:16: I bowed down my ear a little, and received her, and got much learning.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:17: I profited in it, therefore will I ascribe glory to him that gives me wisdom.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:18: For I purposed to do after her, and earnestly I followed that which is good; so shall I not be confounded.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:19: My soul has wrestled with her, and in my doings I was exact: I stretched forth my hands to the heaven above, and bewailed my ignorances of her.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:20: I directed my soul to her, and I found her in pureness: I have had my heart joined with her from the beginning, therefore shall I not be foresaken.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:21: My heart was troubled in seeking her: therefore have I gotten a good possession.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:22: Yahuah (God) has given me a tongue for my reward, and I will praise him with it.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:23: Draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:24: Wherefore are you slow, and what say you to these things, seeing your souls are very thirsty?
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:25: I opened my mouth, and said, Buy her for yourselves without money.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:26: Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction: she is hard at hand to find.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:27: Behold with your eyes, how that I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:28: Get learning with a great sum of money, and get much gold by her.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:29: Let your soul rejoice in his mercy, and be not ashamed of his praise.
live.apocrypha|ecclesiasticus|51:30: Work your work betimes, and in his time he will give you your reward.
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:1: O Yahuah (God), Almighty Yahuah (God) of our fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and of their righteous seed;
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:2: who have made heaven and earth, with all the ornament thereof;
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:3: who have bound the sea by the word of your commandment; who have shut up the deep, and sealed it by your terrible and glorious name;
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:4: whom all men fear, and tremble before your power;
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:5: for the majesty of your glory cannot be borne, and your angry threatening toward sinners is importable:
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:6: but your merciful promise is unmeasurable and unsearchable;
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:7: for you are the most high Yahuah (God), of great compassion, longsuffering, very merciful, and repentest of the evils of men. You, O Yahuah (God), according to your great goodness have promised repentance and forgiveness to them that have sinned against you: and of your infinite mercies have appointed repentance to sinners, that they may be saved.
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:8: You therefore, O Yahuah (God), that are Yahuah (God) of the just, have not appointed repentance to the just, as to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, which have not sinned against you; but you have appointed repentance to me that am a sinner:
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:9: for I have sinned above the number of the sands of the sea. My transgressions, O Yahuah (God), are multiplied: my transgressions are multiplied, and I am not worthy to behold and see the height of heaven for the multitude of my iniquities.
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:10: I am bowed down with many iron bands, that I cannot lift up my head, neither have any release: for I have provoked your wrath, and done evil before you: I did not your will, neither kept I your commandments: I have set up abominations, and have multiplied offences.
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:11: Now therefore I bow the knee of my heart, beseeching you of grace.
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:12: I have sinned, O Yahuah (God), I have sinned, and I acknowledge my iniquities:
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:13: wherefore, I humbly beseech you, forgive me, O Yahuah (God), forgive me, and destroy me not with my iniquites. Be not angry with me for ever, by reserving evil for me; neither condemn me to the lower parts of the earth. For you are Yahuah (God), even Yahuah (God) of them that repent;
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:14: and in me you will shew all your goodness: for you will save me, that am unworthy, according to your great mercy.
live.apocrypha|the-prayer-of-manasseh|1:15: Therefore I will praise you for ever all the days of my life: for all the powers of the heavens do praise you, and yours is the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:1: Love righteousness, you that be judges of the earth: think of Yahuah (God) with a good (heart,) and in simplicity of heart seek him.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:2: For he will be found of them that tempt him not; and sheweth himself to such as do not distrust him.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:3: For froward thoughts separate from Yahuah (God): and his power, when it is tried, reproveth the unwise.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:4: For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject to sin.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:5: For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness comes in.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:6: For wisdom is a loving spirit; and will not acquit a blasphemer of his words: for Yahuah (God) is witness of his reins, and a true beholder of his heart, and a hearer of his tongue.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:7: For the Spirit of Yahuah (God) filleth the world: and that which containeth all things has knowledge of the voice.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:8: Therefore he that speaks unrighteous things cannot be hid: neither shall vengeance, when it punishes, pass by him.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:9: For inquisition shall be made into the counsels of the ungodly: and the sound of his words shall come to Yahuah (God) for the manifestation of his wicked deeds.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:10: For the ear of jealousy heareth all things: and the noise of murmurings is not hid.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:11: Therefore beware of murmuring, which is unprofitable; and refrain your tongue from backbiting: for there is no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:12: Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your hands.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:13: For Yahuah (God) made not death: neither has he pleasure in the destruction of the living.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:14: For he created all things, that they might have their being: and the generations of the world were healthful; and there is no poison of destruction in them, nor the kingdom of death upon the earth:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|1:16: But ungodly men with their works and words called it to them: for when they thought to have it their friend, they consumed to nought, and made a covenant with it, because they are worthy to take part with it.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:1: For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright, Our life is short and tedious, and in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:2: For we are born at all adventure: and we shall be hereafter as though we had never been: for the breath in our nostrils is as smoke, and a little spark in the moving of our heart:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:3: Which being extinguished, our body shall be turned into ashes, and our spirit shall vanish as the soft air,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:4: And our name shall be forgotten in time, and no man shall have our works in remembrance, and our life shall pass away as the trace of a cloud, and shall be dispersed as a mist, that is driven away with the beams of the sun, and overcome with the heat thereof.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:5: For our time is a very shadow that passeth away; and after our end there is no returning: for it is fast sealed, so that no man comes again.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:6: Come on therefore, let us enjoy the good things that are present: and let us speedily use the creatures like as in youth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:7: Let us fill ourselves with costly wine and ointments: and let no flower of the spring pass by us:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:8: Let us crown ourselves with rosebuds, before they be withered:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:9: Let none of us go without his part of our voluptuousness: let us leave tokens of our joyfulness in every place: for this is our portion, and our lot is this.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:10: Let us oppress the poor righteous man, let us not spare the widow, nor reverence the ancient gray hairs of the aged.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:11: Let our strength be the law of justice: for that which is feeble is found to be nothing worth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:12: Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraideth us with our offending the law, and objecteth to our infamy the transgressings of our education.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:13: He professeth to have the knowledge of Yahuah (God): and he calls himself the child of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:14: He was made to reprove our thoughts.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:15: He is grievous to us even to behold: for his life is not like other men’s, his ways are of another fashion.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:16: We are esteemed of him as counterfeits: he abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness: he pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed, and makes his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:17: Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:18: For if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:19: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:20: Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:21: Such things they did imagine, and were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:22: As for the mysteries of Yahuah (God), they knew them not: neither hoped they for the wages of righteousness, nor discerned a reward for blameless souls.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:23: For Yahuah (God) created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|2:24: Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:1: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:2: In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:3: And their going from us to be utter destruction: but they are in peace.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:4: For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:5: And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:6: As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:7: And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:8: They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Elohim (God) shall reign for ever.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:9: They that put their trust in him shall understand the truth: and such as be faithful in love shall abide with him: for grace and mercy is to his saints, and he has care for his elect.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:10: But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous, and forsaken Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:11: For whoso despiseth wisdom and nurture, he is miserable, and their hope is vain, their labours unfruitful, and their works unprofitable:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:12: Their wives are foolish, and their children wicked:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:13: Their offspring is cursed. Wherefore blessed is the barren that is undefiled, which has not known the sinful bed: she shall have fruit in the visitation of souls.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:14: And blessed is the eunuch, which with his hands has wrought no iniquity, nor imagined wicked things against Yahuah (God): for to him shall be given the special gift of faith, and an inheritance in the temple of Yahuah (God) more acceptable to his mind.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:15: For glorious is the fruit of good labours: and the root of wisdom shall never fall away.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:16: As for the children of adulterers, they shall not come to their perfection, and the seed of an unrighteous bed shall be rooted out.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:17: For though they live long, yet shall they be nothing regarded: and their last age shall be without honour.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:18: Or, if they die quickly, they have no hope, neither comfort in the day of trial.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|3:19: For horrible is the end of the unrighteous generation.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:1: Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue: for the memorial thereof is immortal: because it is known with Yahuah (God), and with men.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:2: When it is present, men take example at it; and when it is gone, they desire it: it wears a crown, and triumpheth for ever, having gotten the victory, striving for undefiled rewards.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:3: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive, nor take deep rooting from bastard slips, nor lay any fast foundation.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:4: For though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:5: The imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:6: For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:7: But though the righteous be prevented with death, yet shall he be in rest.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:8: For honourable age is not that which stands in length of time, nor that is measured by number of years.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:9: But wisdom is the gray hair to men, and an unspotted life is old age.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:10: He pleased Yahuah (God), and was beloved of him: so that living among sinners he was translated.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:11: Yea speedily was he taken away, lest that wickedness should alter his understanding, or deceit beguile his soul.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:12: For the bewitching of naughtiness does obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence does undermine the simple mind.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:13: He, being made perfect in a short time, fulfilled a long time:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:14: For his soul pleased Yahuah (God): therefore hasted he to take him away from among the wicked.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:15: This the people saw, and understood it not, neither laid they up this in their minds, That his grace and mercy is with his saints, and that he has respect to his chosen.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:16: Thus the righteous that is dead shall condemn the ungodly which are living; and youth that is soon perfected the many years and old age of the unrighteous.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:17: For they shall see the end of the wise, and shall not understand what Yahuah (God) in his counsel has decreed of him, and to what end Yahuah (God) has set him in safety.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:18: They shall see him, and despise him; but Yahuah (God) shall laugh them to scorn: and they shall hereafter be a vile carcase, and a reproach among the dead for evermore.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:19: For he shall rend them, and cast them down headlong, that they shall be speechless; and he shall shake them from the foundation; and they shall be utterly laid waste, and be in sorrow; and their memorial shall perish.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|4:20: And when they cast up the accounts of their sins, they shall come with fear: and their own iniquities shall convince them to their face.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:1: Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:2: When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:3: And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:4: We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:5: How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints!
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:6: Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:7: We wearied ourselves in the way of wickedness and destruction: yes, we have gone through deserts, where there lay no way: but as for the way of Yahuah (God), we have not known it.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:8: What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:9: All those things are passed away like a shadow, and as a post that hasted by;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:10: And as a ship that passeth over the waves of the water, which when it is gone by, the trace thereof cannot be found, neither the pathway of the keel in the waves;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:11: Or as when a bird has flown through the air, there is no token of her way to be found, but the light air being beaten with the stroke of her wings and parted with the violent noise and motion of them, is passed through, and in it afterwards no sign where she went is to be found;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:12: Or like as when an arrow is shot at a mark, it parteth the air, which immediately comes together again, so that a man cannot know where it went through:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:13: Even so we in like manner, as soon as we were born, began to draw to our end, and had no sign of virtue to shew; but were consumed in our own wickedness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:14: For the hope of the ungodly is like dust that is blown away with the wind; like a thin froth that is driven away with the storm; like as the smoke which is dispersed here and there with a tempest, and passeth away as the remembrance of a guest that tarrieth but a day.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:15: But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with Yahuah (God), and the care of them is with the Most High.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:16: Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the hand of Yahuah (God): for with his right hand shall he cover them, and with his arm shall he protect them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:17: He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour, and make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:18: He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate, and true judgment instead of an helmet.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:19: He shall take holiness for an invincible shield.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:20: His severe wrath shall he sharpen for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:21: Then shall the right aiming thunderbolts go abroad; and from the clouds, as from a well drawn bow, shall they fly to the mark.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:22: And hailstones full of wrath shall be cast as out of a stone bow, and the water of the sea shall rage against them, and the floods shall cruelly drown them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|5:23: Yea, a mighty wind shall stand up against them, and like a storm shall blow them away: thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:1: Hear therefore, O you kings, and understand; learn, you that be judges of the ends of the earth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:2: Give ear, you that rule the people, and glory in the multitude of nations.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:3: For power is given you of Yahuah (God), and sovereignty from the Highest, who shall try your works, and search out your counsels.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:4: Because, being ministers of his kingdom, you have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of Yahuah (God);
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:5: Horribly and speedily shall he come upon you: for a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:6: For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:7: For he which is Yahuah (God) over all shall fear no man’s person, neither shall he stand in awe of any man’s greatness: for he has made the small and great, and careth for all alike.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:8: But a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:9: To you therefore, O kings, do I speak, that you may learn wisdom, and not fall away.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:10: For they that keep holiness holily shall be judged holy: and they that have learned such things shall find what to answer.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:11: Wherefore set your affection upon my words; desire them, and you shall be instructed.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:12: Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yes, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:13: She preventeth them that desire her, in making herself first known to them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:14: Whoso seeks her early shall have no great travail: for he shall find her sitting at his doors.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:15: To think therefore upon her is perfection of wisdom: and whoso watcheth for her shall quickly be without care.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:16: For she goes about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably to them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:17: For the very true beginning of her is the desire of discipline; and the care of discipline is love;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:18: And love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed to her laws is the assurance of incorruption;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:19: And incorruption makes us near to Yahuah (God):
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:20: Therefore the desire of wisdom brings to a kingdom.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:21: If your delight be then in thrones and sceptres, O you kings of the people, honour wisdom, that you may reign for evermore.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:22: As for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you: but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light, and will not pass over the truth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:23: Neither will I go with consuming envy; for such a man shall have no fellowship with wisdom.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:24: But the multitude of the wise is the welfare of the world: and a wise king is the upholding of the people.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|6:25: Receive therefore instruction through my words, and it shall do you good.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:1: I myself also am a mortal man, like to all, and the offspring of him that was first made of the earth,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:2: And in my mother’s womb was fashioned to be flesh in the time of ten months, being compacted in blood, of the seed of man, and the pleasure that came with sleep.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:3: And when I was born, I drew in the common air, and fell upon the earth, which is of like nature, and the first voice which I uttered was crying, as all others do.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:4: I was nursed in swaddling clothes, and that with cares.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:5: For there is no king that had any other beginning of birth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:6: For all men have one entrance into life, and the like going out.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:7: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:8: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:9: Neither compared I to her any precious stone, because all gold in respect of her is as a little sand, and silver shall be counted as clay before her.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:10: I loved her above health and beauty, and chose to have her instead of light: for the light that comes from her never goes out.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:11: All good things together came to me with her, and innumerable riches in her hands.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:12: And I rejoiced in them all, because wisdom goes before them: and I knew not that she was the mother of them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:13: I learned diligently, and do communicate her liberally: I do not hide her riches.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:14: For she is a treasure to men that never fails: which they that use become the friends of Yahuah (God), being commended for the gifts that come from learning.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:15: Yahuah (God) has granted me to speak as I would, and to conceive as is meet for the things that are given me: because it is he that leadeth to wisdom, and directeth the wise.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:16: For in his hand are both we and our words; all wisdom also, and knowledge of workmanship.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:17: For he has given me certain knowledge of the things that are, namely, to know how the world was made, and the operation of the elements:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:18: The beginning, ending, and midst of the times: the alterations of the turning of the sun, and the change of seasons:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:19: The circuits of years, and the positions of stars:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:20: The natures of living creatures, and the furies of wild beasts: the violence of winds, and the reasonings of men: the diversities of plants and the virtues of roots:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:21: And all such things as are either secret or manifest, them I know.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:22: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:23: Kind to man, steadfast, sure, free from care, having all power, overseeing all things, and going through all understanding, pure, and most subtil, spirits.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:24: For wisdom is more moving than any motion: she passeth and goes through all things by reason of her pureness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:25: For she is the breath of the power of Yahuah (God), and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:26: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:27: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she makes all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she makes them friends of Yahuah (God), and prophets.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:28: For Yahuah (God) loves none but him that dwells with wisdom.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:29: For she is more beautiful than the sun, and above all the order of stars: being compared with the light, she is found before it.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|7:30: For after this comes night: but vice shall not prevail against wisdom.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:1: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:2: I loved her, and sought her out from my youth, I desired to make her my spouse, and I was a lover of her beauty.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:3: In that she is conversant with Yahuah (God), she magnifies her nobility: yes, Yahuah (God) of all things himself loved her.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:4: For she is privy to the mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah (God), and a lover of his works.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:5: If riches be a possession to be desired in this life; what is richer than wisdom, that works all things?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:6: And if prudence work; who of all that are is a more cunning workman than she?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:7: And if a man love righteousness her labours are virtues: for she teaches temperance and prudence, justice and fortitude: which are such things, as men can have nothing more profitable in their life.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:8: If a man desire much experience, she knoweth things of old, and conjectureth aright what is to come: she knoweth the subtilties of speeches, and can expound dark sentences: she foreseeth signs and wonders, and the events of seasons and times.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:9: Therefore I purposed to take her to me to live with me, knowing that she would be a counsellor of good things, and a comfort in cares and grief.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:10: For her sake I shall have estimation among the multitude, and honour with the elders, though I be young.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:11: I shall be found of a quick conceit in judgment, and shall be admired in the sight of great men.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:12: When I hold my tongue, they shall bide my leisure, and when I speak, they shall give good ear to me: if I talk much, they shall lay their hands upon their mouth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:13: Moreover by the means of her I shall obtain immortality, and leave behind me an everlasting memorial to them that come after me.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:14: I shall set the people in order, and the nations shall be subject to me.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:15: Horrible tyrants shall be afraid, when they do but hear of me; I shall be found good among the multitude, and valiant in war.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:16: After I am come into my house, I will repose myself with her: for her conversation has no bitterness; and to live with her has no sorrow, but mirth and joy.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:17: Now when I considered these things in myself, and pondered them in my heart, how that to be allied to wisdom is immortality;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:18: And great pleasure it is to have her friendship; and in the works of her hands are infinite riches; and in the exercise of conference with her, prudence; and in talking with her, a good report; I went about seeking how to take her to me.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:19: For I was a witty child, and had a good spirit.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:20: Yea rather, being good, I came into a body undefiled.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|8:21: Nevertheless, when I perceived that I could not otherwise obtain her, except Yahuah (God) gave her me; and that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was; I prayed to Yahuah (God), and besought him, and with my whole heart I said,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:1: O Yahuah (God) of my fathers, and Yahuah (God) of mercy, who have made all things with your word,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:2: And ordained man through your wisdom, that he should have dominion over the creatures which you have made,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:3: And order the world according to equity and righteousness, and execute judgment with an upright heart:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:4: Give me wisdom, that sits by your throne; and reject me not from among your children:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:5: For I your servant and son of yours handmaid am a feeble person, and of a short time, and too young for the understanding of judgment and laws.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:6: For though a man be never so perfect among the children of men, yet if your wisdom be not with him, he shall be nothing regarded.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:7: You have chosen me to be a king of your people, and a judge of your sons and daughters:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:8: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:9: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:10: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory, that being present she may labour with me, that I may know what is pleasing to you.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:11: For she knoweth and understands all things, and she shall lead me soberly in my doings, and preserve me in her power.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:12: So shall my works be acceptable, and then shall I judge your people righteously, and be worthy to sit in my father’s seat.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:13: For what man is he that can know the counsel of Yahuah (God)? or who can think what the will of Yahuah (God) is?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:14: For the thoughts of mortal men are miserable, and our devices are but uncertain.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:15: For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:16: And hardly do we guess aright at things that are upon earth, and with labour do we find the things that are before us: but the things that are in heaven who has searched out?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:17: And your counsel who has known, except you give wisdom, and send your Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) from above?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|9:18: For so the ways of them which lived on the earth were reformed, and men were taught the things that are pleasing to you, and were saved through wisdom.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:1: She preserved the first formed father of the world, that was created alone, and brought him out of his fall,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:2: And gave him power to rule all things.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:3: But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury with which he murdered his brother.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:4: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:5: Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded, she found out the righteous, and preserved him blameless to Yahuah (God), and kept him strong against his tender compassion toward his son.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:6: When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:7: Of whose wickedness even to this day the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and plants bearing fruit that never come to ripeness: and a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:8: For regarding not wisdom, they got not only this hurt, that they knew not the things which were good; but also left behind them to the world a memorial of their foolishness: so that in the things in which they offended they could not so much as be hid.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:9: But wisdom delivered from pain those that attended upon her.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:10: When the righteous fled from his brother’s wrath she guided him in right paths, shewed him the kingdom of Yahuah (God), and gave him knowledge of holy things, made him rich in his travels, and multiplied the fruit of his labours.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:11: In the covetousness of such as oppressed him she stood by him, and made him rich.
