live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:12: She defended him from his enemies, and kept him safe from those that lay in wait, and in a sore conflict she gave him the victory; that he might know that goodness is stronger than all.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:13: When the righteous was sold, she forsook him not, but delivered him from sin: she went down with him into the pit,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:14: And left him not in bonds, till she brought him the sceptre of the kingdom, and power against those that oppressed him: as for them that had accused him, she shewed them to be liars, and gave him perpetual glory.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:15: She delivered the righteous people and blameless seed from the nation that oppressed them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:16: She entered into the soul of the servant of Yahuah (God), and withstood dreadful kings in wonders and signs;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:17: Rendered to the righteous a reward of their labours, guided them in a marvellous way, and was to them for a cover by day, and a light of stars in the night season;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:18: Brought them through the Red sea, and led them through much water:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:19: But she drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:20: Therefore the righteous spoiled the ungodly, and praised your holy name, O Yahuah (God), and magnified with one accord yours hand, that fought for them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|10:21: For wisdom opened the mouth of the dumb, and made the tongues of them that cannot speak eloquent.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:1: She prospered their works in the hand of the holy prophet.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:2: They went through the wilderness that was not inhabited, and pitched tents in places where there lay no way.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:3: They stood against their enemies, and were avenged of their adversaries.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:4: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:5: For by what things their enemies were punished, by the same they in their need were benefited.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:6: For instead of a perpetual running river troubled with foul blood,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:7: For a manifest reproof of that commandment, by which the infants were slain, you gavest to them abundance of water by a means which they hoped not for:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:8: Declaring by that thirst then how you had punished their adversaries.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:9: For when they were tried albeit but in mercy chastised, they knew how the ungodly were judged in wrath and tormented, thirsting in another manner than the just.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:10: For these you did admonish and try, as a father: but the other, as a severe king, you did condemn and punish.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:11: Whether they were absent or present, they were vexed alike.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:12: For a double grief came upon them, and a groaning for the remembrance of things past.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:13: For when they heard by their own punishments the other to be benefited, they had some feeling of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:14: For whom they respected with scorn, when he was long before thrown out at the casting forth of the infants, him in the end, when they saw what came to pass, they admired.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:15: But for the foolish devices of their wickedness, with which being deceived they worshipped serpents void of reason, and vile beasts, you did send a multitude of unreasonable beasts upon them for vengeance;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:16: That they might know, that wherewithal a man sinneth, by the same also shall he be punished.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:17: For your Almighty hand, that made the world of matter without form, wanted not means to send among them a multitude of bears or fierce lions,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:18: Or unknown wild beasts, full of rage, newly created, breathing out either a fiery vapour, or filthy scents of scattered smoke, or shooting horrible sparkles out of their eyes:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:19: Of which not only the harm might dispatch them at once, but also the terrible sight utterly destroy them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:20: Yea, and without these might they have fallen down with one blast, being persecuted of vengeance, and scattered abroad through the breath of your power: but you have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:21: For you can shew your great strength at all times when you will; and who may withstand the power of your arm?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:22: For the whole world before you is as a little grain of the balance, yes, as a drop of the morning dew that falls down upon the earth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:23: But you have mercy upon all; for you can do all things, and winkest at the sins of men, because they should amend.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:24: For you lovest all the things that are, and abhorrest nothing which you have made: for never wouldest you have made any thing, if you had hated it.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:25: And how could any thing have endured, if it had not been your will? or been preserved, if not called by you?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|11:26: But you sparest all: for they are yours, O Yahuah (God), you lover of souls.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:1: For your incorruptible Spirit is in all things.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:2: Therefore chastenest you them by little and little that offend, and warnest them by putting them in remembrance in which they have offended, that leaving their wickedness they may believe on you, O Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:3: For it was your will to destroy by the hands of our fathers both those old inhabitants of your holy land,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:4: Whom you hatedst for doing most odious works of witchcrafts, and wicked sacrifices;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:5: And also those merciless murderers of children, and devourers of man’s flesh, and the feasts of blood,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:6: With their priests out of the midst of their idolatrous crew, and the parents, that killed with their own hands souls destitute of help:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:7: That the land, which you esteemedst above all other, might receive a worthy colony of the children of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:8: Nevertheless even those you sparedst as men, and did send wasps, forerunners of yours host, to destroy them by little and little.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:9: Not that you were unable to bring the ungodly under the hand of the righteous in battle, or to destroy them at once with cruel beasts, or with one rough word:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:10: But executing your judgments upon them by little and little, you gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:11: For it was a cursed seed from the beginning; neither did you for fear of any man give them pardon for those things in which they sinned.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:12: For who shall say, What have you done? or who shall withstand your judgment? or who shall accuse you for the nations that perish, whom you made? or who shall come to stand against you, to be revenged for the unrighteous men?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:13: For neither is there any Yahuah (God) but you that careth for all, to whom you might shew that your judgment is not unright.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:14: Neither shall king or tyrant be able to set his face against you for any whom you have punished.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:15: Forsomuch then as you are righteous thyself, you orderest all things righteously: thinking it not agreeable with your power to condemn him that has not deserved to be punished.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:16: For your power is the beginning of righteousness, and because you are Yahuah (God) of all, it makes you to be gracious to all.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:17: For when men will not believe that you are of a full power, you shewest your strength, and among them that know it you makest their boldness manifest.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:18: But you, mastering your power, judgest with equity, and orderest us with great favour: for you may use power when you will.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:19: But by such works have you taught your people that the just man should be merciful, and have made your children to be of a good hope that you give repentance for sins.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:20: For if you did punish the enemies of your children, and the condemned to death, with such deliberation, giving them time and place, by which they might be delivered from their malice:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:21: With how great circumspection did you judge your own sons, to whose fathers you have sworn, and made covenants of good promises?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:22: Therefore, whereas you do chasten us, you scourgest our enemies a thousand times more, to the intent that, when we judge, we should carefully think of your goodness, and when we ourselves are judged, we should look for mercy.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:23: Wherefore, whereas men have lived dissolutely and unrighteously, you have tormented them with their own abominations.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:24: For they went astray very far in the ways of error, and held them for gods, which even among the beasts of their enemies were despised, being deceived, as children of no understanding.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:25: Therefore to them, as to children without the use of reason, you did send a judgment to mock them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:26: But they that would not be reformed by that correction, in which he dallied with them, shall feel a judgment worthy of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|12:27: For, look, for what things they grudged, when they were punished, that is, for them whom they thought to be gods; now being punished in them, when they saw it, they acknowledged him to be the true Yahuah (God), whom before they denied to know: and therefore came extreme damnation upon them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:1: Surely vain are all men by nature, who are ignorant of Yahuah (God), and could not out of the good things that are seen know him that is: neither by considering the works did they acknowledge the workmaster;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:2: But deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:3: With whose beauty if they being delighted took them to be gods; let them know how much better Yahuah (God) of them is: for the first author of beauty has created them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:4: But if they were astonished at their power and virtue, let them understand by them, how much mightier he is that made them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:5: For by the greatness and beauty of the creatures proportionably the maker of them is seen.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:6: But yet for this they are the less to be blamed: for they perhaps err, seeking Yahuah (God), and desirous to find him.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:7: For being conversant in his works they search him diligently, and believe their sight: because the things are beautiful that are seen.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:8: Howbeit neither are they to be pardoned.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:9: For if they were able to know so much, that they could aim at the world; how did they not sooner find out Yahuah (God) thereof?
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:10: But miserable are they, and in dead things is their hope, who call them gods, which are the works of men’s hands, gold and silver, to shew art in, and resemblances of beasts, or a stone good for nothing, the work of an ancient hand.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:11: Now a carpenter that felleth timber, after he has sawn down a tree meet for the purpose, and taken off all the bark skilfully round about, and has wrought it handsomely, and made a vessel thereof fit for the service of man’s life;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:12: And after spending the refuse of his work to dress his meat, has filled himself;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:13: And taking the very refuse among those which served to no use, being a crooked piece of wood, and full of knots, has carved it diligently, when he had nothing else to do, and formed it by the skill of his understanding, and fashioned it to the image of a man;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:14: Or made it like some vile beast, laying it over with vermilion, and with paint colouring it red, and covering every spot in it;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:15: And when he had made a convenient room for it, set it in a wall, and made it fast with iron:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:16: For he provided for it that it might not fall, knowing that it was unable to help itself; for it is an image, and has need of help:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:17: Then makes he prayer for his goods, for his wife and children, and is not ashamed to speak to that which has no life.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:18: For health he calls upon that which is weak: for life prayeth to that which is dead; for aid humbly beseecheth that which has least means to help: and for a good journey he asketh of that which cannot set a foot forward:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|13:19: And for gaining and getting, and for good success of his hands, asketh ability to do of him, that is most unable to do any thing.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:1: Again, one preparing himself to sail, and about to pass through the raging waves, calls upon a piece of wood more rotten than the vessel that carrieth him.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:2: For verily desire of gain devised that, and the workman built it by his skill.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:3: But your providence, O Father, governeth it: for you have made a way in the sea, and a safe path in the waves;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:4: Shewing that you can save from all danger: yes, though a man went to sea without art.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:5: Nevertheless you would not that the works of your wisdom should be idle, and therefore do men commit their lives to a small piece of wood, and passing the rough sea in a weak vessel are saved.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:6: For in the old time also, when the proud giants perished, the hope of the world governed by your hand escaped in a weak vessel, and left to all ages a seed of generation.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:7: For blessed is the wood by which righteousness comes.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:8: But that which is made with hands is cursed, as well it, as he that made it: he, because he made it; and it, because, being corruptible, it was called god.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:9: For the ungodly and his ungodliness are both alike hateful to Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:10: For that which is made shall be punished together with him that made it.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:11: Therefore even upon the idols of the Gentiles shall there be a visitation: because in the creature of Yahuah (God) they are become an abomination, and stumblingblocks to the souls of men, and a snare to the feet of the unwise.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:12: For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:13: For neither were they from the beginning, neither shall they be for ever.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:14: For by the vain glory of men they entered into the world, and therefore shall they come shortly to an end.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:15: For a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he has made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god, which was then a dead man, and delivered to those that were under him ceremonies and sacrifices.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:16: Thus in process of time an ungodly custom grown strong was kept as a law, and graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:17: Whom men could not honour in presence, because they dwelt far off, they took the counterfeit of his visage from far, and made an express image of a king whom they honoured, to the end that by this their forwardness they might flatter him that was absent, as if he were present.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:18: Also the singular diligence of the artificer did help to set forward the ignorant to more superstition.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:19: For he, perhaps willing to please one in authority, forced all his skill to make the resemblance of the best fashion.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:20: And so the multitude, allured by the grace of the work, took him now for a god, which a little before was but honoured.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:21: And this was an occasion to deceive the world: for men, serving either calamity or tyranny, did ascribe to stones and stocks the incommunicable name.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:22: Moreover this was not enough for them, that they erred in the knowledge of Yahuah (God); but whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance, those so great plagues called they peace.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:23: For while they slew their children in sacrifices, or used secret ceremonies, or made revellings of strange rites;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:24: They kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled: but either one slew another traiterously, or grieved him by adultery.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:25: So that there reigned in all men without exception blood, manslaughter, theft, and dissimulation, corruption, unfaithfulness, tumults, perjury,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:26: Disquieting of good men, forgetfulness of good turns, defiling of souls, changing of kind, disorder in marriages, adultery, and shameless uncleanness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:27: For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:28: For either they are mad when they be merry, or prophesy lies, or live unjustly, or else lightly forswear themselves.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:29: For insomuch as their trust is in idols, which have no life; though they swear falsely, yet they look not to be hurt.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:30: Howbeit for both causes shall they be justly punished: both because they thought not well of Yahuah (God), giving heed to idols, and also unjustly swore in deceit, despising holiness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|14:31: For it is not the power of them by whom they swear: but it is the just vengeance of sinners, that punishes always the offence of the ungodly.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:1: But you, O Yahuah (God), art gracious and true, longsuffering, and in mercy ordering all things,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:2: For if we sin, we are yours, knowing your power: but we will not sin, knowing that we are counted yours.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:3: For to know you is perfect righteousness: yes, to know your power is the root of immortality.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:4: For neither did the mischievous invention of men deceive us, nor an image spotted with divers colours, the painter’s fruitless labour;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:5: The sight of which enticeth fools to lust after it, and so they desire the form of a dead image, that has no breath.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:6: Both they that make them, they that desire them, and they that worship them, are lovers of evil things, and are worthy to have such things to trust upon.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:7: For the potter, tempering soft earth, fashioneth every vessel with much labour for our service: yes, of the same clay he makes both the vessels that serve for clean uses, and likewise also all such as serve to the contrary: but what is the use of either sort, the potter himself is the judge.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:8: And employing his labours lewdly, he makes a vain god of the same clay, even he which a little before was made of earth himself, and within a little while after returns to the same, out when his life which was lent him shall be demanded.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:9: Notwithstanding his care is, not that he shall have much labour, nor that his life is short: but striveth to excel goldsmiths and silversmiths, and endeavoureth to do like the workers in brass, and counteth it his glory to make counterfeit things.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:10: His heart is ashes, his hope is more vile than earth, and his life of less value than clay:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:11: Forasmuch as he knew not his Maker, and him that inspired into him an active soul, and breathed in a living spirit.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:12: But they counted our life a pastime, and our time here a market for gain: for, say they, we must be getting every way, though it be by evil means.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:13: For this man, that of earthly matter makes brittle vessels and graven images, knoweth himself to offend above all others.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:14: And all the enemies of your people, that hold them in subjection, are most foolish, and are more miserable than very babes.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:15: For they counted all the idols of the heathen to be gods: which neither have the use of eyes to see, nor noses to draw breath, nor ears to hear, nor fingers of hands to handle; and as for their feet, they are slow to go.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:16: For man made them, and he that borrowed his own spirit fashioned them: but no man can make a god like to himself.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:17: For being mortal, he works a dead thing with wicked hands: for he himself is better than the things which he worshippeth: whereas he lived once, but they never.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:18: Yea, they worshipped those beasts also that are most hateful: for being compared together, some are worse than others.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|15:19: Neither are they beautiful, so much as to be desired in respect of beasts: but they went without the praise of Yahuah (God) and his blessing.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:1: Therefore by the like were they punished worthily, and by the multitude of beasts tormented.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:2: Instead of which punishment, dealing graciously with your own people, you preparedst for them meat of a strange taste, even quails to stir up their appetite:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:3: To the end that they, desiring food, might for the ugly sight of the beasts sent among them lothe even that, which they must needs desire; but these, suffering penury for a short space, might be made partakers of a strange taste.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:4: For it was requisite, that upon them exercising tyranny should come penury, which they could not avoid: but to these it should only be shewed how their enemies were tormented.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:5: For when the horrible fierceness of beasts came upon these, and they perished with the stings of crooked serpents, your wrath endured not for ever:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:6: But they were troubled for a small season, that they might be admonished, having a sign of salvation, to put them in remembrance of the commandment of your law.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:7: For he that turned himself toward it was not saved by the thing that he saw, but by you, that are the Saviour of all.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:8: And in this you madest your enemies confess, that it is you who deliverest from all evil:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:9: For them the bitings of grasshoppers and flies killed, neither was there found any remedy for their life: for they were worthy to be punished by such.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:10: But your sons not the very teeth of venomous dragons overcame: for your mercy was ever by them, and healed them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:11: For they were pricked, that they should remember your words; and were quickly saved, that not falling into deep forgetfulness, they might be continually mindful of your goodness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:12: For it was neither herb, nor mollifying plaister, that restored them to health: but your word, O Yahuah (God), which healeth all things.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:13: For you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:14: A man indeed killeth through his malice: and the spirit, when it is gone forth, returns not; neither the soul received up comes again.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:15: But it is not possible to escape yours hand.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:16: For the ungodly, that denied to know you, were scourged by the strength of your arm: with strange rains, hails, and showers, were they persecuted, that they could not avoid, and through fire were they consumed.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:17: For, which is most to be wondered at, the fire had more force in the water, that quenches all things: for the world fighteth for the righteous.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:18: For sometime the flame was mitigated, that it might not burn up the beasts that were sent against the ungodly; but themselves might see and perceive that they were persecuted with the judgment of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:19: And at another time it burneth even in the midst of water above the power of fire, that it might destroy the fruits of an unjust land.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:20: Instead of which you feddest your own people with angels’ food, and did send them from heaven bread prepared without their labour, able to content every man’s delight, and agreeing to every taste.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:21: For your sustenance declared your sweetness to your children, and serving to the appetite of the eater, tempered itself to every man’s liking.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:22: But snow and ice endured the fire, and melted not, that they might know that fire burning in the hail, and sparkling in the rain, did destroy the fruits of the enemies.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:23: But this again did even forget his own strength, that the righteous might be nourished.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:24: For the creature that serveth you, who are the Maker increaseth his strength against the unrighteous for their punishment, and abateth his strength for the benefit of such as put their trust in you.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:25: Therefore even then was it altered into all fashions, and was obedient to your grace, that nourishes all things, according to the desire of them that had need:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:26: That your children, O Yahuah (God), whom you lovest, might know, that it is not the growing of fruits that nourishes man: but that it is your word, which preserves them that put their trust in you.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:27: For that which was not destroyed of the fire, being warmed with a little sunbeam, soon melted away:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:28: That it might be known, that we must prevent the sun to give you thanks, and at the dayspring pray to you.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|16:29: For the hope of the unthankful shall melt away as the winter’s hoar frost, and shall run away as unprofitable water.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:1: For great are your judgments, and cannot be expressed: therefore unnurtured souls have erred.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:2: For when unrighteous men thought to oppress the holy nation; they being shut up in their houses, the prisoners of darkness, and fettered with the bonds of a long night, lay there exiled from the eternal providence.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:3: For while they supposed to lie hid in their secret sins, they were scattered under a dark veil of forgetfulness, being horribly astonished, and troubled with strange apparitions.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:4: For neither might the corner that held them keep them from fear: but noises as of waters falling down sounded about them, and sad visions appeared to them with heavy countenances.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:5: No power of the fire might give them light: neither could the bright flames of the stars endure to lighten that horrible night.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:6: Only there appeared to them a fire kindled of itself, very dreadful: for being much terrified, they thought the things which they saw to be worse than the sight they saw not.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:7: As for the illusions of art magick, they were put down, and their vaunting in wisdom was reproved with disgrace.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:8: For they, that promised to drive away terrors and troubles from a sick soul, were sick themselves of fear, worthy to be laughed at.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:9: For though no terrible thing did fear them; yet being scared with beasts that passed by, and hissing of serpents,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:10: They died for fear, denying that they saw the air, which could of no side be avoided.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:11: For wickedness, condemned by her own witness, is very timorous, and being pressed with conscience, always forecasteth grievous things.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:12: For fear is nothing else but a betraying of the succours which reason offers.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:13: And the expectation from within, being less, counteth the ignorance more than the cause which brings the torment.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:14: But they sleeping the same sleep that night, which was indeed intolerable, and which came upon them out of the bottoms of inevitable hell,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:15: Were partly vexed with monstrous apparitions, and partly fainted, their heart failing them: for a sudden fear, and not looked for, came upon them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:16: So then whoever there fell down was straitly kept, shut up in a prison without iron bars,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:17: For whether he were husbandman, or shepherd, or a labourer in the field, he was overtaken, and endured that necessity, which could not be avoided: for they were all bound with one chain of darkness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:18: Whether it were a whistling wind, or a melodious noise of birds among the spreading branches, or a pleasing fall of water running violently,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:19: Or a terrible sound of stones cast down, or a running that could not be seen of skipping beasts, or a roaring voice of most savage wild beasts, or a rebounding echo from the hollow mountains; these things made them to swoon for fear.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:20: For the whole world shined with clear light, and none were hindered in their labour:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|17:21: Over them only was spread an heavy night, an image of that darkness which should afterward receive them: but yet were they to themselves more grievous than the darkness.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:1: Nevertheless your saints had a very great light, whose voice they hearing, and not seeing their shape, because they also had not suffered the same things, they counted them happy.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:2: But for that they did not hurt them now, of whom they had been wronged before, they thanked them, and besought them pardon for that they had been enemies.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:3: Instead of which you gavest them a burning pillar of fire, both to be a guide of the unknown journey, and an harmless sun to entertain them honourably.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:4: For they were worthy to be deprived of light and imprisoned in darkness, who had kept your sons shut up, by whom the uncorrupt light of the law was to be given to the world.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:5: And when they had determined to slay the babes of the saints, one child being cast forth, and saved, to reprove them, you tookest away the multitude of their children, and destroyedst them altogether in a mighty water.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:6: Of that night were our fathers certified afore, that assuredly knowing to what oaths they had given credence, they might afterwards be of good cheer.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:7: So of your people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:8: For with which you did punish our adversaries, by the same you did glorify us, whom you had called.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:9: For the righteous children of good men did sacrifice secretly, and with one consent made a holy law, that the saints should be like partakers of the same good and evil, the fathers now singing out the songs of praise.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:10: But on the other side there sounded an ill according cry of the enemies, and a lamentable noise was carried abroad for children that were bewailed.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:11: The master and the servant were punished after one manner; and like as the king, so suffered the common person.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:12: So they all together had innumerable dead with one kind of death; neither were the living sufficient to bury them: for in one moment the noblest offspring of them was destroyed.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:13: For whereas they would not believe any thing by reason of the enchantments; upon the destruction of the firstborn, they acknowledged this people to be the sons of Yahuah (God).
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:14: For while all things were in quiet silence, and that night was in the midst of her swift course,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:15: Your Almighty word leaped down from heaven out of your royal throne, as a fierce man of war into the midst of a land of destruction,
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:16: And brought your unfeigned commandment as a sharp sword, and standing up filled all things with death; and it touched the heaven, but it stood upon the earth.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:17: Then suddenly visions of horrible dreams troubled them sore, and terrors came upon them unlooked for.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:18: And one thrown here, and another there, half dead, shewed the cause of his death.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:19: For the dreams that troubled them did foreshew this, lest they should perish, and not know why they were afflicted.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:20: Yea, the tasting of death touched the righteous also, and there was a destruction of the multitude in the wilderness: but the wrath endured not long.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:21: For then the blameless man made haste, and stood forth to defend them; and bringing the shield of his proper ministry, even prayer, and the propitiation of incense, set himself against the wrath, and so brought the calamity to an end, declaring that he was your servant.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:22: So he overcame the destroyer, not with strength of body, nor force of arms, but with a word subdued him that punished, alleging the oaths and covenants made with the fathers.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:23: For when the dead were now fallen down by heaps one upon another, standing between, he stayed the wrath, and parted the way to the living.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:24: For in the long garment was the whole world, and in the four rows of the stones was the glory of the fathers graven, and your Majesty upon the diadem of his head.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|18:25: To these the destroyer gave place, and was afraid of them: for it was enough that they only tasted of the wrath.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:1: As for the ungodly, wrath came upon them without mercy to the end: for he knew before what they would do;
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:2: How that having given them leave to depart, and sent them hastily away, they would repent and pursue them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:3: For while they were yet mourning and making lamentation at the graves of the dead, they added another foolish device, and pursued them as fugitives, whom they had intreated to be gone.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:4: For the destiny, of which they were worthy, drew them to this end, and made them forget the things that had already happened, that they might fulfil the punishment which was wanting to their torments:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:5: And that your people might pass a wonderful way: but they might find a strange death.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:6: For the whole creature in his proper kind was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given to them, that your children might be kept without hurt:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:7: As namely, a cloud shadowing the camp; and where water stood before, dry land appeared; and out of the Red sea a way without impediment; and out of the violent stream a green field:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:8: Wherethrough all the people went that were defended with your hand, seeing your marvellous strange wonders.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:9: For they went at large like horses, and leaped like lambs, praising you, O Yahuah (God), who hadst delivered them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:10: For they were yet mindful of the things that were done while they sojourned in the strange land, how the ground brought forth flies instead of cattle, and how the river cast up a multitude of frogs instead of fishes.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:11: But afterwards they saw a new generation of fowls, when, being led with their appetite, they asked delicate meats.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:12: For quails came up to them from the sea for their contentment.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:13: And punishments came upon the sinners not without former signs by the force of thunders: for they suffered justly according to their own wickedness, insomuch as they used a more hard and hateful behaviour toward strangers.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:14: For the Sodomites did not receive those, whom they knew not when they came: but these brought friends into bondage, that had well deserved of them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:15: And not only so, but perhaps some respect shall be had of those, because they used strangers not friendly:
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:16: But these very grievously afflicted them, whom they had received with feastings, and were already made partakers of the same laws with them.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:17: Therefore even with blindness were these stricken, as those were at the doors of the righteous man: when, being compassed about with horrible great darkness, every one sought the passage of his own doors.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:18: For the elements were changed in themselves by a kind of harmony, like as in a psaltery notes change the name of the tune, and yet are always sounds; which may well be perceived by the sight of the things that have been done.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:19: For earthly things were turned into watery, and the things, that before swam in the water, now went upon the ground.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:20: The fire had power in the water, forgetting his own virtue: and the water forgat his own quenching nature.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:21: On the other side, the flames wasted not the flesh of the corruptible living things, though they walked in it; neither melted they the icy kind of heavenly meat that was of nature apt to melt.
live.apocrypha|the-wisdom-of-solomon|19:22: For in all things, O Yahuah (God), you did magnify your people, and glorify them, neither did you lightly regard them: but did assist them in every time and place.
live.canon|1-john|1:1: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
live.canon|1-john|1:2: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
live.canon|1-john|1:4: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
live.canon|1-john|1:5: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that Elohim (God) is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
live.canon|1-john|1:6: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
live.canon|1-john|1:8: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
live.canon|1-john|1:9: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
live.canon|1-john|1:10: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
live.canon|1-john|1:3: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that you also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
live.canon|1-john|1:7: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) his Son cleanses us from all sin.
live.canon|1-john|2:2: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
live.canon|1-john|2:3: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
live.canon|1-john|2:8: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
live.canon|1-john|2:12: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
live.canon|1-john|2:15: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
live.canon|1-john|2:16: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
live.canon|1-john|2:19: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
live.canon|1-john|2:22: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Messiah (Christ)? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
live.canon|1-john|2:26: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
live.canon|1-john|2:28: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
live.canon|1-john|2:1: My little children, these things write I unto you, that you sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) the righteous:
live.canon|1-john|2:4: He that says, I know him, and keeps not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
live.canon|1-john|2:5: But whoso keeps his word, in him verily is the love of Elohim (God) perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
live.canon|1-john|2:6: He that says he abides in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
live.canon|1-john|2:7: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from the beginning.
live.canon|1-john|2:9: He that says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.
live.canon|1-john|2:10: He that loves his brother abides in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
live.canon|1-john|2:11: But he that hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and knows not whither he goes, because that darkness has blinded his eyes.
live.canon|1-john|2:13: I write unto you, fathers, because you have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because you have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because you have known the Father.
live.canon|1-john|2:14: I have written unto you, fathers, because you have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of Elohim (God) abides in you, and you have overcome the wicked one.
live.canon|1-john|2:17: And the world passes away, and the lust thereof: but he that does the will of Elohim (God) abides for ever.
live.canon|1-john|2:18: Little children, it is the last time: and as you have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
live.canon|1-john|2:20: But you have an unction from the Holy One, and you know all things.
live.canon|1-john|2:21: I have not written unto you because you know not the truth, but because you know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
live.canon|1-john|2:23: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same has not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son has the Father also.
live.canon|1-john|2:24: Let that therefore abide in you, which you have heard from the beginning. If that which you have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, you also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
live.canon|1-john|2:25: And this is the promise that he has promised us, even eternal life.
live.canon|1-john|2:27: But the anointing which you have received of him abides in you, and you need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teaches you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it has taught you, you shall abide in him.
live.canon|1-john|2:29: If you know that he is righteous, you know that every one that does righteousness is born of him.
live.canon|1-john|3:12: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
live.canon|1-john|3:13: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
live.canon|1-john|3:16: Hereby perceive we the love of Elohim (God), because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
live.canon|1-john|3:18: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
live.canon|1-john|3:19: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
live.canon|1-john|3:21: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-john|3:22: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
live.canon|1-john|3:23: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
live.canon|1-john|3:1: Behold, what manner of love the Father has bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of Elohim (God): therefore the world knows us not, because it knew him not.
live.canon|1-john|3:2: Beloved, now are we the sons of Elohim (God), and it does not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
live.canon|1-john|3:3: And every man that has this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
live.canon|1-john|3:9: Whosoever is born of Elohim (God) does not commit sin; for his seed remains in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-john|3:10: In this the children of Elohim (God) are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever does not righteousness is not of Elohim (God), neither he that loves not his brother.
live.canon|1-john|3:11: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
live.canon|1-john|3:14: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death.
live.canon|1-john|3:15: Whosoever hates his brother is a murderer: and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
live.canon|1-john|3:17: But whoso has this world’s good, and sees his brother have need, and shuts up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwells the love of Elohim (God) in him?
live.canon|1-john|3:20: For if our heart condemn us, Elohim (God) is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
live.canon|1-john|3:24: And he that keeps his commandments dwells in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abides in us, by the Spirit which he has given us.
live.canon|1-john|3:5: And you know that he was revealed to take our sins away — and in him there is no sin at all.
live.canon|1-john|3:6: No one who remains in him goes on sinning; whoever keeps on sinning has neither seen him nor come to know him.
live.canon|1-john|3:7: Little children, do not let anyone lead you astray: whoever practices righteousness is righteous, just as he is righteous.
live.canon|1-john|3:8: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.
live.canon|1-john|3:4: Everyone who goes on sinning is living in lawlessness; for sin is the transgression of the law.
live.canon|1-john|4:1: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of Elohim (God): because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
live.canon|1-john|4:9: In this was manifested the love of Elohim (God) toward us, because that Elohim (God) sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
live.canon|1-john|4:10: Herein is love, not that we loved Elohim (God), but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
live.canon|1-john|4:11: Beloved, if Elohim (God) so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
live.canon|1-john|4:14: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
live.canon|1-john|4:17: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
live.canon|1-john|4:19: We love him, because he first loved us.
live.canon|1-john|4:2: Hereby know you the Spirit of Elohim (God): Every spirit that confesseth that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is come in the flesh is of Elohim (God):
live.canon|1-john|4:3: And every spirit that confesseth not that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is come in the flesh is not of Elohim (God): and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof you have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
live.canon|1-john|4:4: You are of Elohim (God), little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
live.canon|1-john|4:5: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world hears them.
live.canon|1-john|4:6: We are of Elohim (God): he that knows Elohim (God) hears us; he that is not of Elohim (God) hears not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
live.canon|1-john|4:7: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of Elohim (God); and every one that loves is born of Elohim (God), and knows Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-john|4:8: He that loves not knows not Elohim (God); for Elohim (God) is love.
live.canon|1-john|4:12: No man has seen Elohim (God) at any time. If we love one another, Elohim (God) dwells in us, and his love is perfected in us.
live.canon|1-john|4:13: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
live.canon|1-john|4:15: Whosoever shall confess that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Son of Elohim (God), Elohim (God) dwells in him, and he in Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-john|4:16: And we have known and believed the love that Elohim (God) has to us. Elohim (God) is love; and he that dwells in love dwells in Elohim (God), and Elohim (God) in him.
live.canon|1-john|4:18: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear: because fear has torment. He that fears is not made perfect in love.
live.canon|1-john|4:20: If a man say, I love Elohim (God), and hates his brother, he is a liar: for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love Elohim (God) whom he has not seen?
live.canon|1-john|4:21: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loves Elohim (God) love his brother also.
live.canon|1-john|5:2: By this we know that we love the children of Elohim (God), when we love Elohim (God), and keep his commandments.
live.canon|1-john|5:3: For this is the love of Elohim (God), that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
live.canon|1-john|5:7: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit): and these three are one.
live.canon|1-john|5:8: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
live.canon|1-john|5:15: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
live.canon|1-john|5:16: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
live.canon|1-john|5:17: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
live.canon|1-john|5:21: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
live.canon|1-john|5:1: Whosoever believes that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Messiah (Christ) is born of Elohim (God): and every one that loves him that begat loves him also that is begotten of him.
live.canon|1-john|5:4: For whatsoever is born of Elohim (God) overcomes the world: and this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith.
live.canon|1-john|5:5: Who is he that overcomes the world, but he that believes that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Son of Elohim (God)?
live.canon|1-john|5:6: This is he that came by water and blood, even Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ); not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.
live.canon|1-john|5:9: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of Elohim (God) is greater: for this is the witness of Elohim (God) which he has testified of his Son.
live.canon|1-john|5:10: He that believes on the Son of Elohim (God) has the witness in himself: he that believes not Elohim (God) has made him a liar; because he believes not the record that Elohim (God) gave of his Son.
live.canon|1-john|5:11: And this is the record, that Elohim (God) has given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
live.canon|1-john|5:12: He that has the Son has life; and he that has not the Son of Elohim (God) has not life.
live.canon|1-john|5:13: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of Elohim (God); that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may believe on the name of the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-john|5:14: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he hears us:
live.canon|1-john|5:18: We know that whosoever is born of Elohim (God) sins not; but he that is begotten of Elohim (God) keeps himself, and that wicked one touches him not.
live.canon|1-john|5:19: And we know that we are of Elohim (God), and the whole world lies in wickedness.
live.canon|1-john|5:20: And we know that the Son of Elohim (God) is come, and has given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ). This is the true Elohim (God), and eternal life.
live.canon|1-kings|1:2: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
live.canon|1-kings|1:6: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why have you done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
live.canon|1-kings|1:11: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith does reign, and David our lord knows it not?
live.canon|1-kings|1:12: Now therefore come, let me, I pray you, give you counsel, that you may save your own life, and the life of your son Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|1:13: Go and get you in unto king David, and say unto him, Did not you, my lord, O king, swear unto your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then does Adonijah reign?
live.canon|1-kings|1:14: Behold, while you yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after you, and confirm your words.
live.canon|1-kings|1:16: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What would you?
live.canon|1-kings|1:17: And she said unto him, My lord, you swore by Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) unto your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
live.canon|1-kings|1:18: And now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and now, my lord the king, you know it not:
live.canon|1-kings|1:19: And he has slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon your servant has he not called.
live.canon|1-kings|1:20: And you, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Yashar'el (Israel) are upon you, that you should tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
live.canon|1-kings|1:24: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, have you said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
live.canon|1-kings|1:25: For he is gone down this day, and has slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, Elohim (God) save king Adonijah.
live.canon|1-kings|1:26: But me, even me your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, has he not called.
live.canon|1-kings|1:27: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and you have not shewed it unto your servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
live.canon|1-kings|1:29: And the king sware, and said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, that has redeemed my soul out of all distress,
live.canon|1-kings|1:30: Even as I sware unto you by Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
live.canon|1-kings|1:33: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
live.canon|1-kings|1:34: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Yashar'el (Israel): and blow you with the trumpet, and say, Elohim (God) save king Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|1:35: Then you shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Yashar'el (Israel) and over Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|1-kings|1:37: As Yahuah (LORD) has been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
live.canon|1-kings|1:42: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for you are a valiant man, and bring good tidings.
live.canon|1-kings|1:43: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David has made Solomon king.
live.canon|1-kings|1:44: And the king has sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:
live.canon|1-kings|1:45: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
live.canon|1-kings|1:47: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, Elohim (God) make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
live.canon|1-kings|1:48: And also thus said the king, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which has given one to sit on my throne this day, my eyes even seeing it.
live.canon|1-kings|1:51: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah fears king Solomon: for, lo, he has caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
live.canon|1-kings|1:53: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to your house.
live.canon|1-kings|1:1: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
live.canon|1-kings|1:3: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
live.canon|1-kings|1:4: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
live.canon|1-kings|1:5: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
live.canon|1-kings|1:7: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
live.canon|1-kings|1:8: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
live.canon|1-kings|1:9: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Yahudah (Judah) the king’s servants:
live.canon|1-kings|1:10: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
live.canon|1-kings|1:15: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
live.canon|1-kings|1:21: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
live.canon|1-kings|1:22: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
live.canon|1-kings|1:23: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
live.canon|1-kings|1:28: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
live.canon|1-kings|1:31: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
live.canon|1-kings|1:32: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
live.canon|1-kings|1:36: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of my lord the king say so too.
live.canon|1-kings|1:38: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
live.canon|1-kings|1:39: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, Elohim (God) save king Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|1:40: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
live.canon|1-kings|1:41: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
live.canon|1-kings|1:49: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
live.canon|1-kings|1:50: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
live.canon|1-kings|1:52: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
live.canon|1-kings|1:46: And also Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
live.canon|1-kings|2:2: I go the way of all the earth: be you strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
live.canon|1-kings|2:3: And keep the charge of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do, and whithersoever you turn thyself:
live.canon|1-kings|2:4: That Yahuah (LORD) may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If your children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you (said he) a man on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|2:5: Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Yashar'el (Israel), unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
live.canon|1-kings|2:6: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
live.canon|1-kings|2:7: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at your table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom your brother.
live.canon|1-kings|2:8: And, behold, you have with you Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by Yahuah (LORD), saying, I will not put you to death with the sword.
live.canon|1-kings|2:9: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for you are a wise man, and know what you oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring you down to the grave with blood.
live.canon|1-kings|2:13: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Come you peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
live.canon|1-kings|2:14: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto you. And she said, Say on.
live.canon|1-kings|2:15: And he said, You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Yashar'el (Israel) set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|2:16: And now I ask one petition of you, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
live.canon|1-kings|2:17: And he said, Speak, I pray you, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say you nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
live.canon|1-kings|2:20: Then she said, I desire one small petition of you; I pray you, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say you nay.
live.canon|1-kings|2:21: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother to wife.
live.canon|1-kings|2:22: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
live.canon|1-kings|2:24: Now therefore, as Yahuah (LORD) lives, which has established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who has made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
live.canon|1-kings|2:26: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, unto your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you barest the ark of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) before David my father, and because you have been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
live.canon|1-kings|2:30: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD), and said unto him, Thus says the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
live.canon|1-kings|2:31: And the king said unto him, Do as he has said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that you may take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
live.canon|1-kings|2:36: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build you an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
live.canon|1-kings|2:37: For it shall be, that on the day you go out, and passest over the brook Kidron, you shall know for certain that you shall surely die: your blood shall be upon your own head.
live.canon|1-kings|2:38: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
live.canon|1-kings|2:39: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, your servants be in Gath.
live.canon|1-kings|2:42: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make you to swear by Yahuah (LORD), and protested unto you, saying, Know for a certain, on the day you go out, and walk abroad any whither, that you shall surely die? and you saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
live.canon|1-kings|2:44: The king said moreover to Shimei, You know all the wickedness which your heart is privy to, that you did to David my father: therefore Yahuah (LORD) shall return your wickedness upon your own head;
live.canon|1-kings|2:1: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|2:10: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
live.canon|1-kings|2:11: And the days that David reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
live.canon|1-kings|2:12: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
live.canon|1-kings|2:19: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
live.canon|1-kings|2:23: Then king Solomon sware by Yahuah (LORD), saying, Elohim (God) do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
live.canon|1-kings|2:25: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
live.canon|1-kings|2:27: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto Yahuah (LORD); that he might fulfil the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
live.canon|1-kings|2:18: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for you unto the king.
live.canon|1-kings|2:28: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD), and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
live.canon|1-kings|2:29: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD); and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
live.canon|1-kings|2:32: And Yahuah (LORD) shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Yashar'el (Israel), and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|1-kings|2:33: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|2:34: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
live.canon|1-kings|2:35: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
live.canon|1-kings|2:40: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
live.canon|1-kings|2:41: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
live.canon|1-kings|2:45: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before Yahuah (LORD) for ever.
live.canon|1-kings|2:46: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|2:43: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahuah (LORD), and the commandment that I have charged you with?
live.canon|1-kings|3:5: In Gibeon Yahuah (LORD) appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and Elohim (God) said, Ask what I shall give you.
live.canon|1-kings|3:6: And Solomon said, You have shewed unto your servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before you in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you; and you have kept for him this great kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
live.canon|1-kings|3:7: And now, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), you have made your servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
live.canon|1-kings|3:8: And your servant is in the midst of your people which you have chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
live.canon|1-kings|3:9: Give therefore your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this your so great a people?
live.canon|1-kings|3:11: And Elohim (God) said unto him, Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for thyself long life; neither have asked riches for thyself, nor have asked the life of your enemies; but have asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
live.canon|1-kings|3:12: Behold, I have done according to your words: lo, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like unto you.
live.canon|1-kings|3:13: And I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto you all your days.
live.canon|1-kings|3:14: And if you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David did walk, then I will lengthen your days.
live.canon|1-kings|3:20: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while your handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
live.canon|1-kings|3:22: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is your son. And this said, No; but the dead is your son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
live.canon|1-kings|3:23: Then said the king, The one says, This is my son that lives, and your son is the dead: and the other says, Nay; but your son is the dead, and my son is the living.
live.canon|1-kings|3:26: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither my nor yours, but divide it.
live.canon|1-kings|3:1: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
live.canon|1-kings|3:2: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of Yahuah (LORD), until those days.
