live.canon|1-kings|3:3: And Solomon loved Yahuah (LORD), walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
live.canon|1-kings|3:4: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
live.canon|1-kings|3:15: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
live.canon|1-kings|3:16: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
live.canon|1-kings|3:17: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
live.canon|1-kings|3:18: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
live.canon|1-kings|3:19: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
live.canon|1-kings|3:21: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
live.canon|1-kings|3:24: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
live.canon|1-kings|3:25: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
live.canon|1-kings|3:27: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
live.canon|1-kings|3:28: And all Yashar'el (Israel) heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of Elohim (God) was in him, to do judgment.
live.canon|1-kings|3:10: And the speech pleased Adonai (Lord), that Solomon had asked this thing.
live.canon|1-kings|4:1: So king Solomon was king over all Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|4:2: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
live.canon|1-kings|4:3: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
live.canon|1-kings|4:4: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
live.canon|1-kings|4:5: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king’s friend:
live.canon|1-kings|4:6: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
live.canon|1-kings|4:7: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Yashar'el (Israel), which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
live.canon|1-kings|4:8: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
live.canon|1-kings|4:9: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan:
live.canon|1-kings|4:10: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
live.canon|1-kings|4:11: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
live.canon|1-kings|4:12: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
live.canon|1-kings|4:13: The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
live.canon|1-kings|4:14: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
live.canon|1-kings|4:15: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
live.canon|1-kings|4:16: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
live.canon|1-kings|4:17: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
live.canon|1-kings|4:18: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
live.canon|1-kings|4:19: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
live.canon|1-kings|4:20: Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel) were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
live.canon|1-kings|4:21: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
live.canon|1-kings|4:22: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
live.canon|1-kings|4:23: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
live.canon|1-kings|4:24: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
live.canon|1-kings|4:25: And Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|4:26: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
live.canon|1-kings|4:27: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
live.canon|1-kings|4:28: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
live.canon|1-kings|4:29: And Elohim (God) gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
live.canon|1-kings|4:30: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
live.canon|1-kings|4:31: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
live.canon|1-kings|4:32: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
live.canon|1-kings|4:33: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
live.canon|1-kings|4:34: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
live.canon|1-kings|5:3: You know how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) for the wars which were about him on every side, until Yahuah (LORD) put them under the soles of his feet.
live.canon|1-kings|5:4: But now Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) has given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
live.canon|1-kings|5:5: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God), as Yahuah (LORD) spake unto David my father, saying, Your son, whom I will set upon your throne in your room, he shall build an house unto my name.
live.canon|1-kings|5:6: Now therefore command you that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with your servants: and unto you will I give hire for your servants according to all that you shall appoint: for you know that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
live.canon|1-kings|5:7: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) this day, which has given unto David a wise son over this great people.
live.canon|1-kings|5:8: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which you sentest to me for: and I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
live.canon|1-kings|5:9: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that you shall appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and you shall receive them: and you shall accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
live.canon|1-kings|5:1: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
live.canon|1-kings|5:2: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|5:10: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
live.canon|1-kings|5:11: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
live.canon|1-kings|5:12: And Yahuah (LORD) gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
live.canon|1-kings|5:13: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Yashar'el (Israel); and the levy was thirty thousand men.
live.canon|1-kings|5:14: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
live.canon|1-kings|5:15: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
live.canon|1-kings|5:16: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
live.canon|1-kings|5:17: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
live.canon|1-kings|5:18: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
live.canon|1-kings|6:12: Concerning this house which you are in building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with you, which I spake unto David your father:
live.canon|1-kings|6:1: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Yashar'el (Israel), in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|6:2: And the house which king Solomon built for Yahuah (LORD), the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
live.canon|1-kings|6:3: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
live.canon|1-kings|6:4: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
live.canon|1-kings|6:5: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
live.canon|1-kings|6:6: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
live.canon|1-kings|6:7: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
live.canon|1-kings|6:8: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
live.canon|1-kings|6:9: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
live.canon|1-kings|6:10: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
live.canon|1-kings|6:11: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Solomon, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|6:13: And I will dwell among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and will not forsake my people Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|6:14: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
live.canon|1-kings|6:15: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
live.canon|1-kings|6:16: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
live.canon|1-kings|6:17: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
live.canon|1-kings|6:18: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
live.canon|1-kings|6:19: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|6:20: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
live.canon|1-kings|6:21: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
live.canon|1-kings|6:22: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
live.canon|1-kings|6:23: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
live.canon|1-kings|6:24: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
live.canon|1-kings|6:25: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
live.canon|1-kings|6:26: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
live.canon|1-kings|6:27: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
live.canon|1-kings|6:28: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
live.canon|1-kings|6:29: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
live.canon|1-kings|6:30: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
live.canon|1-kings|6:31: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
live.canon|1-kings|6:32: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
live.canon|1-kings|6:33: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
live.canon|1-kings|6:34: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
live.canon|1-kings|6:35: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
live.canon|1-kings|6:36: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
live.canon|1-kings|6:37: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of Yahuah (LORD) laid, in the month Zif:
live.canon|1-kings|6:38: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
live.canon|1-kings|7:1: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
live.canon|1-kings|7:2: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
live.canon|1-kings|7:3: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
live.canon|1-kings|7:4: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
live.canon|1-kings|7:5: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
live.canon|1-kings|7:6: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
live.canon|1-kings|7:7: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
live.canon|1-kings|7:8: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
live.canon|1-kings|7:9: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
live.canon|1-kings|7:10: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
live.canon|1-kings|7:11: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
live.canon|1-kings|7:12: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and for the porch of the house.
live.canon|1-kings|7:13: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
live.canon|1-kings|7:14: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
live.canon|1-kings|7:15: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
live.canon|1-kings|7:16: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
live.canon|1-kings|7:17: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
live.canon|1-kings|7:18: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
live.canon|1-kings|7:19: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
live.canon|1-kings|7:20: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
live.canon|1-kings|7:21: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
live.canon|1-kings|7:22: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
live.canon|1-kings|7:23: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
live.canon|1-kings|7:24: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
live.canon|1-kings|7:25: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
live.canon|1-kings|7:26: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
live.canon|1-kings|7:27: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
live.canon|1-kings|7:28: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
live.canon|1-kings|7:29: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
live.canon|1-kings|7:30: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
live.canon|1-kings|7:31: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
live.canon|1-kings|7:32: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
live.canon|1-kings|7:33: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
live.canon|1-kings|7:34: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
live.canon|1-kings|7:35: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
live.canon|1-kings|7:36: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
live.canon|1-kings|7:37: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
live.canon|1-kings|7:38: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
live.canon|1-kings|7:39: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
live.canon|1-kings|7:40: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|1-kings|7:41: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
live.canon|1-kings|7:42: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
live.canon|1-kings|7:43: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
live.canon|1-kings|7:44: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
live.canon|1-kings|7:45: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of Yahuah (LORD), were of bright brass.
live.canon|1-kings|7:46: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
live.canon|1-kings|7:47: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
live.canon|1-kings|7:48: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of Yahuah (LORD): the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
live.canon|1-kings|7:49: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
live.canon|1-kings|7:50: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
live.canon|1-kings|7:51: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of Yahuah (LORD). And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|8:15: And he said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|8:18: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto David my father, Whereas it was in your heart to build an house unto my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
live.canon|1-kings|8:19: Nevertheless you shall not build the house; but your son that shall come forth out of your loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
live.canon|1-kings|8:20: And Yahuah (LORD) has performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel), as Yahuah (LORD) promised, and have built an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|8:23: And he said, Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), there is no Elohim (God) like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with your servants that walk before you with all their heart:
live.canon|1-kings|8:24: Who have kept with your servant David my father that you promisedst him: you spoke also with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is this day.
live.canon|1-kings|8:25: Therefore now, Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), keep with your servant David my father that you promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel); so that your children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as you have walked before me.
live.canon|1-kings|8:26: And now, O Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), let your word, I pray you, be verified, which you spoke unto your servant David my father.
live.canon|1-kings|8:27: But will Elohim (God) indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain you; how much less this house that I have builded?
live.canon|1-kings|8:28: Yet have you respect unto the prayer of your servant, and to his supplication, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which your servant prayeth before you to day:
live.canon|1-kings|8:29: That your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, My name shall be there: that you may hearken unto the prayer which your servant shall make toward this place.
live.canon|1-kings|8:30: And hearken you to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Yashar'el (Israel), when they shall pray toward this place: and hear you in heaven your dwelling place: and when you hear, forgive.
live.canon|1-kings|8:31: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before your altar in this house:
live.canon|1-kings|8:32: Then hear you in heaven, and do, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
live.canon|1-kings|8:33: When your people Yashar'el (Israel) be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against you, and shall turn again to you, and confess your name, and pray, and make supplication unto you in this house:
live.canon|1-kings|8:34: Then hear you in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Yashar'el (Israel), and bring them again unto the land which you gave unto their fathers.
live.canon|1-kings|8:35: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; if they pray toward this place, and confess your name, and turn from their sin, when you afflictest them:
live.canon|1-kings|8:36: Then hear you in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Yashar'el (Israel), that you teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.
live.canon|1-kings|8:38: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all your people Yashar'el (Israel), which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
live.canon|1-kings|8:39: Then hear you in heaven your dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart you know; (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men;)
live.canon|1-kings|8:40: That they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave unto our fathers.
live.canon|1-kings|8:41: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of your people Yashar'el (Israel), but comes out of a far country for your name’s sake;
live.canon|1-kings|8:42: (For they shall hear of your great name, and of your strong hand, and of your stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
live.canon|1-kings|8:43: Hear you in heaven your dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calls to you for: that all people of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Yashar'el (Israel); and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by your name.
live.canon|1-kings|8:44: If your people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever you shall send them, and shall pray unto Yahuah (LORD) toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house that I have built for your name:
live.canon|1-kings|8:46: If they sin against you, (for there is no man that sins not,) and you be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
live.canon|1-kings|8:47: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto you in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
live.canon|1-kings|8:48: And so return unto you with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto you toward their land, which you gave unto their fathers, the city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name:
live.canon|1-kings|8:51: For they be your people, and your inheritance, which you brought forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
live.canon|1-kings|8:52: That your eyes may be open unto the supplication of your servant, and unto the supplication of your people Yashar'el (Israel), to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto you.
live.canon|1-kings|8:56: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), that has given rest unto his people Yashar'el (Israel), according to all that he promised: there has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
live.canon|1-kings|8:1: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) out of the city of David, which is Zion.
live.canon|1-kings|8:2: And all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
live.canon|1-kings|8:3: And all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) came, and the priests took up the ark.
live.canon|1-kings|8:4: And they brought up the ark of Yahuah (LORD), and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
live.canon|1-kings|8:5: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
live.canon|1-kings|8:6: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
live.canon|1-kings|8:7: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
live.canon|1-kings|8:8: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
live.canon|1-kings|8:9: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahuah (LORD) made a covenant with the children of Yashar'el (Israel), when they came out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|1-kings|8:10: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of Yahuah (LORD),
live.canon|1-kings|8:11: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of Yahuah (LORD) had filled the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|8:12: Then spake Solomon, Yahuah (LORD) said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
live.canon|1-kings|8:14: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel): (and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) stood;)
live.canon|1-kings|8:13: I have surely built you an house to dwell in, a settled place for you to abide in for ever.
live.canon|1-kings|8:16: Since the day that I brought forth my people Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|8:17: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|8:21: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|1-kings|8:22: And Solomon stood before the altar of Yahuah (LORD) in the presence of all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
live.canon|1-kings|8:37: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
live.canon|1-kings|8:45: Then hear you in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
live.canon|1-kings|8:54: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto Yahuah (LORD), he arose from before the altar of Yahuah (LORD), from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
live.canon|1-kings|8:55: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) with a loud voice, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|8:57: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
live.canon|1-kings|8:58: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
live.canon|1-kings|8:59: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before Yahuah (LORD), be nigh unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Yashar'el (Israel) at all times, as the matter shall require:
live.canon|1-kings|8:60: That all the people of the earth may know that Yahuah (LORD) is Elohim (God), and that there is none else.
live.canon|1-kings|8:61: Let your heart therefore be perfect with Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
live.canon|1-kings|8:62: And the king, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, offered sacrifice before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|8:63: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto Yahuah (LORD), two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) dedicated the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|8:64: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of Yahuah (LORD): for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before Yahuah (LORD) was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
live.canon|1-kings|8:65: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
live.canon|1-kings|8:66: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that Yahuah (LORD) had done for David his servant, and for Yashar'el (Israel) his people.
live.canon|1-kings|8:49: Then hear you their prayer and their supplication in heaven your dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
live.canon|1-kings|8:50: And forgive your people that have sinned against you, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against you, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
live.canon|1-kings|8:53: For you did separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be your inheritance, as you spoke by the hand of Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, O Adonai (Lord) GOD.
live.canon|1-kings|9:3: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, I have heard your prayer and your supplication, that you have made before me: I have hallowed this house, which you have built, to put my name there for ever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.
live.canon|1-kings|9:4: And if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my judgments:
live.canon|1-kings|9:5: Then I will establish the throne of your kingdom upon Yashar'el (Israel) for ever, as I promised to David your father, saying, There shall not fail you a man upon the throne of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|9:6: But if you shall at all turn from following me, you or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
live.canon|1-kings|9:8: And at this house, which is high, every one that passes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why has Yahuah (LORD) done thus unto this land, and to this house?
live.canon|1-kings|9:9: And they shall answer, Because they forsook Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore has Yahuah (LORD) brought upon them all this evil.
live.canon|1-kings|9:13: And he said, What cities are these which you have given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
live.canon|1-kings|9:1: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,
live.canon|1-kings|9:2: That Yahuah (LORD) appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
live.canon|1-kings|9:7: Then will I cut off Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
live.canon|1-kings|9:10: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house,
live.canon|1-kings|9:11: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
live.canon|1-kings|9:12: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
live.canon|1-kings|9:14: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
live.canon|1-kings|9:15: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of Yahuah (LORD), and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
live.canon|1-kings|9:16: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
live.canon|1-kings|9:17: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,
live.canon|1-kings|9:18: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
live.canon|1-kings|9:19: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
live.canon|1-kings|9:20: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Yashar'el (Israel),
live.canon|1-kings|9:21: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Yashar'el (Israel) also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
live.canon|1-kings|9:22: But of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
live.canon|1-kings|9:23: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
live.canon|1-kings|9:24: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
live.canon|1-kings|9:25: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto Yahuah (LORD), and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before Yahuah (LORD). So he finished the house.
live.canon|1-kings|9:26: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
live.canon|1-kings|9:27: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|9:28: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|10:6: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
live.canon|1-kings|10:7: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and my eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: your wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
live.canon|1-kings|10:8: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants, which stand continually before you, and that hear your wisdom.
live.canon|1-kings|10:9: Blessed be Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel): because Yahuah (LORD) loved Yashar'el (Israel) for ever, therefore made he you king, to do judgment and justice.
live.canon|1-kings|10:1: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of Yahuah (LORD), she came to prove him with hard questions.
live.canon|1-kings|10:2: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
live.canon|1-kings|10:3: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
live.canon|1-kings|10:4: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,
live.canon|1-kings|10:5: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of Yahuah (LORD); there was no more spirit in her.
live.canon|1-kings|10:10: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|10:11: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
live.canon|1-kings|10:12: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of Yahuah (LORD), and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
live.canon|1-kings|10:13: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
live.canon|1-kings|10:14: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
live.canon|1-kings|10:15: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
live.canon|1-kings|10:16: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
live.canon|1-kings|10:17: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
live.canon|1-kings|10:18: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
live.canon|1-kings|10:19: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
live.canon|1-kings|10:20: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
live.canon|1-kings|10:21: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|10:22: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
live.canon|1-kings|10:23: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
live.canon|1-kings|10:24: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which Elohim (God) had put in his heart.
live.canon|1-kings|10:25: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
live.canon|1-kings|10:26: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
live.canon|1-kings|10:27: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
live.canon|1-kings|10:28: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
live.canon|1-kings|10:29: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
live.canon|1-kings|11:11: Wherefore Yahuah (LORD) said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely rend the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
live.canon|1-kings|11:12: Notwithstanding in your days I will not do it for David your father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of your son.
live.canon|1-kings|11:13: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to your son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.
live.canon|1-kings|11:21: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.
live.canon|1-kings|11:22: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what have you lacked with me, that, behold, you seek to go to your own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
live.canon|1-kings|11:31: And he said to Jeroboam, Take you ten pieces: for thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to you:
live.canon|1-kings|11:33: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
live.canon|1-kings|11:35: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto you, even ten tribes.
live.canon|1-kings|11:37: And I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|11:38: And it shall be, if you will hearken unto all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with you, and build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Yashar'el (Israel) unto you.
live.canon|1-kings|11:1: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
live.canon|1-kings|11:3: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
live.canon|1-kings|11:4: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), as was the heart of David his father.
live.canon|1-kings|11:5: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
live.canon|1-kings|11:6: And Solomon did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and went not fully after Yahuah (LORD), as did David his father.
live.canon|1-kings|11:7: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
live.canon|1-kings|11:8: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
live.canon|1-kings|11:9: And Yahuah (LORD) was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which had appeared unto him twice,
live.canon|1-kings|11:10: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which Yahuah (LORD) commanded.
live.canon|1-kings|11:14: And Yahuah (LORD) stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.
live.canon|1-kings|11:15: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
live.canon|1-kings|11:16: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Yashar'el (Israel), until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
live.canon|1-kings|11:17: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
live.canon|1-kings|11:18: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
live.canon|1-kings|11:19: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
live.canon|1-kings|11:20: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
live.canon|1-kings|11:23: And Elohim (God) stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
live.canon|1-kings|11:24: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
live.canon|1-kings|11:25: And he was an adversary to Yashar'el (Israel) all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Yashar'el (Israel), and reigned over Syria.
live.canon|1-kings|11:26: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
live.canon|1-kings|11:27: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
live.canon|1-kings|11:28: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
live.canon|1-kings|11:2: Of the nations concerning which Yahuah (LORD) said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
live.canon|1-kings|11:29: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
live.canon|1-kings|11:30: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
live.canon|1-kings|11:32: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel):)
live.canon|1-kings|11:34: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
live.canon|1-kings|11:36: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
live.canon|1-kings|11:39: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
live.canon|1-kings|11:40: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|11:41: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
live.canon|1-kings|11:42: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Yashar'el (Israel) was forty years.
live.canon|1-kings|11:43: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|12:4: Your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make you the grievous service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve you.
live.canon|1-kings|12:6: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do you advise that I may answer this people?
live.canon|1-kings|12:7: And they spake unto him, saying, If you will be a servant unto this people this day, and will serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants for ever.
live.canon|1-kings|12:9: And he said unto them, What counsel give you that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which your father did put upon us lighter?
live.canon|1-kings|12:10: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shall you speak unto this people that spake unto you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but make you it lighter unto us; thus shall you say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
live.canon|1-kings|12:11: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father has chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
live.canon|1-kings|12:16: So when all Yashar'el (Israel) saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Yashar'el (Israel): now see to your own house, David. So Yashar'el (Israel) departed unto their tents.
live.canon|1-kings|12:24: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), You shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Yashar'el (Israel): return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of Yahuah (LORD), and returned to depart, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|12:28: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold your gods, O Yashar'el (Israel), which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|1-kings|12:1: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Yashar'el (Israel) were come to Shechem to make him king.
live.canon|1-kings|12:2: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
live.canon|1-kings|12:3: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|12:5: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
live.canon|1-kings|12:8: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
live.canon|1-kings|12:12: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
live.canon|1-kings|12:13: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;
live.canon|1-kings|12:14: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
live.canon|1-kings|12:15: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from Yahuah (LORD), that he might perform his saying, which Yahuah (LORD) spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
live.canon|1-kings|12:17: But as for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) which dwelt in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), Rehoboam reigned over them.
live.canon|1-kings|12:18: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Yashar'el (Israel) stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
live.canon|1-kings|12:19: So Yashar'el (Israel) rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
live.canon|1-kings|12:20: And it came to pass, when all Yashar'el (Israel) heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Yashar'el (Israel): there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) only.
live.canon|1-kings|12:21: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Yahudah (Judah), with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Yashar'el (Israel), to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
live.canon|1-kings|12:22: But the word of Elohim (God) came unto Shemaiah the man of Elohim (God), saying,
live.canon|1-kings|12:23: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Yahudah (Judah), and unto all the house of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|12:25: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
live.canon|1-kings|12:26: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
live.canon|1-kings|12:27: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of Yahuah (LORD) at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Yahudah (Judah), and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|1-kings|12:29: And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.
live.canon|1-kings|12:30: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
live.canon|1-kings|12:31: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
live.canon|1-kings|12:32: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Yahudah (Judah), and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Beth-el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places which he had made.
live.canon|1-kings|12:33: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
live.canon|1-kings|13:2: And he cried against the altar in the word of Yahuah (LORD), and said, O altar, altar, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon you shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon you, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon you.
live.canon|1-kings|13:7: And the king said unto the man of Elohim (God), Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give you a reward.
live.canon|1-kings|13:8: And the man of Elohim (God) said unto the king, If you will give me half your house, I will not go in with you, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
live.canon|1-kings|13:9: For so was it charged me by the word of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that you came.
live.canon|1-kings|13:14: And went after the man of Elohim (God), and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Are you the man of Elohim (God) that came from Yahudah (Judah)? And he said, I am.
live.canon|1-kings|13:16: And he said, I may not return with you, nor go in with you: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with you in this place:
live.canon|1-kings|13:17: For it was said to me by the word of Yahuah (LORD), You shall eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that you came.
live.canon|1-kings|13:18: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as you are; and an angel spake unto me by the word of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
live.canon|1-kings|13:21: And he cried unto the man of Elohim (God) that came from Yahudah (Judah), saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Forasmuch as you have disobeyed the mouth of Yahuah (LORD), and have not kept the commandment which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) commanded you,
live.canon|1-kings|13:22: But came back, and have eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which Yahuah (LORD) did say to you, Eat no bread, and drink no water; your carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of your fathers.
live.canon|1-kings|13:26: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of Elohim (God), who was disobedient unto the word of Yahuah (LORD): therefore Yahuah (LORD) has delivered him unto the lion, which has torn him, and slain him, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake unto him.
live.canon|1-kings|13:1: And, behold, there came a man of Elohim (God) out of Yahudah (Judah) by the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
live.canon|1-kings|13:4: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of Elohim (God), which had cried against the altar in Beth-el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
live.canon|1-kings|13:5: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of Elohim (God) had given by the word of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|13:6: And the king answered and said unto the man of Elohim (God), Intreat now the face of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of Elohim (God) besought Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
live.canon|1-kings|13:10: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.
live.canon|1-kings|13:11: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of Elohim (God) had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
live.canon|1-kings|13:12: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of Elohim (God) went, which came from Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|1-kings|13:13: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
live.canon|1-kings|13:15: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
live.canon|1-kings|13:19: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
live.canon|1-kings|13:20: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto the prophet that brought him back:
live.canon|1-kings|13:23: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
live.canon|1-kings|13:24: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
live.canon|1-kings|13:25: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
live.canon|1-kings|13:27: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
live.canon|1-kings|13:28: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
live.canon|1-kings|13:29: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of Elohim (God), and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
live.canon|1-kings|13:30: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
live.canon|1-kings|13:31: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of Elohim (God) is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
live.canon|1-kings|13:3: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which Yahuah (LORD) has spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
live.canon|1-kings|13:32: For the saying which he cried by the word of Yahuah (LORD) against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
live.canon|1-kings|13:33: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
live.canon|1-kings|13:34: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
live.canon|1-kings|14:3: And take with you ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell you what shall become of the child.
live.canon|1-kings|14:5: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam comes to ask a thing of you for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shall you say unto her: for it shall be, when she comes in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
live.canon|1-kings|14:6: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, you wife of Jeroboam; why feignest you thyself to be another? for I am sent to you with heavy tidings.
live.canon|1-kings|14:7: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Forasmuch as I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Yashar'el (Israel),
live.canon|1-kings|14:8: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it you: and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes;
live.canon|1-kings|14:9: But have done evil above all that were before you: for you have gone and made you other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back:
live.canon|1-kings|14:10: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Yashar'el (Israel), and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man takes away dung, till it be all gone.
live.canon|1-kings|14:11: Him that dies of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dies in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
live.canon|1-kings|14:12: Arise you therefore, get you to your own house: and when your feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
live.canon|1-kings|14:1: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
live.canon|1-kings|14:4: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
live.canon|1-kings|14:13: And all Yashar'el (Israel) shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) in the house of Jeroboam.
live.canon|1-kings|14:14: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) shall raise him up a king over Yashar'el (Israel), who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
live.canon|1-kings|14:15: For Yahuah (LORD) shall smite Yashar'el (Israel), as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Yashar'el (Israel) out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking Yahuah (LORD) to anger.
live.canon|1-kings|14:16: And he shall give Yashar'el (Israel) up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
live.canon|1-kings|14:17: And Jeroboam’s wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
live.canon|1-kings|14:18: And they buried him; and all Yashar'el (Israel) mourned for him, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
live.canon|1-kings|14:19: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|14:20: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|14:21: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Yahudah (Judah). Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahuah (LORD) did choose out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
live.canon|1-kings|14:22: And Yahudah (Judah) did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
live.canon|1-kings|14:23: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
live.canon|1-kings|14:24: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahuah (LORD) cast out before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|14:25: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
live.canon|1-kings|14:26: And he took away the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
live.canon|1-kings|14:27: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.
live.canon|1-kings|14:28: And it was so, when the king went into the house of Yahuah (LORD), that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
live.canon|1-kings|14:29: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
live.canon|1-kings|14:2: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray you, and disguise thyself, that you be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get you to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
live.canon|1-kings|14:30: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
live.canon|1-kings|14:31: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|15:1: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|1-kings|15:2: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
live.canon|1-kings|15:3: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), as the heart of David his father.
live.canon|1-kings|15:4: Nevertheless for David’s sake did Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
live.canon|1-kings|15:5: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
live.canon|1-kings|15:6: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
live.canon|1-kings|15:7: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
live.canon|1-kings|15:8: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|15:9: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Yashar'el (Israel) reigned Asa over Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|1-kings|15:10: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
live.canon|1-kings|15:11: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), as did David his father.
live.canon|1-kings|15:12: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
live.canon|1-kings|15:13: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
live.canon|1-kings|15:14: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with Yahuah (LORD) all his days.
live.canon|1-kings|15:15: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of Yahuah (LORD), silver, and gold, and vessels.
live.canon|1-kings|15:16: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel) all their days.
live.canon|1-kings|15:17: And Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel) went up against Yahudah (Judah), and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Yahudah (Judah).
