live.canon|1-kings|15:18: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|15:20: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Yashar'el (Israel), and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
live.canon|1-kings|15:21: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
live.canon|1-kings|15:22: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Yahudah (Judah); none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
live.canon|1-kings|15:23: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
live.canon|1-kings|15:24: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|15:25: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in the second year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah), and reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) two years.
live.canon|1-kings|15:26: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
live.canon|1-kings|15:27: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Yashar'el (Israel) laid siege to Gibbethon.
live.canon|1-kings|15:28: Even in the third year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|15:29: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
live.canon|1-kings|15:30: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Yashar'el (Israel) sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger.
live.canon|1-kings|15:31: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-kings|15:32: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel) all their days.
live.canon|1-kings|15:33: In the third year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Yashar'el (Israel) in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
live.canon|1-kings|15:34: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
live.canon|1-kings|15:19: There is a league between me and you, and between my father and your father: behold, I have sent unto you a present of silver and gold; come and break your league with Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel), that he may depart from me.
live.canon|1-kings|16:2: Forasmuch as I exalted you out of the dust, and made you prince over my people Yashar'el (Israel); and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have made my people Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
live.canon|1-kings|16:4: Him that dies of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dies of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
live.canon|1-kings|16:1: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|16:5: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-kings|16:6: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|16:3: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
live.canon|1-kings|16:7: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of Yahuah (LORD) against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
live.canon|1-kings|16:8: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Tirzah, two years.
live.canon|1-kings|16:9: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
live.canon|1-kings|16:10: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah), and reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|16:11: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
live.canon|1-kings|16:12: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
live.canon|1-kings|16:13: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, in provoking Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger with their vanities.
live.canon|1-kings|16:14: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-kings|16:15: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
live.canon|1-kings|16:17: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
live.canon|1-kings|16:18: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
live.canon|1-kings|16:19: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
live.canon|1-kings|16:20: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-kings|16:21: Then were the people of Yashar'el (Israel) divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
live.canon|1-kings|16:22: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
live.canon|1-kings|16:23: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Omri to reign over Yashar'el (Israel), twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
live.canon|1-kings|16:24: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
live.canon|1-kings|16:25: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and did worse than all that were before him.
live.canon|1-kings|16:26: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, to provoke Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger with their vanities.
live.canon|1-kings|16:27: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-kings|16:28: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|16:29: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Yashar'el (Israel): and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria twenty and two years.
live.canon|1-kings|16:30: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD) above all that were before him.
live.canon|1-kings|16:31: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
live.canon|1-kings|16:32: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
live.canon|1-kings|16:33: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger than all the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) that were before him.
live.canon|1-kings|16:34: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
live.canon|1-kings|16:16: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri has conspired, and has also slain the king: wherefore all Yashar'el (Israel) made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Yashar'el (Israel) that day in the camp.
live.canon|1-kings|17:1: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
live.canon|1-kings|17:3: Get you hence, and turn you eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
live.canon|1-kings|17:4: And it shall be, that you shall drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.
live.canon|1-kings|17:9: Arise, get you to Zarephath, which belongs to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain you.
live.canon|1-kings|17:10: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray you, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
live.canon|1-kings|17:11: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray you, a morsel of bread in your hand.
live.canon|1-kings|17:12: And she said, As Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) lives, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
live.canon|1-kings|17:14: For thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that Yahuah (LORD) sends rain upon the earth.
live.canon|1-kings|17:18: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with you, O you man of Elohim (God)? are you come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
live.canon|1-kings|17:19: And he said unto her, Give me your son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
live.canon|1-kings|17:20: And he cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), have you also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
live.canon|1-kings|17:21: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), I pray you, let this child’s soul come into him again.
live.canon|1-kings|17:23: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, your son lives.
live.canon|1-kings|17:24: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that you are a man of Elohim (God), and that the word of Yahuah (LORD) in your mouth is truth.
live.canon|1-kings|17:2: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto him, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|17:5: So he went and did according unto the word of Yahuah (LORD): for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
live.canon|1-kings|17:6: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
live.canon|1-kings|17:7: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
live.canon|1-kings|17:8: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto him, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|17:15: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
live.canon|1-kings|17:16: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by Elijah.
live.canon|1-kings|17:17: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
live.canon|1-kings|17:22: And Yahuah (LORD) heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
live.canon|1-kings|17:13: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as you have said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for you and for your son.
live.canon|1-kings|18:7: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Are you that my lord Elijah?
live.canon|1-kings|18:8: And he answered him, I am: go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
live.canon|1-kings|18:9: And he said, What have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
live.canon|1-kings|18:10: As Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) lives, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord has not sent to seek you: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found you not.
live.canon|1-kings|18:11: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
live.canon|1-kings|18:12: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from you, that the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall carry you whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he shall slay me: but I your servant fear Yahuah (LORD) from my youth.
live.canon|1-kings|18:14: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
live.canon|1-kings|18:15: And Elijah said, As Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) lives, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
live.canon|1-kings|18:17: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Are you he that troubles Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-kings|18:18: And he answered, I have not troubled Yashar'el (Israel); but you, and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), and you have followed Baalim.
live.canon|1-kings|18:21: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt you between two opinions? if Yahuah (LORD) be Elohim (God), follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
live.canon|1-kings|18:24: And call you on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of Yahuah (LORD): and the Elohim (God) that answers by fire, let him be Elohim (God). And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
live.canon|1-kings|18:25: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for you are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
live.canon|1-kings|18:31: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of Yahuah (LORD) came, saying, Yashar'el (Israel) shall be your name:
live.canon|1-kings|18:36: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Abraham, Isaac, and of Yashar'el (Israel), let it be known this day that you are Elohim (God) in Yashar'el (Israel), and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
live.canon|1-kings|18:37: Hear me, O Yahuah (LORD), hear me, that this people may know that you are Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and that you have turned their heart back again.
live.canon|1-kings|18:41: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get you up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
live.canon|1-kings|18:44: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there arises a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare your chariot, and get you down, that the rain stop you not.
live.canon|1-kings|18:1: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
live.canon|1-kings|18:2: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
live.canon|1-kings|18:3: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared Yahuah (LORD) greatly:
live.canon|1-kings|18:4: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of Yahuah (LORD), that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
live.canon|1-kings|18:5: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
live.canon|1-kings|18:6: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
live.canon|1-kings|18:13: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of Yahuah (LORD), how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
live.canon|1-kings|18:16: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
live.canon|1-kings|18:19: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Yashar'el (Israel) unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.
live.canon|1-kings|18:20: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
live.canon|1-kings|18:22: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of Yahuah (LORD); but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
live.canon|1-kings|18:23: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
live.canon|1-kings|18:26: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
live.canon|1-kings|18:28: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
live.canon|1-kings|18:29: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
live.canon|1-kings|18:30: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of Yahuah (LORD) that was broken down.
live.canon|1-kings|18:32: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of Yahuah (LORD): and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
live.canon|1-kings|18:33: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
live.canon|1-kings|18:34: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
live.canon|1-kings|18:35: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
live.canon|1-kings|18:38: Then the fire of Yahuah (LORD) fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
live.canon|1-kings|18:39: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, Yahuah (LORD), he is the Elohim (God); Yahuah (LORD), he is the Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-kings|18:40: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
live.canon|1-kings|18:42: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
live.canon|1-kings|18:43: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
live.canon|1-kings|18:45: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
live.canon|1-kings|18:46: And the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
live.canon|1-kings|18:27: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleeps, and must be awaked.
live.canon|1-kings|19:2: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not your life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
live.canon|1-kings|19:3: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongs to Yahudah (Judah), and left his servant there.
live.canon|1-kings|19:7: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for you.
live.canon|1-kings|19:9: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to him, and he said unto him, What do you here, Elijah?
live.canon|1-kings|19:10: And he said, I have been very jealous for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts: for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and slain your prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
live.canon|1-kings|19:13: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What do you here, Elijah?
live.canon|1-kings|19:14: And he said, I have been very jealous for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts: because the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and slain your prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
live.canon|1-kings|19:16: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shall you anoint to be king over Yashar'el (Israel): and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shall you anoint to be prophet in your room.
live.canon|1-kings|19:18: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Yashar'el (Israel), all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.
live.canon|1-kings|19:20: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray you, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to you?
live.canon|1-kings|19:1: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
live.canon|1-kings|19:4: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O Yahuah (LORD), take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
live.canon|1-kings|19:5: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
live.canon|1-kings|19:6: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
live.canon|1-kings|19:8: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-kings|19:11: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before Yahuah (LORD). And, behold, Yahuah (LORD) passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before Yahuah (LORD); but Yahuah (LORD) was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but Yahuah (LORD) was not in the earthquake:
live.canon|1-kings|19:12: And after the earthquake a fire; but Yahuah (LORD) was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
live.canon|1-kings|19:17: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
live.canon|1-kings|19:19: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
live.canon|1-kings|19:21: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
live.canon|1-kings|19:15: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when you come, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
live.canon|1-kings|20:2: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel) into the city, and said unto him, Thus says Ben-hadad,
live.canon|1-kings|20:3: Your silver and your gold is mine; your wives also and your children, even the goodliest, are mine.
live.canon|1-kings|20:4: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) answered and said, My lord, O king, according to your saying, I am yours, and all that I have.
live.canon|1-kings|20:5: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaks Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto you, saying, You shall deliver me your silver, and your gold, and your wives, and your children;
live.canon|1-kings|20:6: Yet I will send my servants unto you to morrow about this time, and they shall search your house, and the houses of your servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in your eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
live.canon|1-kings|20:7: Then the king of Yashar'el (Israel) called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeks mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
live.canon|1-kings|20:9: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that you did send for to your servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
live.canon|1-kings|20:11: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that puts it off.
live.canon|1-kings|20:13: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Have you seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into your hand this day; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|20:14: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, You.
live.canon|1-kings|20:22: And the prophet came to the king of Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what you do: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against you.
live.canon|1-kings|20:25: And number you an army, like the army that you have lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
live.canon|1-kings|20:28: And there came a man of Elohim (God), and spake unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel), and said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Because the Syrians have said, Yahuah (LORD) is Elohim (God) of the hills, but he is not Elohim (God) of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|20:32: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Yashar'el (Israel), and said, Your servant Ben-hadad says, I pray you, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.
live.canon|1-kings|20:33: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Your brother Ben-hadad. Then he said, Go you, bring him. Then Ben-hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
live.canon|1-kings|20:34: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from your father, I will restore; and you shall make streets for you in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send you away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
live.canon|1-kings|20:35: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of Yahuah (LORD), Smite me, I pray you. And the man refused to smite him.
live.canon|1-kings|20:36: Then said he unto him, Because you have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah (LORD), behold, as soon as you are departed from me, a lion shall slay you. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
live.canon|1-kings|20:39: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Your servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall your life be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.
live.canon|1-kings|20:40: And as your servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto him, So shall your judgment be; thyself have decided it.
live.canon|1-kings|20:42: And he said unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Because you have let go out of your hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore your life shall go for his life, and your people for his people.
live.canon|1-kings|20:1: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
live.canon|1-kings|20:8: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
live.canon|1-kings|20:10: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
live.canon|1-kings|20:12: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.
live.canon|1-kings|20:15: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), being seven thousand.
live.canon|1-kings|20:16: And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
live.canon|1-kings|20:17: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
live.canon|1-kings|20:18: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
live.canon|1-kings|20:19: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
live.canon|1-kings|20:20: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Yashar'el (Israel) pursued them: and Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
live.canon|1-kings|20:21: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
live.canon|1-kings|20:23: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
live.canon|1-kings|20:24: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
live.canon|1-kings|20:26: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|20:27: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
live.canon|1-kings|20:29: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
live.canon|1-kings|20:30: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Ben-hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
live.canon|1-kings|20:38: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
live.canon|1-kings|20:41: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Yashar'el (Israel) discerned him that he was of the prophets.
live.canon|1-kings|20:43: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
live.canon|1-kings|20:31: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) are merciful kings: let us, I pray you, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Yashar'el (Israel): peradventure he will save your life.
live.canon|1-kings|20:37: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray you. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
live.canon|1-kings|21:2: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to you, I will give you the worth of it in money.
live.canon|1-kings|21:3: And Naboth said to Ahab, Yahuah (LORD) forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto you.
live.canon|1-kings|21:4: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
live.canon|1-kings|21:5: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is your spirit so sad, that you eat no bread?
live.canon|1-kings|21:6: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it please you, I will give you another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give you my vineyard.
live.canon|1-kings|21:7: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Do you now govern the kingdom of Yashar'el (Israel)? arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry: I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
live.canon|1-kings|21:10: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, You did blaspheme Elohim (God) and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
live.canon|1-kings|21:15: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
live.canon|1-kings|21:20: And Ahab said to Elijah, Have you found me, O my enemy? And he answered, I have found you: because you have sold thyself to work evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-kings|21:21: Behold, I will bring evil upon you, and will take away your posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Yashar'el (Israel),
live.canon|1-kings|21:22: And will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith you have provoked me to anger, and made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
live.canon|1-kings|21:24: Him that dies of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dies in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
live.canon|1-kings|21:29: See you how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.
live.canon|1-kings|21:1: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
live.canon|1-kings|21:8: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.
live.canon|1-kings|21:9: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
live.canon|1-kings|21:11: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
live.canon|1-kings|21:12: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
live.canon|1-kings|21:13: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme Elohim (God) and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
live.canon|1-kings|21:14: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
live.canon|1-kings|21:16: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
live.canon|1-kings|21:17: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|21:18: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel), which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
live.canon|1-kings|21:23: And of Jezebel also spake Yahuah (LORD), saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
live.canon|1-kings|21:25: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
live.canon|1-kings|21:26: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom Yahuah (LORD) cast out before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|21:27: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
live.canon|1-kings|21:28: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
live.canon|1-kings|21:19: And you shall speak unto him, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Have you killed, and also taken possession? And you shall speak unto him, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick your blood, even yours.
live.canon|1-kings|22:3: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto his servants, Know you that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
live.canon|1-kings|22:4: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Yashar'el (Israel), I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.
live.canon|1-kings|22:5: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel), Enquire, I pray you, at the word of Yahuah (LORD) to day.
live.canon|1-kings|22:8: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of Yahuah (LORD): but I hate him; for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
live.canon|1-kings|22:11: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), With these shall you push the Syrians, until you have consumed them.
live.canon|1-kings|22:13: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let your word, I pray you, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
live.canon|1-kings|22:14: And Micaiah said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, what Yahuah (LORD) says unto me, that will I speak.
live.canon|1-kings|22:16: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure you that you tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|1-kings|22:18: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
live.canon|1-kings|22:19: And he said, Hear you therefore the word of Yahuah (LORD): I saw Yahuah (LORD) sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
live.canon|1-kings|22:22: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You shall persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
live.canon|1-kings|22:23: Now therefore, behold, Yahuah (LORD) has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets, and Yahuah (LORD) has spoken evil concerning you.
live.canon|1-kings|22:24: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) from me to speak unto you?
live.canon|1-kings|22:25: And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see in that day, when you shall go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
live.canon|1-kings|22:27: And say, Thus says the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
live.canon|1-kings|22:28: And Micaiah said, If you return at all in peace, Yahuah (LORD) has not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
live.canon|1-kings|22:30: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put you on your robes. And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) disguised himself, and went into the battle.
live.canon|1-kings|22:34: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Yashar'el (Israel) between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn your hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
live.canon|1-kings|22:49: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with your servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
live.canon|1-kings|22:1: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|22:2: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah) came down to the king of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|22:7: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Yahuah (LORD) besides, that we might enquire of him?
live.canon|1-kings|22:9: Then the king of Yashar'el (Israel) called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
live.canon|1-kings|22:10: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) and Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah) sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
live.canon|1-kings|22:12: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for Yahuah (LORD) shall deliver it into the king’s hand.
live.canon|1-kings|22:15: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for Yahuah (LORD) shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
live.canon|1-kings|22:17: And he said, I saw all Yashar'el (Israel) scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and Yahuah (LORD) said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
live.canon|1-kings|22:20: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
live.canon|1-kings|22:21: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before Yahuah (LORD), and said, I will persuade him.
live.canon|1-kings|22:26: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
live.canon|1-kings|22:29: So the king of Yashar'el (Israel) and Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah) went up to Ramoth-gilead.
live.canon|1-kings|22:31: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|22:32: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Yashar'el (Israel). And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
live.canon|1-kings|22:33: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Yashar'el (Israel), that they turned back from pursuing him.
live.canon|1-kings|22:35: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
live.canon|1-kings|22:36: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
live.canon|1-kings|22:37: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
live.canon|1-kings|22:38: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of Yahuah (LORD) which he spake.
live.canon|1-kings|22:39: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-kings|22:40: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|22:41: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Yahudah (Judah) in the fourth year of Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|22:42: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
live.canon|1-kings|22:43: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD): nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
live.canon|1-kings|22:44: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|22:45: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
live.canon|1-kings|22:46: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
live.canon|1-kings|22:47: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
live.canon|1-kings|22:48: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
live.canon|1-kings|22:50: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|1-kings|22:51: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah), and reigned two years over Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|1-kings|22:52: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin:
live.canon|1-kings|22:53: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), according to all that his father had done.
live.canon|1-kings|22:6: Then the king of Yashar'el (Israel) gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for Adonai (Lord) shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
live.canon|1-peter|1:1: Peter, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
live.canon|1-peter|1:2: Elect according to the foreknowledge of Elohim (God) the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ): Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
live.canon|1-peter|1:4: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
live.canon|1-peter|1:5: Who are kept by the power of Elohim (God) through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
live.canon|1-peter|1:9: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
live.canon|1-peter|1:10: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
live.canon|1-peter|1:11: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Messiah (Christ) which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Messiah (Christ), and the glory that should follow.
live.canon|1-peter|1:12: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
live.canon|1-peter|1:13: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ);
live.canon|1-peter|1:14: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
live.canon|1-peter|1:19: But with the precious blood of Messiah (Christ), as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
live.canon|1-peter|1:20: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
live.canon|1-peter|1:21: Who by him do believe in Elohim (God), that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-peter|1:6: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, you are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
live.canon|1-peter|1:7: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perishes, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
live.canon|1-peter|1:8: Whom having not seen, you love; in whom, though now you see him not, yet believing, you rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
live.canon|1-peter|1:15: But as he which has called you is holy, so be you holy in all manner of conversation;
live.canon|1-peter|1:16: Because it is written, Be you holy; for I am holy.
live.canon|1-peter|1:17: And if you call on the Father, who without respect of persons judges according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
live.canon|1-peter|1:18: Forasmuch as you know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
live.canon|1-peter|1:22: Seeing you have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that you love one another with a pure heart fervently:
live.canon|1-peter|1:23: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of Elohim (God), which lives and abides for ever.
live.canon|1-peter|1:24: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falls away:
live.canon|1-peter|1:25: But the word of Yahuah (Lord) endures for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
live.canon|1-peter|1:3: Blessed be the Elohim (God) and Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), which according to his abundant mercy has begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) from the dead,
live.canon|1-peter|2:1: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
live.canon|1-peter|2:4: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of Elohim (God), and precious,
live.canon|1-peter|2:7: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
live.canon|1-peter|2:8: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
live.canon|1-peter|2:10: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of Elohim (God): which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
live.canon|1-peter|2:11: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
live.canon|1-peter|2:12: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify Elohim (God) in the day of visitation.
live.canon|1-peter|2:13: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for Yahuah's (Lord’s) sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
live.canon|1-peter|2:14: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
live.canon|1-peter|2:16: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-peter|2:17: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear Elohim (God). Honour the king.
live.canon|1-peter|2:18: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
live.canon|1-peter|2:19: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward Elohim (God) endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
live.canon|1-peter|2:22: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
live.canon|1-peter|2:6: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believes on him shall not be confounded.
live.canon|1-peter|2:2: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that you may grow thereby:
live.canon|1-peter|2:3: If so be you have tasted that Yahuah (Lord) is gracious.
live.canon|1-peter|2:5: You also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to Elohim (God) by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
live.canon|1-peter|2:9: But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that you should shew forth the praises of him who has called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
live.canon|1-peter|2:15: For so is the will of Elohim (God), that with well doing you may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
live.canon|1-peter|2:20: For what glory is it, if, when you be buffeted for your faults, you shall take it patiently? but if, when you do well, and suffer for it, you take it patiently, this is acceptable with Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-peter|2:21: For even hereunto were you called: because Messiah (Christ) also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that you should follow his steps:
live.canon|1-peter|2:23: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judges righteously:
live.canon|1-peter|2:24: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes you were healed.
live.canon|1-peter|2:25: For you were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
live.canon|1-peter|3:2: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
live.canon|1-peter|3:3: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
live.canon|1-peter|3:4: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of Elohim (God) of great price.
live.canon|1-peter|3:5: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in Elohim (God), adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
live.canon|1-peter|3:10: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
live.canon|1-peter|3:11: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
live.canon|1-peter|3:12: For the eyes of Yahuah (Lord) are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of Yahuah (Lord) is against them that do evil.
live.canon|1-peter|3:16: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|1-peter|3:19: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
live.canon|1-peter|3:20: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of Elohim (God) waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
live.canon|1-peter|3:22: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of Elohim (God); angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
live.canon|1-peter|3:6: Even as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters you are, as long as you do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
live.canon|1-peter|3:1: Likewise, you wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
live.canon|1-peter|3:7: Likewise, you husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
live.canon|1-peter|3:8: Finally, be you all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
live.canon|1-peter|3:9: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that you are thereunto called, that you should inherit a blessing.
live.canon|1-peter|3:13: And who is he that will harm you, if you be followers of that which is good?
live.canon|1-peter|3:14: But and if you suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are you: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
live.canon|1-peter|3:15: But sanctify Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asks you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
live.canon|1-peter|3:17: For it is better, if the will of Elohim (God) be so, that you suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
live.canon|1-peter|3:18: For Messiah (Christ) also has once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to Elohim (God), being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
live.canon|1-peter|3:21: The like figure whereunto even baptism does also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward Elohim (God),) by the resurrection of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
live.canon|1-peter|4:2: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-peter|4:3: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
live.canon|1-peter|4:5: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
live.canon|1-peter|4:6: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to Elohim (God) in the spirit.
live.canon|1-peter|4:8: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
live.canon|1-peter|4:9: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
live.canon|1-peter|4:12: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
live.canon|1-peter|4:15: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.
live.canon|1-peter|4:16: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify Elohim (God) on this behalf.
live.canon|1-peter|4:17: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of Elohim (God): and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of Elohim (God)?
live.canon|1-peter|4:18: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
live.canon|1-peter|4:19: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of Elohim (God) commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
live.canon|1-peter|4:1: Forasmuch then as Messiah (Christ) has suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;
live.canon|1-peter|4:4: Wherein they think it strange that you run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
live.canon|1-peter|4:7: But the end of all things is at hand: be you therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
live.canon|1-peter|4:10: As every man has received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-peter|4:11: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of Elohim (God); if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which Elohim (God) gives: that Elohim (God) in all things may be glorified through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
live.canon|1-peter|4:13: But rejoice, inasmuch as you are partakers of Messiah's (Christ’s) sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, you may be glad also with exceeding joy.
live.canon|1-peter|4:14: If you be reproached for the name of Messiah (Christ), happy are you; for the spirit of glory and of Elohim (God) resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
live.canon|1-peter|5:1: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Messiah (Christ), and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
live.canon|1-peter|5:2: Feed the flock of Elohim (God) which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
live.canon|1-peter|5:3: Neither as being lords over Elohim's (God’s) heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
live.canon|1-peter|5:6: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of Elohim (God), that he may exalt you in due time:
live.canon|1-peter|5:7: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
live.canon|1-peter|5:9: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
live.canon|1-peter|5:11: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
live.canon|1-peter|5:4: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, you shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
live.canon|1-peter|5:5: Likewise, you younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for Elohim (God) resisteth the proud, and gives grace to the humble.
live.canon|1-peter|5:8: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:
live.canon|1-peter|5:10: But the Elohim (God) of all grace, who has called us unto his eternal glory by HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), after that you have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
live.canon|1-peter|5:12: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of Elohim (God) wherein you stand.
live.canon|1-peter|5:13: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so does Marcus my son.
live.canon|1-peter|5:14: Greet you one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus). Amen.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:8: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest you? and why eat you not? and why is your heart grieved? am not I better to you than ten sons?
live.canon|1-samuel|1:11: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), if you will indeed look on the affliction of your handmaid, and remember me, and not forget your handmaid, but will give unto your handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto Yahuah (LORD) all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:14: And Eli said unto her, How long will you be drunken? put away your wine from you.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:16: Count not your handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:17: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) grant you your petition that you have asked of him.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:18: And she said, Let your handmaid find grace in your sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:23: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seems you good; tarry until you have weaned him; only Yahuah (LORD) establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:26: And she said, Oh my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman that stood by you here, praying unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-samuel|1:27: For this child I prayed; and Yahuah (LORD) has given me my petition which I asked of him:
live.canon|1-samuel|1:28: Therefore also I have lent him to Yahuah (LORD); as long as he lives he shall be lent to Yahuah (LORD). And he worshipped Yahuah (LORD) there.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:1: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
live.canon|1-samuel|1:2: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:3: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of Yahuah (LORD), were there.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:4: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
live.canon|1-samuel|1:5: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but Yahuah (LORD) had shut up her womb.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:6: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because Yahuah (LORD) had shut up her womb.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:7: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of Yahuah (LORD), so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:9: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-samuel|1:10: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), and wept sore.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:12: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before Yahuah (LORD), that Eli marked her mouth.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:13: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:15: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-samuel|1:19: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before Yahuah (LORD), and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahuah (LORD) remembered her.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:20: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-samuel|1:21: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto Yahuah (LORD) the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:22: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahuah (LORD), and there abide for ever.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:24: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of Yahuah (LORD) in Shiloh: and the child was young.
live.canon|1-samuel|1:25: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:1: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoices in Yahuah (LORD), my horn is exalted in Yahuah (LORD): my mouth is enlarged over my enemies; because I rejoice in your salvation.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:2: There is none holy as Yahuah (LORD): for there is none beside you: neither is there any rock like our Elohim (God).
live.canon|1-samuel|2:5: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren has born seven; and she that has many children is waxed feeble.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:6: Yahuah (LORD) kills, and makes alive: he brings down to the grave, and brings up.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:7: Yahuah (LORD) makes poor, and makes rich: he brings low, and lifts up.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:8: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD’S, and he has set the world upon them.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:15: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of you, but raw.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:16: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as your soul desires; then he would answer him, Nay; but you shall give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:20: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, Yahuah (LORD) give you seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to Yahuah (LORD). And they went unto their own home.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:23: And he said unto them, Why do you such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:24: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: you make the LORD’S people to transgress.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:27: And there came a man of Elohim (God) unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Did I plainly appear unto the house of your father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh’s house?
live.canon|1-samuel|2:28: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to be my priest, to offer upon my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of your father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|1-samuel|2:29: Wherefore kick you at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Yashar'el (Israel) my people?
live.canon|1-samuel|2:30: Wherefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) says, I said indeed that your house, and the house of your father, should walk before me for ever: but now Yahuah (LORD) says, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:31: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off your arm, and the arm of your father’s house, that there shall not be an old man in your house.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:32: And you shall see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which Elohim (God) shall give Yashar'el (Israel): and there shall not be an old man in your house for ever.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:33: And the man of yours, whom I shall not cut off from my altar, shall be to consume your eyes, and to grieve your heart: and all the increase of your house shall die in the flower of their age.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:34: And this shall be a sign unto you, that shall come upon your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:35: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before my anointed for ever.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:36: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in your house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray you, into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:3: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for Yahuah (LORD) is a Elohim (God) of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:4: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:9: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:10: The adversaries of Yahuah (LORD) shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: Yahuah (LORD) shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:11: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto Yahuah (LORD) before Eli the priest.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:12: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-samuel|2:13: And the priests’ custom with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest’s servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;
live.canon|1-samuel|2:14: And he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:17: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before Yahuah (LORD): for men abhorred the offering of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-samuel|2:18: But Samuel ministered before Yahuah (LORD), being a child, girded with a linen ephod.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:19: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:21: And Yahuah (LORD) visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|1-samuel|2:22: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Yashar'el (Israel); and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:25: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against Yahuah (LORD), who shall intreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because Yahuah (LORD) would slay them.
live.canon|1-samuel|2:26: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with Yahuah (LORD), and also with men.
live.canon|1-samuel|3:18: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is Yahuah (LORD): let him do what seems him good.
