live.canon|daniel|8:27: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
live.canon|daniel|9:11: Yea, all Yashar'el (Israel) have transgressed your law, even by departing, that they might not obey your voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of Elohim (God), because we have sinned against him.
live.canon|daniel|9:5: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from your precepts and from your judgments:
live.canon|daniel|9:6: Neither have we hearkened unto your servants the prophets, which spake in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
live.canon|daniel|9:12: And he has confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven has not been done as has been done upon Jerusalem.
live.canon|daniel|9:13: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand your truth.
live.canon|daniel|9:14: Therefore has Yahuah (LORD) watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is righteous in all his works which he does: for we obeyed not his voice.
live.canon|daniel|9:18: O my Elohim (God), incline your ear, and hear; open your eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by your name: for we do not present our supplications before you for our righteousnesses, but for your great mercies.
live.canon|daniel|9:22: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give you skill and understanding.
live.canon|daniel|9:23: At the beginning of your supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew you; for you are greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.
live.canon|daniel|9:24: Seventy weeks are determined upon your people and upon your holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
live.canon|daniel|9:1: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
live.canon|daniel|9:2: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
live.canon|daniel|9:3: And I set my face unto Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God), to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
live.canon|daniel|9:9: To Yahuah Eloheinu (the Lord our God) belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
live.canon|daniel|9:10: Neither have we obeyed the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
live.canon|daniel|9:17: Now therefore, O our Elohim (God), hear the prayer of your servant, and his supplications, and cause your face to shine upon your sanctuary that is desolate, for Yahuah's (Lord’s) sake.
live.canon|daniel|9:20: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Yashar'el (Israel), and presenting my supplication before Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) for the holy mountain of my Elohim (God);
live.canon|daniel|9:21: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
live.canon|daniel|9:25: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
live.canon|daniel|9:26: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
live.canon|daniel|9:27: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
live.canon|daniel|9:4: And I prayed unto Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God), and made my confession, and said, O Adonai (Lord), the great and dreadful Elohim (God), keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
live.canon|daniel|9:7: O Adonai (Lord), righteousness belongs unto you, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Yahudah (Judah), and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Yashar'el (Israel), that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.
live.canon|daniel|9:8: O Adonai (Lord), to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.
live.canon|daniel|9:15: And now, O Adonai (Lord) our Elohim (God), that have brought your people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten you renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
live.canon|daniel|9:16: O Adonai (Lord), according to all your righteousness, I beseech you, let your anger and your fury be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
live.canon|daniel|9:19: O Adonai (Lord), hear; O Adonai (Lord), forgive; O Adonai (Lord), hearken and do; defer not, for your own sake, O my Elohim (God): for your city and your people are called by your name.
live.canon|daniel|10:5: Then I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
live.canon|daniel|10:11: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto you, and stand upright: for unto you am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
live.canon|daniel|10:12: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that you did set your heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before your Elohim (God), your words were heard, and I am come for your words.
live.canon|daniel|10:14: Now I am come to make you understand what shall befall your people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
live.canon|daniel|10:19: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto you, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.
live.canon|daniel|10:20: Then said he, Know you wherefore I come unto you? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
live.canon|daniel|10:21: But I will shew you that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
live.canon|daniel|10:1: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
live.canon|daniel|10:2: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
live.canon|daniel|10:3: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
live.canon|daniel|10:4: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
live.canon|daniel|10:6: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
live.canon|daniel|10:7: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
live.canon|daniel|10:8: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
live.canon|daniel|10:9: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
live.canon|daniel|10:10: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
live.canon|daniel|10:13: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
live.canon|daniel|10:15: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
live.canon|daniel|10:16: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
live.canon|daniel|10:17: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
live.canon|daniel|10:18: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
live.canon|daniel|11:14: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of your people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
live.canon|daniel|11:16: But he that comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
live.canon|daniel|11:31: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that makes desolate.
live.canon|daniel|11:1: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
live.canon|daniel|11:3: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
live.canon|daniel|11:4: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
live.canon|daniel|11:5: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
live.canon|daniel|11:2: And now will I shew you the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
live.canon|daniel|11:12: And when he has taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
live.canon|daniel|11:6: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
live.canon|daniel|11:7: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
live.canon|daniel|11:8: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
live.canon|daniel|11:9: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
live.canon|daniel|11:10: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
live.canon|daniel|11:11: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
live.canon|daniel|11:13: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
live.canon|daniel|11:15: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
live.canon|daniel|11:17: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
live.canon|daniel|11:18: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.
live.canon|daniel|11:19: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
live.canon|daniel|11:20: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
live.canon|daniel|11:21: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
live.canon|daniel|11:22: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
live.canon|daniel|11:23: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
live.canon|daniel|11:24: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
live.canon|daniel|11:25: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
live.canon|daniel|11:26: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
live.canon|daniel|11:27: And both these kings’ hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
live.canon|daniel|11:28: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
live.canon|daniel|11:29: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
live.canon|daniel|11:30: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
live.canon|daniel|11:32: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their Elohim (God) shall be strong, and do exploits.
live.canon|daniel|11:33: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
live.canon|daniel|11:34: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
live.canon|daniel|11:35: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
live.canon|daniel|11:36: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the Elohim (God) of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
live.canon|daniel|11:37: Neither shall he regard the Elohim (God) of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
live.canon|daniel|11:38: But in his estate shall he honour the Elohim (God) of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
live.canon|daniel|11:39: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
live.canon|daniel|11:40: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
live.canon|daniel|11:41: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
live.canon|daniel|11:42: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
live.canon|daniel|11:43: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
live.canon|daniel|11:44: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
live.canon|daniel|11:45: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
live.canon|daniel|12:11: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
live.canon|daniel|12:12: Blessed is he that waits, and comes to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
live.canon|daniel|12:13: But go you your way till the end be: for you shall rest, and stand in your lot at the end of the days.
live.canon|daniel|12:1: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
live.canon|daniel|12:4: But you, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
live.canon|daniel|12:7: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that lives for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
live.canon|daniel|12:9: And he said, Go your way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
live.canon|daniel|12:2: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
live.canon|daniel|12:3: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
live.canon|daniel|12:5: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
live.canon|daniel|12:6: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
live.canon|daniel|12:8: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
live.canon|daniel|12:10: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:10: Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has multiplied you, and, behold, you are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:11: (Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!)
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:14: And you answered me, and said, The thing which you have spoken is good for us to do.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:17: You shall not respect persons in judgment; but you shall hear the small as well as the great; you shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is Elohim's (God’s): and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:18: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:19: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which you saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:20: And I said unto you, You are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) does give unto us.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:21: Behold, Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has set the land before you: go up and possess it, as Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers has said unto you; fear not, neither be discouraged.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:22: And you came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:25: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) does give us.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:26: Notwithstanding you would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God):
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:27: And you murmured in your tents, and said, Because Yahuah (LORD) hated us, he has brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:30: Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) which goes before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:31: And in the wilderness, where you have seen how that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) bare you, as a man does bear his son, in all the way that you went, until you came into this place.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:32: Yet in this thing you did not believe Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God),
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:33: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way you should go, and in a cloud by day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:36: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he has trodden upon, and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:38: But Joshua the son of Nun, which stands before you, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Yashar'el (Israel) to inherit it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:39: Moreover your little ones, which you said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:41: Then you answered and said unto me, We have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), we will go up and fight, according to all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) commanded us. And when you had girded on every man his weapons of war, you were ready to go up into the hill.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:42: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest you be smitten before your enemies.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:43: So I spake unto you; and you would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), and went presumptuously up into the hill.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:45: And you returned and wept before Yahuah (LORD); but Yahuah (LORD) would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:46: So you abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that you abode there.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:1: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Yashar'el (Israel) on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:2: (There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:3: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), according unto all that Yahuah (LORD) had given him in commandment unto them;
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:4: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:5: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:7: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:8: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:9: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:12: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:13: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:15: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:16: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:23: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:24: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:6: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) spake unto us in Horeb, saying, You have dwelt long enough in this mount:
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:28: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:29: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:34: And Yahuah (LORD) heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:35: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:40: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:44: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
live.canon|deuteronomy|1:37: Also Yahuah (LORD) was angry with me for your sakes, saying, You also shall not go in thither.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:3: You have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:4: And command you the people, saying, You are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take you good heed unto yourselves therefore:
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:6: You shall buy meat of them for money, that you may eat; and you shall also buy water of them for money, that you may drink.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:7: For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has blessed you in all the works of your hand: he knows your walking through this great wilderness: these forty years Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has been with you; you have lacked nothing.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:9: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give you of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:18: You are to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:19: And when you come nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give you of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:24: Rise you up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:25: This day will I begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of you, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:28: You shall sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:29: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) gives us.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:30: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as appears this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:31: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before you: begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:37: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon you came not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) forbad us.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:1: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:2: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me, saying,
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:5: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:8: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:10: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:11: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:12: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Yashar'el (Israel) did unto the land of his possession, which Yahuah (LORD) gave unto them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:13: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:14: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as Yahuah (LORD) sware unto them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:15: For indeed the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:16: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:17: That Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me, saying,
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:20: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:21: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but Yahuah (LORD) destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:22: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:23: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:26: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:32: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:33: And Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:34: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:35: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:36: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) delivered all unto us:
live.canon|deuteronomy|2:27: Let me pass through your land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:2: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into your hand; and you shall do unto him as you did unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:18: And I commanded you at that time, saying, Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has given you this land to possess it: you shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Yashar'el (Israel), all that are meet for the war.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:19: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that you have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:20: Until Yahuah (LORD) have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has given them beyond Jordan: and then shall you return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:21: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has done unto these two kings: so shall Yahuah (LORD) do unto all the kingdoms whither you passest.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:22: You shall not fear them: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) he shall fight for you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:27: Get you up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with your eyes: for you shall not go over this Jordan.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:28: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:1: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:3: So Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:4: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:5: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:6: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:7: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:8: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:9: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:10: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:11: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:12: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:13: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:14: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:15: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:16: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:17: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:23: And I besought Yahuah (LORD) at that time, saying,
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:29: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:25: I pray you, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:26: But Yahuah (LORD) was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Let it suffice you; speak no more unto me of this matter.
live.canon|deuteronomy|3:24: O Adonai (Lord) GOD, you have begun to shew your servant your greatness, and your mighty hand: for what Elohim (God) is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to your works, and according to your might?
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:1: Now therefore hearken, O Yashar'el (Israel), unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers gives you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:2: You shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall you diminish ought from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) which I command you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:3: Your eyes have seen what Yahuah (LORD) did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has destroyed them from among you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:4: But you that did cleave unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) are alive every one of you this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:5: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) commanded me, that you should do so in the land whither you go to possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:7: For what nation is there so great, who has Elohim (God) so nigh unto them, as Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is in all things that we call upon him for?
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:8: And what nation is there so great, that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:9: Only take heed to thyself, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life: but teach them your sons, and your sons’ sons;
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:10: Specially the day that you stoodest before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in Horeb, when Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:11: And you came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:12: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: you heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only you heard a voice.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:14: And Yahuah (LORD) commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might do them in the land whither you go over to possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:15: Take you therefore good heed unto yourselves; for you saw no manner of similitude on the day that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:16: Lest you corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:18: The likeness of any thing that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:19: And lest you lift up your eyes unto heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, should be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:20: But Yahuah (LORD) has taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as you are this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:21: Furthermore Yahuah (LORD) was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you for an inheritance:
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:22: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:23: Take heed unto yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has forbidden you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:25: When you shall beget children, and children’s children, and you shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to provoke him to anger:
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:26: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto you go over Jordan to possess it; you shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:27: And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter you among the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither Yahuah (LORD) shall lead you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:28: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:29: But if from thence you shall seek Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), you shall find him, if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:30: When you are in tribulation, and all these things are come upon you, even in the latter days, if you turn to Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shall be obedient unto his voice;
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:31: (For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is a merciful Elohim (God);) he will not forsake you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he sware unto them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:32: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that Elohim (God) created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there has been any such thing as this great thing is, or has been heard like it?
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:33: Did ever people hear the voice of Elohim (God) speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:34: Or has Elohim (God) assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:35: Unto you it was shewed, that you might know that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God); there is none else beside him.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:36: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you: and upon earth he shewed you his great fire; and you heard his words out of the midst of the fire.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:37: And because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought you out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:38: To drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you are, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:39: Know therefore this day, and consider it in your heart, that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:40: You shall keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you this day, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days upon the earth, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you, for ever.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:6: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:13: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:17: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:24: For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is a consuming fire, even a jealous Elohim (God).
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:41: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:42: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:43: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:44: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:45: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), after they came forth out of Egypt,
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:46: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:47: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:48: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
live.canon|deuteronomy|4:49: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:1: And Moses called all Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto them, Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel), the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that you may learn them, and keep, and do them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:5: (I stood between Yahuah (LORD) and you at that time, to shew you the word of Yahuah (LORD): for you were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:6: I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:8: You shall not make you any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:9: You shall not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) am a jealous Elohim (God), visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:11: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in vain: for Yahuah (LORD) will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:12: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has commanded you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:13: Six days you shall labour, and do all your work:
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:14: But the seventh day is the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): in it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your ox, nor your ass, nor any of your cattle, nor your stranger that is within your gates; that your manservant and your maidservant may rest as well as you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:15: And remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brought you out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) commanded you to keep the sabbath day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:16: Honour your father and your mother, as Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has commanded you; that your days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:20: Neither shall you bear false witness against your neighbour.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:24: And you said, Behold, Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that Elohim (God) does talk with man, and he lives.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:26: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living Elohim (God) speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:27: Go you near, and hear all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall say: and speak you unto us all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall speak unto you; and we will hear it, and do it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:28: And Yahuah (LORD) heard the voice of your words, when you spake unto me; and Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto you: they have well said all that they have spoken.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:31: But as for you, stand you here by me, and I will speak unto you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:32: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has commanded you: you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:33: You shall walk in all the ways which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:2: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) made a covenant with us in Horeb.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:3: Yahuah (LORD) made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:4: Yahuah (LORD) talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:10: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:7: You shall have none other gods before me.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:22: These words Yahuah (LORD) spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:25: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) any more, then we shall die.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:29: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:30: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:21: Neither shall you desire your neighbour’s wife, neither shall you covet your neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is your neighbour’s.
live.canon|deuteronomy|5:23: And it came to pass, when you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that you came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:1: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land whither you go to possess it:
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:2: That you might fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you, you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:3: Hear therefore, O Yashar'el (Israel), and observe to do it; that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers has promised you, in the land that flows with milk and honey.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:5: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:7: And you shall teach them diligently unto your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you risest up.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:8: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:9: And you shall write them upon the posts of your house, and on your gates.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:10: And it shall be, when Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall have brought you into the land which he sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you great and goodly cities, which you buildedst not,
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:11: And houses full of all good things, which you filledst not, and wells digged, which you diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which you plantedst not; when you shall have eaten and be full;
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:12: Then beware lest you forget Yahuah (LORD), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:4: Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:6: And these words, which I command you this day, shall be in your heart:
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:13: You shall fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and serve him, and shall swear by his name.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:14: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:15: (For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is a jealous Elohim (God) among you) lest the anger of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) be kindled against you, and destroy you from off the face of the earth.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:16: You shall not tempt Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as you tempted him in Massah.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:17: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:18: And you shall do that which is right and good in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers,
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:19: To cast out all your enemies from before you, as Yahuah (LORD) has spoken.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:22: And Yahuah (LORD) shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:23: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:24: And Yahuah (LORD) commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:20: And when your son asks you in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has commanded you?
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:21: Then you shall say unto your son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and Yahuah (LORD) brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
live.canon|deuteronomy|6:25: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), as he has commanded us.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:1: When Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bring you into the land whither you go to possess it, and has cast out many nations before you, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you;
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:2: And when Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall deliver them before you; you shall smite them, and utterly destroy them; you shall make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:3: Neither shall you make marriages with them; your daughter you shall not give unto his son, nor his daughter shall you take unto your son.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:4: For they will turn away your son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of Yahuah (LORD) be kindled against you, and destroy you suddenly.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:5: But thus shall you deal with them; you shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:6: For you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has chosen you to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:7: Yahuah (LORD) did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all people:
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:8: But because Yahuah (LORD) loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, has Yahuah (LORD) brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:9: Know therefore that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), he is Elohim (God), the faithful Elohim (God), which keeps covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:10: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hates him, he will repay him to his face.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:11: You shall therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command you this day, to do them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:12: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if you hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall keep unto you the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto your fathers:
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:13: And he will love you, and bless you, and multiply you: he will also bless the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your corn, and your wine, and your oil, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep, in the land which he sware unto your fathers to give you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:14: You shall be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:15: And Yahuah (LORD) will take away from you all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, upon you; but will lay them upon all them that hate you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:16: And you shall consume all the people which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall deliver you; your eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shall you serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:17: If you shall say in your heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:18: You shall not be afraid of them: but shall well remember what Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:19: The great temptations which your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brought you out: so shall Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) do unto all the people of whom you are afraid.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:20: Moreover Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from you, be destroyed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:21: You shall not be affrighted at them: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is among you, a mighty Elohim (God) and terrible.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:22: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will put out those nations before you by little and little: you may not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:23: But Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall deliver them unto you, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:24: And he shall deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before you, until you have destroyed them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:25: The graven images of their gods shall you burn with fire: you shall not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto you, lest you be snared therein: for it is an abomination to Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
live.canon|deuteronomy|7:26: Neither shall you bring an abomination into your house, lest you be a cursed thing like it: but you shall utterly detest it, and you shall utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:1: All the commandments which I command you this day shall you observe to do, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:2: And you shall remember all the way which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) led you these forty years in the wilderness, to humble you, and to prove you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or no.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:8: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:3: And he humbled you, and suffered you to hunger, and fed you with manna, which you knew not, neither did your fathers know; that he might make you know that man does not live by bread only, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) does man live.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:4: Your raiment waxed not old upon you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:5: You shall also consider in your heart, that, as a man chastens his son, so Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) chastens you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:6: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:7: For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:9: A land wherein you shall eat bread without scarceness, you shall not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig brass.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:10: When you have eaten and are full, then you shall bless Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) for the good land which he has given you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:11: Beware that you forget not Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command you this day:
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:12: Lest when you have eaten and are full, and have built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:13: And when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:14: Then your heart be lifted up, and you forget Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:15: Who led you through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought you forth water out of the rock of flint;
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:16: Who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers knew not, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:17: And you say in your heart, My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:18: But you shall remember Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): for it is he that gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto your fathers, as it is this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:19: And it shall be, if you do at all forget Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that you shall surely perish.
live.canon|deuteronomy|8:20: As the nations which Yahuah (LORD) destroys before your face, so shall you perish; because you would not be obedient unto the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:1: Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): You are to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:2: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:3: Understand therefore this day, that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is he which goes over before you; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before your face: so shall you drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as Yahuah (LORD) has said unto you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:4: Speak not you in your heart, after that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has cast them out from before you, saying, For my righteousness Yahuah (LORD) has brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah (LORD) does drive them out from before you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:5: Not for your righteousness, or for the uprightness of your heart, do you go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) does drive them out from before you, and that he may perform the word which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:6: Understand therefore, that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you not this good land to possess it for your righteousness; for you are a stiffnecked people.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:7: Remember, and forget not, how you provokedst Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that you did depart out of the land of Egypt, until you came unto this place, you have been rebellious against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:8: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahuah (LORD) to wrath, so that Yahuah (LORD) was angry with you to have destroyed you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:9: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Yahuah (LORD) made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:10: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of Elohim (God); and on them was written according to all the words, which Yahuah (LORD) spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:11: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Yahuah (LORD) gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:12: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Arise, get you down quickly from hence; for your people which you have brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:13: Furthermore Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:15: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:14: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:16: And I looked, and, behold, you had sinned against Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and had made you a molten calf: you had turned aside quickly out of the way which Yahuah (LORD) had commanded you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:17: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:19: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith Yahuah (LORD) was wroth against you to destroy you. But Yahuah (LORD) hearkened unto me at that time also.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:18: And I fell down before Yahuah (LORD), as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which you sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), to provoke him to anger.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:20: And Yahuah (LORD) was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:25: Thus I fell down before Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because Yahuah (LORD) had said he would destroy you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:21: And I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:22: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, you provoked Yahuah (LORD) to wrath.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:23: Likewise when Yahuah (LORD) sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then you rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and you believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:24: You have been rebellious against Yahuah (LORD) from the day that I knew you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:27: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:28: Lest the land whence you brought us out say, Because Yahuah (LORD) was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:29: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your mighty power and by your stretched out arm.
live.canon|deuteronomy|9:26: I prayed therefore unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, destroy not your people and your inheritance, which you have redeemed through your greatness, which you have brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:1: At that time Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Hew you two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make you an ark of wood.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:2: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which you brakest, and you shall put them in the ark.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:4: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and Yahuah (LORD) gave them unto me.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:5: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded me.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:6: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:3: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in my hand.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:7: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:8: At that time Yahuah (LORD) separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), to stand before Yahuah (LORD) to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:9: Wherefore Levi has no part nor inheritance with his brethren; Yahuah (LORD) is his inheritance, according as Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) promised him.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:10: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened unto me at that time also, and Yahuah (LORD) would not destroy you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:11: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Arise, take your journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:12: And now, Yashar'el (Israel), what does Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) require of you, but to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart and with all your soul,
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:13: To keep the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), and his statutes, which I command you this day for your good?
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:14: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’S your Elohim (God), the earth also, with all that therein is.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:16: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:15: Only Yahuah (LORD) had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|10:18: He does execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loves the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
