live.canon|deuteronomy|28:10: And all people of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of Yahuah (LORD); and they shall be afraid of you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:11: And Yahuah (LORD) shall make you plenteous in goods, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers to give you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:12: Yahuah (LORD) shall open unto you his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto your land in his season, and to bless all the work of your hand: and you shall lend unto many nations, and you shall not borrow.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:13: And Yahuah (LORD) shall make you the head, and not the tail; and you shall be above only, and you shall not be beneath; if that you hearken unto the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which I command you this day, to observe and to do them:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:14: And you shall not go aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:15: But it shall come to pass, if you will not hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you this day; that all these curses shall come upon you, and overtake you:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:16: Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:17: Cursed shall be your basket and your store.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:18: Cursed shall be the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your land, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:19: Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:20: Yahuah (LORD) shall send upon you cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that you set your hand unto for to do, until you be destroyed, and until you perish quickly; because of the wickedness of your doings, whereby you have forsaken me.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:21: Yahuah (LORD) shall make the pestilence cleave unto you, until he have consumed you from off the land, whither you go to possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:22: Yahuah (LORD) shall smite you with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue you until you perish.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:23: And your heaven that is over your head shall be brass, and the earth that is under you shall be iron.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:24: Yahuah (LORD) shall make the rain of your land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon you, until you be destroyed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:25: Yahuah (LORD) shall cause you to be smitten before your enemies: you shall go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shall be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:26: And your carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:27: Yahuah (LORD) will smite you with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof you can not be healed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:28: Yahuah (LORD) shall smite you with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:29: And you shall grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways: and you shall be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:30: You shall betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: you shall build an house, and you shall not dwell therein: you shall plant a vineyard, and shall not gather the grapes thereof.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:31: Your ox shall be slain before your eyes, and you shall not eat thereof: your ass shall be violently taken away from before your face, and shall not be restored to you: your sheep shall be given unto your enemies, and you shall have none to rescue them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:32: Your sons and your daughters shall be given unto another people, and your eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in your hand.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:33: The fruit of your land, and all your labours, shall a nation which you know not eat up; and you shall be only oppressed and crushed alway:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:34: So that you shall be mad for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:35: Yahuah (LORD) shall smite you in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot unto the top of your head.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:36: Yahuah (LORD) shall bring you, and your king which you shall set over you, unto a nation which neither you nor your fathers have known; and there shall you serve other gods, wood and stone.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:37: And you shall become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither Yahuah (LORD) shall lead you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:38: You shall carry much seed out into the field, and shall gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:39: You shall plant vineyards, and dress them, but shall neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:40: You shall have olive trees throughout all your coasts, but you shall not anoint thyself with the oil; for your olive shall cast his fruit.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:41: You shall beget sons and daughters, but you shall not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:42: All your trees and fruit of your land shall the locust consume.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:43: The stranger that is within you shall get up above you very high; and you shall come down very low.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:50: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:44: He shall lend to you, and you shall not lend to him: he shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:45: Moreover all these curses shall come upon you, and shall pursue you, and overtake you, till you be destroyed; because you hearkenedst not unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:46: And they shall be upon you for a sign and for a wonder, and upon your seed for ever.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:47: Because you servedst not Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:48: Therefore shall you serve your enemies which Yahuah (LORD) shall send against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon your neck, until he have destroyed you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:49: Yahuah (LORD) shall bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue you shall not understand;
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:54: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:51: And he shall eat the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your land, until you be destroyed: which also shall not leave you either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of your kine, or flocks of your sheep, until he have destroyed you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:52: And he shall besiege you in all your gates, until your high and fenced walls come down, wherein you trustedst, throughout all your land: and he shall besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has given you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:53: And you shall eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has given you, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith your enemies shall distress you:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:55: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he has nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith your enemies shall distress you in all your gates.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:56: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:57: And toward her young one that comes out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith your enemy shall distress you in your gates.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:60: Moreover he will bring upon you all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they shall cleave unto you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:58: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE Yahuah (LORD) THY GOD;
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:59: Then Yahuah (LORD) will make your plagues wonderful, and the plagues of your seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:61: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will Yahuah (LORD) bring upon you, until you be destroyed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:62: And you shall be left few in number, whereas you were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because you would not obey the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:63: And it shall come to pass, that as Yahuah (LORD) rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so Yahuah (LORD) will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and you shall be plucked from off the land whither you go to possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:64: And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter you among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there you shall serve other gods, which neither you nor your fathers have known, even wood and stone.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:65: And among these nations shall you find no ease, neither shall the sole of your foot have rest: but Yahuah (LORD) shall give you there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:66: And your life shall hang in doubt before you; and you shall fear day and night, and shall have none assurance of your life:
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:67: In the morning you shall say, Would Elohim (God) it were even! and at even you shall say, Would Elohim (God) it were morning! for the fear of your heart wherewith you shall fear, and for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.
live.canon|deuteronomy|28:68: And Yahuah (LORD) shall bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto you, You shall see it no more again: and there you shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:1: These are the words of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses to make with the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:2: And Moses called unto all Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto them, You have seen all that Yahuah (LORD) did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:3: The great temptations which your eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:4: Yet Yahuah (LORD) has not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:5: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and your shoe is not waxen old upon your foot.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:6: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink: that you might know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:7: And when you came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:8: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:9: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:10: You stand this day all of you before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Yashar'el (Israel),
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:11: Your little ones, your wives, and your stranger that is in your camp, from the hewer of your wood unto the drawer of your water:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:12: That you should enter into covenant with Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and into his oath, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) makes with you this day:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:13: That he may establish you to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto you a Elohim (God), as he has said unto you, and as he has sworn unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:14: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:15: But with him that stands here with us this day before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and also with him that is not here with us this day:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:16: (For you know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which you passed by;
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:17: And you have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:18: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away this day from Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that bears gall and wormwood;
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:19: And it come to pass, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of my heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:20: Yahuah (LORD) will not spare him, but then the anger of Yahuah (LORD) and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and Yahuah (LORD) shall blot out his name from under heaven.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:21: And Yahuah (LORD) shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:22: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which Yahuah (LORD) has laid upon it;
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:23: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor bears, nor any grass grows therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which Yahuah (LORD) overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:24: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:25: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:26: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:27: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:28: And Yahuah (LORD) rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|29:29: The secret things belong unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:1: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has driven you,
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:2: And shall return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shall obey his voice according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:3: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:4: If any of yours be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather you, and from thence will he fetch you:
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:5: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it; and he will do you good, and multiply you above your fathers.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:6: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your seed, to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, that you may live.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:7: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will put all these curses upon your enemies, and on them that hate you, which persecuted you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:8: And you shall return and obey the voice of Yahuah (LORD), and do all his commandments which I command you this day.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:9: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will make you plenteous in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your land, for good: for Yahuah (LORD) will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers:
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:10: If you shall hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if you turn unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:11: For this commandment which I command you this day, it is not hidden from you, neither is it far off.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:12: It is not in heaven, that you should say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:13: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:14: But the word is very nigh unto you, in your mouth, and in your heart, that you may do it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:15: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:16: In that I command you this day to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that you may live and multiply: and Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bless you in the land whither you go to possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:17: But if your heart turn away, so that you will not hear, but shall be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:18: I denounce unto you this day, that you shall surely perish, and that you shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither you passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:19: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:
live.canon|deuteronomy|30:20: That you may love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that you may obey his voice, and that you may cleave unto him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: that you may dwell in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:1: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:4: And Yahuah (LORD) shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:2: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also Yahuah (LORD) has said unto me, You shall not go over this Jordan.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:3: Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God), he will go over before you, and he will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before you, as Yahuah (LORD) has said.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:5: And Yahuah (LORD) shall give them up before your face, that you may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

live.canon|deuteronomy|31:6: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), he it is that does go with you; he will not fail you, nor forsake you.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:7: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel), Be strong and of a good courage: for you must go with this people unto the land which Yahuah (LORD) has sworn unto their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

live.canon|deuteronomy|31:11: When all Yashar'el (Israel) is come to appear before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in the place which he shall choose, you shall read this law before all Yashar'el (Israel) in their hearing.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:12: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and your stranger that is within your gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and observe to do all the words of this law:
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:13: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as long as you live in the land whither you go over Jordan to possess it.

And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:15: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:17: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our Elohim (God) is not among us?
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:16: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:18: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:19: Now therefore write you this song for you, and teach it the children of Yashar'el (Israel): put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Yashar'el (Israel).

live.canon|deuteronomy|31:21: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:22: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Yashar'el (Israel).

live.canon|deuteronomy|31:26: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), that it may be there for a witness against you.

live.canon|deuteronomy|31:28: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:30: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) the words of this song, until they were ended.
live.canon|deuteronomy|31:29: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because you will do evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

live.canon|deuteronomy|32:19: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

live.canon|deuteronomy|32:22: For a fire is kindled in my anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
live.canon|deuteronomy|32:23: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend my arrows upon them.

live.canon|deuteronomy|32:28: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

live.canon|deuteronomy|32:34: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

live.canon|deuteronomy|34:5: So Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).

live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:2: Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:3: What profit has a man of all his labour which he takes under the sun?
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:4: One generation passes away, and another generation comes: but the earth abides for ever.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:5: The sun also arises, and the sun goes down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:6: The wind goes toward the south, and turns about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returns again according to his circuits.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:9: The thing that has been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:10: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it has been already of old time, which was before us.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:13: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail has Elohim (God) given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:1: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:7: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:8: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:11: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:12: I the Preacher was king over Yashar'el (Israel) in Jerusalem.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:14: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:15: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:17: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:16: I communed with my own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|1:18: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increases knowledge increases sorrow.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:2: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What does it?
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:3: I sought in my heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting my heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:6: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that brings forth trees:
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:10: And whatsoever my eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:12: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that comes after the king? even that which has been already done.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:14: The wise man’s eyes are in his head; but the fool walks in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:16: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dies the wise man? as the fool.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:19: And who knows whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:21: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that has not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:22: For what has man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he has laboured under the sun?
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:23: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart takes not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:26: For Elohim (God) gives to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before Elohim (God). This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:4: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:5: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:7: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:8: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:9: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:11: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:13: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:15: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:17: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:18: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:20: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:24: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of Elohim (God).

live.canon|ecclesiastes|2:1: I said in my heart, Go to now, I will prove you with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:9: What profit has he that works in that wherein he laboureth?
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:10: I have seen the travail, which Elohim (God) has given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:11: He has made every thing beautiful in his time: also he has set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that Elohim (God) makes from the beginning to the end.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:14: I know that, whatsoever Elohim (God) does, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and Elohim (God) does it, that men should fear before him.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:15: That which has been is now; and that which is to be has already been; and Elohim (God) requires that which is past.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:17: I said in my heart, Elohim (God) shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:18: I said in my heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that Elohim (God) might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:19: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dies, so dies the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man has no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:21: Who knows the spirit of man that goes upward, and the spirit of the beast that goes downward to the earth?
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:1: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:2: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:3: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:4: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:5: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:6: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:7: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:8: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:12: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:13: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of Elohim (God).
live.canon|ecclesiastes|3:16: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

live.canon|ecclesiastes|5:1: Keep your foot when you go to the house of Elohim (God), and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|5:2: Be not rash with your mouth, and let not your heart be hasty to utter any thing before Elohim (God): for Elohim (God) is in heaven, and you upon earth: therefore let your words be few.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|5:3: For a dream comes through the multitude of business; and a fool’s voice is known by multitude of words.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|5:4: When you vowest a vow unto Elohim (God), defer not to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools: pay that which you have vowed.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|5:5: Better is it that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

live.canon|ecclesiastes|6:9: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|6:11: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
live.canon|ecclesiastes|6:4: For he comes in with vanity, and departs in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.

live.canon|ecclesiastes|7:13: Consider the work of Elohim (God): for who can make that straight, which he has made crooked?
live.canon|ecclesiastes|7:14: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: Elohim (God) also has set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.

live.canon|ecclesiastes|7:18: It is good that you should take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not your hand: for he that fears Elohim (God) shall come forth of them all.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|7:20: For there is not a just man upon earth, that does good, and sins not.

live.canon|ecclesiastes|7:3: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|7:4: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

live.canon|ecclesiastes|8:5: Whoso keeps the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man’s heart discerneth both time and judgment.

live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:8: Vanity of vanities, says the preacher; all is vanity.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:2: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:3: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:4: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:6: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:7: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto Elohim (God) who gave it.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:9: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:10: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:11: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:12: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:13: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear Elohim (God), and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
live.canon|ecclesiastes|12:14: For Elohim (God) shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
live.canon|exodus|1:10: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falls out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
live.canon|exodus|1:16: And he said, When you do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then you shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
live.canon|exodus|1:18: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have you done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
live.canon|exodus|1:22: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.
live.canon|exodus|1:1: Now these are the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
live.canon|exodus|1:4: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
live.canon|exodus|1:5: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
live.canon|exodus|1:6: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
live.canon|exodus|1:7: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
live.canon|exodus|1:8: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
live.canon|exodus|1:9: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) are more and mightier than we:
live.canon|exodus|1:11: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
live.canon|exodus|1:12: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|1:13: And the Egyptians made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to serve with rigour:
live.canon|exodus|1:14: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
live.canon|exodus|1:15: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
live.canon|exodus|1:17: But the midwives feared Elohim (God), and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
live.canon|exodus|1:19: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
live.canon|exodus|1:20: Therefore Elohim (God) dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
live.canon|exodus|1:21: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared Elohim (God), that he made them houses.
live.canon|exodus|2:7: Then said his sister to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and call to you a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?
live.canon|exodus|2:9: And Pharaoh’s daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give you your wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
live.canon|exodus|2:13: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest you your fellow?
live.canon|exodus|2:14: And he said, Who made you a prince and a judge over us? intendest you to kill me, as you killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
live.canon|exodus|2:18: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that you are come so soon to day?
live.canon|exodus|2:20: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that you have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
live.canon|exodus|2:1: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
live.canon|exodus|2:2: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
live.canon|exodus|2:3: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.
live.canon|exodus|2:4: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
live.canon|exodus|2:5: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river’s side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
live.canon|exodus|2:6: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews’ children.
live.canon|exodus|2:8: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child’s mother.
live.canon|exodus|2:10: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
live.canon|exodus|2:11: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
live.canon|exodus|2:12: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
live.canon|exodus|2:15: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
live.canon|exodus|2:16: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
live.canon|exodus|2:17: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
live.canon|exodus|2:19: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
live.canon|exodus|2:21: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
live.canon|exodus|2:22: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
live.canon|exodus|2:23: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto Elohim (God) by reason of the bondage.
live.canon|exodus|2:24: And Elohim (God) heard their groaning, and Elohim (God) remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
live.canon|exodus|2:25: And Elohim (God) looked upon the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and Elohim (God) had respect unto them.
live.canon|exodus|3:5: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off your shoes from off your feet, for the place whereon you stand is holy ground.
live.canon|exodus|3:6: Moreover he said, I am the Elohim (God) of your father, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|3:10: Come now therefore, and I will send you unto Pharaoh, that you may bring forth my people the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|3:12: And he said, Certainly I will be with you; and this shall be a token unto you, that I have sent you: When you have brought forth the people out of Egypt, you shall serve Elohim (God) upon this mountain.
live.canon|exodus|3:13: And Moses said unto Elohim (God), Behold, when I come unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall say unto them, The Elohim (God) of your fathers has sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
live.canon|exodus|3:14: And Elohim (God) said unto Moses, Ehyeh asher Ehyeh (I AM THAT I AM): and he said, Thus shall you say unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), I AM has sent me unto you.
live.canon|exodus|3:15: And Elohim (God) said moreover unto Moses, Thus shall you say unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of your fathers, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob, has sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
live.canon|exodus|3:18: And they shall hearken to your voice: and you shall come, you and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), unto the king of Egypt, and you shall say unto him, Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of the Hebrews has met with us: and now let us go, we beseech you, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|exodus|3:21: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when you go, you shall not go empty:
live.canon|exodus|3:22: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourns in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and you shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and you shall spoil the Egyptians.
live.canon|exodus|3:1: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of Elohim (God), even to Horeb.
live.canon|exodus|3:2: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
live.canon|exodus|3:3: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
live.canon|exodus|3:4: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that he turned aside to see, Elohim (God) called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
live.canon|exodus|3:7: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
live.canon|exodus|3:8: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
live.canon|exodus|3:9: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
live.canon|exodus|3:11: And Moses said unto Elohim (God), Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt?
live.canon|exodus|3:16: Go, and gather the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) together, and say unto them, Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of your fathers, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
live.canon|exodus|3:17: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
live.canon|exodus|3:19: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
live.canon|exodus|3:20: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
live.canon|exodus|4:1: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, Yahuah (LORD) has not appeared unto you.
live.canon|exodus|4:2: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, What is that in your hand? And he said, A rod.
live.canon|exodus|4:4: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Put forth your hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
live.canon|exodus|4:5: That they may believe that Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob, has appeared unto you.
live.canon|exodus|4:6: And Yahuah (LORD) said furthermore unto him, Put now your hand into your bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
live.canon|exodus|4:7: And he said, Put your hand into your bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
live.canon|exodus|4:8: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe you, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
live.canon|exodus|4:9: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which you take out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
live.canon|exodus|4:10: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since you have spoken unto your servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
live.canon|exodus|4:11: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Who has made man’s mouth? or who makes the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|exodus|4:12: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall say.
live.canon|exodus|4:13: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray you, by the hand of him whom you will send.
live.canon|exodus|4:14: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he comes forth to meet you: and when he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
live.canon|exodus|4:15: And you shall speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.
live.canon|exodus|4:16: And he shall be your spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to you instead of a mouth, and you shall be to him instead of Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|4:17: And you shall take this rod in your hand, wherewith you shall do signs.
live.canon|exodus|4:18: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray you, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
live.canon|exodus|4:19: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought your life.
live.canon|exodus|4:21: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, When you go to return into Egypt, see that you do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in your hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
live.canon|exodus|4:22: And you shall say unto Pharaoh, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Yashar'el (Israel) is my son, even my firstborn:
live.canon|exodus|4:23: And I say unto you, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if you refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay your son, even your firstborn.
live.canon|exodus|4:25: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband are you to me.
live.canon|exodus|4:26: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband you are, because of the circumcision.
live.canon|exodus|4:3: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
live.canon|exodus|4:20: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of Elohim (God) in his hand.
live.canon|exodus|4:24: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that Yahuah (LORD) met him, and sought to kill him.
live.canon|exodus|4:27: And Yahuah (LORD) said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of Elohim (God), and kissed him.
live.canon|exodus|4:28: And Moses told Aaron all the words of Yahuah (LORD) who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
live.canon|exodus|4:29: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|exodus|4:30: And Aaron spake all the words which Yahuah (LORD) had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
live.canon|exodus|4:31: And the people believed: and when they heard that Yahuah (LORD) had visited the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
live.canon|exodus|5:1: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
live.canon|exodus|5:3: And they said, The Elohim (God) of the Hebrews has met with us: let us go, we pray you, three days’ journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God); lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
live.canon|exodus|5:4: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do you, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
live.canon|exodus|5:5: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and you make them rest from their burdens.
live.canon|exodus|5:7: You shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
live.canon|exodus|5:8: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, you shall lay upon them; you shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|5:10: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus says Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
live.canon|exodus|5:11: Go you, get you straw where you can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
live.canon|exodus|5:14: And the officers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have you not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
live.canon|exodus|5:15: Then the officers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest you thus with your servants?
live.canon|exodus|5:17: But he said, You are idle, you are idle: therefore you say, Let us go and do sacrifice to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|5:19: And the officers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, You shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
live.canon|exodus|5:21: And they said unto them, Yahuah (LORD) look upon you, and judge; because you have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
live.canon|exodus|5:23: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has done evil to this people; neither have you delivered your people at all.
live.canon|exodus|5:2: And Pharaoh said, Who is Yahuah (LORD), that I should obey his voice to let Yashar'el (Israel) go? I know not Yahuah (LORD), neither will I let Yashar'el (Israel) go.
live.canon|exodus|5:6: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
live.canon|exodus|5:9: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
live.canon|exodus|5:12: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
live.canon|exodus|5:13: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
live.canon|exodus|5:20: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
live.canon|exodus|5:18: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall you deliver the tale of bricks.
live.canon|exodus|5:16: There is no straw given unto your servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.
live.canon|exodus|5:22: And Moses returned unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, Adonai (Lord), wherefore have you so evil entreated this people? why is it that you have sent me?
live.canon|exodus|6:1: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Now shall you see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
live.canon|exodus|6:7: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a Elohim (God): and you shall know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
live.canon|exodus|6:29: That Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying, I am Yahuah (LORD): speak you unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto you.
live.canon|exodus|6:2: And Elohim (God) spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|exodus|6:3: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of El Shaddai (God Almighty), but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
live.canon|exodus|6:4: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
live.canon|exodus|6:5: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
live.canon|exodus|6:6: Wherefore say unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), I am Yahuah (LORD), and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
live.canon|exodus|6:8: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|6:9: And Moses spake so unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
live.canon|exodus|6:10: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|6:11: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Yashar'el (Israel) go out of his land.
live.canon|exodus|6:12: And Moses spake before Yahuah (LORD), saying, Behold, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
live.canon|exodus|6:13: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|6:14: These be the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Yashar'el (Israel); Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
live.canon|exodus|6:15: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
live.canon|exodus|6:16: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
live.canon|exodus|6:17: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
live.canon|exodus|6:18: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
live.canon|exodus|6:19: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
live.canon|exodus|6:20: And Amram took him Jochebed his father’s sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
live.canon|exodus|6:21: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
live.canon|exodus|6:22: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
live.canon|exodus|6:23: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
live.canon|exodus|6:24: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
live.canon|exodus|6:25: And Eleazar Aaron’s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
live.canon|exodus|6:26: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom Yahuah (LORD) said, Bring out the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
live.canon|exodus|6:27: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
live.canon|exodus|6:28: And it came to pass on the day when Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
live.canon|exodus|6:30: And Moses said before Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
live.canon|exodus|7:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, See, I have made you a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
live.canon|exodus|7:2: You shall speak all that I command you: and Aaron your brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of his land.
live.canon|exodus|7:4: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth my armies, and my people the children of Yashar'el (Israel), out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
live.canon|exodus|7:5: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I stretch forth my hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among them.
live.canon|exodus|7:9: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then you shall say unto Aaron, Take your rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
live.canon|exodus|7:14: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Pharaoh’s heart is hardened, he refuses to let the people go.
live.canon|exodus|7:15: Get you unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goes out unto the water; and you shall stand by the river’s brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shall you take in your hand.
live.canon|exodus|7:16: And you shall say unto him, Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of the Hebrews has sent me unto you, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto you would not hear.
live.canon|exodus|7:17: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), In this you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD): behold, I will smite with the rod that is in my hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
live.canon|exodus|7:19: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take your rod, and stretch out your hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.
live.canon|exodus|7:3: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|7:6: And Moses and Aaron did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded them, so did they.
live.canon|exodus|7:7: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
live.canon|exodus|7:8: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|exodus|7:10: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
live.canon|exodus|7:11: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
live.canon|exodus|7:12: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.
live.canon|exodus|7:13: And he hardened Pharaoh’s heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as Yahuah (LORD) had said.
live.canon|exodus|7:18: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
live.canon|exodus|7:20: And Moses and Aaron did so, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
live.canon|exodus|7:21: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|7:22: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as Yahuah (LORD) had said.
live.canon|exodus|7:23: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
live.canon|exodus|7:24: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
live.canon|exodus|7:25: And seven days were fulfilled, after that Yahuah (LORD) had smitten the river.
live.canon|exodus|8:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Let my people go, that they may serve me.
live.canon|exodus|8:3: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into your house, and into your bedchamber, and upon your bed, and into the house of your servants, and upon your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneadingtroughs:
live.canon|exodus|8:4: And the frogs shall come up both on you, and upon your people, and upon all your servants.
live.canon|exodus|8:5: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth your hand with your rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|8:9: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for you, and for your servants, and for your people, to destroy the frogs from you and your houses, that they may remain in the river only?
live.canon|exodus|8:10: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to your word: that you may know that there is none like unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|exodus|8:11: And the frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people; they shall remain in the river only.
live.canon|exodus|8:16: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out your rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|8:20: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he comes forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Let my people go, that they may serve me.
live.canon|exodus|8:21: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon you, and upon your servants, and upon your people, and into your houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
live.canon|exodus|8:22: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end you may know that I am Yahuah (LORD) in the midst of the earth.
live.canon|exodus|8:23: And I will put a division between my people and your people: to morrow shall this sign be.
live.canon|exodus|8:25: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go you, sacrifice to your Elohim (God) in the land.
live.canon|exodus|8:28: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) in the wilderness; only you shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
live.canon|exodus|8:29: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from you, and I will intreat Yahuah (LORD) that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|8:6: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|8:7: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|8:8: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat Yahuah (LORD), that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|8:12: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto Yahuah (LORD) because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
live.canon|exodus|8:2: And if you refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all your borders with frogs:
live.canon|exodus|8:13: And Yahuah (LORD) did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
live.canon|exodus|8:14: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
live.canon|exodus|8:15: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as Yahuah (LORD) had said.
live.canon|exodus|8:17: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|8:18: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
live.canon|exodus|8:19: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of Elohim (God): and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as Yahuah (LORD) had said.
live.canon|exodus|8:24: And Yahuah (LORD) did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.
live.canon|exodus|8:26: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
live.canon|exodus|8:27: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), as he shall command us.
live.canon|exodus|8:30: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|8:31: And Yahuah (LORD) did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
live.canon|exodus|8:32: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
live.canon|exodus|9:1: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
live.canon|exodus|9:2: For if you refuse to let them go, and will hold them still,
live.canon|exodus|9:3: Behold, the hand of Yahuah (LORD) is upon your cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.
live.canon|exodus|9:13: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
live.canon|exodus|9:14: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon your heart, and upon your servants, and upon your people; that you may know that there is none like me in all the earth.
live.canon|exodus|9:15: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite you and your people with pestilence; and you shall be cut off from the earth.
live.canon|exodus|9:16: And in very deed for this cause have I raised you up, for to shew in you my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
live.canon|exodus|9:17: As yet exaltest you thyself against my people, that you will not let them go?
live.canon|exodus|9:18: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
live.canon|exodus|9:19: Send therefore now, and gather your cattle, and all that you have in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
live.canon|exodus|9:22: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Stretch forth your hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|9:28: Intreat Yahuah (LORD) (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.
live.canon|exodus|9:29: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto Yahuah (LORD); and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that you may know how that the earth is the LORD’S.
live.canon|exodus|9:30: But as for you and your servants, I know that you will not yet fear Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God).
live.canon|exodus|9:4: And Yahuah (LORD) shall sever between the cattle of Yashar'el (Israel) and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children’s of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|9:5: And Yahuah (LORD) appointed a set time, saying, To morrow Yahuah (LORD) shall do this thing in the land.
live.canon|exodus|9:6: And Yahuah (LORD) did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) died not one.
live.canon|exodus|9:7: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
live.canon|exodus|9:8: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
