live.canon|exodus|9:9: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|9:10: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
live.canon|exodus|9:11: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
live.canon|exodus|9:12: And Yahuah (LORD) hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as Yahuah (LORD) had spoken unto Moses.
live.canon|exodus|9:20: He that feared the word of Yahuah (LORD) among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
live.canon|exodus|9:21: And he that regarded not the word of Yahuah (LORD) left his servants and his cattle in the field.
live.canon|exodus|9:23: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and Yahuah (LORD) sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and Yahuah (LORD) rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|9:24: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
live.canon|exodus|9:25: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
live.canon|exodus|9:26: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were, was there no hail.
live.canon|exodus|9:27: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: Yahuah (LORD) is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
live.canon|exodus|9:31: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.
live.canon|exodus|9:32: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
live.canon|exodus|9:33: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto Yahuah (LORD): and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
live.canon|exodus|9:34: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
live.canon|exodus|9:35: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Yashar'el (Israel) go; as Yahuah (LORD) had spoken by Moses.
live.canon|exodus|10:2: And that you may tell in the ears of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know how that I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|10:3: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of the Hebrews, How long will you refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
live.canon|exodus|10:4: Else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into your coast:
live.canon|exodus|10:5: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remains unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field:
live.canon|exodus|10:6: And they shall fill your houses, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither your fathers, nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.
live.canon|exodus|10:7: And Pharaoh’s servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God): know you not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
live.canon|exodus|10:11: Not so: go now you that are men, and serve Yahuah (LORD); for that you did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.
live.canon|exodus|10:12: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.
live.canon|exodus|10:17: Now therefore forgive, I pray you, my sin only this once, and intreat Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), that he may take away from me this death only.
live.canon|exodus|10:21: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Stretch out your hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.
live.canon|exodus|10:24: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go you, serve Yahuah (LORD); only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.
live.canon|exodus|10:25: And Moses said, You must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|exodus|10:28: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get you from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day you see my face you shall die.
live.canon|exodus|10:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:
live.canon|exodus|10:8: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): but who are they that shall go?
live.canon|exodus|10:9: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|10:10: And he said unto them, Let Yahuah (LORD) be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.
live.canon|exodus|10:13: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and Yahuah (LORD) brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
live.canon|exodus|10:14: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.
live.canon|exodus|10:15: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|10:16: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and against you.
live.canon|exodus|10:18: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|10:19: And Yahuah (LORD) turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|10:20: But Yahuah (LORD) hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Yashar'el (Israel) go.
live.canon|exodus|10:22: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
live.canon|exodus|10:23: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) had light in their dwellings.
live.canon|exodus|10:26: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God); and we know not with what we must serve Yahuah (LORD), until we come thither.
live.canon|exodus|10:27: But Yahuah (LORD) hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.
live.canon|exodus|10:29: And Moses said, You have spoken well, I will see your face again no more.
live.canon|exodus|11:4: And Moses said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
live.canon|exodus|11:5: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sits upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
live.canon|exodus|11:7: But against any of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that you may know how that Yahuah (LORD) does put a difference between the Egyptians and Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|11:8: And all these your servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get you out, and all the people that follow you: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.
live.canon|exodus|11:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
live.canon|exodus|11:2: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
live.canon|exodus|11:3: And Yahuah (LORD) gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.
live.canon|exodus|11:6: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
live.canon|exodus|11:9: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|11:10: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and Yahuah (LORD) hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Yashar'el (Israel) go out of his land.
live.canon|exodus|12:3: Speak you unto all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
live.canon|exodus|12:5: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: you shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
live.canon|exodus|12:6: And you shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall kill it in the evening.
live.canon|exodus|12:10: And you shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.
live.canon|exodus|12:11: And thus shall you eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD’S passover.
live.canon|exodus|12:13: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where you are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|12:14: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and you shall keep it a feast to Yahuah (LORD) throughout your generations; you shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
live.canon|exodus|12:15: Seven days shall you eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|12:17: And you shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall you observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
live.canon|exodus|12:18: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
live.canon|exodus|12:19: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eats that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
live.canon|exodus|12:20: You shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall you eat unleavened bread.
live.canon|exodus|12:22: And you shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
live.canon|exodus|12:23: For Yahuah (LORD) will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, Yahuah (LORD) will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
live.canon|exodus|12:24: And you shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons for ever.
live.canon|exodus|12:25: And it shall come to pass, when you be come to the land which Yahuah (LORD) will give you, according as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.
live.canon|exodus|12:26: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean you by this service?
live.canon|exodus|12:27: That you shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD’S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
live.canon|exodus|12:31: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both you and the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and go, serve Yahuah (LORD), as you have said.
live.canon|exodus|12:32: Also take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
live.canon|exodus|12:44: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
live.canon|exodus|12:46: In one house shall it be eaten; you shall not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall you break a bone thereof.
live.canon|exodus|12:48: And when a stranger shall sojourn with you, and will keep the passover to Yahuah (LORD), let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
live.canon|exodus|12:49: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourns among you.
live.canon|exodus|12:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
live.canon|exodus|12:2: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
live.canon|exodus|12:4: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
live.canon|exodus|12:7: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
live.canon|exodus|12:8: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
live.canon|exodus|12:9: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
live.canon|exodus|12:12: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|12:16: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
live.canon|exodus|12:21: Then Moses called for all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
live.canon|exodus|12:28: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went away, and did as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
live.canon|exodus|12:29: And it came to pass, that at midnight Yahuah (LORD) smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
live.canon|exodus|12:30: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
live.canon|exodus|12:33: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
live.canon|exodus|12:34: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
live.canon|exodus|12:35: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
live.canon|exodus|12:36: And Yahuah (LORD) gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
live.canon|exodus|12:37: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
live.canon|exodus|12:38: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
live.canon|exodus|12:39: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
live.canon|exodus|12:40: Now the sojourning of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
live.canon|exodus|12:41: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of Yahuah (LORD) went out from the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|12:42: It is a night to be much observed unto Yahuah (LORD) for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of Yahuah (LORD) to be observed of all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in their generations.
live.canon|exodus|12:43: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
live.canon|exodus|12:45: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
live.canon|exodus|12:47: All the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall keep it.
live.canon|exodus|12:50: Thus did all the children of Yashar'el (Israel); as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
live.canon|exodus|12:51: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that Yahuah (LORD) did bring the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
live.canon|exodus|13:2: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever opens the womb among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), both of man and of beast: it is mine.
live.canon|exodus|13:3: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which you came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand Yahuah (LORD) brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
live.canon|exodus|13:4: This day came you out in the month Abib.
live.canon|exodus|13:5: And it shall be when Yahuah (LORD) shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.
live.canon|exodus|13:6: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|13:7: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with you, neither shall there be leaven seen with you in all your quarters.
live.canon|exodus|13:8: And you shall shew your son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which Yahuah (LORD) did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|13:9: And it shall be for a sign unto you upon your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD’S law may be in your mouth: for with a strong hand has Yahuah (LORD) brought you out of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|13:10: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
live.canon|exodus|13:11: And it shall be when Yahuah (LORD) shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto you and to your fathers, and shall give it you,
live.canon|exodus|13:12: That you shall set apart unto Yahuah (LORD) all that opens the matrix, and every firstling that comes of a beast which you have; the males shall be the LORD’S.
live.canon|exodus|13:13: And every firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among your children shall you redeem.
live.canon|exodus|13:14: And it shall be when your son asks you in time to come, saying, What is this? that you shall say unto him, By strength of hand Yahuah (LORD) brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
live.canon|exodus|13:15: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that Yahuah (LORD) slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to Yahuah (LORD) all that opens the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
live.canon|exodus|13:16: And it shall be for a token upon your hand, and for frontlets between your eyes: for by strength of hand Yahuah (LORD) brought us forth out of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|13:19: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you; and you shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
live.canon|exodus|13:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|13:17: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that Elohim (God) led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for Elohim (God) said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
live.canon|exodus|13:18: But Elohim (God) led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|13:20: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
live.canon|exodus|13:21: And Yahuah (LORD) went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
live.canon|exodus|13:22: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
live.canon|exodus|14:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall you encamp by the sea.
live.canon|exodus|14:3: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), They are entangled in the land, the wilderness has shut them in.
live.canon|exodus|14:11: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore have you dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
live.canon|exodus|14:12: Is not this the word that we did tell you in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
live.canon|exodus|14:13: And Moses said unto the people, Fear you not, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahuah (LORD), which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom you have seen to day, you shall see them again no more for ever.
live.canon|exodus|14:15: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Wherefore cry you unto me? speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they go forward:
live.canon|exodus|14:16: But lift you up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
live.canon|exodus|14:26: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
live.canon|exodus|14:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|14:4: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am Yahuah (LORD). And they did so.
live.canon|exodus|14:5: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Yashar'el (Israel) go from serving us?
live.canon|exodus|14:6: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
live.canon|exodus|14:7: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
live.canon|exodus|14:8: And Yahuah (LORD) hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went out with an high hand.
live.canon|exodus|14:9: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.
live.canon|exodus|14:10: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried out unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|14:17: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
live.canon|exodus|14:18: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
live.canon|exodus|14:19: And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
live.canon|exodus|14:20: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Yashar'el (Israel); and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
live.canon|exodus|14:21: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
live.canon|exodus|14:22: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
live.canon|exodus|14:23: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
live.canon|exodus|14:24: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch Yahuah (LORD) looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
live.canon|exodus|14:25: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Yashar'el (Israel); for Yahuah (LORD) fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
live.canon|exodus|14:14: Yahuah (LORD) shall fight for you, and you shall hold your peace.
live.canon|exodus|14:27: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and Yahuah (LORD) overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
live.canon|exodus|14:28: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
live.canon|exodus|14:29: But the children of Yashar'el (Israel) walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
live.canon|exodus|14:30: Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
live.canon|exodus|14:31: And Yashar'el (Israel) saw that great work which Yahuah (LORD) did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared Yahuah (LORD), and believed Yahuah (LORD), and his servant Moses.
live.canon|exodus|15:1: Then sang Moses and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) this song unto Yahuah (LORD), and spake, saying, I will sing unto Yahuah (LORD), for he has triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider has he thrown into the sea.
live.canon|exodus|15:4: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host has he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
live.canon|exodus|15:6: Your right hand, O Yahuah (LORD), is become glorious in power: your right hand, O Yahuah (LORD), has dashed in pieces the enemy.
live.canon|exodus|15:7: And in the greatness of your excellency you have overthrown them that rose up against you: you sentest forth your wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
live.canon|exodus|15:8: And with the blast of your nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
live.canon|exodus|15:10: You did blow with your wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
live.canon|exodus|15:11: Who is like unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the gods? who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
live.canon|exodus|15:12: You stretchedst out your right hand, the earth swallowed them.
live.canon|exodus|15:13: You in your mercy have led forth the people which you have redeemed: you have guided them in your strength unto your holy habitation.
live.canon|exodus|15:16: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of your arm they shall be as still as a stone; till your people pass over, O Yahuah (LORD), till the people pass over, which you have purchased.
live.canon|exodus|15:21: And Miriam answered them, Sing you to Yahuah (LORD), for he has triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider has he thrown into the sea.
live.canon|exodus|15:26: And said, If you will diligently hearken to the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and will do that which is right in his sight, and will give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon you, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am Yahuah Rapha (the LORD that healeth thee).
live.canon|exodus|15:2: Yahuah (LORD) is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my Elohim (God), and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s Elohim (God), and I will exalt him.
live.canon|exodus|15:3: Yahuah (LORD) is a man of war: Yahuah (LORD) is his name.
live.canon|exodus|15:5: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
live.canon|exodus|15:9: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
live.canon|exodus|15:14: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
live.canon|exodus|15:15: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
live.canon|exodus|15:18: Yahuah (LORD) shall reign for ever and ever.
live.canon|exodus|15:19: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahuah (LORD) brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
live.canon|exodus|15:20: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
live.canon|exodus|15:22: So Moses brought Yashar'el (Israel) from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
live.canon|exodus|15:23: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
live.canon|exodus|15:24: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
live.canon|exodus|15:25: And he cried unto Yahuah (LORD); and Yahuah (LORD) shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
live.canon|exodus|15:27: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
live.canon|exodus|15:17: You shall bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, in the place, O Yahuah (LORD), which you have made for you to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Adonai (Lord), which your hands have established.
live.canon|exodus|16:3: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto them, Would to Elohim (God) we had died by the hand of Yahuah (LORD) in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for you have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
live.canon|exodus|16:6: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), At even, then you shall know that Yahuah (LORD) has brought you out from the land of Egypt:
live.canon|exodus|16:7: And in the morning, then you shall see the glory of Yahuah (LORD); for that he hears your murmurings against Yahuah (LORD): and what are we, that you murmur against us?
live.canon|exodus|16:8: And Moses said, This shall be, when Yahuah (LORD) shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that Yahuah (LORD) hears your murmurings which you murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|16:9: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Come near before Yahuah (LORD): for he has heard your murmurings.
live.canon|exodus|16:12: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): speak unto them, saying, At even you shall eat flesh, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread; and you shall know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|exodus|16:15: And when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which Yahuah (LORD) has given you to eat.
live.canon|exodus|16:16: This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take you every man for them which are in his tents.
live.canon|exodus|16:23: And he said unto them, This is that which Yahuah (LORD) has said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto Yahuah (LORD): bake that which you will bake to day, and seethe that you will seethe; and that which remains over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
live.canon|exodus|16:25: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto Yahuah (LORD): to day you shall not find it in the field.
live.canon|exodus|16:26: Six days you shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
live.canon|exodus|16:28: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, How long refuse you to keep my commandments and my laws?
live.canon|exodus|16:29: See, for that Yahuah (LORD) has given you the sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide you every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
live.canon|exodus|16:32: And Moses said, This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) commands, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|16:1: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|16:2: And the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
live.canon|exodus|16:4: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
live.canon|exodus|16:5: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
live.canon|exodus|16:10: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared in the cloud.
live.canon|exodus|16:11: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|16:13: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
live.canon|exodus|16:14: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
live.canon|exodus|16:17: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
live.canon|exodus|16:18: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
live.canon|exodus|16:19: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
live.canon|exodus|16:20: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
live.canon|exodus|16:21: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
live.canon|exodus|16:22: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
live.canon|exodus|16:24: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
live.canon|exodus|16:27: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
live.canon|exodus|16:30: So the people rested on the seventh day.
live.canon|exodus|16:31: And the house of Yashar'el (Israel) called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
live.canon|exodus|16:33: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before Yahuah (LORD), to be kept for your generations.
live.canon|exodus|16:34: As Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
live.canon|exodus|16:35: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
live.canon|exodus|16:36: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
live.canon|exodus|17:2: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide you with me? wherefore do you tempt Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|exodus|17:3: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that you have brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
live.canon|exodus|17:5: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with you of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel); and your rod, wherewith you struck the river, take in your hand, and go.
live.canon|exodus|17:6: Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb; and you shall smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|17:9: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of Elohim (God) in my hand.
live.canon|exodus|17:16: For he said, Because Yahuah (LORD) has sworn that Yahuah (LORD) will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
live.canon|exodus|17:1: And all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
live.canon|exodus|17:4: And Moses cried unto Yahuah (LORD), saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
live.canon|exodus|17:7: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and because they tempted Yahuah (LORD), saying, Is Yahuah (LORD) among us, or not?
live.canon|exodus|17:8: Then came Amalek, and fought with Yashar'el (Israel) in Rephidim.
live.canon|exodus|17:10: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
live.canon|exodus|17:11: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Yashar'el (Israel) prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
live.canon|exodus|17:12: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
live.canon|exodus|17:13: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
live.canon|exodus|17:14: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
live.canon|exodus|17:15: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Yahuah Nissi (Jehovah-nissi):
live.canon|exodus|18:4: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the Elohim (God) of my father, said he, was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
live.canon|exodus|18:6: And he said unto Moses, I your father in law Jethro am come unto you, and your wife, and her two sons with her.
live.canon|exodus|18:10: And Jethro said, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
live.canon|exodus|18:14: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that you do to the people? why sit you thyself alone, and all the people stand by you from morning unto even?
live.canon|exodus|18:18: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you: for this thing is too heavy for you; you are not able to perform it thyself alone.
live.canon|exodus|18:19: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give you counsel, and Elohim (God) shall be with you: Be you for the people to Elohim (God)-ward, that you may bring the causes unto Elohim (God):
live.canon|exodus|18:20: And you shall teach them ordinances and laws, and shall shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
live.canon|exodus|18:21: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men, such as fear Elohim (God), men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
live.canon|exodus|18:22: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto you, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with you.
live.canon|exodus|18:23: If you shall do this thing, and Elohim (God) command you so, then you shall be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
live.canon|exodus|18:1: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that Elohim (God) had done for Moses, and for Yashar'el (Israel) his people, and that Yahuah (LORD) had brought Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt;
live.canon|exodus|18:2: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,
live.canon|exodus|18:3: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
live.canon|exodus|18:5: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of Elohim (God):
live.canon|exodus|18:7: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
live.canon|exodus|18:8: And Moses told his father in law all that Yahuah (LORD) had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Yashar'el's (Israel’s) sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how Yahuah (LORD) delivered them.
live.canon|exodus|18:9: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahuah (LORD) had done to Yashar'el (Israel), whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
live.canon|exodus|18:11: Now I know that Yahuah (LORD) is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
live.canon|exodus|18:12: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for Elohim (God): and Aaron came, and all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|18:13: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
live.canon|exodus|18:15: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of Elohim (God):
live.canon|exodus|18:16: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of Elohim (God), and his laws.
live.canon|exodus|18:24: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
live.canon|exodus|18:25: And Moses chose able men out of all Yashar'el (Israel), and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
live.canon|exodus|18:26: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
live.canon|exodus|18:27: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
live.canon|exodus|18:17: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that you do is not good.
live.canon|exodus|19:3: And Moses went up unto Elohim (God), and Yahuah (LORD) called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shall you say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|exodus|19:4: You have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.
live.canon|exodus|19:5: Now therefore, if you will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then you shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
live.canon|exodus|19:6: And you shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|19:1: In the third month, when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
live.canon|exodus|19:2: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Yashar'el (Israel) camped before the mount.
live.canon|exodus|19:7: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which Yahuah (LORD) commanded him.
live.canon|exodus|19:10: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
live.canon|exodus|19:11: And be ready against the third day: for the third day Yahuah (LORD) will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
live.canon|exodus|19:13: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
live.canon|exodus|19:14: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
live.canon|exodus|19:15: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
live.canon|exodus|19:16: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
live.canon|exodus|19:17: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with Elohim (God); and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
live.canon|exodus|19:18: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
live.canon|exodus|19:19: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and Elohim (God) answered him by a voice.
live.canon|exodus|19:20: And Yahuah (LORD) came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and Yahuah (LORD) called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
live.canon|exodus|19:21: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto Yahuah (LORD) to gaze, and many of them perish.
live.canon|exodus|19:22: And let the priests also, which come near to Yahuah (LORD), sanctify themselves, lest Yahuah (LORD) break forth upon them.
live.canon|exodus|19:25: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
live.canon|exodus|19:8: And all the people answered together, and said, All that Yahuah (LORD) has spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|19:9: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and believe you for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|19:12: And you shall set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that you go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever touches the mount shall be surely put to death:
live.canon|exodus|19:23: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for you chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
live.canon|exodus|19:24: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Away, get you down, and you shall come up, you, and Aaron with you: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto Yahuah (LORD), lest he break forth upon them.
live.canon|exodus|20:4: You shall not make unto you any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
live.canon|exodus|20:5: You shall not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) am a jealous Elohim (God), visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
live.canon|exodus|20:7: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in vain; for Yahuah (LORD) will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.
live.canon|exodus|20:10: But the seventh day is the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): in it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger that is within your gates:
live.canon|exodus|20:12: Honour your father and your mother: that your days may be long upon the land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you.
live.canon|exodus|20:16: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbour.
live.canon|exodus|20:17: You shall not covet your neighbour’s house, you shall not covet your neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is your neighbour’s.
live.canon|exodus|20:19: And they said unto Moses, Speak you with us, and we will hear: but let not Elohim (God) speak with us, lest we die.
live.canon|exodus|20:20: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for Elohim (God) is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that you sin not.
live.canon|exodus|20:22: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Thus you shall say unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
live.canon|exodus|20:23: You shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall you make unto you gods of gold.
live.canon|exodus|20:24: An altar of earth you shall make unto me, and shall sacrifice thereon your burnt offerings, and your peace offerings, your sheep, and your oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto you, and I will bless you.
live.canon|exodus|20:25: And if you will make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stone: for if you lift up your tool upon it, you have polluted it.
live.canon|exodus|20:26: Neither shall you go up by steps unto my altar, that your nakedness be not discovered thereon.
live.canon|exodus|20:1: And Elohim (God) spake all these words, saying,
live.canon|exodus|20:6: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
live.canon|exodus|20:8: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
live.canon|exodus|20:11: For in six days Yahuah (LORD) made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore Yahuah (LORD) blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
live.canon|exodus|20:18: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
live.canon|exodus|20:2: I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which have brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
live.canon|exodus|20:3: You shall have no other gods before me.
live.canon|exodus|20:9: Six days shall you labour, and do all your work:
live.canon|exodus|20:21: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where Elohim (God) was.
live.canon|exodus|21:2: If you buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
live.canon|exodus|21:1: Now these are the judgments which you shall set before them.
live.canon|exodus|21:8: If she please not her master, who has betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he has dealt deceitfully with her.
live.canon|exodus|21:12: He that smites a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
live.canon|exodus|21:13: And if a man lie not in wait, but Elohim (God) deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint you a place whither he shall flee.
live.canon|exodus|21:14: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
live.canon|exodus|21:15: And he that smites his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
live.canon|exodus|21:17: And he that curses his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|exodus|21:18: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keeps his bed:
live.canon|exodus|21:23: And if any mischief follow, then you shall give life for life,
live.canon|exodus|21:29: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it has been testified to his owner, and he has not kept him in, but that he has killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
live.canon|exodus|21:36: Or if it be known that the ox has used to push in time past, and his owner has not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
live.canon|exodus|21:3: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
live.canon|exodus|21:4: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
live.canon|exodus|21:5: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
live.canon|exodus|21:6: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
live.canon|exodus|21:7: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
live.canon|exodus|21:9: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
live.canon|exodus|21:10: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
live.canon|exodus|21:11: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
live.canon|exodus|21:16: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|exodus|21:19: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
live.canon|exodus|21:20: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
live.canon|exodus|21:21: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
live.canon|exodus|21:22: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
live.canon|exodus|21:24: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
live.canon|exodus|21:25: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
live.canon|exodus|21:26: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
live.canon|exodus|21:27: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
live.canon|exodus|21:28: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
live.canon|exodus|21:30: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
live.canon|exodus|21:31: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
live.canon|exodus|21:32: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
live.canon|exodus|21:33: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
live.canon|exodus|21:34: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
live.canon|exodus|21:35: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
live.canon|exodus|22:29: You shall not delay to offer the first of your ripe fruits, and of your liquors: the firstborn of your sons shall you give unto me.
live.canon|exodus|22:30: Likewise shall you do with your oxen, and with your sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day you shall give it me.
live.canon|exodus|22:31: And you shall be holy men unto me: neither shall you eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; you shall cast it to the dogs.
live.canon|exodus|22:1: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
live.canon|exodus|22:2: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
live.canon|exodus|22:3: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
live.canon|exodus|22:4: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
live.canon|exodus|22:5: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
live.canon|exodus|22:6: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
live.canon|exodus|22:7: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
live.canon|exodus|22:8: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.
live.canon|exodus|22:9: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
live.canon|exodus|22:10: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
live.canon|exodus|22:12: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
live.canon|exodus|22:13: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
live.canon|exodus|22:14: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
live.canon|exodus|22:15: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
live.canon|exodus|22:16: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
live.canon|exodus|22:17: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
live.canon|exodus|22:20: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto Yahuah (LORD) only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
live.canon|exodus|22:24: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
live.canon|exodus|22:11: Then shall an oath of Yahuah (LORD) be between them both, that he has not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
live.canon|exodus|22:18: You shall not suffer a witch to live.
live.canon|exodus|22:19: Whosoever lies with a beast shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|exodus|22:21: You shall neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|22:22: You shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
live.canon|exodus|22:23: If you afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
live.canon|exodus|22:25: If you lend money to any of my people that is poor by you, you shall not be to him as an usurer, neither shall you lay upon him usury.
live.canon|exodus|22:26: If you at all take your neighbour’s raiment to pledge, you shall deliver it unto him by that the sun goes down:
live.canon|exodus|22:27: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he cries unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
live.canon|exodus|22:28: You shall not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of your people.
live.canon|exodus|23:1: You shall not raise a false report: put not your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
live.canon|exodus|23:2: You shall not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shall you speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
live.canon|exodus|23:3: Neither shall you countenance a poor man in his cause.
live.canon|exodus|23:4: If you meet your enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
live.canon|exodus|23:5: If you see the ass of him that hates you lying under his burden, and would forbear to help him, you shall surely help with him.
live.canon|exodus|23:6: You shall not wrest the judgment of your poor in his cause.
live.canon|exodus|23:7: Keep you far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay you not: for I will not justify the wicked.
live.canon|exodus|23:8: And you shall take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous.
live.canon|exodus|23:9: Also you shall not oppress a stranger: for you know the heart of a stranger, seeing you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|23:10: And six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in the fruits thereof:
live.canon|exodus|23:11: But the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie still; that the poor of your people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner you shall deal with your vineyard, and with your oliveyard.
live.canon|exodus|23:12: Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest: that your ox and your ass may rest, and the son of your handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
live.canon|exodus|23:13: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of your mouth.
live.canon|exodus|23:15: You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread: (you shall eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded you, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it you came out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
live.canon|exodus|23:16: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of your labours, which you have sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when you have gathered in your labours out of the field.
live.canon|exodus|23:17: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|exodus|23:18: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
live.canon|exodus|23:19: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring into the house of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God). You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
live.canon|exodus|23:20: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
live.canon|exodus|23:22: But if you shall indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto your enemies, and an adversary unto your adversaries.
live.canon|exodus|23:23: For my Angel shall go before you, and bring you in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
live.canon|exodus|23:24: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but you shall utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
live.canon|exodus|23:25: And you shall serve Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and he shall bless your bread, and your water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of you.
live.canon|exodus|23:26: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in your land: the number of your days I will fulfil.
live.canon|exodus|23:27: I will send my fear before you, and will destroy all the people to whom you shall come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs unto you.
live.canon|exodus|23:28: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
live.canon|exodus|23:29: I will not drive them out from before you in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against you.
live.canon|exodus|23:30: By little and little I will drive them out from before you, until you be increased, and inherit the land.
live.canon|exodus|23:31: And I will set your bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and you shall drive them out before you.
live.canon|exodus|23:32: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
live.canon|exodus|23:33: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me: for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto you.
live.canon|exodus|23:21: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
live.canon|exodus|23:14: Three times you shall keep a feast unto me in the year.
live.canon|exodus|24:1: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto Yahuah (LORD), you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel); and worship you afar off.
live.canon|exodus|24:3: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Yahuah (LORD), and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which Yahuah (LORD) has said will we do.
live.canon|exodus|24:7: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that Yahuah (LORD) has said will we do, and be obedient.
live.canon|exodus|24:8: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) has made with you concerning all these words.
live.canon|exodus|24:12: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give you tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that you may teach them.
live.canon|exodus|24:14: And he said unto the elders, Tarry you here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
live.canon|exodus|24:2: And Moses alone shall come near Yahuah (LORD): but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
live.canon|exodus|24:4: And Moses wrote all the words of Yahuah (LORD), and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|24:5: And he sent young men of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|24:6: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
live.canon|exodus|24:9: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|exodus|24:10: And they saw the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel): and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
live.canon|exodus|24:11: And upon the nobles of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) he laid not his hand: also they saw Elohim (God), and did eat and drink.
live.canon|exodus|24:13: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|24:15: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
live.canon|exodus|24:16: And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
live.canon|exodus|24:17: And the sight of the glory of Yahuah (LORD) was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|24:18: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
live.canon|exodus|25:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they bring me an offering: of every man that gives it willingly with his heart you shall take my offering.
live.canon|exodus|25:3: And this is the offering which you shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
live.canon|exodus|25:9: According to all that I shew you, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall you make it.
live.canon|exodus|25:11: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, within and without shall you overlay it, and shall make upon it a crown of gold round about.
live.canon|exodus|25:12: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
live.canon|exodus|25:13: And you shall make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
live.canon|exodus|25:14: And you shall put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
live.canon|exodus|25:16: And you shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.
live.canon|exodus|25:17: And you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
live.canon|exodus|25:18: And you shall make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shall you make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
live.canon|exodus|25:19: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall you make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
live.canon|exodus|25:21: And you shall put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.
live.canon|exodus|25:22: And there I will meet with you, and I will commune with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give you in commandment unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|25:23: You shall also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
live.canon|exodus|25:24: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
live.canon|exodus|25:25: And you shall make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and you shall make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
live.canon|exodus|25:26: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
live.canon|exodus|25:28: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
live.canon|exodus|25:29: And you shall make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shall you make them.
live.canon|exodus|25:30: And you shall set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
live.canon|exodus|25:31: And you shall make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
live.canon|exodus|25:37: And you shall make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
live.canon|exodus|25:40: And look that you make them after their pattern, which was shewed you in the mount.
live.canon|exodus|25:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|25:4: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
live.canon|exodus|25:5: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
live.canon|exodus|25:6: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
live.canon|exodus|25:7: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
live.canon|exodus|25:8: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
live.canon|exodus|25:10: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
live.canon|exodus|25:15: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
live.canon|exodus|25:20: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
live.canon|exodus|25:27: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
live.canon|exodus|25:32: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
live.canon|exodus|25:33: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
live.canon|exodus|25:34: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
live.canon|exodus|25:35: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
live.canon|exodus|25:36: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
live.canon|exodus|25:38: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
