live.canon|exodus|25:39: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
live.canon|exodus|26:1: Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shall you make them.
live.canon|exodus|26:4: And you shall make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shall you make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
live.canon|exodus|26:5: Fifty loops shall you make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shall you make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
live.canon|exodus|26:6: And you shall make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|26:7: And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shall you make.
live.canon|exodus|26:10: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
live.canon|exodus|26:11: And you shall make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
live.canon|exodus|26:12: And the remnant that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|26:13: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
live.canon|exodus|26:14: And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.
live.canon|exodus|26:15: And you shall make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
live.canon|exodus|26:17: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shall you make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|26:18: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
live.canon|exodus|26:19: And you shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
live.canon|exodus|26:22: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
live.canon|exodus|26:23: And two boards shall you make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
live.canon|exodus|26:26: And you shall make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
live.canon|exodus|26:29: And you shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
live.canon|exodus|26:30: And you shall rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed you in the mount.
live.canon|exodus|26:31: And you shall make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
live.canon|exodus|26:32: And you shall hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
live.canon|exodus|26:33: And you shall hang up the vail under the taches, that you may bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
live.canon|exodus|26:34: And you shall put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
live.canon|exodus|26:35: And you shall set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and you shall put the table on the north side.
live.canon|exodus|26:36: And you shall make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
live.canon|exodus|26:37: And you shall make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and you shall cast five sockets of brass for them.
live.canon|exodus|26:2: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
live.canon|exodus|26:3: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
live.canon|exodus|26:8: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
live.canon|exodus|26:16: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
live.canon|exodus|26:20: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
live.canon|exodus|26:21: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
live.canon|exodus|26:24: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
live.canon|exodus|26:25: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
live.canon|exodus|26:27: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
live.canon|exodus|26:28: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
live.canon|exodus|26:9: And you shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|27:1: And you shall make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
live.canon|exodus|27:2: And you shall make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and you shall overlay it with brass.
live.canon|exodus|27:3: And you shall make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof you shall make of brass.
live.canon|exodus|27:4: And you shall make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shall you make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
live.canon|exodus|27:5: And you shall put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
live.canon|exodus|27:6: And you shall make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
live.canon|exodus|27:8: Hollow with boards shall you make it: as it was shewed you in the mount, so shall they make it.
live.canon|exodus|27:9: And you shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
live.canon|exodus|27:7: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
live.canon|exodus|27:10: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
live.canon|exodus|27:11: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
live.canon|exodus|27:12: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
live.canon|exodus|27:13: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
live.canon|exodus|27:14: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
live.canon|exodus|27:15: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
live.canon|exodus|27:16: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
live.canon|exodus|27:17: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
live.canon|exodus|27:18: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
live.canon|exodus|27:19: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
live.canon|exodus|27:21: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before Yahuah (LORD): it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|27:20: And you shall command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they bring you pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
live.canon|exodus|28:1: And take you unto you Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
live.canon|exodus|28:3: And you shall speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
live.canon|exodus|28:4: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
live.canon|exodus|28:9: And you shall take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|exodus|28:11: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shall you engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): you shall make them to be set in ouches of gold.
live.canon|exodus|28:12: And you shall put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and Aaron shall bear their names before Yahuah (LORD) upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
live.canon|exodus|28:14: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shall you make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
live.canon|exodus|28:15: And you shall make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shall you make it.
live.canon|exodus|28:17: And you shall set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
live.canon|exodus|28:22: And you shall make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
live.canon|exodus|28:23: And you shall make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
live.canon|exodus|28:24: And you shall put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
live.canon|exodus|28:25: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains you shall fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
live.canon|exodus|28:26: And you shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
live.canon|exodus|28:27: And two other rings of gold you shall make, and shall put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
live.canon|exodus|28:29: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goes in unto the holy place, for a memorial before Yahuah (LORD) continually.
live.canon|exodus|28:30: And you shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahuah (LORD): and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) upon his heart before Yahuah (LORD) continually.
live.canon|exodus|28:31: And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
live.canon|exodus|28:33: And beneath upon the hem of it you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
live.canon|exodus|28:35: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goes in unto the holy place before Yahuah (LORD), and when he comes out, that he die not.
live.canon|exodus|28:36: And you shall make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|28:37: And you shall put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
live.canon|exodus|28:39: And you shall embroider the coat of fine linen, and you shall make the mitre of fine linen, and you shall make the girdle of needlework.
live.canon|exodus|28:40: And for Aaron’s sons you shall make coats, and you shall make for them girdles, and bonnets shall you make for them, for glory and for beauty.
live.canon|exodus|28:41: And you shall put them upon Aaron your brother, and his sons with him; and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
live.canon|exodus|28:42: And you shall make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
live.canon|exodus|28:5: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
live.canon|exodus|28:6: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
live.canon|exodus|28:7: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
live.canon|exodus|28:8: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
live.canon|exodus|28:10: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
live.canon|exodus|28:16: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
live.canon|exodus|28:18: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
live.canon|exodus|28:19: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
live.canon|exodus|28:20: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
live.canon|exodus|28:21: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
live.canon|exodus|28:28: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
live.canon|exodus|28:32: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
live.canon|exodus|28:2: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother for glory and for beauty.
live.canon|exodus|28:13: And you shall make ouches of gold;
live.canon|exodus|28:34: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
live.canon|exodus|28:38: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|28:43: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
live.canon|exodus|29:1: And this is the thing that you shall do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
live.canon|exodus|29:2: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shall you make them.
live.canon|exodus|29:3: And you shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
live.canon|exodus|29:4: And Aaron and his sons you shall bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall wash them with water.
live.canon|exodus|29:5: And you shall take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
live.canon|exodus|29:7: Then shall you take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
live.canon|exodus|29:8: And you shall bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
live.canon|exodus|29:9: And you shall gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and you shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
live.canon|exodus|29:10: And you shall cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
live.canon|exodus|29:11: And you shall kill the bullock before Yahuah (LORD), by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|exodus|29:12: And you shall take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
live.canon|exodus|29:13: And you shall take all the fat that covers the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
live.canon|exodus|29:14: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shall you burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
live.canon|exodus|29:15: You shall also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
live.canon|exodus|29:16: And you shall slay the ram, and you shall take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
live.canon|exodus|29:17: And you shall cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
live.canon|exodus|29:18: And you shall burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD): it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|29:19: And you shall take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
live.canon|exodus|29:20: Then shall you kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
live.canon|exodus|29:21: And you shall take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
live.canon|exodus|29:22: Also you shall take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covers the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
live.canon|exodus|29:24: And you shall put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|29:25: And you shall receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before Yahuah (LORD): it is an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|29:26: And you shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD): and it shall be your part.
live.canon|exodus|29:27: And you shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
live.canon|exodus|29:30: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he comes into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
live.canon|exodus|29:31: And you shall take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
live.canon|exodus|29:34: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
live.canon|exodus|29:35: And thus shall you do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded you: seven days shall you consecrate them.
live.canon|exodus|29:36: And you shall offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and you shall cleanse the altar, when you have made an atonement for it, and you shall anoint it, to sanctify it.
live.canon|exodus|29:37: Seven days you shall make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever touches the altar shall be holy.
live.canon|exodus|29:38: Now this is that which you shall offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
live.canon|exodus|29:39: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at even:
live.canon|exodus|29:41: And the other lamb you shall offer at even, and shall do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|29:42: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before Yahuah (LORD): where I will meet you, to speak there unto you.
live.canon|exodus|29:6: And you shall put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
live.canon|exodus|29:23: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|exodus|29:28: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Yashar'el (Israel): for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Yashar'el (Israel) of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|29:29: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
live.canon|exodus|29:32: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|exodus|29:33: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
live.canon|exodus|29:40: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
live.canon|exodus|29:43: And there I will meet with the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
live.canon|exodus|29:44: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.
live.canon|exodus|29:45: And I will dwell among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and will be their Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|29:46: And they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|30:1: And you shall make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shall you make it.
live.canon|exodus|30:3: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and you shall make unto it a crown of gold round about.
live.canon|exodus|30:4: And two golden rings shall you make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shall you make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
live.canon|exodus|30:5: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
live.canon|exodus|30:6: And you shall put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with you.
live.canon|exodus|30:7: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresses the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
live.canon|exodus|30:9: You shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall you pour drink offering thereon.
live.canon|exodus|30:12: When you take the sum of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto Yahuah (LORD), when you numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when you numberest them.
live.canon|exodus|30:13: This they shall give, every one that passes among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|30:14: Every one that passes among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|30:16: And you shall take the atonement money of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement for your souls.
live.canon|exodus|30:18: You shall also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and you shall put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and you shall put water therein.
live.canon|exodus|30:23: Take you also unto you principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
live.canon|exodus|30:25: And you shall make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the are of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
live.canon|exodus|30:26: And you shall anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
live.canon|exodus|30:29: And you shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever touches them shall be holy.
live.canon|exodus|30:30: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
live.canon|exodus|30:31: And you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
live.canon|exodus|30:32: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall you make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
live.canon|exodus|30:33: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever puts any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
live.canon|exodus|30:34: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Take unto you sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
live.canon|exodus|30:35: And you shall make it a perfume, a confection after the are of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
live.canon|exodus|30:36: And you shall beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with you: it shall be unto you most holy.
live.canon|exodus|30:37: And as for the perfume which you shall make, you shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto you holy for Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|30:2: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
live.canon|exodus|30:8: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before Yahuah (LORD) throughout your generations.
live.canon|exodus|30:10: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|30:11: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|30:15: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement for your souls.
live.canon|exodus|30:17: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|30:19: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
live.canon|exodus|30:20: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|exodus|30:21: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
live.canon|exodus|30:22: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|30:24: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
live.canon|exodus|30:27: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
live.canon|exodus|30:28: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
live.canon|exodus|30:38: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
live.canon|exodus|31:6: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you;
live.canon|exodus|31:11: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you shall they do.
live.canon|exodus|31:13: Speak you also unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Verily my sabbaths you shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that you may know that I am Yahuah (LORD) that does sanctify you.
live.canon|exodus|31:14: You shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defiles it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
live.canon|exodus|31:15: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to Yahuah (LORD): whosoever does any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|exodus|31:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|31:2: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah):
live.canon|exodus|31:3: And I have filled him with the spirit of Elohim (God), in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
live.canon|exodus|31:4: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
live.canon|exodus|31:5: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
live.canon|exodus|31:7: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
live.canon|exodus|31:8: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
live.canon|exodus|31:9: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
live.canon|exodus|31:10: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
live.canon|exodus|31:12: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|exodus|31:16: Wherefore the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
live.canon|exodus|31:17: It is a sign between me and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for ever: for in six days Yahuah (LORD) made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
live.canon|exodus|31:18: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of Elohim (God).
live.canon|exodus|32:8: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be your gods, O Yashar'el (Israel), which have brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|32:10: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of you a great nation.
live.canon|exodus|32:11: And Moses besought Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), and said, Yahuah (LORD), why does your wrath wax hot against your people, which you have brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
live.canon|exodus|32:12: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from your fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against your people.
live.canon|exodus|32:13: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Yashar'el (Israel), your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
live.canon|exodus|32:21: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto you, that you have brought so great a sin upon them?
live.canon|exodus|32:22: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: you know the people, that they are set on mischief.
live.canon|exodus|32:24: And I said unto them, Whosoever has any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
live.canon|exodus|32:27: And he said unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
live.canon|exodus|32:30: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, You have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto Yahuah (LORD); peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
live.canon|exodus|32:32: Yet now, if you will forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray you, out of your book which you have written.
live.canon|exodus|32:33: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Whosoever has sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
live.canon|exodus|32:34: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto you: behold, my Angel shall go before you: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
live.canon|exodus|32:1: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
live.canon|exodus|32:2: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
live.canon|exodus|32:3: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
live.canon|exodus|32:5: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|32:6: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
live.canon|exodus|32:9: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
live.canon|exodus|32:14: And Yahuah (LORD) repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
live.canon|exodus|32:15: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
live.canon|exodus|32:16: And the tables were the work of Elohim (God), and the writing was the writing of Elohim (God), graven upon the tables.
live.canon|exodus|32:17: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
live.canon|exodus|32:18: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
live.canon|exodus|32:19: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
live.canon|exodus|32:20: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) drink of it.
live.canon|exodus|32:23: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
live.canon|exodus|32:4: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be your gods, O Yashar'el (Israel), which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|32:7: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go, get you down; for your people, which you brought out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
live.canon|exodus|32:25: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
live.canon|exodus|32:26: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
live.canon|exodus|32:28: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
live.canon|exodus|32:29: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to Yahuah (LORD), even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
live.canon|exodus|32:31: And Moses returned unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
live.canon|exodus|32:35: And Yahuah (LORD) plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
live.canon|exodus|33:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, you and the people which you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto your seed will I give it:
live.canon|exodus|33:2: And I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
live.canon|exodus|33:5: For Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of you in a moment, and consume you: therefore now put off your ornaments from you, that I may know what to do unto you.
live.canon|exodus|33:11: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaks unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|33:12: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), See, you say unto me, Bring up this people: and you have not let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, I know you by name, and you have also found grace in my sight.
live.canon|exodus|33:13: Now therefore, I pray you, if I have found grace in your sight, shew me now your way, that I may know you, that I may find grace in your sight: and consider that this nation is your people.
live.canon|exodus|33:15: And he said unto him, If your presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
live.canon|exodus|33:16: For wherein shall it be known here that I and your people have found grace in your sight? is it not in that you go with us? so shall we be separated, I and your people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
live.canon|exodus|33:17: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that you have spoken: for you have found grace in my sight, and I know you by name.
live.canon|exodus|33:18: And he said, I beseech you, shew me your glory.
live.canon|exodus|33:19: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of Yahuah (LORD) before you; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
live.canon|exodus|33:20: And he said, You can not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
live.canon|exodus|33:21: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand upon a rock:
live.canon|exodus|33:22: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a clift of the rock, and will cover you with my hand while I pass by:
live.canon|exodus|33:23: And I will take away my hand, and you shall see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
live.canon|exodus|33:4: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
live.canon|exodus|33:6: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
live.canon|exodus|33:7: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought Yahuah (LORD) went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
live.canon|exodus|33:8: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|33:9: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and Yahuah (LORD) talked with Moses.
live.canon|exodus|33:10: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
live.canon|exodus|33:3: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of you; for you are a stiffnecked people: lest I consume you in the way.
live.canon|exodus|33:14: And he said, My presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest.
live.canon|exodus|34:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Hew you two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which you brakest.
live.canon|exodus|34:3: And no man shall come up with you, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
live.canon|exodus|34:10: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which you are shall see the work of Yahuah (LORD): for it is a terrible thing that I will do with you.
live.canon|exodus|34:11: Observe you that which I command you this day: behold, I drive out before you the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
live.canon|exodus|34:12: Take heed to thyself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither you go, lest it be for a snare in the midst of you:
live.canon|exodus|34:13: But you shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
live.canon|exodus|34:14: For you shall worship no other god: for Yahuah (LORD), whose name is Jealous, is a jealous Elohim (God):
live.canon|exodus|34:15: Lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call you, and you eat of his sacrifice;
live.canon|exodus|34:16: And you take of their daughters unto your sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make your sons go a whoring after their gods.
live.canon|exodus|34:18: The feast of unleavened bread shall you keep. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib you came out from Egypt.
live.canon|exodus|34:19: All that opens the matrix is mine; and every firstling among your cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
live.canon|exodus|34:20: But the firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb: and if you redeem him not, then shall you break his neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
live.canon|exodus|34:21: Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in earing time and in harvest you shall rest.
live.canon|exodus|34:22: And you shall observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.
live.canon|exodus|34:24: For I will cast out the nations before you, and enlarge your borders: neither shall any man desire your land, when you shall go up to appear before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) thrice in the year.
live.canon|exodus|34:25: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
live.canon|exodus|34:26: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring unto the house of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God). You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
live.canon|exodus|34:27: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Write you these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|34:2: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
live.canon|exodus|34:4: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
live.canon|exodus|34:5: And Yahuah (LORD) descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|34:6: And Yahuah (LORD) passed by before him, and proclaimed, Yahuah (LORD), Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God), merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
live.canon|exodus|34:7: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
live.canon|exodus|34:8: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
live.canon|exodus|34:17: You shall make you no molten gods.
live.canon|exodus|34:23: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|34:28: And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
live.canon|exodus|34:29: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
live.canon|exodus|34:30: And when Aaron and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
live.canon|exodus|34:31: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
live.canon|exodus|34:32: And afterward all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that Yahuah (LORD) had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
live.canon|exodus|34:33: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
live.canon|exodus|34:34: But when Moses went in before Yahuah (LORD) to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that which he was commanded.
live.canon|exodus|34:35: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
live.canon|exodus|34:9: And he said, If now I have found grace in your sight, O Adonai (Lord), let my Lord, I pray you, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.
live.canon|exodus|35:1: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) together, and said unto them, These are the words which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, that you should do them.
live.canon|exodus|35:2: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to Yahuah (LORD): whosoever does work therein shall be put to death.
live.canon|exodus|35:3: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
live.canon|exodus|35:5: Take you from among you an offering unto Yahuah (LORD): whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of Yahuah (LORD); gold, and silver, and brass,
live.canon|exodus|35:10: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that Yahuah (LORD) has commanded;
live.canon|exodus|35:31: And he has filled him with the spirit of Elohim (God), in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
live.canon|exodus|35:34: And he has put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
live.canon|exodus|35:35: Them has he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
live.canon|exodus|35:4: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) commanded, saying,
live.canon|exodus|35:6: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
live.canon|exodus|35:7: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
live.canon|exodus|35:8: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
live.canon|exodus|35:9: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
live.canon|exodus|35:11: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
live.canon|exodus|35:12: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
live.canon|exodus|35:13: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
live.canon|exodus|35:14: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
live.canon|exodus|35:15: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
live.canon|exodus|35:16: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
live.canon|exodus|35:17: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
live.canon|exodus|35:18: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
live.canon|exodus|35:19: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
live.canon|exodus|35:20: And all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) departed from the presence of Moses.
live.canon|exodus|35:21: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
live.canon|exodus|35:22: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|35:23: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought them.
live.canon|exodus|35:24: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
live.canon|exodus|35:25: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
live.canon|exodus|35:26: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ hair.
live.canon|exodus|35:27: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
live.canon|exodus|35:28: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
live.canon|exodus|35:29: The children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought a willing offering unto Yahuah (LORD), every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which Yahuah (LORD) had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|exodus|35:32: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
live.canon|exodus|35:33: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
live.canon|exodus|35:30: And Moses said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), See, Yahuah (LORD) has called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah);
live.canon|exodus|36:1: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom Yahuah (LORD) put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahuah (LORD) had commanded.
live.canon|exodus|36:2: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart Yahuah (LORD) had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
live.canon|exodus|36:3: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
live.canon|exodus|36:4: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
live.canon|exodus|36:5: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded to make.
live.canon|exodus|36:6: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
live.canon|exodus|36:7: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
live.canon|exodus|36:8: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
live.canon|exodus|36:9: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
live.canon|exodus|36:10: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
live.canon|exodus|36:11: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
live.canon|exodus|36:12: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
live.canon|exodus|36:13: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|36:14: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
live.canon|exodus|36:15: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
live.canon|exodus|36:16: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
live.canon|exodus|36:17: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
live.canon|exodus|36:18: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
live.canon|exodus|36:19: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that.
live.canon|exodus|36:20: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
live.canon|exodus|36:21: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
live.canon|exodus|36:22: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|36:23: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
live.canon|exodus|36:24: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
live.canon|exodus|36:25: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
live.canon|exodus|36:26: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
live.canon|exodus|36:27: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
live.canon|exodus|36:28: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
live.canon|exodus|36:29: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
live.canon|exodus|36:30: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
live.canon|exodus|36:31: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
live.canon|exodus|36:32: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
live.canon|exodus|36:33: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
live.canon|exodus|36:34: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
live.canon|exodus|36:35: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
live.canon|exodus|36:36: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
live.canon|exodus|36:37: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
live.canon|exodus|36:38: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
live.canon|exodus|37:1: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
live.canon|exodus|37:2: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
live.canon|exodus|37:3: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
live.canon|exodus|37:4: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
live.canon|exodus|37:5: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
live.canon|exodus|37:6: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
live.canon|exodus|37:7: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
live.canon|exodus|37:8: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
live.canon|exodus|37:9: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
live.canon|exodus|37:10: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
live.canon|exodus|37:11: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
live.canon|exodus|37:12: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
live.canon|exodus|37:13: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
live.canon|exodus|37:14: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
live.canon|exodus|37:15: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
live.canon|exodus|37:16: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
live.canon|exodus|37:17: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
live.canon|exodus|37:18: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
live.canon|exodus|37:19: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
live.canon|exodus|37:20: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
live.canon|exodus|37:21: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
live.canon|exodus|37:22: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
live.canon|exodus|37:23: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
live.canon|exodus|37:24: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
live.canon|exodus|37:25: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
live.canon|exodus|37:26: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
live.canon|exodus|37:27: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
live.canon|exodus|37:28: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
live.canon|exodus|37:29: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
live.canon|exodus|38:1: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
live.canon|exodus|38:2: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
live.canon|exodus|38:3: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
live.canon|exodus|38:4: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
live.canon|exodus|38:5: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
live.canon|exodus|38:6: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
live.canon|exodus|38:7: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
live.canon|exodus|38:8: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|exodus|38:9: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
live.canon|exodus|38:10: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
live.canon|exodus|38:11: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
live.canon|exodus|38:12: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
live.canon|exodus|38:13: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
live.canon|exodus|38:14: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
live.canon|exodus|38:15: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
live.canon|exodus|38:16: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
live.canon|exodus|38:17: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
live.canon|exodus|38:18: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
live.canon|exodus|38:19: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
live.canon|exodus|38:20: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
live.canon|exodus|38:21: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
live.canon|exodus|38:22: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), made all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|38:23: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
live.canon|exodus|38:24: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
live.canon|exodus|38:25: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
live.canon|exodus|38:26: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
live.canon|exodus|38:27: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
live.canon|exodus|38:28: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
live.canon|exodus|38:29: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
live.canon|exodus|38:30: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
live.canon|exodus|38:31: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
live.canon|exodus|39:1: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|39:2: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
live.canon|exodus|39:3: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
live.canon|exodus|39:4: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
live.canon|exodus|39:5: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|39:6: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|exodus|39:7: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Yashar'el (Israel); as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|39:8: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
live.canon|exodus|39:9: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
live.canon|exodus|39:10: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
live.canon|exodus|39:11: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
live.canon|exodus|39:12: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
live.canon|exodus|39:13: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
live.canon|exodus|39:14: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
live.canon|exodus|39:15: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
live.canon|exodus|39:16: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
live.canon|exodus|39:17: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
live.canon|exodus|39:18: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
live.canon|exodus|39:19: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
live.canon|exodus|39:20: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
live.canon|exodus|39:21: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|39:22: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
live.canon|exodus|39:23: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
live.canon|exodus|39:24: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
live.canon|exodus|39:25: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
live.canon|exodus|39:26: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|39:27: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
live.canon|exodus|39:28: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
live.canon|exodus|39:29: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|39:30: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|exodus|39:31: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|exodus|39:32: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did according to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so did they.
live.canon|exodus|39:33: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
live.canon|exodus|39:34: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
live.canon|exodus|39:35: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
live.canon|exodus|39:36: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
live.canon|exodus|39:37: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
live.canon|exodus|39:38: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
live.canon|exodus|39:39: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
live.canon|exodus|39:40: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
live.canon|exodus|39:41: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
live.canon|exodus|39:42: According to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so the children of Yashar'el (Israel) made all the work.
live.canon|exodus|39:43: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
live.canon|exodus|40:2: On the first day of the first month shall you set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
live.canon|exodus|40:3: And you shall put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
live.canon|exodus|40:4: And you shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and you shall bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
live.canon|exodus|40:5: And you shall set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
live.canon|exodus|40:6: And you shall set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
live.canon|exodus|40:7: And you shall set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shall put water therein.
live.canon|exodus|40:8: And you shall set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
