live.canon|genesis|44:17: And he said, Elohim (God) forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
live.canon|genesis|44:22: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
live.canon|genesis|44:25: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
live.canon|genesis|44:26: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.
live.canon|genesis|44:28: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
live.canon|genesis|44:34: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
live.canon|genesis|45:3: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; does my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
live.canon|genesis|45:4: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|45:5: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me hither: for Elohim (God) did send me before you to preserve life.
live.canon|genesis|45:6: For these two years has the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
live.canon|genesis|45:8: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but Elohim (God): and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|45:9: Haste you, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus says your son Joseph, Elohim (God) has made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
live.canon|genesis|45:10: And you shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near unto me, you, and your children, and your children’s children, and your flocks, and your herds, and all that you have:
live.canon|genesis|45:11: And there will I nourish you; for yet there are five years of famine; lest you, and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty.
live.canon|genesis|45:12: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks unto you.
live.canon|genesis|45:13: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and you shall haste and bring down my father hither.
live.canon|genesis|45:17: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto your brethren, This do you; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
live.canon|genesis|45:18: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.
live.canon|genesis|45:19: Now you are commanded, this do you; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
live.canon|genesis|45:24: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that you fall not out by the way.
live.canon|genesis|45:1: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
live.canon|genesis|45:2: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
live.canon|genesis|45:7: And Elohim (God) sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
live.canon|genesis|45:14: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
live.canon|genesis|45:15: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
live.canon|genesis|45:16: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
live.canon|genesis|45:20: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
live.canon|genesis|45:21: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
live.canon|genesis|45:22: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
live.canon|genesis|45:23: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
live.canon|genesis|45:25: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
live.canon|genesis|45:26: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.
live.canon|genesis|45:27: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
live.canon|genesis|45:28: And Yashar'el (Israel) said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
live.canon|genesis|46:3: And he said, I am Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of your father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of you a great nation:
live.canon|genesis|46:4: I will go down with you into Egypt; and I will also surely bring you up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon your eyes.
live.canon|genesis|46:1: And Yashar'el (Israel) took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the Elohim (God) of his father Isaac.
live.canon|genesis|46:2: And Elohim (God) spake unto Yashar'el (Israel) in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
live.canon|genesis|46:5: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Yashar'el (Israel) carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
live.canon|genesis|46:6: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
live.canon|genesis|46:7: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|46:8: And these are the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
live.canon|genesis|46:9: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
live.canon|genesis|46:10: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
live.canon|genesis|46:11: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
live.canon|genesis|46:12: And the sons of Yahudah (Judah); Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
live.canon|genesis|46:13: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
live.canon|genesis|46:14: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
live.canon|genesis|46:15: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
live.canon|genesis|46:16: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
live.canon|genesis|46:17: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
live.canon|genesis|46:18: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
live.canon|genesis|46:19: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
live.canon|genesis|46:20: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
live.canon|genesis|46:21: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
live.canon|genesis|46:22: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
live.canon|genesis|46:23: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
live.canon|genesis|46:24: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
live.canon|genesis|46:25: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
live.canon|genesis|46:26: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
live.canon|genesis|46:27: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
live.canon|genesis|46:28: And he sent Yahudah (Judah) before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|46:29: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Yashar'el (Israel) his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
live.canon|genesis|46:31: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
live.canon|genesis|46:33: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
live.canon|genesis|46:30: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you are yet alive.
live.canon|genesis|46:32: And the men are shepherds, for their trade has been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
live.canon|genesis|46:34: That you shall say, Your servants’ trade has been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
live.canon|genesis|47:15: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in your presence? for the money fails.
live.canon|genesis|47:18: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also has our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
live.canon|genesis|47:19: Wherefore shall we die before your eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
live.canon|genesis|47:23: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
live.canon|genesis|47:24: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that you shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
live.canon|genesis|47:25: And they said, You have saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.
live.canon|genesis|47:29: And the time drew nigh that Yashar'el (Israel) must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in your sight, put, I pray you, your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray you, in Egypt:
live.canon|genesis|47:30: But I will lie with my fathers, and you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as you have said.
live.canon|genesis|47:1: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|47:2: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|47:7: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|47:9: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
live.canon|genesis|47:10: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
live.canon|genesis|47:11: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
live.canon|genesis|47:12: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.
live.canon|genesis|47:13: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
live.canon|genesis|47:14: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
live.canon|genesis|47:3: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Your servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
live.canon|genesis|47:4: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for your servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray you, let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|47:5: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Your father and your brethren are come unto you:
live.canon|genesis|47:6: The land of Egypt is before you; in the best of the land make your father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if you know any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
live.canon|genesis|47:8: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old are you?
live.canon|genesis|47:16: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
live.canon|genesis|47:17: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
live.canon|genesis|47:20: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.
live.canon|genesis|47:21: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
live.canon|genesis|47:22: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
live.canon|genesis|47:26: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.
live.canon|genesis|47:27: And Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
live.canon|genesis|47:28: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
live.canon|genesis|47:31: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Yashar'el (Israel) bowed himself upon the bed’s head.
live.canon|genesis|48:1: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, your father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
live.canon|genesis|48:2: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, your son Joseph comes unto you: and Yashar'el (Israel) strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
live.canon|genesis|48:4: And said unto me, Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a multitude of people; and will give this land to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.
live.canon|genesis|48:5: And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto you in the land of Egypt before I came unto you into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
live.canon|genesis|48:6: And your issue, which you begettest after them, shall be yours, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
live.canon|genesis|48:9: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom Elohim (God) has given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray you, unto me, and I will bless them.
live.canon|genesis|48:11: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see your face: and, lo, Elohim (God) has shewed me also your seed.
live.canon|genesis|48:18: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put your right hand upon his head.
live.canon|genesis|48:20: And he blessed them that day, saying, In you shall Yashar'el (Israel) bless, saying, Elohim (God) make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
live.canon|genesis|48:22: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
live.canon|genesis|48:3: And Jacob said unto Joseph, El Shaddai (God Almighty) appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
live.canon|genesis|48:7: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.
live.canon|genesis|48:8: And Yashar'el (Israel) beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?
live.canon|genesis|48:10: Now the eyes of Yashar'el (Israel) were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
live.canon|genesis|48:12: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
live.canon|genesis|48:13: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Yashar'el's (Israel’s) left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Yashar'el's (Israel’s) right hand, and brought them near unto him.
live.canon|genesis|48:14: And Yashar'el (Israel) stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
live.canon|genesis|48:15: And he blessed Joseph, and said, Elohim (God), before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the Elohim (God) which fed me all my life long unto this day,
live.canon|genesis|48:16: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
live.canon|genesis|48:17: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.
live.canon|genesis|48:19: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
live.canon|genesis|48:21: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but Elohim (God) shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
live.canon|genesis|49:2: Gather yourselves together, and hear, you sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Yashar'el (Israel) your father.
live.canon|genesis|49:3: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
live.canon|genesis|49:4: Unstable as water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed; then defiledst you it: he went up to my couch.
live.canon|genesis|49:6: O my soul, come not you into their secret; unto their assembly, my honour, be not you united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
live.canon|genesis|49:8: Yahudah (Judah), you are he whom your brethren shall praise: your hand shall be in the neck of your enemies; your father’s children shall bow down before you.
live.canon|genesis|49:9: Yahudah (Judah) is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, you are gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
live.canon|genesis|49:17: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that bites the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
live.canon|genesis|49:21: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he gives goodly words.
live.canon|genesis|49:25: Even by the Elohim (God) of your father, who shall help you; and by the Almighty, who shall bless you with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
live.canon|genesis|49:26: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
live.canon|genesis|49:1: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
live.canon|genesis|49:5: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
live.canon|genesis|49:7: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|genesis|49:10: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
live.canon|genesis|49:11: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
live.canon|genesis|49:12: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
live.canon|genesis|49:13: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
live.canon|genesis|49:14: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
live.canon|genesis|49:15: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
live.canon|genesis|49:16: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|genesis|49:19: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
live.canon|genesis|49:20: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
live.canon|genesis|49:22: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
live.canon|genesis|49:23: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
live.canon|genesis|49:24: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Yashar'el (Israel):)
live.canon|genesis|49:27: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
live.canon|genesis|49:28: All these are the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel): and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
live.canon|genesis|49:29: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
live.canon|genesis|49:30: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
live.canon|genesis|49:31: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
live.canon|genesis|49:32: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
live.canon|genesis|49:33: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
live.canon|genesis|49:18: I have waited for your salvation, O Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|genesis|50:5: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shall you bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray you, and bury my father, and I will come again.
live.canon|genesis|50:6: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury your father, according as he made you swear.
live.canon|genesis|50:17: So shall you say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray you now, the trespass of your brethren, and their sin; for they did unto you evil: and now, we pray you, forgive the trespass of the servants of the Elohim (God) of your father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
live.canon|genesis|50:18: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be your servants.
live.canon|genesis|50:20: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
live.canon|genesis|50:21: Now therefore fear you not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
live.canon|genesis|50:25: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from hence.
live.canon|genesis|50:1: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
live.canon|genesis|50:2: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|genesis|50:3: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
live.canon|genesis|50:4: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
live.canon|genesis|50:7: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
live.canon|genesis|50:8: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
live.canon|genesis|50:9: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
live.canon|genesis|50:10: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
live.canon|genesis|50:11: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
live.canon|genesis|50:12: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
live.canon|genesis|50:13: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
live.canon|genesis|50:14: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
live.canon|genesis|50:15: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
live.canon|genesis|50:19: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of Elohim (God)?
live.canon|genesis|50:22: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
live.canon|genesis|50:23: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.
live.canon|genesis|50:24: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and Elohim (God) will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
live.canon|genesis|50:26: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
live.canon|genesis|50:16: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Your father did command before he died, saying,
live.canon|hosea|1:2: The beginning of the word of Yahuah (LORD) by Hosea. And Yahuah (LORD) said to Hosea, Go, take unto you a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land has committed great whoredom, departing from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|hosea|1:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah (Judah), and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|hosea|1:3: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
live.canon|hosea|1:4: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|hosea|1:5: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Yashar'el (Israel) in the valley of Jezreel.
live.canon|hosea|1:6: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And Elohim (God) said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Yashar'el (Israel); but I will utterly take them away.
live.canon|hosea|1:7: But I will have mercy upon the house of Yahudah (Judah), and will save them by Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
live.canon|hosea|1:8: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
live.canon|hosea|1:11: Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
live.canon|hosea|1:9: Then said Elohim (God), Call his name Lo-ammi: for you are not my people, and I will not be your Elohim (God).
live.canon|hosea|1:10: Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, You are the sons of the living Elohim (God).
live.canon|hosea|2:6: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
live.canon|hosea|2:10: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.
live.canon|hosea|2:12: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she has said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
live.canon|hosea|2:13: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|hosea|2:16: And it shall be at that day, says Yahuah (LORD), that you shall call me Ishi; and shall call me no more Baali.
live.canon|hosea|2:19: And I will betroth you unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth you unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
live.canon|hosea|2:20: I will even betroth you unto me in faithfulness: and you shall know Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|hosea|2:21: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, says Yahuah (LORD), I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
live.canon|hosea|2:23: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, You are my people; and they shall say, You are my Elohim (God).
live.canon|hosea|2:2: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
live.canon|hosea|2:1: Say you unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.
live.canon|hosea|2:3: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
live.canon|hosea|2:4: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
live.canon|hosea|2:7: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
live.canon|hosea|2:8: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
live.canon|hosea|2:9: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
live.canon|hosea|2:11: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
live.canon|hosea|2:14: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
live.canon|hosea|2:15: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|hosea|2:17: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
live.canon|hosea|2:18: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
live.canon|hosea|2:22: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
live.canon|hosea|2:5: For their mother has played the harlot: she that conceived them has done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.
live.canon|hosea|3:3: And I said unto her, You shall abide for me many days; you shall not play the harlot, and you shall not be for another man: so will I also be for you.
live.canon|hosea|3:1: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of Yahuah (LORD) toward the children of Yashar'el (Israel), who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
live.canon|hosea|3:2: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
live.canon|hosea|3:4: For the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
live.canon|hosea|3:5: Afterward shall the children of Yashar'el (Israel) return, and seek Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and David their king; and shall fear Yahuah (LORD) and his goodness in the latter days.
live.canon|hosea|4:1: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for Yahuah (LORD) has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of Elohim (God) in the land.
live.canon|hosea|4:2: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood touches blood.
live.canon|hosea|4:12: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms has caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their Elohim (God).
live.canon|hosea|4:14: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that does not understand shall fall.
live.canon|hosea|4:15: Though you, Yashar'el (Israel), play the harlot, yet let not Yahudah (Judah) offend; and come not you unto Gilgal, neither go you up to Beth-aven, nor swear, Yahuah (LORD) lives.
live.canon|hosea|4:19: The wind has bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
live.canon|hosea|4:7: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
live.canon|hosea|4:8: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
live.canon|hosea|4:3: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwells therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
live.canon|hosea|4:4: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for your people are as they that strive with the priest.
live.canon|hosea|4:5: Therefore shall you fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with you in the night, and I will destroy your mother.
live.canon|hosea|4:6: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you shall be no priest to me: seeing you have forgotten the law of your Elohim (God), I will also forget your children.
live.canon|hosea|4:9: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
live.canon|hosea|4:10: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|hosea|4:11: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
live.canon|hosea|4:13: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
live.canon|hosea|4:16: For Yashar'el (Israel) slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now Yahuah (LORD) will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
live.canon|hosea|4:17: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
live.canon|hosea|4:18: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give you.
live.canon|hosea|5:1: Hear you this, O priests; and hearken, you house of Yashar'el (Israel); and give you ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because you have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
live.canon|hosea|5:3: I know Ephraim, and Yashar'el (Israel) is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, you committest whoredom, and Yashar'el (Israel) is defiled.
live.canon|hosea|5:5: And the pride of Yashar'el (Israel) does testify to his face: therefore shall Yashar'el (Israel) and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Yahudah (Judah) also shall fall with them.
live.canon|hosea|5:6: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahuah (LORD); but they shall not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.
live.canon|hosea|5:8: Blow you the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after you, O Benjamin.
live.canon|hosea|5:2: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
live.canon|hosea|5:4: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their Elohim (God): for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|hosea|5:7: They have dealt treacherously against Yahuah (LORD): for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
live.canon|hosea|5:9: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) have I made known that which shall surely be.
live.canon|hosea|5:10: The princes of Yahudah (Judah) were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
live.canon|hosea|5:11: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
live.canon|hosea|5:12: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Yahudah (Judah) as rottenness.
live.canon|hosea|5:13: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Yahudah (Judah) saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
live.canon|hosea|5:14: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Yahudah (Judah): I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
live.canon|hosea|5:15: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
live.canon|hosea|6:1: Come, and let us return unto Yahuah (LORD): for he has torn, and he will heal us; he has smitten, and he will bind us up.
live.canon|hosea|6:4: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto you? O Yahudah (Judah), what shall I do unto you? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goes away.
live.canon|hosea|6:5: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and your judgments are as the light that goes forth.
live.canon|hosea|6:2: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
live.canon|hosea|6:3: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know Yahuah (LORD): his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
live.canon|hosea|6:6: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of Elohim (God) more than burnt offerings.
live.canon|hosea|6:7: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
live.canon|hosea|6:8: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
live.canon|hosea|6:9: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
live.canon|hosea|6:10: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Yashar'el (Israel): there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Yashar'el (Israel) is defiled.
live.canon|hosea|6:11: Also, O Yahudah (Judah), he has set an harvest for you, when I returned the captivity of my people.
live.canon|hosea|7:1: When I would have healed Yashar'el (Israel), then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief comes in, and the troop of robbers spoils without.
live.canon|hosea|7:4: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceases from raising after he has kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
live.canon|hosea|7:6: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleeps all the night; in the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
live.canon|hosea|7:7: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calls unto me.
live.canon|hosea|7:8: Ephraim, he has mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
live.canon|hosea|7:2: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
live.canon|hosea|7:3: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
live.canon|hosea|7:5: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
live.canon|hosea|7:10: And the pride of Yashar'el (Israel) testifieth to his face: and they do not return to Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), nor seek him for all this.
live.canon|hosea|7:11: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
live.canon|hosea|7:13: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
live.canon|hosea|7:14: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
live.canon|hosea|7:15: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
live.canon|hosea|7:16: They return, but not to the El Elyon (most High): they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
live.canon|hosea|7:9: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knows it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knows not.
live.canon|hosea|7:12: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
live.canon|hosea|8:1: Set the trumpet to your mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of Yahuah (LORD), because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
live.canon|hosea|8:2: Yashar'el (Israel) shall cry unto me, My Elohim (God), we know you.
live.canon|hosea|8:3: Yashar'el (Israel) has cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
live.canon|hosea|8:5: Your calf, O Samaria, has cast you off; my anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
live.canon|hosea|8:7: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it has no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
live.canon|hosea|8:9: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim has hired lovers.
live.canon|hosea|8:11: Because Ephraim has made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
live.canon|hosea|8:13: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of my offerings, and eat it; but Yahuah (LORD) accepts them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
live.canon|hosea|8:14: For Yashar'el (Israel) has forgotten his Maker, and builds temples; and Yahudah (Judah) has multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
live.canon|hosea|8:4: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
live.canon|hosea|8:6: For from Yashar'el (Israel) was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not Elohim (God): but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
live.canon|hosea|8:8: Yashar'el (Israel) is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
live.canon|hosea|8:10: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
live.canon|hosea|8:12: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
live.canon|hosea|9:1: Rejoice not, O Yashar'el (Israel), for joy, as other people: for you have gone a whoring from your Elohim (God), you have loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
live.canon|hosea|9:2: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
live.canon|hosea|9:3: They shall not dwell in the LORD’S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
live.canon|hosea|9:4: They shall not offer wine offerings to Yahuah (LORD), neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|hosea|9:6: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
live.canon|hosea|9:5: What will you do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|hosea|9:7: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Yashar'el (Israel) shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of your iniquity, and the great hatred.
live.canon|hosea|9:14: Give them, O Yahuah (LORD): what will you give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
live.canon|hosea|9:15: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of my house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
live.canon|hosea|9:8: The watchman of Ephraim was with my Elohim (God): but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his Elohim (God).
live.canon|hosea|9:9: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
live.canon|hosea|9:10: I found Yashar'el (Israel) like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
live.canon|hosea|9:11: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
live.canon|hosea|9:12: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
live.canon|hosea|9:13: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
live.canon|hosea|9:16: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
live.canon|hosea|9:17: My Elohim (God) will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
live.canon|hosea|10:1: Yashar'el (Israel) is an empty vine, he brings forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he has increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
live.canon|hosea|10:9: O Yashar'el (Israel), you have sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
live.canon|hosea|10:11: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loves to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Yahudah (Judah) shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
live.canon|hosea|10:13: You have plowed wickedness, you have reaped iniquity; you have eaten the fruit of lies: because you did trust in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
live.canon|hosea|10:14: Therefore shall a tumult arise among your people, and all your fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
live.canon|hosea|10:2: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
live.canon|hosea|10:3: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not Yahuah (LORD); what then should a king do to us?
live.canon|hosea|10:4: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
live.canon|hosea|10:5: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
live.canon|hosea|10:6: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
live.canon|hosea|10:7: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
live.canon|hosea|10:8: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
live.canon|hosea|10:10: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
live.canon|hosea|10:12: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek Yahuah (LORD), till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
live.canon|hosea|10:15: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Yashar'el (Israel) utterly be cut off.
live.canon|hosea|11:1: When Yashar'el (Israel) was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
live.canon|hosea|11:2: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
live.canon|hosea|11:3: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
live.canon|hosea|11:4: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
live.canon|hosea|11:5: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
live.canon|hosea|11:6: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
live.canon|hosea|11:7: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the El Elyon (most High), none at all would exalt him.
live.canon|hosea|11:10: They shall walk after Yahuah (LORD): he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
live.canon|hosea|11:8: How shall I give you up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver you, Yashar'el (Israel)? how shall I make you as Admah? how shall I set you as Zeboim? my heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
live.canon|hosea|11:9: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am Elohim (God), and not man; the Holy One in the midst of you: and I will not enter into the city.
live.canon|hosea|11:11: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|hosea|11:12: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Yashar'el (Israel) with deceit: but Yahudah (Judah) yet rules with Elohim (God), and is faithful with the saints.
live.canon|hosea|12:2: Yahuah (LORD) has also a controversy with Yahudah (Judah), and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
live.canon|hosea|12:6: Therefore turn you to your Elohim (God): keep mercy and judgment, and wait on your Elohim (God) continually.
live.canon|hosea|12:7: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loves to oppress.
live.canon|hosea|12:9: And I that am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) from the land of Egypt will yet make you to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
live.canon|hosea|12:1: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and follows after the east wind: he daily increases lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
live.canon|hosea|12:3: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with Elohim (God):
live.canon|hosea|12:4: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Beth-el, and there he spake with us;
live.canon|hosea|12:5: Even Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts; Yahuah (LORD) is his memorial.
live.canon|hosea|12:8: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
live.canon|hosea|12:10: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
live.canon|hosea|12:11: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
live.canon|hosea|12:12: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Yashar'el (Israel) served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
live.canon|hosea|12:13: And by a prophet Yahuah (LORD) brought Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
live.canon|hosea|12:14: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
live.canon|hosea|13:3: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passes away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
live.canon|hosea|13:4: Yet I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) from the land of Egypt, and you shall know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
live.canon|hosea|13:5: I did know you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
live.canon|hosea|13:9: O Yashar'el (Israel), you have destroyed thyself; but in me is your help.
live.canon|hosea|13:10: I will be your king: where is any other that may save you in all your cities? and your judges of whom you saidst, Give me a king and princes?
live.canon|hosea|13:11: I gave you a king in my anger, and took him away in my wrath.
live.canon|hosea|13:14: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be your plagues; O grave, I will be your destruction: repentance shall be hid from my eyes.
live.canon|hosea|13:16: Samaria shall become desolate; for she has rebelled against her Elohim (God): they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
live.canon|hosea|13:1: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Yashar'el (Israel); but when he offended in Baal, he died.
live.canon|hosea|13:2: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
live.canon|hosea|13:6: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
live.canon|hosea|13:7: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
live.canon|hosea|13:8: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
live.canon|hosea|13:12: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
live.canon|hosea|13:13: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
live.canon|hosea|13:15: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of Yahuah (LORD) shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
live.canon|hosea|14:1: O Yashar'el (Israel), return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God); for you have fallen by your iniquity.
live.canon|hosea|14:3: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, You are our gods: for in you the fatherless finds mercy.
live.canon|hosea|14:8: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is your fruit found.
live.canon|hosea|14:2: Take with you words, and turn to Yahuah (LORD): say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
live.canon|hosea|14:5: I will be as the dew unto Yashar'el (Israel): he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
live.canon|hosea|14:6: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
live.canon|hosea|14:7: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
live.canon|hosea|14:4: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for my anger is turned away from him.
live.canon|hosea|14:9: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of Yahuah (LORD) are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
live.canon|isaiah|56:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Keep you judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
live.canon|isaiah|56:2: Blessed is the man that does this, and the son of Adam that lays hold on it; that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil.
live.canon|isaiah|56:3: Neither let the son of the stranger, that has joined himself to Yahuah (LORD), speak, saying, Yahuah (LORD) has utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
live.canon|isaiah|56:4: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
live.canon|isaiah|56:5: Even unto them will I give in my house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
live.canon|isaiah|56:6: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah (LORD), to be his servants, every one that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and takes hold of my covenant;
live.canon|isaiah|56:7: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon my altar; for my house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
live.canon|isaiah|56:8: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel) says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
live.canon|isaiah|56:9: All you beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all you beasts in the forest.
live.canon|isaiah|56:12: Come you, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
live.canon|isaiah|56:10: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
live.canon|isaiah|56:11: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
live.canon|isaiah|1:20: But if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
live.canon|isaiah|1:2: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
live.canon|isaiah|1:3: The ox knows his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Yashar'el (Israel) does not know, my people does not consider.
live.canon|isaiah|1:5: Why should you be stricken any more? you will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
live.canon|isaiah|1:10: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our Elohim (God), you people of Gomorrah.
live.canon|isaiah|1:11: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? says Yahuah (LORD): I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
live.canon|isaiah|1:12: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
live.canon|isaiah|1:14: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hates: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
live.canon|isaiah|1:15: And when you spread forth your hands, I will hide my eyes from you: yea, when you make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
live.canon|isaiah|1:16: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes; cease to do evil;
live.canon|isaiah|1:18: Come now, and let us reason together, says Yahuah (LORD): though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
live.canon|isaiah|1:19: If you be willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land:
live.canon|isaiah|1:23: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loves gifts, and follows after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come unto them.
live.canon|isaiah|1:25: And I will turn my hand upon you, and purely purge away your dross, and take away all your tin:
live.canon|isaiah|1:26: And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counsellors as at the beginning: afterward you shall be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
live.canon|isaiah|1:29: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
live.canon|isaiah|1:30: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that has no water.
live.canon|isaiah|1:1: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|isaiah|1:4: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken Yahuah (LORD), they have provoked the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) unto anger, they are gone away backward.
live.canon|isaiah|1:6: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
live.canon|isaiah|1:7: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
live.canon|isaiah|1:8: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
live.canon|isaiah|1:9: Except Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
live.canon|isaiah|1:13: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
live.canon|isaiah|1:17: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
live.canon|isaiah|1:21: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
live.canon|isaiah|1:27: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
live.canon|isaiah|1:28: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Yahuah (LORD) shall be consumed.
live.canon|isaiah|1:31: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
live.canon|isaiah|1:22: Your silver is become dross, your wine mixed with water:
live.canon|isaiah|1:24: Therefore says Adonai (Lord), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel), Ah, I will ease me of my adversaries, and avenge me of my enemies:
live.canon|isaiah|2:3: And many people shall go and say, Come you, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.
live.canon|isaiah|2:5: O house of Jacob, come you, and let us walk in the light of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|2:6: Therefore you have forsaken your people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
live.canon|isaiah|2:10: Enter into the rock, and hide you in the dust, for fear of Yahuah (LORD), and for the glory of his majesty.
live.canon|isaiah|2:19: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of Yahuah (LORD), and for the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake terribly the earth.
live.canon|isaiah|2:21: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of Yahuah (LORD), and for the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake terribly the earth.
live.canon|isaiah|2:22: Cease you from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
live.canon|isaiah|2:1: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem.
live.canon|isaiah|2:2: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
live.canon|isaiah|2:4: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
live.canon|isaiah|2:7: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
live.canon|isaiah|2:8: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
live.canon|isaiah|2:9: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
live.canon|isaiah|2:11: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and Yahuah (LORD) alone shall be exalted in that day.
live.canon|isaiah|2:12: For the day of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
live.canon|isaiah|2:13: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
live.canon|isaiah|2:14: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
live.canon|isaiah|2:15: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
live.canon|isaiah|2:16: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
live.canon|isaiah|2:17: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and Yahuah (LORD) alone shall be exalted in that day.
live.canon|isaiah|2:18: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
live.canon|isaiah|2:20: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

live.canon|isaiah|3:14: Yahuah (LORD) will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for you have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.

live.canon|isaiah|3:5: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.

live.canon|isaiah|3:23: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
