live.canon|isaiah|11:15: And Yahuah (LORD) shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
live.canon|isaiah|11:16: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Yashar'el (Israel) in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|isaiah|11:11: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
live.canon|isaiah|12:2: Behold, Elohim (God) is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for Yahuah (LORD) JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
live.canon|isaiah|12:1: And in that day you shall say, O Yahuah (LORD), I will praise you: though you were angry with me, your anger is turned away, and you comfortedst me.
live.canon|isaiah|12:3: Therefore with joy shall you draw water out of the wells of salvation.
live.canon|isaiah|12:4: And in that day shall you say, Praise Yahuah (LORD), call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
live.canon|isaiah|12:5: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD); for he has done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
live.canon|isaiah|12:6: Cry out and shout, you inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) in the midst of you.
live.canon|isaiah|13:9: Behold, the day of Yahuah (LORD) comes, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
live.canon|isaiah|13:14: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man takes up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
live.canon|isaiah|13:1: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
live.canon|isaiah|13:4: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) mustereth the host of the battle.
live.canon|isaiah|13:5: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even Yahuah (LORD), and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
live.canon|isaiah|13:7: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:
live.canon|isaiah|13:8: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
live.canon|isaiah|13:10: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
live.canon|isaiah|13:11: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
live.canon|isaiah|13:12: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
live.canon|isaiah|13:13: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and in the day of his fierce anger.
live.canon|isaiah|13:15: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
live.canon|isaiah|13:16: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
live.canon|isaiah|13:17: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
live.canon|isaiah|13:18: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
live.canon|isaiah|13:19: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when Elohim (God) overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
live.canon|isaiah|13:20: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
live.canon|isaiah|13:21: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
live.canon|isaiah|13:22: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
live.canon|isaiah|13:2: Lift you up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
live.canon|isaiah|13:3: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for my anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
live.canon|isaiah|13:6: Howl you; for the day of Yahuah (LORD) is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
live.canon|isaiah|14:3: And it shall come to pass in the day that Yahuah (LORD) shall give you rest from your sorrow, and from your fear, and from the hard bondage wherein you were made to serve,
live.canon|isaiah|14:4: That you shall take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How has the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
live.canon|isaiah|14:8: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at you, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since you are laid down, no feller is come up against us.
live.canon|isaiah|14:9: Hell from beneath is moved for you to meet you at your coming: it stirreth up the dead for you, even all the chief ones of the earth; it has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
live.canon|isaiah|14:10: All they shall speak and say unto you, Are you also become weak as we? are you become like unto us?
live.canon|isaiah|14:11: Your pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of your viols: the worm is spread under you, and the worms cover you.
live.canon|isaiah|14:12: How are you fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how are you cut down to the ground, which did weaken the nations!
live.canon|isaiah|14:13: For you have said in your heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim (God): I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
live.canon|isaiah|14:15: Yet you shall be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
live.canon|isaiah|14:16: They that see you shall narrowly look upon you, and consider you, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
live.canon|isaiah|14:19: But you are cast out of your grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
live.canon|isaiah|14:20: You shall not be joined with them in burial, because you have destroyed your land, and slain your people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
live.canon|isaiah|14:22: For I will rise up against them, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|14:23: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|isaiah|14:24: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
live.canon|isaiah|14:27: For Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
live.canon|isaiah|14:29: Rejoice not you, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote you is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
live.canon|isaiah|14:30: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill your root with famine, and he shall slay your remnant.
live.canon|isaiah|14:31: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; you, whole Palestina, are dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
live.canon|isaiah|14:32: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahuah (LORD) has founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
live.canon|isaiah|14:1: For Yahuah (LORD) will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Yashar'el (Israel), and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
live.canon|isaiah|14:2: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Yashar'el (Israel) shall possess them in the land of Yahuah (LORD) for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
live.canon|isaiah|14:6: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
live.canon|isaiah|14:7: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
live.canon|isaiah|14:14: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the El Elyon (most High).
live.canon|isaiah|14:17: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
live.canon|isaiah|14:18: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
live.canon|isaiah|14:21: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
live.canon|isaiah|14:25: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
live.canon|isaiah|14:26: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
live.canon|isaiah|14:28: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
live.canon|isaiah|14:5: Yahuah (LORD) has broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
live.canon|isaiah|15:6: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass fails, there is no green thing.
live.canon|isaiah|15:1: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
live.canon|isaiah|15:2: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
live.canon|isaiah|15:3: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
live.canon|isaiah|15:4: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
live.canon|isaiah|15:5: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
live.canon|isaiah|15:7: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
live.canon|isaiah|15:8: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.
live.canon|isaiah|15:9: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
live.canon|isaiah|16:1: Send you the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
live.canon|isaiah|16:3: Take counsel, execute judgment; make your shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
live.canon|isaiah|16:4: Let my outcasts dwell with you, Moab; be you a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceases, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
live.canon|isaiah|16:14: But now Yahuah (LORD) has spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
live.canon|isaiah|16:2: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
live.canon|isaiah|16:5: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
live.canon|isaiah|16:6: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
live.canon|isaiah|16:8: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
live.canon|isaiah|16:10: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
live.canon|isaiah|16:7: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall you mourn; surely they are stricken.
live.canon|isaiah|16:9: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water you with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for your summer fruits and for your harvest is fallen.
live.canon|isaiah|16:12: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
live.canon|isaiah|16:11: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir-haresh.
live.canon|isaiah|16:13: This is the word that Yahuah (LORD) has spoken concerning Moab since that time.
live.canon|isaiah|17:3: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|isaiah|17:5: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathers the corn, and reaps the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathers ears in the valley of Rephaim.
live.canon|isaiah|17:6: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|17:10: Because you have forgotten the Elohim (God) of your salvation, and have not been mindful of the rock of your strength, therefore shall you plant pleasant plants, and shall set it with strange slips:
live.canon|isaiah|17:11: In the day shall you make your plant to grow, and in the morning shall you make your seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
live.canon|isaiah|17:1: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
live.canon|isaiah|17:2: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
live.canon|isaiah|17:4: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
live.canon|isaiah|17:7: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|17:8: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
live.canon|isaiah|17:9: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and there shall be desolation.
live.canon|isaiah|17:12: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
live.canon|isaiah|17:13: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but Elohim (God) shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
live.canon|isaiah|17:14: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
live.canon|isaiah|18:2: That sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, you swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
live.canon|isaiah|18:3: All you inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see you, when he lifts up an ensign on the mountains; and when he blows a trumpet, hear you.
live.canon|isaiah|18:1: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
live.canon|isaiah|18:4: For so Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
live.canon|isaiah|18:5: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
live.canon|isaiah|18:6: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
live.canon|isaiah|18:7: In that time shall the present be brought unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the mount Zion.
live.canon|isaiah|19:1: The burden of Egypt. Behold, Yahuah (LORD) rides upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
live.canon|isaiah|19:11: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say you unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
live.canon|isaiah|19:12: Where are they? where are your wise men? and let them tell you now, and let them know what Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has purposed upon Egypt.
live.canon|isaiah|19:14: Yahuah (LORD) has mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
live.canon|isaiah|19:17: And the land of Yahudah (Judah) shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that makes mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), which he has determined against it.
live.canon|isaiah|19:25: Whom Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Yashar'el (Israel) my inheritance.
live.canon|isaiah|19:2: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
live.canon|isaiah|19:3: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
live.canon|isaiah|19:5: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
live.canon|isaiah|19:6: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
live.canon|isaiah|19:7: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
live.canon|isaiah|19:8: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
live.canon|isaiah|19:9: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
live.canon|isaiah|19:10: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
live.canon|isaiah|19:13: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
live.canon|isaiah|19:15: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
live.canon|isaiah|19:16: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), which he shaketh over it.
live.canon|isaiah|19:18: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); one shall be called, The city of destruction.
live.canon|isaiah|19:19: In that day shall there be an altar to Yahuah (LORD) in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|19:20: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto Yahuah (LORD) because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
live.canon|isaiah|19:21: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know Yahuah (LORD) in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto Yahuah (LORD), and perform it.
live.canon|isaiah|19:22: And Yahuah (LORD) shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to Yahuah (LORD), and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
live.canon|isaiah|19:23: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
live.canon|isaiah|19:24: In that day shall Yashar'el (Israel) be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
live.canon|isaiah|19:4: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, says Adonai (Lord), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|isaiah|20:2: At the same time spake Yahuah (LORD) by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off your loins, and put off your shoe from your foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
live.canon|isaiah|20:3: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Like as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
live.canon|isaiah|20:1: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
live.canon|isaiah|20:4: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
live.canon|isaiah|20:5: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
live.canon|isaiah|20:6: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
live.canon|isaiah|21:1: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.
live.canon|isaiah|21:2: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer deals treacherously, and the spoiler spoils. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
live.canon|isaiah|21:4: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure has he turned into fear unto me.
live.canon|isaiah|21:5: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, you princes, and anoint the shield.
live.canon|isaiah|21:9: And, behold, here comes a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he has broken unto the ground.
live.canon|isaiah|21:11: The burden of Dumah. He calls to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
live.canon|isaiah|21:13: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall you lodge, O you travelling companies of Dedanim.
live.canon|isaiah|21:17: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) has spoken it.
live.canon|isaiah|21:3: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
live.canon|isaiah|21:7: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
live.canon|isaiah|21:8: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
live.canon|isaiah|21:10: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), have I declared unto you.
live.canon|isaiah|21:14: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
live.canon|isaiah|21:15: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
live.canon|isaiah|21:12: The watchman said, The morning comes, and also the night: if you will enquire, enquire you: return, come.
live.canon|isaiah|21:6: For thus has Adonai (Lord) said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he sees.
live.canon|isaiah|21:16: For thus has Adonai (Lord) said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
live.canon|isaiah|22:1: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth you now, that you are wholly gone up to the housetops?

live.canon|isaiah|24:1: Behold, Yahuah (LORD) makes the earth empty, and makes it waste, and turns it upside down, and scatters abroad the inhabitants thereof.
live.canon|isaiah|25:1: O Yahuah (LORD), you are my Elohim (God); I will exalt you, I will praise your name; for you have done wonderful things; your counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
live.canon|isaiah|25:2: For you have made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
live.canon|isaiah|25:3: Therefore shall the strong people glorify you, the city of the terrible nations shall fear you.
live.canon|isaiah|25:4: For you have been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
live.canon|isaiah|25:5: You shall bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

live.canon|isaiah|29:11: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray you: and he says, I cannot; for it is sealed:
live.canon|isaiah|29:12: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray you: and he says, I am not learned.
live.canon|isaiah|29:18: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
live.canon|isaiah|29:19: The meek also shall increase their joy in Yahuah (LORD), and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|29:20: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
live.canon|isaiah|29:21: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
live.canon|isaiah|29:24: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
live.canon|isaiah|29:15: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from Yahuah (LORD), and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who sees us? and who knows us?
live.canon|isaiah|29:13: Wherefore Adonai (Lord) said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
live.canon|isaiah|30:1: Woe to the rebellious children, says Yahuah (LORD), that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
live.canon|isaiah|30:12: Wherefore thus says the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
live.canon|isaiah|30:13: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly at an instant.
live.canon|isaiah|30:15: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); In returning and rest shall you be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and you would not.
live.canon|isaiah|30:16: But you said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall you flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
live.canon|isaiah|30:17: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall you flee: till you be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
live.canon|isaiah|30:19: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: you shall weep no more: he will be very gracious unto you at the voice of your cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer you.
live.canon|isaiah|30:21: And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, This is the way, walk you in it, when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left.
live.canon|isaiah|30:22: You shall defile also the covering of your graven images of silver, and the ornament of your molten images of gold: you shall cast them away as a menstruous cloth; you shall say unto it, Get you hence.
live.canon|isaiah|30:26: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that Yahuah (LORD) binds up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
live.canon|isaiah|30:27: Behold, the name of Yahuah (LORD) comes from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
live.canon|isaiah|30:29: You shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a pipe to come into the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), to the mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|30:33: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he has made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of Yahuah (LORD), like a stream of brimstone, does kindle it.
live.canon|isaiah|30:2: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
live.canon|isaiah|30:3: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
live.canon|isaiah|30:4: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
live.canon|isaiah|30:5: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
live.canon|isaiah|30:6: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
live.canon|isaiah|30:7: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
live.canon|isaiah|30:8: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
live.canon|isaiah|30:9: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|isaiah|30:10: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
live.canon|isaiah|30:11: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) to cease from before us.
live.canon|isaiah|30:14: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
live.canon|isaiah|30:18: And therefore will Yahuah (LORD) wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for Yahuah (LORD) is a Elohim (God) of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
live.canon|isaiah|30:25: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
live.canon|isaiah|30:23: Then shall he give the rain of your seed, that you shall sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall your cattle feed in large pastures.
live.canon|isaiah|30:28: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
live.canon|isaiah|30:30: And Yahuah (LORD) shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
live.canon|isaiah|30:31: For through the voice of Yahuah (LORD) shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
live.canon|isaiah|30:32: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which Yahuah (LORD) shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
live.canon|isaiah|30:24: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
live.canon|isaiah|30:20: And though Adonai (Lord) give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not your teachers be removed into a corner any more, but your eyes shall see your teachers:
live.canon|isaiah|31:3: Now the Egyptians are men, and not Elohim (God); and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahuah (LORD) shall stretch out his hand, both he that helps shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
live.canon|isaiah|31:4: For thus has Yahuah (LORD) spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
live.canon|isaiah|31:6: Turn you unto him from whom the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have deeply revolted.
live.canon|isaiah|31:9: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, says Yahuah (LORD), whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
live.canon|isaiah|31:1: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!
live.canon|isaiah|31:2: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
live.canon|isaiah|31:5: As birds flying, so will Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
live.canon|isaiah|31:7: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
live.canon|isaiah|31:8: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
live.canon|isaiah|32:7: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
live.canon|isaiah|32:9: Rise up, you women that are at ease; hear my voice, you careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
live.canon|isaiah|32:10: Many days and years shall you be troubled, you careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
live.canon|isaiah|32:11: Tremble, you women that are at ease; be troubled, you careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
live.canon|isaiah|32:1: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
live.canon|isaiah|32:2: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
live.canon|isaiah|32:3: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
live.canon|isaiah|32:4: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
live.canon|isaiah|32:5: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
live.canon|isaiah|32:6: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against Yahuah (LORD), to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
live.canon|isaiah|32:8: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
live.canon|isaiah|32:12: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
live.canon|isaiah|32:13: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
live.canon|isaiah|32:14: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
live.canon|isaiah|32:15: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
live.canon|isaiah|32:16: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
live.canon|isaiah|32:17: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
live.canon|isaiah|32:18: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
live.canon|isaiah|32:19: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
live.canon|isaiah|32:20: Blessed are you that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
live.canon|isaiah|33:1: Woe to you that spoilest, and you were not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with you! when you shall cease to spoil, you shall be spoiled; and when you shall make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with you.
live.canon|isaiah|33:2: O Yahuah (LORD), be gracious unto us; we have waited for you: be you their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
live.canon|isaiah|33:5: Yahuah (LORD) is exalted; for he dwells on high: he has filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
live.canon|isaiah|33:6: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of your times, and strength of salvation: the fear of Yahuah (LORD) is his treasure.
live.canon|isaiah|33:8: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceases: he has broken the covenant, he has despised the cities, he regards no man.
live.canon|isaiah|33:9: The earth mourns and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
live.canon|isaiah|33:10: Now will I rise, says Yahuah (LORD); now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
live.canon|isaiah|33:11: You shall conceive chaff, you shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
live.canon|isaiah|33:13: Hear, you that are far off, what I have done; and, you that are near, acknowledge my might.
live.canon|isaiah|33:14: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness has surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
live.canon|isaiah|33:15: He that walks righteously, and speaks uprightly; he that despises the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from seeing evil;
live.canon|isaiah|33:17: Your eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
live.canon|isaiah|33:18: Your heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
live.canon|isaiah|33:19: You shall not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than you can perceive; of a stammering tongue, that you can not understand.
live.canon|isaiah|33:20: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: your eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
live.canon|isaiah|33:23: Your tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
live.canon|isaiah|33:3: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
live.canon|isaiah|33:4: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
live.canon|isaiah|33:7: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
live.canon|isaiah|33:12: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
live.canon|isaiah|33:16: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
live.canon|isaiah|33:21: But there the glorious Yahuah (LORD) will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
live.canon|isaiah|33:22: For Yahuah (LORD) is our judge, Yahuah (LORD) is our lawgiver, Yahuah (LORD) is our king; he will save us.
live.canon|isaiah|33:24: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
live.canon|isaiah|34:1: Come near, you nations, to hear; and hearken, you people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
live.canon|isaiah|34:2: For the indignation of Yahuah (LORD) is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he has utterly destroyed them, he has delivered them to the slaughter.
live.canon|isaiah|34:4: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falls off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
live.canon|isaiah|34:6: The sword of Yahuah (LORD) is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for Yahuah (LORD) has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
live.canon|isaiah|34:16: Seek you out of the book of Yahuah (LORD), and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it has commanded, and his spirit it has gathered them.
live.canon|isaiah|34:17: And he has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
live.canon|isaiah|34:3: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
live.canon|isaiah|34:5: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
live.canon|isaiah|34:7: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
live.canon|isaiah|34:8: For it is the day of the LORD’S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
live.canon|isaiah|34:9: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
live.canon|isaiah|34:10: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
live.canon|isaiah|34:11: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
live.canon|isaiah|34:12: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
live.canon|isaiah|34:13: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
live.canon|isaiah|34:14: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
live.canon|isaiah|34:15: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
live.canon|isaiah|35:3: Strengthen you the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
live.canon|isaiah|35:1: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
live.canon|isaiah|35:2: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of Yahuah (LORD), and the excellency of our Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|35:4: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your Elohim (God) will come with vengeance, even Elohim (God) with a recompence; he will come and save you.
live.canon|isaiah|35:5: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
live.canon|isaiah|35:6: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
live.canon|isaiah|35:7: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
live.canon|isaiah|35:8: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
live.canon|isaiah|35:9: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
live.canon|isaiah|35:10: And the ransomed of Yahuah (LORD) shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
live.canon|isaiah|36:4: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say you now to Hezekiah, Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein you trust?
live.canon|isaiah|36:5: I say, say you, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom do you trust, that you rebellest against me?
live.canon|isaiah|36:6: Lo, you trust in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
live.canon|isaiah|36:7: But if you say to me, We trust in Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Yahudah (Judah) and to Jerusalem, You shall worship before this altar?
live.canon|isaiah|36:8: Now therefore give pledges, I pray you, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you be able on your part to set riders upon them.
live.canon|isaiah|36:9: How then will you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
live.canon|isaiah|36:11: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray you, unto your servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
live.canon|isaiah|36:12: But Rabshakeh said, Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words? has he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
live.canon|isaiah|36:13: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, and said, Hear you the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
live.canon|isaiah|36:14: Thus says the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
live.canon|isaiah|36:16: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus says the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat you every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink you every one the waters of his own cistern;
live.canon|isaiah|36:18: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, Yahuah (LORD) will deliver us. Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
live.canon|isaiah|36:1: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Yahudah (Judah), and took them.
live.canon|isaiah|36:2: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.
live.canon|isaiah|36:3: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.
live.canon|isaiah|36:10: And am I now come up without Yahuah (LORD) against this land to destroy it? Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
live.canon|isaiah|36:15: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahuah (LORD), saying, Yahuah (LORD) will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
live.canon|isaiah|36:17: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
live.canon|isaiah|36:19: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
live.canon|isaiah|36:20: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that Yahuah (LORD) should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
live.canon|isaiah|36:21: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
live.canon|isaiah|36:22: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
live.canon|isaiah|37:3: And they said unto him, Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
live.canon|isaiah|37:17: Incline your ear, O Yahuah (LORD), and hear; open your eyes, O Yahuah (LORD), and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which has sent to reproach the living Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|37:20: Now therefore, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God), save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahuah (LORD), even you only.
live.canon|isaiah|37:21: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Whereas you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
live.canon|isaiah|37:22: This is the word which Yahuah (LORD) has spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, has despised you, and laughed you to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
live.canon|isaiah|37:23: Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? and against whom have you exalted your voice, and lifted up your eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|37:26: Have you not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that you should be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
live.canon|isaiah|37:29: Because your rage against me, and your tumult, is come up into my ears, therefore will I put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
live.canon|isaiah|37:30: And this shall be a sign unto you, You shall eat this year such as grows of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
live.canon|isaiah|37:33: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
live.canon|isaiah|37:1: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|37:2: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
live.canon|isaiah|37:5: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
live.canon|isaiah|37:7: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

live.canon|isaiah|37:4: It may be Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living Elohim (God), and will reprove the words which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has heard: wherefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.
live.canon|isaiah|37:6: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall you say unto your master, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Be not afraid of the words that you have heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
live.canon|isaiah|37:9: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with you. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
live.canon|isaiah|37:10: Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying, Let not your Elohim (God), in whom you trust, deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
live.canon|isaiah|37:11: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shall you be delivered?
live.canon|isaiah|37:16: O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), that dwell between the cherubims, you are the Elohim (God), even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: you have made heaven and earth.
live.canon|isaiah|37:12: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
live.canon|isaiah|37:13: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
live.canon|isaiah|37:14: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of Yahuah (LORD), and spread it before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|37:15: And Hezekiah prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|isaiah|37:18: Of a truth, Yahuah (LORD), the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
live.canon|isaiah|37:19: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
live.canon|isaiah|37:25: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
live.canon|isaiah|37:27: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
live.canon|isaiah|37:31: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Yahudah (Judah) shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
live.canon|isaiah|37:32: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall do this.
live.canon|isaiah|37:28: But I know your abode, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against me.
live.canon|isaiah|37:36: Then the angel of Yahuah (LORD) went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
live.canon|isaiah|37:37: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
live.canon|isaiah|37:38: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
live.canon|isaiah|37:34: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|37:35: For I will defend this city to save it for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
live.canon|isaiah|37:24: By your servants have you reproached Adonai (Lord), and have said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
live.canon|isaiah|38:6: And I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
live.canon|isaiah|38:7: And this shall be a sign unto you from Yahuah (LORD), that Yahuah (LORD) will do this thing that he has spoken;
live.canon|isaiah|38:12: My age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night will you make an end of me.
live.canon|isaiah|38:13: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night will you make an end of me.
live.canon|isaiah|38:14: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: my eyes fail with looking upward: O Yahuah (LORD), I am oppressed; undertake for me.
live.canon|isaiah|38:15: What shall I say? he has both spoken unto me, and himself has done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
live.canon|isaiah|38:17: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but you have in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
live.canon|isaiah|38:18: For the grave cannot praise you, death can not celebrate you: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for your truth.
live.canon|isaiah|38:19: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known your truth.
live.canon|isaiah|38:1: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Set your house in order: for you shall die, and not live.
live.canon|isaiah|38:2: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD),
live.canon|isaiah|38:4: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) to Isaiah, saying,
live.canon|isaiah|38:8: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
live.canon|isaiah|38:9: The writing of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
live.canon|isaiah|38:10: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
live.canon|isaiah|38:11: I said, I shall not see Yahuah (LORD), even Yahuah (LORD), in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
live.canon|isaiah|38:20: Yahuah (LORD) was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|38:21: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
live.canon|isaiah|38:22: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|isaiah|38:3: And said, Remember now, O Yahuah (LORD), I beseech you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
live.canon|isaiah|38:5: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of David your father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears: behold, I will add unto your days fifteen years.
live.canon|isaiah|38:16: O Adonai (Lord), by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so will you recover me, and make me to live.
live.canon|isaiah|39:3: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto you? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
live.canon|isaiah|39:4: Then said he, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
live.canon|isaiah|39:6: Behold, the days come, that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|39:7: And of your sons that shall issue from you, which you shall beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
live.canon|isaiah|39:8: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of Yahuah (LORD) which you have spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
live.canon|isaiah|39:1: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
live.canon|isaiah|39:2: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
live.canon|isaiah|39:5: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts):
live.canon|isaiah|40:12: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
live.canon|isaiah|40:13: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD), or being his counsellor has taught him?
live.canon|isaiah|40:15: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he takes up the isles as a very little thing.
live.canon|isaiah|40:18: To whom then will you liken Elohim (God)? or what likeness will you compare unto him?
live.canon|isaiah|40:19: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreads it over with gold, and casts silver chains.
live.canon|isaiah|40:20: He that is so impoverished that he has no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeks unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
live.canon|isaiah|40:21: Have you not known? have you not heard? has it not been told you from the beginning? have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?
live.canon|isaiah|40:22: It is he that sits upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreads them out as a tent to dwell in:
live.canon|isaiah|40:23: That brings the princes to nothing; he makes the judges of the earth as vanity.
live.canon|isaiah|40:25: To whom then will you liken me, or shall I be equal? says the Holy One.
live.canon|isaiah|40:26: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who has created these things, that brings out their host by number: he calls them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one fails.
live.canon|isaiah|40:27: Why say you, O Jacob, and speak, O Yashar'el (Israel), My way is hid from Yahuah (LORD), and my judgment is passed over from my Elohim (God)?
live.canon|isaiah|40:28: Have you not known? have you not heard, that El Olam (the everlasting God), Yahuah (LORD), the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
live.canon|isaiah|40:29: He gives power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increases strength.
live.canon|isaiah|40:1: Comfort you, comfort you my people, says your Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|40:4: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
live.canon|isaiah|40:6: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
live.canon|isaiah|40:2: Speak you comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she has received of the LORD’S hand double for all her sins.
live.canon|isaiah|40:3: The voice of him that cries in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of Yahuah (LORD), make straight in the desert a highway for our Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|40:5: And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
live.canon|isaiah|40:8: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our Elohim (God) shall stand for ever.
live.canon|isaiah|40:10: Behold, Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
live.canon|isaiah|40:11: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
live.canon|isaiah|40:14: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
live.canon|isaiah|40:16: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
live.canon|isaiah|40:17: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
live.canon|isaiah|40:24: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
live.canon|isaiah|40:30: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
live.canon|isaiah|40:31: But they that wait upon Yahuah (LORD) shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
live.canon|isaiah|40:7: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) blows upon it: surely the people is grass.
live.canon|isaiah|40:9: O Zion, that bring good tidings, get you up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bring good tidings, lift up your voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Yahudah (Judah), Behold your Elohim (God)!
live.canon|isaiah|41:4: Who has wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I Yahuah (LORD), the first, and with the last; I am he.
live.canon|isaiah|41:14: Fear not, you worm Jacob, and you men of Yashar'el (Israel); I will help you, says Yahuah (LORD), and your redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|41:15: Behold, I will make you a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: you shall thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shall make the hills as chaff.
live.canon|isaiah|41:16: You shall fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and you shall rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), and shall glory in the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|41:17: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue fails for thirst, I Yahuah (LORD) will hear them, I the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) will not forsake them.
live.canon|isaiah|41:20: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of Yahuah (LORD) has done this, and the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) has created it.
live.canon|isaiah|41:21: Produce your cause, says Yahuah (LORD); bring forth your strong reasons, says the King of Jacob.
live.canon|isaiah|41:23: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
live.canon|isaiah|41:24: Behold, you are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
live.canon|isaiah|41:25: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treads clay.
live.canon|isaiah|41:26: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that shows, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that hears your words.
live.canon|isaiah|41:27: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that brings good tidings.
live.canon|isaiah|41:1: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
live.canon|isaiah|41:2: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
live.canon|isaiah|41:3: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
live.canon|isaiah|41:5: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
live.canon|isaiah|41:6: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
live.canon|isaiah|41:7: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
live.canon|isaiah|41:8: But you, Yashar'el (Israel), are my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
live.canon|isaiah|41:9: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called you from the chief men thereof, and said unto you, You are my servant; I have chosen you, and not cast you away.
live.canon|isaiah|41:10: Fear you not; for I am with you: be not dismayed; for I am your Elohim (God): I will strengthen you; yea, I will help you; yea, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
live.canon|isaiah|41:11: Behold, all they that were incensed against you shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with you shall perish.
live.canon|isaiah|41:18: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
live.canon|isaiah|41:19: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
live.canon|isaiah|41:22: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
live.canon|isaiah|41:28: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
live.canon|isaiah|41:29: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
live.canon|isaiah|41:12: You shall seek them, and shall not find them, even them that contended with you: they that war against you shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
live.canon|isaiah|41:13: For I Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will hold your right hand, saying unto you, Fear not; I will help you.
live.canon|isaiah|42:1: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
live.canon|isaiah|42:5: Thus says Elohim (God) Yahuah (LORD), he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which comes out of it; he that gives breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
live.canon|isaiah|42:6: I Yahuah (LORD) have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and give you for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
live.canon|isaiah|42:10: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD) a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
live.canon|isaiah|42:11: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar does inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
live.canon|isaiah|42:20: Seeing many things, but you observest not; opening the ears, but he hears not.
live.canon|isaiah|42:22: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivers; for a spoil, and none says, Restore.
live.canon|isaiah|42:25: Therefore he has poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it has set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
live.canon|isaiah|42:2: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
live.canon|isaiah|42:3: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
live.canon|isaiah|42:4: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
live.canon|isaiah|42:7: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
live.canon|isaiah|42:8: I am Yahuah (LORD): that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
live.canon|isaiah|42:9: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
live.canon|isaiah|42:12: Let them give glory unto Yahuah (LORD), and declare his praise in the islands.
live.canon|isaiah|42:13: Yahuah (LORD) shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
live.canon|isaiah|42:14: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
live.canon|isaiah|42:15: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
live.canon|isaiah|42:16: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
live.canon|isaiah|42:19: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD’S servant?
