live.canon|isaiah|42:17: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, You are our gods.
live.canon|isaiah|42:21: Yahuah (LORD) is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
live.canon|isaiah|42:23: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
live.canon|isaiah|42:24: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Yashar'el (Israel) to the robbers? did not Yahuah (LORD), he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
live.canon|isaiah|42:18: Hear, you deaf; and look, you blind, that you may see.
live.canon|isaiah|43:1: But now thus says Yahuah (LORD) that created you, O Jacob, and he that formed you, O Yashar'el (Israel), Fear not: for I have redeemed you, I have called you by your name; you are mine.
live.canon|isaiah|43:2: When you passest through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow you: when you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon you.
live.canon|isaiah|43:3: For I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), your Saviour: I gave Egypt for your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for you.
live.canon|isaiah|43:4: Since you were precious in my sight, you have been honourable, and I have loved you: therefore will I give men for you, and people for your life.
live.canon|isaiah|43:5: Fear not: for I am with you: I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west;
live.canon|isaiah|43:10: You are my witnesses, says Yahuah (LORD), and my servant whom I have chosen: that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no Elohim (God) formed, neither shall there be after me.
live.canon|isaiah|43:12: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore you are my witnesses, says Yahuah (LORD), that I am Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|43:14: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), your redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
live.canon|isaiah|43:16: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), which makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
live.canon|isaiah|43:17: Which brings forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
live.canon|isaiah|43:18: Remember you not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
live.canon|isaiah|43:19: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
live.canon|isaiah|43:22: But you have not called upon me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of me, O Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|43:23: You have not brought me the small cattle of your burnt offerings; neither have you honoured me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with an offering, nor wearied you with incense.
live.canon|isaiah|43:24: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, neither have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices: but you have made me to serve with your sins, you have wearied me with your iniquities.
live.canon|isaiah|43:25: I, even I, am he that blotteth out your transgressions for my own sake, and will not remember your sins.
live.canon|isaiah|43:26: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare you, that you may be justified.
live.canon|isaiah|43:27: Your first father has sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
live.canon|isaiah|43:6: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
live.canon|isaiah|43:7: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
live.canon|isaiah|43:8: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
live.canon|isaiah|43:9: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
live.canon|isaiah|43:11: I, even I, am Yahuah (LORD); and beside me there is no saviour.
live.canon|isaiah|43:13: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
live.canon|isaiah|43:15: I am Yahuah (LORD), your Holy One, the creator of Yashar'el (Israel), your King.
live.canon|isaiah|43:20: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
live.canon|isaiah|43:21: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
live.canon|isaiah|43:28: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Yashar'el (Israel) to reproaches.
live.canon|isaiah|44:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) that made you, and formed you from the womb, which will help you; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and you, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
live.canon|isaiah|44:13: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and makes it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
live.canon|isaiah|44:14: He heweth him down cedars, and takes the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain does nourish it.
live.canon|isaiah|44:15: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he makes a god, and worshippeth it; he makes it a graven image, and falls down thereto.
live.canon|isaiah|44:16: He burns part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eats flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and says, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
live.canon|isaiah|44:17: And the residue thereof he makes a god, even his graven image: he falls down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and says, Deliver me; for you are my god.
live.canon|isaiah|44:18: They have not known nor understood: for he has shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
live.canon|isaiah|44:20: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart has turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
live.canon|isaiah|44:21: Remember these, O Jacob and Yashar'el (Israel); for you are my servant: I have formed you; you are my servant: O Yashar'el (Israel), you shall not be forgotten of me.
live.canon|isaiah|44:22: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed you.
live.canon|isaiah|44:23: Sing, O you heavens; for Yahuah (LORD) has done it: shout, you lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, you mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for Yahuah (LORD) has redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|44:24: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), your redeemer, and he that formed you from the womb, I am Yahuah (LORD) that makes all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreads abroad the earth by myself;
live.canon|isaiah|44:25: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and makes diviners mad; that turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;
live.canon|isaiah|44:26: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; that says to Jerusalem, You shall be inhabited; and to the cities of Yahudah (Judah), You shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
live.canon|isaiah|44:27: That says to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers:
live.canon|isaiah|44:28: That says of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, You shall be built; and to the temple, Your foundation shall be laid.
live.canon|isaiah|44:1: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Yashar'el (Israel), whom I have chosen:
live.canon|isaiah|44:4: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
live.canon|isaiah|44:5: One shall say, I am the LORD’S; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto Yahuah (LORD), and surname himself by the name of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|44:7: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
live.canon|isaiah|44:3: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon your seed, and my blessing upon your offspring:
live.canon|isaiah|44:6: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|44:8: Fear you not, neither be afraid: have not I told you from that time, and have declared it? you are even my witnesses. Is there a Elohim (God) beside me? yea, there is no Elohim (God); I know not any.
live.canon|isaiah|44:10: Who has formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
live.canon|isaiah|44:9: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
live.canon|isaiah|44:11: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
live.canon|isaiah|44:19: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
live.canon|isaiah|44:12: The smith with the tongs both works in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and works it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength fails: he drinks no water, and is faint.
live.canon|isaiah|45:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
live.canon|isaiah|45:2: I will go before you, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
live.canon|isaiah|45:3: And I will give you the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that I, Yahuah (LORD), which call you by your name, am the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|45:4: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Yashar'el (Israel) my elect, I have even called you by your name: I have surnamed you, though you have not known me.
live.canon|isaiah|45:5: I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God) beside me: I girded you, though you have not known me:
live.canon|isaiah|45:14: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto you, and they shall be yours: they shall come after you; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto you, they shall make supplication unto you, saying, Surely Elohim (God) is in you; and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|45:18: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) that created the heavens; Elohim (God) himself that formed the earth and made it; he has established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am Yahuah (LORD); and there is none else.
live.canon|isaiah|45:19: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek you me in vain: I Yahuah (LORD) speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
live.canon|isaiah|45:20: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, you that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
live.canon|isaiah|45:21: Tell you, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who has declared this from ancient time? who has told it from that time? have not I Yahuah (LORD)? and there is no Elohim (God) else beside me; a just Elohim (God) and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
live.canon|isaiah|45:22: Look unto me, and be you saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am Elohim (God), and there is none else.
live.canon|isaiah|45:6: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else.
live.canon|isaiah|45:7: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I Yahuah (LORD) do all these things.
live.canon|isaiah|45:8: Drop down, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I Yahuah (LORD) have created it.
live.canon|isaiah|45:9: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What make you? or your work, He has no hands?
live.canon|isaiah|45:10: Woe unto him that says unto his father, What begettest you? or to the woman, What have you brought forth?
live.canon|isaiah|45:11: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command you me.
live.canon|isaiah|45:13: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|isaiah|45:15: Verily you are a Elohim (God) that hide thyself, O Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), the Saviour.
live.canon|isaiah|45:17: But Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved in Yahuah (LORD) with an everlasting salvation: you shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
live.canon|isaiah|45:12: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
live.canon|isaiah|45:16: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
live.canon|isaiah|45:23: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
live.canon|isaiah|45:24: Surely, shall one say, in Yahuah (LORD) have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
live.canon|isaiah|45:25: In Yahuah (LORD) shall all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) be justified, and shall glory.
live.canon|isaiah|46:5: To whom will you liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
live.canon|isaiah|46:6: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he makes it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
live.canon|isaiah|46:7: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he stands; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
live.canon|isaiah|46:8: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O you transgressors.
live.canon|isaiah|46:12: Hearken unto me, you stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
live.canon|isaiah|46:1: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
live.canon|isaiah|46:2: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
live.canon|isaiah|46:3: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
live.canon|isaiah|46:4: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
live.canon|isaiah|46:9: Remember the former things of old: for I am Elohim (God), and there is none else; I am Elohim (God), and there is none like me,
live.canon|isaiah|46:10: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
live.canon|isaiah|46:11: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
live.canon|isaiah|46:13: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Yashar'el (Israel) my glory.
live.canon|isaiah|47:8: Therefore hear now this, you that are given to pleasures, that dwell carelessly, that say in your heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
live.canon|isaiah|47:9: But these two things shall come to you in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon you in their perfection for the multitude of your sorceries, and for the great abundance of your enchantments.
live.canon|isaiah|47:10: For you have trusted in your wickedness: you have said, None sees me. Your wisdom and your knowledge, it has perverted you; and you have said in your heart, I am, and none else beside me.
live.canon|isaiah|47:11: Therefore shall evil come upon you; you shall not know from whence it rises: and mischief shall fall upon you; you shall not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon you suddenly, which you shall not know.
live.canon|isaiah|47:12: Stand now with your enchantments, and with the multitude of your sorceries, wherein you have laboured from your youth; if so be you shall be able to profit, if so be you may prevail.
live.canon|isaiah|47:13: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save you from these things that shall come upon you.
live.canon|isaiah|47:15: Thus shall they be unto you with whom you have laboured, even your merchants, from your youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save you.
live.canon|isaiah|47:4: As for our redeemer, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|47:1: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called tender and delicate.
live.canon|isaiah|47:2: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover your locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
live.canon|isaiah|47:3: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, your shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet you as a man.
live.canon|isaiah|47:5: Sit you silent, and get you into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
live.canon|isaiah|47:14: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
live.canon|isaiah|47:6: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted my inheritance, and given them into your hand: you did shew them no mercy; upon the ancient have you very heavily laid your yoke.
live.canon|isaiah|47:7: And you saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that you did not lay these things to your heart, neither did remember the latter end of it.
live.canon|isaiah|48:1: Hear you this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Yashar'el (Israel), and are come forth out of the waters of Yahudah (Judah), which swear by the name of Yahuah (LORD), and make mention of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
live.canon|isaiah|48:5: I have even from the beginning declared it to you; before it came to pass I shewed it you: lest you should say, My idol has done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, has commanded them.
live.canon|isaiah|48:6: You have heard, see all this; and will not you declare it? I have shewed you new things from this time, even hidden things, and you did not know them.
live.canon|isaiah|48:7: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when you heard them not; lest you should say, Behold, I knew them.
live.canon|isaiah|48:8: Yea, you heard not; yea, you knew not; yea, from that time that your ear was not opened: for I knew that you would deal very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.
live.canon|isaiah|48:9: For my name’s sake will I defer my anger, and for my praise will I refrain for you, that I cut you not off.
live.canon|isaiah|48:10: Behold, I have refined you, but not with silver; I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
live.canon|isaiah|48:11: For my own sake, even for my own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
live.canon|isaiah|48:13: My hand also has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
live.canon|isaiah|48:14: All you, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them has declared these things? Yahuah (LORD) has loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
live.canon|isaiah|48:16: Come you near unto me, hear you this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), and his Spirit, has sent me.
live.canon|isaiah|48:17: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), your Redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) which teaches you to profit, which leads you by the way that you should go.
live.canon|isaiah|48:18: O that you had hearkened to my commandments! then had your peace been as a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea:
live.canon|isaiah|48:19: Your seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of your bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
live.canon|isaiah|48:20: Go you forth of Babylon, flee you from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare you, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say you, Yahuah (LORD) has redeemed his servant Jacob.
live.canon|isaiah|48:22: There is no peace, says Yahuah (LORD), unto the wicked.
live.canon|isaiah|48:2: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
live.canon|isaiah|48:3: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
live.canon|isaiah|48:12: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Yashar'el (Israel), my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
live.canon|isaiah|48:15: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
live.canon|isaiah|48:4: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow brass;
live.canon|isaiah|48:21: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
live.canon|isaiah|49:1: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, you people, from far; Yahuah (LORD) has called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother has he made mention of my name.
live.canon|isaiah|49:2: And he has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand has he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver has he hid me;
live.canon|isaiah|49:5: And now, says Yahuah (LORD) that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Yashar'el (Israel) be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and my Elohim (God) shall be my strength.
live.canon|isaiah|49:6: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
live.canon|isaiah|49:7: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Redeemer of Yashar'el (Israel), and his Holy One, to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of Yahuah (LORD) that is faithful, and the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), and he shall choose you.
live.canon|isaiah|49:8: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), In an acceptable time have I heard you, and in a day of salvation have I helped you: and I will preserve you, and give you for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
live.canon|isaiah|49:9: That you may say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
live.canon|isaiah|49:10: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that has mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
live.canon|isaiah|49:13: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for Yahuah (LORD) has comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
live.canon|isaiah|49:14: But Zion said, Yahuah (LORD) has forsaken me, and my Lord has forgotten me.
live.canon|isaiah|49:15: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget you.
live.canon|isaiah|49:16: Behold, I have graven you upon the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.
live.canon|isaiah|49:17: Your children shall make haste; your destroyers and they that made you waste shall go forth of you.
live.canon|isaiah|49:18: Lift up your eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live, says Yahuah (LORD), you shall surely clothe you with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on you, as a bride does.
live.canon|isaiah|49:19: For your waste and your desolate places, and the land of your destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed you up shall be far away.
live.canon|isaiah|49:20: The children which you shall have, after you have lost the other, shall say again in your ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
live.canon|isaiah|49:21: Then shall you say in your heart, Who has begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
live.canon|isaiah|49:22: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Behold, I will lift up my hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
live.canon|isaiah|49:23: And kings shall be your nursing fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers: they shall bow down to you with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of your feet; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD): for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
live.canon|isaiah|49:25: But thus says Yahuah (LORD), Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contends with you, and I will save your children.
live.canon|isaiah|49:26: And I will feed them that oppress you with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) am your Saviour and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
live.canon|isaiah|49:4: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with Yahuah (LORD), and my work with my Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|49:11: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
live.canon|isaiah|49:12: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
live.canon|isaiah|49:24: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
live.canon|isaiah|49:3: And said unto me, You are my servant, O Yashar'el (Israel), in whom I will be glorified.
live.canon|isaiah|50:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have you sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
live.canon|isaiah|50:2: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dies for thirst.
live.canon|isaiah|50:10: Who is among you that fears Yahuah (LORD), that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walks in darkness, and has no light? let him trust in the name of Yahuah (LORD), and stay upon his Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|50:11: Behold, all you that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that you have kindled. This shall you have of my hand; you shall lie down in sorrow.
live.canon|isaiah|50:3: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
live.canon|isaiah|50:6: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
live.canon|isaiah|50:7: For Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
live.canon|isaiah|50:9: Behold, Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
live.canon|isaiah|50:4: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth my ear to hear as the learned.
live.canon|isaiah|50:5: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
live.canon|isaiah|50:8: He is near that justifies me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is my adversary? let him come near to me.
live.canon|isaiah|51:5: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and my arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on my arm shall they trust.
live.canon|isaiah|51:7: Hearken unto me, you that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear you not the reproach of men, neither be you afraid of their revilings.
live.canon|isaiah|51:9: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Yahuah (LORD); awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Are you not it that has cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
live.canon|isaiah|51:10: Are you not it which has dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that has made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
live.canon|isaiah|51:12: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who are you, that you should be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of Adam which shall be made as grass;
live.canon|isaiah|51:13: And forgettest Yahuah (LORD) your maker, that has stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and have feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
live.canon|isaiah|51:16: And I have put my words in your mouth, and I have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, You are my people.
live.canon|isaiah|51:17: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which have drunk at the hand of Yahuah (LORD) the cup of his fury; you have drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
live.canon|isaiah|51:18: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she has brought forth; neither is there any that takes her by the hand of all the sons that she has brought up.
live.canon|isaiah|51:19: These two things are come unto you; who shall be sorry for you? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort you?
live.canon|isaiah|51:20: Your sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of Yahuah (LORD), the rebuke of your Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|51:21: Therefore hear now this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
live.canon|isaiah|51:23: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict you; which have said to your soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and you have laid your body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
live.canon|isaiah|51:2: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
live.canon|isaiah|51:3: For Yahuah (LORD) shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahuah (LORD); joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
live.canon|isaiah|51:4: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
live.canon|isaiah|51:6: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
live.canon|isaiah|51:8: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
live.canon|isaiah|51:11: Therefore the redeemed of Yahuah (LORD) shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
live.canon|isaiah|51:14: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
live.canon|isaiah|51:15: But I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), that divided the sea, whose waves roared: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
live.canon|isaiah|51:1: Hearken to me, you that follow after righteousness, you that seek Yahuah (LORD): look unto the rock whence you are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence you are digged.
live.canon|isaiah|51:22: Thus says your Adonai (Lord) Yahuah (LORD), and your Elohim (God) that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; you shall no more drink it again:
live.canon|isaiah|52:1: Awake, awake; put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean.
live.canon|isaiah|52:2: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
live.canon|isaiah|52:4: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
live.canon|isaiah|52:5: Now therefore, what have I here, says Yahuah (LORD), that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, says Yahuah (LORD); and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
live.canon|isaiah|52:7: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that brings good tidings, that publisheth peace; that brings good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that says unto Zion, Your Elohim (God) reigns!
live.canon|isaiah|52:8: Your watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when Yahuah (LORD) shall bring again Zion.
live.canon|isaiah|52:9: Break forth into joy, sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem: for Yahuah (LORD) has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.
live.canon|isaiah|52:10: Yahuah (LORD) has made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|52:11: Depart you, depart you, go you out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go you out of the midst of her; be you clean, that bear the vessels of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|52:12: For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for Yahuah (LORD) will go before you; and the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) will be your rereward.
live.canon|isaiah|52:14: As many were astonied at you; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
live.canon|isaiah|52:3: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), You have sold yourselves for nought; and you shall be redeemed without money.
live.canon|isaiah|52:13: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
live.canon|isaiah|52:15: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
live.canon|isaiah|52:6: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that does speak: behold, it is I.
live.canon|isaiah|53:1: Who has believed our report? and to whom is the arm of Yahuah (LORD) revealed?
live.canon|isaiah|53:2: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he has no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
live.canon|isaiah|53:4: Surely he has borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of Elohim (God), and afflicted.
live.canon|isaiah|53:6: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and Yahuah (LORD) has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
live.canon|isaiah|53:7: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.
live.canon|isaiah|53:10: Yet it pleased Yahuah (LORD) to bruise him; he has put him to grief: when you shall make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Yahuah (LORD) shall prosper in his hand.
live.canon|isaiah|53:12: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he has poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
live.canon|isaiah|53:3: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
live.canon|isaiah|53:5: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
live.canon|isaiah|53:8: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
live.canon|isaiah|53:9: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
live.canon|isaiah|53:11: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
live.canon|isaiah|54:1: Sing, O barren, you that did not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, you that did not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|54:2: Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of your habitations: spare not, lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes;
live.canon|isaiah|54:3: For you shall break forth on the right hand and on the left; and your seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
live.canon|isaiah|54:4: Fear not; for you shall not be ashamed: neither be you confounded; for you shall not be put to shame: for you shall forget the shame of your youth, and shall not remember the reproach of your widowhood any more.
live.canon|isaiah|54:5: For your Maker is your husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); The Elohim (God) of the whole earth shall he be called.
live.canon|isaiah|54:6: For Yahuah (LORD) has called you as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when you were refused, says your Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|54:7: For a small moment have I forsaken you; but with great mercies will I gather you.
live.canon|isaiah|54:8: In a little wrath I hid my face from you for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on you, says Yahuah (LORD) your Redeemer.
live.canon|isaiah|54:9: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with you, nor rebuke you.
live.canon|isaiah|54:10: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from you, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, says Yahuah (LORD) that has mercy on you.
live.canon|isaiah|54:17: No weapon that is formed against you shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against you in judgment you shall condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of Yahuah (LORD), and their righteousness is of me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|54:11: O you afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay your stones with fair colours, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
live.canon|isaiah|54:12: And I will make your windows of agates, and your gates of carbuncles, and all your borders of pleasant stones.
live.canon|isaiah|54:13: And all your children shall be taught of Yahuah (LORD); and great shall be the peace of your children.
live.canon|isaiah|54:14: In righteousness shall you be established: you shall be far from oppression; for you shall not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near you.
live.canon|isaiah|54:15: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against you shall fall for your sake.
live.canon|isaiah|54:16: Behold, I have created the smith that blows the coals in the fire, and that brings forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
live.canon|isaiah|55:2: Wherefore do you spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfies not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat you that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
live.canon|isaiah|55:5: Behold, you shall call a nation that you know not, and nations that knew not you shall run unto you because of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and for the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); for he has glorified you.
live.canon|isaiah|55:6: Seek you Yahuah (LORD) while he may be found, call you upon him while he is near:
live.canon|isaiah|55:8: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|55:10: For as the rain comes down, and the snow from heaven, and returns not thither, but watereth the earth, and makes it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
live.canon|isaiah|55:11: So shall my word be that goes forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
live.canon|isaiah|55:12: For you shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
live.canon|isaiah|55:3: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
live.canon|isaiah|55:4: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
live.canon|isaiah|55:7: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto Yahuah (LORD), and he will have mercy upon him; and to our Elohim (God), for he will abundantly pardon.
live.canon|isaiah|55:9: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
live.canon|isaiah|55:13: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to Yahuah (LORD) for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
live.canon|isaiah|55:1: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come you to the waters, and he that has no money; come you, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
live.canon|isaiah|57:1: The righteous perishes, and no man lays it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
live.canon|isaiah|57:3: But draw near hither, you sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
live.canon|isaiah|57:9: And you went to the king with ointment, and did increase your perfumes, and did send your messengers far off, and did debase thyself even unto hell.
live.canon|isaiah|57:10: You are wearied in the greatness of your way; yet saidst you not, There is no hope: you have found the life of your hand; therefore you were not grieved.
live.canon|isaiah|57:11: And of whom have you been afraid or feared, that you have lied, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and you fearest me not?
live.canon|isaiah|57:12: I will declare your righteousness, and your works; for they shall not profit you.
live.canon|isaiah|57:13: When you cry, let your companies deliver you; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that puts his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
live.canon|isaiah|57:14: And shall say, Cast you up, cast you up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
live.canon|isaiah|57:15: For thus says the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
live.canon|isaiah|57:19: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, says Yahuah (LORD); and I will heal him.
live.canon|isaiah|57:2: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
live.canon|isaiah|57:5: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
live.canon|isaiah|57:4: Against whom do you sport yourselves? against whom make you a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are you not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
live.canon|isaiah|57:6: Among the smooth stones of the stream is your portion; they, they are your lot: even to them have you poured a drink offering, you have offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
live.canon|isaiah|57:16: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
live.canon|isaiah|57:17: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
live.canon|isaiah|57:18: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
live.canon|isaiah|57:20: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
live.canon|isaiah|57:7: Upon a lofty and high mountain have you set your bed: even thither went you up to offer sacrifice.
live.canon|isaiah|57:8: Behind the doors also and the posts have you set up your remembrance: for you have discovered thyself to another than me, and are gone up; you have enlarged your bed, and made you a covenant with them; you lovedst their bed where you saw it.
live.canon|isaiah|57:21: There is no peace, says my Elohim (God), to the wicked.
live.canon|isaiah|58:1: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up your voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
live.canon|isaiah|58:3: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and you see not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and you take no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
live.canon|isaiah|58:4: Behold, you fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: you shall not fast as you do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
live.canon|isaiah|58:5: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|isaiah|58:6: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?
live.canon|isaiah|58:7: Is it not to deal your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor that are cast out to your house? when you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you hide not thyself from your own flesh?
live.canon|isaiah|58:8: Then shall your light break forth as the morning, and your health shall spring forth speedily: and your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of Yahuah (LORD) shall be your rereward.
live.canon|isaiah|58:9: Then shall you call, and Yahuah (LORD) shall answer; you shall cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If you take away from the midst of you the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
live.canon|isaiah|58:10: And if you draw out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall your light rise in obscurity, and your darkness be as the noonday:
live.canon|isaiah|58:11: And Yahuah (LORD) shall guide you continually, and satisfy your soul in drought, and make fat your bones: and you shall be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
live.canon|isaiah|58:12: And they that shall be of you shall build the old waste places: you shall raise up the foundations of many generations; and you shall be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
live.canon|isaiah|58:13: If you turn away your foot from the sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of Yahuah (LORD), honourable; and shall honour him, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words:
live.canon|isaiah|58:14: Then shall you delight thyself in Yahuah (LORD); and I will cause you to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father: for the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
live.canon|isaiah|58:2: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their Elohim (God): they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|59:15: Yea, truth fails; and he that departs from evil makes himself a prey: and Yahuah (LORD) saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
live.canon|isaiah|59:20: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|59:21: As for me, this is my covenant with them, says Yahuah (LORD); My spirit that is upon you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your seed, nor out of the mouth of your seed’s seed, says Yahuah (LORD), from henceforth and for ever.
live.canon|isaiah|59:1: Behold, the LORD’S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
live.canon|isaiah|59:2: But your iniquities have separated between you and your Elohim (God), and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
live.canon|isaiah|59:6: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
live.canon|isaiah|59:7: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
live.canon|isaiah|59:3: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue has muttered perverseness.
live.canon|isaiah|59:4: None calls for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
live.canon|isaiah|59:5: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eats of their eggs dies, and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.
live.canon|isaiah|59:8: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goes therein shall not know peace.
live.canon|isaiah|59:9: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither does justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
live.canon|isaiah|59:10: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
live.canon|isaiah|59:11: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
live.canon|isaiah|59:13: In transgressing and lying against Yahuah (LORD), and departing away from our Elohim (God), speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
live.canon|isaiah|59:16: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
live.canon|isaiah|59:17: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
live.canon|isaiah|59:18: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
live.canon|isaiah|59:19: So shall they fear the name of Yahuah (LORD) from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall lift up a standard against him.
live.canon|isaiah|59:12: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
live.canon|isaiah|59:14: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice stands afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
live.canon|isaiah|60:1: Arise, shine; for your light is come, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) is risen upon you.
live.canon|isaiah|60:2: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but Yahuah (LORD) shall arise upon you, and his glory shall be seen upon you.
live.canon|isaiah|60:3: And the Gentiles shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
live.canon|isaiah|60:4: Lift up your eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to you: your sons shall come from far, and your daughters shall be nursed at your side.
live.canon|isaiah|60:5: Then you shall see, and flow together, and your heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto you, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto you.
live.canon|isaiah|60:6: The multitude of camels shall cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|60:7: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto you, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto you: they shall come up with acceptance on my altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
live.canon|isaiah|60:9: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and to the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), because he has glorified you.
live.canon|isaiah|60:10: And the sons of strangers shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister unto you: for in my wrath I smote you, but in my favour have I had mercy on you.
live.canon|isaiah|60:11: Therefore your gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto you the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
live.canon|isaiah|60:12: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
live.canon|isaiah|60:17: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make your officers peace, and your exactors righteousness.
live.canon|isaiah|60:18: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, wasting nor destruction within your borders; but you shall call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
live.canon|isaiah|60:19: The sun shall be no more your light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto you: but Yahuah (LORD) shall be unto you an everlasting light, and your Elohim (God) your glory.
live.canon|isaiah|60:20: Your sun shall no more go down; neither shall your moon withdraw itself: for Yahuah (LORD) shall be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning shall be ended.
live.canon|isaiah|60:21: Your people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
live.canon|isaiah|60:8: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
live.canon|isaiah|60:13: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto you, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
live.canon|isaiah|60:14: The sons also of them that afflicted you shall come bending unto you; and all they that despised you shall bow themselves down at the soles of your feet; and they shall call you, The city of Yahuah (LORD), The Zion of the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|isaiah|60:15: Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
live.canon|isaiah|60:16: You shall also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shall suck the breast of kings: and you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) am your Saviour and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
live.canon|isaiah|60:22: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I Yahuah (LORD) will hasten it in his time.
live.canon|isaiah|61:1: The Spirit of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) is upon me; because Yahuah (LORD) has anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
live.canon|isaiah|61:6: But you shall be named the Priests of Yahuah (LORD): men shall call you the Ministers of our Elohim (God): you shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall you boast yourselves.
live.canon|isaiah|61:7: For your shame you shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
live.canon|isaiah|61:9: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which Yahuah (LORD) has blessed.
live.canon|isaiah|61:10: I will greatly rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), my soul shall be joyful in my Elohim (God); for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
live.canon|isaiah|61:11: For as the earth brings forth her bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
live.canon|isaiah|61:2: To proclaim the acceptable year of Yahuah (LORD), and the day of vengeance of our Elohim (God); to comfort all that mourn;
live.canon|isaiah|61:3: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahuah (LORD), that he might be glorified.
live.canon|isaiah|61:4: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
live.canon|isaiah|61:5: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
live.canon|isaiah|61:8: For I Yahuah (LORD) love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
live.canon|isaiah|62:1: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burns.
live.canon|isaiah|62:2: And the Gentiles shall see your righteousness, and all kings your glory: and you shall be called by a new name, which the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) shall name.
live.canon|isaiah|62:3: You shall also be a crown of glory in the hand of Yahuah (LORD), and a royal diadem in the hand of your Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|62:4: You shall no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall your land any more be termed Desolate: but you shall be called Hephzi-bah, and your land Beulah: for Yahuah (LORD) delights in you, and your land shall be married.
live.canon|isaiah|62:5: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall your sons marry you: and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your Elohim (God) rejoice over you.
live.canon|isaiah|62:6: I have set watchmen upon your walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: you that make mention of Yahuah (LORD), keep not silence,
live.canon|isaiah|62:8: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give your corn to be meat for your enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink your wine, for the which you have laboured:
live.canon|isaiah|62:10: Go through, go through the gates; prepare you the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
live.canon|isaiah|62:7: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
live.canon|isaiah|62:9: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise Yahuah (LORD); and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
live.canon|isaiah|62:11: Behold, Yahuah (LORD) has proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say you to the daughter of Zion, Behold, your salvation comes; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
live.canon|isaiah|62:12: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of Yahuah (LORD): and you shall be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
live.canon|isaiah|63:1: Who is this that comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
live.canon|isaiah|63:2: Wherefore are you red in your apparel, and your garments like him that treads in the winefat?
live.canon|isaiah|63:3: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in my anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
live.canon|isaiah|63:4: For the day of vengeance is in my heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
live.canon|isaiah|63:5: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore my own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
live.canon|isaiah|63:6: And I will tread down the people in my anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
live.canon|isaiah|63:7: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of Yahuah (LORD), and the praises of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that Yahuah (LORD) has bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which he has bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
live.canon|isaiah|63:14: As a beast goes down into the valley, the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) caused him to rest: so did you lead your people, to make thyself a glorious name.
live.canon|isaiah|63:15: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory: where is your zeal and your strength, the sounding of your bowels and of your mercies toward me? are they restrained?
live.canon|isaiah|63:16: Doubtless you are our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Yashar'el (Israel) acknowledge us not: you, O Yahuah (LORD), are our father, our redeemer; your name is from everlasting.
live.canon|isaiah|63:17: O Yahuah (LORD), why have you made us to err from your ways, and hardened our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.
live.canon|isaiah|63:18: The people of your holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
live.canon|isaiah|63:19: We are yours: you never barest rule over them; they were not called by your name.
live.canon|isaiah|63:8: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
live.canon|isaiah|63:9: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
live.canon|isaiah|63:10: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
live.canon|isaiah|63:11: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
live.canon|isaiah|63:12: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
live.canon|isaiah|63:13: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
live.canon|isaiah|64:1: Oh that you would rend the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might flow down at your presence,
live.canon|isaiah|64:2: As when the melting fire burns, the fire causes the waters to boil, to make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
live.canon|isaiah|64:3: When you did terrible things which we looked not for, you came down, the mountains flowed down at your presence.
live.canon|isaiah|64:4: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither has the eye seen, O Elohim (God), beside you, what he has prepared for him that waits for him.
live.canon|isaiah|64:5: You meetest him that rejoices and works righteousness, those that remember you in your ways: behold, you are wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
live.canon|isaiah|64:7: And there is none that calls upon your name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of you: for you have hid your face from us, and have consumed us, because of our iniquities.
live.canon|isaiah|64:8: But now, O Yahuah (LORD), you are our father; we are the clay, and you our potter; and we all are the work of your hand.
live.canon|isaiah|64:9: Be not wroth very sore, O Yahuah (LORD), neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech you, we are all your people.
live.canon|isaiah|64:10: Your holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
live.canon|isaiah|64:11: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised you, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
live.canon|isaiah|64:12: Will you refrain thyself for these things, O Yahuah (LORD)? will you hold your peace, and afflict us very sore?
live.canon|isaiah|64:6: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
live.canon|isaiah|65:2: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walks in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
live.canon|isaiah|65:3: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burns incense upon altars of brick;
live.canon|isaiah|65:5: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than you. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all the day.
live.canon|isaiah|65:12: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and you shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, you did not answer; when I spake, you did not hear; but did evil before my eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
live.canon|isaiah|65:13: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Behold, my servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be ashamed:
live.canon|isaiah|65:14: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but you shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
live.canon|isaiah|65:15: And you shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) shall slay you, and call his servants by another name:
live.canon|isaiah|65:16: That he who blesses himself in the earth shall bless himself in the Elohim (God) of truth; and he that swears in the earth shall swear by the Elohim (God) of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from my eyes.
live.canon|isaiah|65:18: But be you glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
live.canon|isaiah|65:20: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that has not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
live.canon|isaiah|65:22: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and my elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
live.canon|isaiah|65:25: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|65:1: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
live.canon|isaiah|65:4: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
live.canon|isaiah|65:6: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
live.canon|isaiah|65:10: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
live.canon|isaiah|65:7: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, says Yahuah (LORD), which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
live.canon|isaiah|65:8: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
live.canon|isaiah|65:9: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Yahudah (Judah) an inheritor of my mountains: and my elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
live.canon|isaiah|65:17: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
live.canon|isaiah|65:19: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
live.canon|isaiah|65:21: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
live.canon|isaiah|65:23: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of Yahuah (LORD), and their offspring with them.
live.canon|isaiah|65:24: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
live.canon|isaiah|65:11: But you are they that forsake Yahuah (LORD), that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
live.canon|isaiah|66:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that you build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
live.canon|isaiah|66:2: For all those things has my hand made, and all those things have been, says Yahuah (LORD): but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembles at my word.
live.canon|isaiah|66:3: He that kills an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offers an oblation, as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burns incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.
live.canon|isaiah|66:4: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before my eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
live.canon|isaiah|66:5: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let Yahuah (LORD) be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
live.canon|isaiah|66:6: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahuah (LORD) that renders recompence to his enemies.
live.canon|isaiah|66:8: Who has heard such a thing? who has seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
live.canon|isaiah|66:9: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? says Yahuah (LORD): shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? says your Elohim (God).
live.canon|isaiah|66:10: Rejoice you with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all you that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all you that mourn for her:
live.canon|isaiah|66:11: That you may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that you may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
live.canon|isaiah|66:12: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall you suck, you shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.
live.canon|isaiah|66:13: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
live.canon|isaiah|66:14: And when you see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of Yahuah (LORD) shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
live.canon|isaiah|66:17: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|66:20: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto Yahuah (LORD) out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says Yahuah (LORD), as the children of Yashar'el (Israel) bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|66:21: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|66:22: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, says Yahuah (LORD), so shall your seed and your name remain.
live.canon|isaiah|66:23: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|isaiah|66:7: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
