live.canon|isaiah|66:15: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
live.canon|isaiah|66:16: For by fire and by his sword will Yahuah (LORD) plead with all flesh: and the slain of Yahuah (LORD) shall be many.
live.canon|isaiah|66:18: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
live.canon|isaiah|66:19: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
live.canon|isaiah|66:24: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
live.canon|james|1:6: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
live.canon|james|1:8: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
live.canon|james|1:9: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
live.canon|james|1:10: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
live.canon|james|1:13: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of Elohim (God): for Elohim (God) cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
live.canon|james|1:14: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
live.canon|james|1:16: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
live.canon|james|1:18: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
live.canon|james|1:19: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
live.canon|james|1:21: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
live.canon|james|1:23: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
live.canon|james|1:26: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
live.canon|james|1:27: Pure religion and undefiled before Elohim (God) and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
live.canon|james|1:2: My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into divers temptations;
live.canon|james|1:3: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith works patience.
live.canon|james|1:4: But let patience have her perfect work, that you may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
live.canon|james|1:5: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim (God), that gives to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
live.canon|james|1:11: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falls, and the grace of the fashion of it perishes: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
live.canon|james|1:15: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.
live.canon|james|1:17: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
live.canon|james|1:20: For the wrath of man works not the righteousness of Elohim (God).
live.canon|james|1:22: But be you doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
live.canon|james|1:24: For he beholds himself, and goes his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
live.canon|james|1:25: But whoso looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
live.canon|james|1:1: James, a servant of Elohim (God) and of Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
live.canon|james|1:7: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
live.canon|james|1:12: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.
live.canon|james|2:2: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
live.canon|james|2:10: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
live.canon|james|2:15: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
live.canon|james|2:21: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
live.canon|james|2:25: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
live.canon|james|2:26: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
live.canon|james|2:3: And you have respect to him that wears the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit you here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand you there, or sit here under my footstool:
live.canon|james|2:4: Are you not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
live.canon|james|2:5: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Has not Elohim (God) chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he has promised to them that love him?
live.canon|james|2:6: But you have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
live.canon|james|2:7: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which you are called?
live.canon|james|2:8: If you fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, You shall love your neighbour as thyself, you do well:
live.canon|james|2:9: But if you have respect to persons, you commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
live.canon|james|2:11: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if you commit no adultery, yet if you kill, you are become a transgressor of the law.
live.canon|james|2:12: So speak you, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
live.canon|james|2:13: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that has shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoices against judgment.
live.canon|james|2:14: What does it profit, my brethren, though a man say he has faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
live.canon|james|2:16: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be you warmed and filled; notwithstanding you give them not those things which are needful to the body; what does it profit?
live.canon|james|2:17: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.
live.canon|james|2:18: Yea, a man may say, You have faith, and I have works: shew me your faith without your works, and I will shew you my faith by my works.
live.canon|james|2:19: You believe that there is one Elohim (God); you do well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
live.canon|james|2:20: But will you know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
live.canon|james|2:22: See you how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
live.canon|james|2:23: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of Elohim (God).
live.canon|james|2:24: You see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
live.canon|james|2:1: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
live.canon|james|3:1: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
live.canon|james|3:2: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
live.canon|james|3:3: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
live.canon|james|3:4: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
live.canon|james|3:5: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
live.canon|james|3:8: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
live.canon|james|3:9: Therewith bless we Elohim (God), even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of Elohim (God).
live.canon|james|3:12: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
live.canon|james|3:13: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
live.canon|james|3:16: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
live.canon|james|3:17: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
live.canon|james|3:18: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
live.canon|james|3:6: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
live.canon|james|3:7: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed of mankind:
live.canon|james|3:10: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
live.canon|james|3:11: Does a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
live.canon|james|3:14: But if you have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
live.canon|james|3:15: This wisdom descends not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
live.canon|james|4:1: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
live.canon|james|4:7: Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
live.canon|james|4:9: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
live.canon|james|4:3: You ask, and receive not, because you ask amiss, that you may consume it upon your lusts.
live.canon|james|4:2: You lust, and have not: you kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: you fight and war, yet you have not, because you ask not.
live.canon|james|4:4: You adulterers and adulteresses, know you not that the friendship of the world is enmity with Elohim (God)? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of Elohim (God).
live.canon|james|4:5: Do you think that the scripture says in vain, The spirit that dwells in us lusteth to envy?
live.canon|james|4:6: But he gives more grace. Wherefore he says, Elohim (God) resisteth the proud, but gives grace unto the humble.
live.canon|james|4:8: Draw nigh to Elohim (God), and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double minded.
live.canon|james|4:11: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaks evil of his brother, and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law, and judges the law: but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.
live.canon|james|4:12: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who are you that judge another?
live.canon|james|4:13: Go to now, you that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
live.canon|james|4:14: Whereas you know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.
live.canon|james|4:15: For that you ought to say, If Yahuah (Lord) will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
live.canon|james|4:16: But now you rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
live.canon|james|4:17: Therefore to him that knows to do good, and does it not, to him it is sin.
live.canon|james|4:10: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
live.canon|james|5:2: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
live.canon|james|5:10: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of Yahuah (Lord), for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
live.canon|james|5:13: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
live.canon|james|5:17: Elijah was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
live.canon|james|5:18: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
live.canon|james|5:19: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
live.canon|james|5:20: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
live.canon|james|5:1: Go to now, you rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
live.canon|james|5:3: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. You have heaped treasure together for the last days.
live.canon|james|5:4: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, cries: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.
live.canon|james|5:5: You have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; you have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
live.canon|james|5:6: You have condemned and killed the just; and he does not resist you.
live.canon|james|5:9: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest you be condemned: behold, the judge stands before the door.
live.canon|james|5:11: Behold, we count them happy which endure. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of Yahuah (Lord); that Yahuah (Lord) is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
live.canon|james|5:12: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest you fall into condemnation.
live.canon|james|5:16: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that you may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
live.canon|james|5:14: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
live.canon|james|5:15: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|james|5:7: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waits for the precious fruit of the earth, and has long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
live.canon|james|5:8: Be you also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draws nigh.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:5: Before I formed you in the belly I knew you; and before you came forth out of the womb I sanctified you, and I ordained you a prophet unto the nations.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:7: But Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for you shall go to all that I shall send you, and whatsoever I command you you shall speak.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:8: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with you to deliver you, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|1:9: Then Yahuah (LORD) put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:10: See, I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:11: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what see you? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:12: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, You have well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:13: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me the second time, saying, What see you? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:15: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, says Yahuah (LORD); and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|1:17: You therefore gird up your loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command you: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound you before them.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:18: For, behold, I have made you this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Yahudah (Judah), against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:19: And they shall fight against you; but they shall not prevail against you; for I am with you, says Yahuah (LORD), to deliver you.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:1: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
live.canon|jeremiah|1:2: To whom the word of Yahuah (LORD) came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Yahudah (Judah), in the thirteenth year of his reign.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:3: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:4: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|1:14: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:16: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
live.canon|jeremiah|1:6: Then said I, Ah, Adonai (Lord) GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:2: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); I remember you, the kindness of your youth, the love of your espousals, when you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:3: Yashar'el (Israel) was holiness unto Yahuah (LORD), and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|2:4: Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|jeremiah|2:5: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
live.canon|jeremiah|2:7: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:19: Your own wickedness shall correct you, and your backslidings shall reprove you: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that you have forsaken Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that my fear is not in you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:20: For of old time I have broken your yoke, and burst your bands; and you saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree you wanderest, playing the harlot.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:21: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then are you turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
live.canon|jeremiah|2:22: For though you wash you with nitre, and take you much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
live.canon|jeremiah|2:23: How can you say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see your way in the valley, know what you have done: you are a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
live.canon|jeremiah|2:25: Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst: but you saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:27: Saying to a stock, You are my father; and to a stone, You have brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:28: But where are your gods that you have made you? let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble: for according to the number of your cities are your gods, O Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|2:30: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:31: O generation, see you the word of Yahuah (LORD). Have I been a wilderness unto Yashar'el (Israel)? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto you?
live.canon|jeremiah|2:33: Why trimmest you your way to seek love? therefore have you also taught the wicked ones your ways.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:34: Also in your skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:35: Yet you say, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with you, because you say, I have not sinned.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:36: Why gaddest you about so much to change your way? you also shall be ashamed of Egypt, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:37: Yea, you shall go forth from him, and your hands upon your head: for Yahuah (LORD) has rejected your confidences, and you shall not prosper in them.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:1: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|2:6: Neither said they, Where is Yahuah (LORD) that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
live.canon|jeremiah|2:8: The priests said not, Where is Yahuah (LORD)? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:10: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:13: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:14: Is Yashar'el (Israel) a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
live.canon|jeremiah|2:9: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, says Yahuah (LORD), and with your children’s children will I plead.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:11: Has a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which does not profit.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:12: Be astonished, O you heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be you very desolate, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|2:15: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:24: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:26: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Yashar'el (Israel) ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
live.canon|jeremiah|2:32: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:16: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of your head.
live.canon|jeremiah|2:17: Have you not procured this unto thyself, in that you have forsaken Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), when he led you by the way?
live.canon|jeremiah|2:18: And now what have you to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what have you to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
live.canon|jeremiah|2:29: Wherefore will you plead with me? you all have transgressed against me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:1: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but you have played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:2: Lift up your eyes unto the high places, and see where you have not been lien with. In the ways have you sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and you have polluted the land with your whoredoms and with your wickedness.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:3: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there has been no latter rain; and you had a whore’s forehead, you refusedst to be ashamed.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:4: Will you not from this time cry unto me, My father, you are the guide of my youth?
live.canon|jeremiah|3:5: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, you have spoken and done evil things as you could.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:6: Yahuah (LORD) said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Have you seen that which backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) has done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there has played the harlot.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:11: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, The backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) has justified herself more than treacherous Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:12: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, you backsliding Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD); and I will not cause my anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (LORD), and I will not keep anger for ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:13: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:14: Turn, O backsliding children, says Yahuah (LORD); for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
live.canon|jeremiah|3:15: And I will give you pastors according to my heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:16: And it shall come to pass, when you be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, says Yahuah (LORD), they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD): neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:19: But I said, How shall I put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, You shall call me, My father; and shall not turn away from me.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:20: Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so have you dealt treacherously with me, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:22: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto you; for you are Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:24: For shame has devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:25: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covers us: for we have sinned against Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:8: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:9: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:17: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of Yahuah (LORD); and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of Yahuah (LORD), to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:18: In those days the house of Yahudah (Judah) shall walk with the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:21: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:23: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|jeremiah|3:7: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn you unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) saw it.
live.canon|jeremiah|3:10: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) has not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|4:1: If you will return, O Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD), return unto me: and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight, then shall you not remove.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:2: And you shall swear, Yahuah (LORD) lives, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:3: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) to the men of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:4: Circumcise yourselves to Yahuah (LORD), and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Yahudah (Judah) and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:5: Declare you in Yahudah (Judah), and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow you the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:7: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make your land desolate; and your cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:9: And it shall come to pass at that day, says Yahuah (LORD), that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:30: And when you are spoiled, what will you do? Though you clothest thyself with crimson, though you deckest you with ornaments of gold, though you rentest your face with painting, in vain shall you make thyself fair; your lovers will despise you, they will seek your life.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:31: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that brings forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreads her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:14: O Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long shall your vain thoughts lodge within you?
live.canon|jeremiah|4:6: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:8: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD) is not turned back from us.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:11: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
live.canon|jeremiah|4:12: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:13: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:15: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:20: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:16: Make you mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|4:21: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
live.canon|jeremiah|4:22: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:23: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:24: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:25: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:26: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of Yahuah (LORD), and by his fierce anger.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:28: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:29: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:17: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she has been rebellious against me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|4:18: Your way and your doings have procured these things unto you; this is your wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reaches unto your heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:19: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart makes a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:27: For thus has Yahuah (LORD) said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
live.canon|jeremiah|4:10: Then said I, Ah, Adonai (Lord) GOD! surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, You shall have peace; whereas the sword reaches unto the soul.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:1: Run you to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if you can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeks the truth; and I will pardon it.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:3: O Yahuah (LORD), are not your eyes upon the truth? you have stricken them, but they have not grieved; you have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:6: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goes out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:7: How shall I pardon you for this? your children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots’ houses.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:9: Shall I not visit for these things? says Yahuah (LORD): and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
live.canon|jeremiah|5:10: Go you up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD’S.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:11: For the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) have dealt very treacherously against me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|5:14: Wherefore thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts, Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:15: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD): it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you know not, neither understand what they say.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:17: And they shall eat up your harvest, and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat: they shall eat up your flocks and your herds: they shall eat up your vines and your fig trees: they shall impoverish your fenced cities, wherein you trustedst, with the sword.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:18: Nevertheless in those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will not make a full end with you.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:19: And it shall come to pass, when you shall say, Wherefore does Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) all these things unto us? then shall you answer them, Like as you have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall you serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:22: Fear you not me? says Yahuah (LORD): will you not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
live.canon|jeremiah|5:24: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), that gives rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:26: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that sets snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:29: Shall I not visit for these things? says Yahuah (LORD): shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
live.canon|jeremiah|5:31: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will you do in the end thereof?
live.canon|jeremiah|5:4: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of Yahuah (LORD), nor the judgment of their Elohim (God).
live.canon|jeremiah|5:5: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of Yahuah (LORD), and the judgment of their Elohim (God): but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:8: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:12: They have belied Yahuah (LORD), and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
live.canon|jeremiah|5:13: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:16: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:2: And though they say, Yahuah (LORD) lives; surely they swear falsely.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:20: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Yahudah (Judah), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|5:21: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
live.canon|jeremiah|5:23: But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:25: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:27: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:28: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
live.canon|jeremiah|5:30: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
live.canon|jeremiah|6:1: O you children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appears out of the north, and great destruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:4: Prepare you war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goes away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:6: For thus has Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) said, Hew you down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:7: As a fountain casts out her waters, so she casts out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:8: Be you instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from you; lest I make you desolate, a land not inhabited.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:9: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), They shall throughly glean the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel) as a vine: turn back your hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:12: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|6:13: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one deals falsely.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:15: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|6:16: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Stand you in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and you shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:18: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:20: To what purpose comes there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:21: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:22: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, a people comes from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:23: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against you, O daughter of Zion.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:24: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish has taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:26: O daughter of my people, gird you with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make you mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:2: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:3: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:5: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:10: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of Yahuah (LORD) is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:11: Therefore I am full of the fury of Yahuah (LORD); I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:14: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:17: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:19: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:25: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:28: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:29: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:27: I have set you for a tower and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
live.canon|jeremiah|6:30: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because Yahuah (LORD) has rejected them.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:2: Stand in the gate of the LORD’S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), all you of Yahudah (Judah), that enter in at these gates to worship Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|7:3: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:4: Trust you not in lying words, saying, The temple of Yahuah (LORD), The temple of Yahuah (LORD), The temple of Yahuah (LORD), are these.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:5: For if you throughly amend your ways and your doings; if you throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
live.canon|jeremiah|7:6: If you oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
live.canon|jeremiah|7:8: Behold, you trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:9: Will you steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom you know not;
live.canon|jeremiah|7:11: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|7:12: But go you now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|jeremiah|7:13: And now, because you have done all these works, says Yahuah (LORD), and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but you heard not; and I called you, but you answered not;
live.canon|jeremiah|7:14: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein you trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:16: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear you.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:17: See you not what they do in the cities of Yahudah (Judah) and in the streets of Jerusalem?
live.canon|jeremiah|7:19: Do they provoke me to anger? says Yahuah (LORD): do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
live.canon|jeremiah|7:20: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, my anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:21: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:23: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your Elohim (God), and you shall be my people: and walk you in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:27: Therefore you shall speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to you: you shall also call unto them; but they will not answer you.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:28: But you shall say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), nor receives correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:29: Cut off your hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for Yahuah (LORD) has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:30: For the children of Yahudah (Judah) have done evil in my sight, says Yahuah (LORD): they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:32: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|7:7: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:10: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
live.canon|jeremiah|7:15: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:18: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:22: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
live.canon|jeremiah|7:24: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:25: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
live.canon|jeremiah|7:26: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:31: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:33: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
live.canon|jeremiah|7:34: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:1: At that time, says Yahuah (LORD), they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
live.canon|jeremiah|8:3: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|jeremiah|8:7: Yea, the stork in the heaven knows her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|8:8: How do you say, We are wise, and the law of Yahuah (LORD) is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:10: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one deals falsely.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:12: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|8:13: I will surely consume them, says Yahuah (LORD): there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:14: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|8:17: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|8:21: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment has taken hold on me.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:2: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:5: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:6: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:4: Moreover you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
live.canon|jeremiah|8:9: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of Yahuah (LORD); and what wisdom is in them?
live.canon|jeremiah|8:11: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:15: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
live.canon|jeremiah|8:16: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:18: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:19: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not Yahuah (LORD) in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
live.canon|jeremiah|8:20: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
live.canon|jeremiah|8:22: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
live.canon|jeremiah|9:1: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
live.canon|jeremiah|9:3: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|9:4: Take you heed every one of his neighbour, and trust you not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:6: Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|9:7: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
live.canon|jeremiah|9:8: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he lays his wait.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:9: Shall I not visit them for these things? says Yahuah (LORD): shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
live.canon|jeremiah|9:12: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perishes and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passes through?
live.canon|jeremiah|9:13: And Yahuah (LORD) says, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
live.canon|jeremiah|9:15: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:17: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Consider you, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
live.canon|jeremiah|9:20: Yet hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:22: Speak, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:23: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
live.canon|jeremiah|9:24: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understands and knows me, that I am Yahuah (LORD) which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|9:25: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
live.canon|jeremiah|9:2: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:5: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:10: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:11: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Yahudah (Judah) desolate, without an inhabitant.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:14: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
live.canon|jeremiah|9:16: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:18: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:19: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:21: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
live.canon|jeremiah|9:26: Egypt, and Yahudah (Judah), and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) are uncircumcised in the heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:1: Hear you the word which Yahuah (LORD) speaks unto you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|jeremiah|10:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:6: Forasmuch as there is none like unto you, O Yahuah (LORD); you are great, and your name is great in might.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:7: Who would not fear you, O King of nations? for to you does it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:11: Thus shall you say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:12: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:13: When he utters his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:17: Gather up your wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:18: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:23: O Yahuah (LORD), I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walks to direct his steps.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:24: O Yahuah (LORD), correct me, but with judgment; not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:25: Pour out your fury upon the heathen that know you not, and upon the families that call not on your name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:3: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:4: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:5: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:8: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:9: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:10: But Yahuah (LORD) is the true Elohim (God), he is the living Elohim (God), and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:14: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:15: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:16: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Yashar'el (Israel) is the rod of his inheritance: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:19: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:20: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:21: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought Yahuah (LORD): therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
live.canon|jeremiah|10:22: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Yahudah (Judah) desolate, and a den of dragons.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:2: Hear you the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Yahudah (Judah), and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
live.canon|jeremiah|11:3: And say you unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
live.canon|jeremiah|11:4: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall you be my people, and I will be your Elohim (God):
live.canon|jeremiah|11:6: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear you the words of this covenant, and do them.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:11: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:13: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Yahudah (Judah); and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:14: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:15: What has my beloved to do in my house, seeing she has wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do evil, then you rejoicest.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:16: Yahuah (LORD) called your name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:17: For Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that planted you, has pronounced evil against you, for the evil of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and of the house of Yahudah (Judah), which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:18: And Yahuah (LORD) has given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then you shewedst me their doings.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:20: But, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that judge righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see your vengeance on them: for unto you have I revealed my cause.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:21: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) of the men of Anathoth, that seek your life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of Yahuah (LORD), that you die not by our hand:
live.canon|jeremiah|11:22: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
live.canon|jeremiah|11:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|11:5: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|11:7: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:8: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:9: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Yahudah (Judah), and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:10: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:12: Then shall the cities of Yahudah (Judah) and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:19: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
live.canon|jeremiah|11:23: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:1: Righteous are you, O Yahuah (LORD), when I plead with you: yet let me talk with you of your judgments: Wherefore does the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
live.canon|jeremiah|12:2: You have planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: you are near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:3: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), know me: you have seen me, and tried my heart toward you: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:5: If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein you trustedst, they wearied you, then how will you do in the swelling of Jordan?
live.canon|jeremiah|12:6: For even your brethren, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; yea, they have called a multitude after you: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:7: I have forsaken my house, I have left my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:8: My heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it cries out against me: therefore have I hated it.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:9: My heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come you, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:11: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourns unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man lays it to heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:14: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) against all my evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Yashar'el (Israel) to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Yahudah (Judah) from among them.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:16: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, Yahuah (LORD) lives; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:17: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|12:4: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:10: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:12: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of Yahuah (LORD) shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
live.canon|jeremiah|12:13: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|12:15: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:12: Therefore you shall speak unto them this word; Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto you, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
live.canon|jeremiah|13:13: Then shall you say unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:14: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says Yahuah (LORD): I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:15: Hear you, and give ear; be not proud: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:16: Give glory to Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:17: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and my eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’S flock is carried away captive.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:20: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?
live.canon|jeremiah|13:21: What will you say when he shall punish you? for you have taught them to be captains, and as chief over you: shall not sorrows take you, as a woman in travail?
live.canon|jeremiah|13:22: And if you say in your heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of your iniquity are your skirts discovered, and your heels made bare.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:23: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:24: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:25: This is your lot, the portion of your measures from me, says Yahuah (LORD); because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:26: Therefore will I discover your skirts upon your face, that your shame may appear.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:27: I have seen your adulteries, and your neighings, the lewdness of your whoredom, and your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto you, O Jerusalem! will you not be made clean? when shall it once be?
live.canon|jeremiah|13:2: So I got a girdle according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), and put it on my loins.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:3: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me the second time, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|13:5: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded me.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Go and get you a linen girdle, and put it upon your loins, and put it not in water.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:4: Take the girdle that you have got, which is upon your loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:6: And it came to pass after many days, that Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded you to hide there.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:9: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), After this manner will I mar the pride of Yahudah (Judah), and the great pride of Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:11: For as the girdle cleaves to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the whole house of Yahudah (Judah), says Yahuah (LORD); that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:7: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:8: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|13:10: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:18: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
live.canon|jeremiah|13:19: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Yahudah (Judah) shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:2: Yahudah (Judah) mourns, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:7: O Yahuah (LORD), though our iniquities testify against us, do you it for your name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.
