live.canon|jeremiah|14:8: O the hope of Yashar'el (Israel), the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why should you be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turns aside to tarry for a night?
live.canon|jeremiah|14:9: Why should you be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet you, O Yahuah (LORD), are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; leave us not.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:15: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:17: Therefore you shall say this word unto them; Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:19: Have you utterly rejected Yahudah (Judah)? has your soul lothed Zion? why have you smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
live.canon|jeremiah|14:20: We acknowledge, O Yahuah (LORD), our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against you.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:21: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of your glory: remember, break not your covenant with us.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:22: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? are not you he, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God)? therefore we will wait upon you: for you have made all these things.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:3: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:4: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:5: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:6: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:11: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:12: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:14: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:10: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore Yahuah (LORD) does not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:16: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:18: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
live.canon|jeremiah|14:13: Then said I, Ah, Adonai (Lord) GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, You shall not see the sword, neither shall you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:2: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto you, Whither shall we go forth? then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:3: And I will appoint over them four kinds, says Yahuah (LORD): the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:5: For who shall have pity upon you, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan you? or who shall go aside to ask how you do?
live.canon|jeremiah|15:6: You have forsaken me, says Yahuah (LORD), you are gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against you, and destroy you; I am weary with repenting.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:9: She that has borne seven languisheth: she has given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she has been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|15:10: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them does curse me.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:11: Yahuah (LORD) said, Verily it shall be well with your remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat you well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:13: Your substance and your treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:14: And I will make you to pass with your enemies into a land which you know not: for a fire is kindled in my anger, which shall burn upon you.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:15: O Yahuah (LORD), you know: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in your longsuffering: know that for your sake I have suffered rebuke.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:16: Your words were found, and I did eat them; and your word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by your name, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of hosts.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:17: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of your hand: for you have filled me with indignation.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:18: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? will you be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
live.canon|jeremiah|15:19: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), If you return, then will I bring you again, and you shall stand before me: and if you take forth the precious from the vile, you shall be as my mouth: let them return unto you; but return not you unto them.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:20: And I will make you unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against you, but they shall not prevail against you: for I am with you to save you and to deliver you, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|15:1: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:4: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), for that which he did in Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:7: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:8: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
live.canon|jeremiah|15:12: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
live.canon|jeremiah|15:21: And I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:8: You shall not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:9: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:10: And it shall come to pass, when you shall shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto you, Wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God)?
live.canon|jeremiah|16:11: Then shall you say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, says Yahuah (LORD), and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
live.canon|jeremiah|16:12: And you have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, you walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
live.canon|jeremiah|16:13: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that you know not, neither you nor your fathers; and there shall you serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:14: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that it shall no more be said, Yahuah (LORD) lives, that brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt;
live.canon|jeremiah|16:15: But, Yahuah (LORD) lives, that brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:16: Behold, I will send for many fishers, says Yahuah (LORD), and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:17: For my eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from my eyes.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:18: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled my inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:19: O Yahuah (LORD), my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto you from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:21: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|16:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came also unto me, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|16:4: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:6: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
live.canon|jeremiah|16:7: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:20: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
live.canon|jeremiah|16:2: You shall not take you a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters in this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|16:3: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
live.canon|jeremiah|16:5: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, says Yahuah (LORD), even lovingkindness and mercies.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:3: O my mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures to the spoil, and your high places for sin, throughout all your borders.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:4: And you, even thyself, shall discontinue from your heritage that I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you know not: for you have kindled a fire in my anger, which shall burn for ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:5: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Cursed be the man that trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|17:6: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good comes; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:7: Blessed is the man that trusts in Yahuah (LORD), and whose hope Yahuah (LORD) is.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:8: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreads out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat comes, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:11: As the partridge sits on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that gets riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:13: O Yahuah (LORD), the hope of Yashar'el (Israel), all that forsake you shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahuah (LORD), the fountain of living waters.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:14: Heal me, O Yahuah (LORD), and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for you are my praise.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:16: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow you: neither have I desired the woeful day; you know: that which came out of my lips was right before you.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:17: Be not a terror unto me: you are my hope in the day of evil.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:20: And say unto them, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), you kings of Yahudah (Judah), and all Yahudah (Judah), and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
live.canon|jeremiah|17:21: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
live.canon|jeremiah|17:22: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do you any work, but hallow you the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:24: And it shall come to pass, if you diligently hearken unto me, says Yahuah (LORD), to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
live.canon|jeremiah|17:27: But if you will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:1: The sin of Yahudah (Judah) is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
live.canon|jeremiah|17:2: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:9: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
live.canon|jeremiah|17:10: I Yahuah (LORD) search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:12: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:15: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of Yahuah (LORD)? let it come now.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:18: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:19: Thus said Yahuah (LORD) unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Yahudah (Judah) come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
live.canon|jeremiah|17:23: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:25: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Yahudah (Judah), and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|17:26: And they shall come from the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|18:2: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:6: O house of Yashar'el (Israel), cannot I do with you as this potter? says Yahuah (LORD). Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, O house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|jeremiah|18:11: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Yahudah (Judah), and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return you now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:13: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Ask you now among the heathen, who has heard such things: the virgin of Yashar'el (Israel) has done a very horrible thing.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:14: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which comes from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
live.canon|jeremiah|18:15: Because my people has forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
live.canon|jeremiah|18:16: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passes thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:20: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before you to speak good for them, and to turn away your wrath from them.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:22: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when you shall bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:23: Yet, Yahuah (LORD), you know all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from your sight, but let them be overthrown before you; deal thus with them in the time of your anger.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:1: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|18:3: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:4: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:5: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|18:7: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
live.canon|jeremiah|18:8: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:9: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
live.canon|jeremiah|18:10: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:12: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:17: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:18: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:19: Give heed to me, O Yahuah (LORD), and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
live.canon|jeremiah|18:21: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
live.canon|jeremiah|19:2: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell you,
live.canon|jeremiah|19:3: And say, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), O kings of Yahudah (Judah), and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever hears, his ears shall tingle.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:6: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:8: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passes thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:10: Then shall you break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with you,
live.canon|jeremiah|19:11: And shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:12: Thus will I do unto this place, says Yahuah (LORD), and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
live.canon|jeremiah|19:15: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:4: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Yahudah (Judah), and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
live.canon|jeremiah|19:5: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
live.canon|jeremiah|19:7: And I will make void the counsel of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:9: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:13: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
live.canon|jeremiah|19:14: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither Yahuah (LORD) had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’S house; and said to all the people,
live.canon|jeremiah|20:3: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, Yahuah (LORD) has not called your name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:4: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will make you a terror to thyself, and to all your friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Yahudah (Judah) into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:6: And you, Pashur, and all that dwell in your house shall go into captivity: and you shall come to Babylon, and there you shall die, and shall be buried there, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied lies.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:7: O Yahuah (LORD), you have deceived me, and I was deceived: you are stronger than I, and have prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocks me.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:9: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in my heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:12: But, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that triest the righteous, and see the reins and the heart, let me see your vengeance on them: for unto you have I opened my cause.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:13: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD), praise you Yahuah (LORD): for he has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:15: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto you; making him very glad.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:1: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of Yahuah (LORD), heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:2: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|20:5: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Yahudah (Judah) will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:8: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of Yahuah (LORD) was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:10: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:11: But Yahuah (LORD) is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:14: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:16: And let that man be as the cities which Yahuah (LORD) overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
live.canon|jeremiah|20:17: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
live.canon|jeremiah|20:18: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
live.canon|jeremiah|21:10: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, says Yahuah (LORD): it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:11: And touching the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah), say, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD);
live.canon|jeremiah|21:12: O house of David, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:13: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, says Yahuah (LORD); which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
live.canon|jeremiah|21:14: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahuah (LORD): and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:1: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|21:5: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:6: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:2: Enquire, I pray you, of Yahuah (LORD) for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon makes war against us; if so be that Yahuah (LORD) will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:3: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall you say to Zedekiah:
live.canon|jeremiah|21:4: Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:7: And afterward, says Yahuah (LORD), I will deliver Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:8: And unto this people you shall say, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
live.canon|jeremiah|21:9: He that abides in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goes out, and falls to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Go down to the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah), and speak there this word,
live.canon|jeremiah|22:2: And say, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O king of Yahudah (Judah), that sit upon the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people that enter in by these gates:
live.canon|jeremiah|22:3: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Execute you judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:4: For if you do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:5: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself, says Yahuah (LORD), that this house shall become a desolation.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:6: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto the king’s house of Yahudah (Judah); You are Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make you a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:7: And I will prepare destroyers against you, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:8: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) done thus unto this great city?
live.canon|jeremiah|22:10: Weep you not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goes away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:11: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
live.canon|jeremiah|22:13: Woe unto him that builds his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and gives him not for his work;
live.canon|jeremiah|22:14: That says, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:15: Shall you reign, because you closest thyself in cedar? did not your father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
live.canon|jeremiah|22:16: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|22:18: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah); They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
live.canon|jeremiah|22:21: I spake unto you in your prosperity; but you saidst, I will not hear. This has been your manner from your youth, that you obeyedst not my voice.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:22: The wind shall eat up all your pastors, and your lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shall you be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:23: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that make your nest in the cedars, how gracious shall you be when pangs come upon you, the pain as of a woman in travail!
live.canon|jeremiah|22:24: As I live, says Yahuah (LORD), though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck you thence;
live.canon|jeremiah|22:25: And I will give you into the hand of them that seek your life, and into the hand of them whose face you fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:26: And I will cast you out, and your mother that bare you, into another country, where you were not born; and there shall you die.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:30: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Write you this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|22:9: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and worshipped other gods, and served them.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:12: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:19: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:17: But your eyes and your heart are not but for your covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:27: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
live.canon|jeremiah|22:28: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
live.canon|jeremiah|22:29: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|22:20: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all your lovers are destroyed.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:1: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:2: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) against the pastors that feed my people; You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:4: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:5: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:7: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that they shall no more say, Yahuah (LORD) lives, which brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt;
live.canon|jeremiah|23:8: But, Yahuah (LORD) lives, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:9: My heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahuah (LORD), and because of the words of his holiness.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:10: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourns; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:11: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:12: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:14: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:15: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:16: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:17: They say still unto them that despise me, Yahuah (LORD) has said, You shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walks after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:18: For who has stood in the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), and has perceived and heard his word? who has marked his word, and heard it?
live.canon|jeremiah|23:20: The anger of Yahuah (LORD) shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days you shall consider it perfectly.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:31: Behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahuah (LORD), that use their tongues, and say, He says.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:32: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, says Yahuah (LORD), and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:33: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask you, saying, What is the burden of Yahuah (LORD)? you shall then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:35: Thus shall you say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What has Yahuah (LORD) answered? and, What has Yahuah (LORD) spoken?
live.canon|jeremiah|23:36: And the burden of Yahuah (LORD) shall you mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for you have perverted the words of the living Elohim (God), of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) our Elohim (God).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:37: Thus shall you say to the prophet, What has Yahuah (LORD) answered you? and, What has Yahuah (LORD) spoken?
live.canon|jeremiah|23:38: But since you say, The burden of Yahuah (LORD); therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Because you say this word, The burden of Yahuah (LORD), and I have sent unto you, saying, You shall not say, The burden of Yahuah (LORD);
live.canon|jeremiah|23:3: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:6: In his days Yahudah (Judah) shall be saved, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, Yahuah Tsidkenu (THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:13: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Yashar'el (Israel) to err.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:19: Behold, a whirlwind of Yahuah (LORD) is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:21: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:22: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:25: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:26: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
live.canon|jeremiah|23:27: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:23: Am I a Elohim (God) at hand, says Yahuah (LORD), and not a Elohim (God) afar off?
live.canon|jeremiah|23:24: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? says Yahuah (LORD). Do not I fill heaven and earth? says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:34: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of Yahuah (LORD), I will even punish that man and his house.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:39: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
live.canon|jeremiah|23:40: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
live.canon|jeremiah|23:28: The prophet that has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|23:29: Is not my word like as a fire? says Yahuah (LORD); and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
live.canon|jeremiah|23:30: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahuah (LORD), that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:3: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, What see you, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:5: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Yahudah (Judah), whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:6: For I will set my eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:8: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus says Yahuah (LORD), So will I give Zedekiah the king of Yahudah (Judah), and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
live.canon|jeremiah|24:1: Yahuah (LORD) shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of Yahuah (LORD), after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah), and the princes of Yahudah (Judah), with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:2: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:4: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|24:7: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am Yahuah (LORD): and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God): for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:9: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
live.canon|jeremiah|24:10: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:3: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Yahudah (Judah), even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of Yahuah (LORD) has come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but you have not hearkened.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:4: And Yahuah (LORD) has sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but you have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:5: They said, Turn you again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahuah (LORD) has given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
live.canon|jeremiah|25:7: Yet you have not hearkened unto me, says Yahuah (LORD); that you might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:8: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Because you have not heard my words,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:9: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says Yahuah (LORD), and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:12: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, says Yahuah (LORD), for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:13: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:15: For thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:27: Therefore you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Drink you, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:28: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then shall you say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); You shall certainly drink.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:29: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|jeremiah|25:30: Therefore prophesy you against them all these words, and say unto them, Yahuah (LORD) shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:31: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for Yahuah (LORD) has a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|25:32: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:34: Howl, you shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, you principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and you shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:36: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoiled their pasture.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:38: He has forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:1: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Yahudah (Judah) in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
live.canon|jeremiah|25:2: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Yahudah (Judah), and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:6: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:10: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:11: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:14: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:16: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:17: Then took I the cup at the LORD’S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom Yahuah (LORD) had sent me:
live.canon|jeremiah|25:18: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
live.canon|jeremiah|25:19: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
live.canon|jeremiah|25:20: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:21: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:22: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:23: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:24: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:25: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
live.canon|jeremiah|25:26: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:33: And the slain of Yahuah (LORD) shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:35: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
live.canon|jeremiah|25:37: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|26:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Stand in the court of the LORD’S house, and speak unto all the cities of Yahudah (Judah), which come to worship in the LORD’S house, all the words that I command you to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
live.canon|jeremiah|26:4: And you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If you will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
live.canon|jeremiah|26:5: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but you have not hearkened;
live.canon|jeremiah|26:8: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that Yahuah (LORD) had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, You shall surely die.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:9: Why have you prophesied in the name of Yahuah (LORD), saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|26:11: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:12: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, Yahuah (LORD) sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:13: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); and Yahuah (LORD) will repent him of the evil that he has pronounced against you.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:14: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seems good and meet unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:15: But know you for certain, that if you put me to death, you shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth Yahuah (LORD) has sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:16: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|jeremiah|26:18: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), and spake to all the people of Yahudah (Judah), saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:1: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah) came this word from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|26:3: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:6: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:7: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|26:10: When the princes of Yahudah (Judah) heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of Yahuah (LORD), and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:17: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|26:19: Did Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) and all Yahudah (Judah) put him at all to death? did he not fear Yahuah (LORD), and besought Yahuah (LORD), and Yahuah (LORD) repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:20: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of Yahuah (LORD), Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
live.canon|jeremiah|26:21: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
live.canon|jeremiah|26:22: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:23: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
live.canon|jeremiah|26:24: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) to me; Make you bonds and yokes, and put them upon your neck,
live.canon|jeremiah|27:4: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Thus shall you say unto your masters;
live.canon|jeremiah|27:8: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, says Yahuah (LORD), with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:9: Therefore hearken not you to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon:
live.canon|jeremiah|27:10: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and you should perish.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:11: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, says Yahuah (LORD); and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:13: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahuah (LORD) has spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
live.canon|jeremiah|27:14: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:15: For I have not sent them, says Yahuah (LORD), yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that you might perish, you, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:16: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD’S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:19: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
live.canon|jeremiah|27:21: Yea, thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), concerning the vessels that remain in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah) and of Jerusalem;
live.canon|jeremiah|27:22: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, says Yahuah (LORD); then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:1: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah) came this word unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|27:3: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah);
live.canon|jeremiah|27:5: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:6: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:7: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:12: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:17: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
live.canon|jeremiah|27:18: But if they be prophets, and if the word of Yahuah (LORD) be with them, let them now make intercession to Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that the vessels which are left in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah), and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|27:20: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem;
live.canon|jeremiah|28:2: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:4: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah), with all the captives of Yahudah (Judah), that went into Babylon, says Yahuah (LORD): for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:6: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: Yahuah (LORD) do so: Yahuah (LORD) perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:8: The prophets that have been before me and before you of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:9: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that Yahuah (LORD) has truly sent him.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:11: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:13: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); You have broken the yokes of wood; but you shall make for them yokes of iron.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:14: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:15: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; Yahuah (LORD) has not sent you; but you make this people to trust in a lie.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:16: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will cast you from off the face of the earth: this year you shall die, because you have taught rebellion against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|28:7: Nevertheless hear you now this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people;
live.canon|jeremiah|28:1: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of Yahuah (LORD), in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|28:3: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
live.canon|jeremiah|28:5: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of Yahuah (LORD),
live.canon|jeremiah|28:10: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.
live.canon|jeremiah|28:12: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|28:17: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:4: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
live.canon|jeremiah|29:6: Take you wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that you may be increased there, and not diminished.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:7: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto Yahuah (LORD) for it: for in the peace thereof shall you have peace.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:8: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:9: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|29:10: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:11: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says Yahuah (LORD), thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:12: Then shall you call upon me, and you shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:13: And you shall seek me, and find me, when you shall search for me with all your heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:14: And I will be found of you, says Yahuah (LORD): and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, says Yahuah (LORD); and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:15: Because you have said, Yahuah (LORD) has raised us up prophets in Babylon;
live.canon|jeremiah|29:16: Know that thus says Yahuah (LORD) of the king that sits upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwells in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
live.canon|jeremiah|29:17: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:19: Because they have not hearkened to my words, says Yahuah (LORD), which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|29:20: Hear you therefore the word of Yahuah (LORD), all you of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
live.canon|jeremiah|29:21: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
live.canon|jeremiah|29:22: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Yahudah (Judah) which are in Babylon, saying, Yahuah (LORD) make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
live.canon|jeremiah|29:23: Because they have committed villany in Yashar'el (Israel), and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|29:24: Thus shall you also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|29:25: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Because you have sent letters in your name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|29:26: Yahuah (LORD) has made you priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that you should be officers in the house of Yahuah (LORD), for every man that is mad, and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in prison, and in the stocks.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:27: Now therefore why have you not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which makes himself a prophet to you?
live.canon|jeremiah|29:28: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build you houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:31: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah has prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
live.canon|jeremiah|29:32: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, says Yahuah (LORD); because he has taught rebellion against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|29:1: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
live.canon|jeremiah|29:2: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
live.canon|jeremiah|29:3: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|29:18: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
live.canon|jeremiah|29:29: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
live.canon|jeremiah|29:30: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|29:5: Build you houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
live.canon|jeremiah|30:2: Thus speaks Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Write you all the words that I have spoken unto you in a book.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:3: For, lo, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will bring again the captivity of my people Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah), says Yahuah (LORD): and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:5: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:6: Ask you now, and see whether a man does travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
live.canon|jeremiah|30:8: For it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
live.canon|jeremiah|30:10: Therefore fear you not, O my servant Jacob, says Yahuah (LORD); neither be dismayed, O Yashar'el (Israel): for, lo, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:11: For I am with you, says Yahuah (LORD), to save you: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered you, yet will I not make a full end of you: but I will correct you in measure, and will not leave you altogether unpunished.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:12: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Your bruise is incurable, and your wound is grievous.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:13: There is none to plead your cause, that you may be bound up: you have no healing medicines.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:14: All your lovers have forgotten you; they seek you not; for I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of your iniquity; because your sins were increased.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:15: Why cry you for your affliction? your sorrow is incurable for the multitude of your iniquity: because your sins were increased, I have done these things unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:16: Therefore all they that devour you shall be devoured; and all your adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil you shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon you will I give for a prey.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:17: For I will restore health unto you, and I will heal you of your wounds, says Yahuah (LORD); because they called you an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeks after.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:18: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:21: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|30:23: Behold, the whirlwind of Yahuah (LORD) goes forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:24: The fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD) shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days you shall consider it.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|30:4: And these are the words that Yahuah (LORD) spake concerning Yashar'el (Israel) and concerning Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|30:7: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:9: But they shall serve Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:19: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:20: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
live.canon|jeremiah|30:22: And you shall be my people, and I will be your Elohim (God).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:30: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eats the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:1: At the same time, says Yahuah (LORD), will I be the Elohim (God) of all the families of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall be my people.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Yashar'el (Israel), when I went to cause him to rest.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:3: Yahuah (LORD) has appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved you with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn you.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:4: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Yashar'el (Israel): you shall again be adorned with your tabrets, and shall go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:5: You shall yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:6: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise you, and let us go up to Zion unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:7: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish you, praise you, and say, O Yahuah (LORD), save your people, the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:10: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O you nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.
