live.canon|jeremiah|31:11: For Yahuah (LORD) has redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:14: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:15: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:16: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears: for your work shall be rewarded, says Yahuah (LORD); and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:17: And there is hope in your end, says Yahuah (LORD), that your children shall come again to their own border.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:18: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn you me, and I shall be turned; for you are Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:20: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:21: Set you up waymarks, make you high heaps: set your heart toward the highway, even the way which you went: turn again, O virgin of Yashar'el (Israel), turn again to these your cities.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:22: How long will you go about, O you backsliding daughter? for Yahuah (LORD) has created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:23: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Yahudah (Judah) and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; Yahuah (LORD) bless you, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:27: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will sow the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:28: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:31: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and with the house of Yahudah (Judah):
live.canon|jeremiah|31:32: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, says Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|jeremiah|31:33: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:34: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know Yahuah (LORD): for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, says Yahuah (LORD): for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:35: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), which gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divides the sea when the waves thereof roar; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:
live.canon|jeremiah|31:36: If those ordinances depart from before me, says Yahuah (LORD), then the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:37: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) for all that they have done, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|31:38: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that the city shall be built to Yahuah (LORD) from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:8: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:9: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Yashar'el (Israel), and Ephraim is my firstborn.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:12: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of Yahuah (LORD), for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:13: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:19: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:24: And there shall dwell in Yahudah (Judah) itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:25: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:26: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:29: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:39: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
live.canon|jeremiah|31:40: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto Yahuah (LORD); it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:3: For Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) had shut him up, saying, Wherefore do you prophesy, and say, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
live.canon|jeremiah|32:8: So Hanameel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray you, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|32:12: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Yahudim (Jews) that sat in the court of the prison.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:14: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:15: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:18: You shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty Elohim (God), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), is his name,
live.canon|jeremiah|32:19: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for your eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
live.canon|jeremiah|32:20: Which have set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Yashar'el (Israel), and among other men; and have made you a name, as at this day;
live.canon|jeremiah|32:21: And have brought forth your people Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
live.canon|jeremiah|32:23: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not your voice, neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do: therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them:
live.canon|jeremiah|32:24: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what you have spoken is come to pass; and, behold, you see it.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:28: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
live.canon|jeremiah|32:30: For the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and the children of Yahudah (Judah) have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|32:31: For this city has been to me as a provocation of my anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
live.canon|jeremiah|32:36: And now therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), concerning this city, whereof you say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
live.canon|jeremiah|32:43: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof you say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:44: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|32:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD) in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:2: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Yahudah's (Judah’s) house.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:4: And Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
live.canon|jeremiah|32:6: And Jeremiah said, The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|32:5: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, says Yahuah (LORD): though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not prosper.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:7: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum your uncle shall come unto you, saying, Buy you my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:9: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:10: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:11: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
live.canon|jeremiah|32:13: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|32:16: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|32:26: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|32:27: Behold, I am Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
live.canon|jeremiah|32:29: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:32: Because of all the evil of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and of the children of Yahudah (Judah), which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Yahudah (Judah), and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:33: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:34: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:35: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Yahudah (Judah) to sin.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:22: And have given them this land, which you did swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
live.canon|jeremiah|32:38: And they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God):
live.canon|jeremiah|32:39: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
live.canon|jeremiah|32:40: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:41: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:37: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in my anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
live.canon|jeremiah|32:42: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
live.canon|jeremiah|32:17: Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! behold, you have made the heaven and the earth by your great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for you:
live.canon|jeremiah|32:25: And you have said unto me, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, Buy you the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) the maker thereof, Yahuah (LORD) that formed it, to establish it; Yahuah (LORD) is his name;
live.canon|jeremiah|33:3: Call unto me, and I will answer you, and shew you great and mighty things, which you know not.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:4: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
live.canon|jeremiah|33:5: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in my anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:10: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Again there shall be heard in this place, which you say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
live.canon|jeremiah|33:11: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): for Yahuah (LORD) is good; for his mercy endures for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of Yahuah (LORD). For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|33:12: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:13: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|33:14: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and to the house of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|33:17: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|jeremiah|33:20: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If you can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
live.canon|jeremiah|33:24: Considerest you not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which Yahuah (LORD) has chosen, he has even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:25: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
live.canon|jeremiah|33:1: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|33:6: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:7: And I will cause the captivity of Yahudah (Judah) and the captivity of Yashar'el (Israel) to return, and will build them, as at the first.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:8: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:9: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:15: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:16: In those days shall Yahudah (Judah) be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, Yahuah (LORD) our righteousness.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:18: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:19: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|33:21: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:22: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
live.canon|jeremiah|33:23: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|33:26: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:3: And you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and your eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:5: But you shall die in peace: and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings which were before you, so shall they burn odours for you; and they will lament you, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|34:13: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|34:14: At the end of seven years let you go every man his brother an Hebrew, which has been sold unto you; and when he has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:15: And you were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and you had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
live.canon|jeremiah|34:16: But you turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom you had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:17: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); You have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, says Yahuah (LORD), to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:22: Behold, I will command, says Yahuah (LORD), and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Yahudah (Judah) a desolation without an inhabitant.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:1: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|34:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), and tell him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
live.canon|jeremiah|34:6: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) in Jerusalem,
live.canon|jeremiah|34:7: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Yahudah (Judah) that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|34:8: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
live.canon|jeremiah|34:9: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Yahudi (Jew) his brother.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:10: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:11: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:12: Therefore the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|34:18: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
live.canon|jeremiah|34:19: The princes of Yahudah (Judah), and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
live.canon|jeremiah|34:20: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:21: And Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.
live.canon|jeremiah|34:4: Yet hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah); Thus says Yahuah (LORD) of you, You shall not die by the sword:
live.canon|jeremiah|35:5: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink you wine.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:6: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, neither you, nor your sons for ever:
live.canon|jeremiah|35:14: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but you hearkened not unto me.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:15: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return you now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but you have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:16: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people has not hearkened unto me:
live.canon|jeremiah|35:17: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts, the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring upon Yahudah (Judah) and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:18: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he has commanded you:
live.canon|jeremiah|35:19: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:1: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD) in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|35:2: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of Yahuah (LORD), into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:3: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
live.canon|jeremiah|35:4: And I brought them into the house of Yahuah (LORD), into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of Elohim (God), which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
live.canon|jeremiah|35:9: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
live.canon|jeremiah|35:10: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:11: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:7: Neither shall you build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days you shall dwell in tents; that you may live many days in the land where you be strangers.
live.canon|jeremiah|35:8: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he has charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
live.canon|jeremiah|35:13: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Go and tell the men of Yahudah (Judah) and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to hearken to my words? says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|35:12: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|36:2: Take you a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto you against Yashar'el (Israel), and against Yahudah (Judah), and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto you, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:6: Therefore go you, and read in the roll, which you have written from my mouth, the words of Yahuah (LORD) in the ears of the people in the LORD’S house upon the fasting day: and also you shall read them in the ears of all Yahudah (Judah) that come out of their cities.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:7: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahuah (LORD), and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that Yahuah (LORD) has pronounced against this people.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:14: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in your hand the roll wherein you have read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:29: And you shall say to Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah), Thus says Yahuah (LORD); You have burned this roll, saying, Why have you written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
live.canon|jeremiah|36:30: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah); He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:1: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), that this word came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|36:3: It may be that the house of Yahudah (Judah) will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:4: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of Yahuah (LORD), which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:5: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|jeremiah|36:8: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of Yahuah (LORD) in the LORD’S house.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:9: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before Yahuah (LORD) to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Yahudah (Judah) unto Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:10: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of Yahuah (LORD), in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house, in the ears of all the people.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:11: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of Yahuah (LORD),
live.canon|jeremiah|36:12: Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:13: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:15: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:16: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:18: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:20: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:21: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe’s chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:17: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How did you write all these words at his mouth?
live.canon|jeremiah|36:19: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide you, you and Jeremiah; and let no man know where you be.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:22: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:23: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:24: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:25: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:26: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but Yahuah (LORD) hid them.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:27: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|36:31: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Yahudah (Judah), all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:32: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.
live.canon|jeremiah|36:28: Take you again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Yahudah (Judah) has burned.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:7: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Thus shall you say to the king of Yahudah (Judah), that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:10: For though you had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:13: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, You fallest away to the Chaldeans.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:17: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from Yahuah (LORD)? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, you shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:18: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?
live.canon|jeremiah|37:1: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|37:2: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:3: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) for us.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:4: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:5: Then Pharaoh’s army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:6: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|37:8: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:11: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,
live.canon|jeremiah|37:12: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:14: Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:15: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:16: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
live.canon|jeremiah|37:19: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
live.canon|jeremiah|37:9: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:21: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
live.canon|jeremiah|37:20: Therefore hear now, I pray you, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray you, be accepted before you; that you cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), He that remains in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goes forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:3: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which shall take it.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:4: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech you, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeks not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:10: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:12: And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under your armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:14: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of Yahuah (LORD): and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask you a thing; hide nothing from me.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:15: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto you, will you not surely put me to death? and if I give you counsel, will you not hearken unto me?
live.canon|jeremiah|38:16: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, that made us this soul, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men that seek your life.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:17: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of hosts, the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); If you will assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and you shall live, and your house:
live.canon|jeremiah|38:18: But if you will not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and you shall not escape out of their hand.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:20: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver you. Obey, I beseech you, the voice of Yahuah (LORD), which I speak unto you: so it shall be well unto you, and your soul shall live.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:21: But if you refuse to go forth, this is the word that Yahuah (LORD) has shewed me:
live.canon|jeremiah|38:22: And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Yahudah's (Judah’s) house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women shall say, Your friends have set you on, and have prevailed against you: your feet are sunk in the mire, and they are turned away back.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:23: So they shall bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans: and you shall not escape out of their hand, but shall be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and you shall cause this city to be burned with fire.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:24: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and you shall not die.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:25: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come unto you, and say unto you, Declare unto us now what you have said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put you to death; also what the king said unto you:
live.canon|jeremiah|38:26: Then you shall say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:1: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|38:5: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:6: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:7: Now when Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;
live.canon|jeremiah|38:8: Ebed-melech went forth out of the king’s house, and spake to the king, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|38:9: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:11: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:13: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:19: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Yahudim (Jews) that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:27: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.
live.canon|jeremiah|38:28: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was there when Jerusalem was taken.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:17: But I will deliver you in that day, says Yahuah (LORD): and you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:18: For I will surely deliver you, and you shall not fall by the sword, but your life shall be for a prey unto you: because you have put your trust in me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|39:1: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:2: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:3: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, even Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:4: And it came to pass, that when Zedekiah the king of Yahudah (Judah) saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:5: But the Chaldeans’ army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:6: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|39:7: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:12: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:16: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before you.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:8: And the Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:9: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:10: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Yahudah (Judah), and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:11: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|39:13: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag, and all the king of Babylon’s princes;
live.canon|jeremiah|39:14: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.
live.canon|jeremiah|39:15: Now the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|40:2: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) has pronounced this evil upon this place.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:3: Now Yahuah (LORD) has brought it, and done according as he has said: because you have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:4: And now, behold, I loose you this day from the chains which were upon your hand. If it seem good unto you to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto you: but if it seem ill unto you to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before you: whither it seems good and convenient for you to go, thither go.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:5: Now while he was not yet gone back, he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seems convenient unto you to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:10: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but you, gather you wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:14: And said unto him, Do you certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay you? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:15: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray you, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay you, that all the Yahudim (Jews) which are gathered unto you should be scattered, and the remnant in Yahudah (Judah) perish?
live.canon|jeremiah|40:1: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), which were carried away captive unto Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:6: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:7: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;
live.canon|jeremiah|40:8: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:9: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:11: Likewise when all the Yahudim (Jews) that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Yahudah (Judah), and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;
live.canon|jeremiah|40:12: Even all the Yahudim (Jews) returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Yahudah (Judah), to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
live.canon|jeremiah|40:13: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
live.canon|jeremiah|40:16: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing: for you speak falsely of Ishmael.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:1: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:2: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:3: Ishmael also slew all the Yahudim (Jews) that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:4: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
live.canon|jeremiah|41:5: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|41:6: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:7: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:8: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:9: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel): and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:10: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:11: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
live.canon|jeremiah|41:12: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:13: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:14: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:15: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
live.canon|jeremiah|41:16: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
live.canon|jeremiah|41:17: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Beth-lehem, to go to enter into Egypt,
live.canon|jeremiah|41:18: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:2: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech you, our supplication be accepted before you, and pray for us unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes do behold us:)
live.canon|jeremiah|42:5: Then they said to Jeremiah, Yahuah (LORD) be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall send you to us.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:6: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|jeremiah|42:9: And said unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), unto whom you sent me to present your supplication before him;
live.canon|jeremiah|42:10: If you will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:11: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; be not afraid of him, says Yahuah (LORD): for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:13: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God),
live.canon|jeremiah|42:15: And now therefore hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you remnant of Yahudah (Judah); Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); If you wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;
live.canon|jeremiah|42:18: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); As my anger and my fury has been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when you shall enter into Egypt: and you shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:19: Yahuah (LORD) has said concerning you, O you remnant of Yahudah (Judah); Go you not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:20: For you dissembled in your hearts, when you sent me unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), saying, Pray for us unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God); and according unto all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do it.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:21: And now I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), nor any thing for the which he has sent me unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:22: Now therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither you desire to go and to sojourn.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:1: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
live.canon|jeremiah|42:3: That Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:4: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) according to your words; and it shall come to pass, that whatsoever thing Yahuah (LORD) shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:7: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:8: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
live.canon|jeremiah|42:12: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:14: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:
live.canon|jeremiah|42:17: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.
live.canon|jeremiah|42:16: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which you feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof you were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.
live.canon|jeremiah|43:2: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, You speak falsely: Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has not sent you to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
live.canon|jeremiah|43:3: But Baruch the son of Neriah sets you on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|43:9: Take great stones in your hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Yahudah (Judah);
live.canon|jeremiah|43:10: And say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
live.canon|jeremiah|43:11: And when he comes, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.
live.canon|jeremiah|43:12: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
live.canon|jeremiah|43:1: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), for which Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) had sent him to them, even all these words,
live.canon|jeremiah|43:4: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of Yahuah (LORD), to dwell in the land of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|43:5: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Yahudah (Judah);
live.canon|jeremiah|43:6: Even men, and women, and children, and the king’s daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
live.canon|jeremiah|43:7: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah (LORD): thus came they even to Tahpanhes.
live.canon|jeremiah|43:8: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|43:13: He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:2: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); You have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Yahudah (Judah); and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwells therein,
live.canon|jeremiah|44:3: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, you, nor your fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:6: Wherefore my fury and my anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Yahudah (Judah) and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:7: Therefore now thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of hosts, the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Wherefore commit you this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Yahudah (Judah), to leave you none to remain;
live.canon|jeremiah|44:8: In that you provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither you be gone to dwell, that you might cut yourselves off, and that you might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
live.canon|jeremiah|44:9: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem?
live.canon|jeremiah|44:11: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|44:17: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goes forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:21: The incense that you burned in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem, you, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not Yahuah (LORD) remember them, and came it not into his mind?
live.canon|jeremiah|44:22: So that Yahuah (LORD) could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:23: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), and have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah (LORD), nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:25: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying; You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: you will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:26: Therefore hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), all Yahudah (Judah) that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says Yahuah (LORD), that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Yahudah (Judah) in all the land of Egypt, saying, Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) lives.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:29: And this shall be a sign unto you, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
live.canon|jeremiah|44:30: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:1: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Yahudim (Jews) which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|44:4: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:5: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:10: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:12: And I will take the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:13: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
live.canon|jeremiah|44:14: So that none of the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Yahudah (Judah), to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:15: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|44:18: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:19: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
live.canon|jeremiah|44:20: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|44:24: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), all Yahudah (Judah) that are in the land of Egypt:
live.canon|jeremiah|44:27: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Yahudah (Judah) that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:28: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Yahudah (Judah), and all the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.
live.canon|jeremiah|44:16: As for the word that you have spoken unto us in the name of Yahuah (LORD), we will not hearken unto you.
live.canon|jeremiah|45:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), unto you, O Baruch;
live.canon|jeremiah|45:3: You did say, Woe is me now! for Yahuah (LORD) has added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
live.canon|jeremiah|45:4: Thus shall you say unto him, Yahuah (LORD) says thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
live.canon|jeremiah|45:5: And seek you great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, says Yahuah (LORD): but your life will I give unto you for a prey in all places whither you go.
live.canon|jeremiah|45:1: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|46:3: Order you the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:5: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|46:7: Who is this that comes up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
live.canon|jeremiah|46:14: Declare you in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say you, Stand fast, and prepare you; for the sword shall devour round about you.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:15: Why are your valiant men swept away? they stood not, because Yahuah (LORD) did drive them.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:17: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has passed the time appointed.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:18: As I live, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:19: O you daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:20: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction comes; it comes out of the north.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:23: They shall cut down her forest, says Yahuah (LORD), though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:25: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), says; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
live.canon|jeremiah|46:26: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|46:27: But fear not you, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Yashar'el (Israel): for, behold, I will save you from afar off, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:28: Fear you not, O Jacob my servant, says Yahuah (LORD): for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven you: but I will not make a full end of you, but correct you in measure; yet will I not leave you wholly unpunished.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:4: Harness the horses; and get up, you horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
live.canon|jeremiah|46:2: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|jeremiah|46:6: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:8: Egypt rises up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he says, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:9: Come up, you horses; and rage, you chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:10: For this is the day of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:13: The word that Yahuah (LORD) spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:16: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:21: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:22: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:24: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:11: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shall you use many medicines; for you shall not be cured.
live.canon|jeremiah|46:12: The nations have heard of your shame, and your cry has filled the land: for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.
live.canon|jeremiah|47:2: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
