live.canon|jeremiah|47:4: Because of the day that comes to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remains: for Yahuah (LORD) will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
live.canon|jeremiah|47:5: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut thyself?
live.canon|jeremiah|47:6: O you sword of Yahuah (LORD), how long will it be ere you be quiet? put up thyself into your scabbard, rest, and be still.
live.canon|jeremiah|47:7: How can it be quiet, seeing Yahuah (LORD) has given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there has he appointed it.
live.canon|jeremiah|47:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
live.canon|jeremiah|47:3: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
live.canon|jeremiah|48:1: Against Moab thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:2: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also you shall be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue you.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:8: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as Yahuah (LORD) has spoken.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:11: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:12: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:14: How say you, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
live.canon|jeremiah|48:15: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|jeremiah|48:17: All you that are about him, bemoan him; and all you that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
live.canon|jeremiah|48:18: You daughter that do inhabit Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon you, and he shall destroy your strong holds.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:20: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell you it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
live.canon|jeremiah|48:25: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|48:26: Make you him drunken: for he magnified himself against Yahuah (LORD): Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:27: For was not Yashar'el (Israel) a derision unto you? was he found among thieves? for since you spoke of him, you skippedst for joy.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:30: I know his wrath, says Yahuah (LORD); but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:31: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; my heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:32: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for you with the weeping of Jazer: your plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon your summer fruits and upon your vintage.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:35: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahuah (LORD), him that offers in the high places, and him that burns incense to his gods.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:36: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and my heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he has gotten are perished.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:38: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|48:39: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how has Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:40: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:42: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|48:43: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon you, O inhabitant of Moab, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|48:44: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|48:46: Woe be unto you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perishes: for your sons are taken captives, and your daughters captives.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:47: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahuah (LORD). Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:3: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:4: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:5: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:6: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:9: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:28: O you that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that makes her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:7: For because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you shall also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:13: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Yashar'el (Israel) was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:16: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:19: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
live.canon|jeremiah|48:21: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
live.canon|jeremiah|48:22: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,
live.canon|jeremiah|48:23: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,
live.canon|jeremiah|48:24: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:29: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:33: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:34: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:37: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:41: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:45: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
live.canon|jeremiah|48:10: Cursed be he that does the work of Yahuah (LORD) deceitfully, and cursed be he that keeps back his sword from blood.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:1: Concerning the Ammonites, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Has Yashar'el (Israel) no sons? has he no heir? why then does their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
live.canon|jeremiah|49:2: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Yashar'el (Israel) be heir unto them that were his heirs, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|49:3: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, you daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:4: Wherefore gloriest you in the valleys, your flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
live.canon|jeremiah|49:5: Behold, I will bring a fear upon you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts, from all those that be about you; and you shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:6: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|49:7: Concerning Edom, thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
live.canon|jeremiah|49:8: Flee you, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:9: If grapegatherers come to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:11: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let your widows trust in me.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:12: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and are you he that shall altogether go unpunished? you shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink of it.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:13: For I have sworn by myself, says Yahuah (LORD), that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:14: I have heard a rumour from Yahuah (LORD), and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather you together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:15: For, lo, I will make you small among the heathen, and despised among men.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:16: Your terribleness has deceived you, and the pride of your heart, O you that dwell in the clefts of the rock, that hold the height of the hill: though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from thence, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|49:17: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:18: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, says Yahuah (LORD), no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of Adam dwell in it.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:20: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), that he has taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:24: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turns herself to flee, and fear has seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:26: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|jeremiah|49:28: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Arise you, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:31: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwells without care, says Yahuah (LORD), which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:32: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|49:35: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:37: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, says Yahuah (LORD); and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
live.canon|jeremiah|49:38: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|49:39: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|49:10: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:19: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
live.canon|jeremiah|49:21: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:22: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:23: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:25: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
live.canon|jeremiah|49:27: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:29: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:33: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of Adam dwell in it.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:34: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying,
live.canon|jeremiah|49:36: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
live.canon|jeremiah|49:30: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O you inhabitants of Hazor, says Yahuah (LORD); for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:2: Declare you among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:3: For out of the north there comes up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:4: In those days, and in that time, says Yahuah (LORD), the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come, they and the children of Yahudah (Judah) together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
live.canon|jeremiah|50:6: My people has been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:10: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|50:11: Because you were glad, because you rejoiced, O you destroyers of my heritage, because you are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
live.canon|jeremiah|50:13: Because of the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goes by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:14: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all you that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she has sinned against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|50:15: Shout against her round about: she has given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of Yahuah (LORD): take vengeance upon her; as she has done, do unto her.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:17: Yashar'el (Israel) is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria has devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:18: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:20: In those days, and in that time, says Yahuah (LORD), the iniquity of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Yahudah (Judah), and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:21: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, says Yahuah (LORD), and do according to all that I have commanded you.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:24: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, O Babylon, and you were not aware: you are found, and also caught, because you have striven against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|50:25: Yahuah (LORD) has opened his armoury, and has brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:42: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against you, O daughter of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:43: The king of Babylon has heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:45: Therefore hear you the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:1: The word that Yahuah (LORD) spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:5: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to Yahuah (LORD) in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:7: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), the habitation of justice, even Yahuah (LORD), the hope of their fathers.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:8: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:9: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:12: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:16: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:19: And I will bring Yashar'el (Israel) again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:22: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:23: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
live.canon|jeremiah|50:26: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:27: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:28: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), the vengeance of his temple.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:29: Call together the archers against Babylon: all you that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she has done, do unto her: for she has been proud against Yahuah (LORD), against the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|jeremiah|50:30: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|50:31: Behold, I am against you, O you most proud, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts: for your day is come, the time that I will visit you.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:33: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); The children of Yashar'el (Israel) and the children of Yahudah (Judah) were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:35: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, says Yahuah (LORD), and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:32: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:34: Their Redeemer is strong; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:36: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:37: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:38: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:39: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:41: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:44: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
live.canon|jeremiah|50:46: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
live.canon|jeremiah|50:40: As Elohim (God) overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, says Yahuah (LORD); so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of Adam dwell therein.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:1: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
live.canon|jeremiah|51:3: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifts himself up in his brigandine: and spare you not her young men; destroy you utterly all her host.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:5: For Yashar'el (Israel) has not been forsaken, nor Yahudah (Judah) of his Elohim (God), of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:7: Babylon has been a golden cup in the LORD’S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:9: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reaches unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:15: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and has stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:16: When he utters his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:20: You are my battle axe and weapons of war: for with you will I break in pieces the nations, and with you will I destroy kingdoms;
live.canon|jeremiah|51:21: And with you will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with you will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
live.canon|jeremiah|51:22: With you also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with you will I break in pieces old and young; and with you will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
live.canon|jeremiah|51:23: I will also break in pieces with you the shepherd and his flock; and with you will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with you will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:24: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:25: Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, says Yahuah (LORD), which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out my hand upon you, and roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burnt mountain.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:26: And they shall not take of you a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but you shall be desolate for ever, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:27: Set you up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:30: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might has failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:33: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:34: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me, he has crushed me, he has made me an empty vessel, he has swallowed me up like a dragon, he has filled his belly with my delicates, he has cast me out.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:36: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:39: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:43: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwells, neither does any son of Adam pass thereby.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:50: You that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember Yahuah (LORD) afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:51: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame has covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’S house.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:52: Wherefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:53: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:54: A sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
live.canon|jeremiah|51:55: Because Yahuah (LORD) has spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
live.canon|jeremiah|51:57: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:58: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:61: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come to Babylon, and shall see, and shall read all these words;
live.canon|jeremiah|51:62: Then shall you say, O Yahuah (LORD), you have spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:63: And it shall be, when you have made an end of reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
live.canon|jeremiah|51:64: And you shall say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:2: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:4: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:6: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD’S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:8: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:10: Yahuah (LORD) has brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:11: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: Yahuah (LORD) has raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of Yahuah (LORD), the vengeance of his temple.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:12: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for Yahuah (LORD) has both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:17: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:18: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:19: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Yashar'el (Israel) is the rod of his inheritance: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:28: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:29: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of Yahuah (LORD) shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:31: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
live.canon|jeremiah|51:32: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:35: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:37: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:38: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:40: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:41: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
live.canon|jeremiah|51:42: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:13: O you that dwell upon many waters, abundant in treasures, your end is come, and the measure of your covetousness.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:14: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill you with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against you.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:47: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:44: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:45: My people, go you out of the midst of her, and deliver you every man his soul from the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:46: And lest your heart faint, and you fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:48: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|jeremiah|51:56: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of recompences shall surely requite.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:59: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Yahudah (Judah) into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:60: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|51:49: As Babylon has caused the slain of Yashar'el (Israel) to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:1: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:2: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:3: For through the anger of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass in Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:4: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:5: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:6: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:7: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:8: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:9: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:10: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Yahudah (Judah) in Riblah.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:11: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:12: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
live.canon|jeremiah|52:13: And burned the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
live.canon|jeremiah|52:14: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:15: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:16: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:17: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of Yahuah (LORD), the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:18: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:19: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:20: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of Yahuah (LORD): the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:21: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:22: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:23: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:24: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
live.canon|jeremiah|52:25: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:26: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:27: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Yahudah (Judah) was carried away captive out of his own land.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:28: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Yahudim (Jews) and three and twenty:
live.canon|jeremiah|52:29: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
live.canon|jeremiah|52:30: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Yahudim (Jews) seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:31: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah (Judah), in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah (Judah), and brought him forth out of prison,
live.canon|jeremiah|52:32: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,
live.canon|jeremiah|52:33: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
live.canon|jeremiah|52:34: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
live.canon|job|1:8: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Have you considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that fears Elohim (God), and escheweth evil?

live.canon|job|1:10: Have not you made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he has on every side? you have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
live.canon|job|1:11: But put forth your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will curse you to your face.
live.canon|job|1:12: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Behold, all that he has is in your power; only upon himself put not forth your hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of Yahuah (LORD).

live.canon|job|1:2: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
live.canon|job|1:3: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
live.canon|job|1:4: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
live.canon|job|1:5: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed Elohim (God) in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
live.canon|job|1:6: Now there was a day when the sons of Elohim (God) came to present themselves before Yahuah (LORD), and Satan came also among them.

live.canon|job|1:16: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of Elohim (God) is fallen from heaven, and has burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.
live.canon|job|1:17: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.
live.canon|job|1:22: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged Elohim (God) foolishly.

live.canon|job|2:4: And Satan answered Yahuah (LORD), and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man has will he give for his life.

live.canon|job|2:10: But he said unto her, You speak as one of the foolish women speaks. What? shall we receive good at the hand of Elohim (God), and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

live.canon|job|2:12: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

live.canon|job|27:21: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departs: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
live.canon|job|27:1: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
live.canon|job|27:3: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of Elohim (God) is in my nostrils;
live.canon|job|27:4: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
live.canon|job|27:6: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
live.canon|job|27:10: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon Elohim (God)?
live.canon|job|27:5: Elohim (God) forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove my integrity from me.
live.canon|job|27:7: Let my enemy be as the wicked, and he that rises up against me as the unrighteous.
live.canon|job|27:8: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he has gained, when Elohim (God) takes away his soul?
live.canon|job|27:11: I will teach you by the hand of Elohim (God): that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
live.canon|job|27:13: This is the portion of a wicked man with Elohim (God), and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
live.canon|job|27:14: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
live.canon|job|27:15: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
live.canon|job|27:16: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
live.canon|job|27:17: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
live.canon|job|27:20: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
live.canon|job|27:22: For Elohim (God) shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
live.canon|job|27:23: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
live.canon|job|27:9: Will Elohim (God) hear his cry when trouble comes upon him?
live.canon|job|27:12: Behold, all you yourselves have seen it; why then are you thus altogether vain?
live.canon|job|27:18: He builds his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper makes.
live.canon|job|27:19: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he opens his eyes, and he is not.
live.canon|job|28:3: He sets an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
live.canon|job|28:4: The flood breaks out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
live.canon|job|28:5: As for the earth, out of it comes bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
live.canon|job|28:6: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it has dust of gold.
live.canon|job|28:7: There is a path which no fowl knows, and which the vulture’s eye has not seen:
live.canon|job|28:9: He puts forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
live.canon|job|28:10: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye sees every precious thing.
live.canon|job|28:11: He binds the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid brings he forth to light.
live.canon|job|28:13: Man knows not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
live.canon|job|28:14: The depth says, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.
live.canon|job|28:20: Whence then comes wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
live.canon|job|28:23: Elohim (God) understands the way thereof, and he knows the place thereof.
live.canon|job|28:24: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole heaven;
live.canon|job|28:1: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
live.canon|job|28:2: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
live.canon|job|28:8: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
live.canon|job|28:12: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
live.canon|job|28:15: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
live.canon|job|28:16: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
live.canon|job|28:17: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
live.canon|job|28:18: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
live.canon|job|28:19: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
live.canon|job|28:21: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
live.canon|job|28:22: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
live.canon|job|28:25: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
live.canon|job|28:26: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
live.canon|job|28:27: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
live.canon|job|28:28: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of Adonai (Lord), that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
live.canon|job|29:1: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
live.canon|job|29:2: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when Elohim (God) preserved me;
live.canon|job|29:3: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
live.canon|job|29:4: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of Elohim (God) was upon my tabernacle;
live.canon|job|29:5: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
live.canon|job|29:6: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
live.canon|job|29:7: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
live.canon|job|29:8: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
live.canon|job|29:9: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
live.canon|job|29:10: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
live.canon|job|29:11: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
live.canon|job|29:12: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
live.canon|job|29:13: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
live.canon|job|29:14: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
live.canon|job|29:15: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
live.canon|job|29:16: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
live.canon|job|29:17: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
live.canon|job|29:18: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
live.canon|job|29:19: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
live.canon|job|29:20: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
live.canon|job|29:21: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
live.canon|job|29:22: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
live.canon|job|29:23: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
live.canon|job|29:24: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
live.canon|job|29:25: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
live.canon|job|30:11: Because he has loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
live.canon|job|30:15: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passes away as a cloud.
live.canon|job|30:18: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it binds me about as the collar of my coat.
live.canon|job|30:19: He has cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
live.canon|job|30:20: I cry unto you, and you do not hear me: I stand up, and you regard me not.
live.canon|job|30:21: You are become cruel to me: with your strong hand you opposest thyself against me.
live.canon|job|30:22: You liftest me up to the wind; you cause me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
live.canon|job|30:23: For I know that you will bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
live.canon|job|30:1: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
live.canon|job|30:2: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
live.canon|job|30:3: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
live.canon|job|30:4: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
live.canon|job|30:5: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
live.canon|job|30:6: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
live.canon|job|30:7: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
live.canon|job|30:8: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
live.canon|job|30:9: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
live.canon|job|30:10: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
live.canon|job|30:12: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
live.canon|job|30:13: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
live.canon|job|30:14: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
live.canon|job|30:16: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
live.canon|job|30:17: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
live.canon|job|30:24: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
live.canon|job|30:25: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
live.canon|job|30:26: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
live.canon|job|30:27: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
live.canon|job|30:28: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
live.canon|job|30:29: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
live.canon|job|30:30: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
live.canon|job|30:31: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
live.canon|job|31:1: I made a covenant with my eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
live.canon|job|31:4: Does not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
live.canon|job|31:5: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot has hasted to deceit;
live.canon|job|31:6: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that Elohim (God) may know my integrity.
live.canon|job|31:7: If my step has turned out of the way, and my heart walked after my eyes, and if any blot has cleaved to my hands;
live.canon|job|31:9: If my heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
live.canon|job|31:12: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
live.canon|job|31:33: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom:
live.canon|job|31:35: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that my adversary had written a book.
live.canon|job|31:2: For what portion of Elohim (God) is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
live.canon|job|31:3: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
live.canon|job|31:8: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
live.canon|job|31:10: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
live.canon|job|31:11: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
live.canon|job|31:13: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
live.canon|job|31:15: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
live.canon|job|31:16: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
live.canon|job|31:18: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
live.canon|job|31:14: What then shall I do when Elohim (God) rises up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
live.canon|job|31:17: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless has not eaten thereof;
live.canon|job|31:19: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
live.canon|job|31:20: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
live.canon|job|31:21: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
live.canon|job|31:23: For destruction from Elohim (God) was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
live.canon|job|31:26: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
live.canon|job|31:28: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the Elohim (God) that is above.
live.canon|job|31:29: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
live.canon|job|31:30: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
live.canon|job|31:31: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
live.canon|job|31:32: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
live.canon|job|31:34: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
live.canon|job|31:36: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
live.canon|job|31:37: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
live.canon|job|31:38: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
live.canon|job|31:39: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
live.canon|job|31:40: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
live.canon|job|31:22: Then let my arm fall from my shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
live.canon|job|31:24: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, You are my confidence;
live.canon|job|31:25: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
live.canon|job|31:27: And my heart has been secretly enticed, or my mouth has kissed my hand:
live.canon|job|32:6: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and you are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you my opinion.
live.canon|job|32:8: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty gives them understanding.
live.canon|job|32:10: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew my opinion.
live.canon|job|32:11: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst you searched out what to say.
live.canon|job|32:13: Lest you should say, We have found out wisdom: Elohim (God) thrusteth him down, not man.
live.canon|job|32:14: Now he has not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
live.canon|job|32:17: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew my opinion.
live.canon|job|32:19: Behold, my belly is as wine which has no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
live.canon|job|32:1: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
live.canon|job|32:2: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than Elohim (God).
live.canon|job|32:3: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
live.canon|job|32:4: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
live.canon|job|32:5: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
live.canon|job|32:7: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
live.canon|job|32:9: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
live.canon|job|32:12: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
live.canon|job|32:15: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
live.canon|job|32:16: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
live.canon|job|32:18: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
live.canon|job|32:20: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
live.canon|job|32:21: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
live.canon|job|32:22: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
live.canon|job|33:1: Wherefore, Job, I pray you, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
live.canon|job|33:2: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken in my mouth.
live.canon|job|33:4: The Spirit of Elohim (God) has made me, and the breath of the Almighty has given me life.
live.canon|job|33:5: If you can answer me, set your words in order before me, stand up.
live.canon|job|33:6: Behold, I am according to your wish in Elohim's (God’s) stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
live.canon|job|33:7: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon you.
live.canon|job|33:8: Surely you have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
live.canon|job|33:10: Behold, he finds occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
live.canon|job|33:11: He puts my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
live.canon|job|33:12: Behold, in this you are not just: I will answer you, that Elohim (God) is greater than man.
live.canon|job|33:13: Why do you strive against him? for he gives not account of any of his matters.
live.canon|job|33:14: For Elohim (God) speaks once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
live.canon|job|33:15: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
live.canon|job|33:16: Then he opens the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
live.canon|job|33:18: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
live.canon|job|33:20: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty meat.
live.canon|job|33:22: Yea, his soul draws near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
live.canon|job|33:24: Then he is gracious unto him, and says, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
live.canon|job|33:27: He looks upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
live.canon|job|33:29: Lo, all these things works Elohim (God) oftentimes with man,
live.canon|job|33:31: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I will speak.
live.canon|job|33:32: If you have any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify you.
live.canon|job|33:33: If not, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I shall teach you wisdom.
live.canon|job|33:3: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
live.canon|job|33:9: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
live.canon|job|33:17: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
live.canon|job|33:19: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
live.canon|job|33:21: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
live.canon|job|33:23: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
live.canon|job|33:25: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:
live.canon|job|33:26: He shall pray unto Elohim (God), and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
live.canon|job|33:28: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
live.canon|job|33:30: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
live.canon|job|34:2: Hear my words, O you wise men; and give ear unto me, you that have knowledge.
live.canon|job|34:5: For Job has said, I am righteous: and Elohim (God) has taken away my judgment.
live.canon|job|34:7: What man is like Job, who drinks up scorning like water?
live.canon|job|34:8: Which goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men.
live.canon|job|34:9: For he has said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with Elohim (God).
live.canon|job|34:10: Therefore hearken unto me, you men of understanding: far be it from Elohim (God), that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
live.canon|job|34:13: Who has given him a charge over the earth? or who has disposed the whole world?
live.canon|job|34:16: If now you have understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
live.canon|job|34:17: Shall even he that hates right govern? and will you condemn him that is most just?
live.canon|job|34:18: Is it fit to say to a king, You are wicked? and to princes, You are ungodly?
live.canon|job|34:19: How much less to him that accepts not the persons of princes, nor regards the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
live.canon|job|34:21: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he sees all his goings.
live.canon|job|34:25: Therefore he knows their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
live.canon|job|34:28: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he hears the cry of the afflicted.
live.canon|job|34:29: When he gives quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hides his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
live.canon|job|34:32: That which I see not teach you me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
live.canon|job|34:3: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
live.canon|job|34:4: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
live.canon|job|34:6: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
live.canon|job|34:11: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
live.canon|job|34:12: Yea, surely Elohim (God) will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
live.canon|job|34:14: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
live.canon|job|34:15: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
live.canon|job|34:20: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
live.canon|job|34:22: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
live.canon|job|34:23: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with Elohim (God).
live.canon|job|34:24: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
live.canon|job|34:26: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
live.canon|job|34:27: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
live.canon|job|34:30: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
live.canon|job|34:31: Surely it is meet to be said unto Elohim (God), I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
live.canon|job|34:34: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
live.canon|job|34:36: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
live.canon|job|34:37: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against Elohim (God).
