live.canon|john|20:1: The first day of the week comes Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and sees the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
live.canon|john|20:6: Then comes Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and sees the linen clothes lie,
live.canon|john|20:12: And sees two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Yahusha (Jesus) had lain.
live.canon|john|20:13: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest you? She says unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
live.canon|john|20:16: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and says unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
live.canon|john|20:17: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my Elohim (God), and your Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|20:19: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Yahudim (Jews), came Yahusha (Jesus) and stood in the midst, and says unto them, Peace be unto you.
live.canon|john|20:21: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father has sent me, even so send I you.
live.canon|john|20:22: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and says unto them, Receive you the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
live.canon|john|20:23: Whose soever sins you remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins you retain, they are retained.
live.canon|john|20:27: Then says he to Thomas, Reach hither your finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither your hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
live.canon|john|20:29: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Thomas, because you have seen me, you have believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
live.canon|john|20:31: But these are written, that you might believe that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Messiah (Christ), the Son of Elohim (God); and that believing you might have life through his name.
live.canon|john|20:18: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
live.canon|john|20:20: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
live.canon|john|20:25: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
live.canon|john|20:2: Then she runs, and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved, and says unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
live.canon|john|1:25: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest you then, if you be not that Messiah (Christ), nor Elijah, neither that prophet?
live.canon|john|1:23: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of Yahuah (Lord), as said the prophet Isaiah.
live.canon|john|1:9: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that comes into the world.
live.canon|john|1:15: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that comes after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
live.canon|john|1:18: No man has seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.
live.canon|john|1:19: And this is the record of John, when the Yahudim (Jews) sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you?
live.canon|john|1:22: Then said they unto him, Who are you? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What say you of thyself?
live.canon|john|1:26: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there stands one among you, whom you know not;
live.canon|john|1:29: The next day John sees Yahusha (Jesus) coming unto him, and says, Behold the Lamb of Elohim (God), which takes away the sin of the world.
live.canon|john|1:30: This is he of whom I said, After me comes a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
live.canon|john|1:33: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom you shall see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
live.canon|john|1:36: And looking upon Yahusha (Jesus) as he walked, he says, Behold the Lamb of Elohim (God)!
live.canon|john|1:38: Then Yahusha (Jesus) turned, and saw them following, and says unto them, What seek you? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwell you?
live.canon|john|1:39: He says unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
live.canon|john|1:41: He first finds his own brother Simon, and says unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|john|1:42: And he brought him to Yahusha (Jesus). And when Yahusha (Jesus) beheld him, he said, You are Simon the son of Jona: you shall be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
live.canon|john|1:43: The day following Yahusha (Jesus) would go forth into Galilee, and finds Philip, and says unto him, Follow me.
live.canon|john|1:45: Philip finds Nathanael, and says unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
live.canon|john|1:46: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip says unto him, Come and see.
live.canon|john|1:47: Yahusha (Jesus) saw Nathanael coming to him, and says of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
live.canon|john|1:48: Nathanael says unto him, Whence know you me? Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.
live.canon|john|1:49: Nathanael answered and says unto him, Rabbi, you are the Son of Elohim (God); you are the King of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|john|1:21: And they asked him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he says, I am not. Are you that prophet? And he answered, No.
live.canon|john|1:50: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Because I said unto you, I saw you under the fig tree, believe you? you shall see greater things than these.
live.canon|john|1:51: And he says unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter you shall see heaven open, and the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending upon the Son of Adam.
live.canon|john|1:1: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|1:2: The same was in the beginning with Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|1:3: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
live.canon|john|1:4: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
live.canon|john|1:5: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
live.canon|john|1:6: There was a man sent from Elohim (God), whose name was John.
live.canon|john|1:7: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
live.canon|john|1:8: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
live.canon|john|1:10: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
live.canon|john|1:11: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
live.canon|john|1:12: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of Elohim (God), even to them that believe on his name:
live.canon|john|1:13: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|1:14: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
live.canon|john|1:16: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
live.canon|john|1:17: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
live.canon|john|1:20: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|john|1:24: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
live.canon|john|1:27: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
live.canon|john|1:28: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
live.canon|john|1:31: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Yashar'el (Israel), therefore am I come baptizing with water.
live.canon|john|1:32: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
live.canon|john|1:34: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|1:35: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
live.canon|john|1:37: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|john|1:40: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
live.canon|john|1:44: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
live.canon|john|2:3: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, They have no wine.
live.canon|john|2:4: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Woman, what have I to do with you? my hour is not yet come.
live.canon|john|2:5: His mother says unto the servants, Whatsoever he says unto you, do it.
live.canon|john|2:7: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
live.canon|john|2:8: And he says unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
live.canon|john|2:10: And says unto him, Every man at the beginning does set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but you have kept the good wine until now.
live.canon|john|2:17: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of your house has eaten me up.
live.canon|john|2:18: Then answered the Yahudim (Jews) and said unto him, What sign shewest you unto us, seeing that you do these things?
live.canon|john|2:20: Then said the Yahudim (Jews), Forty and six years was this temple in building, and will you rear it up in three days?
live.canon|john|2:1: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Yahusha (Jesus) was there:
live.canon|john|2:2: And both Yahusha (Jesus) was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
live.canon|john|2:6: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Yahudim (Jews), containing two or three firkins apiece.
live.canon|john|2:9: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
live.canon|john|2:11: This beginning of miracles did Yahusha (Jesus) in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
live.canon|john|2:12: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
live.canon|john|2:13: And the Yahudim's (Jews’) passover was at hand, and Yahusha (Jesus) went up to Jerusalem,
live.canon|john|2:14: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
live.canon|john|2:15: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;
live.canon|john|2:16: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.
live.canon|john|2:19: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
live.canon|john|2:21: But he spake of the temple of his body.
live.canon|john|2:22: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Yahusha (Jesus) had said.
live.canon|john|2:23: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
live.canon|john|2:24: But Yahusha (Jesus) did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
live.canon|john|2:25: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
live.canon|john|3:2: The same came to Yahusha (Jesus) by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from Elohim (God): for no man can do these miracles that you do, except Elohim (God) be with him.
live.canon|john|3:3: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|3:4: Nicodemus says unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
live.canon|john|3:5: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|3:7: Marvel not that I said unto you, You must be born again.
live.canon|john|3:8: The wind blows where it listeth, and you hear the sound thereof, but can not tell whence it comes, and whither it goes: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
live.canon|john|3:10: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Are you a master of Yashar'el (Israel), and know not these things?
live.canon|john|3:11: Verily, verily, I say unto you, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and you receive not our witness.
live.canon|john|3:12: If I have told you earthly things, and you believe not, how shall you believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
live.canon|john|3:13: And no man has ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of Adam which is in heaven.
live.canon|john|3:15: That whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
live.canon|john|3:16: For Elohim (God) so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
live.canon|john|3:18: He that believes on him is not condemned: but he that believes not is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|3:20: For every one that does evil hates the light, neither comes to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
live.canon|john|3:21: But he that does truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|3:26: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with you beyond Jordan, to whom you barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
live.canon|john|3:28: You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Messiah (Christ), but that I am sent before him.
live.canon|john|3:29: He that has the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
live.canon|john|3:31: He that comes from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaks of the earth: he that comes from heaven is above all.
live.canon|john|3:32: And what he has seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receives his testimony.
live.canon|john|3:33: He that has received his testimony has set to his seal that Elohim (God) is true.
live.canon|john|3:34: For he whom Elohim (God) has sent speaks the words of Elohim (God): for Elohim (God) gives not the Spirit by measure unto him.
live.canon|john|3:35: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
live.canon|john|3:36: He that believes on the Son has everlasting life: and he that believes not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of Elohim (God) abides on him.
live.canon|john|3:1: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Yahudim (Jews):
live.canon|john|3:6: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
live.canon|john|3:9: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
live.canon|john|3:14: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Adam be lifted up:
live.canon|john|3:17: For Elohim (God) sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
live.canon|john|3:19: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
live.canon|john|3:22: After these things came Yahusha (Jesus) and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
live.canon|john|3:23: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
live.canon|john|3:24: For John was not yet cast into prison.
live.canon|john|3:25: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Yahudim (Jews) about purifying.
live.canon|john|3:27: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
live.canon|john|3:30: He must increase, but I must decrease.
live.canon|john|4:5: Then comes he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
live.canon|john|4:7: There comes a woman of Samaria to draw water: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Give me to drink.
live.canon|john|4:9: Then says the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that you, being a Yahudi (Jew), ask drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Yahudim (Jews) have no dealings with the Samaritans.
live.canon|john|4:10: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, If you knew the gift of Elohim (God), and who it is that says to you, Give me to drink; you would have asked of him, and he would have given you living water.
live.canon|john|4:11: The woman says unto him, Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then have you that living water?
live.canon|john|4:12: Are you greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
live.canon|john|4:13: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinks of this water shall thirst again:
live.canon|john|4:14: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
live.canon|john|4:15: The woman says unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
live.canon|john|4:16: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Go, call your husband, and come hither.
live.canon|john|4:17: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Yahusha (Jesus) said unto her, You have well said, I have no husband:
live.canon|john|4:18: For you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband: in that saidst you truly.
live.canon|john|4:19: The woman says unto him, Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
live.canon|john|4:20: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and you say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
live.canon|john|4:21: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when you shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
live.canon|john|4:22: You worship you know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Yahudim (Jews).
live.canon|john|4:23: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeks such to worship him.
live.canon|john|4:25: The woman says unto him, I know that Messias comes, which is called Messiah (Christ): when he is come, he will tell us all things.
live.canon|john|4:28: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and says to the men,
live.canon|john|4:32: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that you know not of.
live.canon|john|4:33: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Has any man brought him ought to eat?
live.canon|john|4:34: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
live.canon|john|4:35: Say not you, There are yet four months, and then comes harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
live.canon|john|4:36: And he that reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit unto life eternal: that both he that sows and he that reaps may rejoice together.
live.canon|john|4:37: And herein is that saying true, One sows, and another reaps.
live.canon|john|4:38: I sent you to reap that whereon you bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and you are entered into their labours.
live.canon|john|4:42: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of your saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Messiah (Christ), the Saviour of the world.
live.canon|john|4:44: For Yahusha (Jesus) himself testified, that a prophet has no honour in his own country.
live.canon|john|4:48: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, Except you see signs and wonders, you will not believe.
live.canon|john|4:49: The nobleman says unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
live.canon|john|4:50: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Go your way; your son lives. And the man believed the word that Yahusha (Jesus) had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
live.canon|john|4:51: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Your son lives.
live.canon|john|4:53: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Your son lives: and himself believed, and his whole house.
live.canon|john|4:2: (Though Yahusha (Jesus) himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
live.canon|john|4:3: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.
live.canon|john|4:4: And he must needs go through Samaria.
live.canon|john|4:6: Now Jacob’s well was there. Yahusha (Jesus) therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
live.canon|john|4:8: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
live.canon|john|4:24: Elohim (God) is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
live.canon|john|4:29: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Messiah (Christ)?
live.canon|john|4:30: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
live.canon|john|4:31: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
live.canon|john|4:39: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
live.canon|john|4:40: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
live.canon|john|4:41: And many more believed because of his own word;
live.canon|john|4:43: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
live.canon|john|4:45: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
live.canon|john|4:46: So Yahusha (Jesus) came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
live.canon|john|4:47: When he heard that Yahusha (Jesus) was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
live.canon|john|4:52: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
live.canon|john|4:26: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, I that speak unto you am he.
live.canon|john|4:54: This is again the second miracle that Yahusha (Jesus) did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.
live.canon|john|4:27: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seek you? or, Why talkest you with her?
live.canon|john|4:1: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Yahusha (Jesus) made and baptized more disciples than John,
live.canon|john|5:6: When Yahusha (Jesus) saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he says unto him, Will you be made whole?
live.canon|john|5:8: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Rise, take up your bed, and walk.
live.canon|john|5:10: The Yahudim (Jews) therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for you to carry your bed.
live.canon|john|5:11: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up your bed, and walk.
live.canon|john|5:12: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto you, Take up your bed, and walk?
live.canon|john|5:14: Afterward Yahusha (Jesus) finds him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, you are made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto you.
live.canon|john|5:17: But Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, My Father works hitherto, and I work.
live.canon|john|5:19: Then answered Yahusha (Jesus) and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father do: for what things soever he does, these also does the Son likewise.
live.canon|john|5:20: For the Father loves the Son, and shows him all things that himself does: and he will shew him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
live.canon|john|5:22: For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment unto the Son:
live.canon|john|5:23: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which has sent him.
live.canon|john|5:24: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that hears my word, and believes on him that sent me, has everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
live.canon|john|5:26: For as the Father has life in himself; so has he given to the Son to have life in himself;
live.canon|john|5:27: And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.
live.canon|john|5:30: I can of my own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father which has sent me.
live.canon|john|5:32: There is another that bears witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
live.canon|john|5:33: You sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
live.canon|john|5:34: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that you might be saved.
live.canon|john|5:35: He was a burning and a shining light: and you were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
live.canon|john|5:36: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father has given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father has sent me.
live.canon|john|5:37: And the Father himself, which has sent me, has borne witness of me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
live.canon|john|5:38: And you have not his word abiding in you: for whom he has sent, him you believe not.
live.canon|john|5:39: Search the scriptures; for in them you think you have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
live.canon|john|5:40: And you will not come to me, that you might have life.
live.canon|john|5:42: But I know you, that you have not the love of Elohim (God) in you.
live.canon|john|5:43: I am come in my Father’s name, and you receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him you will receive.
live.canon|john|5:44: How can you believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that comes from Elohim (God) only?
live.canon|john|5:45: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom you trust.
live.canon|john|5:46: For had you believed Moses, you would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
live.canon|john|5:47: But if you believe not his writings, how shall you believe my words?
live.canon|john|5:1: After this there was a feast of the Yahudim (Jews); and Yahusha (Jesus) went up to Jerusalem.
live.canon|john|5:2: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
live.canon|john|5:3: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
live.canon|john|5:4: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
live.canon|john|5:5: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
live.canon|john|5:7: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
live.canon|john|5:9: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
live.canon|john|5:13: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Yahusha (Jesus) had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
live.canon|john|5:15: The man departed, and told the Yahudim (Jews) that it was Yahusha (Jesus), which had made him whole.
live.canon|john|5:16: And therefore did the Yahudim (Jews) persecute Yahusha (Jesus), and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
live.canon|john|5:18: Therefore the Yahudim (Jews) sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that Elohim (God) was his Father, making himself equal with Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|5:25: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of Elohim (God): and they that hear shall live.
live.canon|john|5:28: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
live.canon|john|5:29: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
live.canon|john|5:31: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
live.canon|john|5:41: I receive not honour from men.
live.canon|john|5:21: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickens them; even so the Son quickens whom he will.
live.canon|john|6:5: When Yahusha (Jesus) then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he says unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
live.canon|john|6:8: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, says unto him,
live.canon|john|6:9: There is a lad here, which has five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
live.canon|john|6:20: But he says unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
live.canon|john|6:39: And this is the Father’s will which has sent me, that of all which he has given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
live.canon|john|6:40: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which sees the Son, and believes on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
live.canon|john|6:42: And they said, Is not this Yahusha (Jesus), the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he says, I came down from heaven?
live.canon|john|6:44: No man can come to me, except the Father which has sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
live.canon|john|6:45: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of Elohim (God). Every man therefore that has heard, and has learned of the Father, comes unto me.
live.canon|john|6:46: Not that any man has seen the Father, save he which is of Elohim (God), he has seen the Father.
live.canon|john|6:47: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me has everlasting life.
live.canon|john|6:50: This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
live.canon|john|6:53: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except you eat the flesh of the Son of Adam, and drink his blood, you have no life in you.
live.canon|john|6:54: Whoso eats my flesh, and drinks my blood, has eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
live.canon|john|6:56: He that eats my flesh, and drinks my blood, dwells in me, and I in him.
live.canon|john|6:57: As the living Father has sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eats me, even he shall live by me.
live.canon|john|6:58: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eats of this bread shall live for ever.
live.canon|john|6:61: When Yahusha (Jesus) knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Does this offend you?
live.canon|john|6:62: What and if you shall see the Son of Adam ascend up where he was before?
live.canon|john|6:63: It is the spirit that quickens; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
live.canon|john|6:67: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto the twelve, Will you also go away?
live.canon|john|6:69: And we believe and are sure that you are that Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|6:1: After these things Yahusha (Jesus) went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
live.canon|john|6:2: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
live.canon|john|6:3: And Yahusha (Jesus) went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
live.canon|john|6:4: And the passover, a feast of the Yahudim (Jews), was nigh.
live.canon|john|6:6: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
live.canon|john|6:7: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
live.canon|john|6:10: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
live.canon|john|6:11: And Yahusha (Jesus) took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
live.canon|john|6:12: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
live.canon|john|6:13: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
live.canon|john|6:14: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Yahusha (Jesus) did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
live.canon|john|6:15: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
live.canon|john|6:16: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
live.canon|john|6:17: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Yahusha (Jesus) was not come to them.
live.canon|john|6:18: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
live.canon|john|6:19: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Yahusha (Jesus) walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
live.canon|john|6:21: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
live.canon|john|6:22: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Yahusha (Jesus) went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
live.canon|john|6:24: When the people therefore saw that Yahusha (Jesus) was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|john|6:28: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of Elohim (God)?
live.canon|john|6:31: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
live.canon|john|6:41: The Yahudim (Jews) then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
live.canon|john|6:43: Yahusha (Jesus) therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
live.canon|john|6:48: I am that bread of life.
live.canon|john|6:49: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
live.canon|john|6:51: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
live.canon|john|6:52: The Yahudim (Jews) therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
live.canon|john|6:55: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
live.canon|john|6:59: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
live.canon|john|6:60: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
live.canon|john|6:25: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when came you hither?
live.canon|john|6:26: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, You seek me, not because you saw the miracles, but because you did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
live.canon|john|6:27: Labour not for the meat which perishes, but for that meat which endures unto everlasting life, which the Son of Adam shall give unto you: for him has Elohim (God) the Father sealed.
live.canon|john|6:29: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, This is the work of Elohim (God), that you believe on him whom he has sent.
live.canon|john|6:30: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest you then, that we may see, and believe you? what do you work?
live.canon|john|6:32: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
live.canon|john|6:33: For the bread of Elohim (God) is he which comes down from heaven, and gives life unto the world.
live.canon|john|6:35: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that comes to me shall never hunger; and he that believes on me shall never thirst.
live.canon|john|6:36: But I said unto you, That you also have seen me, and believe not.
live.canon|john|6:37: All that the Father gives me shall come to me; and him that comes to me I will in no wise cast out.
live.canon|john|6:38: For I came down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him that sent me.
live.canon|john|6:64: But there are some of you that believe not. For Yahusha (Jesus) knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
live.canon|john|6:65: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
live.canon|john|6:66: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
live.canon|john|6:70: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
live.canon|john|6:71: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
live.canon|john|6:34: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
live.canon|john|6:68: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? you have the words of eternal life.
live.canon|john|6:23: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
live.canon|john|7:3: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that your disciples also may see the works that you do.
live.canon|john|7:4: For there is no man that does any thing in secret, and he himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, shew thyself to the world.
live.canon|john|7:7: The world cannot hate you; but me it hates, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
live.canon|john|7:8: Go you up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
live.canon|john|7:15: And the Yahudim (Jews) marvelled, saying, How knows this man letters, having never learned?
live.canon|john|7:18: He that speaks of himself seeks his own glory: but he that seeks his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
live.canon|john|7:19: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why go you about to kill me?
live.canon|john|7:20: The people answered and said, You have a devil: who goes about to kill you?
live.canon|john|7:21: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and you all marvel.
live.canon|john|7:22: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and you on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
live.canon|john|7:23: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are you angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
live.canon|john|7:26: But, lo, he speaks boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Messiah (Christ)?
live.canon|john|7:27: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Messiah (Christ) comes, no man knows whence he is.
live.canon|john|7:28: Then cried Yahusha (Jesus) in the temple as he taught, saying, You both know me, and you know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom you know not.
live.canon|john|7:29: But I know him: for I am from him, and he has sent me.
live.canon|john|7:31: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Messiah (Christ) comes, will he do more miracles than these which this man has done?
live.canon|john|7:34: You shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come.
live.canon|john|7:36: What manner of saying is this that he said, You shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come?
live.canon|john|7:38: He that believes on me, as the scripture has said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
live.canon|john|7:42: Has not the scripture said, That Messiah (Christ) comes of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
live.canon|john|7:45: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have you not brought him?
live.canon|john|7:47: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are you also deceived?
live.canon|john|7:49: But this people who knows not the law are cursed.
live.canon|john|7:50: Nicodemus says unto them, (he that came to Yahusha (Jesus) by night, being one of them,)
live.canon|john|7:51: Does our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he does?
live.canon|john|7:52: They answered and said unto him, Are you also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee arises no prophet.
live.canon|john|7:1: After these things Yahusha (Jesus) walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Yahudim (Jews) sought to kill him.
live.canon|john|7:2: Now the Yahudim's (Jews’) feast of tabernacles was at hand.
live.canon|john|7:5: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
live.canon|john|7:6: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
live.canon|john|7:9: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
live.canon|john|7:10: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
live.canon|john|7:11: Then the Yahudim (Jews) sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
live.canon|john|7:12: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
live.canon|john|7:13: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Yahudim (Jews).
live.canon|john|7:14: Now about the midst of the feast Yahusha (Jesus) went up into the temple, and taught.
live.canon|john|7:16: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
live.canon|john|7:17: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of Elohim (God), or whether I speak of myself.
live.canon|john|7:24: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
live.canon|john|7:25: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
live.canon|john|7:30: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
live.canon|john|7:32: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
live.canon|john|7:33: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
live.canon|john|7:35: Then said the Yahudim (Jews) among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
live.canon|john|7:37: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
live.canon|john|7:39: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) was not yet given; because that Yahusha (Jesus) was not yet glorified.)
live.canon|john|7:40: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
live.canon|john|7:41: Others said, This is the Messiah (Christ). But some said, Shall Messiah (Christ) come out of Galilee?
live.canon|john|7:43: So there was a division among the people because of him.
live.canon|john|7:44: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
live.canon|john|7:46: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
live.canon|john|7:48: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
live.canon|john|7:53: And every man went unto his own house.
live.canon|john|8:5: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what say you?
live.canon|john|8:10: When Yahusha (Jesus) had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those your accusers? has no man condemned you?
live.canon|john|8:12: Then spake Yahusha (Jesus) again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that follows me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
live.canon|john|8:13: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, You bear record of thyself; your record is not true.
live.canon|john|8:14: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but you cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
live.canon|john|8:15: You judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
live.canon|john|8:18: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me bears witness of me.
live.canon|john|8:19: Then said they unto him, Where is your Father? Yahusha (Jesus) answered, You neither know me, nor my Father: if you had known me, you should have known my Father also.
live.canon|john|8:21: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) again unto them, I go my way, and you shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, you cannot come.
live.canon|john|8:22: Then said the Yahudim (Jews), Will he kill himself? because he says, Whither I go, you cannot come.
live.canon|john|8:23: And he said unto them, You are from beneath; I am from above: you are of this world; I am not of this world.
live.canon|john|8:24: I said therefore unto you, that you shall die in your sins: for if you believe not that I am he, you shall die in your sins.
live.canon|john|8:25: Then said they unto him, Who are you? And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
live.canon|john|8:28: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, When you have lifted up the Son of Adam, then shall you know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father has taught me, I speak these things.
live.canon|john|8:29: And he that sent me is with me: the Father has not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
live.canon|john|8:31: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) to those Yahudim (Jews) which believed on him, If you continue in my word, then are you my disciples indeed;
live.canon|john|8:32: And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
live.canon|john|8:33: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how say you, You shall be made free?
live.canon|john|8:34: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever commits sin is the servant of sin.
live.canon|john|8:35: And the servant abides not in the house for ever: but the Son abides ever.
live.canon|john|8:36: If the Son therefore shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.
live.canon|john|8:37: I know that you are Abraham’s seed; but you seek to kill me, because my word has no place in you.
live.canon|john|8:38: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and you do that which you have seen with your father.
live.canon|john|8:39: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
live.canon|john|8:40: But now you seek to kill me, a man that has told you the truth, which I have heard of Elohim (God): this did not Abraham.
live.canon|john|8:41: You do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|8:42: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, If Elohim (God) were your Father, you would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from Elohim (God); neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
live.canon|john|8:43: Why do you not understand my speech? even because you cannot hear my word.
live.canon|john|8:44: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
live.canon|john|8:45: And because I tell you the truth, you believe me not.
live.canon|john|8:46: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do you not believe me?
live.canon|john|8:47: He that is of Elohim (God) hears Elohim's (God’s) words: you therefore hear them not, because you are not of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|8:48: Then answered the Yahudim (Jews), and said unto him, Say we not well that you are a Samaritan, and have a devil?
live.canon|john|8:49: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and you do dishonour me.

live.canon|john|12:17: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
live.canon|john|12:18: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
live.canon|john|12:20: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
live.canon|john|12:21: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|john|12:23: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of Adam should be glorified.
live.canon|john|12:26: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
live.canon|john|12:27: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
live.canon|john|12:29: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
live.canon|john|12:30: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
live.canon|john|12:31: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
live.canon|john|12:32: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
live.canon|john|12:33: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
live.canon|john|12:37: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
live.canon|john|12:42: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
live.canon|john|12:43: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|12:47: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
live.canon|john|12:49: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
live.canon|john|12:50: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
live.canon|john|12:45: And he that sees me sees him that sent me.
live.canon|john|12:46: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believes on me should not abide in darkness.
live.canon|john|12:48: He that rejecteth me, and receives not my words, has one that judges him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
live.canon|john|12:39: Therefore they could not believe, because that Isaiah said again,
live.canon|john|13:10: Yahusha (Jesus) says to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and you are clean, but not all.
live.canon|john|13:12: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know you what I have done to you?
live.canon|john|13:14: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
live.canon|john|13:15: For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.
live.canon|john|13:17: If you know these things, happy are you if you do them.
live.canon|john|13:18: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.
live.canon|john|13:19: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, you may believe that I am he.
live.canon|john|13:20: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receives whomsoever I send receives me; and he that receives me receives him that sent me.
live.canon|john|13:27: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, That you do, do quickly.
live.canon|john|13:33: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You shall seek me: and as I said unto the Yahudim (Jews), Whither I go, you cannot come; so now I say to you.
live.canon|john|13:34: A new commandment I give unto you, That you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
live.canon|john|13:35: By this shall all men know that you are my disciples, if you have love one to another.
live.canon|john|13:38: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Will you lay down your life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto you, The cock shall not crow, till you have denied me thrice.
live.canon|john|13:1: Now before the feast of the passover, when Yahusha (Jesus) knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
live.canon|john|13:2: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;
live.canon|john|13:3: Yahusha (Jesus) knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from Elohim (God), and went to Elohim (God);
live.canon|john|13:4: He rises from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
live.canon|john|13:5: After that he pours water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
live.canon|john|13:16: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
live.canon|john|13:21: When Yahusha (Jesus) had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
live.canon|john|13:22: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
live.canon|john|13:23: Now there was leaning on Yahusha's (Jesus’) bosom one of his disciples, whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved.
live.canon|john|13:24: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
live.canon|john|13:26: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
live.canon|john|13:28: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
live.canon|john|13:29: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Yahusha (Jesus) had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
live.canon|john|13:30: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
live.canon|john|13:31: Therefore, when he was gone out, Yahusha (Jesus) said, Now is the Son of Adam glorified, and Elohim (God) is glorified in him.
live.canon|john|13:32: If Elohim (God) be glorified in him, Elohim (God) shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
live.canon|john|13:7: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, What I do you know not now; but you shall know hereafter.
live.canon|john|13:8: Peter says unto him, You shall never wash my feet. Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, If I wash you not, you have no part with me.
live.canon|john|13:11: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, You are not all clean.
live.canon|john|13:37: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for your sake.
live.canon|john|13:13: You call me Master and the Lord: and you say well; for so I am.
live.canon|john|13:25: He then lying on Yahusha's (Jesus’) breast says unto him, Lord, who is it?
live.canon|john|13:6: Then comes he to Simon Peter: and Peter says unto him, Lord, do you wash my feet?
live.canon|john|13:9: Simon Peter says unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
live.canon|john|13:36: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither go you? Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Whither I go, you can not follow me now; but you shall follow me afterwards.
live.canon|john|14:1: Let not your heart be troubled: you believe in Elohim (God), believe also in me.
live.canon|john|14:3: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there you may be also.
live.canon|john|14:4: And whither I go you know, and the way you know.
live.canon|john|14:6: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man comes unto the Father, but by me.
live.canon|john|14:7: If you had known me, you should have known my Father also: and from henceforth you know him, and have seen him.
live.canon|john|14:9: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet have you not known me, Philip? he that has seen me has seen the Father; and how say you then, Shew us the Father?
live.canon|john|14:10: Believe you not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwells in me, he does the works.
live.canon|john|14:12: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
live.canon|john|14:13: And whatsoever you shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
live.canon|john|14:14: If you shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
live.canon|john|14:15: If you love me, keep my commandments.
live.canon|john|14:17: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it sees him not, neither knows him: but you know him; for he dwells with you, and shall be in you.
live.canon|john|14:19: Yet a little while, and the world sees me no more; but you see me: because I live, you shall live also.
live.canon|john|14:20: At that day you shall know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
live.canon|john|14:21: He that has my commandments, and keeps them, he it is that loves me: and he that loves me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
live.canon|john|14:24: He that loves me not keeps not my sayings: and the word which you hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
live.canon|john|14:27: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world gives, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
live.canon|john|14:28: You have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If you loved me, you would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
live.canon|john|14:29: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, you might believe.
live.canon|john|14:30: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world comes, and has nothing in me.
live.canon|john|14:2: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
live.canon|john|14:11: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
live.canon|john|14:16: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
live.canon|john|14:18: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
live.canon|john|14:23: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
live.canon|john|14:25: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
live.canon|john|14:26: But the Comforter, which is the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
live.canon|john|14:31: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
live.canon|john|14:5: Thomas says unto him, Lord, we know not whither you go; and how can we know the way?
live.canon|john|14:8: Philip says unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
live.canon|john|14:22: Judas says unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that you will manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
live.canon|john|15:2: Every branch in me that bears not fruit he takes away: and every branch that bears fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
live.canon|john|15:3: Now you are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
live.canon|john|15:4: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can you, except you abide in me.
live.canon|john|15:5: I am the vine, you are the branches: He that abides in me, and I in him, the same brings forth much fruit: for without me you can do nothing.
live.canon|john|15:7: If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, you shall ask what you will, and it shall be done unto you.
live.canon|john|15:8: Herein is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; so shall you be my disciples.
live.canon|john|15:9: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you: continue you in my love.
live.canon|john|15:10: If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
live.canon|john|15:12: This is my commandment, That you love one another, as I have loved you.
live.canon|john|15:13: Greater love has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
live.canon|john|15:14: You are my friends, if you do whatsoever I command you.
live.canon|john|15:15: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knows not what his lord does: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
live.canon|john|15:16: You have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that you should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever you shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
live.canon|john|15:17: These things I command you, that you love one another.
live.canon|john|15:18: If the world hate you, you know that it hated me before it hated you.
live.canon|john|15:19: If you were of the world, the world would love his own: but because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
live.canon|john|15:23: He that hates me hates my Father also.
live.canon|john|15:25: But this comes to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
live.canon|john|15:26: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceeds from the Father, he shall testify of me:
live.canon|john|15:27: And you also shall bear witness, because you have been with me from the beginning.
live.canon|john|15:1: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
live.canon|john|15:6: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
live.canon|john|15:11: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
live.canon|john|15:20: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
live.canon|john|15:21: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
live.canon|john|15:22: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
live.canon|john|15:24: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
live.canon|john|16:1: These things have I spoken unto you, that you should not be offended.
live.canon|john|16:2: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time comes, that whosoever kills you will think that he does Elohim (God) service.
live.canon|john|16:4: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
live.canon|john|16:5: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asks me, Whither go you?
live.canon|john|16:6: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow has filled your heart.
live.canon|john|16:10: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and you see me no more;
live.canon|john|16:12: I have yet many things to say unto you, but you cannot bear them now.
live.canon|john|16:15: All things that the Father has are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
live.canon|john|16:16: A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me, because I go to the Father.
live.canon|john|16:17: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he says unto us, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
live.canon|john|16:18: They said therefore, What is this that he says, A little while? we cannot tell what he says.
live.canon|john|16:19: Now Yahusha (Jesus) knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do you enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me?
live.canon|john|16:20: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That you shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
live.canon|john|16:21: A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
live.canon|john|16:22: And you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man takes from you.
live.canon|john|16:23: And in that day you shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever you shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
live.canon|john|16:24: Hitherto have you asked nothing in my name: ask, and you shall receive, that your joy may be full.
live.canon|john|16:25: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time comes, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
live.canon|john|16:26: At that day you shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
live.canon|john|16:27: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came out from Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|16:29: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speak you plainly, and speak no proverb.
live.canon|john|16:30: Now are we sure that you know all things, and needest not that any man should ask you: by this we believe that you came forth from Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|16:31: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Do you now believe?
live.canon|john|16:32: Behold, the hour comes, yea, is now come, that you shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
live.canon|john|16:33: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me you might have peace. In the world you shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
live.canon|john|16:3: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
live.canon|john|16:7: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
live.canon|john|16:8: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
live.canon|john|16:9: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
live.canon|john|16:11: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
live.canon|john|16:13: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
live.canon|john|16:14: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
live.canon|john|16:28: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
live.canon|john|17:1: These words spake Yahusha (Jesus), and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify your Son, that your Son also may glorify you:
live.canon|john|17:6: I have manifested your name unto the men which you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them me; and they have kept your word.
live.canon|john|17:7: Now they have known that all things whatsoever you have given me are of you.
live.canon|john|17:8: For I have given unto them the words which you gave me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from you, and they have believed that you did send me.
live.canon|john|17:9: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which you have given me; for they are yours.
live.canon|john|17:10: And all my are yours, and yours are mine; and I am glorified in them.
live.canon|john|17:11: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep through your own name those whom you have given me, that they may be one, as we are.
live.canon|john|17:12: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those that you gave me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
live.canon|john|17:13: And now come I to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
live.canon|john|17:14: I have given them your word; and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
live.canon|john|17:15: I pray not that you should take them out of the world, but that you should keep them from the evil.
live.canon|john|17:18: As you have sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
live.canon|john|17:21: That they all may be one; as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that you have sent me.
live.canon|john|17:22: And the glory which you gave me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
live.canon|john|17:23: I in them, and you in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that you have sent me, and have loved them, as you have loved me.
live.canon|john|17:24: Father, I will that they also, whom you have given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which you have given me: for you lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
live.canon|john|17:25: O righteous Father, the world has not known you: but I have known you, and these have known that you have sent me.
live.canon|john|17:26: And I have declared unto them your name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith you have loved me may be in them, and I in them.
live.canon|john|17:16: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
live.canon|john|17:2: As you have given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as you have given him.
live.canon|john|17:3: And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true Elohim (God), and Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), whom you have sent.
live.canon|john|17:4: I have glorified you on the earth: I have finished the work which you gave me to do.
live.canon|john|17:19: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
live.canon|john|17:20: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
live.canon|john|17:5: And now, O Father, glorify you me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world was.
live.canon|john|17:17: Sanctify them through your truth: your word is truth.
live.canon|john|18:19: The high priest then asked Yahusha (Jesus) of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
live.canon|john|18:20: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Yahudim (Jews) always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
live.canon|john|18:24: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
live.canon|john|18:21: Why ask you me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
live.canon|john|18:22: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Yahusha (Jesus) with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest you the high priest so?
live.canon|john|18:23: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest you me?
live.canon|john|18:25: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Are not you also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
live.canon|john|18:26: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with him?
live.canon|john|18:27: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
live.canon|john|18:28: Then led they Yahusha (Jesus) from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
live.canon|john|18:32: That the saying of Yahusha (Jesus) might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
live.canon|john|18:36: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Yahudim (Jews): but now is my kingdom not from hence.
live.canon|john|18:40: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
live.canon|john|18:29: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring you against this man?
live.canon|john|18:30: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto you.
live.canon|john|18:3: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, comes thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
live.canon|john|18:4: Yahusha (Jesus) therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek you?
live.canon|john|18:5: They answered him, Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
live.canon|john|18:7: Then asked he them again, Whom seek you? And they said, Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth.
live.canon|john|18:8: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore you seek me, let these go their way:
live.canon|john|18:9: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which you gave me have I lost none.
live.canon|john|18:11: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?
live.canon|john|18:17: Then says the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Are not you also one of this man’s disciples? He says, I am not.
