live.canon|john|18:31: Then said Pilate unto them, Take you him, and judge him according to your law. The Yahudim (Jews) therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
live.canon|john|18:33: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Yahusha (Jesus), and said unto him, Are you the King of the Yahudim (Jews)?
live.canon|john|18:34: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Say you this thing of thyself, or did others tell it you of me?
live.canon|john|18:35: Pilate answered, Am I a Yahudi (Jew)? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you unto me: what have you done?
live.canon|john|18:37: Pilate therefore said unto him, Are you a king then? Yahusha (Jesus) answered, You say that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth hears my voice.
live.canon|john|18:38: Pilate says unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Yahudim (Jews), and says unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
live.canon|john|18:39: But you have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will you therefore that I release unto you the King of the Yahudim (Jews)?
live.canon|john|18:1: When Yahusha (Jesus) had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
live.canon|john|18:2: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Yahusha (Jesus) ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
live.canon|john|18:6: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
live.canon|john|18:10: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
live.canon|john|18:12: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Yahudim (Jews) took Yahusha (Jesus), and bound him,
live.canon|john|18:13: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
live.canon|john|18:14: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Yahudim (Jews), that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
live.canon|john|18:15: And Simon Peter followed Yahusha (Jesus), and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Yahusha (Jesus) into the palace of the high priest.
live.canon|john|18:16: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
live.canon|john|18:18: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
live.canon|john|19:1: Then Pilate therefore took Yahusha (Jesus), and scourged him.
live.canon|john|19:2: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
live.canon|john|19:3: And said, Hail, King of the Yahudim (Jews)! and they smote him with their hands.
live.canon|john|19:7: The Yahudim (Jews) answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|john|19:8: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
live.canon|john|19:13: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Yahusha (Jesus) forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
live.canon|john|19:16: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Yahusha (Jesus), and led him away.
live.canon|john|19:17: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
live.canon|john|19:18: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Yahusha (Jesus) in the midst.
live.canon|john|19:19: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, Yahusha (JESUS) OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
live.canon|john|19:20: This title then read many of the Yahudim (Jews): for the place where Yahusha (Jesus) was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
live.canon|john|19:21: Then said the chief priests of the Yahudim (Jews) to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Yahudim (Jews); but that he said, I am King of the Yahudim (Jews).
live.canon|john|19:22: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
live.canon|john|19:23: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Yahusha (Jesus), took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
live.canon|john|19:25: Now there stood by the cross of Yahusha (Jesus) his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
live.canon|john|19:29: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
live.canon|john|19:30: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
live.canon|john|19:31: The Yahudim (Jews) therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
live.canon|john|19:24: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which says, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
live.canon|john|19:26: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he says unto his mother, Woman, behold your son!
live.canon|john|19:27: Then says he to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
live.canon|john|19:28: After this, Yahusha (Jesus) knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst.
live.canon|john|19:32: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
live.canon|john|19:33: But when they came to Yahusha (Jesus), and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
live.canon|john|19:34: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
live.canon|john|19:36: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
live.canon|john|19:38: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Yahusha (Jesus), but secretly for fear of the Yahudim (Jews), besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Yahusha (Jesus): and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|john|19:39: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Yahusha (Jesus) by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
live.canon|john|19:40: Then took they the body of Yahusha (Jesus), and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Yahudim (Jews) is to bury.
live.canon|john|19:41: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
live.canon|john|19:42: There laid they Yahusha (Jesus) therefore because of the Yahudim's (Jews’) preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
live.canon|john|19:35: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knows that he says true, that you might believe.
live.canon|john|19:37: And again another scripture says, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
live.canon|john|19:4: Pilate therefore went forth again, and says unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that you may know that I find no fault in him.
live.canon|john|19:5: Then came Yahusha (Jesus) forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate says unto them, Behold the man!
live.canon|john|19:6: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Take you him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
live.canon|john|19:9: And went again into the judgment hall, and says unto Yahusha (Jesus), Whence are you? But Yahusha (Jesus) gave him no answer.
live.canon|john|19:10: Then says Pilate unto him, Speak you not unto me? know you not that I have power to crucify you, and have power to release you?
live.canon|john|19:11: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, You could have no power at all against me, except it were given you from above: therefore he that delivered me unto you has the greater sin.
live.canon|john|19:12: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Yahudim (Jews) cried out, saying, If you let this man go, you are not Cæsar’s friend: whosoever makes himself a king speaks against Cæsar.
live.canon|john|19:14: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he says unto the Yahudim (Jews), Behold your King!
live.canon|john|19:15: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
live.canon|john|21:1: After these things Yahusha (Jesus) shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
live.canon|john|21:2: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
live.canon|john|21:4: But when the morning was now come, Yahusha (Jesus) stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|john|21:8: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
live.canon|john|21:9: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
live.canon|john|21:11: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
live.canon|john|21:14: This is now the third time that Yahusha (Jesus) shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
live.canon|john|21:24: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
live.canon|john|21:25: And there are also many other things which Yahusha (Jesus) did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
live.canon|john|21:15: So when they had dined, Yahusha (Jesus) says to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonah, love you me more than these? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my lambs.
live.canon|john|21:17: He says unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonah, love you me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Love you me? And he said unto him, Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Feed my sheep.
live.canon|john|21:16: He says to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonah, love you me? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my sheep.
live.canon|john|21:3: Simon Peter says unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with you. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
live.canon|john|21:5: Then Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Children, have you any meat? They answered him, No.
live.canon|john|21:6: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and you shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
live.canon|john|21:10: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Bring of the fish which you have now caught.
live.canon|john|21:13: Yahusha (Jesus) then comes, and takes bread, and gives them, and fish likewise.
live.canon|john|21:18: Verily, verily, I say unto you, When you were young, you girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither you would: but when you shall be old, you shall stretch forth your hands, and another shall gird you, and carry you whither you would not.
live.canon|john|21:19: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify Elohim (God). And when he had spoken this, he says unto him, Follow me.
live.canon|john|21:22: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you? follow you me.
live.canon|john|21:23: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Yahusha (Jesus) said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you?
live.canon|john|21:7: Therefore that disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved says unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
live.canon|john|21:12: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord.
live.canon|john|21:20: Then Peter, turning about, sees the disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth you?
live.canon|john|21:21: Peter seeing him says to Yahusha (Jesus), Lord, and what shall this man do?
live.canon|joshua|1:2: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, you, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|1:5: There shall not any man be able to stand before you all the days of your life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with you: I will not fail you, nor forsake you.
live.canon|joshua|1:6: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shall you divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.
live.canon|joshua|1:7: Only be you strong and very courageous, that you may observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded you: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may prosper whithersoever you go.
live.canon|joshua|1:8: This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth; but you shall meditate therein day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
live.canon|joshua|1:9: Have not I commanded you? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be you dismayed: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is with you whithersoever you go.
live.canon|joshua|1:11: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days you shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) gives you to possess it.
live.canon|joshua|1:13: Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded you, saying, Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has given you rest, and has given you this land.
live.canon|joshua|1:14: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but you shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;
live.canon|joshua|1:15: Until Yahuah (LORD) have given your brethren rest, as he has given you, and they also have possessed the land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) gives them: then you shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
live.canon|joshua|1:16: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that you commandest us we will do, and whithersoever you send us, we will go.
live.canon|joshua|1:17: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto you: only Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) be with you, as he was with Moses.
live.canon|joshua|1:18: Whosoever he be that does rebel against your commandment, and will not hearken unto your words in all that you commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
live.canon|joshua|1:1: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,
live.canon|joshua|1:3: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
live.canon|joshua|1:4: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
live.canon|joshua|1:10: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
live.canon|joshua|1:12: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
live.canon|joshua|2:3: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to you, which are entered into your house: for they be come to search out all the country.
live.canon|joshua|2:5: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for you shall overtake them.
live.canon|joshua|2:10: For we have heard how Yahuah (LORD) dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
live.canon|joshua|2:12: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by Yahuah (LORD), since I have shewed you kindness, that you will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:
live.canon|joshua|2:13: And that you will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
live.canon|joshua|2:14: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if you utter not this our business. And it shall be, when Yahuah (LORD) has given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.
live.canon|joshua|2:16: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may you go your way.
live.canon|joshua|2:17: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this your oath which you have made us swear.
live.canon|joshua|2:18: Behold, when we come into the land, you shall bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which you did let us down by: and you shall bring your father, and your mother, and your brethren, and all your father’s household, home unto you.
live.canon|joshua|2:19: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.
live.canon|joshua|2:20: And if you utter this our business, then we will be quit of your oath which you have made us to swear.
live.canon|joshua|2:24: And they said unto Joshua, Truly Yahuah (LORD) has delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
live.canon|joshua|2:1: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
live.canon|joshua|2:2: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to search out the country.
live.canon|joshua|2:4: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:
live.canon|joshua|2:6: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
live.canon|joshua|2:7: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
live.canon|joshua|2:8: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
live.canon|joshua|2:11: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
live.canon|joshua|2:15: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
live.canon|joshua|2:21: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
live.canon|joshua|2:22: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.
live.canon|joshua|2:23: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:
live.canon|joshua|2:9: And she said unto the men, I know that Yahuah (LORD) has given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.
live.canon|joshua|3:3: And they commanded the people, saying, When you see the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and the priests the Levites bearing it, then you shall remove from your place, and go after it.
live.canon|joshua|3:4: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that you may know the way by which you must go: for you have not passed this way heretofore.
live.canon|joshua|3:7: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify you in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel), that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
live.canon|joshua|3:8: And you shall command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When you are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, you shall stand still in Jordan.
live.canon|joshua|3:10: And Joshua said, Hereby you shall know that the living Elohim (God) is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
live.canon|joshua|3:1: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and lodged there before they passed over.
live.canon|joshua|3:2: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;
live.canon|joshua|3:5: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow Yahuah (LORD) will do wonders among you.
live.canon|joshua|3:6: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
live.canon|joshua|3:9: And Joshua said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Come hither, and hear the words of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|joshua|3:12: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), out of every tribe a man.
live.canon|joshua|3:14: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
live.canon|joshua|3:15: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)
live.canon|joshua|3:16: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
live.canon|joshua|3:17: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.
live.canon|joshua|3:11: Behold, the ark of the covenant of Adonai (Lord) of all the earth passes over before you into Jordan.
live.canon|joshua|3:13: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of Yahuah (LORD), Adonai (Lord) of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.
live.canon|joshua|4:3: And command you them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and you shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where you shall lodge this night.
live.canon|joshua|4:5: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|joshua|4:6: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean you by these stones?
live.canon|joshua|4:7: Then you shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD); when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for ever.
live.canon|joshua|4:17: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come you up out of Jordan.
live.canon|joshua|4:22: Then you shall let your children know, saying, Yashar'el (Israel) came over this Jordan on dry land.
live.canon|joshua|4:23: For Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until you were passed over, as Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
live.canon|joshua|4:24: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of Yahuah (LORD), that it is mighty: that you might fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) for ever.
live.canon|joshua|4:1: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua, saying,
live.canon|joshua|4:2: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
live.canon|joshua|4:4: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), out of every tribe a man:
live.canon|joshua|4:8: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
live.canon|joshua|4:9: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|4:10: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
live.canon|joshua|4:11: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of Yahuah (LORD) passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
live.canon|joshua|4:12: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), as Moses spake unto them:
live.canon|joshua|4:13: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before Yahuah (LORD) unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
live.canon|joshua|4:14: On that day Yahuah (LORD) magnified Joshua in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel); and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
live.canon|joshua|4:15: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua, saying,
live.canon|joshua|4:16: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
live.canon|joshua|4:18: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.
live.canon|joshua|4:19: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
live.canon|joshua|4:20: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
live.canon|joshua|4:21: And he spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
live.canon|joshua|5:6: For the children of Yashar'el (Israel) walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah (LORD): unto whom Yahuah (LORD) sware that he would not shew them the land, which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that flows with milk and honey.
live.canon|joshua|5:13: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Are you for us, or for our adversaries?
live.canon|joshua|5:14: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of Yahuah (LORD) am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What says my lord unto his servant?
live.canon|joshua|5:1: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that Yahuah (LORD) had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|5:3: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Yashar'el (Israel) at the hill of the foreskins.
live.canon|joshua|5:4: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.
live.canon|joshua|5:5: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.
live.canon|joshua|5:7: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.
live.canon|joshua|5:8: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
live.canon|joshua|5:9: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|5:10: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.
live.canon|joshua|5:11: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
live.canon|joshua|5:12: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Yashar'el (Israel) manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
live.canon|joshua|5:2: At that time Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Make you sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Yashar'el (Israel) the second time.
live.canon|joshua|5:15: And the captain of the LORD’S host said unto Joshua, Loose your shoe from off your foot; for the place whereon you stand is holy. And Joshua did so.
live.canon|joshua|6:2: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, See, I have given into your hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.
live.canon|joshua|6:3: And you shall compass the city, all you men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shall you do six days.
live.canon|joshua|6:4: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day you shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.
live.canon|joshua|6:5: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
live.canon|joshua|6:10: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, You shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall you shout.
live.canon|joshua|6:16: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for Yahuah (LORD) has given you the city.
live.canon|joshua|6:18: And you, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest you make yourselves accursed, when you take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Yashar'el (Israel) a curse, and trouble it.
live.canon|joshua|6:22: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she has, as you sware unto her.
live.canon|joshua|6:25: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwells in Yashar'el (Israel) even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
live.canon|joshua|6:26: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before Yahuah (LORD), that rises up and builds this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
live.canon|joshua|6:1: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): none went out, and none came in.
live.canon|joshua|6:6: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|6:7: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|6:8: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before Yahuah (LORD), and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) followed them.
live.canon|joshua|6:9: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
live.canon|joshua|6:11: So the ark of Yahuah (LORD) compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
live.canon|joshua|6:12: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|6:13: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of Yahuah (LORD) went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of Yahuah (LORD), the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
live.canon|joshua|6:14: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
live.canon|joshua|6:15: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.
live.canon|joshua|6:17: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to Yahuah (LORD): only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
live.canon|joshua|6:19: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto Yahuah (LORD): they shall come into the treasury of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|6:20: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
live.canon|joshua|6:21: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.
live.canon|joshua|6:23: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|6:24: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|6:27: So Yahuah (LORD) was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.
live.canon|joshua|7:9: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what will you do unto your great name?
live.canon|joshua|7:10: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Get you up; wherefore lie you thus upon your face?
live.canon|joshua|7:11: Yashar'el (Israel) has sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.
live.canon|joshua|7:12: Therefore the children of Yashar'el (Israel) could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except you destroy the accursed from among you.
live.canon|joshua|7:13: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), There is an accursed thing in the midst of you, O Yashar'el (Israel): you can not stand before your enemies, until you take away the accursed thing from among you.
live.canon|joshua|7:14: In the morning therefore you shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which Yahuah (LORD) takes shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which Yahuah (LORD) shall take shall come by households; and the household which Yahuah (LORD) shall take shall come man by man.
live.canon|joshua|7:15: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he has: because he has transgressed the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and because he has wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|7:19: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray you, glory to Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and make confession unto him; and tell me now what you have done; hide it not from me.
live.canon|joshua|7:25: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? Yahuah (LORD) shall trouble you this day. And all Yashar'el (Israel) stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.
live.canon|joshua|7:8: O Adonai (Lord), what shall I say, when Yashar'el (Israel) turns their backs before their enemies!
live.canon|joshua|7:1: But the children of Yashar'el (Israel) committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), took of the accursed thing: and the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|7:2: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.
live.canon|joshua|7:3: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.
live.canon|joshua|7:4: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
live.canon|joshua|7:5: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
live.canon|joshua|7:6: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of Yahuah (LORD) until the eventide, he and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and put dust upon their heads.
live.canon|joshua|7:16: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Yashar'el (Israel) by their tribes; and the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) was taken:
live.canon|joshua|7:17: And he brought the family of Yahudah (Judah); and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
live.canon|joshua|7:18: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), was taken.
live.canon|joshua|7:20: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and thus and thus have I done:
live.canon|joshua|7:21: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
live.canon|joshua|7:22: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
live.canon|joshua|7:23: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and laid them out before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|7:24: And Joshua, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
live.canon|joshua|7:26: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So Yahuah (LORD) turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|7:7: And Joshua said, Alas, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, wherefore have you at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to Elohim (God) we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!
live.canon|joshua|8:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be you dismayed: take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
live.canon|joshua|8:2: And you shall do to Ai and her king as you did unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall you take for a prey unto yourselves: lay you an ambush for the city behind it.
live.canon|joshua|8:4: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, you shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be you all ready:
live.canon|joshua|8:7: Then you shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) will deliver it into your hand.
live.canon|joshua|8:8: And it shall be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) shall you do. See, I have commanded you.
live.canon|joshua|8:29: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remains unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|8:31: As Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel), as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man has lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto Yahuah (LORD), and sacrificed peace offerings.
live.canon|joshua|8:3: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
live.canon|joshua|8:5: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
live.canon|joshua|8:6: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.
live.canon|joshua|8:9: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
live.canon|joshua|8:10: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), before the people to Ai.
live.canon|joshua|8:11: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
live.canon|joshua|8:12: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.
live.canon|joshua|8:13: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
live.canon|joshua|8:14: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Yashar'el (Israel) to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
live.canon|joshua|8:15: And Joshua and all Yashar'el (Israel) made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
live.canon|joshua|8:16: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
live.canon|joshua|8:17: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Yashar'el (Israel): and they left the city open, and pursued after Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|8:19: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
live.canon|joshua|8:20: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
live.canon|joshua|8:21: And when Joshua and all Yashar'el (Israel) saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
live.canon|joshua|8:22: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel), some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
live.canon|joshua|8:23: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
live.canon|joshua|8:24: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el (Israel) had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
live.canon|joshua|8:25: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
live.canon|joshua|8:26: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
live.canon|joshua|8:27: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Yashar'el (Israel) took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of Yahuah (LORD) which he commanded Joshua.
live.canon|joshua|8:28: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|8:30: Then Joshua built an altar unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) in mount Ebal,
live.canon|joshua|8:32: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|8:33: And all Yashar'el (Israel), and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|8:34: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
live.canon|joshua|8:35: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
live.canon|joshua|8:18: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in your hand toward Ai; for I will give it into your hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.
live.canon|joshua|9:6: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Yashar'el (Israel), We be come from a far country: now therefore make you a league with us.
live.canon|joshua|9:7: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto the Hivites, Peradventure you dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
live.canon|joshua|9:8: And they said unto Joshua, We are your servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are you? and from whence come you?
live.canon|joshua|9:9: And they said unto him, From a very far country your servants are come because of the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
live.canon|joshua|9:11: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make you a league with us.
live.canon|joshua|9:23: Now therefore you are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my Elohim (God).
live.canon|joshua|9:24: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told your servants, how that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
live.canon|joshua|9:25: And now, behold, we are in your hand: as it seems good and right unto you to do unto us, do.
live.canon|joshua|9:1: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
live.canon|joshua|9:2: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Yashar'el (Israel), with one accord.
live.canon|joshua|9:3: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
live.canon|joshua|9:4: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
live.canon|joshua|9:5: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
live.canon|joshua|9:10: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
live.canon|joshua|9:12: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
live.canon|joshua|9:13: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
live.canon|joshua|9:14: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|9:15: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
live.canon|joshua|9:16: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
live.canon|joshua|9:17: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
live.canon|joshua|9:18: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel). And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
live.canon|joshua|9:19: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel): now therefore we may not touch them.
live.canon|joshua|9:20: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
live.canon|joshua|9:21: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
live.canon|joshua|9:26: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they slew them not.
live.canon|joshua|9:27: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of Yahuah (LORD), even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
live.canon|joshua|9:22: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have you beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when you dwell among us?
live.canon|joshua|10:4: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it has made peace with Joshua and with the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|10:6: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not your hand from your servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
live.canon|joshua|10:8: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into your hand; there shall not a man of them stand before you.
live.canon|joshua|10:10: And Yahuah (LORD) discomfited them before Yashar'el (Israel), and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goes up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
live.canon|joshua|10:12: Then spake Joshua to Yahuah (LORD) in the day when Yahuah (LORD) delivered up the Amorites before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and he said in the sight of Yashar'el (Israel), Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon; and you, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
live.canon|joshua|10:19: And stay you not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has delivered them into your hand.
live.canon|joshua|10:25: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall Yahuah (LORD) do to all your enemies against whom you fight.
live.canon|joshua|10:1: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Yashar'el (Israel), and were among them;
live.canon|joshua|10:2: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
live.canon|joshua|10:3: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
live.canon|joshua|10:5: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
live.canon|joshua|10:7: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
live.canon|joshua|10:9: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
live.canon|joshua|10:11: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Yashar'el (Israel), and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that Yahuah (LORD) cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Yashar'el (Israel) slew with the sword.
live.canon|joshua|10:13: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
live.canon|joshua|10:14: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahuah (LORD) hearkened unto the voice of a man: for Yahuah (LORD) fought for Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|10:15: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
live.canon|joshua|10:16: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
live.canon|joshua|10:17: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
live.canon|joshua|10:18: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
live.canon|joshua|10:20: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
live.canon|joshua|10:21: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|10:22: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
live.canon|joshua|10:23: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
live.canon|joshua|10:24: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
live.canon|joshua|10:26: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
live.canon|joshua|10:27: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day.
live.canon|joshua|10:28: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
live.canon|joshua|10:29: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
live.canon|joshua|10:30: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Yashar'el (Israel); and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
live.canon|joshua|10:31: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
live.canon|joshua|10:32: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered Lachish into the hand of Yashar'el (Israel), which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
live.canon|joshua|10:33: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
live.canon|joshua|10:34: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
live.canon|joshua|10:35: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
live.canon|joshua|10:36: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
live.canon|joshua|10:37: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
live.canon|joshua|10:38: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
live.canon|joshua|10:39: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
live.canon|joshua|10:40: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) commanded.
live.canon|joshua|10:41: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
live.canon|joshua|10:42: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) fought for Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|10:43: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
live.canon|joshua|11:6: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Yashar'el (Israel): you shall hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
live.canon|joshua|11:17: Even from the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
live.canon|joshua|11:1: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
live.canon|joshua|11:2: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
live.canon|joshua|11:3: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
live.canon|joshua|11:4: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
live.canon|joshua|11:5: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|11:7: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
live.canon|joshua|11:8: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered them into the hand of Yashar'el (Israel), who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
live.canon|joshua|11:9: And Joshua did unto them as Yahuah (LORD) bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
live.canon|joshua|11:10: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
live.canon|joshua|11:11: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
live.canon|joshua|11:12: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded.
live.canon|joshua|11:13: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Yashar'el (Israel) burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
live.canon|joshua|11:14: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
live.canon|joshua|11:15: As Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|joshua|11:16: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Yashar'el (Israel), and the valley of the same;
live.canon|joshua|11:18: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
live.canon|joshua|11:19: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Yashar'el (Israel), save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
live.canon|joshua|11:20: For it was of Yahuah (LORD) to harden their hearts, that they should come against Yashar'el (Israel) in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|joshua|11:21: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Yahudah (Judah), and from all the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel): Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
live.canon|joshua|11:22: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
live.canon|joshua|11:23: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Yashar'el (Israel) according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
live.canon|joshua|12:7: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) for a possession according to their divisions;
live.canon|joshua|12:1: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
live.canon|joshua|12:2: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
live.canon|joshua|12:3: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:
live.canon|joshua|12:4: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
live.canon|joshua|12:5: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
live.canon|joshua|12:6: Them did Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smite: and Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
live.canon|joshua|12:8: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
live.canon|joshua|12:9: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:10: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:11: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:12: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:13: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:14: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:15: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:16: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:17: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:18: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:19: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:20: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:21: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:22: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:23: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
live.canon|joshua|12:24: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
live.canon|joshua|13:1: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, You are old and stricken in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.
live.canon|joshua|13:2: This is the land that yet remains: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
live.canon|joshua|13:6: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Yashar'el (Israel): only divide you it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
live.canon|joshua|13:3: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
live.canon|joshua|13:4: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
live.canon|joshua|13:5: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
live.canon|joshua|13:7: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
live.canon|joshua|13:8: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) gave them;
live.canon|joshua|13:9: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
live.canon|joshua|13:10: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
live.canon|joshua|13:11: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
live.canon|joshua|13:12: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
live.canon|joshua|13:13: Nevertheless the children of Yashar'el (Israel) expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
live.canon|joshua|13:14: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
live.canon|joshua|13:15: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|13:16: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
live.canon|joshua|13:17: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
live.canon|joshua|13:18: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
live.canon|joshua|13:19: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,
live.canon|joshua|13:20: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
live.canon|joshua|13:21: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
live.canon|joshua|13:22: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Yashar'el (Israel) slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
live.canon|joshua|13:23: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
live.canon|joshua|13:24: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|13:25: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
live.canon|joshua|13:26: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
live.canon|joshua|13:27: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
live.canon|joshua|13:28: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
live.canon|joshua|13:29: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
live.canon|joshua|13:30: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
live.canon|joshua|13:31: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
live.canon|joshua|13:32: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
live.canon|joshua|13:33: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
live.canon|joshua|14:6: Then the children of Yahudah (Judah) came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, You know the thing that Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses the man of Elohim (God) concerning me and you in Kadesh-barnea.
live.canon|joshua|14:7: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
live.canon|joshua|14:9: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon your feet have trodden shall be your inheritance, and your children’s for ever, because you have wholly followed Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God).
live.canon|joshua|14:10: And now, behold, Yahuah (LORD) has kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since Yahuah (LORD) spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Yashar'el (Israel) wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
