live.canon|joshua|14:12: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof Yahuah (LORD) spake in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be Yahuah (LORD) will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as Yahuah (LORD) said.
live.canon|joshua|14:1: And these are the countries which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), distributed for inheritance to them.
live.canon|joshua|14:2: By lot was their inheritance, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
live.canon|joshua|14:3: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
live.canon|joshua|14:4: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
live.canon|joshua|14:5: As Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did, and they divided the land.
live.canon|joshua|14:8: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God).
live.canon|joshua|14:11: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
live.canon|joshua|14:13: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
live.canon|joshua|14:14: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|14:15: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
live.canon|joshua|15:18: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What would you?
live.canon|joshua|15:19: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for you have given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
live.canon|joshua|15:2: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looks southward:
live.canon|joshua|15:8: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
live.canon|joshua|15:16: And Caleb said, He that smites Kirjath-sepher, and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
live.canon|joshua|15:1: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Yahudah (Judah) by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
live.canon|joshua|15:3: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
live.canon|joshua|15:4: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
live.canon|joshua|15:5: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
live.canon|joshua|15:6: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
live.canon|joshua|15:7: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:
live.canon|joshua|15:9: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim:
live.canon|joshua|15:10: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
live.canon|joshua|15:11: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
live.canon|joshua|15:12: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Yahudah (Judah) round about according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|15:13: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Yahudah (Judah), according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
live.canon|joshua|15:14: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
live.canon|joshua|15:15: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.
live.canon|joshua|15:17: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
live.canon|joshua|15:20: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Yahudah (Judah) according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|15:21: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Yahudah (Judah) toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
live.canon|joshua|15:22: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
live.canon|joshua|15:23: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
live.canon|joshua|15:25: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
live.canon|joshua|15:27: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,
live.canon|joshua|15:28: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,
live.canon|joshua|15:30: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
live.canon|joshua|15:31: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
live.canon|joshua|15:32: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:33: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
live.canon|joshua|15:34: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
live.canon|joshua|15:35: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
live.canon|joshua|15:36: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:38: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
live.canon|joshua|15:40: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
live.canon|joshua|15:41: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:43: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
live.canon|joshua|15:44: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:45: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:46: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:47: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
live.canon|joshua|15:48: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
live.canon|joshua|15:49: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,
live.canon|joshua|15:50: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
live.canon|joshua|15:51: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:53: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,
live.canon|joshua|15:54: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:55: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
live.canon|joshua|15:56: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
live.canon|joshua|15:57: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:59: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:60: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|15:61: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,
live.canon|joshua|15:62: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|15:63: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Yahudah (Judah) could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Yahudah (Judah) at Jerusalem unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|16:1: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goes up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el,
live.canon|joshua|16:2: And goes out from Beth-el to Luz, and passes along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
live.canon|joshua|16:3: And goes down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
live.canon|joshua|16:4: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
live.canon|joshua|16:5: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;
live.canon|joshua|16:6: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
live.canon|joshua|16:7: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
live.canon|joshua|16:8: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
live.canon|joshua|16:9: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|16:10: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
live.canon|joshua|17:7: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lies before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
live.canon|joshua|17:14: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why have you given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as Yahuah (LORD) has blessed me hitherto?
live.canon|joshua|17:15: And Joshua answered them, If you be a great people, then get you up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for you.
live.canon|joshua|17:17: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, You are a great people, and have great power: you shall not have one lot only:
live.canon|joshua|17:18: But the mountain shall be yours; for it is a wood, and you shall cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be yours: for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
live.canon|joshua|17:1: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
live.canon|joshua|17:2: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
live.canon|joshua|17:3: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
live.canon|joshua|17:4: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
live.canon|joshua|17:5: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
live.canon|joshua|17:6: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.
live.canon|joshua|17:8: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
live.canon|joshua|17:9: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
live.canon|joshua|17:10: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
live.canon|joshua|17:11: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
live.canon|joshua|17:12: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
live.canon|joshua|17:13: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
live.canon|joshua|17:16: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
live.canon|joshua|18:3: And Joshua said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), How long are you slack to go to possess the land, which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers has given you?
live.canon|joshua|18:6: You shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|joshua|18:13: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Beth-el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lies on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.
live.canon|joshua|18:14: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lies before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Yahudah (Judah): this was the west quarter.
live.canon|joshua|18:16: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,
live.canon|joshua|18:1: And the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
live.canon|joshua|18:2: And there remained among the children of Yashar'el (Israel) seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
live.canon|joshua|18:4: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
live.canon|joshua|18:5: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Yahudah (Judah) shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
live.canon|joshua|18:7: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of Yahuah (LORD) is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) gave them.
live.canon|joshua|18:8: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before Yahuah (LORD) in Shiloh.
live.canon|joshua|18:9: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
live.canon|joshua|18:10: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahuah (LORD): and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) according to their divisions.
live.canon|joshua|18:11: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Joseph.
live.canon|joshua|18:12: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
live.canon|joshua|18:15: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
live.canon|joshua|18:17: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
live.canon|joshua|18:18: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
live.canon|joshua|18:19: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
live.canon|joshua|18:20: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|18:21: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
live.canon|joshua|18:22: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,
live.canon|joshua|18:23: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
live.canon|joshua|18:24: And Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
live.canon|joshua|18:26: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
live.canon|joshua|18:27: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
live.canon|joshua|18:28: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|19:12: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goes out to Daberath, and goes up to Japhia,
live.canon|joshua|19:13: And from thence passes on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goes out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;
live.canon|joshua|19:22: And the coast reaches to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:26: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reaches to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;
live.canon|joshua|19:27: And turns toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reaches to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goes out to Cabul on the left hand,
live.canon|joshua|19:29: And then the coast turns to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turns to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
live.canon|joshua|19:34: And then the coast turns westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goes out from thence to Hukkok, and reaches to Zebulun on the south side, and reaches to Asher on the west side, and to Yahudah (Judah) upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
live.canon|joshua|19:1: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|joshua|19:2: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
live.canon|joshua|19:3: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,
live.canon|joshua|19:4: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
live.canon|joshua|19:5: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,
live.canon|joshua|19:6: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
live.canon|joshua|19:7: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
live.canon|joshua|19:8: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|19:9: Out of the portion of the children of Yahudah (Judah) was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Yahudah (Judah) was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
live.canon|joshua|19:10: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
live.canon|joshua|19:11: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
live.canon|joshua|19:14: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:
live.canon|joshua|19:15: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:16: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:17: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|19:18: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
live.canon|joshua|19:19: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
live.canon|joshua|19:20: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
live.canon|joshua|19:21: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;
live.canon|joshua|19:23: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:24: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|19:25: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
live.canon|joshua|19:28: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
live.canon|joshua|19:30: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:31: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:32: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|19:33: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
live.canon|joshua|19:35: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
live.canon|joshua|19:36: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
live.canon|joshua|19:37: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,
live.canon|joshua|19:38: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:39: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:40: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
live.canon|joshua|19:41: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,
live.canon|joshua|19:42: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
live.canon|joshua|19:43: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
live.canon|joshua|19:44: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
live.canon|joshua|19:45: And Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,
live.canon|joshua|19:46: And Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
live.canon|joshua|19:47: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
live.canon|joshua|19:48: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
live.canon|joshua|19:49: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
live.canon|joshua|19:50: According to the word of Yahuah (LORD) they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
live.canon|joshua|19:51: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahuah (LORD), at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
live.canon|joshua|20:3: That the slayer that kills any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
live.canon|joshua|20:4: And when he that does flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
live.canon|joshua|20:9: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and for the stranger that sojourns among them, that whosoever kills any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
live.canon|joshua|20:1: Yahuah (LORD) also spake unto Joshua, saying,
live.canon|joshua|20:2: Speak to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
live.canon|joshua|20:5: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
live.canon|joshua|20:6: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
live.canon|joshua|20:7: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|joshua|20:8: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
live.canon|joshua|21:1: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|joshua|21:2: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, Yahuah (LORD) commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
live.canon|joshua|21:3: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), these cities and their suburbs.
live.canon|joshua|21:4: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:5: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:6: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:7: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:8: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|joshua|21:9: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Yahudah (Judah), and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
live.canon|joshua|21:10: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
live.canon|joshua|21:11: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Yahudah (Judah), with the suburbs thereof round about it.
live.canon|joshua|21:12: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
live.canon|joshua|21:13: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:14: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:15: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:16: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
live.canon|joshua|21:17: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:18: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:19: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
live.canon|joshua|21:20: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
live.canon|joshua|21:21: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:22: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:23: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:24: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:25: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:26: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
live.canon|joshua|21:27: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs; two cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:28: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:29: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:30: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:31: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:32: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:33: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
live.canon|joshua|21:34: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:35: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:36: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:37: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:38: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
live.canon|joshua|21:39: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
live.canon|joshua|21:40: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:41: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
live.canon|joshua|21:42: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
live.canon|joshua|21:43: And Yahuah (LORD) gave unto Yashar'el (Israel) all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
live.canon|joshua|21:44: And Yahuah (LORD) gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; Yahuah (LORD) delivered all their enemies into their hand.
live.canon|joshua|21:45: There failed not ought of any good thing which Yahuah (LORD) had spoken unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel); all came to pass.
live.canon|joshua|22:2: And said unto them, You have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
live.canon|joshua|22:3: You have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|joshua|22:4: And now Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return you, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) gave you on the other side Jordan.
live.canon|joshua|22:16: Thus says the whole congregation of Yahuah (LORD), What trespass is this that you have committed against the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), to turn away this day from following Yahuah (LORD), in that you have builded you an altar, that you might rebel this day against Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|joshua|22:18: But that you must turn away this day from following Yahuah (LORD)? and it will be, seeing you rebel to day against Yahuah (LORD), that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|22:19: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass you over unto the land of the possession of Yahuah (LORD), wherein the LORD’S tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us: but rebel not against Yahuah (LORD), nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|joshua|22:22: Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of gods, Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of gods, he knows, and Yashar'el (Israel) he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against Yahuah (LORD), (save us not this day,)
live.canon|joshua|22:24: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have you to do with Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|joshua|22:25: For Yahuah (LORD) has made Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad; you have no part in Yahuah (LORD): so shall your children make our children cease from fearing Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|22:27: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of Yahuah (LORD) before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, You have no part in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|22:31: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that Yahuah (LORD) is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahuah (LORD): now you have delivered the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the hand of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|22:1: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
live.canon|joshua|22:5: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) charged you, to love Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
live.canon|joshua|22:6: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
live.canon|joshua|22:7: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
live.canon|joshua|22:8: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
live.canon|joshua|22:9: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|joshua|22:10: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
live.canon|joshua|22:11: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|22:12: And when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
live.canon|joshua|22:13: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
live.canon|joshua|22:14: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel); and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|22:15: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
live.canon|joshua|22:17: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of Yahuah (LORD),
live.canon|joshua|22:20: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel)? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
live.canon|joshua|22:21: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel),
live.canon|joshua|22:23: That we have built us an altar to turn from following Yahuah (LORD), or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let Yahuah (LORD) himself require it;
live.canon|joshua|22:26: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
live.canon|joshua|22:28: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of Yahuah (LORD), which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
live.canon|joshua|22:29: Elohim (God) forbid that we should rebel against Yahuah (LORD), and turn this day from following Yahuah (LORD), to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) that is before his tabernacle.
live.canon|joshua|22:30: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel) which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
live.canon|joshua|22:32: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and brought them word again.
live.canon|joshua|22:33: And the thing pleased the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) blessed Elohim (God), and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
live.canon|joshua|22:34: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that Yahuah (LORD) is Elohim (God).
live.canon|joshua|23:3: And you have seen all that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has done unto all these nations because of you; for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) is he that has fought for you.
live.canon|joshua|23:5: And Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and you shall possess their land, as Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has promised unto you.
live.canon|joshua|23:6: Be you therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
live.canon|joshua|23:7: That you come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
live.canon|joshua|23:8: But cleave unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as you have done unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|23:9: For Yahuah (LORD) has driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man has been able to stand before you unto this day.
live.canon|joshua|23:10: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he it is that fighteth for you, as he has promised you.
live.canon|joshua|23:11: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that you love Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|joshua|23:12: Else if you do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
live.canon|joshua|23:13: Know for a certainty that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has given you.
live.canon|joshua|23:14: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing has failed thereof.
live.canon|joshua|23:15: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) promised you; so shall Yahuah (LORD) bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has given you.
live.canon|joshua|23:16: When you have transgressed the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of Yahuah (LORD) be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land which he has given unto you.
live.canon|joshua|23:1: And it came to pass a long time after that Yahuah (LORD) had given rest unto Yashar'el (Israel) from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.
live.canon|joshua|23:2: And Joshua called for all Yashar'el (Israel), and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
live.canon|joshua|23:4: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
live.canon|joshua|24:2: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
live.canon|joshua|24:6: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
live.canon|joshua|24:7: And when they cried unto Yahuah (LORD), he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and you dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
live.canon|joshua|24:8: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that you might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
live.canon|joshua|24:11: And you went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
live.canon|joshua|24:12: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with your sword, nor with your bow.
live.canon|joshua|24:13: And I have given you a land for which you did not labour, and cities which you built not, and you dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which you planted not do you eat.
live.canon|joshua|24:14: Now therefore fear Yahuah (LORD), and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|24:15: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Yahuah (LORD), choose you this day whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|24:19: And Joshua said unto the people, You cannot serve Yahuah (LORD): for he is an holy Elohim (God); he is a jealous Elohim (God); he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
live.canon|joshua|24:20: If you forsake Yahuah (LORD), and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he has done you good.
live.canon|joshua|24:22: And Joshua said unto the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen you Yahuah (LORD), to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
live.canon|joshua|24:27: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it has heard all the words of Yahuah (LORD) which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest you deny your Elohim (God).
live.canon|joshua|24:1: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to Shechem, and called for the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before Elohim (God).
live.canon|joshua|24:3: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
live.canon|joshua|24:4: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
live.canon|joshua|24:5: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
live.canon|joshua|24:9: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Yashar'el (Israel), and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
live.canon|joshua|24:10: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
live.canon|joshua|24:16: And the people answered and said, Elohim (God) forbid that we should forsake Yahuah (LORD), to serve other gods;
live.canon|joshua|24:17: For Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
live.canon|joshua|24:18: And Yahuah (LORD) drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve Yahuah (LORD); for he is our Elohim (God).
live.canon|joshua|24:21: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|24:23: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|24:24: And the people said unto Joshua, Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
live.canon|joshua|24:25: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
live.canon|joshua|24:26: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of Elohim (God), and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|joshua|24:28: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
live.canon|joshua|24:29: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahuah (LORD), died, being an hundred and ten years old.
live.canon|joshua|24:30: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
live.canon|joshua|24:31: And Yashar'el (Israel) served Yahuah (LORD) all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of Yahuah (LORD), that he had done for Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|joshua|24:32: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
live.canon|joshua|24:33: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
live.canon|leviticus|1:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto Yahuah (LORD), you shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
live.canon|leviticus|1:1: And Yahuah (LORD) called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|1:3: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|1:4: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
live.canon|leviticus|1:5: And he shall kill the bullock before Yahuah (LORD): and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|1:6: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
live.canon|leviticus|1:7: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
live.canon|leviticus|1:8: And the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
live.canon|leviticus|1:9: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|1:10: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
live.canon|leviticus|1:11: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before Yahuah (LORD): and the priests, Aaron’s sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|1:12: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
live.canon|leviticus|1:13: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|1:14: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to Yahuah (LORD) be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
live.canon|leviticus|1:15: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
live.canon|leviticus|1:16: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
live.canon|leviticus|1:17: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|2:4: And if you bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
live.canon|leviticus|2:5: And if your oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
live.canon|leviticus|2:6: You shall part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
live.canon|leviticus|2:7: And if your oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
live.canon|leviticus|2:8: And you shall bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto Yahuah (LORD): and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|2:11: No meat offering, which you shall bring unto Yahuah (LORD), shall be made with leaven: for you shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire.
live.canon|leviticus|2:12: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, you shall offer them unto Yahuah (LORD): but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
live.canon|leviticus|2:13: And every oblation of your meat offering shall you season with salt; neither shall you suffer the salt of the covenant of your Elohim (God) to be lacking from your meat offering: with all your offerings you shall offer salt.
live.canon|leviticus|2:14: And if you offer a meat offering of your firstfruits unto Yahuah (LORD), you shall offer for the meat offering of your firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
live.canon|leviticus|2:1: And when any will offer a meat offering unto Yahuah (LORD), his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
live.canon|leviticus|2:2: And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|leviticus|2:3: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire.
live.canon|leviticus|2:9: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|2:10: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’: it is a thing most holy of the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire.
live.canon|leviticus|2:16: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|2:15: And you shall put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
live.canon|leviticus|3:3: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD); the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
live.canon|leviticus|3:9: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD); the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
live.canon|leviticus|3:14: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD); the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
live.canon|leviticus|3:17: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that you eat neither fat nor blood.
live.canon|leviticus|3:1: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|3:2: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
live.canon|leviticus|3:4: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
live.canon|leviticus|3:5: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|3:6: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto Yahuah (LORD) be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
live.canon|leviticus|3:7: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|3:8: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|3:10: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
live.canon|leviticus|3:11: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|3:12: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|3:13: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
live.canon|leviticus|3:15: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
live.canon|leviticus|3:16: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD’S.
live.canon|leviticus|4:3: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he has sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto Yahuah (LORD) for a sin offering.
live.canon|leviticus|4:8: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
live.canon|leviticus|4:22: When a ruler has sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
live.canon|leviticus|4:27: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he does somewhat against any of the commandments of Yahuah (LORD) concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
live.canon|leviticus|4:28: Or if his sin, which he has sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has sinned.
live.canon|leviticus|4:35: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD): and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he has committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|leviticus|4:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|4:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of Yahuah (LORD) concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
live.canon|leviticus|4:4: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before Yahuah (LORD); and shall lay his hand upon the bullock’s head, and kill the bullock before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|4:5: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock’s blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
live.canon|leviticus|4:6: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before Yahuah (LORD), before the vail of the sanctuary.
live.canon|leviticus|4:7: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahuah (LORD), which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|4:9: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
live.canon|leviticus|4:10: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|4:11: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
live.canon|leviticus|4:12: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
live.canon|leviticus|4:13: And if the whole congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of Yahuah (LORD) concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
live.canon|leviticus|4:14: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|4:15: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before Yahuah (LORD): and the bullock shall be killed before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|4:16: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
live.canon|leviticus|4:17: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Yahuah (LORD), even before the vail.
live.canon|leviticus|4:18: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before Yahuah (LORD), that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|4:19: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|4:20: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
live.canon|leviticus|4:21: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|4:24: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahuah (LORD): it is a sin offering.
live.canon|leviticus|4:25: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|4:26: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|leviticus|4:29: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|4:30: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|4:31: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD); and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|leviticus|4:32: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
live.canon|leviticus|4:33: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|4:34: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
live.canon|leviticus|4:23: Or if his sin, wherein he has sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
live.canon|leviticus|5:1: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he has seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
live.canon|leviticus|5:3: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.
live.canon|leviticus|5:4: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
live.canon|leviticus|5:5: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he has sinned in that thing:
live.canon|leviticus|5:6: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto Yahuah (LORD) for his sin which he has sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
live.canon|leviticus|5:7: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he has committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto Yahuah (LORD); one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|5:10: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he has sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|leviticus|5:13: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he has sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as a meat offering.
live.canon|leviticus|5:15: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of Yahuah (LORD); then he shall bring for his trespass unto Yahuah (LORD) a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with your estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
live.canon|leviticus|5:16: And he shall make amends for the harm that he has done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|leviticus|5:18: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with your estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|leviticus|5:2: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
live.canon|leviticus|5:8: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
live.canon|leviticus|5:9: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.
live.canon|leviticus|5:11: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.
live.canon|leviticus|5:12: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD): it is a sin offering.
live.canon|leviticus|5:14: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|5:17: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of Yahuah (LORD); though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
live.canon|leviticus|5:19: It is a trespass offering: he has certainly trespassed against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|6:2: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against Yahuah (LORD), and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or has deceived his neighbour;
live.canon|leviticus|6:3: Or have found that which was lost, and lies concerning it, and swears falsely; in any of all these that a man does, sinning therein:
live.canon|leviticus|6:4: Then it shall be, because he has sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he has deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
live.canon|leviticus|6:5: Or all that about which he has sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
live.canon|leviticus|6:6: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto Yahuah (LORD), a ram without blemish out of the flock, with your estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
live.canon|leviticus|6:7: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before Yahuah (LORD): and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he has done in trespassing therein.
live.canon|leviticus|6:10: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire has consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|6:18: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire: every one that touches them shall be holy.
live.canon|leviticus|6:21: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, you shall bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shall you offer for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|6:26: The priest that offers it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|6:27: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, you shall wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
live.canon|leviticus|6:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|6:8: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|6:9: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
live.canon|leviticus|6:11: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
live.canon|leviticus|6:12: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
live.canon|leviticus|6:13: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
live.canon|leviticus|6:14: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahuah (LORD), before the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|6:15: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|6:16: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
live.canon|leviticus|6:17: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
live.canon|leviticus|6:19: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|6:20: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto Yahuah (LORD) in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
live.canon|leviticus|6:22: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto Yahuah (LORD); it shall be wholly burnt.
live.canon|leviticus|6:23: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
live.canon|leviticus|6:24: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|6:25: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before Yahuah (LORD): it is most holy.
live.canon|leviticus|6:28: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
live.canon|leviticus|6:29: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
live.canon|leviticus|6:30: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
live.canon|leviticus|7:3: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covers the inwards,
