live.canon|leviticus|7:7: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that makes atonement therewith shall have it.
live.canon|leviticus|7:8: And the priest that offers any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
live.canon|leviticus|7:9: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offers it.
live.canon|leviticus|7:16: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offers his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
live.canon|leviticus|7:18: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offers it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eats of it shall bear his iniquity.
live.canon|leviticus|7:19: And the flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
live.canon|leviticus|7:20: But the soul that eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto Yahuah (LORD), having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
live.canon|leviticus|7:23: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, You shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
live.canon|leviticus|7:24: And the fat of the beast that dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but you shall in no wise eat of it.
live.canon|leviticus|7:25: For whosoever eats the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD), even the soul that eats it shall be cut off from his people.
live.canon|leviticus|7:26: Moreover you shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
live.canon|leviticus|7:27: Whatsoever soul it be that eats any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
live.canon|leviticus|7:29: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, He that offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD) shall bring his oblation unto Yahuah (LORD) of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
live.canon|leviticus|7:32: And the right shoulder shall you give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
live.canon|leviticus|7:33: He among the sons of Aaron, that offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
live.canon|leviticus|7:1: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
live.canon|leviticus|7:2: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|7:4: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
live.canon|leviticus|7:5: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD): it is a trespass offering.
live.canon|leviticus|7:6: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
live.canon|leviticus|7:10: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
live.canon|leviticus|7:11: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|7:12: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
live.canon|leviticus|7:13: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
live.canon|leviticus|7:14: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD), and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
live.canon|leviticus|7:15: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
live.canon|leviticus|7:17: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
live.canon|leviticus|7:21: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto Yahuah (LORD), even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
live.canon|leviticus|7:22: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|7:28: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|7:30: His own hands shall bring the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|7:31: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
live.canon|leviticus|7:34: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|leviticus|7:35: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto Yahuah (LORD) in the priest’s office;
live.canon|leviticus|7:36: Which Yahuah (LORD) commanded to be given them of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
live.canon|leviticus|7:37: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
live.canon|leviticus|7:38: Which Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to offer their oblations unto Yahuah (LORD), in the wilderness of Sinai.
live.canon|leviticus|8:3: And gather you all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|8:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|8:2: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
live.canon|leviticus|8:4: And Moses did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|8:5: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) commanded to be done.
live.canon|leviticus|8:6: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
live.canon|leviticus|8:7: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
live.canon|leviticus|8:8: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
live.canon|leviticus|8:9: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|8:10: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
live.canon|leviticus|8:11: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
live.canon|leviticus|8:12: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
live.canon|leviticus|8:13: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|8:14: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
live.canon|leviticus|8:15: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
live.canon|leviticus|8:16: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|8:17: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|8:18: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
live.canon|leviticus|8:19: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
live.canon|leviticus|8:20: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
live.canon|leviticus|8:21: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD); as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|8:22: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
live.canon|leviticus|8:23: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
live.canon|leviticus|8:24: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
live.canon|leviticus|8:25: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
live.canon|leviticus|8:26: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Yahuah (LORD), he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
live.canon|leviticus|8:27: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|8:28: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|8:29: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD): for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|8:30: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
live.canon|leviticus|8:31: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
live.canon|leviticus|8:32: And that which remains of the flesh and of the bread shall you burn with fire.
live.canon|leviticus|8:33: And you shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
live.canon|leviticus|8:36: So Aaron and his sons did all things which Yahuah (LORD) commanded by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|8:34: As he has done this day, so Yahuah (LORD) has commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
live.canon|leviticus|8:35: Therefore shall you abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of Yahuah (LORD), that you die not: for so I am commanded.
live.canon|leviticus|9:2: And he said unto Aaron, Take you a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|9:3: And unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) you shall speak, saying, Take you a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
live.canon|leviticus|9:6: And Moses said, This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) commanded that you should do: and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) shall appear unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|9:7: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded.
live.canon|leviticus|9:1: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|leviticus|9:4: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahuah (LORD); and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day Yahuah (LORD) will appear unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|9:5: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|9:8: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
live.canon|leviticus|9:9: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
live.canon|leviticus|9:10: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|9:11: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
live.canon|leviticus|9:12: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|9:13: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|9:14: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|9:15: And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
live.canon|leviticus|9:16: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
live.canon|leviticus|9:17: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
live.canon|leviticus|9:18: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
live.canon|leviticus|9:20: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
live.canon|leviticus|9:21: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD); as Moses commanded.
live.canon|leviticus|9:22: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
live.canon|leviticus|9:23: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto all the people.
live.canon|leviticus|9:24: And there came a fire out from before Yahuah (LORD), and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
live.canon|leviticus|9:19: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covers the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
live.canon|leviticus|10:6: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest you die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel), bewail the burning which Yahuah (LORD) has kindled.
live.canon|leviticus|10:7: And you shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest you die: for the anointing oil of Yahuah (LORD) is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|10:9: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, you, nor your sons with you, when you go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest you die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
live.canon|leviticus|10:10: And that you may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
live.canon|leviticus|10:11: And that you may teach the children of Yashar'el (Israel) all the statutes which Yahuah (LORD) has spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|10:12: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remains of the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
live.canon|leviticus|10:13: And you shall eat it in the holy place, because it is your due, and your sons’ due, of the sacrifices of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire: for so I am commanded.
live.canon|leviticus|10:14: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall you eat in a clean place; you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they be your due, and your sons’ due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|leviticus|10:15: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD); and it shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, by a statute for ever; as Yahuah (LORD) has commanded.
live.canon|leviticus|10:17: Wherefore have you not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and Elohim (God) has given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|leviticus|10:18: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: you should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
live.canon|leviticus|10:1: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before Yahuah (LORD), which he commanded them not.
live.canon|leviticus|10:2: And there went out fire from Yahuah (LORD), and devoured them, and they died before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|10:3: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that Yahuah (LORD) spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
live.canon|leviticus|10:4: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
live.canon|leviticus|10:5: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
live.canon|leviticus|10:8: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|10:16: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|10:19: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before Yahuah (LORD); and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|leviticus|10:20: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
live.canon|leviticus|11:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, These are the beasts which you shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
live.canon|leviticus|11:3: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall you eat.
live.canon|leviticus|11:4: Nevertheless these shall you not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:5: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:6: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:8: Of their flesh shall you not eat, and their carcase shall you not touch; they are unclean to you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:9: These shall you eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall you eat.
live.canon|leviticus|11:11: They shall be even an abomination unto you; you shall not eat of their flesh, but you shall have their carcases in abomination.
live.canon|leviticus|11:12: Whatsoever has no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:13: And these are they which you shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
live.canon|leviticus|11:21: Yet these may you eat of every flying creeping thing that goes upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
live.canon|leviticus|11:22: Even these of them you may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
live.canon|leviticus|11:24: And for these you shall be unclean: whosoever touches the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|11:25: And whosoever bears ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|11:26: The carcases of every beast which divides the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that touches them shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|11:27: And whatsoever goes upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso touches their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|11:28: And he that bears the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:31: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever does touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|11:32: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, does fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
live.canon|leviticus|11:33: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falls, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and you shall break it.
live.canon|leviticus|11:34: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water comes shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|11:35: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falls shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:36: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which touches their carcase shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|11:39: And if any beast, of which you may eat, die; he that touches the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|11:40: And he that eats of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that bears the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|11:41: And every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
live.canon|leviticus|11:42: Whatsoever goes upon the belly, and whatsoever goes upon all four, or whatsoever has more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
live.canon|leviticus|11:43: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps, neither shall you make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled thereby.
live.canon|leviticus|11:44: For I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): you shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and you shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall you defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.
live.canon|leviticus|11:45: For I am Yahuah (LORD) that brings you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your Elohim (God): you shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
live.canon|leviticus|11:46: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps upon the earth:
live.canon|leviticus|11:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
live.canon|leviticus|11:7: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:10: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
live.canon|leviticus|11:14: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
live.canon|leviticus|11:16: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
live.canon|leviticus|11:17: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
live.canon|leviticus|11:18: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
live.canon|leviticus|11:19: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
live.canon|leviticus|11:20: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:23: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:29: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
live.canon|leviticus|11:30: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
live.canon|leviticus|11:37: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|11:38: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|11:47: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
live.canon|leviticus|12:7: Who shall offer it before Yahuah (LORD), and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that has born a male or a female.
live.canon|leviticus|12:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|12:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|12:3: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
live.canon|leviticus|12:4: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
live.canon|leviticus|12:5: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
live.canon|leviticus|12:6: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
live.canon|leviticus|12:8: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:4: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that has the plague seven days:
live.canon|leviticus|13:8: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
live.canon|leviticus|13:12: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that has the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looks;
live.canon|leviticus|13:13: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that has the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:14: But when raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:17: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that has the plague: he is clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:20: And if, when the priest sees it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
live.canon|leviticus|13:24: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burns have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
live.canon|leviticus|13:31: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that has the plague of the scall seven days:
live.canon|leviticus|13:33: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that has the scall seven days more:
live.canon|leviticus|13:39: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that grows in the skin; he is clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:41: And he that has his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:43: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appears in the skin of the flesh;
live.canon|leviticus|13:50: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that has the plague seven days:
live.canon|leviticus|13:55: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
live.canon|leviticus|13:57: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: you shall burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
live.canon|leviticus|13:58: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which you shall wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|13:2: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
live.canon|leviticus|13:3: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:5: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
live.canon|leviticus|13:6: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:9: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
live.canon|leviticus|13:10: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
live.canon|leviticus|13:11: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:15: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
live.canon|leviticus|13:16: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
live.canon|leviticus|13:18: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
live.canon|leviticus|13:19: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
live.canon|leviticus|13:21: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
live.canon|leviticus|13:22: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
live.canon|leviticus|13:23: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:25: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
live.canon|leviticus|13:26: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
live.canon|leviticus|13:27: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
live.canon|leviticus|13:28: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
live.canon|leviticus|13:29: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
live.canon|leviticus|13:30: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
live.canon|leviticus|13:32: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
live.canon|leviticus|13:7: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he has been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
live.canon|leviticus|13:34: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:35: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
live.canon|leviticus|13:36: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:37: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:38: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
live.canon|leviticus|13:40: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:42: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
live.canon|leviticus|13:44: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
live.canon|leviticus|13:45: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:46: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
live.canon|leviticus|13:47: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
live.canon|leviticus|13:48: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
live.canon|leviticus|13:49: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
live.canon|leviticus|13:51: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|13:52: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
live.canon|leviticus|13:53: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
live.canon|leviticus|13:54: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
live.canon|leviticus|13:56: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
live.canon|leviticus|13:59: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|14:11: And the priest that makes him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before Yahuah (LORD), at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
live.canon|leviticus|14:34: When you be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
live.canon|leviticus|14:35: And he that owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seems to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
live.canon|leviticus|14:43: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he has taken away the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
live.canon|leviticus|14:46: Moreover he that goes into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|14:47: And he that lies in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eats in the house shall wash his clothes.
live.canon|leviticus|14:48: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague has not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
live.canon|leviticus|14:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|14:2: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
live.canon|leviticus|14:3: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
live.canon|leviticus|14:4: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
live.canon|leviticus|14:5: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
live.canon|leviticus|14:6: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
live.canon|leviticus|14:7: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
live.canon|leviticus|14:8: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
live.canon|leviticus|14:9: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|14:10: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
live.canon|leviticus|14:12: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|leviticus|14:13: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:
live.canon|leviticus|14:14: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
live.canon|leviticus|14:15: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
live.canon|leviticus|14:16: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|leviticus|14:17: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
live.canon|leviticus|14:18: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|14:19: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
live.canon|leviticus|14:20: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|14:21: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
live.canon|leviticus|14:22: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|14:23: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|14:24: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|leviticus|14:25: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
live.canon|leviticus|14:26: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
live.canon|leviticus|14:27: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|leviticus|14:28: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
live.canon|leviticus|14:29: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|14:30: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
live.canon|leviticus|14:31: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|14:32: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
live.canon|leviticus|14:33: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|14:36: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
live.canon|leviticus|14:37: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
live.canon|leviticus|14:38: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
live.canon|leviticus|14:39: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
live.canon|leviticus|14:40: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
live.canon|leviticus|14:41: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
live.canon|leviticus|14:42: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
live.canon|leviticus|14:44: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|14:45: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
live.canon|leviticus|14:49: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
live.canon|leviticus|14:50: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
live.canon|leviticus|14:51: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
live.canon|leviticus|14:52: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
live.canon|leviticus|14:53: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|14:54: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
live.canon|leviticus|14:55: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
live.canon|leviticus|14:56: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
live.canon|leviticus|14:57: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
live.canon|leviticus|15:6: And he that sits on any thing whereon he sat that has the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:7: And he that touches the flesh of him that has the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:8: And if he that has the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:10: And whosoever touches any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that bears any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:11: And whomsoever he touches that has the issue, and has not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:12: And the vessel of earth, that he touches which has the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
live.canon|leviticus|15:13: And when he that has an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:19: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever touches her shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:21: And whosoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:22: And whosoever touches any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:23: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:24: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:26: Every bed whereon she lies all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sits upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
live.canon|leviticus|15:27: And whosoever touches those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:31: Thus shall you separate the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
live.canon|leviticus|15:32: This is the law of him that has an issue, and of him whose seed goes from him, and is defiled therewith;
live.canon|leviticus|15:33: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that has an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lies with her that is unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|15:3: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
live.canon|leviticus|15:14: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahuah (LORD) unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
live.canon|leviticus|15:15: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before Yahuah (LORD) for his issue.
live.canon|leviticus|15:16: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:17: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:18: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:25: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:28: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:29: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|15:30: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before Yahuah (LORD) for the issue of her uncleanness.
live.canon|leviticus|15:20: And every thing that she lies upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sits upon shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When any man has a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:4: Every bed, whereon he lies that has the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sits, shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|15:5: And whosoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
live.canon|leviticus|15:9: And what saddle soever he rides upon that has the issue shall be unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|16:2: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron your brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
live.canon|leviticus|16:16: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remains among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
live.canon|leviticus|16:17: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goes in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|leviticus|16:20: And when he has made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
live.canon|leviticus|16:28: And he that burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
live.canon|leviticus|16:29: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourns among you:
live.canon|leviticus|16:30: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that you may be clean from all your sins before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|16:31: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and you shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
live.canon|leviticus|16:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before Yahuah (LORD), and died;
live.canon|leviticus|16:3: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|16:4: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
live.canon|leviticus|16:5: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
live.canon|leviticus|16:6: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
live.canon|leviticus|16:7: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before Yahuah (LORD) at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|16:8: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Yahuah (LORD), and the other lot for the scapegoat.
live.canon|leviticus|16:9: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’S lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
live.canon|leviticus|16:10: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
live.canon|leviticus|16:11: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
live.canon|leviticus|16:12: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before Yahuah (LORD), and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
live.canon|leviticus|16:13: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before Yahuah (LORD), that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
live.canon|leviticus|16:14: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
live.canon|leviticus|16:15: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
live.canon|leviticus|16:18: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before Yahuah (LORD), and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
live.canon|leviticus|16:19: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|leviticus|16:21: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
live.canon|leviticus|16:22: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
live.canon|leviticus|16:23: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
live.canon|leviticus|16:24: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
live.canon|leviticus|16:25: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
live.canon|leviticus|16:26: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
live.canon|leviticus|16:27: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
live.canon|leviticus|16:32: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
live.canon|leviticus|16:33: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
live.canon|leviticus|16:34: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for all their sins once a year. And he did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|17:2: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them; This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|17:3: What man soever there be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), that kills an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that kills it out of the camp,
live.canon|leviticus|17:4: And brings it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto Yahuah (LORD) before the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD); blood shall be imputed unto that man; he has shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
live.canon|leviticus|17:8: And you shall say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
live.canon|leviticus|17:9: And brings it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto Yahuah (LORD); even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
live.canon|leviticus|17:10: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eats any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
live.canon|leviticus|17:11: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that makes an atonement for the soul.
live.canon|leviticus|17:12: Therefore I said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourns among you eat blood.
live.canon|leviticus|17:13: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catches any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
live.canon|leviticus|17:14: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eats it shall be cut off.
live.canon|leviticus|17:15: And every soul that eats that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
live.canon|leviticus|17:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|17:5: To the end that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Yahuah (LORD), unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|17:6: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Yahuah (LORD) at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|17:7: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
live.canon|leviticus|17:16: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
live.canon|leviticus|18:3: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein you dwelt, shall you not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall you not do: neither shall you walk in their ordinances.
live.canon|leviticus|18:4: You shall do my judgments, and keep my ordinances, to walk therein: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|18:5: You shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|18:7: The nakedness of your father, or the nakedness of your mother, shall you not uncover: she is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:8: The nakedness of your father’s wife shall you not uncover: it is your father’s nakedness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:9: The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or daughter of your mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness you shall not uncover.
live.canon|leviticus|18:10: The nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness you shall not uncover: for theirs is your own nakedness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:11: The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of your father, she is your sister, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:12: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.
live.canon|leviticus|18:13: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
live.canon|leviticus|18:14: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach to his wife: she is your aunt.
live.canon|leviticus|18:15: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter in law: she is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:16: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife: it is your brother’s nakedness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:17: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shall you take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:18: Neither shall you take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
live.canon|leviticus|18:19: Also you shall not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
live.canon|leviticus|18:20: Moreover you shall not lie carnally with your neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
live.canon|leviticus|18:21: And you shall not let any of your seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shall you profane the name of your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|18:22: You shall not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
live.canon|leviticus|18:23: Neither shall you lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
live.canon|leviticus|18:24: Defile not you yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
live.canon|leviticus|18:26: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourns among you:
live.canon|leviticus|18:28: That the land spue not you out also, when you defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
live.canon|leviticus|18:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|18:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|18:6: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|18:25: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
live.canon|leviticus|18:27: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
live.canon|leviticus|18:29: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
live.canon|leviticus|18:30: Therefore shall you keep my ordinance, that you commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that you defile not yourselves therein: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|19:4: Turn you not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|19:5: And if you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD), you shall offer it at your own will.
live.canon|leviticus|19:6: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
live.canon|leviticus|19:8: Therefore every one that eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the hallowed thing of Yahuah (LORD): and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
live.canon|leviticus|19:9: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
live.canon|leviticus|19:10: And you shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather every grape of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and stranger: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|19:12: And you shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shall you profane the name of your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:13: You shall not defraud your neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with you all night until the morning.
live.canon|leviticus|19:14: You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shall fear your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:15: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: you shall not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shall you judge your neighbour.
live.canon|leviticus|19:16: You shall not go up and down as a talebearer among your people: neither shall you stand against the blood of your neighbour: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:17: You shall not hate your brother in your heart: you shall in any wise rebuke your neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
live.canon|leviticus|19:18: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:19: You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your cattle gender with a diverse kind: you shall not sow your field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon you.
live.canon|leviticus|19:20: And whosoever lies carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
live.canon|leviticus|19:22: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahuah (LORD) for his sin which he has done: and the sin which he has done shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|leviticus|19:23: And when you shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then you shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
live.canon|leviticus|19:25: And in the fifth year shall you eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|19:26: You shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall you use enchantment, nor observe times.
live.canon|leviticus|19:27: You shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shall you mar the corners of your beard.
live.canon|leviticus|19:28: You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:29: Do not prostitute your daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
live.canon|leviticus|19:30: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:32: You shall rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:34: But the stranger that dwells with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and you shall love him as thyself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|19:35: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
live.canon|leviticus|19:36: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall you have: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|leviticus|19:37: Therefore shall you observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|19:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|19:7: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
live.canon|leviticus|19:21: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto Yahuah (LORD), unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
live.canon|leviticus|19:24: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise Yahuah (LORD) withal.
live.canon|leviticus|19:33: And if a stranger sojourn with you in your land, you shall not vex him.
live.canon|leviticus|19:31: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|19:2: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, You shall be holy: for I Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) am holy.
live.canon|leviticus|19:3: You shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|19:11: You shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
live.canon|leviticus|20:2: Again, you shall say to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Whosoever he be of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers that sojourn in Yashar'el (Israel), that gives any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
live.canon|leviticus|20:3: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he has given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
live.canon|leviticus|20:4: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he gives of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
live.canon|leviticus|20:6: And the soul that turns after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
live.canon|leviticus|20:7: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be you holy: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|20:8: And you shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Yahuah (LORD) which sanctify you.
live.canon|leviticus|20:9: For every one that curses his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he has cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
live.canon|leviticus|20:10: And the man that commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he that commits adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|leviticus|20:11: And the man that lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
live.canon|leviticus|20:13: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lies with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
live.canon|leviticus|20:15: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and you shall slay the beast.
live.canon|leviticus|20:16: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, you shall kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
