live.canon|leviticus|20:17: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
live.canon|leviticus|20:18: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he has discovered her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
live.canon|leviticus|20:19: And you shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
live.canon|leviticus|20:20: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
live.canon|leviticus|20:21: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
live.canon|leviticus|20:22: You shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
live.canon|leviticus|20:23: And you shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
live.canon|leviticus|20:24: But I have said unto you, You shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that flows with milk and honey: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which have separated you from other people.
live.canon|leviticus|20:25: You shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and you shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
live.canon|leviticus|20:26: And you shall be holy unto me: for I Yahuah (LORD) am holy, and have severed you from other people, that you should be mine.
live.canon|leviticus|20:27: A man also or woman that has a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
live.canon|leviticus|20:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|20:5: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
live.canon|leviticus|20:12: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
live.canon|leviticus|20:14: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
live.canon|leviticus|21:3: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which has had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
live.canon|leviticus|21:8: You shall sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of your Elohim (God): he shall be holy unto you: for I Yahuah (LORD), which sanctify you, am holy.
live.canon|leviticus|21:17: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of your seed in their generations that has any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his Elohim (God).
live.canon|leviticus|21:18: For whatsoever man he be that has a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that has a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
live.canon|leviticus|21:20: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that has a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or has his stones broken;
live.canon|leviticus|21:21: No man that has a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire: he has a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his Elohim (God).
live.canon|leviticus|21:23: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he has a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify them.
live.canon|leviticus|21:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
live.canon|leviticus|21:2: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
live.canon|leviticus|21:4: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
live.canon|leviticus|21:5: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
live.canon|leviticus|21:6: They shall be holy unto their Elohim (God), and not profane the name of their Elohim (God): for the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire, and the bread of their Elohim (God), they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
live.canon|leviticus|21:7: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his Elohim (God).
live.canon|leviticus|21:9: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
live.canon|leviticus|21:10: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
live.canon|leviticus|21:11: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
live.canon|leviticus|21:12: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his Elohim (God); for the crown of the anointing oil of his Elohim (God) is upon him: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|21:13: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
live.canon|leviticus|21:14: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
live.canon|leviticus|21:15: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify him.
live.canon|leviticus|21:16: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|21:19: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
live.canon|leviticus|21:22: He shall eat the bread of his Elohim (God), both of the most holy, and of the holy.
live.canon|leviticus|21:24: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|leviticus|22:3: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goes unto the holy things, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) hallow unto Yahuah (LORD), having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|22:4: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or has a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso touches any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;
live.canon|leviticus|22:5: Or whosoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he has;
live.canon|leviticus|22:6: The soul which has touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
live.canon|leviticus|22:8: That which dies of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|22:9: They shall therefore keep my ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify them.
live.canon|leviticus|22:19: You shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
live.canon|leviticus|22:20: But whatsoever has a blemish, that shall you not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
live.canon|leviticus|22:21: And whosoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD) to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
live.canon|leviticus|22:22: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, you shall not offer these unto Yahuah (LORD), nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|22:23: Either a bullock or a lamb that has any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that may you offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
live.canon|leviticus|22:24: You shall not offer unto Yahuah (LORD) that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall you make any offering thereof in your land.
live.canon|leviticus|22:25: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall you offer the bread of your Elohim (God) of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
live.canon|leviticus|22:28: And whether it be cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
live.canon|leviticus|22:29: And when you will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Yahuah (LORD), offer it at your own will.
live.canon|leviticus|22:30: On the same day it shall be eaten up; you shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|22:31: Therefore shall you keep my commandments, and do them: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|22:32: Neither shall you profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): I am Yahuah (LORD) which hallow you,
live.canon|leviticus|22:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|22:2: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|22:7: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
live.canon|leviticus|22:10: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
live.canon|leviticus|22:11: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
live.canon|leviticus|22:12: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
live.canon|leviticus|22:13: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
live.canon|leviticus|22:14: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
live.canon|leviticus|22:15: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which they offer unto Yahuah (LORD);
live.canon|leviticus|22:16: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify them.
live.canon|leviticus|22:17: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|22:18: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers in Yashar'el (Israel), that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto Yahuah (LORD) for a burnt offering;
live.canon|leviticus|22:26: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|22:27: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|22:33: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
live.canon|leviticus|23:3: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; you shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of Yahuah (LORD) in all your dwellings.
live.canon|leviticus|23:4: These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their seasons.
live.canon|leviticus|23:6: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Yahuah (LORD): seven days you must eat unleavened bread.
live.canon|leviticus|23:7: In the first day you shall have an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.
live.canon|leviticus|23:8: But you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD) seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.
live.canon|leviticus|23:10: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
live.canon|leviticus|23:12: And you shall offer that day when you wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:14: And you shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that you have brought an offering unto your Elohim (God): it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
live.canon|leviticus|23:15: And you shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
live.canon|leviticus|23:16: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall you number fifty days; and you shall offer a new meat offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:17: You shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:18: And you shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD), with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:19: Then you shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
live.canon|leviticus|23:21: And you shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: you shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
live.canon|leviticus|23:22: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not make clean riddance of the corners of your field when you reapest, neither shall you gather any gleaning of your harvest: you shall leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|23:24: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall you have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
live.canon|leviticus|23:25: You shall do no servile work therein: but you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:27: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and you shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:28: And you shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|23:30: And whatsoever soul it be that does any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
live.canon|leviticus|23:31: You shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
live.canon|leviticus|23:32: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and you shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall you celebrate your sabbath.
live.canon|leviticus|23:36: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD): on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD): it is a solemn assembly; and you shall do no servile work therein.
live.canon|leviticus|23:37: These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD), a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
live.canon|leviticus|23:38: Beside the sabbaths of Yahuah (LORD), and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which you give unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:39: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruit of the land, you shall keep a feast unto Yahuah (LORD) seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
live.canon|leviticus|23:40: And you shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) seven days.
live.canon|leviticus|23:41: And you shall keep it a feast unto Yahuah (LORD) seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
live.canon|leviticus|23:42: You shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
live.canon|leviticus|23:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|23:5: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’S passover.
live.canon|leviticus|23:9: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|23:11: And he shall wave the sheaf before Yahuah (LORD), to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
live.canon|leviticus|23:13: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD) for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
live.canon|leviticus|23:20: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD), with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Yahuah (LORD) for the priest.
live.canon|leviticus|23:23: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|23:26: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|23:29: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
live.canon|leviticus|23:33: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|23:34: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|23:35: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.
live.canon|leviticus|23:43: That your generations may know that I made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|23:44: And Moses declared unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) the feasts of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|24:2: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they bring unto you pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
live.canon|leviticus|24:5: And you shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
live.canon|leviticus|24:6: And you shall set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|24:7: And you shall put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|24:14: Bring forth him that has cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
live.canon|leviticus|24:15: And you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Whosoever curses his Elohim (God) shall bear his sin.
live.canon|leviticus|24:18: And he that kills a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
live.canon|leviticus|24:19: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he has done, so shall it be done to him;
live.canon|leviticus|24:20: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he has caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
live.canon|leviticus|24:21: And he that kills a beast, he shall restore it: and he that kills a man, he shall be put to death.
live.canon|leviticus|24:22: You shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|24:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|24:3: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before Yahuah (LORD) continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
live.canon|leviticus|24:4: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Yahuah (LORD) continually.
live.canon|leviticus|24:8: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before Yahuah (LORD) continually, being taken from the children of Yashar'el (Israel) by an everlasting covenant.
live.canon|leviticus|24:9: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire by a perpetual statute.
live.canon|leviticus|24:10: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Yashar'el (Israel) strove together in the camp;
live.canon|leviticus|24:11: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of Yahuah (LORD), and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
live.canon|leviticus|24:12: And they put him in ward, that the mind of Yahuah (LORD) might be shewed them.
live.canon|leviticus|24:13: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|24:16: And he that blasphemeth the name of Yahuah (LORD), he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of Yahuah (LORD), shall be put to death.
live.canon|leviticus|24:23: And Moses spake to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|24:17: And he that kills any man shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|leviticus|25:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|25:3: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
live.canon|leviticus|25:4: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for Yahuah (LORD): you shall neither sow your field, nor prune your vineyard.
live.canon|leviticus|25:5: That which grows of its own accord of your harvest you shall not reap, neither gather the grapes of your vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
live.canon|leviticus|25:6: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for you, and for your servant, and for your maid, and for your hired servant, and for your stranger that sojourns with you,
live.canon|leviticus|25:7: And for your cattle, and for the beast that are in your land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
live.canon|leviticus|25:8: And you shall number seven sabbaths of years unto you, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto you forty and nine years.
live.canon|leviticus|25:9: Then shall you cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall you make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
live.canon|leviticus|25:10: And you shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and you shall return every man unto his possession, and you shall return every man unto his family.
live.canon|leviticus|25:11: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of your vine undressed.
live.canon|leviticus|25:12: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: you shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
live.canon|leviticus|25:13: In the year of this jubile you shall return every man unto his possession.
live.canon|leviticus|25:14: And if you sell ought unto your neighbour, or buyest ought of your neighbour’s hand, you shall not oppress one another:
live.canon|leviticus|25:15: According to the number of years after the jubile you shall buy of your neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto you:
live.canon|leviticus|25:16: According to the multitude of years you shall increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years you shall diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits does he sell unto you.
live.canon|leviticus|25:17: You shall not therefore oppress one another; but you shall fear your Elohim (God): for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|25:18: Wherefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
live.canon|leviticus|25:19: And the land shall yield her fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
live.canon|leviticus|25:20: And if you shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
live.canon|leviticus|25:22: And you shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in you shall eat of the old store.
live.canon|leviticus|25:23: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for you are strangers and sojourners with me.
live.canon|leviticus|25:24: And in all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
live.canon|leviticus|25:25: If your brother be waxen poor, and has sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
live.canon|leviticus|25:28: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that has bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
live.canon|leviticus|25:35: And if your brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with you; then you shall relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with you.
live.canon|leviticus|25:36: Take you no usury of him, or increase: but fear your Elohim (God); that your brother may live with you.
live.canon|leviticus|25:37: You shall not give him your money upon usury, nor lend him your victuals for increase.
live.canon|leviticus|25:39: And if your brother that dwells by you be waxen poor, and be sold unto you; you shall not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
live.canon|leviticus|25:40: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with you, and shall serve you unto the year of jubile:
live.canon|leviticus|25:41: And then shall he depart from you, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
live.canon|leviticus|25:43: You shall not rule over him with rigour; but shall fear your Elohim (God).
live.canon|leviticus|25:44: Both your bondmen, and your bondmaids, which you shall have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall you buy bondmen and bondmaids.
live.canon|leviticus|25:45: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall you buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
live.canon|leviticus|25:46: And you shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Yashar'el (Israel), you shall not rule one over another with rigour.
live.canon|leviticus|25:47: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by you, and your brother that dwells by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by you, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:
live.canon|leviticus|25:53: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in your sight.
live.canon|leviticus|25:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|25:21: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
live.canon|leviticus|25:26: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
live.canon|leviticus|25:27: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
live.canon|leviticus|25:29: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
live.canon|leviticus|25:30: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
live.canon|leviticus|25:31: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
live.canon|leviticus|25:32: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
live.canon|leviticus|25:33: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|leviticus|25:34: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
live.canon|leviticus|25:38: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your Elohim (God).
live.canon|leviticus|25:42: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
live.canon|leviticus|25:48: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
live.canon|leviticus|25:49: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
live.canon|leviticus|25:50: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
live.canon|leviticus|25:51: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
live.canon|leviticus|25:52: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
live.canon|leviticus|25:54: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
live.canon|leviticus|25:55: For unto me the children of Yashar'el (Israel) are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|26:1: You shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall you set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|leviticus|26:6: And I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
live.canon|leviticus|26:7: And you shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
live.canon|leviticus|26:10: And you shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
live.canon|leviticus|26:12: And I will walk among you, and will be your Elohim (God), and you shall be my people.
live.canon|leviticus|26:13: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
live.canon|leviticus|26:14: But if you will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
live.canon|leviticus|26:15: And if you shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that you will not do all my commandments, but that you break my covenant:
live.canon|leviticus|26:16: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
live.canon|leviticus|26:17: And I will set my face against you, and you shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and you shall flee when none pursueth you.
live.canon|leviticus|26:18: And if you will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
live.canon|leviticus|26:21: And if you walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
live.canon|leviticus|26:23: And if you will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
live.canon|leviticus|26:25: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when you are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
live.canon|leviticus|26:26: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and you shall eat, and not be satisfied.
live.canon|leviticus|26:27: And if you will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
live.canon|leviticus|26:29: And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall you eat.
live.canon|leviticus|26:34: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lies desolate, and you be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
live.canon|leviticus|26:35: As long as it lies desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when you dwelt upon it.
live.canon|leviticus|26:37: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
live.canon|leviticus|26:38: And you shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
live.canon|leviticus|26:43: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lies desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
live.canon|leviticus|26:4: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
live.canon|leviticus|26:8: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
live.canon|leviticus|26:9: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
live.canon|leviticus|26:11: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
live.canon|leviticus|26:19: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
live.canon|leviticus|26:20: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
live.canon|leviticus|26:22: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
live.canon|leviticus|26:24: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
live.canon|leviticus|26:28: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
live.canon|leviticus|26:30: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
live.canon|leviticus|26:2: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|26:3: If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
live.canon|leviticus|26:5: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
live.canon|leviticus|26:31: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
live.canon|leviticus|26:32: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
live.canon|leviticus|26:33: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
live.canon|leviticus|26:36: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
live.canon|leviticus|26:39: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
live.canon|leviticus|26:40: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
live.canon|leviticus|26:41: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
live.canon|leviticus|26:42: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
live.canon|leviticus|26:44: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
live.canon|leviticus|26:45: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|26:46: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which Yahuah (LORD) made between him and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|leviticus|27:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for Yahuah (LORD) by your estimation.
live.canon|leviticus|27:3: And your estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even your estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
live.canon|leviticus|27:5: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then your estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
live.canon|leviticus|27:6: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then your estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female your estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
live.canon|leviticus|27:7: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then your estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
live.canon|leviticus|27:8: But if he be poorer than your estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
live.canon|leviticus|27:9: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto Yahuah (LORD), all that any man gives of such unto Yahuah (LORD) shall be holy.
live.canon|leviticus|27:12: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as you valuest it, who are the priest, so shall it be.
live.canon|leviticus|27:13: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto your estimation.
live.canon|leviticus|27:15: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
live.canon|leviticus|27:16: And if a man shall sanctify unto Yahuah (LORD) some part of a field of his possession, then your estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
live.canon|leviticus|27:17: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to your estimation it shall stand.
live.canon|leviticus|27:18: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from your estimation.
live.canon|leviticus|27:19: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
live.canon|leviticus|27:21: But the field, when it goes out in the jubile, shall be holy unto Yahuah (LORD), as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
live.canon|leviticus|27:22: And if a man sanctify unto Yahuah (LORD) a field which he has bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
live.canon|leviticus|27:23: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of your estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give your estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|27:25: And all your estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
live.canon|leviticus|27:27: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to your estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your estimation.
live.canon|leviticus|27:28: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto Yahuah (LORD) of all that he has, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|27:32: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|27:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|leviticus|27:10: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
live.canon|leviticus|27:11: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto Yahuah (LORD), then he shall present the beast before the priest:
live.canon|leviticus|27:14: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto Yahuah (LORD), then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
live.canon|leviticus|27:20: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
live.canon|leviticus|27:24: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
live.canon|leviticus|27:26: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’S firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD’S.
live.canon|leviticus|27:29: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|leviticus|27:30: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’S: it is holy unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|leviticus|27:31: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
live.canon|leviticus|27:4: And if it be a female, then your estimation shall be thirty shekels.
live.canon|leviticus|27:33: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
live.canon|leviticus|27:34: These are the commandments, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in mount Sinai.
live.canon|luke|1:17: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for Yahuah (Lord).
live.canon|luke|1:13: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for your prayer is heard; and your wife Elisabeth shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
live.canon|luke|1:14: And you shall have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
live.canon|luke|1:19: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of Elohim (God); and am sent to speak unto you, and to shew you these glad tidings.
live.canon|luke|1:20: And, behold, you shall be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because you believe not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

live.canon|luke|1:28: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, you that are highly favoured, Yahuah (Lord) is with you: blessed are you among women.
live.canon|luke|1:30: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for you have found favour with Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|1:31: And, behold, you shall conceive in your womb, and bring forth a son, and shall call his name Yahusha (JESUS).
live.canon|luke|1:35: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall come upon you, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow you: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of you shall be called the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|1:36: And, behold, your cousin Elisabeth, she has also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
live.canon|luke|1:38: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of Yahuah (Lord); be it unto me according to your word. And the angel departed from her.
live.canon|luke|1:42: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb.
live.canon|luke|1:44: For, lo, as soon as the voice of your salutation sounded in my ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
live.canon|luke|1:46: And Mary said, My soul does magnify Yahuah (Lord),
live.canon|luke|1:47: And my spirit has rejoiced in Elohim (God) my Saviour.
live.canon|luke|1:48: For he has regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
live.canon|luke|1:49: For he that is mighty has done to me great things; and holy is his name.
live.canon|luke|1:51: He has shewed strength with his arm; he has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
live.canon|luke|1:52: He has put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
live.canon|luke|1:53: He has filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he has sent empty away.
live.canon|luke|1:54: He has holpen his servant Yashar'el (Israel), in remembrance of his mercy;

live.canon|luke|1:3: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto you in order, most excellent Theophilus,
live.canon|luke|1:4: That you might know the certainty of those things, wherein you have been instructed.
live.canon|luke|1:5: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abijah: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
live.canon|luke|1:1: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
live.canon|luke|1:2: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
live.canon|luke|1:6: And they were both righteous before Elohim (God), walking in all the commandments and ordinances of Yahuah (Lord) blameless.
live.canon|luke|1:7: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

live.canon|luke|1:9: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of Yahuah (Lord).
live.canon|luke|1:10: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
live.canon|luke|1:11: And there appeared unto him an angel of Yahuah (Lord) standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
live.canon|luke|1:12: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
live.canon|luke|1:15: For he shall be great in the sight of Yahuah (Lord), and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), even from his mother’s womb.
live.canon|luke|1:16: And many of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall he turn to Yahuah (Lord) their Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|1:18: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

live.canon|luke|1:22: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
live.canon|luke|1:23: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

live.canon|luke|1:32: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
live.canon|luke|1:33: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
live.canon|luke|1:34: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
live.canon|luke|1:37: For with Elohim (God) nothing shall be impossible.

live.canon|luke|5:19: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|luke|5:20: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.
live.canon|luke|5:25: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|5:26: And they were all amazed, and they glorified Elohim (God), and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
live.canon|luke|5:27: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
live.canon|luke|5:28: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
live.canon|luke|5:29: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
live.canon|luke|5:31: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
live.canon|luke|5:32: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
live.canon|luke|5:35: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
live.canon|luke|5:38: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
live.canon|luke|5:21: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but Elohim (God) alone?
live.canon|luke|5:12: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Yahusha (Jesus) fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.
live.canon|luke|5:8: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
live.canon|luke|5:17: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judæa, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
live.canon|luke|6:2: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do you that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
live.canon|luke|6:3: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering them said, Have you not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
live.canon|luke|6:10: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
live.canon|luke|6:20: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be you poor: for yours is the kingdom of Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|6:22: Blessed are you, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of Adam’s sake.
live.canon|luke|6:23: Rejoice you in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
live.canon|luke|6:25: Woe unto you that are full! for you shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for you shall mourn and weep.
live.canon|luke|6:29: And unto him that smites you on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that takes away your cloke forbid not to take your coat also.
live.canon|luke|6:30: Give to every man that asks of you; and of him that takes away your goods ask them not again.
live.canon|luke|6:31: And as you would that men should do to you, do you also to them likewise.
live.canon|luke|6:32: For if you love them which love you, what thank have you? for sinners also love those that love them.
live.canon|luke|6:33: And if you do good to them which do good to you, what thank have you? for sinners also do even the same.
live.canon|luke|6:34: And if you lend to them of whom you hope to receive, what thank have you? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
live.canon|luke|6:35: But love you your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and you shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
live.canon|luke|6:36: Be you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
live.canon|luke|6:37: Judge not, and you shall not be judged: condemn not, and you shall not be condemned: forgive, and you shall be forgiven:
live.canon|luke|6:38: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that you mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
live.canon|luke|6:41: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in your own eye?
live.canon|luke|6:42: Either how can you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in your eye, when you thyself behold not the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of your own eye, and then shall you see clearly to pull out the mote that is in your brother’s eye.
live.canon|luke|6:43: For a good tree brings not forth corrupt fruit; neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
live.canon|luke|6:45: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
live.canon|luke|6:47: Whosoever comes to me, and hears my sayings, and does them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
live.canon|luke|6:49: But he that hears, and does not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
live.canon|luke|6:1: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
live.canon|luke|6:4: How he went into the house of Elohim (God), and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
live.canon|luke|6:6: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
live.canon|luke|6:7: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
live.canon|luke|6:8: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
live.canon|luke|6:9: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
live.canon|luke|6:11: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|luke|6:12: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|6:13: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
live.canon|luke|6:14: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
live.canon|luke|6:15: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon called Zelotes,
live.canon|luke|6:16: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
live.canon|luke|6:17: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
live.canon|luke|6:18: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
live.canon|luke|6:19: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
live.canon|luke|6:26: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
live.canon|luke|6:21: Blessed are you that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are you that weep now: for you shall laugh.
live.canon|luke|6:24: But woe unto you that are rich! for you have received your consolation.
live.canon|luke|6:27: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
live.canon|luke|6:28: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
live.canon|luke|6:39: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
live.canon|luke|6:40: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
live.canon|luke|6:44: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
live.canon|luke|6:48: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
live.canon|luke|6:46: And why call you me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
live.canon|luke|6:5: And he said unto them, That the Son of Adam is the Lord also of the sabbath.
live.canon|luke|7:5: For he loves our nation, and he has built us a synagogue.
live.canon|luke|7:7: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto you: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
live.canon|luke|7:8: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.
live.canon|luke|7:14: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto you, Arise.
live.canon|luke|7:20: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist has sent us unto you, saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?
live.canon|luke|7:22: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things you have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
live.canon|luke|7:24: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
live.canon|luke|7:25: But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
live.canon|luke|7:27: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.
live.canon|luke|7:32: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you have not wept.
live.canon|luke|7:33: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and you say, He has a devil.
live.canon|luke|7:34: The Son of Adam is come eating and drinking; and you say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
live.canon|luke|7:39: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that touches him: for she is a sinner.
live.canon|luke|7:40: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto you. And he says, Master, say on.
live.canon|luke|7:43: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, You have rightly judged.
live.canon|luke|7:44: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, See you this woman? I entered into your house, you gave me no water for my feet: but she has washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
live.canon|luke|7:45: You gave me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in has not ceased to kiss my feet.
live.canon|luke|7:48: And he said unto her, Your sins are forgiven.
live.canon|luke|7:1: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
live.canon|luke|7:2: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
live.canon|luke|7:3: And when he heard of Yahusha (Jesus), he sent unto him the elders of the Yahudim (Jews), beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
live.canon|luke|7:4: And when they came to Yahusha (Jesus), they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
live.canon|luke|7:9: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|luke|7:10: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
live.canon|luke|7:11: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
live.canon|luke|7:12: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
live.canon|luke|7:15: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
live.canon|luke|7:17: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa, and throughout all the region round about.
live.canon|luke|7:18: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
live.canon|luke|7:50: And he said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.
live.canon|luke|7:46: My head with oil you did not anoint: but this woman has anointed my feet with ointment.
live.canon|luke|7:47: Wherefore I say unto you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.
live.canon|luke|7:16: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified Elohim (God), saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That Elohim (God) has visited his people.
live.canon|luke|7:21: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
live.canon|luke|7:23: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
live.canon|luke|7:28: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of Elohim (God) is greater than he.
live.canon|luke|7:29: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified Elohim (God), being baptized with the baptism of John.
live.canon|luke|7:30: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of Elohim (God) against themselves, being not baptized of him.
live.canon|luke|7:35: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
live.canon|luke|7:36: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
live.canon|luke|7:37: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Yahusha (Jesus) sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
live.canon|luke|7:38: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
live.canon|luke|7:41: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
live.canon|luke|7:42: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
live.canon|luke|7:49: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
live.canon|luke|7:19: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Yahusha (Jesus), saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?
live.canon|luke|7:26: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
live.canon|luke|7:6: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof:
live.canon|luke|7:13: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
live.canon|luke|7:31: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
live.canon|luke|8:30: And Yahusha (Jesus) asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
live.canon|luke|8:39: Return to your own house, and shew how great things Elohim (God) has done unto you. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Yahusha (Jesus) had done unto him.
live.canon|luke|8:1: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of Elohim (God): and the twelve were with him,
live.canon|luke|8:2: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
live.canon|luke|8:3: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
live.canon|luke|8:4: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
live.canon|luke|8:5: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
live.canon|luke|8:6: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
live.canon|luke|8:7: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
live.canon|luke|8:9: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
live.canon|luke|8:10: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of Elohim (God): but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
live.canon|luke|8:11: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of Elohim (God).
live.canon|luke|8:13: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
live.canon|luke|8:14: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
live.canon|luke|8:15: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
live.canon|luke|8:8: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
live.canon|luke|8:12: Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
live.canon|luke|8:16: No man, when he has lighted a candle, covers it with a vessel, or puts it under a bed; but sets it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
live.canon|luke|8:18: Take heed therefore how you hear: for whosoever has, to him shall be given; and whosoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.
live.canon|luke|8:20: And it was told him by certain which said, Your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to see you.
live.canon|luke|8:25: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commands even the winds and water, and they obey him.
live.canon|luke|8:28: When he saw Yahusha (Jesus), he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of Elohim (God) most high? I beseech you, torment me not.
live.canon|luke|8:17: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
live.canon|luke|8:19: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
live.canon|luke|8:21: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of Elohim (God), and do it.
live.canon|luke|8:22: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
live.canon|luke|8:23: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
live.canon|luke|8:24: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
live.canon|luke|8:26: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
live.canon|luke|8:27: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
live.canon|luke|8:29: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
live.canon|luke|8:31: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
live.canon|luke|8:32: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
live.canon|luke|8:33: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
live.canon|luke|8:34: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
live.canon|luke|8:35: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Yahusha (Jesus), and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Yahusha (Jesus), clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
live.canon|luke|8:36: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
live.canon|luke|8:37: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
live.canon|luke|8:38: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Yahusha (Jesus) sent him away, saying,
live.canon|luke|8:40: And it came to pass, that, when Yahusha (Jesus) was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
live.canon|luke|8:41: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
live.canon|luke|8:42: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
live.canon|luke|8:43: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
live.canon|luke|8:44: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
live.canon|luke|8:47: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
live.canon|luke|8:45: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng you and press you, and say you, Who touched me?
live.canon|luke|8:46: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Somebody has touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
live.canon|luke|8:48: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: your faith has made you whole; go in peace.
live.canon|luke|8:49: While he yet spake, there comes one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, Your daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
live.canon|luke|8:52: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleeps.
live.canon|luke|8:50: But when Yahusha (Jesus) heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
live.canon|luke|8:51: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
live.canon|luke|8:53: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
live.canon|luke|8:54: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
live.canon|luke|8:55: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
live.canon|luke|8:56: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
live.canon|luke|9:33: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Yahusha (Jesus), Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah: not knowing what he said.
live.canon|luke|9:54: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, will you that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elijah did?

live.canon|luke|22:57: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

live.canon|luke|23:2: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Messiah (Christ) a King.

live.canon|luke|23:8: And when Herod saw Yahusha (Jesus), he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
