live.canon|matthew|24:1: And Yahusha (Jesus) went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
live.canon|matthew|24:4: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
live.canon|matthew|24:5: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah (Christ); and shall deceive many.
live.canon|matthew|24:7: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
live.canon|matthew|24:8: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
live.canon|matthew|24:10: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
live.canon|matthew|24:11: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
live.canon|matthew|24:12: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
live.canon|matthew|24:13: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
live.canon|matthew|24:14: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
live.canon|matthew|24:16: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
live.canon|matthew|24:17: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
live.canon|matthew|24:18: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
live.canon|matthew|24:19: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
live.canon|matthew|24:21: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
live.canon|matthew|24:22: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
live.canon|matthew|24:23: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Messiah (Christ), or there; believe it not.
live.canon|matthew|24:24: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
live.canon|matthew|24:25: Behold, I have told you before.
live.canon|matthew|24:26: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
live.canon|matthew|24:28: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
live.canon|matthew|24:29: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
live.canon|matthew|24:30: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of Adam in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
live.canon|matthew|24:31: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
live.canon|matthew|24:34: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
live.canon|matthew|24:35: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
live.canon|matthew|24:2: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, See you not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
live.canon|matthew|24:3: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of your coming, and of the end of the world?

live.canon|matthew|24:40: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
live.canon|matthew|24:41: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
live.canon|matthew|24:43: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
live.canon|matthew|24:42: Watch therefore: for you know not what hour your Lord does come.
live.canon|matthew|24:47: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
live.canon|matthew|24:48: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

live.canon|matthew|25:6: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom comes; go you out to meet him.
live.canon|matthew|25:9: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go you rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
live.canon|matthew|25:13: Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of Adam comes.
live.canon|matthew|25:19: After a long time the lord of those servants comes, and reckoneth with them.
live.canon|matthew|25:21: His lord said unto him, Well done, you good and faithful servant: you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord.
live.canon|matthew|25:23: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord.
live.canon|matthew|25:25: And I was afraid, and went and hid your talent in the earth: lo, there you have that is yours.
live.canon|matthew|25:26: His lord answered and said unto him, You wicked and slothful servant, you knew that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
live.canon|matthew|25:27: You oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received my own with usury.
live.canon|matthew|25:28: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which has ten talents.
live.canon|matthew|25:29: For unto every one that has shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that has not shall be taken away even that which he has.
live.canon|matthew|25:30: And cast you the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
live.canon|matthew|25:32: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides his sheep from the goats:
live.canon|matthew|25:34: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, you blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
live.canon|matthew|25:35: For I was an hungred, and you gave me meat: I was thirsty, and you gave me drink: I was a stranger, and you took me in:
live.canon|matthew|25:36: Naked, and you clothed me: I was sick, and you visited me: I was in prison, and you came unto me.
live.canon|matthew|25:39: Or when saw we you sick, or in prison, and came unto you?
live.canon|matthew|25:40: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as you have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, you have done it unto me.
live.canon|matthew|25:41: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
live.canon|matthew|25:42: For I was an hungred, and you gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink:
live.canon|matthew|25:43: I was a stranger, and you took me not in: naked, and you clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and you visited me not.
live.canon|matthew|25:45: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as you did it not to one of the least of these, you did it not to me.
live.canon|matthew|25:1: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
live.canon|matthew|25:2: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
live.canon|matthew|25:3: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
live.canon|matthew|25:4: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
live.canon|matthew|25:5: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
live.canon|matthew|25:7: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
live.canon|matthew|25:8: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
live.canon|matthew|25:10: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
live.canon|matthew|25:12: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
live.canon|matthew|25:14: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
live.canon|matthew|25:15: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
live.canon|matthew|25:16: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
live.canon|matthew|25:17: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
live.canon|matthew|25:18: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

live.canon|matthew|25:33: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
live.canon|matthew|25:46: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
live.canon|matthew|25:38: When saw we you a stranger, and took you in? or naked, and clothed you?
live.canon|matthew|25:20: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, you delivered unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
live.canon|matthew|25:22: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, you delivered unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
live.canon|matthew|25:24: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew you that you are an hard man, reaping where you have not sown, and gathering where you have not strawed:

live.canon|matthew|25:11: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

live.canon|matthew|27:11: And Yahusha (Jesus) stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Yahudim (Jews)? And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, You say.
live.canon|matthew|27:13: Then said Pilate unto him, Hear you not how many things they witness against you?
live.canon|matthew|27:17: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will you that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Yahusha (Jesus) which is called Messiah (Christ)?
live.canon|matthew|27:19: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have you nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
live.canon|matthew|27:21: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will you that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
live.canon|matthew|27:22: Pilate says unto them, What shall I do then with Yahusha (Jesus) which is called Messiah (Christ)? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
live.canon|matthew|27:23: And the governor said, Why, what evil has he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

live.canon|matthew|27:1: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death:
live.canon|matthew|27:2: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
live.canon|matthew|27:3: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
live.canon|matthew|27:5: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
live.canon|matthew|27:6: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
live.canon|matthew|27:7: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
live.canon|matthew|27:8: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
live.canon|matthew|27:10: And gave them for the potter’s field, as Yahuah (Lord) appointed me.
live.canon|matthew|27:12: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
live.canon|matthew|27:14: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
live.canon|matthew|27:15: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
live.canon|matthew|27:16: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
live.canon|matthew|27:18: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
live.canon|matthew|27:20: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|matthew|27:25: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
live.canon|matthew|27:26: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Yahusha (Jesus), he delivered him to be crucified.
live.canon|matthew|27:27: Then the soldiers of the governor took Yahusha (Jesus) into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
live.canon|matthew|27:28: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
live.canon|matthew|27:29: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Yahudim (Jews)!
live.canon|matthew|27:30: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
live.canon|matthew|27:31: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
live.canon|matthew|27:32: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
live.canon|matthew|27:33: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
live.canon|matthew|27:34: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
live.canon|matthew|27:35: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
live.canon|matthew|27:36: And sitting down they watched him there;
live.canon|matthew|27:37: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS Yahusha (JESUS) THE KING OF THE JEWS.
live.canon|matthew|27:38: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
live.canon|matthew|27:39: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

live.canon|matthew|27:42: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Yashar'el (Israel), let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
live.canon|matthew|27:43: He trusted in Elohim (God); let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|27:44: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
