live.canon|matthew|27:51: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
live.canon|matthew|27:52: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
live.canon|matthew|27:53: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
live.canon|matthew|27:4: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see you to that.
live.canon|matthew|27:54: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Yahusha (Jesus), saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of Elohim (God).
live.canon|matthew|27:55: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Yahusha (Jesus) from Galilee, ministering unto him:
live.canon|matthew|27:56: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.
live.canon|matthew|27:57: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathæa, named Joseph, who also himself was Yahusha's (Jesus’) disciple:
live.canon|matthew|27:58: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Yahusha (Jesus). Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
live.canon|matthew|27:59: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
live.canon|matthew|27:60: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
live.canon|matthew|27:61: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
live.canon|matthew|27:49: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elijah will come to save him.
live.canon|matthew|27:62: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
live.canon|matthew|27:63: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
live.canon|matthew|27:64: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
live.canon|matthew|27:66: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
live.canon|matthew|28:5: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not you: for I know that you seek Yahusha (Jesus), which was crucified.
live.canon|matthew|28:7: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there shall you see him: lo, I have told you.
live.canon|matthew|28:13: Saying, Say you, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
live.canon|matthew|28:19: Go you therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
live.canon|matthew|28:1: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
live.canon|matthew|28:2: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of Yahuah (Lord) descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
live.canon|matthew|28:3: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
live.canon|matthew|28:4: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
live.canon|matthew|28:8: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
live.canon|matthew|28:9: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Yahusha (Jesus) met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
live.canon|matthew|28:10: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
live.canon|matthew|28:11: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
live.canon|matthew|28:12: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
live.canon|matthew|28:14: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
live.canon|matthew|28:15: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Yahudim (Jews) until this day.
live.canon|matthew|28:16: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Yahusha (Jesus) had appointed them.
live.canon|matthew|28:17: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
live.canon|matthew|28:18: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
live.canon|matthew|28:20: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
live.canon|matthew|28:6: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
live.canon|matthew|17:11: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Elijah truly shall first come, and restore all things.
live.canon|matthew|17:10: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elijah must first come?
live.canon|matthew|17:3: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elijah talking with him.
live.canon|matthew|17:4: Then answered Peter, and said unto Yahusha (Jesus), Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will, let us make here three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
live.canon|matthew|17:16: And I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.
live.canon|matthew|17:20: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
live.canon|matthew|17:21: Howbeit this kind goes not out but by prayer and fasting.
live.canon|matthew|17:24: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Does not your master pay tribute?
live.canon|matthew|17:25: He says, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Yahusha (Jesus) prevented him, saying, What thinkest you, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
live.canon|matthew|17:26: Peter says unto him, Of strangers. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Then are the children free.
live.canon|matthew|17:27: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go you to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first comes up; and when you have opened his mouth, you shall find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and you.
live.canon|matthew|17:1: And after six days Yahusha (Jesus) takes Peter, James, and John his brother, and brings them up into an high mountain apart,
live.canon|matthew|17:2: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
live.canon|matthew|17:6: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
live.canon|matthew|17:7: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
live.canon|matthew|17:8: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Yahusha (Jesus) only.
live.canon|matthew|17:9: And as they came down from the mountain, Yahusha (Jesus) charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of Adam be risen again from the dead.
live.canon|matthew|17:13: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
live.canon|matthew|17:14: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
live.canon|matthew|17:17: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
live.canon|matthew|17:18: And Yahusha (Jesus) rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
live.canon|matthew|17:19: Then came the disciples to Yahusha (Jesus) apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
live.canon|matthew|17:22: And while they abode in Galilee, Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, The Son of Adam shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
live.canon|matthew|17:23: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
live.canon|matthew|17:5: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear you him.
live.canon|matthew|17:12: But I say unto you, That Elijah is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of Adam suffer of them.
live.canon|matthew|17:15: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falls into the fire, and oft into the water.
live.canon|micah|1:3: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) comes forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
live.canon|micah|1:10: Declare you it not at Gath, weep you not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
live.canon|micah|1:11: Pass you away, you inhabitant of Saphir, having your shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
live.canon|micah|1:13: O you inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Yashar'el (Israel) were found in you.
live.canon|micah|1:14: Therefore shall you give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|micah|1:15: Yet will I bring an heir unto you, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|micah|1:16: Make you bald, and poll you for your delicate children; enlarge your baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from you.
live.canon|micah|1:1: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah (Judah), which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
live.canon|micah|1:4: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
live.canon|micah|1:5: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Yashar'el (Israel). What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Yahudah (Judah)? are they not Jerusalem?
live.canon|micah|1:6: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
live.canon|micah|1:7: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
live.canon|micah|1:8: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
live.canon|micah|1:9: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Yahudah (Judah); he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
live.canon|micah|1:12: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from Yahuah (LORD) unto the gate of Jerusalem.
live.canon|micah|1:2: Hear, all you people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) be witness against you, Adonai (Lord) from his holy temple.
live.canon|micah|2:3: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which you shall not remove your necks; neither shall you go haughtily: for this time is evil.
live.canon|micah|2:4: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he has changed the portion of my people: how has he removed it from me! turning away he has divided our fields.
live.canon|micah|2:5: Therefore you shall have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|micah|2:6: Prophesy you not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
live.canon|micah|2:7: O you that are named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walks uprightly?
live.canon|micah|2:8: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: you pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
live.canon|micah|2:9: The women of my people have you cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have you taken away my glory for ever.
live.canon|micah|2:10: Arise you, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
live.canon|micah|2:11: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto you of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
live.canon|micah|2:12: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of you; I will surely gather the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel); I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
live.canon|micah|2:1: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
live.canon|micah|2:2: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
live.canon|micah|2:13: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and Yahuah (LORD) on the head of them.
live.canon|micah|3:1: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and you princes of the house of Yashar'el (Israel); Is it not for you to know judgment?
live.canon|micah|3:5: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that puts not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
live.canon|micah|3:6: Therefore night shall be unto you, that you shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that you shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
live.canon|micah|3:2: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
live.canon|micah|3:3: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
live.canon|micah|3:4: Then shall they cry unto Yahuah (LORD), but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
live.canon|micah|3:7: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of Elohim (God).
live.canon|micah|3:8: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of Yahuah (LORD), and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his sin.
live.canon|micah|3:9: Hear this, I pray you, you heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
live.canon|micah|3:10: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
live.canon|micah|3:11: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon Yahuah (LORD), and say, Is not Yahuah (LORD) among us? none evil can come upon us.
live.canon|micah|3:12: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
live.canon|micah|4:4: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has spoken it.
live.canon|micah|4:6: In that day, says Yahuah (LORD), will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
live.canon|micah|4:8: And you, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto you shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
live.canon|micah|4:9: Now why do you cry out aloud? is there no king in you? is your counsellor perished? for pangs have taken you as a woman in travail.
live.canon|micah|4:10: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shall you go forth out of the city, and you shall dwell in the field, and you shall go even to Babylon; there shall you be delivered; there Yahuah (LORD) shall redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
live.canon|micah|4:11: Now also many nations are gathered against you, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
live.canon|micah|4:1: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of Yahuah (LORD) shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
live.canon|micah|4:2: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), and to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.
live.canon|micah|4:3: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
live.canon|micah|4:5: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) for ever and ever.
live.canon|micah|4:7: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahuah (LORD) shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
live.canon|micah|4:12: But they know not the thoughts of Yahuah (LORD), neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
live.canon|micah|4:13: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs brass: and you shall beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto Yahuah (LORD), and their substance unto Adonai (Lord) of the whole earth.
live.canon|micah|5:1: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he has laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Yashar'el (Israel) with a rod upon the cheek.
live.canon|micah|5:2: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
live.canon|micah|5:3: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth has brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|micah|5:6: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he comes into our land, and when he treads within our borders.
live.canon|micah|5:7: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from Yahuah (LORD), as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waits for the sons of men.
live.canon|micah|5:8: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treads down, and tears in pieces, and none can deliver.
live.canon|micah|5:9: Your hand shall be lifted up upon your adversaries, and all your enemies shall be cut off.
live.canon|micah|5:10: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will cut off your horses out of the midst of you, and I will destroy your chariots:
live.canon|micah|5:11: And I will cut off the cities of your land, and throw down all your strong holds:
live.canon|micah|5:12: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of your hand; and you shall have no more soothsayers:
live.canon|micah|5:13: Your graven images also will I cut off, and your standing images out of the midst of you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
live.canon|micah|5:4: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of Yahuah (LORD), in the majesty of the name of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God); and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
live.canon|micah|5:5: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
live.canon|micah|5:15: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
live.canon|micah|5:14: And I will pluck up your groves out of the midst of you: so will I destroy your cities.
live.canon|micah|6:2: Hear you, O mountains, the LORD’S controversy, and you strong foundations of the earth: for Yahuah (LORD) has a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|micah|6:4: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of servants; and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
live.canon|micah|6:5: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that you may know the righteousness of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|micah|6:8: He has shewed you, O man, what is good; and what does Yahuah (LORD) require of you, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your Elohim (God)?
live.canon|micah|6:9: The LORD’S voice cries unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see your name: hear you the rod, and who has appointed it.
live.canon|micah|6:13: Therefore also will I make you sick in smiting you, in making you desolate because of your sins.
live.canon|micah|6:14: You shall eat, but not be satisfied; and your casting down shall be in the midst of you; and you shall take hold, but shall not deliver; and that which you deliverest will I give up to the sword.
live.canon|micah|6:15: You shall sow, but you shall not reap; you shall tread the olives, but you shall not anoint you with oil; and sweet wine, but shall not drink wine.
live.canon|micah|6:16: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you walk in their counsels; that I should make you a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore you shall bear the reproach of my people.
live.canon|micah|6:6: Wherewith shall I come before Yahuah (LORD), and bow myself before the high Elohim (God)? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
live.canon|micah|6:7: Will Yahuah (LORD) be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
live.canon|micah|6:10: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
live.canon|micah|6:11: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
live.canon|micah|6:12: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
live.canon|micah|6:1: Hear you now what Yahuah (LORD) says; Arise, contend you before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
live.canon|micah|6:3: O my people, what have I done unto you? and wherein have I wearied you? testify against me.
live.canon|micah|7:3: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asks, and the judge asks for a reward; and the great man, he utters his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
live.canon|micah|7:4: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of your watchmen and your visitation comes; now shall be their perplexity.
live.canon|micah|7:5: Trust you not in a friend, put you not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of your mouth from her that lies in your bosom.
live.canon|micah|7:6: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
live.canon|micah|7:8: Rejoice not against me, O my enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, Yahuah (LORD) shall be a light unto me.
live.canon|micah|7:10: Then she that is my enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God)? my eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
live.canon|micah|7:11: In the day that your walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
live.canon|micah|7:12: In that day also he shall come even to you from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
live.canon|micah|7:14: Feed your people with your rod, the flock of your heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
live.canon|micah|7:15: According to the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
live.canon|micah|7:17: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and shall fear because of you.
live.canon|micah|7:18: Who is a Elohim (God) like unto you, that pardoneth iniquity, and passes by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delights in mercy.
live.canon|micah|7:19: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
live.canon|micah|7:20: You will perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which you have sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
live.canon|micah|7:1: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
live.canon|micah|7:2: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
live.canon|micah|7:7: Therefore I will look unto Yahuah (LORD); I will wait for the Elohim (God) of my salvation: my Elohim (God) will hear me.
live.canon|micah|7:9: I will bear the indignation of Yahuah (LORD), because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
live.canon|micah|7:13: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
live.canon|micah|7:16: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
live.canon|numbers|1:2: Take you the sum of all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
live.canon|numbers|1:3: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Yashar'el (Israel): you and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
live.canon|numbers|1:50: But you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
live.canon|numbers|1:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
live.canon|numbers|1:4: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
live.canon|numbers|1:5: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
live.canon|numbers|1:6: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|1:7: Of Yahudah (Judah); Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
live.canon|numbers|1:8: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
live.canon|numbers|1:9: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
live.canon|numbers|1:10: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
live.canon|numbers|1:11: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
live.canon|numbers|1:12: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|1:13: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
live.canon|numbers|1:14: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
live.canon|numbers|1:15: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
live.canon|numbers|1:16: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|1:17: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
live.canon|numbers|1:18: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
live.canon|numbers|1:19: As Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
live.canon|numbers|1:20: And the children of Reuben, Yashar'el's (Israel’s) eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:21: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:22: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:23: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:24: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:25: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
live.canon|numbers|1:26: Of the children of Yahudah (Judah), by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:27: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:28: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:29: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:30: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:31: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:32: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:33: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:34: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:35: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:36: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:37: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:38: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:39: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:40: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:41: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:42: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
live.canon|numbers|1:43: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|1:44: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Yashar'el (Israel), being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
live.canon|numbers|1:45: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|numbers|1:46: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
live.canon|numbers|1:47: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
live.canon|numbers|1:48: For Yahuah (LORD) had spoken unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|1:52: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
live.canon|numbers|1:53: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
live.canon|numbers|1:54: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did according to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so did they.
live.canon|numbers|1:49: Only you shall not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|numbers|1:51: And when the tabernacle sets forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that comes nigh shall be put to death.
live.canon|numbers|2:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|numbers|2:2: Every man of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
live.canon|numbers|2:3: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Yahudah (Judah) pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|numbers|2:4: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:5: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
live.canon|numbers|2:6: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:7: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
live.canon|numbers|2:8: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:9: All that were numbered in the camp of Yahudah (Judah) were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
live.canon|numbers|2:10: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
live.canon|numbers|2:11: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:12: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|2:13: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:14: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
live.canon|numbers|2:15: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
live.canon|numbers|2:16: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
live.canon|numbers|2:17: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
live.canon|numbers|2:18: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
live.canon|numbers|2:19: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:20: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
live.canon|numbers|2:21: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:22: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
live.canon|numbers|2:23: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:24: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
live.canon|numbers|2:25: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|2:26: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:27: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
live.canon|numbers|2:28: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:29: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
live.canon|numbers|2:30: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|2:31: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
live.canon|numbers|2:32: These are those which were numbered of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
live.canon|numbers|2:33: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Yashar'el (Israel); as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|2:34: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did according to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
live.canon|numbers|3:9: And you shall give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|3:10: And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that comes nigh shall be put to death.
live.canon|numbers|3:12: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel) instead of all the firstborn that opens the matrix among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): therefore the Levites shall be mine;
live.canon|numbers|3:13: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Yashar'el (Israel), both man and beast: my shall they be: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|3:15: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shall you number them.
live.canon|numbers|3:36: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serves thereto,
live.canon|numbers|3:38: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and the stranger that comes nigh shall be put to death.
live.canon|numbers|3:41: And you shall take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|3:47: You shall even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shall you take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
live.canon|numbers|3:48: And you shall give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
live.canon|numbers|3:1: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahuah (LORD) spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
live.canon|numbers|3:2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
live.canon|numbers|3:3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
live.canon|numbers|3:4: And Nadab and Abihu died before Yahuah (LORD), when they offered strange fire before Yahuah (LORD), in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.
live.canon|numbers|3:5: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|3:6: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
live.canon|numbers|3:7: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
live.canon|numbers|3:8: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), to do the service of the tabernacle.
live.canon|numbers|3:11: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|3:14: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
live.canon|numbers|3:16: And Moses numbered them according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), as he was commanded.
live.canon|numbers|3:17: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
live.canon|numbers|3:18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
live.canon|numbers|3:19: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
live.canon|numbers|3:20: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
live.canon|numbers|3:21: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
live.canon|numbers|3:22: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|3:23: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
live.canon|numbers|3:24: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
live.canon|numbers|3:25: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
live.canon|numbers|3:26: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
live.canon|numbers|3:27: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
live.canon|numbers|3:28: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
live.canon|numbers|3:29: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
live.canon|numbers|3:30: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
live.canon|numbers|3:31: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
live.canon|numbers|3:32: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
live.canon|numbers|3:33: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
live.canon|numbers|3:34: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
live.canon|numbers|3:35: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
live.canon|numbers|3:37: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
live.canon|numbers|3:39: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
live.canon|numbers|3:40: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
live.canon|numbers|3:42: And Moses numbered, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|3:43: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
live.canon|numbers|3:44: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|3:45: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|3:46: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which are more than the Levites;
live.canon|numbers|3:49: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
live.canon|numbers|3:50: Of the firstborn of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
live.canon|numbers|3:51: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|4:5: And when the camp sets forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
live.canon|numbers|4:27: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and you shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
live.canon|numbers|4:30: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shall you number them, every one that enters into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|4:32: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
live.canon|numbers|4:35: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that enters into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
live.canon|numbers|4:39: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that enters into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
live.canon|numbers|4:43: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that enters into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
live.canon|numbers|4:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|numbers|4:2: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
live.canon|numbers|4:3: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|4:4: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
live.canon|numbers|4:6: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
live.canon|numbers|4:7: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
live.canon|numbers|4:8: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
live.canon|numbers|4:9: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
live.canon|numbers|4:10: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
live.canon|numbers|4:11: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
live.canon|numbers|4:12: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:
live.canon|numbers|4:13: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
live.canon|numbers|4:14: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.
live.canon|numbers|4:15: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|4:16: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
live.canon|numbers|4:17: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|numbers|4:19: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
live.canon|numbers|4:20: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
live.canon|numbers|4:21: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|4:22: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
live.canon|numbers|4:24: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
live.canon|numbers|4:25: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
live.canon|numbers|4:26: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
live.canon|numbers|4:28: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
live.canon|numbers|4:31: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
live.canon|numbers|4:33: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
live.canon|numbers|4:34: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
live.canon|numbers|4:36: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
live.canon|numbers|4:37: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|numbers|4:38: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
live.canon|numbers|4:40: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
live.canon|numbers|4:41: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|4:42: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
live.canon|numbers|4:44: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
live.canon|numbers|4:45: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|numbers|4:46: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Yashar'el (Israel) numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
live.canon|numbers|4:47: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
live.canon|numbers|4:48: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
live.canon|numbers|4:18: Cut you not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
live.canon|numbers|4:23: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shall you number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|4:29: As for the sons of Merari, you shall number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
live.canon|numbers|4:49: According to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|5:2: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that has an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
live.canon|numbers|5:3: Both male and female shall you put out, without the camp shall you put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
live.canon|numbers|5:7: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he has trespassed.
live.canon|numbers|5:10: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.
live.canon|numbers|5:18: And the priest shall set the woman before Yahuah (LORD), and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causes the curse:
live.canon|numbers|5:19: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with you, and if you have not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of your husband, be you free from this bitter water that causes the curse:
live.canon|numbers|5:20: But if you have gone aside to another instead of your husband, and if you be defiled, and some man have lain with you beside your husband:
live.canon|numbers|5:21: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, Yahuah (LORD) make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahuah (LORD) does make your thigh to rot, and your belly to swell;
live.canon|numbers|5:22: And this water that causes the curse shall go into your bowels, to make your belly to swell, and your thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
live.canon|numbers|5:24: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causes the curse: and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
live.canon|numbers|5:27: And when he has made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
live.canon|numbers|5:29: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goes aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
live.canon|numbers|5:30: Or when the spirit of jealousy comes upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before Yahuah (LORD), and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
live.canon|numbers|5:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|5:4: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so, and put them out without the camp: as Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, so did the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|5:5: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|5:6: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against Yahuah (LORD), and that person be guilty;
live.canon|numbers|5:8: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto Yahuah (LORD), even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
live.canon|numbers|5:9: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
live.canon|numbers|5:11: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|5:12: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
live.canon|numbers|5:13: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
live.canon|numbers|5:14: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
live.canon|numbers|5:15: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
live.canon|numbers|5:16: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|numbers|5:17: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
live.canon|numbers|5:23: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
live.canon|numbers|5:25: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before Yahuah (LORD), and offer it upon the altar:
live.canon|numbers|5:26: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
live.canon|numbers|5:28: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
live.canon|numbers|5:31: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
live.canon|numbers|6:25: Yahuah (LORD) make his face shine upon you, and be gracious unto you:
live.canon|numbers|6:26: Yahuah (LORD) lift up his countenance upon you, and give you peace.
live.canon|numbers|6:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|6:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|numbers|6:3: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
live.canon|numbers|6:4: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
live.canon|numbers|6:5: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto Yahuah (LORD), he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
live.canon|numbers|6:6: All the days that he separateth himself unto Yahuah (LORD) he shall come at no dead body.
live.canon|numbers|6:7: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his Elohim (God) is upon his head.
live.canon|numbers|6:8: All the days of his separation he is holy unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|6:10: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
live.canon|numbers|6:11: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
live.canon|numbers|6:12: And he shall consecrate unto Yahuah (LORD) the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
live.canon|numbers|6:13: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
live.canon|numbers|6:14: And he shall offer his offering unto Yahuah (LORD), one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
live.canon|numbers|6:15: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
live.canon|numbers|6:16: And the priest shall bring them before Yahuah (LORD), and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|6:17: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD), with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|6:18: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
live.canon|numbers|6:19: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
live.canon|numbers|6:20: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD): this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
live.canon|numbers|6:22: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|6:27: And they shall put my name upon the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and I will bless them.
live.canon|numbers|6:9: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he has defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
live.canon|numbers|6:21: This is the law of the Nazarite who has vowed, and of his offering unto Yahuah (LORD) for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
live.canon|numbers|6:23: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise you shall bless the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying unto them,
live.canon|numbers|6:24: Yahuah (LORD) bless you, and keep you:
live.canon|numbers|7:5: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and you shall give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
live.canon|numbers|7:1: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
live.canon|numbers|7:2: That the princes of Yashar'el (Israel), heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
live.canon|numbers|7:3: And they brought their offering before Yahuah (LORD), six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
live.canon|numbers|7:4: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|7:6: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
live.canon|numbers|7:7: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
live.canon|numbers|7:8: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
live.canon|numbers|7:9: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
live.canon|numbers|7:10: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
live.canon|numbers|7:11: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
live.canon|numbers|7:12: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah):
live.canon|numbers|7:13: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:14: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:15: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:16: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:17: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
live.canon|numbers|7:18: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
live.canon|numbers|7:19: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:20: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:21: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:22: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:23: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
live.canon|numbers|7:24: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:
live.canon|numbers|7:25: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:26: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:27: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:28: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:29: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
live.canon|numbers|7:30: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:
live.canon|numbers|7:31: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

live.canon|numbers|7:34: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:35: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.
live.canon|numbers|7:36: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:
live.canon|numbers|7:37: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:38: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:39: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:40: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:41: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|7:42: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:
live.canon|numbers|7:43: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:44: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:45: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:46: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:47: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
live.canon|numbers|7:48: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:
live.canon|numbers|7:49: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:50: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:51: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:52: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:53: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
live.canon|numbers|7:54: On the eighth day offered Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh:
live.canon|numbers|7:55: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:56: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:57: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:58: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:59: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
live.canon|numbers|7:60: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered:
live.canon|numbers|7:61: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:62: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:63: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:64: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:65: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.
live.canon|numbers|7:66: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, offered:
live.canon|numbers|7:67: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:68: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
