live.canon|numbers|7:69: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:70: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:71: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|7:72: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:
live.canon|numbers|7:73: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:74: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:75: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:76: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:77: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
live.canon|numbers|7:78: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
live.canon|numbers|7:79: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:80: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
live.canon|numbers|7:81: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:82: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
live.canon|numbers|7:83: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
live.canon|numbers|7:84: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Yashar'el (Israel): twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
live.canon|numbers|7:85: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
live.canon|numbers|7:86: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
live.canon|numbers|7:87: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
live.canon|numbers|7:88: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
live.canon|numbers|7:89: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
live.canon|numbers|8:8: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shall you take for a sin offering.
live.canon|numbers|8:9: And you shall bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and you shall gather the whole assembly of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) together:
live.canon|numbers|8:10: And you shall bring the Levites before Yahuah (LORD): and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall put their hands upon the Levites:
live.canon|numbers|8:12: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement for the Levites.
live.canon|numbers|8:13: And you shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|8:14: Thus shall you separate the Levites from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and the Levites shall be mine.
live.canon|numbers|8:15: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
live.canon|numbers|8:24: This is it that belongs unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
live.canon|numbers|8:26: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shall you do unto the Levites touching their charge.
live.canon|numbers|8:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|8:3: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|8:4: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which Yahuah (LORD) had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
live.canon|numbers|8:5: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|8:6: Take the Levites from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and cleanse them.
live.canon|numbers|8:11: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahuah (LORD) for an offering of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they may execute the service of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|8:2: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When you lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
live.canon|numbers|8:16: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel); instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), have I taken them unto me.
live.canon|numbers|8:17: For all the firstborn of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
live.canon|numbers|8:18: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|8:19: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), to do the service of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Yashar'el (Israel): that there be no plague among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) come nigh unto the sanctuary.
live.canon|numbers|8:20: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), did to the Levites according unto all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Yashar'el (Israel) unto them.
live.canon|numbers|8:21: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before Yahuah (LORD); and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
live.canon|numbers|8:7: And thus shall you do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
live.canon|numbers|8:22: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
live.canon|numbers|8:23: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|8:25: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
live.canon|numbers|9:3: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, you shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall you keep it.
live.canon|numbers|9:14: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto Yahuah (LORD); according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: you shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
live.canon|numbers|9:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
live.canon|numbers|9:2: Let the children of Yashar'el (Israel) also keep the passover at his appointed season.
live.canon|numbers|9:4: And Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they should keep the passover.
live.canon|numbers|9:5: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so did the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|9:6: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
live.canon|numbers|9:7: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of Yahuah (LORD) in his appointed season among the children of Yashar'el (Israel)?
live.canon|numbers|9:8: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what Yahuah (LORD) will command concerning you.
live.canon|numbers|9:9: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|9:10: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|9:11: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
live.canon|numbers|9:12: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
live.canon|numbers|9:13: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of Yahuah (LORD) in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
live.canon|numbers|9:15: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
live.canon|numbers|9:16: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
live.canon|numbers|9:17: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Yashar'el (Israel) pitched their tents.
live.canon|numbers|9:18: At the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed, and at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
live.canon|numbers|9:19: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Yashar'el (Israel) kept the charge of Yahuah (LORD), and journeyed not.
live.canon|numbers|9:20: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they journeyed.
live.canon|numbers|9:21: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
live.canon|numbers|9:22: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
live.canon|numbers|9:23: At the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they journeyed: they kept the charge of Yahuah (LORD), at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|numbers|10:2: Make you two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shall you make them: that you may use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
live.canon|numbers|10:3: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to you at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|10:4: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel), shall gather themselves unto you.
live.canon|numbers|10:5: When you blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
live.canon|numbers|10:6: When you blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
live.canon|numbers|10:7: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
live.canon|numbers|10:9: And if you go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresses you, then you shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and you shall be remembered before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and you shall be saved from your enemies.
live.canon|numbers|10:10: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|numbers|10:29: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which Yahuah (LORD) said, I will give it you: come you with us, and we will do you good: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken good concerning Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|10:31: And he said, Leave us not, I pray you; forasmuch as you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you may be to us instead of eyes.
live.canon|numbers|10:32: And it shall be, if you go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness Yahuah (LORD) shall do unto us, the same will we do unto you.
live.canon|numbers|10:35: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Yahuah (LORD), and let your enemies be scattered; and let them that hate you flee before you.
live.canon|numbers|10:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|10:8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
live.canon|numbers|10:11: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
live.canon|numbers|10:12: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
live.canon|numbers|10:13: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|numbers|10:14: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Yahudah (Judah) according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
live.canon|numbers|10:15: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
live.canon|numbers|10:16: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
live.canon|numbers|10:17: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
live.canon|numbers|10:18: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
live.canon|numbers|10:19: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|10:20: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
live.canon|numbers|10:21: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
live.canon|numbers|10:22: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
live.canon|numbers|10:23: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
live.canon|numbers|10:24: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
live.canon|numbers|10:25: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
live.canon|numbers|10:26: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
live.canon|numbers|10:27: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
live.canon|numbers|10:28: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) according to their armies, when they set forward.
live.canon|numbers|10:33: And they departed from the mount of Yahuah (LORD) three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.
live.canon|numbers|10:34: And the cloud of Yahuah (LORD) was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
live.canon|numbers|10:36: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Yahuah (LORD), unto the many thousands of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|10:30: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my kindred.
live.canon|numbers|11:11: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), Wherefore have you afflicted your servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in your sight, that you layest the burden of all this people upon me?
live.canon|numbers|11:12: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that you should say unto me, Carry them in your bosom, as a nursing father bears the sucking child, unto the land which you swore unto their fathers?
live.canon|numbers|11:15: And if you deal thus with me, kill me, I pray you, out of hand, if I have found favour in your sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
live.canon|numbers|11:16: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with you.
live.canon|numbers|11:17: And I will come down and talk with you there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon you, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you bear it not thyself alone.
live.canon|numbers|11:18: And say you unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and you shall eat flesh: for you have wept in the ears of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore Yahuah (LORD) will give you flesh, and you shall eat.
live.canon|numbers|11:19: You shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
live.canon|numbers|11:20: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that you have despised Yahuah (LORD) which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
live.canon|numbers|11:21: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and you have said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
live.canon|numbers|11:23: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Is the LORD’S hand waxed short? you shall see now whether my word shall come to pass unto you or not.
live.canon|numbers|11:29: And Moses said unto him, Enviest you for my sake? would Elohim (God) that all the LORD’S people were prophets, and that Yahuah (LORD) would put his spirit upon them!
live.canon|numbers|11:1: And when the people complained, it displeased Yahuah (LORD): and Yahuah (LORD) heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of Yahuah (LORD) burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
live.canon|numbers|11:2: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), the fire was quenched.
live.canon|numbers|11:3: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of Yahuah (LORD) burnt among them.
live.canon|numbers|11:4: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
live.canon|numbers|11:5: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
live.canon|numbers|11:6: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
live.canon|numbers|11:7: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
live.canon|numbers|11:8: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
live.canon|numbers|11:9: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
live.canon|numbers|11:10: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
live.canon|numbers|11:13: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
live.canon|numbers|11:14: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
live.canon|numbers|11:22: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
live.canon|numbers|11:24: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Yahuah (LORD), and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
live.canon|numbers|11:25: And Yahuah (LORD) came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
live.canon|numbers|11:26: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
live.canon|numbers|11:27: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
live.canon|numbers|11:28: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
live.canon|numbers|11:30: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|11:31: And there went forth a wind from Yahuah (LORD), and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
live.canon|numbers|11:32: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
live.canon|numbers|11:33: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against the people, and Yahuah (LORD) smote the people with a very great plague.
live.canon|numbers|11:34: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
live.canon|numbers|11:35: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
live.canon|numbers|12:2: And they said, Has Yahuah (LORD) indeed spoken only by Moses? has he not spoken also by us? And Yahuah (LORD) heard it.
live.canon|numbers|12:4: And Yahuah (LORD) spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out you three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
live.canon|numbers|12:8: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of Yahuah (LORD) shall he behold: wherefore then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
live.canon|numbers|12:11: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech you, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
live.canon|numbers|12:12: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.
live.canon|numbers|12:13: And Moses cried unto Yahuah (LORD), saying, Heal her now, O Elohim (God), I beseech you.
live.canon|numbers|12:1: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
live.canon|numbers|12:3: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
live.canon|numbers|12:5: And Yahuah (LORD) came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
live.canon|numbers|12:6: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I Yahuah (LORD) will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
live.canon|numbers|12:9: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against them; and he departed.
live.canon|numbers|12:10: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
live.canon|numbers|12:14: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
live.canon|numbers|12:15: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
live.canon|numbers|12:16: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
live.canon|numbers|12:7: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all my house.
live.canon|numbers|13:2: Send you men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): of every tribe of their fathers shall you send a man, every one a ruler among them.
live.canon|numbers|13:32: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eats up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
live.canon|numbers|13:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|13:3: And Moses by the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|13:4: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
live.canon|numbers|13:5: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
live.canon|numbers|13:6: Of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
live.canon|numbers|13:7: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
live.canon|numbers|13:8: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
live.canon|numbers|13:9: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
live.canon|numbers|13:10: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
live.canon|numbers|13:11: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
live.canon|numbers|13:12: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
live.canon|numbers|13:13: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
live.canon|numbers|13:14: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
live.canon|numbers|13:15: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
live.canon|numbers|13:16: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
live.canon|numbers|13:17: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
live.canon|numbers|13:19: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
live.canon|numbers|13:21: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
live.canon|numbers|13:22: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
live.canon|numbers|13:23: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
live.canon|numbers|13:24: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cut down from thence.
live.canon|numbers|13:25: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
live.canon|numbers|13:26: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
live.canon|numbers|13:28: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
live.canon|numbers|13:29: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
live.canon|numbers|13:30: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
live.canon|numbers|13:31: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
live.canon|numbers|13:33: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
live.canon|numbers|13:18: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwells therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
live.canon|numbers|13:20: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be you of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
live.canon|numbers|13:27: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither you sentest us, and surely it flows with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
live.canon|numbers|14:3: And wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
live.canon|numbers|14:8: If Yahuah (LORD) delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which flows with milk and honey.
live.canon|numbers|14:9: Only rebel not you against Yahuah (LORD), neither fear you the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and Yahuah (LORD) is with us: fear them not.
live.canon|numbers|14:12: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a greater nation and mightier than they.
live.canon|numbers|14:13: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for you brought up this people in your might from among them;)
live.canon|numbers|14:14: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that you Yahuah (LORD) are among this people, that you Yahuah (LORD) are seen face to face, and that your cloud stands over them, and that you go before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
live.canon|numbers|14:15: Now if you shall kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
live.canon|numbers|14:16: Because Yahuah (LORD) was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.
live.canon|numbers|14:43: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword: because you are turned away from Yahuah (LORD), therefore Yahuah (LORD) will not be with you.
live.canon|numbers|14:1: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
live.canon|numbers|14:2: And all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would Elohim (God) that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would Elohim (God) we had died in this wilderness!
live.canon|numbers|14:4: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
live.canon|numbers|14:5: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|14:6: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
live.canon|numbers|14:7: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
live.canon|numbers|14:10: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|14:11: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
live.canon|numbers|14:18: Yahuah (LORD) is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
live.canon|numbers|14:21: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|14:22: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
live.canon|numbers|14:23: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
live.canon|numbers|14:25: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
live.canon|numbers|14:26: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|numbers|14:27: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which they murmur against me.
live.canon|numbers|14:29: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
live.canon|numbers|14:32: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
live.canon|numbers|14:33: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
live.canon|numbers|14:35: I Yahuah (LORD) have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
live.canon|numbers|14:36: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
live.canon|numbers|14:37: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|14:38: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
live.canon|numbers|14:39: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and the people mourned greatly.
live.canon|numbers|14:44: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
live.canon|numbers|14:45: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
live.canon|numbers|14:17: And now, I beseech you, let the power of my Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
live.canon|numbers|14:19: Pardon, I beseech you, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of your mercy, and as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
live.canon|numbers|14:20: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I have pardoned according to your word:
live.canon|numbers|14:24: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
live.canon|numbers|14:28: Say unto them, As truly as I live, says Yahuah (LORD), as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you:
live.canon|numbers|14:30: Doubtless you shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
live.canon|numbers|14:31: But your little ones, which you said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which you have despised.
live.canon|numbers|14:34: After the number of the days in which you searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall you bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you shall know my breach of promise.
live.canon|numbers|14:40: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which Yahuah (LORD) has promised: for we have sinned.
live.canon|numbers|14:41: And Moses said, Wherefore now do you transgress the commandment of Yahuah (LORD)? but it shall not prosper.
live.canon|numbers|14:42: Go not up, for Yahuah (LORD) is not among you; that you be not smitten before your enemies.
live.canon|numbers|15:4: Then shall he that offers his offering unto Yahuah (LORD) bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
live.canon|numbers|15:5: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shall you prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
live.canon|numbers|15:6: Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
live.canon|numbers|15:7: And for a drink offering you shall offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|15:8: And when you preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|numbers|15:10: And you shall bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|15:12: According to the number that you shall prepare, so shall you do to every one according to their number.
live.canon|numbers|15:14: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD); as you do, so he shall do.
live.canon|numbers|15:15: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourns with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as you are, so shall the stranger be before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|15:16: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourns with you.
live.canon|numbers|15:18: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you come into the land whither I bring you,
live.canon|numbers|15:19: Then it shall be, that, when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up an heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|15:20: You shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as you do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall you heave it.
live.canon|numbers|15:21: Of the first of your dough you shall give unto Yahuah (LORD) an heave offering in your generations.
live.canon|numbers|15:22: And if you have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which Yahuah (LORD) has spoken unto Moses,
live.canon|numbers|15:23: Even all that Yahuah (LORD) has commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
live.canon|numbers|15:26: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and the stranger that sojourns among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
live.canon|numbers|15:28: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sins ignorantly, when he sins by ignorance before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
live.canon|numbers|15:29: You shall have one law for him that sins through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and for the stranger that sojourns among them.
live.canon|numbers|15:30: But the soul that does ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth Yahuah (LORD); and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
live.canon|numbers|15:31: Because he has despised the word of Yahuah (LORD), and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
live.canon|numbers|15:39: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that you may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), and do them; and that you seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you use to go a whoring:
live.canon|numbers|15:40: That you may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your Elohim (God).
live.canon|numbers|15:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|15:3: And will make an offering by fire unto Yahuah (LORD), a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD), of the herd, or of the flock:
live.canon|numbers|15:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
live.canon|numbers|15:9: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
live.canon|numbers|15:11: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
live.canon|numbers|15:13: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|15:17: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|15:24: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD), with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
live.canon|numbers|15:25: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD), and their sin offering before Yahuah (LORD), for their ignorance:
live.canon|numbers|15:27: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
live.canon|numbers|15:32: And while the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
live.canon|numbers|15:33: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|15:34: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
live.canon|numbers|15:35: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
live.canon|numbers|15:36: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|15:37: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|15:38: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
live.canon|numbers|15:41: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|numbers|16:3: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, You take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and Yahuah (LORD) is among them: wherefore then lift you up yourselves above the congregation of Yahuah (LORD)?
live.canon|numbers|16:10: And he has brought you near to him, and all your brethren the sons of Levi with you: and seek you the priesthood also?
live.canon|numbers|16:11: For which cause both you and all your company are gathered together against Yahuah (LORD): and what is Aaron, that you murmur against him?
live.canon|numbers|16:13: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land that flows with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except you make thyself altogether a prince over us?
live.canon|numbers|16:14: Moreover you have not brought us into a land that flows with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: will you put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
live.canon|numbers|16:15: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Yahuah (LORD), Respect not you their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
live.canon|numbers|16:16: And Moses said unto Korah, Be you and all your company before Yahuah (LORD), you, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
live.canon|numbers|16:17: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring you before Yahuah (LORD) every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
live.canon|numbers|16:22: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be wroth with all the congregation?
live.canon|numbers|16:26: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins.
live.canon|numbers|16:28: And Moses said, Hereby you shall know that Yahuah (LORD) has sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of my own mind.
live.canon|numbers|16:29: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Yahuah (LORD) has not sent me.
live.canon|numbers|16:30: But if Yahuah (LORD) make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then you shall understand that these men have provoked Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|16:37: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter you the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
live.canon|numbers|16:1: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
live.canon|numbers|16:2: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
live.canon|numbers|16:4: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
live.canon|numbers|16:6: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
live.canon|numbers|16:12: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
live.canon|numbers|16:18: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
live.canon|numbers|16:19: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto all the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|16:20: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|numbers|16:21: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
live.canon|numbers|16:23: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|16:24: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
live.canon|numbers|16:25: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) followed him.
live.canon|numbers|16:27: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
live.canon|numbers|16:5: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow Yahuah (LORD) will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he has chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
live.canon|numbers|16:7: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before Yahuah (LORD) to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Yahuah (LORD) does choose, he shall be holy: you take too much upon you, you sons of Levi.
live.canon|numbers|16:31: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
live.canon|numbers|16:32: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
live.canon|numbers|16:33: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|16:34: And all Yashar'el (Israel) that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
live.canon|numbers|16:35: And there came out a fire from Yahuah (LORD), and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
live.canon|numbers|16:36: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|16:38: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Yahuah (LORD), therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|16:39: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
live.canon|numbers|16:40: To be a memorial unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before Yahuah (LORD); that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as Yahuah (LORD) said to him by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|numbers|16:8: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, you sons of Levi:
live.canon|numbers|16:9: Seems it but a small thing unto you, that the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) has separated you from the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD), and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
live.canon|numbers|16:42: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared.
live.canon|numbers|16:43: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|16:44: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|16:45: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
live.canon|numbers|16:46: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from Yahuah (LORD); the plague is begun.
live.canon|numbers|16:47: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
live.canon|numbers|16:48: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
live.canon|numbers|16:49: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
live.canon|numbers|16:50: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
live.canon|numbers|16:41: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, You have killed the people of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|17:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|17:5: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), whereby they murmur against you.
live.canon|numbers|17:6: And Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
live.canon|numbers|17:7: And Moses laid up the rods before Yahuah (LORD) in the tabernacle of witness.
live.canon|numbers|17:2: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write you every man’s name upon his rod.
live.canon|numbers|17:3: And you shall write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
live.canon|numbers|17:4: And you shall lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
live.canon|numbers|17:10: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and you shall quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
live.canon|numbers|17:8: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
live.canon|numbers|17:9: And Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahuah (LORD) unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and they looked, and took every man his rod.
live.canon|numbers|17:11: And Moses did so: as Yahuah (LORD) commanded him, so did he.
live.canon|numbers|17:12: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
live.canon|numbers|17:13: Whosoever comes any thing near unto the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD) shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
live.canon|numbers|18:2: And your brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring you with you, that they may be joined unto you, and minister unto you: but you and your sons with you shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
live.canon|numbers|18:3: And they shall keep your charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor you also, die.
live.canon|numbers|18:4: And they shall be joined unto you, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
live.canon|numbers|18:5: And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|18:7: Therefore you and your sons with you shall keep your priest’s office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and you shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that comes nigh shall be put to death.
live.canon|numbers|18:8: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given you the charge of my heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel); unto you have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, by an ordinance for ever.
live.canon|numbers|18:16: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shall you redeem, according to your estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
live.canon|numbers|18:17: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy: you shall sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|18:18: And the flesh of them shall be yours, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are yours.
live.canon|numbers|18:19: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) offer unto Yahuah (LORD), have I given you, and your sons and your daughters with you, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before Yahuah (LORD) unto you and to your seed with you.
live.canon|numbers|18:20: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Aaron, You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any part among them: I am your part and your inheritance among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|18:26: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When you take of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up an heave offering of it for Yahuah (LORD), even a tenth part of the tithe.
live.canon|numbers|18:28: Thus you also shall offer an heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD) of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and you shall give thereof the LORD’S heave offering to Aaron the priest.
live.canon|numbers|18:29: Out of all your gifts you shall offer every heave offering of Yahuah (LORD), of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
live.canon|numbers|18:30: Therefore you shall say unto them, When you have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
live.canon|numbers|18:31: And you shall eat it in every place, you and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|18:32: And you shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall you pollute the holy things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), lest you die.
live.canon|numbers|18:6: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): to you they are given as a gift for Yahuah (LORD), to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|18:1: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Aaron, You and your sons and your father’s house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
live.canon|numbers|18:21: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Yashar'el (Israel) for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|18:22: Neither must the children of Yashar'el (Israel) henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
live.canon|numbers|18:23: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Yashar'el (Israel) they have no inheritance.
live.canon|numbers|18:24: But the tithes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which they offer as an heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD), I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Yashar'el (Israel) they shall have no inheritance.
live.canon|numbers|18:25: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|18:27: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
live.canon|numbers|18:9: This shall be your of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
live.canon|numbers|18:10: In the most holy place shall you eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto you.
live.canon|numbers|18:11: And this is yours; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): I have given them unto you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in your house shall eat of it.
live.canon|numbers|18:12: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto Yahuah (LORD), them have I given you.
live.canon|numbers|18:13: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto Yahuah (LORD), shall be yours; every one that is clean in your house shall eat of it.
live.canon|numbers|18:14: Every thing devoted in Yashar'el (Israel) shall be yours.
live.canon|numbers|18:15: Every thing that opens the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto Yahuah (LORD), whether it be of men or beasts, shall be yours: nevertheless the firstborn of man shall you surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shall you redeem.
live.canon|numbers|19:2: This is the ordinance of the law which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they bring you a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
live.canon|numbers|19:3: And you shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
live.canon|numbers|19:13: Whosoever touches the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defiles the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD); and that soul shall be cut off from Yashar'el (Israel): because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
live.canon|numbers|19:14: This is the law, when a man dies in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
live.canon|numbers|19:15: And every open vessel, which has no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
live.canon|numbers|19:16: And whosoever touches one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
live.canon|numbers|19:20: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahuah (LORD): the water of separation has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
live.canon|numbers|19:21: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that touches the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
live.canon|numbers|19:22: And whatsoever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until even.
live.canon|numbers|19:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
live.canon|numbers|19:4: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
live.canon|numbers|19:5: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
live.canon|numbers|19:6: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
live.canon|numbers|19:7: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|numbers|19:9: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
live.canon|numbers|19:12: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
live.canon|numbers|19:17: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
live.canon|numbers|19:18: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
live.canon|numbers|19:19: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
live.canon|numbers|19:8: And he that burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
live.canon|numbers|19:10: And he that gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and unto the stranger that sojourns among them, for a statute for ever.
live.canon|numbers|19:11: He that touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
live.canon|numbers|20:4: And why have you brought up the congregation of Yahuah (LORD) into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
live.canon|numbers|20:5: And wherefore have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
live.canon|numbers|20:8: Take the rod, and gather you the assembly together, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak you unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and you shall bring forth to them water out of the rock: so you shall give the congregation and their beasts drink.
live.canon|numbers|20:10: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, you rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
live.canon|numbers|20:12: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because you believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), therefore you shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
live.canon|numbers|20:14: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus says your brother Yashar'el (Israel), You know all the travail that has befallen us:
live.canon|numbers|20:16: And when we cried unto Yahuah (LORD), he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and has brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of your border:
live.canon|numbers|20:17: Let us pass, I pray you, through your country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your borders.
live.canon|numbers|20:18: And Edom said unto him, You shall not pass by me, lest I come out against you with the sword.
live.canon|numbers|20:19: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of your water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
live.canon|numbers|20:20: And he said, You shall not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
live.canon|numbers|20:24: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), because you rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
live.canon|numbers|20:1: Then came the children of Yashar'el (Israel), even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
live.canon|numbers|20:2: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
live.canon|numbers|20:3: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would Elohim (God) that we had died when our brethren died before Yahuah (LORD)!
live.canon|numbers|20:6: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto them.
live.canon|numbers|20:7: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|20:9: And Moses took the rod from before Yahuah (LORD), as he commanded him.
live.canon|numbers|20:11: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
live.canon|numbers|20:13: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Yashar'el (Israel) strove with Yahuah (LORD), and he was sanctified in them.
live.canon|numbers|20:15: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
live.canon|numbers|20:21: Thus Edom refused to give Yashar'el (Israel) passage through his border: wherefore Yashar'el (Israel) turned away from him.
live.canon|numbers|20:22: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel), even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
live.canon|numbers|20:23: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
live.canon|numbers|20:25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
live.canon|numbers|20:26: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
live.canon|numbers|20:27: And Moses did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|20:28: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
live.canon|numbers|20:29: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|21:2: And Yashar'el (Israel) vowed a vow unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
live.canon|numbers|21:5: And the people spake against Elohim (God), and against Moses, Wherefore have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
live.canon|numbers|21:7: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against Yahuah (LORD), and against you; pray unto Yahuah (LORD), that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
live.canon|numbers|21:8: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Make you a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looks upon it, shall live.
live.canon|numbers|21:13: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
live.canon|numbers|21:15: And at the stream of the brooks that goes down to the dwelling of Ar, and lies upon the border of Moab.
live.canon|numbers|21:17: Then Yashar'el (Israel) sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing you unto it:
live.canon|numbers|21:20: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward Jeshimon.
live.canon|numbers|21:22: Let me pass through your land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past your borders.
live.canon|numbers|21:28: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it has consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
live.canon|numbers|21:29: Woe to you, Moab! you are undone, O people of Chemosh: he has given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
live.canon|numbers|21:30: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reaches unto Medeba.
live.canon|numbers|21:34: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into your hand, and all his people, and his land; and you shall do to him as you did unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
live.canon|numbers|21:1: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Yashar'el (Israel) came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Yashar'el (Israel), and took some of them prisoners.
live.canon|numbers|21:3: And Yahuah (LORD) hearkened to the voice of Yashar'el (Israel), and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
live.canon|numbers|21:4: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
live.canon|numbers|21:6: And Yahuah (LORD) sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Yashar'el (Israel) died.
live.canon|numbers|21:9: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
live.canon|numbers|21:10: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
live.canon|numbers|21:11: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
live.canon|numbers|21:12: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
live.canon|numbers|21:14: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of Yahuah (LORD), What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
live.canon|numbers|21:16: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
live.canon|numbers|21:18: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
live.canon|numbers|21:19: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
live.canon|numbers|21:21: And Yashar'el (Israel) sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
live.canon|numbers|21:23: And Sihon would not suffer Yashar'el (Israel) to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Yashar'el (Israel) into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|21:24: And Yashar'el (Israel) smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
live.canon|numbers|21:25: And Yashar'el (Israel) took all these cities: and Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
live.canon|numbers|21:26: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
live.canon|numbers|21:27: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
live.canon|numbers|21:31: Thus Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
live.canon|numbers|21:32: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
live.canon|numbers|21:33: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
live.canon|numbers|21:35: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
live.canon|numbers|22:35: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto you, that you shall speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
