live.canon|numbers|22:6: Come now therefore, I pray you, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom you blessest is blessed, and he whom you cursest is cursed.
live.canon|numbers|22:10: And Balaam said unto Elohim (God), Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent unto me, saying,
live.canon|numbers|22:11: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covers the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
live.canon|numbers|22:12: And Elohim (God) said unto Balaam, You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people: for they are blessed.
live.canon|numbers|22:13: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for Yahuah (LORD) refuses to give me leave to go with you.
live.canon|numbers|22:14: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuses to come with us.
live.canon|numbers|22:16: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray you, hinder you from coming unto me:
live.canon|numbers|22:17: For I will promote you unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever you say unto me: come therefore, I pray you, curse me this people.
live.canon|numbers|22:19: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry you also here this night, that I may know what Yahuah (LORD) will say unto me more.
live.canon|numbers|22:20: And Elohim (God) came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call you, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto you, that shall you do.
live.canon|numbers|22:28: And Yahuah (LORD) opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto you, that you have smitten me these three times?
live.canon|numbers|22:29: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because you have mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now would I kill you.
live.canon|numbers|22:30: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I your ass, upon which you have ridden ever since I was your unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto you? And he said, Nay.
live.canon|numbers|22:32: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Wherefore have you smitten your ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand you, because your way is perverse before me:
live.canon|numbers|22:33: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain you, and saved her alive.
live.canon|numbers|22:34: And Balaam said unto the angel of Yahuah (LORD), I have sinned; for I knew not that you stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease you, I will get me back again.
live.canon|numbers|22:37: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto you to call you? wherefore came you not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote you to honour?
live.canon|numbers|22:38: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto you: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that Elohim (God) puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.
live.canon|numbers|22:1: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
live.canon|numbers|22:2: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Yashar'el (Israel) had done to the Amorites.
live.canon|numbers|22:3: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|22:4: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
live.canon|numbers|22:5: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
live.canon|numbers|22:7: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
live.canon|numbers|22:8: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahuah (LORD) shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
live.canon|numbers|22:15: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
live.canon|numbers|22:18: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God), to do less or more.
live.canon|numbers|22:21: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
live.canon|numbers|22:22: And Elohim's (God’s) anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
live.canon|numbers|22:23: And the ass saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD) standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
live.canon|numbers|22:24: But the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
live.canon|numbers|22:25: And when the ass saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD), she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
live.canon|numbers|22:26: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
live.canon|numbers|22:27: And when the ass saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD), she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
live.canon|numbers|22:31: Then Yahuah (LORD) opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD) standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
live.canon|numbers|22:9: And Elohim (God) came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with you?
live.canon|numbers|22:36: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
live.canon|numbers|22:39: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.
live.canon|numbers|22:40: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
live.canon|numbers|22:41: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
live.canon|numbers|23:3: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure Yahuah (LORD) will come to meet me: and whatsoever he shows me I will tell you. And he went to an high place.
live.canon|numbers|23:5: And Yahuah (LORD) put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus you shall speak.
live.canon|numbers|23:7: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|23:8: How shall I curse, whom Elohim (God) has not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom Yahuah (LORD) has not defied?
live.canon|numbers|23:11: And Balak said unto Balaam, What have you done unto me? I took you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have blessed them altogether.
live.canon|numbers|23:12: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahuah (LORD) has put in my mouth?
live.canon|numbers|23:13: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray you, with me unto another place, from whence you may see them: you shall see but the utmost part of them, and shall not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
live.canon|numbers|23:15: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet Yahuah (LORD) yonder.
live.canon|numbers|23:17: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What has Yahuah (LORD) spoken?
live.canon|numbers|23:18: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, you son of Zippor:
live.canon|numbers|23:19: Elohim (God) is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of Adam, that he should repent: has he said, and shall he not do it? or has he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
live.canon|numbers|23:20: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he has blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
live.canon|numbers|23:21: He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither has he seen perverseness in Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
live.canon|numbers|23:22: Elohim (God) brought them out of Egypt; he has as it were the strength of an unicorn.
live.canon|numbers|23:23: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Yashar'el (Israel): according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Yashar'el (Israel), What has Elohim (God) wrought!
live.canon|numbers|23:26: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I you, saying, All that Yahuah (LORD) speaks, that I must do?
live.canon|numbers|23:27: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray you, I will bring you unto another place; peradventure it will please Elohim (God) that you may curse me them from thence.
live.canon|numbers|23:28: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looks toward Jeshimon.
live.canon|numbers|23:1: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
live.canon|numbers|23:2: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
live.canon|numbers|23:4: And Elohim (God) met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
live.canon|numbers|23:6: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
live.canon|numbers|23:9: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
live.canon|numbers|23:10: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Yashar'el (Israel)? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
live.canon|numbers|23:14: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
live.canon|numbers|23:16: And Yahuah (LORD) met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
live.canon|numbers|23:24: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
live.canon|numbers|23:25: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
live.canon|numbers|23:29: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
live.canon|numbers|23:30: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
live.canon|numbers|24:3: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor has said, and the man whose eyes are open has said:
live.canon|numbers|24:4: He has said, which heard the words of Elohim (God), which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
live.canon|numbers|24:5: How goodly are your tents, O Jacob, and your tabernacles, O Yashar'el (Israel)!
live.canon|numbers|24:6: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which Yahuah (LORD) has planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
live.canon|numbers|24:8: Elohim (God) brought him forth out of Egypt; he has as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
live.canon|numbers|24:16: He has said, which heard the words of Elohim (God), and knew the knowledge of the El Elyon (most High), which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
live.canon|numbers|24:19: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remains of the city.
live.canon|numbers|24:21: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is your dwellingplace, and you put your nest in a rock.
live.canon|numbers|24:22: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry you away captive.
live.canon|numbers|24:23: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when Elohim (God) does this!
live.canon|numbers|24:1: And when Balaam saw that it pleased Yahuah (LORD) to bless Yashar'el (Israel), he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
live.canon|numbers|24:2: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Yashar'el (Israel) abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of Elohim (God) came upon him.
live.canon|numbers|24:7: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
live.canon|numbers|24:17: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
live.canon|numbers|24:18: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Yashar'el (Israel) shall do valiantly.
live.canon|numbers|24:20: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
live.canon|numbers|24:24: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
live.canon|numbers|24:25: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
live.canon|numbers|24:9: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesses you, and cursed is he that curses you.
live.canon|numbers|24:10: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.
live.canon|numbers|24:11: Therefore now flee you to your place: I thought to promote you unto great honour; but, lo, Yahuah (LORD) has kept you back from honour.
live.canon|numbers|24:12: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to your messengers which you sentest unto me, saying,
live.canon|numbers|24:13: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), to do either good or bad of my own mind; but what Yahuah (LORD) says, that will I speak?
live.canon|numbers|24:14: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.
live.canon|numbers|24:15: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor has said, and the man whose eyes are open has said:
live.canon|numbers|25:5: And Moses said unto the judges of Yashar'el (Israel), Slay you every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.
live.canon|numbers|25:11: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Yashar'el (Israel), while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in my jealousy.
live.canon|numbers|25:1: And Yashar'el (Israel) abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
live.canon|numbers|25:2: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
live.canon|numbers|25:3: And Yashar'el (Israel) joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|25:4: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before Yahuah (LORD) against the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD) may be turned away from Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|25:6: And, behold, one of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|25:7: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
live.canon|numbers|25:8: And he went after the man of Yashar'el (Israel) into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Yashar'el (Israel), and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|25:9: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
live.canon|numbers|25:10: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|25:12: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
live.canon|numbers|25:13: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his Elohim (God), and made an atonement for the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|25:14: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
live.canon|numbers|25:15: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
live.canon|numbers|25:16: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|25:17: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
live.canon|numbers|25:18: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.
live.canon|numbers|26:1: And it came to pass after the plague, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
live.canon|numbers|26:2: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|26:3: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
live.canon|numbers|26:4: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses and the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
live.canon|numbers|26:6: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
live.canon|numbers|26:7: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
live.canon|numbers|26:8: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
live.canon|numbers|26:9: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|numbers|26:10: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
live.canon|numbers|26:11: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
live.canon|numbers|26:12: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
live.canon|numbers|26:13: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
live.canon|numbers|26:14: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:15: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
live.canon|numbers|26:16: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
live.canon|numbers|26:17: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
live.canon|numbers|26:18: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:19: The sons of Yahudah (Judah) were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|numbers|26:20: And the sons of Yahudah (Judah) after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
live.canon|numbers|26:21: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
live.canon|numbers|26:22: These are the families of Yahudah (Judah) according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:23: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
live.canon|numbers|26:24: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
live.canon|numbers|26:25: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:26: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
live.canon|numbers|26:27: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:28: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
live.canon|numbers|26:29: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
live.canon|numbers|26:30: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
live.canon|numbers|26:31: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
live.canon|numbers|26:5: Reuben, the eldest son of Yashar'el (Israel): the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom comes the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
live.canon|numbers|26:32: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
live.canon|numbers|26:33: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
live.canon|numbers|26:34: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:35: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
live.canon|numbers|26:36: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
live.canon|numbers|26:37: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
live.canon|numbers|26:38: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
live.canon|numbers|26:39: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
live.canon|numbers|26:40: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
live.canon|numbers|26:41: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:42: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
live.canon|numbers|26:43: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:44: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
live.canon|numbers|26:45: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
live.canon|numbers|26:46: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
live.canon|numbers|26:47: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:48: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
live.canon|numbers|26:49: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
live.canon|numbers|26:50: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
live.canon|numbers|26:51: These were the numbered of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
live.canon|numbers|26:52: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|26:53: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
live.canon|numbers|26:55: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
live.canon|numbers|26:56: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
live.canon|numbers|26:57: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
live.canon|numbers|26:58: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
live.canon|numbers|26:59: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
live.canon|numbers|26:60: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
live.canon|numbers|26:61: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|26:62: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|26:63: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
live.canon|numbers|26:64: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the wilderness of Sinai.
live.canon|numbers|26:65: For Yahuah (LORD) had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
live.canon|numbers|26:54: To many you shall give the more inheritance, and to few you shall give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
live.canon|numbers|27:4: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he has no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
live.canon|numbers|27:7: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: you shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and you shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
live.canon|numbers|27:8: And you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, If a man die, and have no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
live.canon|numbers|27:9: And if he have no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
live.canon|numbers|27:10: And if he have no brethren, then you shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.
live.canon|numbers|27:11: And if his father have no brethren, then you shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) a statute of judgment, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|27:12: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Get you up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|27:13: And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered unto your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered.
live.canon|numbers|27:14: For you rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
live.canon|numbers|27:18: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Take you Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay your hand upon him;
live.canon|numbers|27:20: And you shall put some of your honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) may be obedient.
live.canon|numbers|27:1: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
live.canon|numbers|27:2: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
live.canon|numbers|27:3: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against Yahuah (LORD) in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
live.canon|numbers|27:5: And Moses brought their cause before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|27:6: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|27:15: And Moses spake unto Yahuah (LORD), saying,
live.canon|numbers|27:16: Let Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
live.canon|numbers|27:17: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahuah (LORD) be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
live.canon|numbers|27:19: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
live.canon|numbers|27:21: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before Yahuah (LORD): at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) with him, even all the congregation.
live.canon|numbers|27:22: And Moses did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
live.canon|numbers|27:23: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded by the hand of Moses.
live.canon|numbers|28:2: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall you observe to offer unto me in their due season.
live.canon|numbers|28:3: And you shall say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer unto Yahuah (LORD); two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
live.canon|numbers|28:4: The one lamb shall you offer in the morning, and the other lamb shall you offer at even;
live.canon|numbers|28:7: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shall you cause the strong wine to be poured unto Yahuah (LORD) for a drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|28:8: And the other lamb shall you offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, you shall offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|28:11: And in the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD); two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
live.canon|numbers|28:18: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; you shall do no manner of servile work therein:
live.canon|numbers|28:19: But you shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD); two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|28:20: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall you offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
live.canon|numbers|28:21: A several tenth deal shall you offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
live.canon|numbers|28:23: You shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
live.canon|numbers|28:24: After this manner you shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD): it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|28:25: And on the seventh day you shall have an holy convocation; you shall do no servile work.
live.canon|numbers|28:26: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new meat offering unto Yahuah (LORD), after your weeks be out, you shall have an holy convocation; you shall do no servile work:
live.canon|numbers|28:27: But you shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD); two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
live.canon|numbers|28:31: You shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
live.canon|numbers|28:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|28:5: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
live.canon|numbers|28:6: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|28:9: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
live.canon|numbers|28:10: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|28:12: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
live.canon|numbers|28:13: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|28:14: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
live.canon|numbers|28:15: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto Yahuah (LORD) shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|28:16: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|28:17: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
live.canon|numbers|28:22: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
live.canon|numbers|28:28: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
live.canon|numbers|28:29: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
live.canon|numbers|28:30: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
live.canon|numbers|29:1: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have an holy convocation; you shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
live.canon|numbers|29:2: And you shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD); one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|29:7: And you shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and you shall afflict your souls: you shall not do any work therein:
live.canon|numbers|29:8: But you shall offer a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD) for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|29:13: And you shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD); thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|29:17: And on the second day you shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
live.canon|numbers|29:35: On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no servile work therein:
live.canon|numbers|29:36: But you shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD): one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|29:39: These things you shall do unto Yahuah (LORD) in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
live.canon|numbers|29:3: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
live.canon|numbers|29:4: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
live.canon|numbers|29:5: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
live.canon|numbers|29:6: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|29:9: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
live.canon|numbers|29:10: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
live.canon|numbers|29:11: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
live.canon|numbers|29:14: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
live.canon|numbers|29:15: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
live.canon|numbers|29:16: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|29:18: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
live.canon|numbers|29:19: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
live.canon|numbers|29:20: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
live.canon|numbers|29:21: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
live.canon|numbers|29:22: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|29:23: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|29:24: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
live.canon|numbers|29:25: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|29:26: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
live.canon|numbers|29:27: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
live.canon|numbers|29:28: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|29:29: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|29:30: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
live.canon|numbers|29:31: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|29:32: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
live.canon|numbers|29:33: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
live.canon|numbers|29:34: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|29:37: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
live.canon|numbers|29:38: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
live.canon|numbers|29:40: And Moses told the children of Yashar'el (Israel) according to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|29:12: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have an holy convocation; you shall do no servile work, and you shall keep a feast unto Yahuah (LORD) seven days:
live.canon|numbers|30:1: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded.
live.canon|numbers|30:2: If a man vow a vow unto Yahuah (LORD), or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
live.canon|numbers|30:4: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she has bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she has bound her soul shall stand.
live.canon|numbers|30:5: But if her father disallow her in the day that he hears; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she has bound her soul, shall stand: and Yahuah (LORD) shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
live.canon|numbers|30:12: But if her husband has utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband has made them void; and Yahuah (LORD) shall forgive her.
live.canon|numbers|30:14: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establishes all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
live.canon|numbers|30:15: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he has heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
live.canon|numbers|30:3: If a woman also vow a vow unto Yahuah (LORD), and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;
live.canon|numbers|30:6: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
live.canon|numbers|30:7: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
live.canon|numbers|30:8: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and Yahuah (LORD) shall forgive her.
live.canon|numbers|30:9: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
live.canon|numbers|30:10: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
live.canon|numbers|30:11: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
live.canon|numbers|30:13: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
live.canon|numbers|30:16: These are the statutes, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.
live.canon|numbers|31:2: Avenge the children of Yashar'el (Israel) of the Midianites: afterward shall you be gathered unto your people.
live.canon|numbers|31:4: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), shall you send to the war.
live.canon|numbers|31:15: And Moses said unto them, Have you saved all the women alive?
live.canon|numbers|31:17: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that has known man by lying with him.
live.canon|numbers|31:19: And do you abide without the camp seven days: whosoever has killed any person, and whosoever has touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
live.canon|numbers|31:23: Every thing that may abide the fire, you shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abides not the fire you shall make go through the water.
live.canon|numbers|31:24: And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean, and afterward you shall come into the camp.
live.canon|numbers|31:26: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
live.canon|numbers|31:30: And of the children of Yashar'el's (Israel’s) half, you shall take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|31:50: We have therefore brought an oblation for Yahuah (LORD), what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|31:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|31:3: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge Yahuah (LORD) of Midian.
live.canon|numbers|31:5: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel), a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
live.canon|numbers|31:6: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
live.canon|numbers|31:7: And they warred against the Midianites, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
live.canon|numbers|31:8: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
live.canon|numbers|31:9: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
live.canon|numbers|31:10: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
live.canon|numbers|31:11: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
live.canon|numbers|31:12: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
live.canon|numbers|31:13: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
live.canon|numbers|31:14: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
live.canon|numbers|31:16: Behold, these caused the children of Yashar'el (Israel), through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahuah (LORD) in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|31:18: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
live.canon|numbers|31:20: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.
live.canon|numbers|31:21: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses;
live.canon|numbers|31:22: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
live.canon|numbers|31:25: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|31:27: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
live.canon|numbers|31:28: And levy a tribute unto Yahuah (LORD) of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
live.canon|numbers|31:29: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|31:31: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|31:32: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
live.canon|numbers|31:33: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
live.canon|numbers|31:34: And threescore and one thousand asses,
live.canon|numbers|31:35: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
live.canon|numbers|31:36: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
live.canon|numbers|31:37: And the LORD’S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
live.canon|numbers|31:38: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and twelve.
live.canon|numbers|31:39: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD’S tribute was threescore and one.
live.canon|numbers|31:40: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD’S tribute was thirty and two persons.
live.canon|numbers|31:41: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|31:42: And of the children of Yashar'el's (Israel’s) half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
live.canon|numbers|31:43: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
live.canon|numbers|31:44: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
live.canon|numbers|31:45: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
live.canon|numbers|31:47: Even of the children of Yashar'el's (Israel’s) half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD); as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
live.canon|numbers|31:48: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
live.canon|numbers|31:51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
live.canon|numbers|31:52: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to Yahuah (LORD), of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
live.canon|numbers|31:53: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
live.canon|numbers|31:54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|31:49: And they said unto Moses, Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
live.canon|numbers|32:5: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in your sight, let this land be given unto your servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
live.canon|numbers|32:6: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall you sit here?
live.canon|numbers|32:7: And wherefore discourage you the heart of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from going over into the land which Yahuah (LORD) has given them?
live.canon|numbers|32:14: And, behold, you are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD) toward Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|32:15: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you shall destroy all this people.
live.canon|numbers|32:20: And Moses said unto them, If you will do this thing, if you will go armed before Yahuah (LORD) to war,
live.canon|numbers|32:21: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before Yahuah (LORD), until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
live.canon|numbers|32:22: And the land be subdued before Yahuah (LORD): then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless before Yahuah (LORD), and before Yashar'el (Israel); and this land shall be your possession before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|32:23: But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahuah (LORD): and be sure your sin will find you out.
live.canon|numbers|32:24: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.
live.canon|numbers|32:25: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Your servants will do as my lord commands.
live.canon|numbers|32:27: But your servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before Yahuah (LORD) to battle, as my lord says.
live.canon|numbers|32:31: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Yahuah (LORD) has said unto your servants, so will we do.
live.canon|numbers|32:1: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
live.canon|numbers|32:2: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
live.canon|numbers|32:3: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
live.canon|numbers|32:8: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
live.canon|numbers|32:9: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they should not go into the land which Yahuah (LORD) had given them.
live.canon|numbers|32:10: And the LORD’S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
live.canon|numbers|32:11: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
live.canon|numbers|32:12: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|numbers|32:13: And the LORD’S anger was kindled against Yashar'el (Israel), and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), was consumed.
live.canon|numbers|32:16: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
live.canon|numbers|32:17: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
live.canon|numbers|32:18: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have inherited every man his inheritance.
live.canon|numbers|32:19: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
live.canon|numbers|32:26: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
live.canon|numbers|32:28: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|numbers|32:4: Even the country which Yahuah (LORD) smote before the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), is a land for cattle, and your servants have cattle:
live.canon|numbers|32:30: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|numbers|32:32: We will pass over armed before Yahuah (LORD) into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
live.canon|numbers|32:33: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
live.canon|numbers|32:34: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
live.canon|numbers|32:35: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
live.canon|numbers|32:36: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
live.canon|numbers|32:37: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
live.canon|numbers|32:38: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
live.canon|numbers|32:39: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
live.canon|numbers|32:40: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
live.canon|numbers|32:41: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.
live.canon|numbers|32:42: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
live.canon|numbers|32:29: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before Yahuah (LORD), and the land shall be subdued before you; then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
live.canon|numbers|33:51: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
live.canon|numbers|33:52: Then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
live.canon|numbers|33:53: And you shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
live.canon|numbers|33:54: And you shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falls; according to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.
live.canon|numbers|33:55: But if you will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which you let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein you dwell.
live.canon|numbers|33:1: These are the journeys of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
live.canon|numbers|33:2: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahuah (LORD): and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
live.canon|numbers|33:3: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
live.canon|numbers|33:4: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which Yahuah (LORD) had smitten among them: upon their gods also Yahuah (LORD) executed judgments.
live.canon|numbers|33:5: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
live.canon|numbers|33:6: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
live.canon|numbers|33:7: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
live.canon|numbers|33:8: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
live.canon|numbers|33:9: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
live.canon|numbers|33:10: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
live.canon|numbers|33:11: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
live.canon|numbers|33:12: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
live.canon|numbers|33:13: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
live.canon|numbers|33:14: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
live.canon|numbers|33:15: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
live.canon|numbers|33:16: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
live.canon|numbers|33:17: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
live.canon|numbers|33:18: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
live.canon|numbers|33:19: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
live.canon|numbers|33:20: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
live.canon|numbers|33:21: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
live.canon|numbers|33:22: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
live.canon|numbers|33:23: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
live.canon|numbers|33:24: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
live.canon|numbers|33:25: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
live.canon|numbers|33:26: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
live.canon|numbers|33:27: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
live.canon|numbers|33:28: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
live.canon|numbers|33:29: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
live.canon|numbers|33:30: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
live.canon|numbers|33:31: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
live.canon|numbers|33:32: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
live.canon|numbers|33:33: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
live.canon|numbers|33:34: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
live.canon|numbers|33:35: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
live.canon|numbers|33:36: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
live.canon|numbers|33:37: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
live.canon|numbers|33:38: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
live.canon|numbers|33:39: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
live.canon|numbers|33:40: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|33:41: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
live.canon|numbers|33:42: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
live.canon|numbers|33:43: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
live.canon|numbers|33:44: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
live.canon|numbers|33:45: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
live.canon|numbers|33:46: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
live.canon|numbers|33:47: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
live.canon|numbers|33:48: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
live.canon|numbers|33:49: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
live.canon|numbers|33:50: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
live.canon|numbers|33:56: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
live.canon|numbers|34:10: And you shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
live.canon|numbers|34:2: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
live.canon|numbers|34:6: And as for the western border, you shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
live.canon|numbers|34:7: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall point out for you mount Hor:
live.canon|numbers|34:8: From mount Hor you shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
live.canon|numbers|34:13: And Moses commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
live.canon|numbers|34:18: And you shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
live.canon|numbers|34:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|34:3: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
live.canon|numbers|34:4: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
live.canon|numbers|34:5: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
live.canon|numbers|34:9: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
live.canon|numbers|34:11: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
live.canon|numbers|34:12: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
live.canon|numbers|34:14: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
live.canon|numbers|34:15: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
live.canon|numbers|34:16: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|34:17: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
live.canon|numbers|34:19: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
live.canon|numbers|34:20: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
live.canon|numbers|34:21: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
live.canon|numbers|34:22: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
live.canon|numbers|34:23: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
live.canon|numbers|34:24: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
live.canon|numbers|34:25: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
live.canon|numbers|34:26: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
live.canon|numbers|34:27: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
live.canon|numbers|34:28: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
live.canon|numbers|34:29: These are they whom Yahuah (LORD) commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the land of Canaan.
live.canon|numbers|35:2: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and you shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
live.canon|numbers|35:10: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
live.canon|numbers|35:11: Then you shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which kills any person at unawares.
live.canon|numbers|35:13: And of these cities which you shall give six cities shall you have for refuge.
live.canon|numbers|35:14: You shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall you give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
live.canon|numbers|35:15: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that kills any person unawares may flee thither.
live.canon|numbers|35:30: Whoso kills any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
live.canon|numbers|35:31: Moreover you shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
live.canon|numbers|35:32: And you shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
live.canon|numbers|35:33: So you shall not pollute the land wherein you are: for blood it defiles the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
live.canon|numbers|35:34: Defile not therefore the land which you shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I Yahuah (LORD) dwell among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|numbers|35:1: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
live.canon|numbers|35:3: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
live.canon|numbers|35:9: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
live.canon|numbers|35:12: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
live.canon|numbers|35:16: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|numbers|35:17: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|numbers|35:18: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
live.canon|numbers|35:19: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
live.canon|numbers|35:20: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
live.canon|numbers|35:21: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
live.canon|numbers|35:22: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
live.canon|numbers|35:23: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
live.canon|numbers|35:24: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
live.canon|numbers|35:25: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
live.canon|numbers|35:26: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
live.canon|numbers|35:27: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
live.canon|numbers|35:28: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
live.canon|numbers|35:29: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
live.canon|numbers|35:4: And the suburbs of the cities, which you shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
live.canon|numbers|35:5: And you shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
live.canon|numbers|35:6: And among the cities which you shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which you shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them you shall add forty and two cities.
live.canon|numbers|35:7: So all the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall you give with their suburbs.
live.canon|numbers|35:8: And the cities which you shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): from them that have many you shall give many; but from them that have few you shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inherits.
live.canon|numbers|36:6: This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
live.canon|numbers|36:1: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|numbers|36:2: And they said, Yahuah (LORD) commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and my lord was commanded by Yahuah (LORD) to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
