live.canon|numbers|36:3: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
live.canon|numbers|36:4: And when the jubile of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
live.canon|numbers|36:7: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
live.canon|numbers|36:8: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
live.canon|numbers|36:9: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
live.canon|numbers|36:10: Even as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
live.canon|numbers|36:11: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:
live.canon|numbers|36:12: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
live.canon|numbers|36:13: These are the commandments and the judgments, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
live.canon|numbers|36:5: And Moses commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel) according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph has said well.
live.canon|proverbs|1:8: My son, hear the instruction of your father, and forsake not the law of your mother:
live.canon|proverbs|1:9: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto your head, and chains about your neck.
live.canon|proverbs|1:14: Cast in your lot among us; let us all have one purse:
live.canon|proverbs|1:15: My son, walk not you in the way with them; refrain your foot from their path:
live.canon|proverbs|1:19: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which takes away the life of the owners thereof.
live.canon|proverbs|1:20: Wisdom cries without; she utters her voice in the streets:
live.canon|proverbs|1:26: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear comes;
live.canon|proverbs|1:27: When your fear comes as desolation, and your destruction comes as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish comes upon you.
live.canon|proverbs|1:1: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Yashar'el (Israel);
live.canon|proverbs|1:2: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
live.canon|proverbs|1:3: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
live.canon|proverbs|1:4: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
live.canon|proverbs|1:5: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
live.canon|proverbs|1:6: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
live.canon|proverbs|1:7: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
live.canon|proverbs|1:11: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
live.canon|proverbs|1:12: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
live.canon|proverbs|1:13: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
live.canon|proverbs|1:16: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
live.canon|proverbs|1:17: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
live.canon|proverbs|1:18: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
live.canon|proverbs|1:10: My son, if sinners entice you, consent you not.
live.canon|proverbs|1:23: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
live.canon|proverbs|1:21: She cries in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she utters her words, saying,
live.canon|proverbs|1:28: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
live.canon|proverbs|1:29: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|proverbs|1:30: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
live.canon|proverbs|1:31: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
live.canon|proverbs|1:32: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
live.canon|proverbs|1:33: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
live.canon|proverbs|1:22: How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
live.canon|proverbs|1:24: Because I have called, and you refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
live.canon|proverbs|1:25: But you have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
live.canon|proverbs|2:1: My son, if you will receive my words, and hide my commandments with you;
live.canon|proverbs|2:2: So that you incline your ear unto wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
live.canon|proverbs|2:3: Yea, if you cry after knowledge, and liftest up your voice for understanding;
live.canon|proverbs|2:4: If you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hid treasures;
live.canon|proverbs|2:5: Then shall you understand the fear of Yahuah (LORD), and find the knowledge of Elohim (God).
live.canon|proverbs|2:6: For Yahuah (LORD) gives wisdom: out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
live.canon|proverbs|2:7: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
live.canon|proverbs|2:8: He keeps the paths of judgment, and preserves the way of his saints.
live.canon|proverbs|2:9: Then shall you understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
live.canon|proverbs|2:10: When wisdom enters into your heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto your soul;
live.canon|proverbs|2:11: Discretion shall preserve you, understanding shall keep you:
live.canon|proverbs|2:12: To deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaks froward things;
live.canon|proverbs|2:16: To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
live.canon|proverbs|2:20: That you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
live.canon|proverbs|2:13: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
live.canon|proverbs|2:14: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
live.canon|proverbs|2:15: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
live.canon|proverbs|2:17: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her Elohim (God).
live.canon|proverbs|2:18: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
live.canon|proverbs|2:19: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
live.canon|proverbs|2:21: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
live.canon|proverbs|2:22: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
live.canon|proverbs|3:1: My son, forget not my law; but let your heart keep my commandments:
live.canon|proverbs|3:2: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to you.
live.canon|proverbs|3:3: Let not mercy and truth forsake you: bind them about your neck; write them upon the table of your heart:
live.canon|proverbs|3:4: So shall you find favour and good understanding in the sight of Elohim (God) and man.
live.canon|proverbs|3:5: Trust in Yahuah (LORD) with all your heart; and lean not unto your own understanding.
live.canon|proverbs|3:6: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct your paths.
live.canon|proverbs|3:7: Be not wise in your own eyes: fear Yahuah (LORD), and depart from evil.
live.canon|proverbs|3:8: It shall be health to your navel, and marrow to your bones.
live.canon|proverbs|3:9: Honour Yahuah (LORD) with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all your increase:
live.canon|proverbs|3:10: So shall your barns be filled with plenty, and your presses shall burst out with new wine.
live.canon|proverbs|3:12: For whom Yahuah (LORD) loves he corrects; even as a father the son in whom he delights.
live.canon|proverbs|3:13: Happy is the man that finds wisdom, and the man that gets understanding.
live.canon|proverbs|3:15: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things you can desire are not to be compared unto her.
live.canon|proverbs|3:19: Yahuah (LORD) by wisdom has founded the earth; by understanding has he established the heavens.
live.canon|proverbs|3:21: My son, let not them depart from your eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
live.canon|proverbs|3:22: So shall they be life unto your soul, and grace to your neck.
live.canon|proverbs|3:25: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes.
live.canon|proverbs|3:26: For Yahuah (LORD) shall be your confidence, and shall keep your foot from being taken.

live.canon|proverbs|11:6: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
live.canon|proverbs|11:11: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
live.canon|proverbs|11:13: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
live.canon|proverbs|11:14: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
live.canon|proverbs|11:16: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
live.canon|proverbs|11:19: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
live.canon|proverbs|11:20: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
live.canon|proverbs|11:21: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
live.canon|proverbs|11:22: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
live.canon|proverbs|11:23: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
live.canon|proverbs|11:25: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
live.canon|proverbs|11:26: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
live.canon|proverbs|11:24: There is that scatters, and yet increases; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
live.canon|proverbs|11:30: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
live.canon|proverbs|11:31: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
live.canon|proverbs|11:27: He that diligently seeks good procureth favour: but he that seeks mischief, it shall come unto him.
live.canon|proverbs|12:1: Whoso loves instruction loves knowledge: but he that hates reproof is brutish.
live.canon|proverbs|12:2: A good man obtains favour of Yahuah (LORD): but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
live.canon|proverbs|12:4: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that makes ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
live.canon|proverbs|12:9: He that is despised, and has a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
live.canon|proverbs|12:10: A righteous man regards the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
live.canon|proverbs|12:11: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that follows vain persons is void of understanding.
live.canon|proverbs|12:12: The wicked desires the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
live.canon|proverbs|12:16: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covers shame.
live.canon|proverbs|12:17: He that speaks truth shows forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
live.canon|proverbs|12:18: There is that speaks like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
live.canon|proverbs|12:25: Heaviness in the heart of man makes it stoop: but a good word makes it glad.
live.canon|proverbs|12:3: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
live.canon|proverbs|12:5: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
live.canon|proverbs|12:6: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
live.canon|proverbs|12:7: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
live.canon|proverbs|12:8: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
live.canon|proverbs|12:13: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
live.canon|proverbs|12:14: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
live.canon|proverbs|12:15: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
live.canon|proverbs|12:19: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
live.canon|proverbs|12:20: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
live.canon|proverbs|12:21: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
live.canon|proverbs|12:22: Lying lips are abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but they that deal truly are his delight.
live.canon|proverbs|12:23: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
live.canon|proverbs|12:24: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
live.canon|proverbs|12:26: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
live.canon|proverbs|12:27: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
live.canon|proverbs|12:28: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
live.canon|proverbs|13:1: A wise son hears his father’s instruction: but a scorner hears not rebuke.
live.canon|proverbs|13:3: He that keeps his mouth keeps his life: but he that opens wide his lips shall have destruction.
live.canon|proverbs|13:4: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
live.canon|proverbs|13:5: A righteous man hates lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and comes to shame.
live.canon|proverbs|13:6: Righteousness keeps him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
live.canon|proverbs|13:7: There is that makes himself rich, yet has nothing: there is that makes himself poor, yet has great riches.
live.canon|proverbs|13:8: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor hears not rebuke.
live.canon|proverbs|13:9: The light of the righteous rejoices: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
live.canon|proverbs|13:10: Only by pride comes contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
live.canon|proverbs|13:11: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathers by labour shall increase.
live.canon|proverbs|13:12: Hope deferred makes the heart sick: but when the desire comes, it is a tree of life.
live.canon|proverbs|13:13: Whoso despises the word shall be destroyed: but he that fears the commandment shall be rewarded.
live.canon|proverbs|13:15: Good understanding gives favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
live.canon|proverbs|13:16: Every prudent man deals with knowledge: but a fool lays open his folly.
live.canon|proverbs|13:17: A wicked messenger falls into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
live.canon|proverbs|13:2: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
live.canon|proverbs|13:14: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
live.canon|proverbs|13:19: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
live.canon|proverbs|13:21: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
live.canon|proverbs|13:22: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
live.canon|proverbs|13:23: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
live.canon|proverbs|13:18: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuses instruction: but he that regards reproof shall be honoured.
live.canon|proverbs|13:20: He that walks with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
live.canon|proverbs|13:24: He that spareth his rod hates his son: but he that loves him chastens him betimes.
live.canon|proverbs|13:25: The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
live.canon|proverbs|14:2: He that walks in his uprightness fears Yahuah (LORD): but he that is perverse in his ways despises him.
live.canon|proverbs|14:6: A scorner seeks wisdom, and finds it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understands.
live.canon|proverbs|14:7: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when you perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|14:10: The heart knows his own bitterness; and a stranger does not intermeddle with his joy.
live.canon|proverbs|14:12: There is a way which seems right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
live.canon|proverbs|14:15: The simple believes every word: but the prudent man looks well to his going.
live.canon|proverbs|14:16: A wise man fears, and departs from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
live.canon|proverbs|14:17: He that is soon angry deals foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
live.canon|proverbs|14:20: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich has many friends.
live.canon|proverbs|14:21: He that despises his neighbour sins: but he that has mercy on the poor, happy is he.
live.canon|proverbs|14:25: A true witness delivers souls: but a deceitful witness speaks lies.
live.canon|proverbs|14:31: He that oppresses the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him has mercy on the poor.
live.canon|proverbs|14:32: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous has hope in his death.
live.canon|proverbs|14:33: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that has understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
live.canon|proverbs|14:35: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causes shame.
live.canon|proverbs|14:3: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
live.canon|proverbs|14:4: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
live.canon|proverbs|14:5: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
live.canon|proverbs|14:8: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
live.canon|proverbs|14:9: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
live.canon|proverbs|14:11: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
live.canon|proverbs|14:13: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
live.canon|proverbs|14:14: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
live.canon|proverbs|14:18: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|14:19: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
live.canon|proverbs|14:22: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
live.canon|proverbs|14:23: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
live.canon|proverbs|14:24: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
live.canon|proverbs|14:26: In the fear of Yahuah (LORD) is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
live.canon|proverbs|14:27: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
live.canon|proverbs|14:28: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
live.canon|proverbs|14:29: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
live.canon|proverbs|14:30: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
live.canon|proverbs|14:34: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
live.canon|proverbs|14:1: Every wise woman builds her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
live.canon|proverbs|15:1: A soft answer turns away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
live.canon|proverbs|15:2: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools pours out foolishness.
live.canon|proverbs|15:5: A fool despises his father’s instruction: but he that regards reproof is prudent.
live.canon|proverbs|15:7: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish does not so.
live.canon|proverbs|15:9: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto Yahuah (LORD): but he loves him that follows after righteousness.
live.canon|proverbs|15:10: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hates reproof shall die.
live.canon|proverbs|15:12: A scorner loves not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
live.canon|proverbs|15:13: A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
live.canon|proverbs|15:14: The heart of him that has understanding seeks knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
live.canon|proverbs|15:15: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart has a continual feast.
live.canon|proverbs|15:20: A wise son makes a glad father: but a foolish man despises his mother.
live.canon|proverbs|15:21: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walks uprightly.
live.canon|proverbs|15:23: A man has joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
live.canon|proverbs|15:27: He that is greedy of gain troubles his own house; but he that hates gifts shall live.
live.canon|proverbs|15:28: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.
live.canon|proverbs|15:29: Yahuah (LORD) is far from the wicked: but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
live.canon|proverbs|15:30: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart: and a good report makes the bones fat.
live.canon|proverbs|15:31: The ear that hears the reproof of life abides among the wise.
live.canon|proverbs|15:32: He that refuses instruction despises his own soul: but he that hears reproof gets understanding.
live.canon|proverbs|15:3: The eyes of Yahuah (LORD) are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
live.canon|proverbs|15:4: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
live.canon|proverbs|15:6: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
live.canon|proverbs|15:8: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
live.canon|proverbs|15:11: Hell and destruction are before Yahuah (LORD): how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
live.canon|proverbs|15:16: Better is little with the fear of Yahuah (LORD) than great treasure and trouble therewith.
live.canon|proverbs|15:17: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
live.canon|proverbs|15:18: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
live.canon|proverbs|15:19: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
live.canon|proverbs|15:22: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
live.canon|proverbs|15:24: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
live.canon|proverbs|15:25: Yahuah (LORD) will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
live.canon|proverbs|15:26: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
live.canon|proverbs|15:33: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
live.canon|proverbs|16:3: Commit your works unto Yahuah (LORD), and your thoughts shall be established.
live.canon|proverbs|16:4: Yahuah (LORD) has made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
live.canon|proverbs|16:7: When a man’s ways please Yahuah (LORD), he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
live.canon|proverbs|16:13: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaks right.
live.canon|proverbs|16:17: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keeps his way preserves his soul.
live.canon|proverbs|16:18: Pride goes before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
live.canon|proverbs|16:20: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusts in Yahuah (LORD), happy is he.
live.canon|proverbs|16:21: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increases learning.
live.canon|proverbs|16:22: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that has it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
live.canon|proverbs|16:23: The heart of the wise teaches his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
live.canon|proverbs|16:25: There is a way that seems right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
live.canon|proverbs|16:27: An ungodly man digs up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
live.canon|proverbs|16:28: A froward man sows strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
live.canon|proverbs|16:29: A violent man entices his neighbour, and leads him into the way that is not good.
live.canon|proverbs|16:30: He shuts his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he brings evil to pass.
live.canon|proverbs|16:32: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that rules his spirit than he that takes a city.
live.canon|proverbs|16:1: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|16:2: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahuah (LORD) weigheth the spirits.
live.canon|proverbs|16:5: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
live.canon|proverbs|16:6: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of Yahuah (LORD) men depart from evil.
live.canon|proverbs|16:8: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
live.canon|proverbs|16:9: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but Yahuah (LORD) directeth his steps.
live.canon|proverbs|16:10: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
live.canon|proverbs|16:11: A just weight and balance are the LORD’S: all the weights of the bag are his work.
live.canon|proverbs|16:12: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
live.canon|proverbs|16:14: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
live.canon|proverbs|16:15: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
live.canon|proverbs|16:16: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
live.canon|proverbs|16:19: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
live.canon|proverbs|16:24: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
live.canon|proverbs|16:26: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
live.canon|proverbs|16:31: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
live.canon|proverbs|16:33: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|17:2: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causes shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
live.canon|proverbs|17:4: A wicked doer gives heed to false lips; and a liar gives ear to a naughty tongue.
live.canon|proverbs|17:5: Whoso mocks the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
live.canon|proverbs|17:7: Excellent speech becomes not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
live.canon|proverbs|17:8: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that has it: whithersoever it turns, it prospereth.
live.canon|proverbs|17:9: He that covers a transgression seeks love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
live.canon|proverbs|17:10: A reproof enters more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
live.canon|proverbs|17:11: An evil man seeks only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
live.canon|proverbs|17:15: He that justifies the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|17:16: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he has no heart to it?
live.canon|proverbs|17:17: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
live.canon|proverbs|17:18: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becomes surety in the presence of his friend.
live.canon|proverbs|17:19: He loves transgression that loves strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeks destruction.
live.canon|proverbs|17:20: He that has a froward heart finds no good: and he that has a perverse tongue falls into mischief.
live.canon|proverbs|17:21: He that begetteth a fool does it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool has no joy.
live.canon|proverbs|17:22: A merry heart does good like a medicine: but a broken spirit dries the bones.
live.canon|proverbs|17:23: A wicked man takes a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
live.canon|proverbs|17:24: Wisdom is before him that has understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
live.canon|proverbs|17:27: He that has knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
live.canon|proverbs|17:28: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shuts his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
live.canon|proverbs|17:1: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
live.canon|proverbs|17:3: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but Yahuah (LORD) trieth the hearts.
live.canon|proverbs|17:6: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
live.canon|proverbs|17:12: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
live.canon|proverbs|17:13: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
live.canon|proverbs|17:14: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
live.canon|proverbs|17:25: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
live.canon|proverbs|17:26: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
live.canon|proverbs|18:1: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeks and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
live.canon|proverbs|18:2: A fool has no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
live.canon|proverbs|18:3: When the wicked comes, then comes also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
live.canon|proverbs|18:6: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calls for strokes.
live.canon|proverbs|18:10: The name of Yahuah (LORD) is a strong tower: the righteous runs into it, and is safe.
live.canon|proverbs|18:13: He that answers a matter before he hears it, it is folly and shame unto him.
live.canon|proverbs|18:15: The heart of the prudent gets knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|18:16: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
live.canon|proverbs|18:17: He that is first in his own cause seems just; but his neighbour comes and searcheth him.
live.canon|proverbs|18:18: The lot causes contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
live.canon|proverbs|18:22: Whoso finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favour of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|18:23: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answers roughly.
live.canon|proverbs|18:24: A man that has friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
live.canon|proverbs|18:4: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
live.canon|proverbs|18:5: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
live.canon|proverbs|18:7: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
live.canon|proverbs|18:8: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
live.canon|proverbs|18:9: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
live.canon|proverbs|18:11: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
live.canon|proverbs|18:12: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
live.canon|proverbs|18:14: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
live.canon|proverbs|18:19: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
live.canon|proverbs|18:20: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
live.canon|proverbs|18:21: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
live.canon|proverbs|19:1: Better is the poor that walks in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
live.canon|proverbs|19:2: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sins.
live.canon|proverbs|19:3: The foolishness of man perverts his way: and his heart fretteth against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|19:4: Wealth makes many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
live.canon|proverbs|19:5: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaks lies shall not escape.
live.canon|proverbs|19:6: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that gives gifts.
live.canon|proverbs|19:8: He that gets wisdom loves his own soul: he that keeps understanding shall find good.
live.canon|proverbs|19:9: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaks lies shall perish.
live.canon|proverbs|19:18: Chasten your son while there is hope, and let not your soul spare for his crying.
live.canon|proverbs|19:19: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if you deliver him, yet you must do it again.
live.canon|proverbs|19:20: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
live.canon|proverbs|19:23: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) tendeth to life: and he that has it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
live.canon|proverbs|19:24: A slothful man hides his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
live.canon|proverbs|19:25: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that has understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|19:26: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causes shame, and brings reproach.
live.canon|proverbs|19:27: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causes to err from the words of knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|19:28: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.
live.canon|proverbs|19:7: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
live.canon|proverbs|19:10: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
live.canon|proverbs|19:11: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
live.canon|proverbs|19:12: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
live.canon|proverbs|19:13: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
live.canon|proverbs|19:14: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|19:15: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
live.canon|proverbs|19:21: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), that shall stand.
live.canon|proverbs|19:22: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
live.canon|proverbs|19:29: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
live.canon|proverbs|19:16: He that keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; but he that despises his ways shall die.
live.canon|proverbs|19:17: He that has pity upon the poor lendeth unto Yahuah (LORD); and that which he has given will he pay him again.
live.canon|proverbs|20:2: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sins against his own soul.
live.canon|proverbs|20:7: The just man walks in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
live.canon|proverbs|20:8: A king that sits in the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
live.canon|proverbs|20:12: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahuah (LORD) has made even both of them.
live.canon|proverbs|20:13: Love not sleep, lest you come to poverty; open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
live.canon|proverbs|20:14: It is naught, it is naught, says the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
live.canon|proverbs|20:19: He that goes about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
live.canon|proverbs|20:20: Whoso curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
live.canon|proverbs|20:22: Say not you, I will recompense evil; but wait on Yahuah (LORD), and he shall save you.
live.canon|proverbs|20:25: It is a snare to the man who devours that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
live.canon|proverbs|20:26: A wise king scatters the wicked, and brings the wheel over them.
live.canon|proverbs|20:30: The blueness of a wound cleanses away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
live.canon|proverbs|20:1: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
live.canon|proverbs|20:3: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
live.canon|proverbs|20:4: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
live.canon|proverbs|20:5: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
live.canon|proverbs|20:6: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
live.canon|proverbs|20:9: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
live.canon|proverbs|20:10: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|20:11: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
live.canon|proverbs|20:15: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
live.canon|proverbs|20:16: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
live.canon|proverbs|20:17: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
live.canon|proverbs|20:18: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
live.canon|proverbs|20:21: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
live.canon|proverbs|20:23: Divers weights are an abomination unto Yahuah (LORD); and a false balance is not good.
live.canon|proverbs|20:24: Man’s goings are of Yahuah (LORD); how can a man then understand his own way?
live.canon|proverbs|20:27: The spirit of man is the candle of Yahuah (LORD), searching all the inward parts of the belly.
live.canon|proverbs|20:28: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
live.canon|proverbs|20:29: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.
live.canon|proverbs|21:1: The king’s heart is in the hand of Yahuah (LORD), as the rivers of water: he turns it whithersoever he will.
live.canon|proverbs|21:10: The soul of the wicked desires evil: his neighbour finds no favour in his eyes.
live.canon|proverbs|21:11: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|21:17: He that loves pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
live.canon|proverbs|21:21: He that follows after righteousness and mercy finds life, righteousness, and honour.
live.canon|proverbs|21:22: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casts down the strength of the confidence thereof.
live.canon|proverbs|21:23: Whoso keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
live.canon|proverbs|21:24: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who deals in proud wrath.
live.canon|proverbs|21:25: The desire of the slothful kills him; for his hands refuse to labour.
live.canon|proverbs|21:26: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous gives and spareth not.
live.canon|proverbs|21:27: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind?
live.canon|proverbs|21:28: A false witness shall perish: but the man that hears speaks constantly.
live.canon|proverbs|21:2: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but Yahuah (LORD) pondereth the hearts.
live.canon|proverbs|21:3: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to Yahuah (LORD) than sacrifice.
live.canon|proverbs|21:4: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
live.canon|proverbs|21:5: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
live.canon|proverbs|21:6: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
live.canon|proverbs|21:7: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
live.canon|proverbs|21:8: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
live.canon|proverbs|21:9: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
live.canon|proverbs|21:12: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but Elohim (God) overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
live.canon|proverbs|21:13: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
live.canon|proverbs|21:14: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
live.canon|proverbs|21:15: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
live.canon|proverbs|21:16: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
live.canon|proverbs|21:18: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
live.canon|proverbs|21:19: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
live.canon|proverbs|21:20: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
live.canon|proverbs|21:29: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
live.canon|proverbs|21:30: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|21:31: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|22:3: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hides himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
live.canon|proverbs|22:5: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that does keep his soul shall be far from them.
live.canon|proverbs|22:7: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
live.canon|proverbs|22:8: He that sows iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
live.canon|proverbs|22:9: He that has a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he gives of his bread to the poor.
live.canon|proverbs|22:11: He that loves pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
live.canon|proverbs|22:13: The slothful man says, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
live.canon|proverbs|22:16: He that oppresses the poor to increase his riches, and he that gives to the rich, shall surely come to want.
live.canon|proverbs|22:17: Bow down your ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply your heart unto my knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|22:18: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; they shall withal be fitted in your lips.
live.canon|proverbs|22:19: That your trust may be in Yahuah (LORD), I have made known to you this day, even to you.
live.canon|proverbs|22:20: Have not I written to you excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
live.canon|proverbs|22:21: That I might make you know the certainty of the words of truth; that you might answer the words of truth to them that send unto you?
live.canon|proverbs|22:24: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man you shall not go:
live.canon|proverbs|22:25: Lest you learn his ways, and get a snare to your soul.
live.canon|proverbs|22:26: Be not you one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
live.canon|proverbs|22:27: If you have nothing to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
live.canon|proverbs|22:28: Remove not the ancient landmark, which your fathers have set.
live.canon|proverbs|22:29: See you a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
live.canon|proverbs|22:1: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
live.canon|proverbs|22:2: The rich and poor meet together: Yahuah (LORD) is the maker of them all.
live.canon|proverbs|22:4: By humility and the fear of Yahuah (LORD) are riches, and honour, and life.
live.canon|proverbs|22:6: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
live.canon|proverbs|22:10: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
live.canon|proverbs|22:12: The eyes of Yahuah (LORD) preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
live.canon|proverbs|22:14: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of Yahuah (LORD) shall fall therein.
live.canon|proverbs|22:15: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
live.canon|proverbs|22:22: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
live.canon|proverbs|22:23: For Yahuah (LORD) will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
live.canon|proverbs|23:1: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you:
live.canon|proverbs|23:2: And put a knife to your throat, if you be a man given to appetite.
live.canon|proverbs|23:4: Labour not to be rich: cease from your own wisdom.
live.canon|proverbs|23:5: Will you set your eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
live.canon|proverbs|23:6: Eat you not the bread of him that has an evil eye, neither desire you his dainty meats:
live.canon|proverbs|23:7: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, says he to you; but his heart is not with you.
live.canon|proverbs|23:8: The morsel which you have eaten shall you vomit up, and lose your sweet words.
live.canon|proverbs|23:9: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
live.canon|proverbs|23:11: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with you.
live.canon|proverbs|23:12: Apply your heart unto instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
live.canon|proverbs|23:13: Withhold not correction from the child: for if you beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
live.canon|proverbs|23:14: You shall beat him with the rod, and shall deliver his soul from hell.
live.canon|proverbs|23:15: My son, if your heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
live.canon|proverbs|23:16: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when your lips speak right things.
live.canon|proverbs|23:17: Let not your heart envy sinners: but be you in the fear of Yahuah (LORD) all the day long.
live.canon|proverbs|23:18: For surely there is an end; and your expectation shall not be cut off.
live.canon|proverbs|23:19: Hear you, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart in the way.
live.canon|proverbs|23:22: Hearken unto your father that begat you, and despise not your mother when she is old.
live.canon|proverbs|23:25: Your father and your mother shall be glad, and she that bare you shall rejoice.
live.canon|proverbs|23:26: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes observe my ways.
live.canon|proverbs|23:28: She also lies in wait as for a prey, and increases the transgressors among men.
live.canon|proverbs|23:29: Who has woe? who has sorrow? who has contentions? who has babbling? who has wounds without cause? who has redness of eyes?
live.canon|proverbs|23:31: Look not you upon the wine when it is red, when it gives his colour in the cup, when it moves itself aright.
live.canon|proverbs|23:32: At the last it bites like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
live.canon|proverbs|23:33: Your eyes shall behold strange women, and your heart shall utter perverse things.
live.canon|proverbs|23:34: Yea, you shall be as he that lies down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lies upon the top of a mast.
live.canon|proverbs|23:35: They have stricken me, shall you say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
live.canon|proverbs|23:3: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
live.canon|proverbs|23:10: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
live.canon|proverbs|23:20: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
live.canon|proverbs|23:21: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
live.canon|proverbs|23:23: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
live.canon|proverbs|23:24: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
live.canon|proverbs|23:27: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
live.canon|proverbs|23:30: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
live.canon|proverbs|24:1: Be not you envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
live.canon|proverbs|24:5: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increases strength.
live.canon|proverbs|24:6: For by wise counsel you shall make your war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
live.canon|proverbs|24:7: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he opens not his mouth in the gate.
live.canon|proverbs|24:10: If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.
live.canon|proverbs|24:11: If you forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
live.canon|proverbs|24:12: If you say, Behold, we knew it not; does not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keeps your soul, does not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
live.canon|proverbs|24:13: My son, eat you honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to your taste:
live.canon|proverbs|24:14: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto your soul: when you have found it, then there shall be a reward, and your expectation shall not be cut off.
live.canon|proverbs|24:16: For a righteous man falls seven times, and rises up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
live.canon|proverbs|24:17: Rejoice not when your enemy falls, and let not your heart be glad when he stumbleth:
live.canon|proverbs|24:19: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be you envious at the wicked;
live.canon|proverbs|24:21: My son, fear you Yahuah (LORD) and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
live.canon|proverbs|24:22: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knows the ruin of them both?
live.canon|proverbs|24:24: He that says unto the wicked, You are righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
live.canon|proverbs|24:26: Every man shall kiss his lips that gives a right answer.
live.canon|proverbs|24:27: Prepare your work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build your house.
live.canon|proverbs|24:28: Be not a witness against your neighbour without cause; and deceive not with your lips.
live.canon|proverbs|24:29: Say not, I will do so to him as he has done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
live.canon|proverbs|24:2: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
live.canon|proverbs|24:3: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
live.canon|proverbs|24:4: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
live.canon|proverbs|24:8: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
live.canon|proverbs|24:9: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
live.canon|proverbs|24:15: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
live.canon|proverbs|24:18: Lest Yahuah (LORD) see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
live.canon|proverbs|24:20: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
live.canon|proverbs|24:23: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
live.canon|proverbs|24:25: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
live.canon|proverbs|24:30: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
live.canon|proverbs|24:31: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
live.canon|proverbs|24:32: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
live.canon|proverbs|24:33: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
live.canon|proverbs|24:34: So shall your poverty come as one that travelleth; and your want as an armed man.
live.canon|proverbs|25:9: Debate your cause with your neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
live.canon|proverbs|25:10: Lest he that hears it put you to shame, and your infamy turn not away.
live.canon|proverbs|25:15: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaks the bone.
live.canon|proverbs|25:16: Have you found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for you, lest you be filled therewith, and vomit it.
live.canon|proverbs|25:17: Withdraw your foot from your neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of you, and so hate you.
live.canon|proverbs|25:18: A man that bears false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
live.canon|proverbs|25:20: As he that takes away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
live.canon|proverbs|25:21: If your enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
live.canon|proverbs|25:22: For you shall heap coals of fire upon his head, and Yahuah (LORD) shall reward you.
live.canon|proverbs|25:23: The north wind drives away rain: so does an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
live.canon|proverbs|25:28: He that has no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
live.canon|proverbs|25:1: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) copied out.
live.canon|proverbs|25:2: It is the glory of Elohim (God) to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
live.canon|proverbs|25:3: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
live.canon|proverbs|25:4: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
live.canon|proverbs|25:5: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
live.canon|proverbs|25:6: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
live.canon|proverbs|25:7: For better it is that it be said unto you, Come up hither; than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince whom your eyes have seen.
live.canon|proverbs|25:11: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
live.canon|proverbs|25:12: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
live.canon|proverbs|25:13: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
live.canon|proverbs|25:14: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
live.canon|proverbs|25:19: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
live.canon|proverbs|25:24: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
live.canon|proverbs|25:25: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
live.canon|proverbs|25:26: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
live.canon|proverbs|25:27: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
live.canon|proverbs|25:8: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest you know not what to do in the end thereof, when your neighbour has put you to shame.
live.canon|proverbs|26:4: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like unto him.
live.canon|proverbs|26:6: He that sends a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinks damage.
live.canon|proverbs|26:8: As he that binds a stone in a sling, so is he that gives honour to a fool.
live.canon|proverbs|26:9: As a thorn goes up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
live.canon|proverbs|26:12: See you a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
live.canon|proverbs|26:13: The slothful man says, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
live.canon|proverbs|26:14: As the door turns upon his hinges, so does the slothful upon his bed.
live.canon|proverbs|26:15: The slothful hides his hand in his bosom; it grieves him to bring it again to his mouth.
live.canon|proverbs|26:17: He that passes by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that takes a dog by the ears.
live.canon|proverbs|26:18: As a mad man who casts firebrands, arrows, and death,
live.canon|proverbs|26:19: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and says, Am not I in sport?
live.canon|proverbs|26:20: Where no wood is, there the fire goes out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceases.
live.canon|proverbs|26:24: He that hates dissembleth with his lips, and lays up deceit within him;
live.canon|proverbs|26:25: When he speaks fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
live.canon|proverbs|26:1: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
live.canon|proverbs|26:2: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
live.canon|proverbs|26:3: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.
live.canon|proverbs|26:5: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
live.canon|proverbs|26:7: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
live.canon|proverbs|26:10: The great Elohim (God) that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
live.canon|proverbs|26:16: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
live.canon|proverbs|26:21: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
live.canon|proverbs|26:22: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
live.canon|proverbs|26:23: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
live.canon|proverbs|26:26: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
live.canon|proverbs|26:11: As a dog returns to his vomit, so a fool returns to his folly.
live.canon|proverbs|26:27: Whoso digs a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
live.canon|proverbs|26:28: A lying tongue hates those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
live.canon|proverbs|27:16: Whosoever hides her hides the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
live.canon|proverbs|27:17: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.
live.canon|proverbs|27:18: Whoso keeps the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waits on his master shall be honoured.
live.canon|proverbs|27:19: As in water face answers to face, so the heart of man to man.
live.canon|proverbs|27:22: Though you should bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
live.canon|proverbs|27:23: Be you diligent to know the state of your flocks, and look well to your herds.
live.canon|proverbs|27:24: For riches are not for ever: and does the crown endure to every generation?
live.canon|proverbs|27:25: The hay appears, and the tender grass shows itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
live.canon|proverbs|27:26: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
live.canon|proverbs|27:27: And you shall have goats’ milk enough for your food, for the food of your household, and for the maintenance for your maidens.
live.canon|proverbs|27:3: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.
live.canon|proverbs|27:1: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for you know not what a day may bring forth.
live.canon|proverbs|27:4: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
live.canon|proverbs|27:5: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
live.canon|proverbs|27:6: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
live.canon|proverbs|27:7: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
live.canon|proverbs|27:8: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
live.canon|proverbs|27:11: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
live.canon|proverbs|27:13: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
live.canon|proverbs|27:15: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
live.canon|proverbs|27:20: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
live.canon|proverbs|27:21: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
live.canon|proverbs|27:2: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
live.canon|proverbs|27:9: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so does the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.
live.canon|proverbs|27:10: Your own friend, and your father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into your brother’s house in the day of your calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
live.canon|proverbs|27:12: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
live.canon|proverbs|27:14: He that blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
live.canon|proverbs|28:3: A poor man that oppresses the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
live.canon|proverbs|28:6: Better is the poor that walks in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
live.canon|proverbs|28:7: Whoso keeps the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
live.canon|proverbs|28:8: He that by usury and unjust gain increases his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
live.canon|proverbs|28:9: He that turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
live.canon|proverbs|28:10: Whoso causes the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
live.canon|proverbs|28:11: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that has understanding searcheth him out.
live.canon|proverbs|28:13: He that covers his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
live.canon|proverbs|28:14: Happy is the man that fears alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
live.canon|proverbs|28:16: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hates covetousness shall prolong his days.
live.canon|proverbs|28:17: A man that does violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
live.canon|proverbs|28:18: Whoso walks uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
live.canon|proverbs|28:19: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that follows after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
live.canon|proverbs|28:24: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and says, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
live.canon|proverbs|28:25: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that puts his trust in Yahuah (LORD) shall be made fat.
live.canon|proverbs|28:26: He that trusts in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walks wisely, he shall be delivered.
live.canon|proverbs|28:27: He that gives unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hides his eyes shall have many a curse.
live.canon|proverbs|28:1: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
live.canon|proverbs|28:2: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
live.canon|proverbs|28:4: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
live.canon|proverbs|28:5: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek Yahuah (LORD) understand all things.
live.canon|proverbs|28:12: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
live.canon|proverbs|28:15: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
live.canon|proverbs|28:21: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
live.canon|proverbs|28:23: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
live.canon|proverbs|28:20: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that makes haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
live.canon|proverbs|28:28: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
live.canon|proverbs|28:22: He that hasteth to be rich has an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
live.canon|proverbs|29:2: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked bears rule, the people mourn.
live.canon|proverbs|29:3: Whoso loves wisdom rejoices his father: but he that keeps company with harlots spendeth his substance.
live.canon|proverbs|29:4: The king by judgment establishes the land: but he that receives gifts overthroweth it.
live.canon|proverbs|29:5: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreads a net for his feet.
live.canon|proverbs|29:6: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous does sing and rejoice.
live.canon|proverbs|29:7: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regards not to know it.
live.canon|proverbs|29:9: If a wise man contends with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
live.canon|proverbs|29:11: A fool utters all his mind: but a wise man keeps it in till afterwards.
live.canon|proverbs|29:14: The king that faithfully judges the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
live.canon|proverbs|29:15: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself brings his mother to shame.
live.canon|proverbs|29:16: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases: but the righteous shall see their fall.
live.canon|proverbs|29:17: Correct your son, and he shall give you rest; yea, he shall give delight unto your soul.
live.canon|proverbs|29:18: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keeps the law, happy is he.
live.canon|proverbs|29:20: See you a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
live.canon|proverbs|29:21: He that delicately brings up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
live.canon|proverbs|29:22: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man abounds in transgression.
live.canon|proverbs|29:24: Whoso is partner with a thief hates his own soul: he hears cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
live.canon|proverbs|29:25: The fear of man brings a snare: but whoso puts his trust in Yahuah (LORD) shall be safe.
live.canon|proverbs|29:26: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment comes from Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|proverbs|29:1: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
live.canon|proverbs|29:8: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
live.canon|proverbs|29:10: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
live.canon|proverbs|29:12: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
live.canon|proverbs|29:13: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: Yahuah (LORD) lighteneth both their eyes.
live.canon|proverbs|29:19: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
live.canon|proverbs|29:23: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
live.canon|proverbs|29:27: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
live.canon|proverbs|30:4: Who has ascended up into heaven, or descended? who has gathered the wind in his fists? who has bound the waters in a garment? who has established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you can tell?
live.canon|proverbs|30:6: Add you not unto his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
live.canon|proverbs|30:7: Two things have I required of you; deny me them not before I die:
live.canon|proverbs|30:9: Lest I be full, and deny you, and say, Who is Yahuah (LORD)? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my Elohim (God) in vain.
live.canon|proverbs|30:10: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse you, and you be found guilty.
live.canon|proverbs|30:11: There is a generation that curses their father, and does not bless their mother.
live.canon|proverbs|30:15: The horseleach has two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
live.canon|proverbs|30:16: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that says not, It is enough.
live.canon|proverbs|30:17: The eye that mocks at his father, and despises to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
live.canon|proverbs|30:20: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eats, and wipeth her mouth, and says, I have done no wickedness.
live.canon|proverbs|30:22: For a servant when he reigns; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
live.canon|proverbs|30:28: The spider takes hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.
live.canon|proverbs|30:30: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turns not away for any;
live.canon|proverbs|30:32: If you have done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if you have thought evil, lay your hand upon your mouth.
live.canon|proverbs|30:33: Surely the churning of milk brings forth butter, and the wringing of the nose brings forth blood: so the forcing of wrath brings forth strife.
live.canon|proverbs|30:1: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
live.canon|proverbs|30:2: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
live.canon|proverbs|30:3: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
live.canon|proverbs|30:5: Every word of Elohim (God) is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
live.canon|proverbs|30:8: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
live.canon|proverbs|30:12: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
live.canon|proverbs|30:13: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
live.canon|proverbs|30:14: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
live.canon|proverbs|30:18: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
live.canon|proverbs|30:19: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
live.canon|proverbs|30:21: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
live.canon|proverbs|30:23: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
live.canon|proverbs|30:24: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
live.canon|proverbs|30:25: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
live.canon|proverbs|30:26: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
live.canon|proverbs|30:27: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
live.canon|proverbs|30:29: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
live.canon|proverbs|30:31: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
live.canon|proverbs|31:3: Give not your strength unto women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
live.canon|proverbs|31:8: Open your mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
live.canon|proverbs|31:9: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
live.canon|proverbs|31:11: The heart of her husband does safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
live.canon|proverbs|31:13: She seeks wool, and flax, and works willingly with her hands.
live.canon|proverbs|31:14: She is like the merchants’ ships; she brings her food from afar.
live.canon|proverbs|31:15: She rises also while it is yet night, and gives meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
live.canon|proverbs|31:18: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goes not out by night.
live.canon|proverbs|31:19: She lays her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
live.canon|proverbs|31:20: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reaches forth her hands to the needy.
live.canon|proverbs|31:22: She makes herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
live.canon|proverbs|31:23: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
live.canon|proverbs|31:24: She makes fine linen, and selleth it; and delivers girdles unto the merchant.
live.canon|proverbs|31:26: She opens her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
live.canon|proverbs|31:27: She looks well to the ways of her household, and eats not the bread of idleness.
live.canon|proverbs|31:28: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.
live.canon|proverbs|31:29: Many daughters have done virtuously, but you excellest them all.
live.canon|proverbs|31:30: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that fears Yahuah (LORD), she shall be praised.
live.canon|proverbs|31:1: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
live.canon|proverbs|31:2: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
live.canon|proverbs|31:4: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
live.canon|proverbs|31:5: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
