live.canon|proverbs|31:6: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
live.canon|proverbs|31:7: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
live.canon|proverbs|31:10: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
live.canon|proverbs|31:12: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
live.canon|proverbs|31:16: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
live.canon|proverbs|31:17: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
live.canon|proverbs|31:21: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
live.canon|proverbs|31:25: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
live.canon|proverbs|31:31: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
live.canon|psalms|1:3: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he does shall prosper.
live.canon|psalms|1:6: For Yahuah (LORD) knows the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
live.canon|psalms|1:1: Blessed is the man that walks not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of the scornful.
live.canon|psalms|1:5: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
live.canon|psalms|1:2: But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law does he meditate day and night.
live.canon|psalms|1:4: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
live.canon|psalms|2:7: I will declare the decree: Yahuah (LORD) has said unto me, You are my Son; this day have I begotten you.
live.canon|psalms|2:8: Ask of me, and I shall give you the heathen for your inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
live.canon|psalms|2:9: You shall break them with a rod of iron; you shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
live.canon|psalms|2:10: Be wise now therefore, O you kings: be instructed, you judges of the earth.
live.canon|psalms|2:12: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
live.canon|psalms|2:1: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
live.canon|psalms|2:2: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahuah (LORD), and against his anointed, saying,
live.canon|psalms|2:3: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
live.canon|psalms|2:5: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
live.canon|psalms|2:6: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
live.canon|psalms|2:11: Serve Yahuah (LORD) with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
live.canon|psalms|2:4: He that sits in the heavens shall laugh: Adonai (Lord) shall have them in derision.
live.canon|psalms|10:1: Why stand you afar off, O Yahuah (LORD)? why hide you thyself in times of trouble?
live.canon|psalms|10:2: The wicked in his pride does persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
live.canon|psalms|10:3: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesses the covetous, whom Yahuah (LORD) abhors.
live.canon|psalms|10:5: His ways are always grievous; your judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
live.canon|psalms|10:6: He has said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
live.canon|psalms|10:8: He sits in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places does he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
live.canon|psalms|10:9: He lies in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lies in wait to catch the poor: he does catch the poor, when he draws him into his net.
live.canon|psalms|10:11: He has said in his heart, Elohim (God) has forgotten: he hides his face; he will never see it.
live.canon|psalms|10:12: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD); O Elohim (God), lift up your hand: forget not the humble.
live.canon|psalms|10:13: Wherefore does the wicked contemn Elohim (God)? he has said in his heart, You will not require it.
live.canon|psalms|10:14: You have seen it; for you behold mischief and spite, to requite it with your hand: the poor commits himself unto you; you are the helper of the fatherless.
live.canon|psalms|10:15: Break you the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till you find none.
live.canon|psalms|10:17: Yahuah (LORD), you have heard the desire of the humble: you will prepare their heart, you will cause your ear to hear:
live.canon|psalms|10:4: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after Elohim (God): Elohim (God) is not in all his thoughts.
live.canon|psalms|10:7: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
live.canon|psalms|10:10: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
live.canon|psalms|10:16: Yahuah (LORD) is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
live.canon|psalms|10:18: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
live.canon|psalms|33:14: From the place of his habitation he looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
live.canon|psalms|33:20: Our soul waits for Yahuah (LORD): he is our help and our shield.
live.canon|psalms|33:22: Let your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), be upon us, according as we hope in you.
live.canon|psalms|33:2: Praise Yahuah (LORD) with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
live.canon|psalms|33:3: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
live.canon|psalms|33:4: For the word of Yahuah (LORD) is right; and all his works are done in truth.
live.canon|psalms|33:1: Rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), O you righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
live.canon|psalms|33:5: He loves righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|33:7: He gathers the waters of the sea together as an heap: he lays up the depth in storehouses.
live.canon|psalms|33:6: By the word of Yahuah (LORD) were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
live.canon|psalms|33:8: Let all the earth fear Yahuah (LORD): let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
live.canon|psalms|33:9: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
live.canon|psalms|33:15: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
live.canon|psalms|33:16: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
live.canon|psalms|33:17: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
live.canon|psalms|33:18: Behold, the eye of Yahuah (LORD) is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
live.canon|psalms|33:19: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
live.canon|psalms|33:21: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
live.canon|psalms|33:10: Yahuah (LORD) brings the counsel of the heathen to nought: he makes the devices of the people of none effect.
live.canon|psalms|33:11: The counsel of Yahuah (LORD) stands for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
live.canon|psalms|33:12: Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD); and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
live.canon|psalms|33:13: Yahuah (LORD) looks from heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.
live.canon|psalms|43:2: For you are the Elohim (God) of my strength: why do you cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
live.canon|psalms|43:3: O send out your light and your truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto your holy hill, and to your tabernacles.
live.canon|psalms|43:4: Then will I go unto the altar of Elohim (God), unto Elohim (God) my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise you, O Elohim (God) my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|43:5: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope in Elohim (God): for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|43:1: Judge me, O Elohim (God), and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
live.canon|psalms|71:1: In you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
live.canon|psalms|71:2: Deliver me in your righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline your ear unto me, and save me.
live.canon|psalms|71:3: Be you my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: you have given commandment to save me; for you are my rock and my fortress.
live.canon|psalms|71:6: By you have I been holden up from the womb: you are he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of you.
live.canon|psalms|71:7: I am as a wonder unto many; but you are my strong refuge.
live.canon|psalms|71:8: Let my mouth be filled with your praise and with your honour all the day.
live.canon|psalms|71:9: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.
live.canon|psalms|71:10: For my enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
live.canon|psalms|71:11: Saying, Elohim (God) has forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
live.canon|psalms|71:14: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise you more and more.
live.canon|psalms|71:15: My mouth shall shew forth your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
live.canon|psalms|71:16: I will go in the strength of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): I will make mention of your righteousness, even of your only.
live.canon|psalms|71:17: O Elohim (God), you have taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared your wondrous works.
live.canon|psalms|71:18: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O Elohim (God), forsake me not; until I have shewed your strength unto this generation, and your power to every one that is to come.
live.canon|psalms|71:19: Your righteousness also, O Elohim (God), is very high, who have done great things: O Elohim (God), who is like unto you!
live.canon|psalms|71:20: You, which have shewed me great and sore troubles, shall quicken me again, and shall bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
live.canon|psalms|71:21: You shall increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
live.canon|psalms|71:22: I will also praise you with the psaltery, even your truth, O my Elohim (God): unto you will I sing with the harp, O you Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|71:23: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto you; and my soul, which you have redeemed.
live.canon|psalms|71:5: For you are my hope, O Adonai (Lord) GOD: you are my trust from my youth.
live.canon|psalms|71:24: My tongue also shall talk of your righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
live.canon|psalms|71:4: Deliver me, O my Elohim (God), out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
live.canon|psalms|71:12: O Elohim (God), be not far from me: O my Elohim (God), make haste for my help.
live.canon|psalms|71:13: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
live.canon|psalms|91:1: He that dwells in the secret place of the El Elyon (most High) shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
live.canon|psalms|91:3: Surely he shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
live.canon|psalms|91:4: He shall cover you with his feathers, and under his wings shall you trust: his truth shall be your shield and buckler.
live.canon|psalms|91:5: You shall not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
live.canon|psalms|91:6: Nor for the pestilence that walks in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
live.canon|psalms|91:7: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it shall not come nigh you.
live.canon|psalms|91:8: Only with your eyes shall you behold and see the reward of the wicked.
live.canon|psalms|91:9: Because you have made Yahuah (LORD), which is my refuge, even the El Elyon (most High), your habitation;
live.canon|psalms|91:10: There shall no evil befall you, neither shall any plague come nigh your dwelling.
live.canon|psalms|91:11: For he shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways.
live.canon|psalms|91:12: They shall bear you up in their hands, lest you dash your foot against a stone.
live.canon|psalms|91:13: You shall tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shall you trample under feet.
live.canon|psalms|91:14: Because he has set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
live.canon|psalms|91:2: I will say of Yahuah (LORD), He is my refuge and my fortress: my Elohim (God); in him will I trust.
live.canon|psalms|91:15: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
live.canon|psalms|91:16: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
live.canon|psalms|93:1: Yahuah (LORD) reigns, he is clothed with majesty; Yahuah (LORD) is clothed with strength, wherewith he has girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
live.canon|psalms|93:2: Your throne is established of old: you are from everlasting.
live.canon|psalms|93:5: Your testimonies are very sure: holiness becomes your house, O Yahuah (LORD), for ever.
live.canon|psalms|93:3: The floods have lifted up, O Yahuah (LORD), the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
live.canon|psalms|93:4: Yahuah (LORD) on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
live.canon|psalms|94:8: Understand, you brutish among the people: and you fools, when will you be wise?
live.canon|psalms|94:10: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teaches man knowledge, shall not he know?
live.canon|psalms|94:11: Yahuah (LORD) knows the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
live.canon|psalms|94:12: Blessed is the man whom you chastenest, O Yahuah (LORD), and teach him out of your law;
live.canon|psalms|94:13: That you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
live.canon|psalms|94:18: When I said, My foot slippeth; your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), held me up.
live.canon|psalms|94:19: In the multitude of my thoughts within me your comforts delight my soul.
live.canon|psalms|94:20: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with you, which frameth mischief by a law?
live.canon|psalms|94:3: Yahuah (LORD), how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
live.canon|psalms|94:4: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
live.canon|psalms|94:6: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
live.canon|psalms|94:7: Yet they say, Yahuah (LORD) shall not see, neither shall the Elohim (God) of Jacob regard it.
live.canon|psalms|94:9: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
live.canon|psalms|94:14: For Yahuah (LORD) will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
live.canon|psalms|94:15: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
live.canon|psalms|94:16: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
live.canon|psalms|94:17: Unless Yahuah (LORD) had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
live.canon|psalms|94:21: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
live.canon|psalms|94:22: But Yahuah (LORD) is my defence; and my Elohim (God) is the rock of my refuge.
live.canon|psalms|94:23: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall cut them off.
live.canon|psalms|94:1: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), to whom vengeance belongs; O Elohim (God), to whom vengeance belongs, shew thyself.
live.canon|psalms|94:2: Lift up thyself, you judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
live.canon|psalms|94:5: They break in pieces your people, O Yahuah (LORD), and afflict your heritage.
live.canon|psalms|95:7: For he is our Elohim (God); and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if you will hear his voice,
live.canon|psalms|95:1: O come, let us sing unto Yahuah (LORD): let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
live.canon|psalms|95:2: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
live.canon|psalms|95:3: For Yahuah (LORD) is a great Elohim (God), and a great King above all gods.
live.canon|psalms|95:4: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
live.canon|psalms|95:5: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
live.canon|psalms|95:6: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before Yahuah (LORD) our maker.
live.canon|psalms|95:8: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
live.canon|psalms|95:9: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
live.canon|psalms|95:10: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
live.canon|psalms|95:11: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
live.canon|psalms|96:7: Give unto Yahuah (LORD), O you kindreds of the people, give unto Yahuah (LORD) glory and strength.
live.canon|psalms|96:10: Say among the heathen that Yahuah (LORD) reigns: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
live.canon|psalms|96:1: O sing unto Yahuah (LORD) a new song: sing unto Yahuah (LORD), all the earth.
live.canon|psalms|96:2: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD), bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
live.canon|psalms|96:3: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
live.canon|psalms|96:4: For Yahuah (LORD) is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
live.canon|psalms|96:5: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but Yahuah (LORD) made the heavens.
live.canon|psalms|96:6: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
live.canon|psalms|96:8: Give unto Yahuah (LORD) the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
live.canon|psalms|96:9: O worship Yahuah (LORD) in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
live.canon|psalms|96:11: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
live.canon|psalms|96:12: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
live.canon|psalms|96:13: Before Yahuah (LORD): for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
live.canon|psalms|97:1: Yahuah (LORD) reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
live.canon|psalms|97:3: A fire goes before him, and burns up his enemies round about.
live.canon|psalms|97:7: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all you gods.
live.canon|psalms|97:8: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Yahudah (Judah) rejoiced because of your judgments, O Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|97:9: For you, Yahuah (LORD), are high above all the earth: you are exalted far above all gods.
live.canon|psalms|97:10: You that love Yahuah (LORD), hate evil: he preserves the souls of his saints; he delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
live.canon|psalms|97:12: Rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), you righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
live.canon|psalms|97:2: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
live.canon|psalms|97:4: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
live.canon|psalms|97:6: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
live.canon|psalms|97:11: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
live.canon|psalms|97:5: The hills melted like wax at the presence of Yahuah (LORD), at the presence of Adonai (Lord) of the whole earth.
live.canon|psalms|99:1: Yahuah (LORD) reigns; let the people tremble: he sits between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
live.canon|psalms|99:3: Let them praise your great and terrible name; for it is holy.
live.canon|psalms|99:4: The king’s strength also loves judgment; you do establish equity, you executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
live.canon|psalms|99:5: Exalt you Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
live.canon|psalms|99:8: You answeredst them, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God): you were a Elohim (God) that forgavest them, though you tookest vengeance of their inventions.
live.canon|psalms|99:2: Yahuah (LORD) is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
live.canon|psalms|99:6: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon Yahuah (LORD), and he answered them.
live.canon|psalms|99:7: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
live.canon|psalms|99:9: Exalt Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and worship at his holy hill; for Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is holy.
live.canon|psalms|104:1: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul. O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), you are very great; you are clothed with honour and majesty.
live.canon|psalms|104:3: Who lays the beams of his chambers in the waters: who makes the clouds his chariot: who walks upon the wings of the wind:
live.canon|psalms|104:4: Who makes his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
live.canon|psalms|104:6: You coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
live.canon|psalms|104:7: At your rebuke they fled; at the voice of your thunder they hasted away.
live.canon|psalms|104:14: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
live.canon|psalms|104:15: And wine that makes glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.
live.canon|psalms|104:16: The trees of Yahuah (LORD) are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
live.canon|psalms|104:19: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.
live.canon|psalms|104:20: You make darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
live.canon|psalms|104:22: The sun arises, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
live.canon|psalms|104:23: Man goes forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
live.canon|psalms|104:24: O Yahuah (LORD), how manifold are your works! in wisdom have you made them all: the earth is full of your riches.
live.canon|psalms|104:26: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom you have made to play therein.
live.canon|psalms|104:27: These wait all upon you; that you may give them their meat in due season.
live.canon|psalms|104:28: That you give them they gather: you openest your hand, they are filled with good.
live.canon|psalms|104:29: You hide your face, they are troubled: you take away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
live.canon|psalms|104:30: You send forth your spirit, they are created: and you renewest the face of the earth.
live.canon|psalms|104:32: He looks on the earth, and it trembles: he touches the hills, and they smoke.
live.canon|psalms|104:35: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless you Yahuah (LORD), O my soul. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|104:2: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
live.canon|psalms|104:5: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
live.canon|psalms|104:11: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
live.canon|psalms|104:12: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
live.canon|psalms|104:8: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which you have founded for them.
live.canon|psalms|104:9: You have set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
live.canon|psalms|104:17: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
live.canon|psalms|104:18: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
live.canon|psalms|104:21: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|104:25: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
live.canon|psalms|104:31: The glory of Yahuah (LORD) shall endure for ever: Yahuah (LORD) shall rejoice in his works.
live.canon|psalms|104:33: I will sing unto Yahuah (LORD) as long as I live: I will sing praise to my Elohim (God) while I have my being.
live.canon|psalms|104:34: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|104:10: He sends the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
live.canon|psalms|104:13: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your works.
live.canon|psalms|105:2: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk you of all his wondrous works.
live.canon|psalms|105:3: Glory you in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|105:5: Remember his marvellous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
live.canon|psalms|105:6: O you seed of Abraham his servant, you children of Jacob his chosen.
live.canon|psalms|105:8: He has remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
live.canon|psalms|105:11: Saying, Unto you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
live.canon|psalms|105:15: Saying, Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
live.canon|psalms|105:1: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
live.canon|psalms|105:4: Seek Yahuah (LORD), and his strength: seek his face evermore.
live.canon|psalms|105:7: He is Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): his judgments are in all the earth.
live.canon|psalms|105:9: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
live.canon|psalms|105:10: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Yashar'el (Israel) for an everlasting covenant:
live.canon|psalms|105:12: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
live.canon|psalms|105:13: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
live.canon|psalms|105:14: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
live.canon|psalms|105:16: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
live.canon|psalms|105:17: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
live.canon|psalms|105:18: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
live.canon|psalms|105:19: Until the time that his word came: the word of Yahuah (LORD) tried him.
live.canon|psalms|105:20: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
live.canon|psalms|105:21: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
live.canon|psalms|105:22: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
live.canon|psalms|105:23: Yashar'el (Israel) also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
live.canon|psalms|105:24: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
live.canon|psalms|105:25: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
live.canon|psalms|105:26: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
live.canon|psalms|105:27: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
live.canon|psalms|105:28: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
live.canon|psalms|105:29: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
live.canon|psalms|105:30: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
live.canon|psalms|105:31: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
live.canon|psalms|105:32: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
live.canon|psalms|105:33: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
live.canon|psalms|105:34: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
live.canon|psalms|105:35: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
live.canon|psalms|105:36: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
live.canon|psalms|105:37: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
live.canon|psalms|105:38: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
live.canon|psalms|105:39: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
live.canon|psalms|105:45: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|105:40: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
live.canon|psalms|105:41: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
live.canon|psalms|105:42: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
live.canon|psalms|105:43: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
live.canon|psalms|105:44: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
live.canon|psalms|106:3: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that does righteousness at all times.
live.canon|psalms|106:4: Remember me, O Yahuah (LORD), with the favour that you bear unto your people: O visit me with your salvation;
live.canon|psalms|106:5: That I may see the good of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
live.canon|psalms|106:7: Our fathers understood not your wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of your mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
live.canon|psalms|106:20: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eats grass.
live.canon|psalms|106:2: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahuah (LORD)? who can shew forth all his praise?
live.canon|psalms|106:6: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
live.canon|psalms|106:8: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
live.canon|psalms|106:9: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
live.canon|psalms|106:10: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
live.canon|psalms|106:11: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
live.canon|psalms|106:12: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
live.canon|psalms|106:13: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
live.canon|psalms|106:14: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted Elohim (God) in the desert.
live.canon|psalms|106:15: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
live.canon|psalms|106:16: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|106:17: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
live.canon|psalms|106:18: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
live.canon|psalms|106:19: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
live.canon|psalms|106:21: They forgat Elohim (God) their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
live.canon|psalms|106:22: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
live.canon|psalms|106:23: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
live.canon|psalms|106:24: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
live.canon|psalms|106:25: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|106:26: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
live.canon|psalms|106:27: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
live.canon|psalms|106:28: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
live.canon|psalms|106:29: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
live.canon|psalms|106:30: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
live.canon|psalms|106:31: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|106:32: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
live.canon|psalms|106:33: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
live.canon|psalms|106:34: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom Yahuah (LORD) commanded them:
live.canon|psalms|106:35: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
live.canon|psalms|106:36: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
live.canon|psalms|106:37: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
live.canon|psalms|106:38: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
live.canon|psalms|106:39: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
live.canon|psalms|106:40: Therefore was the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
live.canon|psalms|106:41: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
live.canon|psalms|106:42: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
live.canon|psalms|106:43: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
live.canon|psalms|106:44: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
live.canon|psalms|106:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|106:45: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
live.canon|psalms|106:46: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
live.canon|psalms|106:47: Save us, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God), and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto your holy name, and to triumph in your praise.
live.canon|psalms|106:48: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|107:16: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
live.canon|psalms|107:18: Their soul abhors all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
live.canon|psalms|107:19: Then they cry unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
live.canon|psalms|107:25: For he commands, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifts up the waves thereof.
live.canon|psalms|107:28: Then they cry unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distresses.
live.canon|psalms|107:29: He makes the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
live.canon|psalms|107:30: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he brings them unto their desired haven.
live.canon|psalms|107:33: He turns rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
live.canon|psalms|107:35: He turns the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
live.canon|psalms|107:36: And there he makes the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
live.canon|psalms|107:38: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffers not their cattle to decrease.
live.canon|psalms|107:40: He pours contempt upon princes, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
live.canon|psalms|107:41: Yet sets he the poor on high from affliction, and makes him families like a flock.
live.canon|psalms|107:1: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD), for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|107:3: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
live.canon|psalms|107:4: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
live.canon|psalms|107:5: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
live.canon|psalms|107:6: Then they cried unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
live.canon|psalms|107:7: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
live.canon|psalms|107:8: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
live.canon|psalms|107:10: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
live.canon|psalms|107:11: Because they rebelled against the words of Elohim (God), and contemned the counsel of the El Elyon (most High):
live.canon|psalms|107:12: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
live.canon|psalms|107:13: Then they cried unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
live.canon|psalms|107:14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
live.canon|psalms|107:15: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
live.canon|psalms|107:17: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
live.canon|psalms|107:20: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
live.canon|psalms|107:21: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
live.canon|psalms|107:22: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
live.canon|psalms|107:23: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
live.canon|psalms|107:24: These see the works of Yahuah (LORD), and his wonders in the deep.
live.canon|psalms|107:26: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
live.canon|psalms|107:27: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
live.canon|psalms|107:31: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
live.canon|psalms|107:32: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
live.canon|psalms|107:34: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
live.canon|psalms|107:37: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
live.canon|psalms|107:39: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
live.canon|psalms|107:42: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
live.canon|psalms|107:43: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|107:2: Let the redeemed of Yahuah (LORD) say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
live.canon|psalms|107:9: For he satisfies the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
live.canon|psalms|111:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). I will praise Yahuah (LORD) with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
live.canon|psalms|111:3: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|111:4: He has made his wonderful works to be remembered: Yahuah (LORD) is gracious and full of compassion.
live.canon|psalms|111:5: He has given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
live.canon|psalms|111:6: He has shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
live.canon|psalms|111:9: He sent redemption unto his people: he has commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
live.canon|psalms|111:10: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|111:2: The works of Yahuah (LORD) are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
live.canon|psalms|111:7: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
live.canon|psalms|111:8: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
live.canon|psalms|112:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Blessed is the man that fears Yahuah (LORD), that delights greatly in his commandments.
live.canon|psalms|112:5: A good man shows favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
live.canon|psalms|112:9: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
live.canon|psalms|112:2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
live.canon|psalms|112:6: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
live.canon|psalms|112:7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|112:8: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
live.canon|psalms|112:10: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
live.canon|psalms|112:3: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|112:4: Unto the upright there arises light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
live.canon|psalms|113:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise, O you servants of Yahuah (LORD), praise the name of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|113:5: Who is like unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), who dwells on high,
live.canon|psalms|113:7: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifts the needy out of the dunghill;
live.canon|psalms|113:9: He makes the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|113:2: Blessed be the name of Yahuah (LORD) from this time forth and for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|113:3: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’S name is to be praised.
live.canon|psalms|113:4: Yahuah (LORD) is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
live.canon|psalms|113:6: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
live.canon|psalms|113:8: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
live.canon|psalms|114:5: What ailed you, O you sea, that you fleddest? you Jordan, that you were driven back?
live.canon|psalms|114:6: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; and you little hills, like lambs?
live.canon|psalms|114:1: When Yashar'el (Israel) went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
live.canon|psalms|114:2: Yahudah (Judah) was his sanctuary, and Yashar'el (Israel) his dominion.
live.canon|psalms|114:3: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
live.canon|psalms|114:4: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
live.canon|psalms|114:8: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
live.canon|psalms|114:7: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of Adonai (Lord), at the presence of the Elohim (God) of Jacob;
live.canon|psalms|115:1: Not unto us, O Yahuah (LORD), not unto us, but unto your name give glory, for your mercy, and for your truth’s sake.
live.canon|psalms|115:3: But our Elohim (God) is in the heavens: he has done whatsoever he has pleased.
live.canon|psalms|115:8: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusts in them.
live.canon|psalms|115:9: O Yashar'el (Israel), trust you in Yahuah (LORD): he is their help and their shield.
live.canon|psalms|115:11: You that fear Yahuah (LORD), trust in Yahuah (LORD): he is their help and their shield.
live.canon|psalms|115:12: Yahuah (LORD) has been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Yashar'el (Israel); he will bless the house of Aaron.
live.canon|psalms|115:16: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’S: but the earth has he given to the children of men.
live.canon|psalms|115:2: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their Elohim (God)?
live.canon|psalms|115:4: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
live.canon|psalms|115:5: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
live.canon|psalms|115:6: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
live.canon|psalms|115:7: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
live.canon|psalms|115:10: O house of Aaron, trust in Yahuah (LORD): he is their help and their shield.
live.canon|psalms|115:13: He will bless them that fear Yahuah (LORD), both small and great.
live.canon|psalms|115:14: Yahuah (LORD) shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
live.canon|psalms|115:17: The dead praise not Yahuah (LORD), neither any that go down into silence.
live.canon|psalms|115:18: But we will bless Yahuah (LORD) from this time forth and for evermore. Praise Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|115:15: You are blessed of Yahuah (LORD) which made heaven and earth.
live.canon|psalms|116:1: I love Yahuah (LORD), because he has heard my voice and my supplications.
live.canon|psalms|116:2: Because he has inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
live.canon|psalms|116:4: Then called I upon the name of Yahuah (LORD); O Yahuah (LORD), I beseech you, deliver my soul.
live.canon|psalms|116:6: Yahuah (LORD) preserves the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
live.canon|psalms|116:7: Return unto your rest, O my soul; for Yahuah (LORD) has dealt bountifully with you.
live.canon|psalms|116:8: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
live.canon|psalms|116:16: O Yahuah (LORD), truly I am your servant; I am your servant, and the son of your handmaid: you have loosed my bonds.
live.canon|psalms|116:17: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|116:19: In the courts of the LORD’S house, in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|116:3: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
live.canon|psalms|116:5: Gracious is Yahuah (LORD), and righteous; yea, our Elohim (God) is merciful.
live.canon|psalms|116:9: I will walk before Yahuah (LORD) in the land of the living.
live.canon|psalms|116:10: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
live.canon|psalms|116:11: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
live.canon|psalms|116:12: What shall I render unto Yahuah (LORD) for all his benefits toward me?
live.canon|psalms|116:13: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|116:14: I will pay my vows unto Yahuah (LORD) now in the presence of all his people.
live.canon|psalms|116:15: Precious in the sight of Yahuah (LORD) is the death of his saints.
live.canon|psalms|116:18: I will pay my vows unto Yahuah (LORD) now in the presence of all his people,
live.canon|psalms|117:1: O praise Yahuah (LORD), all you nations: praise him, all you people.
live.canon|psalms|117:2: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of Yahuah (LORD) endures for ever. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|118:1: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: because his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|118:2: Let Yashar'el (Israel) now say, that his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|118:3: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|118:4: Let them now that fear Yahuah (LORD) say, that his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|118:7: Yahuah (LORD) takes my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
live.canon|psalms|118:13: You have thrust sore at me that I might fall: but Yahuah (LORD) helped me.
live.canon|psalms|118:15: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of Yahuah (LORD) does valiantly.
live.canon|psalms|118:16: The right hand of Yahuah (LORD) is exalted: the right hand of Yahuah (LORD) does valiantly.
live.canon|psalms|118:18: Yahuah (LORD) has chastened me sore: but he has not given me over unto death.
live.canon|psalms|118:21: I will praise you: for you have heard me, and are become my salvation.
live.canon|psalms|118:24: This is the day which Yahuah (LORD) has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
live.canon|psalms|118:25: Save now, I beseech you, O Yahuah (LORD): O Yahuah (LORD), I beseech you, send now prosperity.
live.canon|psalms|118:26: Blessed be he that comes in the name of Yahuah (LORD): we have blessed you out of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|118:27: Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD), which has shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
live.canon|psalms|118:28: You are my Elohim (God), and I will praise you: you are my Elohim (God), I will exalt you.
live.canon|psalms|118:29: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|118:5: I called upon Yahuah (LORD) in distress: Yahuah (LORD) answered me, and set me in a large place.
live.canon|psalms|118:6: Yahuah (LORD) is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
live.canon|psalms|118:8: It is better to trust in Yahuah (LORD) than to put confidence in man.
live.canon|psalms|118:9: It is better to trust in Yahuah (LORD) than to put confidence in princes.
live.canon|psalms|118:10: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of Yahuah (LORD) will I destroy them.
live.canon|psalms|118:11: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of Yahuah (LORD) I will destroy them.
live.canon|psalms|118:12: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of Yahuah (LORD) I will destroy them.
live.canon|psalms|118:14: Yahuah (LORD) is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
live.canon|psalms|118:17: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|118:19: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|psalms|118:20: This gate of Yahuah (LORD), into which the righteous shall enter.
live.canon|psalms|118:22: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
live.canon|psalms|118:23: This is the LORD’S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
live.canon|psalms|135:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise you the name of Yahuah (LORD); praise him, O you servants of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|135:2: You that stand in the house of Yahuah (LORD), in the courts of the house of our Elohim (God),
live.canon|psalms|135:4: For Yahuah (LORD) has chosen Jacob unto himself, and Yashar'el (Israel) for his peculiar treasure.
live.canon|psalms|135:7: He causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain; he brings the wind out of his treasuries.
live.canon|psalms|135:9: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
live.canon|psalms|135:13: Your name, O Yahuah (LORD), endures for ever; and your memorial, O Yahuah (LORD), throughout all generations.
live.canon|psalms|135:18: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusts in them.
live.canon|psalms|135:20: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O house of Levi: you that fear Yahuah (LORD), bless Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|135:21: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) out of Zion, which dwells at Jerusalem. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|135:3: Praise Yahuah (LORD); for Yahuah (LORD) is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
live.canon|psalms|135:5: For I know that Yahuah (LORD) is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
live.canon|psalms|135:6: Whatsoever Yahuah (LORD) pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
live.canon|psalms|135:8: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
live.canon|psalms|135:10: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
live.canon|psalms|135:11: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
live.canon|psalms|135:12: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Yashar'el (Israel) his people.
live.canon|psalms|135:14: For Yahuah (LORD) will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
live.canon|psalms|135:15: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
live.canon|psalms|135:16: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
live.canon|psalms|135:17: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
live.canon|psalms|135:19: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O house of Yashar'el (Israel): bless Yahuah (LORD), O house of Aaron:
live.canon|psalms|136:1: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:2: O give thanks unto the Elohim (God) of gods: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:4: To him who alone does great wonders: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:5: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:6: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:7: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:8: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:9: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:10: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:11: And brought out Yashar'el (Israel) from among them: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:12: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:13: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:14: And made Yashar'el (Israel) to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:15: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:16: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:17: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:18: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:19: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:20: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:21: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:22: Even an heritage unto Yashar'el (Israel) his servant: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:23: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endures for ever:
live.canon|psalms|136:24: And has redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:25: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:26: O give thanks unto the Elohim (God) of heaven: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|136:3: O give thanks to Adonai (Lord) of lords: for his mercy endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|137:1: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
live.canon|psalms|137:2: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
live.canon|psalms|137:3: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
live.canon|psalms|137:4: How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?
live.canon|psalms|137:7: Remember, O Yahuah (LORD), the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
live.canon|psalms|137:5: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
live.canon|psalms|137:6: If I do not remember you, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
live.canon|psalms|137:8: O daughter of Babylon, who are to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth you as you have served us.
live.canon|psalms|137:9: Happy shall he be, that takes and dasheth your little ones against the stones.
live.canon|psalms|146:4: His breath goes forth, he returns to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
live.canon|psalms|146:5: Happy is he that has the Elohim (God) of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God):
live.canon|psalms|146:6: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keeps truth for ever:
live.canon|psalms|146:7: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which gives food to the hungry. Yahuah (LORD) looseth the prisoners:
live.canon|psalms|146:8: Yahuah (LORD) opens the eyes of the blind: Yahuah (LORD) raiseth them that are bowed down: Yahuah (LORD) loves the righteous:
live.canon|psalms|146:9: Yahuah (LORD) preserves the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turns upside down.
live.canon|psalms|146:10: Yahuah (LORD) shall reign for ever, even your Elohim (God), O Zion, unto all generations. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|146:2: While I live will I praise Yahuah (LORD): I will sing praises unto my Elohim (God) while I have any being.
live.canon|psalms|146:3: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of Adam, in whom there is no help.
live.canon|psalms|146:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise Yahuah (LORD), O my soul.
live.canon|psalms|147:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD): for it is good to sing praises unto our Elohim (God); for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
live.canon|psalms|147:2: Yahuah (LORD) does build up Jerusalem: he gathers together the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|147:3: He healeth the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
live.canon|psalms|147:4: He telleth the number of the stars; he calls them all by their names.
live.canon|psalms|147:6: Yahuah (LORD) lifts up the meek: he casts the wicked down to the ground.
live.canon|psalms|147:8: Who covers the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow upon the mountains.
live.canon|psalms|147:9: He gives to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
live.canon|psalms|147:12: Praise Yahuah (LORD), O Jerusalem; praise your Elohim (God), O Zion.
live.canon|psalms|147:13: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates; he has blessed your children within you.
live.canon|psalms|147:14: He makes peace in your borders, and filleth you with the finest of the wheat.
live.canon|psalms|147:15: He sends forth his commandment upon earth: his word runs very swiftly.
live.canon|psalms|147:16: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the hoarfrost like ashes.
live.canon|psalms|147:17: He casts forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
live.canon|psalms|147:18: He sends out his word, and melteth them: he causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
live.canon|psalms|147:19: He shows his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|147:20: He has not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|147:5: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
live.canon|psalms|147:7: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD) with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our Elohim (God):
live.canon|psalms|147:10: He delights not in the strength of the horse: he takes not pleasure in the legs of a man.
live.canon|psalms|147:11: Yahuah (LORD) takes pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
live.canon|psalms|148:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise you Yahuah (LORD) from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
live.canon|psalms|148:2: Praise you him, all his angels: praise you him, all his hosts.
live.canon|psalms|148:3: Praise you him, sun and moon: praise him, all you stars of light.
live.canon|psalms|148:4: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, and you waters that be above the heavens.
live.canon|psalms|148:6: He has also stablished them for ever and ever: he has made a decree which shall not pass.
live.canon|psalms|148:7: Praise Yahuah (LORD) from the earth, you dragons, and all deeps:
live.canon|psalms|148:14: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), a people near unto him. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|148:5: Let them praise the name of Yahuah (LORD): for he commanded, and they were created.
live.canon|psalms|148:8: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
live.canon|psalms|148:9: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
live.canon|psalms|148:10: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
live.canon|psalms|148:11: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
live.canon|psalms|148:12: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
live.canon|psalms|148:13: Let them praise the name of Yahuah (LORD): for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
live.canon|psalms|149:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Sing unto Yahuah (LORD) a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
live.canon|psalms|149:4: For Yahuah (LORD) takes pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
live.canon|psalms|149:9: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|149:2: Let Yashar'el (Israel) rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
live.canon|psalms|149:3: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
live.canon|psalms|149:5: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
live.canon|psalms|149:6: Let the high praises of Elohim (God) be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
live.canon|psalms|149:7: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
live.canon|psalms|149:8: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
live.canon|psalms|150:1: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise Elohim (God) in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
live.canon|psalms|150:6: Let every thing that has breath praise Yahuah (LORD). Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|150:2: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
live.canon|psalms|150:3: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
live.canon|psalms|150:4: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
live.canon|psalms|150:5: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
live.canon|psalms|3:3: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), are a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
live.canon|psalms|3:7: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD); save me, O my Elohim (God): for you have smitten all my enemies upon the cheek bone; you have broken the teeth of the ungodly.
live.canon|psalms|3:8: Salvation belongs unto Yahuah (LORD): your blessing is upon your people. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|3:1: Yahuah (LORD), how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
live.canon|psalms|3:2: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in Elohim (God). Selah.
live.canon|psalms|3:4: I cried unto Yahuah (LORD) with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|3:5: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Yahuah (LORD) sustained me.
live.canon|psalms|3:6: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
live.canon|psalms|4:1: Hear me when I call, O Elohim (God) of my righteousness: you have enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
live.canon|psalms|4:2: O you sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? how long will you love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
live.canon|psalms|4:3: But know that Yahuah (LORD) has set apart him that is godly for himself: Yahuah (LORD) will hear when I call unto him.
live.canon|psalms|4:6: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Yahuah (LORD), lift you up the light of your countenance upon us.
live.canon|psalms|4:7: You have put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
live.canon|psalms|4:8: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for you, Yahuah (LORD), only make me dwell in safety.
live.canon|psalms|4:4: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|4:5: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|5:8: Lead me, O Yahuah (LORD), in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before my face.
live.canon|psalms|5:10: Destroy you them, O Elohim (God); let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against you.
live.canon|psalms|5:11: But let all those that put their trust in you rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because you defendest them: let them also that love your name be joyful in you.
live.canon|psalms|5:12: For you, Yahuah (LORD), will bless the righteous; with favour will you compass him as with a shield.
live.canon|psalms|5:1: Give ear to my words, O Yahuah (LORD), consider my meditation.
live.canon|psalms|5:2: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my Elohim (God): for unto you will I pray.
live.canon|psalms|5:3: My voice shall you hear in the morning, O Yahuah (LORD); in the morning will I direct my prayer unto you, and will look up.
live.canon|psalms|5:4: For you are not a Elohim (God) that has pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with you.
live.canon|psalms|5:5: The foolish shall not stand in your sight: you hate all workers of iniquity.
live.canon|psalms|5:9: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
live.canon|psalms|5:6: You shall destroy them that speak leasing: Yahuah (LORD) will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
live.canon|psalms|5:7: But as for me, I will come into your house in the multitude of your mercy: and in your fear will I worship toward your holy temple.
live.canon|psalms|6:1: O Yahuah (LORD), rebuke me not in your anger, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
live.canon|psalms|6:3: My soul is also sore vexed: but you, O Yahuah (LORD), how long?
live.canon|psalms|6:4: Return, O Yahuah (LORD), deliver my soul: oh save me for your mercies’ sake.
live.canon|psalms|6:5: For in death there is no remembrance of you: in the grave who shall give you thanks?
live.canon|psalms|6:7: My eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all my enemies.
live.canon|psalms|6:8: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for Yahuah (LORD) has heard the voice of my weeping.
live.canon|psalms|6:9: Yahuah (LORD) has heard my supplication; Yahuah (LORD) will receive my prayer.
live.canon|psalms|6:10: Let all my enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
live.canon|psalms|6:2: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah (LORD); for I am weak: O Yahuah (LORD), heal me; for my bones are vexed.
live.canon|psalms|6:6: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
live.canon|psalms|7:1: O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), in you do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
live.canon|psalms|7:4: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is my enemy:)
live.canon|psalms|7:5: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay my honour in the dust. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|7:6: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD), in your anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of my enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that you have commanded.
live.canon|psalms|7:7: So shall the congregation of the people compass you about: for their sakes therefore return you on high.
live.canon|psalms|7:8: Yahuah (LORD) shall judge the people: judge me, O Yahuah (LORD), according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity that is in me.
live.canon|psalms|7:10: My defence is of Elohim (God), which saves the upright in heart.
live.canon|psalms|7:11: Elohim (God) judges the righteous, and Elohim (God) is angry with the wicked every day.
live.canon|psalms|7:12: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.
live.canon|psalms|7:13: He has also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
live.canon|psalms|7:14: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and has conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
live.canon|psalms|7:2: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
live.canon|psalms|7:3: O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
live.canon|psalms|7:9: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous Elohim (God) trieth the hearts and reins.
live.canon|psalms|7:15: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
live.canon|psalms|7:16: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
live.canon|psalms|7:17: I will praise Yahuah (LORD) according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of Yahuah (LORD) most high.
live.canon|psalms|8:1: O Yahuah (LORD) our Lord, how excellent is your name in all the earth! who have set your glory above the heavens.
live.canon|psalms|8:2: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings have you ordained strength because of your enemies, that you might still the enemy and the avenger.
live.canon|psalms|8:3: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
live.canon|psalms|8:4: What is man, that you are mindful of him? and the son of Adam, that you visit him?
live.canon|psalms|8:5: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and have crowned him with glory and honour.
live.canon|psalms|8:6: You made him to have dominion over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet:
live.canon|psalms|8:8: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passes through the paths of the seas.
live.canon|psalms|8:9: O Yahuah (LORD) our Lord, how excellent is your name in all the earth!
live.canon|psalms|8:7: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
live.canon|psalms|9:13: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah (LORD); consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, you that liftest me up from the gates of death:
live.canon|psalms|9:19: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD); let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in your sight.
live.canon|psalms|9:1: I will praise you, O Yahuah (LORD), with my whole heart; I will shew forth all your marvellous works.
live.canon|psalms|9:2: I will be glad and rejoice in you: I will sing praise to your name, O you El Elyon (most High).
live.canon|psalms|9:3: When my enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at your presence.
live.canon|psalms|9:4: For you have maintained my right and my cause; you sat in the throne judging right.
live.canon|psalms|9:5: You have rebuked the heathen, you have destroyed the wicked, you have put out their name for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|9:6: O you enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and you have destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
live.canon|psalms|9:7: But Yahuah (LORD) shall endure for ever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.
live.canon|psalms|9:8: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
live.canon|psalms|9:9: Yahuah (LORD) also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
live.canon|psalms|9:15: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
live.canon|psalms|9:16: Yahuah (LORD) is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|9:17: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|9:18: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
live.canon|psalms|9:20: Put them in fear, O Yahuah (LORD): that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|9:10: And they that know your name will put their trust in you: for you, Yahuah (LORD), have not forsaken them that seek you.
live.canon|psalms|9:11: Sing praises to Yahuah (LORD), which dwells in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
live.canon|psalms|9:12: When he makes inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
live.canon|psalms|9:14: That I may shew forth all your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in your salvation.
live.canon|psalms|11:1: In Yahuah (LORD) put I my trust: how say you to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
live.canon|psalms|11:5: Yahuah (LORD) trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loves violence his soul hates.
live.canon|psalms|11:2: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
live.canon|psalms|11:3: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
live.canon|psalms|11:4: Yahuah (LORD) is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
live.canon|psalms|11:6: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
live.canon|psalms|11:7: For the righteous Yahuah (LORD) loves righteousness; his countenance does behold the upright.
live.canon|psalms|12:2: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
live.canon|psalms|12:1: Help, Yahuah (LORD); for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
live.canon|psalms|12:3: Yahuah (LORD) shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaks proud things:
live.canon|psalms|12:4: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
live.canon|psalms|12:6: The words of Yahuah (LORD) are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
live.canon|psalms|12:8: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
live.canon|psalms|12:5: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says Yahuah (LORD); I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
live.canon|psalms|12:7: You shall keep them, O Yahuah (LORD), you shall preserve them from this generation for ever.
live.canon|psalms|13:2: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
live.canon|psalms|13:3: Consider and hear me, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God): lighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
live.canon|psalms|13:5: But I have trusted in your mercy; my heart shall rejoice in your salvation.
live.canon|psalms|13:6: I will sing unto Yahuah (LORD), because he has dealt bountifully with me.
live.canon|psalms|13:1: How long will you forget me, O Yahuah (LORD)? for ever? how long will you hide your face from me?
live.canon|psalms|13:4: Lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
live.canon|psalms|14:1: The fool has said in his heart, There is no Elohim (God). They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that does good.
live.canon|psalms|14:3: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that does good, no, not one.
live.canon|psalms|14:6: You have shamed the counsel of the poor, because Yahuah (LORD) is his refuge.
live.canon|psalms|14:7: Oh that the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of Zion! when Yahuah (LORD) brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be glad.
live.canon|psalms|14:2: Yahuah (LORD) looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|14:4: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon Yahuah (LORD).
