live.canon|psalms|14:5: There were they in great fear: for Elohim (God) is in the generation of the righteous.
live.canon|psalms|15:1: Yahuah (LORD), who shall abide in your tabernacle? who shall dwell in your holy hill?
live.canon|psalms|15:2: He that walks uprightly, and works righteousness, and speaks the truth in his heart.
live.canon|psalms|15:3: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor does evil to his neighbour, nor takes up a reproach against his neighbour.
live.canon|psalms|15:4: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear Yahuah (LORD). He that swears to his own hurt, and changeth not.
live.canon|psalms|15:5: He that puts not out his money to usury, nor takes reward against the innocent. He that does these things shall never be moved.
live.canon|psalms|16:1: Preserve me, O Elohim (God): for in you do I put my trust.
live.canon|psalms|16:2: O my soul, you have said unto Yahuah (LORD), You are my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to you;
live.canon|psalms|16:5: Yahuah (LORD) is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: you maintainest my lot.
live.canon|psalms|16:7: I will bless Yahuah (LORD), who has given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
live.canon|psalms|16:9: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
live.canon|psalms|16:10: For you will not leave my soul in hell; neither will you suffer your Holy One to see corruption.
live.canon|psalms|16:11: You will shew me the path of life: in your presence is fulness of joy; at your right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|16:3: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
live.canon|psalms|16:4: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
live.canon|psalms|16:6: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
live.canon|psalms|16:8: I have set Yahuah (LORD) always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
live.canon|psalms|17:1: Hear the right, O Yahuah (LORD), attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goes not out of feigned lips.
live.canon|psalms|17:2: Let my sentence come forth from your presence; let your eyes behold the things that are equal.
live.canon|psalms|17:3: You have proved my heart; you have visited me in the night; you have tried me, and shall find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
live.canon|psalms|17:4: Concerning the works of men, by the word of your lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
live.canon|psalms|17:5: Hold up my goings in your paths, that my footsteps slip not.
live.canon|psalms|17:6: I have called upon you, for you will hear me, O Elohim (God): incline your ear unto me, and hear my speech.
live.canon|psalms|17:7: Shew your marvellous lovingkindness, O you that savest by your right hand them which put their trust in you from those that rise up against them.
live.canon|psalms|17:13: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD), disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is your sword:
live.canon|psalms|17:14: From men which are your hand, O Yahuah (LORD), from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly you fillest with your hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
live.canon|psalms|17:15: As for me, I will behold your face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with your likeness.
live.canon|psalms|17:9: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
live.canon|psalms|17:10: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
live.canon|psalms|17:11: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
live.canon|psalms|17:12: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
live.canon|psalms|17:8: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of your wings,
live.canon|psalms|18:1: I will love you, O Yahuah (LORD), my strength.
live.canon|psalms|18:3: I will call upon Yahuah (LORD), who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from my enemies.
live.canon|psalms|18:15: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at your rebuke, O Yahuah (LORD), at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
live.canon|psalms|18:20: Yahuah (LORD) rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
live.canon|psalms|18:23: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.
live.canon|psalms|18:24: Therefore has Yahuah (LORD) recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
live.canon|psalms|18:25: With the merciful you will shew thyself merciful; with an upright man you will shew thyself upright;
live.canon|psalms|18:26: With the pure you will shew thyself pure; and with the froward you will shew thyself froward.
live.canon|psalms|18:27: For you will save the afflicted people; but will bring down high looks.
live.canon|psalms|18:28: For you will light my candle: Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) will enlighten my darkness.
live.canon|psalms|18:29: For by you I have run through a troop; and by my Elohim (God) have I leaped over a wall.
live.canon|psalms|18:32: It is Elohim (God) that girdeth me with strength, and makes my way perfect.
live.canon|psalms|18:33: He makes my feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me upon my high places.
live.canon|psalms|18:34: He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.
live.canon|psalms|18:35: You have also given me the shield of your salvation: and your right hand has holden me up, and your gentleness has made me great.
live.canon|psalms|18:36: You have enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
live.canon|psalms|18:37: I have pursued my enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
live.canon|psalms|18:39: For you have girded me with strength unto the battle: you have subdued under me those that rose up against me.
live.canon|psalms|18:40: You have also given me the necks of my enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
live.canon|psalms|18:43: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; and you have made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
live.canon|psalms|18:46: Yahuah (LORD) lives; and blessed be my rock; and let the Elohim (God) of my salvation be exalted.
live.canon|psalms|18:49: Therefore will I give thanks unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the heathen, and sing praises unto your name.
live.canon|psalms|18:50: Great deliverance gives he to his king; and shows mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|18:2: Yahuah (LORD) is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my Elohim (God), my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
live.canon|psalms|18:4: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
live.canon|psalms|18:5: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
live.canon|psalms|18:6: In my distress I called upon Yahuah (LORD), and cried unto my Elohim (God): he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
live.canon|psalms|18:7: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
live.canon|psalms|18:8: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
live.canon|psalms|18:9: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
live.canon|psalms|18:10: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
live.canon|psalms|18:11: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
live.canon|psalms|18:12: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
live.canon|psalms|18:13: Yahuah (LORD) also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
live.canon|psalms|18:14: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
live.canon|psalms|18:16: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
live.canon|psalms|18:17: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
live.canon|psalms|18:18: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but Yahuah (LORD) was my stay.
live.canon|psalms|18:19: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
live.canon|psalms|18:21: For I have kept the ways of Yahuah (LORD), and have not wickedly departed from my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|18:22: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
live.canon|psalms|18:30: As for Elohim (God), his way is perfect: the word of Yahuah (LORD) is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
live.canon|psalms|18:31: For who is Elohim (God) save Yahuah (LORD)? or who is a rock save our Elohim (God)?
live.canon|psalms|18:38: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
live.canon|psalms|18:41: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto Yahuah (LORD), but he answered them not.
live.canon|psalms|18:42: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
live.canon|psalms|18:44: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
live.canon|psalms|18:45: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
live.canon|psalms|18:47: It is Elohim (God) that avenges me, and subdueth the people under me.
live.canon|psalms|18:48: He delivers me from my enemies: yea, you liftest me up above those that rise up against me: you have delivered me from the violent man.
live.canon|psalms|19:2: Day unto day utters speech, and night unto night shows knowledge.
live.canon|psalms|19:4: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them has he set a tabernacle for the sun,
live.canon|psalms|19:5: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoices as a strong man to run a race.
live.canon|psalms|19:11: Moreover by them is your servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
live.canon|psalms|19:12: Who can understand his errors? cleanse you me from secret faults.
live.canon|psalms|19:13: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
live.canon|psalms|19:14: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in your sight, O Yahuah (LORD), my strength, and my redeemer.
live.canon|psalms|19:3: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
live.canon|psalms|19:6: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
live.canon|psalms|19:7: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.
live.canon|psalms|19:8: The statutes of Yahuah (LORD) are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) is pure, enlightening the eyes.
live.canon|psalms|19:9: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of Yahuah (LORD) are true and righteous altogether.
live.canon|psalms|19:10: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
live.canon|psalms|19:1: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament shows his handywork.
live.canon|psalms|20:1: Yahuah (LORD) hear you in the day of trouble; the name of the Elohim (God) of Jacob defend you;
live.canon|psalms|20:2: Send you help from the sanctuary, and strengthen you out of Zion;
live.canon|psalms|20:3: Remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice; Selah.
live.canon|psalms|20:4: Grant you according to your own heart, and fulfil all your counsel.
live.canon|psalms|20:5: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our Elohim (God) we will set up our banners: Yahuah (LORD) fulfil all your petitions.
live.canon|psalms|20:6: Now know I that Yahuah (LORD) saves his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
live.canon|psalms|20:7: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
live.canon|psalms|20:8: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
live.canon|psalms|20:9: Save, Yahuah (LORD): let the king hear us when we call.
live.canon|psalms|21:1: The king shall joy in your strength, O Yahuah (LORD); and in your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
live.canon|psalms|21:2: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|21:3: For you preventest him with the blessings of goodness: you set a crown of pure gold on his head.
live.canon|psalms|21:4: He asked life of you, and you gave it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|21:5: His glory is great in your salvation: honour and majesty have you laid upon him.
live.canon|psalms|21:6: For you have made him most blessed for ever: you have made him exceeding glad with your countenance.
live.canon|psalms|21:7: For the king trusts in Yahuah (LORD), and through the mercy of the El Elyon (most High) he shall not be moved.
live.canon|psalms|21:8: Your hand shall find out all your enemies: your right hand shall find out those that hate you.
live.canon|psalms|21:9: You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of your anger: Yahuah (LORD) shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
live.canon|psalms|21:10: Their fruit shall you destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
live.canon|psalms|21:11: For they intended evil against you: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
live.canon|psalms|21:12: Therefore shall you make them turn their back, when you shall make ready your arrows upon your strings against the face of them.
live.canon|psalms|21:13: Be you exalted, Yahuah (LORD), in your own strength: so will we sing and praise your power.
live.canon|psalms|22:1: My Elohim (God), my Elohim (God), why have you forsaken me? why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
live.canon|psalms|22:2: O my Elohim (God), I cry in the daytime, but you hear not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
live.canon|psalms|22:3: But you are holy, O you that inhabitest the praises of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|22:4: Our fathers trusted in you: they trusted, and you did deliver them.
live.canon|psalms|22:5: They cried unto you, and were delivered: they trusted in you, and were not confounded.
live.canon|psalms|22:9: But you are he that took me out of the womb: you did make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.
live.canon|psalms|22:10: I was cast upon you from the womb: you are my Elohim (God) from my mother’s belly.
live.canon|psalms|22:23: You that fear Yahuah (LORD), praise him; all you the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all you the seed of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|22:24: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither has he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
live.canon|psalms|22:25: My praise shall be of you in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
live.canon|psalms|22:27: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto Yahuah (LORD): and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before you.
live.canon|psalms|22:31: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he has done this.
live.canon|psalms|22:6: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
live.canon|psalms|22:7: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
live.canon|psalms|22:8: He trusted on Yahuah (LORD) that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
live.canon|psalms|22:11: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
live.canon|psalms|22:12: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
live.canon|psalms|22:13: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
live.canon|psalms|22:14: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
live.canon|psalms|22:16: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
live.canon|psalms|22:17: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
live.canon|psalms|22:18: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
live.canon|psalms|22:15: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaves to my jaws; and you have brought me into the dust of death.
live.canon|psalms|22:20: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
live.canon|psalms|22:26: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise Yahuah (LORD) that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
live.canon|psalms|22:28: For the kingdom is the LORD’S: and he is the governor among the nations.
live.canon|psalms|22:29: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
live.canon|psalms|22:19: But be not you far from me, O Yahuah (LORD): O my strength, haste you to help me.
live.canon|psalms|22:21: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for you have heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
live.canon|psalms|22:22: I will declare your name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise you.
live.canon|psalms|22:30: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to Adonai (Lord) for a generation.
live.canon|psalms|23:2: He makes me to lie down in green pastures: he leads me beside the still waters.
live.canon|psalms|23:3: He restoreth my soul: he leads me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
live.canon|psalms|23:4: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for you are with me; your rod and your staff they comfort me.
live.canon|psalms|23:5: You preparest a table before me in the presence of my enemies: you anointest my head with oil; my cup runs over.
live.canon|psalms|23:1: Yahuah Ra'ah (The LORD is my shepherd); I shall not want.
live.canon|psalms|23:6: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of Yahuah (LORD) for ever.
live.canon|psalms|24:2: For he has founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
live.canon|psalms|24:4: He that has clean hands, and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
live.canon|psalms|24:6: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek your face, O Jacob. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|24:7: Lift up your heads, O you gates; and be you lift up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
live.canon|psalms|24:9: Lift up your heads, O you gates; even lift them up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
live.canon|psalms|24:1: The earth is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
live.canon|psalms|24:3: Who shall ascend into the hill of Yahuah (LORD)? or who shall stand in his holy place?
live.canon|psalms|24:5: He shall receive the blessing from Yahuah (LORD), and righteousness from the Elohim (God) of his salvation.
live.canon|psalms|24:8: Who is this King of glory? Yahuah (LORD) strong and mighty, Yahuah (LORD) mighty in battle.
live.canon|psalms|24:10: Who is this King of glory? Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), he is the King of glory. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|25:1: Unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I lift up my soul.
live.canon|psalms|25:2: O my Elohim (God), I trust in you: let me not be ashamed, let not my enemies triumph over me.
live.canon|psalms|25:3: Yea, let none that wait on you be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
live.canon|psalms|25:4: Shew me your ways, O Yahuah (LORD); teach me your paths.
live.canon|psalms|25:5: Lead me in your truth, and teach me: for you are the Elohim (God) of my salvation; on you do I wait all the day.
live.canon|psalms|25:6: Remember, O Yahuah (LORD), your tender mercies and your lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
live.canon|psalms|25:7: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to your mercy remember you me for your goodness’ sake, O Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|25:11: For your name’s sake, O Yahuah (LORD), pardon my iniquity; for it is great.
live.canon|psalms|25:12: What man is he that fears Yahuah (LORD)? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
live.canon|psalms|25:15: My eyes are ever toward Yahuah (LORD); for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
live.canon|psalms|25:16: Turn you unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
live.canon|psalms|25:17: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring you me out of my distresses.
live.canon|psalms|25:18: Look upon my affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
live.canon|psalms|25:8: Good and upright is Yahuah (LORD): therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
live.canon|psalms|25:9: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
live.canon|psalms|25:10: All the paths of Yahuah (LORD) are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|25:13: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
live.canon|psalms|25:14: The secret of Yahuah (LORD) is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
live.canon|psalms|25:22: Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles.
live.canon|psalms|25:19: Consider my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
live.canon|psalms|25:20: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in you.
live.canon|psalms|25:21: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on you.
live.canon|psalms|26:12: My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations will I bless Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|26:1: Judge me, O Yahuah (LORD); for I have walked in my integrity: I have trusted also in Yahuah (LORD); therefore I shall not slide.
live.canon|psalms|26:2: Examine me, O Yahuah (LORD), and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
live.canon|psalms|26:4: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
live.canon|psalms|26:5: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
live.canon|psalms|26:9: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
live.canon|psalms|26:10: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
live.canon|psalms|26:3: For your lovingkindness is before my eyes: and I have walked in your truth.
live.canon|psalms|26:6: I will wash my hands in innocency: so will I compass your altar, O Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|psalms|26:7: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all your wondrous works.
live.canon|psalms|26:8: Yahuah (LORD), I have loved the habitation of your house, and the place where your honour dwells.
live.canon|psalms|26:11: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
live.canon|psalms|27:2: When the wicked, even my enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
live.canon|psalms|27:6: And now shall my head be lifted up above my enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|27:8: When you saidst, Seek you my face; my heart said unto you, Your face, Yahuah (LORD), will I seek.
live.canon|psalms|27:9: Hide not your face far from me; put not your servant away in anger: you have been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O Elohim (God) of my salvation.
live.canon|psalms|27:11: Teach me your way, O Yahuah (LORD), and lead me in a plain path, because of my enemies.
live.canon|psalms|27:12: Deliver me not over unto the will of my enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
live.canon|psalms|27:14: Wait on Yahuah (LORD): be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart: wait, I say, on Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|27:1: Yahuah (LORD) is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Yahuah (LORD) is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
live.canon|psalms|27:3: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
live.canon|psalms|27:4: One thing have I desired of Yahuah (LORD), that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of Yahuah (LORD) all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of Yahuah (LORD), and to enquire in his temple.
live.canon|psalms|27:5: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
live.canon|psalms|27:7: Hear, O Yahuah (LORD), when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
live.canon|psalms|27:10: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahuah (LORD) will take me up.
live.canon|psalms|27:13: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Yahuah (LORD) in the land of the living.
live.canon|psalms|28:1: Unto you will I cry, O Yahuah (LORD) my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if you be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
live.canon|psalms|28:2: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto you, when I lift up my hands toward your holy oracle.
live.canon|psalms|28:6: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), because he has heard the voice of my supplications.
live.canon|psalms|28:7: Yahuah (LORD) is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song will I praise him.
live.canon|psalms|28:9: Save your people, and bless your inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
live.canon|psalms|28:3: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
live.canon|psalms|28:4: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
live.canon|psalms|28:5: Because they regard not the works of Yahuah (LORD), nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
live.canon|psalms|28:8: Yahuah (LORD) is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
live.canon|psalms|29:1: Give unto Yahuah (LORD), O you mighty, give unto Yahuah (LORD) glory and strength.
live.canon|psalms|29:5: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) breaks the cedars; yea, Yahuah (LORD) breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
live.canon|psalms|29:6: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
live.canon|psalms|29:7: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) divides the flames of fire.
live.canon|psalms|29:9: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) makes the hinds to calve, and discovers the forests: and in his temple does every one speak of his glory.
live.canon|psalms|29:10: Yahuah (LORD) sits upon the flood; yea, Yahuah (LORD) sits King for ever.
live.canon|psalms|29:2: Give unto Yahuah (LORD) the glory due unto his name; worship Yahuah (LORD) in the beauty of holiness.
live.canon|psalms|29:3: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) is upon the waters: the Elohim (God) of glory thundereth: Yahuah (LORD) is upon many waters.
live.canon|psalms|29:4: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) is powerful; the voice of Yahuah (LORD) is full of majesty.
live.canon|psalms|29:8: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) shaketh the wilderness; Yahuah (LORD) shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
live.canon|psalms|29:11: Yahuah (LORD) will give strength unto his people; Yahuah (LORD) will bless his people with peace.
live.canon|psalms|30:1: I will extol you, O Yahuah (LORD); for you have lifted me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
live.canon|psalms|30:2: O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), I cried unto you, and you have healed me.
live.canon|psalms|30:3: O Yahuah (LORD), you have brought up my soul from the grave: you have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
live.canon|psalms|30:4: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD), O you saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
live.canon|psalms|30:5: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
live.canon|psalms|30:7: Yahuah (LORD), by your favour you have made my mountain to stand strong: you did hide your face, and I was troubled.
live.canon|psalms|30:8: I cried to you, O Yahuah (LORD); and unto Yahuah (LORD) I made supplication.
live.canon|psalms|30:9: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? shall it declare your truth?
live.canon|psalms|30:10: Hear, O Yahuah (LORD), and have mercy upon me: Yahuah (LORD), be you my helper.
live.canon|psalms|30:11: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing: you have put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
live.canon|psalms|30:12: To the end that my glory may sing praise to you, and not be silent. O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), I will give thanks unto you for ever.
live.canon|psalms|30:6: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
live.canon|psalms|31:1: In you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in your righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|31:2: Bow down your ear to me; deliver me speedily: be you my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
live.canon|psalms|31:3: For you are my rock and my fortress; therefore for your name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
live.canon|psalms|31:4: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for you are my strength.
live.canon|psalms|31:5: Into your hand I commit my spirit: you have redeemed me, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of truth.
live.canon|psalms|31:7: I will be glad and rejoice in your mercy: for you have considered my trouble; you have known my soul in adversities;
live.canon|psalms|31:8: And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: you have set my feet in a large room.
live.canon|psalms|31:9: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah (LORD), for I am in trouble: my eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
live.canon|psalms|31:10: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
live.canon|psalms|31:11: I was a reproach among all my enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to my acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
live.canon|psalms|31:14: But I trusted in you, O Yahuah (LORD): I said, You are my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|31:15: My times are in your hand: deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from them that persecute me.
live.canon|psalms|31:16: Make your face to shine upon your servant: save me for your mercies’ sake.
live.canon|psalms|31:17: Let me not be ashamed, O Yahuah (LORD); for I have called upon you: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
live.canon|psalms|31:19: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for them that fear you; which you have wrought for them that trust in you before the sons of men!
live.canon|psalms|31:20: You shall hide them in the secret of your presence from the pride of man: you shall keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
live.canon|psalms|31:21: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD): for he has shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
live.canon|psalms|31:22: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before your eyes: nevertheless you heard the voice of my supplications when I cried unto you.
live.canon|psalms|31:23: O love Yahuah (LORD), all you his saints: for Yahuah (LORD) preserves the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
live.canon|psalms|31:24: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all you that hope in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|31:6: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|31:12: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
live.canon|psalms|31:13: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
live.canon|psalms|31:18: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
live.canon|psalms|32:11: Be glad in Yahuah (LORD), and rejoice, you righteous: and shout for joy, all you that are upright in heart.
live.canon|psalms|32:4: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|32:5: I acknowledged my sin unto you, and my iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Yahuah (LORD); and you forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|32:6: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto you in a time when you may be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
live.canon|psalms|32:7: You are my hiding place; you shall preserve me from trouble; you shall compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|32:8: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go: I will guide you with my eye.
live.canon|psalms|32:9: Be you not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto you.
live.canon|psalms|32:10: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusts in Yahuah (LORD), mercy shall compass him about.
live.canon|psalms|32:1: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
live.canon|psalms|32:2: Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah (LORD) imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
live.canon|psalms|32:3: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
live.canon|psalms|34:7: The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivers them.
live.canon|psalms|34:8: O taste and see that Yahuah (LORD) is good: blessed is the man that trusts in him.
live.canon|psalms|34:9: O fear Yahuah (LORD), you his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
live.canon|psalms|34:11: Come, you children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|34:12: What man is he that desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
live.canon|psalms|34:13: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile.
live.canon|psalms|34:17: The righteous cry, and Yahuah (LORD) hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
live.canon|psalms|34:18: Yahuah (LORD) is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saves such as be of a contrite spirit.
live.canon|psalms|34:19: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but Yahuah (LORD) delivers him out of them all.
live.canon|psalms|34:20: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.
live.canon|psalms|34:1: I will bless Yahuah (LORD) at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
live.canon|psalms|34:2: My soul shall make her boast in Yahuah (LORD): the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
live.canon|psalms|34:3: O magnify Yahuah (LORD) with me, and let us exalt his name together.
live.canon|psalms|34:4: I sought Yahuah (LORD), and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
live.canon|psalms|34:5: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
live.canon|psalms|34:6: This poor man cried, and Yahuah (LORD) heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
live.canon|psalms|34:10: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek Yahuah (LORD) shall not want any good thing.
live.canon|psalms|34:14: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
live.canon|psalms|34:15: The eyes of Yahuah (LORD) are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
live.canon|psalms|34:16: The face of Yahuah (LORD) is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
live.canon|psalms|34:21: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
live.canon|psalms|34:22: Yahuah (LORD) redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
live.canon|psalms|35:2: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
live.canon|psalms|35:3: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am your salvation.
live.canon|psalms|35:8: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he has hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
live.canon|psalms|35:24: Judge me, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), according to your righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
live.canon|psalms|35:26: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at my hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
live.canon|psalms|35:27: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let Yahuah (LORD) be magnified, which has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
live.canon|psalms|35:28: And my tongue shall speak of your righteousness and of your praise all the day long.
live.canon|psalms|35:1: Plead my cause, O Yahuah (LORD), with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
live.canon|psalms|35:4: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
live.canon|psalms|35:5: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of Yahuah (LORD) chase them.
live.canon|psalms|35:6: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of Yahuah (LORD) persecute them.
live.canon|psalms|35:7: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
live.canon|psalms|35:9: And my soul shall be joyful in Yahuah (LORD): it shall rejoice in his salvation.
live.canon|psalms|35:11: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
live.canon|psalms|35:12: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
live.canon|psalms|35:16: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
live.canon|psalms|35:10: All my bones shall say, Yahuah (LORD), who is like unto you, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoils him?
live.canon|psalms|35:13: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into my own bosom.
live.canon|psalms|35:14: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourns for his mother.
live.canon|psalms|35:15: But in my adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
live.canon|psalms|35:18: I will give you thanks in the great congregation: I will praise you among much people.
live.canon|psalms|35:20: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
live.canon|psalms|35:23: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my Elohim (God) and my Lord.
live.canon|psalms|35:25: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
live.canon|psalms|35:19: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
live.canon|psalms|35:21: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye has seen it.
live.canon|psalms|35:17: Adonai (Lord), how long will you look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
live.canon|psalms|35:22: This you have seen, O Yahuah (LORD): keep not silence: O Adonai (Lord), be not far from me.
live.canon|psalms|36:1: The transgression of the wicked says within my heart, that there is no fear of Elohim (God) before his eyes.
live.canon|psalms|36:3: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he has left off to be wise, and to do good.
live.canon|psalms|36:4: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he abhors not evil.
live.canon|psalms|36:5: Your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), is in the heavens; and your faithfulness reaches unto the clouds.
live.canon|psalms|36:6: Your righteousness is like the great mountains; your judgments are a great deep: O Yahuah (LORD), you preservest man and beast.
live.canon|psalms|36:7: How excellent is your lovingkindness, O Elohim (God)! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of your wings.
live.canon|psalms|36:8: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of your house; and you shall make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
live.canon|psalms|36:9: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see light.
live.canon|psalms|36:10: O continue your lovingkindness unto them that know you; and your righteousness to the upright in heart.
live.canon|psalms|36:2: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
live.canon|psalms|36:11: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
live.canon|psalms|36:12: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
live.canon|psalms|37:1: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be you envious against the workers of iniquity.
live.canon|psalms|37:3: Trust in Yahuah (LORD), and do good; so shall you dwell in the land, and verily you shall be fed.
live.canon|psalms|37:4: Delight thyself also in Yahuah (LORD); and he shall give you the desires of your heart.
live.canon|psalms|37:5: Commit your way unto Yahuah (LORD); trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
live.canon|psalms|37:6: And he shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your judgment as the noonday.
live.canon|psalms|37:7: Rest in Yahuah (LORD), and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who brings wicked devices to pass.
live.canon|psalms|37:10: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, you shall diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
live.canon|psalms|37:2: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
live.canon|psalms|37:8: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
live.canon|psalms|37:9: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon Yahuah (LORD), they shall inherit the earth.
live.canon|psalms|37:11: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
live.canon|psalms|37:12: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
live.canon|psalms|37:14: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
live.canon|psalms|37:15: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
live.canon|psalms|37:17: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but Yahuah (LORD) upholdeth the righteous.
live.canon|psalms|37:19: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
live.canon|psalms|37:16: A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked.
live.canon|psalms|37:18: Yahuah (LORD) knows the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
live.canon|psalms|37:21: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.
live.canon|psalms|37:23: The steps of a good man are ordered by Yahuah (LORD): and he delights in his way.
live.canon|psalms|37:20: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of Yahuah (LORD) shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
live.canon|psalms|37:22: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
live.canon|psalms|37:24: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for Yahuah (LORD) upholdeth him with his hand.
live.canon|psalms|37:25: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
live.canon|psalms|37:26: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
live.canon|psalms|37:27: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|37:29: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
live.canon|psalms|37:31: The law of his Elohim (God) is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
live.canon|psalms|37:33: Yahuah (LORD) will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
live.canon|psalms|37:35: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
live.canon|psalms|37:36: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
live.canon|psalms|37:37: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
live.canon|psalms|37:38: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
live.canon|psalms|37:39: But the salvation of the righteous is of Yahuah (LORD): he is their strength in the time of trouble.
live.canon|psalms|37:40: And Yahuah (LORD) shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
live.canon|psalms|37:28: For Yahuah (LORD) loves judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
live.canon|psalms|37:30: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue talks of judgment.
live.canon|psalms|37:32: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeks to slay him.
live.canon|psalms|37:34: Wait on Yahuah (LORD), and keep his way, and he shall exalt you to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
live.canon|psalms|37:13: Adonai (Lord) shall laugh at him: for he sees that his day is coming.
live.canon|psalms|38:1: O Yahuah (LORD), rebuke me not in your wrath: neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
live.canon|psalms|38:2: For your arrows stick fast in me, and your hand presseth me sore.
live.canon|psalms|38:3: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
live.canon|psalms|38:4: For my iniquities are gone over my head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
live.canon|psalms|38:10: My heart panteth, my strength fails me: as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.
live.canon|psalms|38:13: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that opens not his mouth.
live.canon|psalms|38:14: Thus I was as a man that hears not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
live.canon|psalms|38:18: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
live.canon|psalms|38:19: But my enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
live.canon|psalms|38:20: They also that render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
live.canon|psalms|38:5: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
live.canon|psalms|38:6: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
live.canon|psalms|38:7: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
live.canon|psalms|38:8: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
live.canon|psalms|38:11: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
live.canon|psalms|38:12: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
live.canon|psalms|38:16: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
live.canon|psalms|38:17: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
live.canon|psalms|38:21: Forsake me not, O Yahuah (LORD): O my Elohim (God), be not far from me.
live.canon|psalms|38:9: Adonai (Lord), all my desire is before you; and my groaning is not hid from you.
live.canon|psalms|38:15: For in you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I hope: you will hear, O Adonai (Lord) my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|38:22: Make haste to help me, O Adonai (Lord) my salvation.
live.canon|psalms|39:1: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
live.canon|psalms|39:2: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
live.canon|psalms|39:3: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
live.canon|psalms|39:4: Yahuah (LORD), make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
live.canon|psalms|39:5: Behold, you have made my days as an handbreadth; and my age is as nothing before you: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|39:6: Surely every man walks in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.
live.canon|psalms|39:9: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because you did it.
live.canon|psalms|39:8: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
live.canon|psalms|39:13: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
live.canon|psalms|39:10: Remove your stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of your hand.
live.canon|psalms|39:11: When you with rebukes do correct man for iniquity, you make his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|39:12: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah (LORD), and give ear unto my cry; hold not your peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with you, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
live.canon|psalms|39:7: And now, Adonai (Lord), what wait I for? my hope is in you.
live.canon|psalms|40:3: And he has put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our Elohim (God): many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|40:4: Blessed is that man that makes Yahuah (LORD) his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
live.canon|psalms|40:5: Many, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), are your wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto you: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
live.canon|psalms|40:6: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire; my ears have you opened: burnt offering and sin offering have you not required.
live.canon|psalms|40:8: I delight to do your will, O my Elohim (God): yea, your law is within my heart.
live.canon|psalms|40:9: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Yahuah (LORD), you know.
live.canon|psalms|40:10: I have not hid your righteousness within my heart; I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation: I have not concealed your lovingkindness and your truth from the great congregation.
live.canon|psalms|40:11: Withhold not you your tender mercies from me, O Yahuah (LORD): let your lovingkindness and your truth continually preserve me.
live.canon|psalms|40:12: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.
live.canon|psalms|40:16: Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: let such as love your salvation say continually, Yahuah (LORD) be magnified.
live.canon|psalms|40:1: I waited patiently for Yahuah (LORD); and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
live.canon|psalms|40:2: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
live.canon|psalms|40:7: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
live.canon|psalms|40:13: Be pleased, O Yahuah (LORD), to deliver me: O Yahuah (LORD), make haste to help me.
live.canon|psalms|40:14: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
live.canon|psalms|40:15: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
live.canon|psalms|40:17: But I am poor and needy; yet Adonai (Lord) thinketh upon me: you are my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|41:2: Yahuah (LORD) will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and you will not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
live.canon|psalms|41:3: Yahuah (LORD) will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: you will make all his bed in his sickness.
live.canon|psalms|41:4: I said, Yahuah (LORD), be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against you.
live.canon|psalms|41:5: My enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
live.canon|psalms|41:6: And if he come to see me, he speaks vanity: his heart gathers iniquity to itself; when he goes abroad, he telleth it.
live.canon|psalms|41:8: An evil disease, say they, cleaves fast unto him: and now that he lies he shall rise up no more.
live.canon|psalms|41:9: Yea, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
live.canon|psalms|41:10: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
live.canon|psalms|41:11: By this I know that you favourest me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.
live.canon|psalms|41:12: And as for me, you upholdest me in my integrity, and set me before your face for ever.
live.canon|psalms|41:1: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Yahuah (LORD) will deliver him in time of trouble.
live.canon|psalms|41:7: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
live.canon|psalms|41:13: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
live.canon|psalms|42:5: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted in me? hope you in Elohim (God): for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
live.canon|psalms|42:6: O my Elohim (God), my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember you from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
live.canon|psalms|42:7: Deep calls unto deep at the noise of your waterspouts: all your waves and your billows are gone over me.
live.canon|psalms|42:9: I will say unto Elohim (God) my rock, Why have you forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
live.canon|psalms|42:10: As with a sword in my bones, my enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is your Elohim (God)?
live.canon|psalms|42:11: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope you in Elohim (God): for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|42:2: My soul thirsteth for Elohim (God), for the living Elohim (God): when shall I come and appear before Elohim (God)?
live.canon|psalms|42:4: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of Elohim (God), with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
live.canon|psalms|42:1: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after you, O Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|42:8: Yet Yahuah (LORD) will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the Elohim (God) of my life.
live.canon|psalms|42:3: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is your Elohim (God)?
live.canon|psalms|44:1: We have heard with our ears, O Elohim (God), our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the times of old.
live.canon|psalms|44:2: How you did drive out the heathen with your hand, and plantedst them; how you did afflict the people, and cast them out.
live.canon|psalms|44:3: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, because you had a favour unto them.
live.canon|psalms|44:4: You are my King, O Elohim (God): command deliverances for Jacob.
live.canon|psalms|44:5: Through you will we push down our enemies: through your name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
live.canon|psalms|44:7: But you have saved us from our enemies, and have put them to shame that hated us.
live.canon|psalms|44:8: In Elohim (God) we boast all the day long, and praise your name for ever. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|44:9: But you have cast off, and put us to shame; and go not forth with our armies.
live.canon|psalms|44:10: You make us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
live.canon|psalms|44:11: You have given us like sheep appointed for meat; and have scattered us among the heathen.
live.canon|psalms|44:12: You sellest your people for nought, and do not increase your wealth by their price.
live.canon|psalms|44:13: You make us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
live.canon|psalms|44:14: You make us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
live.canon|psalms|44:15: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
live.canon|psalms|44:17: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten you, neither have we dealt falsely in your covenant.
live.canon|psalms|44:18: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from your way;
live.canon|psalms|44:19: Though you have sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
live.canon|psalms|44:21: Shall not Elohim (God) search this out? for he knows the secrets of the heart.
live.canon|psalms|44:22: Yea, for your sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
live.canon|psalms|44:24: Wherefore hide you your face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
live.canon|psalms|44:25: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaves unto the earth.
live.canon|psalms|44:26: Arise for our help, and redeem us for your mercies’ sake.
live.canon|psalms|44:6: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
live.canon|psalms|44:16: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
live.canon|psalms|44:20: If we have forgotten the name of our Elohim (God), or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
live.canon|psalms|44:23: Awake, why sleepest you, O Adonai (Lord)? arise, cast us not off for ever.
live.canon|psalms|45:2: You are fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into your lips: therefore Elohim (God) has blessed you for ever.
live.canon|psalms|45:3: Gird your sword upon your thigh, O most mighty, with your glory and your majesty.
live.canon|psalms|45:4: And in your majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and your right hand shall teach you terrible things.
live.canon|psalms|45:5: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under you.
live.canon|psalms|45:6: Your throne, O Elohim (God), is for ever and ever: the sceptre of your kingdom is a right sceptre.
live.canon|psalms|45:7: You love righteousness, and hate wickedness: therefore Elohim (God), your Elohim (God), has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
live.canon|psalms|45:9: Kings’ daughters were among your honourable women: upon your right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
live.canon|psalms|45:10: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline your ear; forget also your own people, and your father’s house;
live.canon|psalms|45:12: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat your favour.
live.canon|psalms|45:14: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto you.
live.canon|psalms|45:16: Instead of your fathers shall be your children, whom you may make princes in all the earth.
live.canon|psalms|45:17: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise you for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|45:1: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
live.canon|psalms|45:8: All your garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made you glad.
live.canon|psalms|45:13: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
live.canon|psalms|45:15: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.
live.canon|psalms|45:11: So shall the king greatly desire your beauty: for he is your Adonai (Lord); and worship you him.
live.canon|psalms|46:8: Come, behold the works of Yahuah (LORD), what desolations he has made in the earth.
live.canon|psalms|46:9: He makes wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burns the chariot in the fire.
live.canon|psalms|46:1: Elohim (God) is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
live.canon|psalms|46:2: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
live.canon|psalms|46:3: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|46:4: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of Elohim (God), the holy place of the tabernacles of the El Elyon (most High).
live.canon|psalms|46:5: Elohim (God) is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: Elohim (God) shall help her, and that right early.
live.canon|psalms|46:6: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
live.canon|psalms|46:7: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is with us; the Elohim (God) of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|46:10: Be still, and know that I am Elohim (God): I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
live.canon|psalms|46:11: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is with us; the Elohim (God) of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|47:1: O clap your hands, all you people; shout unto Elohim (God) with the voice of triumph.
live.canon|psalms|47:7: For Elohim (God) is the King of all the earth: sing you praises with understanding.
live.canon|psalms|47:8: Elohim (God) reigns over the heathen: Elohim (God) sits upon the throne of his holiness.
live.canon|psalms|47:2: For Yahuah (LORD) most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
live.canon|psalms|47:3: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
live.canon|psalms|47:4: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|47:5: Elohim (God) is gone up with a shout, Yahuah (LORD) with the sound of a trumpet.
live.canon|psalms|47:6: Sing praises to Elohim (God), sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
live.canon|psalms|47:9: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the Elohim (God) of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto Elohim (God): he is greatly exalted.
live.canon|psalms|48:7: You breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
live.canon|psalms|48:9: We have thought of your lovingkindness, O Elohim (God), in the midst of your temple.
live.canon|psalms|48:10: According to your name, O Elohim (God), so is your praise unto the ends of the earth: your right hand is full of righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|48:11: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Yahudah (Judah) be glad, because of your judgments.
live.canon|psalms|48:13: Mark you well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that you may tell it to the generation following.
live.canon|psalms|48:1: Great is Yahuah (LORD), and greatly to be praised in the city of our Elohim (God), in the mountain of his holiness.
live.canon|psalms|48:2: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
live.canon|psalms|48:3: Elohim (God) is known in her palaces for a refuge.
live.canon|psalms|48:4: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
live.canon|psalms|48:5: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
live.canon|psalms|48:6: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
live.canon|psalms|48:8: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), in the city of our Elohim (God): Elohim (God) will establish it for ever. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|48:12: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
live.canon|psalms|48:14: For this Elohim (God) is our Elohim (God) for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
live.canon|psalms|49:1: Hear this, all you people; give ear, all you inhabitants of the world:
live.canon|psalms|49:4: I will incline my ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
live.canon|psalms|49:8: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceases for ever:)
live.canon|psalms|49:10: For he sees that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
live.canon|psalms|49:16: Be not you afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
live.canon|psalms|49:17: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
live.canon|psalms|49:18: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise you, when you do well to thyself.
live.canon|psalms|49:20: Man that is in honour, and understands not, is like the beasts that perish.
live.canon|psalms|49:2: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
live.canon|psalms|49:3: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
live.canon|psalms|49:5: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
live.canon|psalms|49:6: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
live.canon|psalms|49:7: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim (God) a ransom for him:
live.canon|psalms|49:9: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
live.canon|psalms|49:11: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
live.canon|psalms|49:13: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|49:14: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
live.canon|psalms|49:15: But Elohim (God) will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|49:19: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
live.canon|psalms|49:12: Nevertheless man being in honour abides not: he is like the beasts that perish.
live.canon|psalms|50:1: El Gibbor (The mighty God), even Yahuah (LORD), has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
live.canon|psalms|50:2: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, Elohim (God) has shined.
live.canon|psalms|50:7: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Yashar'el (Israel), and I will testify against you: I am Elohim (God), even your Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|50:8: I will not reprove you for your sacrifices or your burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
live.canon|psalms|50:9: I will take no bullock out of your house, nor he goats out of your folds.
live.canon|psalms|50:12: If I were hungry, I would not tell you: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
live.canon|psalms|50:14: Offer unto Elohim (God) thanksgiving; and pay your vows unto the El Elyon (most High):
live.canon|psalms|50:15: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.
live.canon|psalms|50:16: But unto the wicked Elohim (God) says, What have you to do to declare my statutes, or that you should take my covenant in your mouth?
live.canon|psalms|50:17: Seeing you hate instruction, and cast my words behind you.
live.canon|psalms|50:18: When you saw a thief, then you consentedst with him, and have been partaker with adulterers.
live.canon|psalms|50:19: You give your mouth to evil, and your tongue frameth deceit.
live.canon|psalms|50:20: You sit and speak against your brother; you slanderest your own mother’s son.
live.canon|psalms|50:21: These things have you done, and I kept silence; you thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove you, and set them in order before your eyes.
live.canon|psalms|50:22: Now consider this, you that forget Elohim (God), lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
live.canon|psalms|50:23: Whoso offers praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|50:3: Our Elohim (God) shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
live.canon|psalms|50:4: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
live.canon|psalms|50:5: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
live.canon|psalms|50:6: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for Elohim (God) is judge himself. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|50:10: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
live.canon|psalms|50:11: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
live.canon|psalms|50:13: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
live.canon|psalms|51:1: Have mercy upon me, O Elohim (God), according to your lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of your tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
live.canon|psalms|51:2: Wash me throughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
live.canon|psalms|51:4: Against you, you only, have I sinned, and done this evil in your sight: that you might be justified when you speak, and be clear when you judge.
live.canon|psalms|51:6: Behold, you desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part you shall make me to know wisdom.
live.canon|psalms|51:8: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
live.canon|psalms|51:9: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
live.canon|psalms|51:11: Cast me not away from your presence; and take not your holy spirit from me.
live.canon|psalms|51:12: Restore unto me the joy of your salvation; and uphold me with your free spirit.
live.canon|psalms|51:13: Then will I teach transgressors your ways; and sinners shall be converted unto you.
live.canon|psalms|51:14: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O Elohim (God), you Elohim (God) of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|51:16: For you desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: you delightest not in burnt offering.
live.canon|psalms|51:17: The sacrifices of Elohim (God) are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O Elohim (God), you will not despise.
live.canon|psalms|51:18: Do good in your good pleasure unto Zion: build you the walls of Jerusalem.
live.canon|psalms|51:19: Then shall you be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon your altar.
live.canon|psalms|51:3: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
live.canon|psalms|51:5: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
live.canon|psalms|51:7: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
live.canon|psalms|51:10: Create in me a clean heart, O Elohim (God); and renew a right spirit within me.
live.canon|psalms|51:15: O Adonai (Lord), open you my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth your praise.
live.canon|psalms|52:1: Why boastest you thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of Elohim (God) endures continually.
live.canon|psalms|52:2: Your tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
live.canon|psalms|52:3: You love evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|52:4: You love all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.
live.canon|psalms|52:5: Elohim (God) shall likewise destroy you for ever, he shall take you away, and pluck you out of your dwelling place, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|52:9: I will praise you for ever, because you have done it: and I will wait on your name; for it is good before your saints.
live.canon|psalms|52:6: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
live.canon|psalms|52:7: Lo, this is the man that made not Elohim (God) his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
live.canon|psalms|52:8: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of Elohim (God): I trust in the mercy of Elohim (God) for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|53:1: The fool has said in his heart, There is no Elohim (God). Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that does good.
live.canon|psalms|53:3: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that does good, no, not one.
live.canon|psalms|53:5: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for Elohim (God) has scattered the bones of him that encampeth against you: you have put them to shame, because Elohim (God) has despised them.
live.canon|psalms|53:6: Oh that the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of Zion! When Elohim (God) brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be glad.
live.canon|psalms|53:2: Elohim (God) looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|53:4: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|54:5: He shall reward evil unto my enemies: cut them off in your truth.
live.canon|psalms|54:6: I will freely sacrifice unto you: I will praise your name, O Yahuah (LORD); for it is good.
live.canon|psalms|54:7: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has seen his desire upon my enemies.
live.canon|psalms|54:2: Hear my prayer, O Elohim (God); give ear to the words of my mouth.
live.canon|psalms|54:3: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set Elohim (God) before them. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|54:1: Save me, O Elohim (God), by your name, and judge me by your strength.
live.canon|psalms|54:4: Behold, Elohim (God) is my helper: Adonai (Lord) is with them that uphold my soul.
live.canon|psalms|55:5: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
live.canon|psalms|55:13: But it was you, a man my equal, my guide, and my acquaintance.
live.canon|psalms|55:18: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
live.canon|psalms|55:19: Elohim (God) shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abides of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|55:20: He has put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he has broken his covenant.
live.canon|psalms|55:22: Cast your burden upon Yahuah (LORD), and he shall sustain you: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
live.canon|psalms|55:23: But you, O Elohim (God), shall bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in you.
live.canon|psalms|55:1: Give ear to my prayer, O Elohim (God); and hide not thyself from my supplication.
live.canon|psalms|55:2: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
live.canon|psalms|55:3: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
live.canon|psalms|55:4: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
live.canon|psalms|55:6: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
live.canon|psalms|55:7: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|55:8: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
live.canon|psalms|55:10: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
live.canon|psalms|55:11: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
live.canon|psalms|55:12: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
live.canon|psalms|55:14: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of Elohim (God) in company.
live.canon|psalms|55:15: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
live.canon|psalms|55:16: As for me, I will call upon Elohim (God); and Yahuah (LORD) shall save me.
live.canon|psalms|55:17: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
