live.canon|psalms|102:24: I said, O my Elohim (God), take me not away in the midst of my days: your years are throughout all generations.
live.canon|psalms|102:25: Of old have you laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of your hands.
live.canon|psalms|102:26: They shall perish, but you shall endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shall you change them, and they shall be changed:
live.canon|psalms|102:27: But you are the same, and your years shall have no end.
live.canon|psalms|102:28: The children of your servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before you.
live.canon|psalms|102:3: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
live.canon|psalms|102:4: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
live.canon|psalms|102:5: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
live.canon|psalms|102:6: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
live.canon|psalms|102:7: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
live.canon|psalms|102:9: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
live.canon|psalms|102:8: My enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
live.canon|psalms|102:10: Because of your indignation and your wrath: for you have lifted me up, and cast me down.
live.canon|psalms|102:12: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), shall endure for ever; and your remembrance unto all generations.
live.canon|psalms|102:11: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
live.canon|psalms|102:16: When Yahuah (LORD) shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
live.canon|psalms|102:17: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
live.canon|psalms|102:18: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|102:20: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
live.canon|psalms|102:21: To declare the name of Yahuah (LORD) in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
live.canon|psalms|102:22: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|102:23: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
live.canon|psalms|102:13: You shall arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
live.canon|psalms|102:14: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
live.canon|psalms|102:15: So the heathen shall fear the name of Yahuah (LORD), and all the kings of the earth your glory.
live.canon|psalms|102:19: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did Yahuah (LORD) behold the earth;
live.canon|psalms|103:3: Who forgiveth all your iniquities; who healeth all your diseases;
live.canon|psalms|103:4: Who redeemeth your life from destruction; who crowneth you with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
live.canon|psalms|103:5: Who satisfies your mouth with good things; so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
live.canon|psalms|103:10: He has not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
live.canon|psalms|103:12: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
live.canon|psalms|103:14: For he knows our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
live.canon|psalms|103:16: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
live.canon|psalms|103:19: Yahuah (LORD) has prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom rules over all.
live.canon|psalms|103:20: Bless Yahuah (LORD), you his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
live.canon|psalms|103:21: Bless you Yahuah (LORD), all you his hosts; you ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
live.canon|psalms|103:1: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
live.canon|psalms|103:2: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
live.canon|psalms|103:6: Yahuah (LORD) executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
live.canon|psalms|103:7: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|103:8: Yahuah (LORD) is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
live.canon|psalms|103:9: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
live.canon|psalms|103:11: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
live.canon|psalms|103:13: Like as a father pitieth his children, so Yahuah (LORD) pitieth them that fear him.
live.canon|psalms|103:15: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
live.canon|psalms|103:17: But the mercy of Yahuah (LORD) is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;
live.canon|psalms|103:18: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
live.canon|psalms|103:22: Bless Yahuah (LORD), all his works in all places of his dominion: bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul.
live.canon|psalms|108:3: I will praise you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the people: and I will sing praises unto you among the nations.
live.canon|psalms|108:4: For your mercy is great above the heavens: and your truth reaches unto the clouds.
live.canon|psalms|108:5: Be you exalted, O Elohim (God), above the heavens: and your glory above all the earth;
live.canon|psalms|108:6: That your beloved may be delivered: save with your right hand, and answer me.
live.canon|psalms|108:7: Elohim (God) has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
live.canon|psalms|108:8: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Yahudah (Judah) is my lawgiver;
live.canon|psalms|108:11: Will not you, O Elohim (God), who have cast us off? and will not you, O Elohim (God), go forth with our hosts?
live.canon|psalms|108:1: O Elohim (God), my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
live.canon|psalms|108:2: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
live.canon|psalms|108:9: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
live.canon|psalms|108:10: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
live.canon|psalms|108:12: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
live.canon|psalms|108:13: Through Elohim (God) we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
live.canon|psalms|109:1: Hold not your peace, O Elohim (God) of my praise;
live.canon|psalms|109:6: Set you a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
live.canon|psalms|109:11: Let the extortioner catch all that he has; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
live.canon|psalms|109:19: Let it be unto him as the garment which covers him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
live.canon|psalms|109:20: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from Yahuah (LORD), and of them that speak evil against my soul.
live.canon|psalms|109:24: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh fails of fatness.
live.canon|psalms|109:26: Help me, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God): O save me according to your mercy:
live.canon|psalms|109:27: That they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahuah (LORD), have done it.
live.canon|psalms|109:28: Let them curse, but bless you: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let your servant rejoice.
live.canon|psalms|109:29: Let my adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
live.canon|psalms|109:2: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
live.canon|psalms|109:3: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
live.canon|psalms|109:4: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
live.canon|psalms|109:5: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
live.canon|psalms|109:7: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
live.canon|psalms|109:8: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
live.canon|psalms|109:9: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
live.canon|psalms|109:10: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
live.canon|psalms|109:12: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
live.canon|psalms|109:13: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
live.canon|psalms|109:14: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Yahuah (LORD); and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
live.canon|psalms|109:15: Let them be before Yahuah (LORD) continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
live.canon|psalms|109:16: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
live.canon|psalms|109:17: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
live.canon|psalms|109:18: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
live.canon|psalms|109:22: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
live.canon|psalms|109:23: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
live.canon|psalms|109:25: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
live.canon|psalms|109:30: I will greatly praise Yahuah (LORD) with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
live.canon|psalms|109:31: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
live.canon|psalms|109:21: But do you for me, O GOD Adonai (Lord), for your name’s sake: because your mercy is good, deliver you me.
live.canon|psalms|110:1: Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit you at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool.
live.canon|psalms|110:2: Yahuah (LORD) shall send the rod of your strength out of Zion: rule you in the midst of your enemies.
live.canon|psalms|110:3: Your people shall be willing in the day of your power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: you have the dew of your youth.
live.canon|psalms|110:4: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).
live.canon|psalms|110:5: Adonai (Lord) at your right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
live.canon|psalms|110:6: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
live.canon|psalms|110:7: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
live.canon|psalms|119:8: I will keep your statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
live.canon|psalms|119:16: I will delight myself in your statutes: I will not forget your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:24: Your testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
live.canon|psalms|119:40: Behold, I have longed after your precepts: quicken me in your righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|119:48: My hands also will I lift up unto your commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:56: This I had, because I kept your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:64: The earth, O Yahuah (LORD), is full of your mercy: teach me your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:72: The law of your mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
live.canon|psalms|119:80: Let my heart be sound in your statutes; that I be not ashamed.
live.canon|psalms|119:96: I have seen an end of all perfection: but your commandment is exceeding broad.
live.canon|psalms|119:104: Through your precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
live.canon|psalms|119:112: I have inclined my heart to perform your statutes alway, even unto the end.
live.canon|psalms|119:128: Therefore I esteem all your precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
live.canon|psalms|119:136: Rivers of waters run down my eyes, because they keep not your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:144: The righteousness of your testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
live.canon|psalms|119:160: Your word is true from the beginning: and every one of your righteous judgments endures for ever.
live.canon|psalms|119:168: I have kept your precepts and your testimonies: for all my ways are before you.
live.canon|psalms|119:32: I will run the way of your commandments, when you shall enlarge my heart.
live.canon|psalms|119:88: Quicken me after your lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of your mouth.
live.canon|psalms|119:152: Concerning your testimonies, I have known of old that you have founded them for ever.
live.canon|psalms|119:4: You have commanded us to keep your precepts diligently.
live.canon|psalms|119:5: O that my ways were directed to keep your statutes!
live.canon|psalms|119:6: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:7: I will praise you with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned your righteous judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:9: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:10: With my whole heart have I sought you: O let me not wander from your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:11: Your word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
live.canon|psalms|119:12: Blessed are you, O Yahuah (LORD): teach me your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:13: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of your mouth.
live.canon|psalms|119:14: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
live.canon|psalms|119:15: I will meditate in your precepts, and have respect unto your ways.
live.canon|psalms|119:17: Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live, and keep your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:18: Open you my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:19: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not your commandments from me.
live.canon|psalms|119:20: My soul breaks for the longing that it has unto your judgments at all times.
live.canon|psalms|119:21: You have rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:22: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:23: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but your servant did meditate in your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:25: My soul cleaves unto the dust: quicken you me according to your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:26: I have declared my ways, and you heard me: teach me your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:27: Make me to understand the way of your precepts: so shall I talk of your wondrous works.
live.canon|psalms|119:28: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen you me according unto your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:29: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me your law graciously.
live.canon|psalms|119:38: Stablish your word unto your servant, who is devoted to your fear.
live.canon|psalms|119:39: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for your judgments are good.
live.canon|psalms|119:41: Let your mercies come also unto me, O Yahuah (LORD), even your salvation, according to your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:42: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:43: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in your judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:44: So shall I keep your law continually for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|119:45: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:46: I will speak of your testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
live.canon|psalms|119:47: And I will delight myself in your commandments, which I have loved.
live.canon|psalms|119:49: Remember the word unto your servant, upon which you have caused me to hope.
live.canon|psalms|119:50: This is my comfort in my affliction: for your word has quickened me.
live.canon|psalms|119:51: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:52: I remembered your judgments of old, O Yahuah (LORD); and have comforted myself.
live.canon|psalms|119:53: Horror has taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:54: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
live.canon|psalms|119:55: I have remembered your name, O Yahuah (LORD), in the night, and have kept your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:57: You are my portion, O Yahuah (LORD): I have said that I would keep your words.
live.canon|psalms|119:58: I intreated your favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:59: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:60: I made haste, and delayed not to keep your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:61: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:62: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto you because of your righteous judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:63: I am a companion of all them that fear you, and of them that keep your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:65: You have dealt well with your servant, O Yahuah (LORD), according unto your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:67: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:68: You are good, and do good; teach me your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:69: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep your precepts with my whole heart.
live.canon|psalms|119:70: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:73: Your hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:74: They that fear you will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:75: I know, O Yahuah (LORD), that your judgments are right, and that you in faithfulness have afflicted me.
live.canon|psalms|119:76: Let, I pray you, your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to your word unto your servant.
live.canon|psalms|119:77: Let your tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for your law is my delight.
live.canon|psalms|119:78: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:79: Let those that fear you turn unto me, and those that have known your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:81: My soul fainteth for your salvation: but I hope in your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:82: My eyes fail for your word, saying, When will you comfort me?
live.canon|psalms|119:83: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:84: How many are the days of your servant? when will you execute judgment on them that persecute me?
live.canon|psalms|119:85: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:86: All your commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help you me.
live.canon|psalms|119:93: I will never forget your precepts: for with them you have quickened me.
live.canon|psalms|119:94: I am yours, save me; for I have sought your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:95: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:97: O how love I your law! it is my meditation all the day.
live.canon|psalms|119:98: You through your commandments have made me wiser than my enemies: for they are ever with me.
live.canon|psalms|119:99: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for your testimonies are my meditation.
live.canon|psalms|119:100: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:101: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:102: I have not departed from your judgments: for you have taught me.
live.canon|psalms|119:103: How sweet are your words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
live.canon|psalms|119:105: Your word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
live.canon|psalms|119:106: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep your righteous judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:107: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Yahuah (LORD), according unto your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:108: Accept, I beseech you, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Yahuah (LORD), and teach me your judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:109: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:110: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:111: Your testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
live.canon|psalms|119:113: I hate vain thoughts: but your law do I love.
live.canon|psalms|119:114: You are my hiding place and my shield: I hope in your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:115: Depart from me, you evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my Elohim (God).
live.canon|psalms|119:116: Uphold me according unto your word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
live.canon|psalms|119:117: Hold you me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto your statutes continually.
live.canon|psalms|119:118: You have trodden down all them that err from your statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
live.canon|psalms|119:119: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:121: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to my oppressors.
live.canon|psalms|119:122: Be surety for your servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
live.canon|psalms|119:123: My eyes fail for your salvation, and for the word of your righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|119:124: Deal with your servant according unto your mercy, and teach me your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:125: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:126: It is time for you, Yahuah (LORD), to work: for they have made void your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:127: Therefore I love your commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
live.canon|psalms|119:129: Your testimonies are wonderful: therefore does my soul keep them.
live.canon|psalms|119:130: The entrance of your words gives light; it gives understanding unto the simple.
live.canon|psalms|119:131: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:132: Look you upon me, and be merciful unto me, as you usest to do unto those that love your name.
live.canon|psalms|119:133: Order my steps in your word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
live.canon|psalms|119:134: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:135: Make your face to shine upon your servant; and teach me your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:137: Righteous are you, O Yahuah (LORD), and upright are your judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:138: Your testimonies that you have commanded are righteous and very faithful.
live.canon|psalms|119:139: My zeal has consumed me, because my enemies have forgotten your words.
live.canon|psalms|119:140: Your word is very pure: therefore your servant loves it.
live.canon|psalms|119:141: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:142: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is the truth.
live.canon|psalms|119:143: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet your commandments are my delights.
live.canon|psalms|119:145: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Yahuah (LORD): I will keep your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:159: Consider how I love your precepts: quicken me, O Yahuah (LORD), according to your lovingkindness.
live.canon|psalms|119:161: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart stands in awe of your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:162: I rejoice at your word, as one that finds great spoil.
live.canon|psalms|119:164: Seven times a day do I praise you because of your righteous judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:165: Great peace have they which love your law: and nothing shall offend them.
live.canon|psalms|119:166: Yahuah (LORD), I have hoped for your salvation, and done your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:120: My flesh trembles for fear of you; and I am afraid of your judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:167: My soul has kept your testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
live.canon|psalms|119:169: Let my cry come near before you, O Yahuah (LORD): give me understanding according to your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:170: Let my supplication come before you: deliver me according to your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:171: My lips shall utter praise, when you have taught me your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:172: My tongue shall speak of your word: for all your commandments are righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|119:173: Let your hand help me; for I have chosen your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:174: I have longed for your salvation, O Yahuah (LORD); and your law is my delight.
live.canon|psalms|119:175: Let my soul live, and it shall praise you; and let your judgments help me.
live.canon|psalms|119:176: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant; for I do not forget your commandments.
live.canon|psalms|119:1: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|119:2: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
live.canon|psalms|119:3: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
live.canon|psalms|119:30: I have chosen the way of truth: your judgments have I laid before me.
live.canon|psalms|119:31: I have stuck unto your testimonies: O Yahuah (LORD), put me not to shame.
live.canon|psalms|119:33: Teach me, O Yahuah (LORD), the way of your statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
live.canon|psalms|119:34: Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
live.canon|psalms|119:35: Make me to go in the path of your commandments; for therein do I delight.
live.canon|psalms|119:36: Incline my heart unto your testimonies, and not to covetousness.
live.canon|psalms|119:37: Turn away my eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken you me in your way.
live.canon|psalms|119:87: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not your precepts.
live.canon|psalms|119:89: For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), your word is settled in heaven.
live.canon|psalms|119:90: Your faithfulness is unto all generations: you have established the earth, and it abides.
live.canon|psalms|119:91: They continue this day according to your ordinances: for all are your servants.
live.canon|psalms|119:92: Unless your law had been my delights, I should then have perished in my affliction.
live.canon|psalms|119:163: I hate and abhor lying: but your law do I love.
live.canon|psalms|119:146: I cried unto you; save me, and I shall keep your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:147: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:148: My eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:149: Hear my voice according unto your lovingkindness: O Yahuah (LORD), quicken me according to your judgment.
live.canon|psalms|119:150: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:151: You are near, O Yahuah (LORD); and all your commandments are truth.
live.canon|psalms|119:153: Consider my affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget your law.
live.canon|psalms|119:154: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to your word.
live.canon|psalms|119:155: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not your statutes.
live.canon|psalms|119:156: Great are your tender mercies, O Yahuah (LORD): quicken me according to your judgments.
live.canon|psalms|119:157: Many are my persecutors and my enemies; yet do I not decline from your testimonies.
live.canon|psalms|119:158: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not your word.
live.canon|psalms|120:3: What shall be given unto you? or what shall be done unto you, you false tongue?
live.canon|psalms|120:6: My soul has long dwelt with him that hates peace.
live.canon|psalms|120:1: In my distress I cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and he heard me.
live.canon|psalms|120:2: Deliver my soul, O Yahuah (LORD), from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
live.canon|psalms|120:4: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
live.canon|psalms|120:5: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
live.canon|psalms|120:7: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
live.canon|psalms|121:1: I will lift up my eyes unto the hills, from whence comes my help.
live.canon|psalms|121:2: My help comes from Yahuah (LORD), which made heaven and earth.
live.canon|psalms|121:3: He will not suffer your foot to be moved: he that keeps you will not slumber.
live.canon|psalms|121:4: Behold, he that keeps Yashar'el (Israel) shall neither slumber nor sleep.
live.canon|psalms|121:5: Yahuah (LORD) is your keeper: Yahuah (LORD) is your shade upon your right hand.
live.canon|psalms|121:6: The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.
live.canon|psalms|121:7: Yahuah (LORD) shall preserve you from all evil: he shall preserve your soul.
live.canon|psalms|121:8: Yahuah (LORD) shall preserve your going out and your coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|122:2: Our feet shall stand within your gates, O Jerusalem.
live.canon|psalms|122:6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love you.
live.canon|psalms|122:7: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
live.canon|psalms|122:9: Because of the house of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) I will seek your good.
live.canon|psalms|122:1: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|122:3: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
live.canon|psalms|122:4: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of Yahuah (LORD), unto the testimony of Yashar'el (Israel), to give thanks unto the name of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|122:5: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
live.canon|psalms|122:8: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within you.
live.canon|psalms|123:2: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), until that he have mercy upon us.
live.canon|psalms|123:3: Have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (LORD), have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
live.canon|psalms|123:4: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
live.canon|psalms|123:1: Unto you lift I up my eyes, O you that dwell in the heavens.
live.canon|psalms|124:6: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
live.canon|psalms|124:1: If it had not been Yahuah (LORD) who was on our side, now may Yashar'el (Israel) say;
live.canon|psalms|124:2: If it had not been Yahuah (LORD) who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
live.canon|psalms|124:3: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
live.canon|psalms|124:4: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
live.canon|psalms|124:5: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
live.canon|psalms|124:7: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
live.canon|psalms|124:8: Our help is in the name of Yahuah (LORD), who made heaven and earth.
live.canon|psalms|125:1: They that trust in Yahuah (LORD) shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abides for ever.
live.canon|psalms|125:2: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so Yahuah (LORD) is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
live.canon|psalms|125:3: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
live.canon|psalms|125:4: Do good, O Yahuah (LORD), unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
live.canon|psalms|125:5: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Yahuah (LORD) shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|126:2: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, Yahuah (LORD) has done great things for them.
live.canon|psalms|126:3: Yahuah (LORD) has done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
live.canon|psalms|126:6: He that goes forth and weeps, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
live.canon|psalms|126:1: When Yahuah (LORD) turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
live.canon|psalms|126:4: Turn again our captivity, O Yahuah (LORD), as the streams in the south.
live.canon|psalms|126:5: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
live.canon|psalms|127:2: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he gives his beloved sleep.
live.canon|psalms|127:5: Happy is the man that has his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
live.canon|psalms|127:1: Except Yahuah (LORD) build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except Yahuah (LORD) keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
live.canon|psalms|127:3: Lo, children are an heritage of Yahuah (LORD): and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
live.canon|psalms|127:4: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
live.canon|psalms|128:1: Blessed is every one that fears Yahuah (LORD); that walks in his ways.
live.canon|psalms|128:2: For you shall eat the labour of your hands: happy shall you be, and it shall be well with you.
live.canon|psalms|128:3: Your wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of your house: your children like olive plants round about your table.
live.canon|psalms|128:4: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that fears Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|128:5: Yahuah (LORD) shall bless you out of Zion: and you shall see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
live.canon|psalms|128:6: Yea, you shall see your children’s children, and peace upon Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|psalms|129:4: Yahuah (LORD) is righteous: he has cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
live.canon|psalms|129:6: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it grows up:
live.canon|psalms|129:7: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that binds sheaves his bosom.
live.canon|psalms|129:1: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Yashar'el (Israel) now say:
live.canon|psalms|129:2: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
live.canon|psalms|129:3: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
live.canon|psalms|129:5: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
live.canon|psalms|129:8: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of Yahuah (LORD) be upon you: we bless you in the name of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|130:1: Out of the depths have I cried unto you, O Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|130:4: But there is forgiveness with you, that you may be feared.
live.canon|psalms|130:5: I wait for Yahuah (LORD), my soul does wait, and in his word do I hope.
live.canon|psalms|130:7: Let Yashar'el (Israel) hope in Yahuah (LORD): for with Yahuah (LORD) there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
live.canon|psalms|130:8: And he shall redeem Yashar'el (Israel) from all his iniquities.
live.canon|psalms|130:2: Adonai (Lord), hear my voice: let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
live.canon|psalms|130:3: If you, Yahuah (LORD), should mark iniquities, O Adonai (Lord), who shall stand?
live.canon|psalms|130:6: My soul waits for Adonai (Lord) more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
live.canon|psalms|131:1: Yahuah (LORD), my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
live.canon|psalms|131:2: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
live.canon|psalms|131:3: Let Yashar'el (Israel) hope in Yahuah (LORD) from henceforth and for ever.
live.canon|psalms|132:4: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
live.canon|psalms|132:8: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD), into your rest; you, and the ark of your strength.
live.canon|psalms|132:9: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; and let your saints shout for joy.
live.canon|psalms|132:10: For your servant David’s sake turn not away the face of your anointed.
live.canon|psalms|132:11: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of your body will I set upon your throne.
live.canon|psalms|132:12: If your children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon your throne for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|132:13: For Yahuah (LORD) has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his habitation.
live.canon|psalms|132:17: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
live.canon|psalms|132:1: Yahuah (LORD), remember David, and all his afflictions:
live.canon|psalms|132:2: How he sware unto Yahuah (LORD), and vowed unto El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob;
live.canon|psalms|132:3: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
live.canon|psalms|132:5: Until I find out a place for Yahuah (LORD), an habitation for El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob.
live.canon|psalms|132:6: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
live.canon|psalms|132:7: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
live.canon|psalms|132:14: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
live.canon|psalms|132:15: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
live.canon|psalms|132:16: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
live.canon|psalms|132:18: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
live.canon|psalms|133:1: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
live.canon|psalms|133:2: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
live.canon|psalms|133:3: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there Yahuah (LORD) commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
live.canon|psalms|134:1: Behold, bless you Yahuah (LORD), all you servants of Yahuah (LORD), which by night stand in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|134:3: Yahuah (LORD) that made heaven and earth bless you out of Zion.
live.canon|psalms|134:2: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|138:1: I will praise you with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto you.
live.canon|psalms|138:2: I will worship toward your holy temple, and praise your name for your lovingkindness and for your truth: for you have magnified your word above all your name.
live.canon|psalms|138:3: In the day when I cried you answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
live.canon|psalms|138:4: All the kings of the earth shall praise you, O Yahuah (LORD), when they hear the words of your mouth.
live.canon|psalms|138:6: Though Yahuah (LORD) be high, yet has he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knows afar off.
live.canon|psalms|138:7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me: you shall stretch forth your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and your right hand shall save me.
live.canon|psalms|138:8: Yahuah (LORD) will perfect that which concerneth me: your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), endures for ever: forsake not the works of your own hands.
live.canon|psalms|138:5: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of Yahuah (LORD): for great is the glory of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|139:1: O Yahuah (LORD), you have searched me, and known me.
live.canon|psalms|139:2: You know my downsitting and my uprising, you understand my thought afar off.
live.canon|psalms|139:3: You compassest my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
live.canon|psalms|139:4: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Yahuah (LORD), you know it altogether.
live.canon|psalms|139:5: You have beset me behind and before, and laid your hand upon me.
live.canon|psalms|139:7: Whither shall I go from your spirit? or whither shall I flee from your presence?
live.canon|psalms|139:8: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, you are there.
live.canon|psalms|139:10: Even there shall your hand lead me, and your right hand shall hold me.
live.canon|psalms|139:12: Yea, the darkness hides not from you; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to you.
live.canon|psalms|139:13: For you have possessed my reins: you have covered me in my mother’s womb.
live.canon|psalms|139:14: I will praise you; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are your works; and that my soul knows right well.
live.canon|psalms|139:15: My substance was not hid from you, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
live.canon|psalms|139:16: Your eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in your book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
live.canon|psalms|139:17: How precious also are your thoughts unto me, O Elohim (God)! how great is the sum of them!
live.canon|psalms|139:18: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with you.
live.canon|psalms|139:19: Surely you will slay the wicked, O Elohim (God): depart from me therefore, you bloody men.
live.canon|psalms|139:20: For they speak against you wickedly, and your enemies take your name in vain.
live.canon|psalms|139:21: Do not I hate them, O Yahuah (LORD), that hate you? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against you?
live.canon|psalms|139:6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
live.canon|psalms|139:9: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
live.canon|psalms|139:11: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
live.canon|psalms|139:23: Search me, O Elohim (God), and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
live.canon|psalms|139:24: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
live.canon|psalms|139:22: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them my enemies.
live.canon|psalms|140:13: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto your name: the upright shall dwell in your presence.
live.canon|psalms|140:1: Deliver me, O Yahuah (LORD), from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
live.canon|psalms|140:2: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
live.canon|psalms|140:3: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|140:4: Keep me, O Yahuah (LORD), from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
live.canon|psalms|140:5: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|140:8: Grant not, O Yahuah (LORD), the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|140:9: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
live.canon|psalms|140:10: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
live.canon|psalms|140:11: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
live.canon|psalms|140:12: I know that Yahuah (LORD) will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
live.canon|psalms|140:6: I said unto Yahuah (LORD), You are my Elohim (God): hear the voice of my supplications, O Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|140:7: O GOD Adonai (Lord), the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
live.canon|psalms|141:1: Yahuah (LORD), I cry unto you: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto you.
live.canon|psalms|141:2: Let my prayer be set forth before you as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
live.canon|psalms|141:7: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaves wood upon the earth.
live.canon|psalms|141:3: Set a watch, O Yahuah (LORD), before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
live.canon|psalms|141:4: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
live.canon|psalms|141:5: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
live.canon|psalms|141:6: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
live.canon|psalms|141:9: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
live.canon|psalms|141:10: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
live.canon|psalms|141:8: But my eyes are unto you, O GOD Adonai (Lord): in you is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
live.canon|psalms|142:3: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then you knew my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
live.canon|psalms|142:5: I cried unto you, O Yahuah (LORD): I said, You are my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
live.canon|psalms|142:7: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise your name: the righteous shall compass me about; for you shall deal bountifully with me.
live.canon|psalms|142:1: I cried unto Yahuah (LORD) with my voice; with my voice unto Yahuah (LORD) did I make my supplication.
live.canon|psalms|142:2: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
live.canon|psalms|142:4: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
live.canon|psalms|142:6: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
live.canon|psalms|143:1: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah (LORD), give ear to my supplications: in your faithfulness answer me, and in your righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|143:2: And enter not into judgment with your servant: for in your sight shall no man living be justified.
live.canon|psalms|143:3: For the enemy has persecuted my soul; he has smitten my life down to the ground; he has made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
live.canon|psalms|143:5: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all your works; I muse on the work of your hands.
live.canon|psalms|143:6: I stretch forth my hands unto you: my soul thirsteth after you, as a thirsty land. Selah.
live.canon|psalms|143:7: Hear me speedily, O Yahuah (LORD): my spirit fails: hide not your face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
live.canon|psalms|143:8: Cause me to hear your lovingkindness in the morning; for in you do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto you.
live.canon|psalms|143:9: Deliver me, O Yahuah (LORD), from my enemies: I flee unto you to hide me.
live.canon|psalms|143:10: Teach me to do your will; for you are my Elohim (God): your spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
live.canon|psalms|143:11: Quicken me, O Yahuah (LORD), for your name’s sake: for your righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
live.canon|psalms|143:12: And of your mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am your servant.
live.canon|psalms|143:4: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
live.canon|psalms|144:1: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) my strength, which teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
live.canon|psalms|144:3: Yahuah (LORD), what is man, that you take knowledge of him! or the son of Adam, that you make account of him!
live.canon|psalms|144:4: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passes away.
live.canon|psalms|144:5: Bow your heavens, O Yahuah (LORD), and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
live.canon|psalms|144:6: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out your arrows, and destroy them.
live.canon|psalms|144:7: Send your hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
live.canon|psalms|144:2: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
live.canon|psalms|144:12: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
live.canon|psalms|144:13: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
live.canon|psalms|144:8: Whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
live.canon|psalms|144:9: I will sing a new song unto you, O Elohim (God): upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto you.
live.canon|psalms|144:10: It is he that gives salvation unto kings: who delivers David his servant from the hurtful sword.
live.canon|psalms|144:11: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
live.canon|psalms|144:14: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
live.canon|psalms|144:15: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|psalms|145:6: And men shall speak of the might of your terrible acts: and I will declare your greatness.
live.canon|psalms|145:7: They shall abundantly utter the memory of your great goodness, and shall sing of your righteousness.
live.canon|psalms|145:10: All your works shall praise you, O Yahuah (LORD); and your saints shall bless you.
live.canon|psalms|145:11: They shall speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk of your power;
live.canon|psalms|145:13: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures throughout all generations.
live.canon|psalms|145:15: The eyes of all wait upon you; and you give them their meat in due season.
live.canon|psalms|145:16: You openest your hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
live.canon|psalms|145:20: Yahuah (LORD) preserves all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
live.canon|psalms|145:3: Great is Yahuah (LORD), and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
live.canon|psalms|145:8: Yahuah (LORD) is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
live.canon|psalms|145:9: Yahuah (LORD) is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
live.canon|psalms|145:12: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
live.canon|psalms|145:14: Yahuah (LORD) upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
live.canon|psalms|145:17: Yahuah (LORD) is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
live.canon|psalms|145:18: Yahuah (LORD) is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
live.canon|psalms|145:19: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
live.canon|psalms|145:21: My mouth shall speak the praise of Yahuah (LORD): and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|145:1: I will extol you, my Elohim (God), O king; and I will bless your name for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|145:2: Every day will I bless you; and I will praise your name for ever and ever.
live.canon|psalms|145:4: One generation shall praise your works to another, and shall declare your mighty acts.
live.canon|psalms|145:5: I will speak of the glorious honour of your majesty, and of your wondrous works.
live.canon|revelation|1:1: The Revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), which Elohim (God) gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
live.canon|revelation|1:2: Who bare record of the word of Elohim (God), and of the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and of all things that he saw.
live.canon|revelation|1:3: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
live.canon|revelation|1:4: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
live.canon|revelation|1:5: And from Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
live.canon|revelation|1:9: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
live.canon|revelation|1:10: I was in the Spirit on Yahuah's (Lord’s) day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
live.canon|revelation|1:12: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
live.canon|revelation|1:13: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of Adam, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
live.canon|revelation|1:14: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
live.canon|revelation|1:15: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
live.canon|revelation|1:16: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
live.canon|revelation|1:17: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
live.canon|revelation|1:6: And has made us kings and priests unto Elohim (God) and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
live.canon|revelation|1:7: Behold, he comes with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
live.canon|revelation|1:8: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, says Yahuah (Lord), which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
live.canon|revelation|1:11: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What you see, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
live.canon|revelation|1:18: I am he that lives, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
live.canon|revelation|1:19: Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
live.canon|revelation|1:20: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which you saw are the seven churches.
live.canon|revelation|2:21: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
live.canon|revelation|2:22: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
live.canon|revelation|2:23: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
live.canon|revelation|2:24: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
live.canon|revelation|2:27: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
live.canon|revelation|2:28: And I will give him the morning star.
live.canon|revelation|2:14: But I have a few things against you, because you have there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
live.canon|revelation|2:1: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things says he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
live.canon|revelation|2:2: I know your works, and your labour, and your patience, and how you can not bear them which are evil: and you have tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and have found them liars:
live.canon|revelation|2:3: And have borne, and have patience, and for my name’s sake have laboured, and have not fainted.
live.canon|revelation|2:4: Nevertheless I have somewhat against you, because you have left your first love.
live.canon|revelation|2:5: Remember therefore from whence you are fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will remove your candlestick out of his place, except you repent.
live.canon|revelation|2:6: But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
live.canon|revelation|2:7: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|2:8: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things says the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
live.canon|revelation|2:9: I know your works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but you are rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Yahudim (Jews), and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
live.canon|revelation|2:10: Fear none of those things which you shall suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that you may be tried; and you shall have tribulation ten days: be you faithful unto death, and I will give you a crown of life.
live.canon|revelation|2:11: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; He that overcomes shall not be hurt of the second death.
live.canon|revelation|2:12: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things says he which has the sharp sword with two edges;
live.canon|revelation|2:13: I know your works, and where you dwell, even where Satan’s seat is: and you hold fast my name, and have not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.
live.canon|revelation|2:15: So have you also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
live.canon|revelation|2:16: Repent; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
live.canon|revelation|2:17: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knows saving he that receives it.
live.canon|revelation|2:18: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things says the Son of Elohim (God), who has his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
live.canon|revelation|2:19: I know your works, and charity, and service, and faith, and your patience, and your works; and the last to be more than the first.
live.canon|revelation|2:20: Notwithstanding I have a few things against you, because you sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calls herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
live.canon|revelation|2:25: But that which you have already hold fast till I come.
live.canon|revelation|2:26: And he that overcomes, and keeps my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
live.canon|revelation|2:29: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
live.canon|revelation|3:19: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
live.canon|revelation|3:20: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
live.canon|revelation|3:6: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
live.canon|revelation|3:1: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things says he that has the seven Spirits of Elohim (God), and the seven stars; I know your works, that you have a name that you livest, and are dead.
live.canon|revelation|3:2: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found your works perfect before Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|3:3: Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore you shall not watch, I will come on you as a thief, and you shall not know what hour I will come upon you.
live.canon|revelation|3:4: You have a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
live.canon|revelation|3:5: He that overcomes, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
live.canon|revelation|3:7: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things says he that is holy, he that is true, he that has the key of David, he that opens, and no man shuts; and shuts, and no man opens;
live.canon|revelation|3:8: I know your works: behold, I have set before you an open door, and no man can shut it: for you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have not denied my name.
live.canon|revelation|3:9: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Yahudim (Jews), and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
live.canon|revelation|3:10: Because you have kept the word of my patience, I also will keep you from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
live.canon|revelation|3:11: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which you have, that no man take your crown.
live.canon|revelation|3:12: Him that overcomes will I make a pillar in the temple of my Elohim (God), and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my Elohim (God), and the name of the city of my Elohim (God), which is new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my Elohim (God): and I will write upon him my new name.
live.canon|revelation|3:13: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
live.canon|revelation|3:14: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of Elohim (God);
live.canon|revelation|3:15: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot: I would you were cold or hot.
live.canon|revelation|3:16: So then because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue you out of my mouth.
live.canon|revelation|3:17: Because you say, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and know not that you are wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
live.canon|revelation|3:18: I counsel you to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that you may be rich; and white raiment, that you may be clothed, and that the shame of your nakedness do not appear; and anoint your eyes with eyesalve, that you may see.
live.canon|revelation|3:21: To him that overcomes will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
live.canon|revelation|3:22: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
live.canon|revelation|4:2: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
live.canon|revelation|4:3: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
live.canon|revelation|4:4: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
live.canon|revelation|4:5: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|4:6: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
live.canon|revelation|4:7: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
live.canon|revelation|4:8: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
live.canon|revelation|4:1: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew you things which must be hereafter.
live.canon|revelation|4:9: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who lives for ever and ever,
live.canon|revelation|4:10: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that lives for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
live.canon|revelation|4:11: You are worthy, O Yahuah (Lord), to receive glory and honour and power: for you have created all things, and for your pleasure they are and were created.
live.canon|revelation|5:1: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
live.canon|revelation|5:2: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
live.canon|revelation|5:3: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
live.canon|revelation|5:4: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
live.canon|revelation|5:6: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim (God) sent forth into all the earth.
live.canon|revelation|5:7: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
live.canon|revelation|5:8: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
live.canon|revelation|5:11: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
live.canon|revelation|5:12: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
live.canon|revelation|5:5: And one of the elders says unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
live.canon|revelation|5:9: And they sung a new song, saying, You are worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for you were slain, and have redeemed us to Elohim (God) by your blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
live.canon|revelation|5:10: And have made us unto our Elohim (God) kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
live.canon|revelation|5:13: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sits upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
live.canon|revelation|5:14: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that lives for ever and ever.
live.canon|revelation|6:1: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
live.canon|revelation|6:2: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
live.canon|revelation|6:3: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
live.canon|revelation|6:4: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
live.canon|revelation|6:5: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
live.canon|revelation|6:7: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
live.canon|revelation|6:8: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
live.canon|revelation|6:9: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony which they held:
live.canon|revelation|6:11: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
live.canon|revelation|6:12: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
live.canon|revelation|6:14: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
live.canon|revelation|6:15: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
live.canon|revelation|6:17: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
live.canon|revelation|6:6: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see you hurt not the oil and the wine.
live.canon|revelation|6:10: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
live.canon|revelation|6:13: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casts her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
live.canon|revelation|6:16: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
live.canon|revelation|7:1: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
live.canon|revelation|7:2: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living Elohim (God): and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
live.canon|revelation|7:3: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our Elohim (God) in their foreheads.
live.canon|revelation|7:4: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|revelation|7:7: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
live.canon|revelation|7:8: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
live.canon|revelation|7:9: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
live.canon|revelation|7:11: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped Elohim (God),
live.canon|revelation|7:12: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our Elohim (God) for ever and ever. Amen.
live.canon|revelation|7:13: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
live.canon|revelation|7:16: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
live.canon|revelation|7:6: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasseh were sealed twelve thousand.
live.canon|revelation|7:17: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
live.canon|revelation|7:5: Of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
live.canon|revelation|7:10: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our Elohim (God) which sits upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
live.canon|revelation|7:14: And I said unto him, Sir, you know. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
live.canon|revelation|7:15: Therefore are they before the throne of Elohim (God), and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sits on the throne shall dwell among them.
live.canon|revelation|8:1: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
live.canon|revelation|8:2: And I saw the seven angels which stood before Elohim (God); and to them were given seven trumpets.
live.canon|revelation|8:3: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
live.canon|revelation|8:4: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before Elohim (God) out of the angel’s hand.
live.canon|revelation|8:5: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
live.canon|revelation|8:6: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
live.canon|revelation|8:7: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
live.canon|revelation|8:8: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
live.canon|revelation|8:9: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
live.canon|revelation|8:10: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
