live.canon|revelation|8:11: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
live.canon|revelation|8:12: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
live.canon|revelation|8:13: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
live.canon|revelation|9:1: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
live.canon|revelation|9:2: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
live.canon|revelation|9:3: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
live.canon|revelation|9:4: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of Elohim (God) in their foreheads.
live.canon|revelation|9:5: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
live.canon|revelation|9:6: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
live.canon|revelation|9:7: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
live.canon|revelation|9:8: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
live.canon|revelation|9:9: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
live.canon|revelation|9:10: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
live.canon|revelation|9:12: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
live.canon|revelation|9:13: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before Elohim (God),
live.canon|revelation|9:14: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
live.canon|revelation|9:15: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
live.canon|revelation|9:16: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
live.canon|revelation|9:17: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
live.canon|revelation|9:18: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
live.canon|revelation|9:19: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
live.canon|revelation|9:20: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
live.canon|revelation|9:21: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
live.canon|revelation|9:11: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue has his name Apollyon.
live.canon|revelation|10:1: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
live.canon|revelation|10:2: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
live.canon|revelation|10:3: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
live.canon|revelation|10:4: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
live.canon|revelation|10:5: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
live.canon|revelation|10:10: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
live.canon|revelation|10:6: And sware by him that lives for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
live.canon|revelation|10:7: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of Elohim (God) should be finished, as he has declared to his servants the prophets.
live.canon|revelation|10:8: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which stands upon the sea and upon the earth.
live.canon|revelation|10:9: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make your belly bitter, but it shall be in your mouth sweet as honey.
live.canon|revelation|10:11: And he said unto me, You must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
live.canon|revelation|11:1: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of Elohim (God), and the altar, and them that worship therein.
live.canon|revelation|11:2: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
live.canon|revelation|11:3: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
live.canon|revelation|11:4: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the Elohim (God) of the earth.
live.canon|revelation|11:6: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
live.canon|revelation|11:8: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
live.canon|revelation|11:9: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
live.canon|revelation|11:10: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
live.canon|revelation|11:11: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from Elohim (God) entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
live.canon|revelation|11:12: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
live.canon|revelation|11:13: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the Elohim (God) of heaven.
live.canon|revelation|11:15: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Messiah (Christ); and he shall reign for ever and ever.
live.canon|revelation|11:16: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before Elohim (God) on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped Elohim (God),
live.canon|revelation|11:19: And the temple of Elohim (God) was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
live.canon|revelation|11:14: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe comes quickly.
live.canon|revelation|11:5: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceeds out of their mouth, and devours their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
live.canon|revelation|11:7: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascends out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
live.canon|revelation|11:17: Saying, We give you thanks, O Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which are, and were, and are to come; because you have taken to you your great power, and have reigned.
live.canon|revelation|11:18: And the nations were angry, and your wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that you should give reward unto your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear your name, small and great; and should destroy them which destroy the earth.
live.canon|revelation|12:1: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
live.canon|revelation|12:2: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
live.canon|revelation|12:3: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
live.canon|revelation|12:4: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
live.canon|revelation|12:5: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto Elohim (God), and to his throne.
live.canon|revelation|12:7: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
live.canon|revelation|12:8: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
live.canon|revelation|12:9: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
live.canon|revelation|12:10: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our Elohim (God), and the power of his Messiah (Christ): for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our Elohim (God) day and night.
live.canon|revelation|12:11: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
live.canon|revelation|12:13: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
live.canon|revelation|12:14: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
live.canon|revelation|12:15: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
live.canon|revelation|12:16: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
live.canon|revelation|12:17: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of Elohim (God), and have the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
live.canon|revelation|12:6: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared of Elohim (God), that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
live.canon|revelation|12:12: Therefore rejoice, you heavens, and you that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knows that he has but a short time.
live.canon|revelation|13:1: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
live.canon|revelation|13:2: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
live.canon|revelation|13:3: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
live.canon|revelation|13:4: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
live.canon|revelation|13:5: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
live.canon|revelation|13:6: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against Elohim (God), to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
live.canon|revelation|13:7: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
live.canon|revelation|13:8: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
live.canon|revelation|13:9: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
live.canon|revelation|13:11: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
live.canon|revelation|13:14: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
live.canon|revelation|13:15: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
live.canon|revelation|13:17: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
live.canon|revelation|13:10: He that leads into captivity shall go into captivity: he that kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
live.canon|revelation|13:12: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causes the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
live.canon|revelation|13:13: And he does great wonders, so that he makes fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
live.canon|revelation|13:16: And he causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
live.canon|revelation|13:18: Here is wisdom. Let him that has understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
live.canon|revelation|14:2: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
live.canon|revelation|14:3: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
live.canon|revelation|14:5: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|14:6: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
live.canon|revelation|14:7: Saying with a loud voice, Fear Elohim (God), and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
live.canon|revelation|14:8: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
live.canon|revelation|14:9: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
live.canon|revelation|14:10: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of Elohim (God), which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
live.canon|revelation|14:12: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of Elohim (God), and the faith of Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|revelation|14:14: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of Adam, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
live.canon|revelation|14:16: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
live.canon|revelation|14:17: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
live.canon|revelation|14:19: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|14:20: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
live.canon|revelation|14:1: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Zion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.
live.canon|revelation|14:4: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goes. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto Elohim (God) and to the Lamb.
live.canon|revelation|14:11: And the smoke of their torment ascends up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receives the mark of his name.
live.canon|revelation|14:15: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in your sickle, and reap: for the time is come for you to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
live.canon|revelation|14:18: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
live.canon|revelation|14:13: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
live.canon|revelation|15:1: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|15:2: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|15:5: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
live.canon|revelation|15:6: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
live.canon|revelation|15:8: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of Elohim (God), and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
live.canon|revelation|15:3: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of Elohim (God), and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are your works, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty; just and true are your ways, you King of saints.
live.canon|revelation|15:4: Who shall not fear you, O Yahuah (Lord), and glorify your name? for you only are holy: for all nations shall come and worship before you; for your judgments are made manifest.
live.canon|revelation|15:7: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of Elohim (God), who lives for ever and ever.
live.canon|revelation|16:1: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of Elohim (God) upon the earth.
live.canon|revelation|16:2: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
live.canon|revelation|16:3: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
live.canon|revelation|16:4: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
live.canon|revelation|16:8: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
live.canon|revelation|16:10: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
live.canon|revelation|16:11: And blasphemed the Elohim (God) of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
live.canon|revelation|16:12: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
live.canon|revelation|16:13: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
live.canon|revelation|16:14: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of El Shaddai (God Almighty).
live.canon|revelation|16:16: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
live.canon|revelation|16:17: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
live.canon|revelation|16:18: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
live.canon|revelation|16:19: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before Elohim (God), to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
live.canon|revelation|16:20: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
live.canon|revelation|16:21: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed Elohim (God) because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
live.canon|revelation|16:5: And I heard the angel of the waters say, You are righteous, O Yahuah (Lord), which are, and were, and shall be, because you have judged thus.
live.canon|revelation|16:6: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
live.canon|revelation|16:7: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.
live.canon|revelation|16:9: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of Elohim (God), which has power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
live.canon|revelation|16:15: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
live.canon|revelation|17:2: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
live.canon|revelation|17:3: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
live.canon|revelation|17:4: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
live.canon|revelation|17:5: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
live.canon|revelation|17:6: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Yahusha (Jesus): and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
live.canon|revelation|17:13: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
live.canon|revelation|17:9: And here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.
live.canon|revelation|17:1: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto you the judgment of the great whore that sits upon many waters:
live.canon|revelation|17:7: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
live.canon|revelation|17:8: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
live.canon|revelation|17:10: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he comes, he must continue a short space.
live.canon|revelation|17:11: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into perdition.
live.canon|revelation|17:12: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
live.canon|revelation|17:15: And he says unto me, The waters which you saw, where the whore sits, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
live.canon|revelation|17:16: And the ten horns which you saw upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
live.canon|revelation|17:17: For Elohim (God) has put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of Elohim (God) shall be fulfilled.
live.canon|revelation|17:18: And the woman which you saw is that great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.
live.canon|revelation|17:14: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is the Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
live.canon|revelation|18:1: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
live.canon|revelation|18:2: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
live.canon|revelation|18:3: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
live.canon|revelation|18:9: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
live.canon|revelation|18:11: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
live.canon|revelation|18:12: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
live.canon|revelation|18:13: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
live.canon|revelation|18:15: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
live.canon|revelation|18:16: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
live.canon|revelation|18:17: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
live.canon|revelation|18:18: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
live.canon|revelation|18:19: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
live.canon|revelation|18:21: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
live.canon|revelation|18:24: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
live.canon|revelation|18:20: Rejoice over her, you heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets; for Elohim (God) has avenged you on her.
live.canon|revelation|18:4: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that you be not partakers of her sins, and that you receive not of her plagues.
live.canon|revelation|18:5: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and Elohim (God) has remembered her iniquities.
live.canon|revelation|18:6: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she has filled fill to her double.
live.canon|revelation|18:7: How much she has glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she says in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
live.canon|revelation|18:8: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) who judges her.
live.canon|revelation|18:10: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is your judgment come.
live.canon|revelation|18:14: And the fruits that your soul lusted after are departed from you, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from you, and you shall find them no more at all.
live.canon|revelation|18:22: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in you; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in you; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in you;
live.canon|revelation|18:23: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in you; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in you: for your merchants were the great men of the earth; for by your sorceries were all nations deceived.
live.canon|revelation|19:1: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the Lord our God):
live.canon|revelation|19:3: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
live.canon|revelation|19:4: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped Elohim (God) that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
live.canon|revelation|19:8: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
live.canon|revelation|19:12: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
live.canon|revelation|19:13: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|19:14: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
live.canon|revelation|19:17: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great Elohim (God);
live.canon|revelation|19:19: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
live.canon|revelation|19:20: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
live.canon|revelation|19:21: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
live.canon|revelation|19:2: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he has judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
live.canon|revelation|19:5: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our Elohim (God), all you his servants, and you that fear him, both small and great.
live.canon|revelation|19:6: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) omnipotent reigns.
live.canon|revelation|19:7: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife has made herself ready.
live.canon|revelation|19:9: And he says unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he says unto me, These are the true sayings of Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|19:10: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See you do it not: I am your fellowservant, and of your brethren that have the testimony of Yahusha (Jesus): worship Elohim (God): for the testimony of Yahusha (Jesus) is the spirit of prophecy.
live.canon|revelation|19:11: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he does judge and make war.
live.canon|revelation|19:15: And out of his mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treads the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of El Shaddai (Almighty God).
live.canon|revelation|19:16: And he has on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND Yahuah (LORD) OF LORDS.
live.canon|revelation|19:18: That you may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
live.canon|revelation|20:1: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
live.canon|revelation|20:2: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
live.canon|revelation|20:3: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
live.canon|revelation|20:4: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Yahusha (Jesus), and for the word of Elohim (God), and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Messiah (Christ) a thousand years.
live.canon|revelation|20:5: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
live.canon|revelation|20:7: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
live.canon|revelation|20:8: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
live.canon|revelation|20:9: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, and devoured them.
live.canon|revelation|20:10: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
live.canon|revelation|20:11: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
live.canon|revelation|20:12: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
live.canon|revelation|20:13: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
live.canon|revelation|20:14: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
live.canon|revelation|20:15: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
live.canon|revelation|20:6: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection: on such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.
live.canon|revelation|21:1: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
live.canon|revelation|21:2: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
live.canon|revelation|21:3: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|21:4: And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
live.canon|revelation|21:5: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
live.canon|revelation|21:6: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
live.canon|revelation|21:10: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from Elohim (God),
live.canon|revelation|21:11: Having the glory of Elohim (God): and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
live.canon|revelation|21:12: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|revelation|21:13: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
live.canon|revelation|21:14: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
live.canon|revelation|21:15: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
live.canon|revelation|21:17: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
live.canon|revelation|21:18: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
live.canon|revelation|21:19: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
live.canon|revelation|21:20: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
live.canon|revelation|21:21: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
live.canon|revelation|21:22: And I saw no temple therein: for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
live.canon|revelation|21:23: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of Elohim (God) did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
live.canon|revelation|21:24: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
live.canon|revelation|21:25: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
live.canon|revelation|21:26: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
live.canon|revelation|21:7: He that overcomes shall inherit all things; and I will be his Elohim (God), and he shall be my son.
live.canon|revelation|21:8: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
live.canon|revelation|21:9: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.
live.canon|revelation|21:16: And the city lies foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
live.canon|revelation|21:27: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defiles, neither whatsoever works abomination, or makes a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
live.canon|revelation|22:1: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.
live.canon|revelation|22:2: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
live.canon|revelation|22:3: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
live.canon|revelation|22:4: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
live.canon|revelation|22:6: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
live.canon|revelation|22:8: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
live.canon|revelation|22:11: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
live.canon|revelation|22:12: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
live.canon|revelation|22:13: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
live.canon|revelation|22:14: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
live.canon|revelation|22:19: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, Elohim (God) shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
live.canon|revelation|22:21: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you all. Amen.
live.canon|revelation|22:7: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keeps the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
live.canon|revelation|22:5: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) gives them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
live.canon|revelation|22:9: Then says he unto me, See you do it not: for I am your fellowservant, and of your brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship Elohim (God).
live.canon|revelation|22:10: And he says unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
live.canon|revelation|22:15: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loves and makes a lie.
live.canon|revelation|22:16: I Yahusha (Jesus) have sent my angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
live.canon|revelation|22:17: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that hears say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
live.canon|revelation|22:18: For I testify unto every man that hears the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, Elohim (God) shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
live.canon|revelation|22:20: He which testifieth these things says, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|romans|1:1: Paul, a servant of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of Elohim (God),
live.canon|romans|1:2: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
live.canon|romans|1:3: Concerning his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
live.canon|romans|1:4: And declared to be the Son of Elohim (God) with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
live.canon|romans|1:5: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
live.canon|romans|1:8: First, I thank my Elohim (God) through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
live.canon|romans|1:9: For Elohim (God) is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
live.canon|romans|1:10: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of Elohim (God) to come unto you.
live.canon|romans|1:12: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
live.canon|romans|1:13: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
live.canon|romans|1:14: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
live.canon|romans|1:15: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
live.canon|romans|1:18: For the wrath of Elohim (God) is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
live.canon|romans|1:20: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
live.canon|romans|1:21: Because that, when they knew Elohim (God), they glorified him not as Elohim (God), neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
live.canon|romans|1:16: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Messiah (Christ): for it is the power of Elohim (God) unto salvation to every one that believes; to the Yahudi (Jew) first, and also to the Greek.
live.canon|romans|1:22: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
live.canon|romans|1:23: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
live.canon|romans|1:24: Wherefore Elohim (God) also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
live.canon|romans|1:25: Who changed the truth of Elohim (God) into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
live.canon|romans|1:26: For this cause Elohim (God) gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
live.canon|romans|1:27: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
live.canon|romans|1:28: And even as they did not like to retain Elohim (God) in their knowledge, Elohim (God) gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
live.canon|romans|1:29: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
live.canon|romans|1:30: Backbiters, haters of Elohim (God), despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
live.canon|romans|1:31: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
live.canon|romans|1:32: Who knowing the judgment of Elohim (God), that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
live.canon|romans|1:6: Among whom are you also the called of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
live.canon|romans|1:11: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end you may be established;
live.canon|romans|1:17: For therein is the righteousness of Elohim (God) revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The righteous shall live by faith.
live.canon|romans|1:19: Because that which may be known of Elohim (God) is manifest in them; for Elohim (God) has shewed it unto them.
live.canon|romans|1:7: To all that be in Rome, beloved of Elohim (God), called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from Elohim (God) our Father, and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
live.canon|romans|2:2: But we are sure that the judgment of Elohim (God) is according to truth against them which commit such things.
live.canon|romans|2:6: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
live.canon|romans|2:7: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
live.canon|romans|2:8: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
live.canon|romans|2:11: For there is no respect of persons with Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|2:12: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
live.canon|romans|2:13: (For not the hearers of the law are just before Elohim (God), but the doers of the law shall be justified.
live.canon|romans|2:14: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
live.canon|romans|2:15: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
live.canon|romans|2:16: In the day when Elohim (God) shall judge the secrets of men by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) according to my gospel.
live.canon|romans|2:24: For the name of Elohim (God) is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
live.canon|romans|2:26: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
live.canon|romans|2:28: For he is not a Yahudi (Jew), which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
live.canon|romans|2:29: But he is a Yahudi (Jew), which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|2:1: Therefore you are inexcusable, O man, whosoever you are that judge: for wherein you judge another, you condemnest thyself; for you that judge do the same things.
live.canon|romans|2:3: And thinkest you this, O man, that judge them which do such things, and do the same, that you shall escape the judgment of Elohim (God)?
live.canon|romans|2:4: Or despisest you the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of Elohim (God) leads you to repentance?
live.canon|romans|2:5: But after your hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of Elohim (God);
live.canon|romans|2:9: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that does evil, of the Yahudi (Jew) first, and also of the Gentile;
live.canon|romans|2:10: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that works good, to the Yahudi (Jew) first, and also to the Gentile:
live.canon|romans|2:17: Behold, you are called a Yahudi (Jew), and restest in the law, and make your boast of Elohim (God),
live.canon|romans|2:18: And know his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
live.canon|romans|2:19: And are confident that you thyself are a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
live.canon|romans|2:20: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which have the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
live.canon|romans|2:21: You therefore which teach another, teach you not thyself? you that preachest a man should not steal, do you steal?
live.canon|romans|2:22: You that say a man should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? you that abhorrest idols, do you commit sacrilege?
live.canon|romans|2:23: You that make your boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest you Elohim (God)?
live.canon|romans|2:25: For circumcision verily profiteth, if you keep the law: but if you be a breaker of the law, your circumcision is made uncircumcision.
live.canon|romans|2:27: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge you, who by the letter and circumcision do transgress the law?
live.canon|romans|3:2: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|3:3: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of Elohim (God) without effect?
live.canon|romans|3:6: Elohim (God) forbid: for then how shall Elohim (God) judge the world?
live.canon|romans|3:8: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
live.canon|romans|3:9: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Yahudim (Jews) and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
live.canon|romans|3:10: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
live.canon|romans|3:13: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
live.canon|romans|3:14: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
live.canon|romans|3:15: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
live.canon|romans|3:16: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
live.canon|romans|3:17: And the way of peace have they not known:
live.canon|romans|3:18: There is no fear of Elohim (God) before their eyes.
live.canon|romans|3:20: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
live.canon|romans|3:21: But now the righteousness of Elohim (God) without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
live.canon|romans|3:22: Even the righteousness of Elohim (God) which is by faith of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
live.canon|romans|3:23: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of Elohim (God);
live.canon|romans|3:24: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
live.canon|romans|3:27: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
live.canon|romans|3:28: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
live.canon|romans|3:29: Is he the Elohim (God) of the Yahudim (Jews) only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
live.canon|romans|3:30: Seeing it is one Elohim (God), which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
live.canon|romans|3:31: Do we then make void the law through faith? Elohim (God) forbid: yea, we establish the law.
live.canon|romans|3:1: What advantage then has the Yahudi (Jew)? or what profit is there of circumcision?
live.canon|romans|3:4: Elohim (God) forbid: yea, let Elohim (God) be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That you might be justified in your sayings, and might overcome when you are judged.
live.canon|romans|3:5: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of Elohim (God), what shall we say? Is Elohim (God) unrighteous who takes vengeance? (I speak as a man)
live.canon|romans|3:7: For if the truth of Elohim (God) has more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
live.canon|romans|3:11: There is none that understands, there is none that seeks after Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|3:12: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that does good, no, not one.
live.canon|romans|3:19: Now we know that what things soever the law says, it says to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|3:25: Whom Elohim (God) has set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of Elohim (God);
live.canon|romans|3:26: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believes in Yahusha (Jesus).
live.canon|romans|4:6: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom Elohim (God) imputeth righteousness without works,
live.canon|romans|4:7: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
live.canon|romans|4:8: Blessed is the man to whom Yahuah (Lord) will not impute sin.
live.canon|romans|4:10: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
live.canon|romans|4:11: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
live.canon|romans|4:12: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
live.canon|romans|4:13: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
live.canon|romans|4:14: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
live.canon|romans|4:16: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
live.canon|romans|4:20: He staggered not at the promise of Elohim (God) through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to Elohim (God);
live.canon|romans|4:21: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
live.canon|romans|4:22: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
live.canon|romans|4:23: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
live.canon|romans|4:17: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.
live.canon|romans|4:18: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall your seed be.
live.canon|romans|4:24: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Yahusha (Jesus) our Lord from the dead;
live.canon|romans|4:25: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
live.canon|romans|4:19: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah’s womb:
live.canon|romans|4:1: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, has found?
live.canon|romans|4:2: For if Abraham were justified by works, he has whereof to glory; but not before Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|4:3: For what says the scripture? Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
live.canon|romans|4:4: Now to him that works is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
live.canon|romans|4:5: But to him that works not, but believes on him that justifies the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
live.canon|romans|4:9: Comes this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
live.canon|romans|4:15: Because the law works wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
live.canon|romans|5:2: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|5:4: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
live.canon|romans|5:6: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Messiah (Christ) died for the ungodly.
live.canon|romans|5:7: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
live.canon|romans|5:8: But Elohim (God) commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Messiah (Christ) died for us.
live.canon|romans|5:9: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
live.canon|romans|5:10: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to Elohim (God) by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
live.canon|romans|5:12: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
live.canon|romans|5:13: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
live.canon|romans|5:14: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
live.canon|romans|5:16: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
live.canon|romans|5:17: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).)
live.canon|romans|5:18: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
live.canon|romans|5:19: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
live.canon|romans|5:20: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
live.canon|romans|5:3: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation works patience;
live.canon|romans|5:5: And hope makes not ashamed; because the love of Elohim (God) is shed abroad in our hearts by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) which is given unto us.
live.canon|romans|5:15: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of Elohim (God), and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), has abounded unto many.
live.canon|romans|5:21: That as sin has reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
live.canon|romans|5:1: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with Elohim (God) through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
live.canon|romans|5:11: And not only so, but we also joy in Elohim (God) through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), by whom we have now received the atonement.
live.canon|romans|6:1: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
live.canon|romans|6:2: Elohim (God) forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
live.canon|romans|6:4: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Messiah (Christ) was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
live.canon|romans|6:5: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
live.canon|romans|6:6: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
live.canon|romans|6:7: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
live.canon|romans|6:8: Now if we be dead with Messiah (Christ), we believe that we shall also live with him:
live.canon|romans|6:15: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? Elohim (God) forbid.
live.canon|romans|6:16: Know you not, that to whom you yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants you are to whom you obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
live.canon|romans|6:17: But Elohim (God) be thanked, that you were the servants of sin, but you have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
live.canon|romans|6:18: Being then made free from sin, you became the servants of righteousness.
live.canon|romans|6:23: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of Elohim (God) is eternal life through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
live.canon|romans|6:20: For when you were the servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
live.canon|romans|6:3: Know you not, that so many of us as were baptized into Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) were baptized into his death?
live.canon|romans|6:9: Knowing that Messiah (Christ) being raised from the dead dies no more; death has no more dominion over him.
live.canon|romans|6:10: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he lives, he lives unto Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|6:11: Likewise reckon you also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto Elohim (God) through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
live.canon|romans|6:12: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in the lusts thereof.
live.canon|romans|6:13: Neither yield you your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto Elohim (God), as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|6:14: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for you are not under the law, but under grace.
live.canon|romans|6:19: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as you have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
live.canon|romans|6:21: What fruit had you then in those things whereof you are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
live.canon|romans|6:22: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to Elohim (God), you have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
live.canon|romans|7:5: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
live.canon|romans|7:6: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
live.canon|romans|7:8: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
live.canon|romans|7:9: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
live.canon|romans|7:10: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
live.canon|romans|7:11: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
live.canon|romans|7:12: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
live.canon|romans|7:13: Was then that which is good made death unto me? Elohim (God) forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
live.canon|romans|7:14: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
live.canon|romans|7:15: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
live.canon|romans|7:16: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
live.canon|romans|7:19: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
live.canon|romans|7:21: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
live.canon|romans|7:22: For I delight in the law of Elohim (God) after the inward man:
live.canon|romans|7:23: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
live.canon|romans|7:24: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
live.canon|romans|7:25: I thank Elohim (God) through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of Elohim (God); but with the flesh the law of sin.
live.canon|romans|7:17: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.
live.canon|romans|7:1: Know you not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law has dominion over a man as long as he lives?
live.canon|romans|7:2: For the woman which has an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he lives; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
live.canon|romans|7:3: So then if, while her husband lives, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
live.canon|romans|7:4: Wherefore, my brethren, you also are become dead to the law by the body of Messiah (Christ); that you should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|7:7: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? Elohim (God) forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, You shall not covet.
live.canon|romans|7:18: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwells no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
live.canon|romans|7:20: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.
live.canon|romans|8:1: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
live.canon|romans|8:3: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, Elohim (God) sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
live.canon|romans|8:4: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
live.canon|romans|8:5: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
live.canon|romans|8:6: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
live.canon|romans|8:7: Because the carnal mind is enmity against Elohim (God): for it is not subject to the law of Elohim (God), neither indeed can be.
live.canon|romans|8:8: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|8:10: And if Messiah (Christ) be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
live.canon|romans|8:12: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
live.canon|romans|8:14: For as many as are led by the Spirit of Elohim (God), they are the sons of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|8:36: As it is written, For your sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
live.canon|romans|8:17: And if children, then heirs; heirs of Elohim (God), and joint-heirs with Messiah (Christ); if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
live.canon|romans|8:18: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
live.canon|romans|8:21: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|8:22: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
live.canon|romans|8:23: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
live.canon|romans|8:25: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
live.canon|romans|8:28: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love Elohim (God), to them who are the called according to his purpose.
live.canon|romans|8:29: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
live.canon|romans|8:30: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
live.canon|romans|8:31: What shall we then say to these things? If Elohim (God) be for us, who can be against us?
live.canon|romans|8:32: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
live.canon|romans|8:35: Who shall separate us from the love of Messiah (Christ)? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
live.canon|romans|8:37: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
live.canon|romans|8:38: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
live.canon|romans|8:39: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of Elohim (God), which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) our Lord.
live.canon|romans|8:13: For if you live after the flesh, you shall die: but if you through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, you shall live.
