live.canon|romans|8:2: For the law of the Spirit of life in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) has made me free from the law of sin and death.
live.canon|romans|8:9: But you are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of Elohim (God) dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Messiah (Christ), he is none of his.
live.canon|romans|8:11: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Yahusha (Jesus) from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Messiah (Christ) from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwells in you.
live.canon|romans|8:15: For you have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but you have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
live.canon|romans|8:16: The Spirit itself bears witness with our spirit, that we are the children of Elohim (God):
live.canon|romans|8:19: For the earnest expectation of the creature waits for the manifestation of the sons of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|8:20: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who has subjected the same in hope,
live.canon|romans|8:24: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man sees, why does he yet hope for?
live.canon|romans|8:26: Likewise the Spirit also helps our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself makes intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
live.canon|romans|8:27: And he that searcheth the hearts knows what is the mind of the Spirit, because he makes intercession for the saints according to the will of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|8:33: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of Elohim's (God’s) elect? It is Elohim (God) that justifies.
live.canon|romans|8:34: Who is he that condemneth? It is Messiah (Christ) that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of Elohim (God), who also makes intercession for us.
live.canon|romans|9:1: I say the truth in Messiah (Christ), I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit),
live.canon|romans|9:2: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
live.canon|romans|9:3: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Messiah (Christ) for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
live.canon|romans|9:4: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of Elohim (God), and the promises;
live.canon|romans|9:5: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Messiah (Christ) came, who is over all, Elohim (God) blessed for ever. Amen.
live.canon|romans|9:8: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of Elohim (God): but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
live.canon|romans|9:12: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
live.canon|romans|9:13: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
live.canon|romans|9:14: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with Elohim (God)? Elohim (God) forbid.
live.canon|romans|9:22: What if Elohim (God), willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
live.canon|romans|9:23: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
live.canon|romans|9:28: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will Yahuah (Lord) make upon the earth.
live.canon|romans|9:30: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
live.canon|romans|9:32: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
live.canon|romans|9:27: Isaiah also cries concerning Yashar'el (Israel), Though the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
live.canon|romans|9:29: And as Isaiah said before, Except Yahuah (Lord) of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodom, and been made like unto Gomorrah.
live.canon|romans|9:10: And not only this; but when Rebekah also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
live.canon|romans|9:9: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
live.canon|romans|9:33: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Zion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.
live.canon|romans|9:6: Not as though the word of Elohim (God) has taken none effect. For they are not all Yashar'el (Israel), which are of Yashar'el (Israel):
live.canon|romans|9:7: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall your seed be called.
live.canon|romans|9:11: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of Elohim (God) according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calls;)
live.canon|romans|9:15: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
live.canon|romans|9:16: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runs, but of Elohim (God) that shows mercy.
live.canon|romans|9:17: For the scripture says unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised you up, that I might shew my power in you, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
live.canon|romans|9:18: Therefore has he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
live.canon|romans|9:19: You will say then unto me, Why does he yet find fault? For who has resisted his will?
live.canon|romans|9:20: Nay but, O man, who are you that repliest against Elohim (God)? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why have you made me thus?
live.canon|romans|9:21: Has not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
live.canon|romans|9:24: Even us, whom he has called, not of the Yahudim (Jews) only, but also of the Gentiles?
live.canon|romans|9:25: As he says also in Hosea, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
live.canon|romans|9:26: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|9:31: But Yashar'el (Israel), which followed after the law of righteousness, has not attained to the law of righteousness.
live.canon|romans|10:1: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to Elohim (God) for Yashar'el (Israel) is, that they might be saved.
live.canon|romans|10:2: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of Elohim (God), but not according to knowledge.
live.canon|romans|10:3: For they being ignorant of Elohim's (God’s) righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|10:7: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Messiah (Christ) again from the dead.)
live.canon|romans|10:13: For whosoever shall call upon the name of Yahuah (Lord) shall be saved.
live.canon|romans|10:14: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
live.canon|romans|10:15: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
live.canon|romans|10:18: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
live.canon|romans|10:16: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, Yahuah (Lord), who has believed our report?
live.canon|romans|10:4: For Messiah (Christ) is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believes.
live.canon|romans|10:5: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which does those things shall live by them.
live.canon|romans|10:6: But the righteousness which is of faith speaks on this wise, Say not in your heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Messiah (Christ) down from above:)
live.canon|romans|10:8: But what says it? The word is nigh you, even in your mouth, and in your heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
live.canon|romans|10:10: For with the heart man believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
live.canon|romans|10:11: For the scripture says, Whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.
live.canon|romans|10:17: So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|10:19: But I say, Did not Yashar'el (Israel) know? First Moses says, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
live.canon|romans|10:21: But to Yashar'el (Israel) he says, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
live.canon|romans|10:20: But Isaiah is very bold, and says, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
live.canon|romans|10:12: For there is no difference between the Yahudi (Jew) and the Greek: for the same the Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
live.canon|romans|10:9: That if you shall confess with your mouth Lord Yahusha (Jesus), and shall believe in your heart that Elohim (God) has raised him from the dead, you shall be saved.
live.canon|romans|11:5: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
live.canon|romans|11:6: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
live.canon|romans|11:10: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
live.canon|romans|11:11: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? Elohim (God) forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
live.canon|romans|11:12: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
live.canon|romans|11:14: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
live.canon|romans|11:15: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
live.canon|romans|11:16: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
live.canon|romans|11:23: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for Elohim (God) is able to graff them in again.
live.canon|romans|11:27: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
live.canon|romans|11:28: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.
live.canon|romans|11:29: For the gifts and calling of Elohim (God) are without repentance.
live.canon|romans|11:31: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
live.canon|romans|11:33: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
live.canon|romans|11:36: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
live.canon|romans|11:26: And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Zion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
live.canon|romans|11:32: For Elohim (God) has concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
live.canon|romans|11:34: For who has known the mind of Yahuah (Lord)? or who has been his counsellor?
live.canon|romans|11:35: Or who has first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
live.canon|romans|11:2: Elohim (God) has not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot you not what the scripture says of Elijah? how he makes intercession to Elohim (God) against Yashar'el (Israel), saying,
live.canon|romans|11:1: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
live.canon|romans|11:3: Yahuah (Lord), they have killed your prophets, and digged down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
live.canon|romans|11:4: But what says the answer of Elohim (God) unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
live.canon|romans|11:7: What then? Yashar'el (Israel) has not obtained that which he seeks for; but the election has obtained it, and the rest were blinded
live.canon|romans|11:8: (According as it is written, Elohim (God) has given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
live.canon|romans|11:9: And David says, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
live.canon|romans|11:13: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify my office:
live.canon|romans|11:17: And if some of the branches be broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
live.canon|romans|11:18: Boast not against the branches. But if you boast, you bear not the root, but the root you.
live.canon|romans|11:19: You will say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
live.canon|romans|11:20: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
live.canon|romans|11:21: For if Elohim (God) spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not you.
live.canon|romans|11:22: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of Elohim (God): on them which fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness: otherwise you also shall be cut off.
live.canon|romans|11:24: For if you were cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and were graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
live.canon|romans|11:25: For I would not, brethren, that you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest you should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
live.canon|romans|11:30: For as you in times past have not believed Elohim (God), yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
live.canon|romans|12:4: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
live.canon|romans|12:5: So we, being many, are one body in Messiah (Christ), and every one members one of another.
live.canon|romans|12:6: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
live.canon|romans|12:9: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
live.canon|romans|12:10: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
live.canon|romans|12:12: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
live.canon|romans|12:13: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
live.canon|romans|12:14: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
live.canon|romans|12:15: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
live.canon|romans|12:16: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
live.canon|romans|12:17: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
live.canon|romans|12:21: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
live.canon|romans|12:1: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of Elohim (God), that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto Elohim (God), which is your reasonable service.
live.canon|romans|12:2: And be not conformed to this world: but be you transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|12:3: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as Elohim (God) has dealt to every man the measure of faith.
live.canon|romans|12:7: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teaches, on teaching;
live.canon|romans|12:8: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that gives, let him do it with simplicity; he that rules, with diligence; he that shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
live.canon|romans|12:18: If it be possible, as much as lies in you, live peaceably with all men.
live.canon|romans|12:19: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says Yahuah (Lord).
live.canon|romans|12:20: Therefore if your enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing you shall heap coals of fire on his head.
live.canon|romans|12:11: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
live.canon|romans|13:1: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of Elohim (God): the powers that be are ordained of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|13:2: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of Elohim (God): and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
live.canon|romans|13:7: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
live.canon|romans|13:3: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Will you then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and you shall have praise of the same:
live.canon|romans|13:4: For he is the minister of Elohim (God) to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid; for he bears not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of Elohim (God), a revenger to execute wrath upon him that does evil.
live.canon|romans|13:11: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
live.canon|romans|13:12: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
live.canon|romans|13:13: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
live.canon|romans|13:5: Wherefore you must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
live.canon|romans|13:6: For for this cause pay you tribute also: for they are Elohim's (God’s) ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
live.canon|romans|13:8: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loves another has fulfilled the law.
live.canon|romans|13:9: For this, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not kill, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness, You shall not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.
live.canon|romans|13:10: Love works no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
live.canon|romans|13:14: But put you on Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
live.canon|romans|14:5: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
live.canon|romans|14:12: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|14:13: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.
live.canon|romans|14:16: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
live.canon|romans|14:17: For the kingdom of Elohim (God) is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
live.canon|romans|14:19: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
live.canon|romans|14:1: Him that is weak in the faith receive you, but not to doubtful disputations.
live.canon|romans|14:2: For one believes that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eats herbs.
live.canon|romans|14:3: Let not him that eats despise him that eats not; and let not him which eats not judge him that eats: for Elohim (God) has received him.
live.canon|romans|14:4: Who are you that judge another man’s servant? to his own master he stands or falls. Yea, he shall be holden up: for Elohim (God) is able to make him stand.
live.canon|romans|14:7: For none of us lives to himself, and no man dies to himself.
live.canon|romans|14:10: But why do you judge your brother? or why do you set at nought your brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|romans|14:11: For it is written, As I live, says Yahuah (Lord), every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|14:15: But if your brother be grieved with your meat, now walk you not charitably. Destroy not him with your meat, for whom Messiah (Christ) died.
live.canon|romans|14:18: For he that in these things serves Messiah (Christ) is acceptable to Elohim (God), and approved of men.
live.canon|romans|14:20: For meat destroy not the work of Elohim (God). All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eats with offence.
live.canon|romans|14:21: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby your brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
live.canon|romans|14:22: Have you faith? have it to thyself before Elohim (God). Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
live.canon|romans|14:23: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eats not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
live.canon|romans|14:8: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are Yahuah's (Lord’s).
live.canon|romans|14:9: For to this end Messiah (Christ) both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be the Lord both of the dead and living.
live.canon|romans|14:14: I know, and am persuaded by Lord Yahusha (Jesus), that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
live.canon|romans|14:6: He that regards the day, regards it unto the Lord; and he that regards not the day, to the Lord he does not regard it. He that eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives Elohim (God) thanks; and he that eats not, to the Lord he eats not, and gives Elohim (God) thanks.
live.canon|romans|15:30: Now I beseech you, brethren, for Lord Yahusha HaMashiach's (Lord Jesus Christ’s) sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to Elohim (God) for me;
live.canon|romans|15:1: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
live.canon|romans|15:2: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
live.canon|romans|15:4: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
live.canon|romans|15:5: Now the Elohim (God) of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
live.canon|romans|15:8: Now I say that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of Elohim (God), to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
live.canon|romans|15:15: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of Elohim (God),
live.canon|romans|15:16: That I should be the minister of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of Elohim (God), that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
live.canon|romans|15:17: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) in those things which pertain to Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|15:19: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of Elohim (God); so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|romans|15:20: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Messiah (Christ) was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
live.canon|romans|15:21: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
live.canon|romans|15:22: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
live.canon|romans|15:23: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
live.canon|romans|15:24: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
live.canon|romans|15:25: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
live.canon|romans|15:28: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
live.canon|romans|15:29: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|romans|15:31: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
live.canon|romans|15:32: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of Elohim (God), and may with you be refreshed.
live.canon|romans|15:33: Now the Elohim (God) of peace be with you all. Amen.
live.canon|romans|15:7: Wherefore receive you one another, as Messiah (Christ) also received us to the glory of Elohim (God).
live.canon|romans|15:10: And again he says, Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.
live.canon|romans|15:12: And again, Isaiah says, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
live.canon|romans|15:3: For even Messiah (Christ) pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached you fell on me.
live.canon|romans|15:9: And that the Gentiles might glorify Elohim (God) for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to you among the Gentiles, and sing unto your name.
live.canon|romans|15:11: And again, Praise Yahuah (Lord), all you Gentiles; and laud him, all you people.
live.canon|romans|15:13: Now the Elohim (God) of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, through the power of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
live.canon|romans|15:14: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
live.canon|romans|15:18: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Messiah (Christ) has not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
live.canon|romans|15:26: For it has pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
live.canon|romans|15:27: It has pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
live.canon|romans|15:6: That you may with one mind and one mouth glorify Elohim (God), even the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
live.canon|romans|16:1: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
live.canon|romans|16:3: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
live.canon|romans|16:4: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
live.canon|romans|16:5: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Messiah (Christ).
live.canon|romans|16:6: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
live.canon|romans|16:7: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Messiah (Christ) before me.
live.canon|romans|16:9: Salute Urbane, our helper in Messiah (Christ), and Stachys my beloved.
live.canon|romans|16:10: Salute Apelles approved in Messiah (Christ). Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
live.canon|romans|16:14: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
live.canon|romans|16:15: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
live.canon|romans|16:16: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Messiah (Christ) salute you.
live.canon|romans|16:19: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
live.canon|romans|16:21: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
live.canon|romans|16:27: To Elohim (God) only wise, be glory through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) for ever. Amen.
live.canon|romans|16:25: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
live.canon|romans|16:17: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which you have learned; and avoid them.
live.canon|romans|16:23: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
live.canon|romans|16:26: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of El Olam (the everlasting God), made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
live.canon|romans|16:8: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
live.canon|romans|16:11: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
live.canon|romans|16:12: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
live.canon|romans|16:13: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
live.canon|romans|16:18: For they that are such serve not our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
live.canon|romans|16:20: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.
live.canon|romans|16:22: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
live.canon|romans|16:24: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you all. Amen.
live.canon|romans|16:2: That you receive her in the Lord, as becomes saints, and that you assist her in whatsoever business she has need of you: for she has been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
live.canon|zechariah|1:3: Therefore say you unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Turn you unto me, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and I will turn unto you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|zechariah|1:4: Be you not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Turn you now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|1:6: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so has he dealt with us.
live.canon|zechariah|1:9: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew you what these be.
live.canon|zechariah|1:10: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom Yahuah (LORD) has sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
live.canon|zechariah|1:11: And they answered the angel of Yahuah (LORD) that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sits still, and is at rest.
live.canon|zechariah|1:12: Then the angel of Yahuah (LORD) answered and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Yahudah (Judah), against which you have had indignation these threescore and ten years?
live.canon|zechariah|1:14: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry you, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
live.canon|zechariah|1:16: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
live.canon|zechariah|1:17: Cry yet, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and Yahuah (LORD) shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
live.canon|zechariah|1:18: Then lifted I up my eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
live.canon|zechariah|1:1: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|1:5: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
live.canon|zechariah|1:7: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|1:8: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
live.canon|zechariah|1:13: And Yahuah (LORD) answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
live.canon|zechariah|1:15: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
live.canon|zechariah|1:19: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Yahudah (Judah), Yashar'el (Israel), and Jerusalem.
live.canon|zechariah|1:20: And Yahuah (LORD) shewed me four carpenters.
live.canon|zechariah|1:21: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Yahudah (Judah), so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Yahudah (Judah) to scatter it.
live.canon|zechariah|1:2: Yahuah (LORD) has been sore displeased with your fathers.
live.canon|zechariah|2:1: I lifted up my eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
live.canon|zechariah|2:2: Then said I, Whither go you? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
live.canon|zechariah|2:5: For I, says Yahuah (LORD), will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
live.canon|zechariah|2:6: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, says Yahuah (LORD): for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|2:7: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwell with the daughter of Babylon.
live.canon|zechariah|2:9: For, behold, I will shake my hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me.
live.canon|zechariah|2:10: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|2:11: And many nations shall be joined to Yahuah (LORD) in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of you, and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me unto you.
live.canon|zechariah|2:3: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
live.canon|zechariah|2:4: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
live.canon|zechariah|2:12: And Yahuah (LORD) shall inherit Yahudah (Judah) his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
live.canon|zechariah|2:13: Be silent, O all flesh, before Yahuah (LORD): for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
live.canon|zechariah|2:8: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); After the glory has he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that touches you touches the apple of his eye.
live.canon|zechariah|3:2: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Yahuah (LORD) rebuke you, O Satan; even Yahuah (LORD) that has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
live.canon|zechariah|3:4: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with change of raiment.
live.canon|zechariah|3:7: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); If you will walk in my ways, and if you will keep my charge, then you shall also judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you places to walk among these that stand by.
live.canon|zechariah|3:8: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, you, and your fellows that sit before you: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.
live.canon|zechariah|3:9: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
live.canon|zechariah|3:10: In that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), shall you call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
live.canon|zechariah|3:1: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah (LORD), and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
live.canon|zechariah|3:3: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
live.canon|zechariah|3:5: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stood by.
live.canon|zechariah|3:6: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) protested unto Joshua, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|4:2: And said unto me, What see you? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
live.canon|zechariah|4:5: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Know you not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
live.canon|zechariah|4:6: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|zechariah|4:7: Who are you, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel you shall become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
live.canon|zechariah|4:9: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me unto you.
live.canon|zechariah|4:10: For who has despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), which run to and fro through the whole earth.
live.canon|zechariah|4:13: And he answered me and said, Know you not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
live.canon|zechariah|4:1: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,
live.canon|zechariah|4:3: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
live.canon|zechariah|4:4: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
live.canon|zechariah|4:8: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|4:11: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
live.canon|zechariah|4:12: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
live.canon|zechariah|4:14: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by Adonai (Lord) of the whole earth.
live.canon|zechariah|5:1: Then I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
live.canon|zechariah|5:2: And he said unto me, What see you? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
live.canon|zechariah|5:3: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that swears shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
live.canon|zechariah|5:4: I will bring it forth, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that swears falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
live.canon|zechariah|5:5: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now your eyes, and see what is this that goes forth.
live.canon|zechariah|5:6: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goes forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
live.canon|zechariah|5:7: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sits in the midst of the ephah.
live.canon|zechariah|5:9: Then lifted I up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
live.canon|zechariah|5:8: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
live.canon|zechariah|5:10: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
live.canon|zechariah|5:11: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
live.canon|zechariah|6:15: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of Yahuah (LORD), and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if you will diligently obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
live.canon|zechariah|6:2: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
live.canon|zechariah|6:3: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
live.canon|zechariah|6:4: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
live.canon|zechariah|6:1: And I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
live.canon|zechariah|6:10: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come you the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
live.canon|zechariah|6:12: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD):
live.canon|zechariah|6:6: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
live.canon|zechariah|6:7: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
live.canon|zechariah|6:8: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
live.canon|zechariah|6:9: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|6:11: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
live.canon|zechariah|6:13: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
live.canon|zechariah|6:14: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|6:5: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before Adonai (Lord) of all the earth.
live.canon|zechariah|7:6: And when you did eat, and when you did drink, did not you eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
live.canon|zechariah|7:7: Should you not hear the words which Yahuah (LORD) has cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
live.canon|zechariah|7:9: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
live.canon|zechariah|7:12: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|zechariah|7:13: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts):
live.canon|zechariah|7:1: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
live.canon|zechariah|7:2: When they had sent unto the house of Elohim (God) Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before Yahuah (LORD),
live.canon|zechariah|7:3: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
live.canon|zechariah|7:4: Then came the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) unto me, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|7:8: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Zechariah, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|7:10: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
live.canon|zechariah|7:11: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
live.canon|zechariah|7:14: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
live.canon|zechariah|7:5: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did you at all fast unto me, even to me?
live.canon|zechariah|8:2: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
live.canon|zechariah|8:3: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) the holy mountain.
live.canon|zechariah|8:4: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
live.canon|zechariah|8:6: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in my eyes? says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|zechariah|8:9: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Let your hands be strong, you that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) was laid, that the temple might be built.
live.canon|zechariah|8:11: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.canon|zechariah|8:13: And it shall come to pass, that as you were a curse among the heathen, O house of Yahudah (Judah), and house of Yashar'el (Israel); so will I save you, and you shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
live.canon|zechariah|8:14: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and I repented not:
live.canon|zechariah|8:15: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Yahudah (Judah): fear you not.
live.canon|zechariah|8:16: These are the things that you shall do; Speak you every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
live.canon|zechariah|8:17: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|8:19: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Yahudah (Judah) joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
live.canon|zechariah|8:20: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
live.canon|zechariah|8:23: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Yahudi (Jew), saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that Elohim (God) is with you.
live.canon|zechariah|8:1: Again the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) came to me, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|8:5: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
live.canon|zechariah|8:8: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God), in truth and in righteousness.
live.canon|zechariah|8:10: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
live.canon|zechariah|8:12: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
live.canon|zechariah|8:18: And the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) came unto me, saying,
live.canon|zechariah|8:21: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before Yahuah (LORD), and to seek Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): I will go also.
live.canon|zechariah|8:22: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) in Jerusalem, and to pray before Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|8:7: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
live.canon|zechariah|9:7: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remains, even he, shall be for our Elohim (God), and he shall be as a governor in Yahudah (Judah), and Ekron as a Jebusite.
live.canon|zechariah|9:8: And I will encamp about my house because of the army, because of him that passes by, and because of him that returns: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with my eyes.
live.canon|zechariah|9:9: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, your King comes unto you: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
live.canon|zechariah|9:11: As for you also, by the blood of your covenant I have sent forth your prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
live.canon|zechariah|9:12: Turn you to the strong hold, you prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto you;
live.canon|zechariah|9:13: When I have bent Yahudah (Judah) for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and made you as the sword of a mighty man.
live.canon|zechariah|9:1: The burden of the word of Yahuah (LORD) in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be toward Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|9:2: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
live.canon|zechariah|9:3: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
live.canon|zechariah|9:5: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
live.canon|zechariah|9:6: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
live.canon|zechariah|9:10: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
live.canon|zechariah|9:14: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
live.canon|zechariah|9:15: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
live.canon|zechariah|9:16: And Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
live.canon|zechariah|9:17: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
live.canon|zechariah|9:4: Behold, Adonai (Lord) will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
live.canon|zechariah|10:1: Ask you of Yahuah (LORD) rain in the time of the latter rain; so Yahuah (LORD) shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
live.canon|zechariah|10:3: My anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has visited his flock the house of Yahudah (Judah), and has made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
live.canon|zechariah|10:12: And I will strengthen them in Yahuah (LORD); and they shall walk up and down in his name, says Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|10:2: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
live.canon|zechariah|10:4: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
live.canon|zechariah|10:5: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because Yahuah (LORD) is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
live.canon|zechariah|10:6: And I will strengthen the house of Yahudah (Judah), and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and will hear them.
live.canon|zechariah|10:7: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|10:8: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
live.canon|zechariah|10:9: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
live.canon|zechariah|10:10: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
live.canon|zechariah|10:11: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
live.canon|zechariah|11:1: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.
live.canon|zechariah|11:2: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O you oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
live.canon|zechariah|11:4: Thus says Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God); Feed the flock of the slaughter;
live.canon|zechariah|11:6: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, says Yahuah (LORD): but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
live.canon|zechariah|11:9: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dies, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
live.canon|zechariah|11:12: And I said unto them, If you think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
live.canon|zechariah|11:14: Then I cut asunder my other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel).
live.canon|zechariah|11:15: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Take unto you yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
live.canon|zechariah|11:16: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that stands still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
live.canon|zechariah|11:3: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
live.canon|zechariah|11:5: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD); for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
live.canon|zechariah|11:7: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
live.canon|zechariah|11:8: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
live.canon|zechariah|11:10: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
live.canon|zechariah|11:11: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|11:13: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
live.canon|zechariah|11:17: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
live.canon|zechariah|12:1: The burden of the word of Yahuah (LORD) for Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD), which stretcheth forth the heavens, and lays the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
live.canon|zechariah|12:4: In that day, says Yahuah (LORD), I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open my eyes upon the house of Yahudah (Judah), and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
live.canon|zechariah|12:10: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourns for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
live.canon|zechariah|12:2: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Yahudah (Judah) and against Jerusalem.
live.canon|zechariah|12:3: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
live.canon|zechariah|12:5: And the governors of Yahudah (Judah) shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) their Elohim (God).
live.canon|zechariah|12:6: In that day will I make the governors of Yahudah (Judah) like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
live.canon|zechariah|12:7: Yahuah (LORD) also shall save the tents of Yahudah (Judah) first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Yahudah (Judah).
live.canon|zechariah|12:8: In that day shall Yahuah (LORD) defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as Elohim (God), as the angel of Yahuah (LORD) before them.
live.canon|zechariah|12:9: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
live.canon|zechariah|12:11: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
live.canon|zechariah|12:12: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
live.canon|zechariah|12:13: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
live.canon|zechariah|12:14: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
live.canon|zechariah|13:2: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
live.canon|zechariah|13:3: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, You shall not live; for you speak lies in the name of Yahuah (LORD): and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
live.canon|zechariah|13:4: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he has prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
live.canon|zechariah|13:6: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in your hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
live.canon|zechariah|13:7: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn my hand upon the little ones.
live.canon|zechariah|13:8: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, says Yahuah (LORD), two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.
live.canon|zechariah|13:1: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.
live.canon|zechariah|13:5: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
live.canon|zechariah|13:9: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, Yahuah (LORD) is my Elohim (God).
live.canon|zechariah|14:1: Behold, the day of Yahuah (LORD) comes, and your spoil shall be divided in the midst of you.
live.canon|zechariah|14:5: And you shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, you shall flee, like as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Yahudah (Judah): and Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) shall come, and all the saints with you.
live.canon|zechariah|14:2: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
live.canon|zechariah|14:3: Then shall Yahuah (LORD) go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
live.canon|zechariah|14:4: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
live.canon|zechariah|14:6: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
live.canon|zechariah|14:7: But it shall be one day which shall be known to Yahuah (LORD), not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
live.canon|zechariah|14:8: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
live.canon|zechariah|14:9: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Yahuah (LORD), and his name one.
live.canon|zechariah|14:10: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.
live.canon|zechariah|14:11: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
live.canon|zechariah|14:12: And this shall be the plague wherewith Yahuah (LORD) will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
live.canon|zechariah|14:13: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from Yahuah (LORD) shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
live.canon|zechariah|14:14: And Yahudah (Judah) also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
live.canon|zechariah|14:15: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
live.canon|zechariah|14:16: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
live.canon|zechariah|14:17: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), even upon them shall be no rain.
live.canon|zechariah|14:18: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith Yahuah (LORD) will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
live.canon|zechariah|14:19: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
live.canon|zechariah|14:20: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE Yahuah (LORD); and the pots in the LORD’S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
live.canon|zechariah|14:21: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Yahudah (Judah) shall be holiness unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:9: [Not in 1 Enoch. This verse number was removed when the text was corrected to the R.H. Charles 1917 edition; see the chapter above.]
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:1: And he said unto me: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask me regarding the fragrance of the tree, and why dost thou wish to learn the truth?’
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:2: Then I answered him saying: ‘I wish to know about everything, but especially about this tree.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:3: And he answered saying: ‘This high mountain which thou hast seen, whose summit is like the throne of Elohim (God), is His throne, where the Holy Great One, Yahuah (Lord) of Glory, the Eternal King, will sit, when He shall come down to visit the earth with goodness.
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:4: And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy.
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:5: Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King.
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:6: Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad, And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no sorrow or plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|25:7: Then blessed I the Elohim (God) of Glory, the Eternal King, who hath prepared such things for the righteous, and hath created them and promised to give to them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:14: And all mankind shall look to the path of uprightness. And after that, in the ninth week, the righteous judgement shall be revealed to the whole world, And all the works of the godless shall vanish from all the earth, And the world shall be written down for destruction.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:15: And after this, in the tenth week in the seventh part, There shall be the great eternal judgement, In which He will execute vengeance amongst the angels.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:16: And the first heaven shall depart and pass away, And a new heaven shall appear, And all the powers of the heavens shall give sevenfold light.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:17: And after that there will be many weeks without number for ever, And all shall be in goodness and righteousness, And sin shall no more be mentioned for ever.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:18: And now I tell you, my sons, and show you The paths of righteousness and the paths of violence. Yea, I will show them to you again That ye may know what will come to pass.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:19: And now, hearken unto me, my sons, And walk in the paths of righteousness, And walk not in the paths of violence; For all who walk in the paths of unrighteousness shall perish for ever.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:3: And he spake unto all the children of righteousness and said: ‘Hear, ye sons of Enoch, all the words of your father, And hearken aright to the voice of my mouth; For I exhort you and say unto you, beloved:
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:4: Love uprightness and walk therein. And draw not nigh to uprightness with a double heart, And associate not with those of a double heart, But walk in righteousness, my sons. And it shall guide you on good paths, And righteousness shall be your companion.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:7: And when sin and unrighteousness and blasphemy And violence in all kinds of deeds increase, And apostasy and transgression and uncleanness increase, A great chastisement shall come from heaven upon all these, And the holy Yahuah (Lord) will come forth with wrath and chastisement To execute judgement on earth.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:11: [And after that the roots of unrighteousness shall be cut off, and the sinners shall be destroyed by the sword... shall be cut off from the blasphemers in every place, and those who plan violence and those who commit blasphemy shall perish by the sword.]
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:9: And all the idols of the heathen shall be abandoned, And the temples burned with fire, And they shall remove them from the whole earth, And they (i.e. the heathen) shall be cast into the judgement of fire, And shall perish in wrath and in grievous judgement for ever.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:10: And the righteous shall arise from their sleep, And wisdom shall arise and be given unto them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:12: And after that there shall be another, the eighth week, that of righteousness, And a sword shall be given to it that a righteous judgement may be executed on the oppressors, And sinners shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:13: And at its close they shall acquire houses through their righteousness, And a house shall be built for the Great King in glory for evermore,
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:1: ‘And now, my son Methuselah, call to me all thy brothers And gather together to me all the sons of thy mother; For the word calls me, And the spirit is poured out upon me, That I may show you everything That shall befall you for ever.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:2: And thereupon Methuselah went and summoned to him all his brothers and assembled his relatives.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:5: For I know that violence must increase on the earth, And a great chastisement be executed on the earth, And all unrighteousness come to an end: Yea, it shall be cut off from its roots, And its whole structure be destroyed.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:6: And unrighteousness shall again be consummated on the earth, And all the deeds of unrighteousness and of violence And transgression shall prevail in a twofold degree.
live.enoch|1-enoch|91:8: In those days violence shall be cut off from its roots, And the roots of unrighteousness together with deceit, And they shall be destroyed from under heaven.
live.enoch|1-enoch|92:1: The book written by Enoch—[Enoch indeed wrote this complete doctrine of wisdom, (which is) praised of all men and a judge of all the earth] for all my children who shall dwell on the earth. And for the future generations who shall observe uprightness and peace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|92:2: Let not your spirit be troubled on account of the times; For the Holy and Great One has appointed days for all things.
live.enoch|1-enoch|92:3: And the righteous one shall arise from sleep, [Shall arise] and walk in the paths of righteousness, And all his path and conversation shall be in eternal goodness and grace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|92:4: He will be gracious to the righteous and give him eternal uprightness, And He will give him power so that he shall be (endowed) with goodness and righteousness, And he shall walk in eternal light.
live.enoch|1-enoch|92:5: And sin shall perish in darkness for ever, And shall no more be seen from that day for evermore.
live.enoch|1-enoch|93:1: And after that Enoch both gave and began to recount from the books.
live.enoch|1-enoch|93:2: And Enoch said: ‘Concerning the children of righteousness and concerning the elect of the world, And concerning the plant of uprightness, I will speak these things, Yea, I Enoch will declare (them) unto you, my sons: According to that which appeared to me in the heavenly vision, And which I have known through the word of the holy angels, And have learnt from the heavenly tablets.’
