live.enoch|1-enoch|89:21: And I saw the sheep till they departed from amongst the wolves; but the eyes of the wolves were blinded, and those wolves departed in pursuit of the sheep with all their power.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:22: And Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep went with them, as their leader, and all His sheep followed Him: and His face was dazzling and glorious and terrible to behold.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:23: But the wolves began to pursue those sheep till they reached a sea of water.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:28: But the sheep escaped from that water and went forth into a wilderness, where there was no water and no grass; and they began to open their eyes and to see; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep pasturing them and giving them water and grass, and that sheep going and leading them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:29: And that sheep ascended to the summit of that lofty rock, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep sent it to them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:30: And after that I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep who stood before them, and His appearance was great and terrible and majestic, and all those sheep saw Him and were afraid before His face.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:31: And they all feared and trembled because of Him, and they cried to that sheep with them [which was amongst them]: ‘We are not able to stand before our Lord or to behold Him.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:32: And that sheep which led them again ascended to the summit of that rock, but the sheep began to be blinded and to wander from the way which he had showed them, but that sheep wot not thereof.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:33: And Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep was wrathful exceedingly against them, and that sheep discovered it, and went down from the summit of the rock, and came to the sheep, and found the greatest part of them blinded and fallen away.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:34: And when they saw it they feared and trembled at its presence, and desired to return to their folds.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:35: And that sheep took other sheep with it, and came to those sheep which had fallen away, and began to slay them; and the sheep feared its presence, and thus that sheep brought back those sheep that had fallen away, and they returned to their folds.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:36: And I saw in this vision till that sheep became a man and built a house for Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, and placed all the sheep in that house.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:37: And I saw till this sheep which had met that sheep which led them fell asleep: and I saw till all the great sheep perished and little ones arose in their place, and they came to a pasture, and approached a stream of water.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:38: Then that sheep, their leader which had become a man, withdrew from them and fell asleep, and all the sheep sought it and cried over it with a great crying.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:39: And I saw till they left off crying for that sheep and crossed that stream of water, and there arose the two sheep as leaders in the place of those which had led them and fallen asleep (lit. ‘had fallen asleep and led them’).
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:40: And I saw till the sheep came to a goodly place, and a pleasant and glorious land, and I saw till those sheep were satisfied; and that house stood amongst them in the pleasant land.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:41: And sometimes their eyes were opened, and sometimes blinded, till another sheep arose and led them and brought them all back, and their eyes were opened.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:42: And the dogs and the foxes and the wild boars began to devour those sheep till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep raised up [another sheep] a ram from their midst, which led them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:43: And that ram began to butt on either side those dogs, foxes, and wild boars till he had destroyed them all.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:44: And that sheep whose eyes were opened saw that ram, which was amongst the sheep, till it forsook its glory and began to butt those sheep, and trampled upon them, and behaved itself unseemly.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:45: And Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep sent the lamb to another lamb and raised it to being a ram and leader of the sheep instead of that ram which had forsaken its glory.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:46: And it went to it and spake to it alone, and raised it to being a ram, and made it the prince and leader of the sheep; but during all these things those dogs oppressed the sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:47: And the first ram pursued that second ram, and that second ram arose and fled before it; and I saw till those dogs pulled down the first ram.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:49: And those sheep grew and multiplied; but all the dogs, and foxes, and wild boars feared and fled before it, and that ram butted and killed the wild beasts, and those wild beasts had no longer any power among the sheep and robbed them no more of ought.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:50: And that house became great and broad, and it was built for those sheep: and a tower lofty and great was built on the house for Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, and that house was low, but the tower was elevated and lofty, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep stood on that tower and they offered a full table before Him.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:51: And again I saw those sheep that they again erred and went many ways, and forsook that their house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep called some from amongst the sheep and sent them to the sheep, but the sheep began to slay them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:52: And one of them was saved and was not slain, and it sped away and cried aloud over the sheep; and they sought to slay it, but Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep saved it from the sheep, and brought it up to me, and caused it to dwell there.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:53: And many other sheep He sent to those sheep to testify unto them and lament over them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:54: And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of Yahuah (Lord) and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:55: And He gave them over into the hands of the lions and tigers, and wolves and hyenas, and into the hand of the foxes, and to all the wild beasts, and those wild beasts began to tear in pieces those sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:56: And I saw that He forsook that their house and their tower and gave them all into the hand of the lions, to tear and devour them, into the hand of all the wild beasts.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:57: And I began to cry aloud with all my power, and to appeal to Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, and to represent to Him in regard to the sheep that they were devoured by all the wild beasts.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:58: But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:59: And He called seventy shepherds, and cast those sheep to them that they might pasture them, and He spake to the shepherds and their companions: ‘Let each individual of you pasture the sheep henceforward, and everything that I shall command you that do ye.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:60: And I will deliver them over unto you duly numbered, and tell you which of them are to be destroyed—and them destroy ye.’ And He gave over unto them those sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:61: And He called another and spake unto him: 'Observe and mark everything that the shepherds will do to those sheep; for they will destroy more of them than I have commanded them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:62: And every excess and the destruction which will be wrought through the shepherds, record (namely) how many they destroy according to my command, and how many according to their own caprice: record against every individual shepherd all the destruction he effects.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:63: And read out before me by number how many they destroy, and how many they deliver over for destruction, that I may have this as a testimony against them, and know every deed of the shepherds, that I may comprehend and see what they do, whether or not they abide by my command which I have commanded them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:64: But they shall not know it, and thou shalt not declare it to them, nor admonish them, but only record against each individual all the destruction which the shepherds effect each in his time and lay it all before me.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:65: And I saw till those shepherds pastured in their season, and they began to slay and to destroy more than they were bidden, and they delivered those sheep into the hand of the lions.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:68: And the shepherds and their associates delivered over those sheep to all the wild beasts, to devour them, and each one of them received in his time a definite number: it was written by the other in a book how many each one of them destroyed of them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:69: And each one slew and destroyed many more than was prescribed; and I began to weep and lament on account of those sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:70: And thus in the vision I saw that one who wrote, how he wrote down every one that was destroyed by those shepherds, day by day, and carried up and laid down and showed actually the whole book to Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep—(even) everything that they had done, and all that each one of them had made away with, and all that they had given over to destruction.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:71: And the book was read before Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, and He took the book from his hand and read it and sealed it and laid it down.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:72: And forthwith I saw how the shepherds pastured for twelve hours, and behold three of those sheep turned back and came and entered and began to build up all that had fallen down of that house; but the wild boars tried to hinder them, but they were not able.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:73: And they began again to build as before, and they reared up that tower, and it was named the high tower; and they began again to place a table before the tower, but all the bread on it was polluted and not pure.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:74: And as touching all this the eyes of those sheep were blinded so that they saw not, and (the eyes of) their shepherds likewise; and they delivered them in large numbers to their shepherds for destruction, and they trampled the sheep with their feet and devoured them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:75: And Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep remained unmoved till all the sheep were dispersed over the field and mingled with them (i.e. the beasts), and they (i.e. the shepherds) did not save them out of the hand of the beasts.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:76: And this one who wrote the book carried it up, and showed it and read it before Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, and implored Him on their account, and besought Him on their account as he showed Him all the doings of the shepherds, and gave testimony before Him against all the shepherds.
live.enoch|1-enoch|89:77: And he took the actual book and laid it down beside Him and departed.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:2: And after that I saw in my vision all the birds of heaven coming, the eagles, the vultures, the kites, the ravens; but the eagles led all the birds; and they began to devour those sheep, and to pick out their eyes and to devour their flesh.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:3: And the sheep cried out because their flesh was being devoured by the birds, and as for me I looked and lamented in my sleep over that shepherd who pastured the sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:4: And I saw until those sheep were devoured by the dogs and eagles and kites, and they left neither flesh nor skin nor sinew remaining on them till only their bones stood there: and their bones too fell to the earth and the sheep became few.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:5: And I saw until that twenty-three had undertaken the pasturing and completed in their several periods fifty-eight times.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:30: And I saw all the sheep which had been left, and all the beasts on the earth, and all the birds of the heaven, falling down and doing homage to those sheep and making petition to and obeying them in every thing.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:1: And I saw till that in this manner thirty-five shepherds undertook the pasturing (of the sheep), and they severally completed their periods as did the first; and others received them into their hands, to pasture them for their period, each shepherd in his own period.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:6: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:7: Yea, they cried to them, but they did not hearken to what they said to them, but were exceedingly deaf, and their eyes were very exceedingly blinded.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:8: And I saw in the vision how the ravens flew upon those lambs and took one of those lambs, and dashed the sheep in pieces and devoured them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:9: And I saw till horns grew upon those lambs, and the ravens cast down their horns; and I saw till there sprouted a great horn of one of those sheep, and their eyes were opened.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:10: And it looked at them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:11: And notwithstanding all this those eagles and vultures and ravens and kites still kept tearing the sheep and swooping down upon them and devouring them: still the sheep remained silent, but the rams lamented and cried out.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:12: And those ravens fought and battled with it and sought to lay low its horn, but they had no power over it.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:13: And I saw till the shepherds and eagles and those vultures and kites came, and they cried to the ravens that they should break the horn of that ram, and they battled and fought with it, and it battled with them and cried that its help might come.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:14: And I saw till that man, who wrote down the names of the shepherds [and] carried up into the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep [came and helped it and showed it everything: he had come down for the help of that ram].
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:15: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them in wrath, and all who saw Him fled, and they all fell into His shadow from before His face.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:16: All the eagles and vultures and ravens and kites were gathered together, and there came with them all the sheep of the field, yea, they all came together, and helped each other to break that horn of the ram.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:17: And I saw that man, who wrote the book according to the command of Yahuah (Lord), till he opened that book concerning the destruction which those twelve last shepherds had wrought, and showed that they had destroyed much more than their predecessors, before Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:18: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of His wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:19: And I saw till a great sword was given to the sheep, and the sheep proceeded against all the beasts of the field to slay them, and all the beasts and the birds of the heaven fled before their face.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:20: And I saw till a throne was erected in the pleasant land, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep sat Himself thereon, and the other took the sealed books and opened those books before Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:21: And Yahuah (Lord) called those men the seven first white ones, and commanded that they should bring before Him, beginning with the first star which led the way, all the stars whose privy members were like those of horses, and they brought them all before Him.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:22: And He said to that man who wrote before Him, being one of those seven white ones, and said unto him: ‘Take those seventy shepherds to whom I delivered the sheep, and who taking them on their own authority slew more than I commanded them.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:23: And behold they were all bound, I saw, and they all stood before Him.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:24: And the judgement was held first over the stars, and they were judged and found guilty, and went to the place of condemnation, and they were cast into an abyss, full of fire and flaming, and full of pillars of fire.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:25: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:26: And I saw at that time how a like abyss was opened in the midst of the earth, full of fire, and they brought those blinded sheep, and they were all judged and found guilty and cast into this fiery abyss, and they burned; now this abyss was to the right of that house.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:27: And I saw those sheep burning and their bones burning.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:28: And I stood up to see till they folded up that old house; and carried off all the pillars, and all the beams and ornaments of the house were at the same time folded up with it, and they carried it off and laid it in a place in the south of the land.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:29: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:31: And thereafter those three who were clothed in white and had seized me by my hand [who had taken me up before], and the hand of that ram also seizing hold of me, they took me up and set me down in the midst of those sheep before the judgement took place.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:32: And those sheep were all white, and their wool was abundant and clean.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:33: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:34: And I saw till they laid down that sword, which had been given to the sheep, and they brought it back into the house, and it was sealed before the presence of Yahuah (Lord), and all the sheep were invited into that house, but it held them not.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:35: And the eyes of them all were opened, and they saw the good, and there was not one among them that did not see.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:36: And I saw that that house was large and broad and very full.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:37: And I saw that a white bull was born, with large horns, and all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air feared him and made petition to him all the time.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:38: And I saw till all their generations were transformed, and they all became white bulls; and the first among them became a lamb, and that lamb became a great animal and had great black horns on its head; and Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep rejoiced over it and over all the oxen.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:39: And I slept in their midst: and I awoke and saw everything.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:40: This is the vision which I saw while I slept, and I awoke and blessed Yahuah (Lord) of righteousness and gave Him glory.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:41: Then I wept with a great weeping and my tears stayed not till I could no longer endure it: when I saw, they flowed on account of what I had seen; for everything shall come and be fulfilled, and all the deeds of men in their order were shown to me.
live.enoch|1-enoch|90:42: On that night I remembered the first dream, and because of it I wept and was troubled—because I had seen that vision.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:1: And now I say unto you, my sons, love righteousness and walk therein; For the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptation, But the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:10: Thus I speak and declare unto you: He who hath created you will overthrow you, And for your fall there shall be no compassion, And your Creator will rejoice at your destruction.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:2: And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed, And they shall hold themselves afar from them, And shall not follow them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:3: And now I say unto you the righteous: Walk not in the paths of wickedness, nor in the paths of death, And draw not nigh to them, lest ye be destroyed.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:4: But seek and choose for yourselves righteousness and an elect life, And walk in the paths of peace, And ye shall live and prosper.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:5: And hold fast my words in the thoughts of your hearts, And suffer them not to be effaced from your hearts; For I know that sinners will tempt men to evilly-entreat wisdom, So that no place may be found for her, And no manner of temptation may minish.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:6: Woe to those who build unrighteousness and oppression And lay deceit as a foundation; For they shall be suddenly overthrown, And they shall have no peace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:7: Woe to those who build their houses with sin; For from all their foundations shall they be overthrown, And by the sword shall they fall. [And those who acquire gold and silver in judgement suddenly shall perish.]
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:8: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:9: Ye have committed blasphemy and unrighteousness, And have become ready for the day of slaughter, And the day of darkness and the day of the great judgement.
live.enoch|1-enoch|94:11: And your righteous ones in those days shall be A reproach to the sinners and the godless.
live.enoch|1-enoch|95:7: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.
live.enoch|1-enoch|95:1: Oh that mine eyes were [a cloud of] waters That I might weep over you, And pour down my tears as a cloud of waters: That so I might rest from my trouble of heart!
live.enoch|1-enoch|95:2: Who has permitted you to practise reproaches and wickedness? And so judgement shall overtake you, sinners.
live.enoch|1-enoch|95:3: Fear not the sinners, ye righteous; For again will Yahuah (Lord) deliver them into your hands, That ye may execute judgement upon them according to your desires.
live.enoch|1-enoch|95:4: Woe to you who fulminate anathemas which cannot be reversed: Healing shall therefore be far from you because of your sins.
live.enoch|1-enoch|95:5: Woe to you who requite your neighbour with evil; For ye shall be requited according to your works.
live.enoch|1-enoch|95:6: Woe to you, lying witnesses, And to those who weigh out injustice, For suddenly shall ye perish.
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:1: Be hopeful, ye righteous; for suddenly shall the sinners perish before you, And ye shall have lordship over them according to your desires.
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:2: [And in the day of the tribulation of the sinners, Your children shall mount and rise as eagles, And higher than the vultures will be your nest, And ye shall ascend and enter the crevices of the earth, And the clefts of the rock for ever as coneys before the unrighteous, And the sirens shall sigh because of you—and weep.]
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:3: Wherefore fear not, ye that have suffered; For healing shall be your portion, And a bright light shall enlighten you, And the voice of rest ye shall hear from heaven.
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:4: Woe unto you, ye sinners, for your riches make you appear like the righteous, But your hearts convict you of being sinners, And this fact shall be a testimony against you for a memorial of (your) evil deeds.
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:5: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:6: Woe to you who drink water from every fountain, For suddenly shall ye be consumed and wither away, Because ye have forsaken the fountain of life.
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:7: Woe to you who work unrighteousness And deceit and blasphemy: It shall be a memorial against you for evil.
live.enoch|1-enoch|96:8: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:1: Believe, ye righteous, that the sinners will become a shame And perish in the day of unrighteousness.
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:2: Be it known unto you (ye sinners) that the El Elyon (Most High) is mindful of your destruction, And the angels of heaven rejoice over your destruction.
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:3: What will ye do, ye sinners, And whither will ye flee on that day of judgement, When ye hear the voice of the prayer of the righteous?
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:4: Yea, ye shall fare like unto them, Against whom this word shall be a testimony: “Ye have been companions of sinners.”
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:5: And in those days the prayer of the righteous shall reach unto Yahuah (Lord), And for you the days of your judgement shall come.
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:6: And all the words of your unrighteousness shall be read out before the Great Holy One, And your faces shall be covered with shame, And He will reject every work which is grounded on unrighteousness.
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:7: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:8: Woe to you who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness and say: ‘We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And have acquired everything we have desired.
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:9: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,
live.enoch|1-enoch|97:10: Yea and like water your lies shall flow away; For your riches shall not abide But speedily ascend from you; For ye have acquired it all in unrighteousness, And ye shall be given over to a great curse.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:1: And now I swear unto you, to the wise and to the foolish, For ye shall have manifold experiences on the earth.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:2: For ye men shall put on more adornments than a woman, And coloured garments more than a virgin: In royalty and in grandeur and in power, And in silver and in gold and in purple, And in splendour and in food they shall be poured out as water.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:3: Therefore they shall be wanting in doctrine and wisdom, And they shall perish thereby together with their possessions; And with all their glory and their splendour, And in shame and in slaughter and in great destitution, Their spirits shall be cast into the furnace of fire.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:4: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, as a mountain has not become a slave, And a hill does not become the handmaid of a woman, Even so sin has not been sent upon the earth, But man of himself has created it, And under a great curse shall they fall who commit it.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:5: And barrenness has not been given to the woman, But on account of the deeds of her own hands she dies without children.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:6: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, by the Holy Great One, That all your evil deeds are revealed in the heavens, And that none of your deeds of oppression are covered and hidden.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:16: Therefore they shall have no peace but die a sudden death.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:7: And do not think in your spirit nor say in your heart that ye do not know and that ye do not see that every sin is every day recorded in heaven in the presence of the El Elyon (Most High).
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:8: From henceforth ye know that all your oppression wherewith ye oppress is written down every day till the day of your judgement.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:9: Woe to you, ye fools, for through your folly shall ye perish: and ye transgress against the wise, and so good hap shall not be your portion.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:10: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:11: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, who work wickedness and eat blood: Whence have ye good things to eat and to drink and to be filled? From all the good things which Yahuah (Lord) the El Elyon (Most High) has placed in abundance on the earth; therefore ye shall have no peace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:12: Woe to you who love the deeds of unrighteousness: wherefore do ye hope for good hap unto yourselves? know that ye shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous, and they shall cut off your necks and slay you, and have no mercy upon you.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:13: Woe to you who rejoice in the tribulation of the righteous; for no grave shall be dug for you.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:14: Woe to you who set at nought the words of the righteous; for ye shall have no hope of life.
live.enoch|1-enoch|98:15: Woe to you who write down lying and godless words; for they write down their lies that men may hear them and act godlessly towards (their) neighbour.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:1: Woe to you who work godlessness, And glory in lying and extol them: Ye shall perish, and no happy life shall be yours.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:2: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:4: In those days the nations shall be stirred up, And the families of the nations shall arise on the day of destruction.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:5: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:6: And again I swear to you, ye sinners, that sin is prepared for a day of unceasing bloodshed.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:8: And they shall become godless by reason of the folly of their hearts, And their eyes shall be blinded through the fear of their hearts And through visions in their dreams.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:9: Through these they shall become godless and fearful; For they shall have wrought all their work in a lie, And shall have worshipped a stone: Therefore in an instant shall they perish.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:11: Woe to you who spread evil to your neighbours; For you shall be slain in Sheol.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:12: Woe to you who make deceitful and false measures, And (to them) who cause bitterness on the earth; For they shall thereby be utterly consumed.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:13: Woe to you who build your houses through the grievous toil of others, And all their building materials are the bricks and stones of sin; I tell you ye shall have no peace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:14: Woe to them who reject the measure and eternal heritage of their fathers And whose souls follow after idols; For they shall have no rest.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:15: Woe to them who work unrighteousness and help oppression, And slay their neighbours until the day of the great judgement.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:16: For He shall cast down your glory, And bring affliction on your hearts, And shall arouse His fierce indignation And destroy you all with the sword; And all the holy and righteous shall remember your sins.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:3: In those days make ready, ye righteous, to raise your prayers as a memorial, And place them as a testimony before the angels, That they may place the sin of the sinners for a memorial before the El Elyon (Most High).
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:7: And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|99:10: But in those days blessed are all they who accept the words of wisdom, and understand them, And observe the paths of the El Elyon (Most High), and walk in the path of His righteousness, And become not godless with the godless; For they shall be saved.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:2: For a man shall not withhold his hand from slaying his sons and his sons’ sons, And the sinner shall not withhold his hand from his honoured brother: From dawn till sunset they shall slay one another.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:3: And the horse shall walk up to the breast in the blood of sinners, And the chariot shall be submerged to its height.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:5: And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:6: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:7: Woe to you, Sinners, on the day of strong anguish, Ye who afflict the righteous and burn them with fire: Ye shall be requited according to your works.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:8: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, Who watch in order to devise wickedness: Therefore shall fear come upon you And there shall be none to help you.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:9: Woe to you, ye sinners, on account of the words of your mouth, And on account of the deeds of your hands which your godlessness has wrought, In blazing flames burning worse than fire shall ye burn.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:10: And now, know ye that from the angels He will inquire as to your deeds in heaven, from the sun and from the moon and from the stars in reference to your sins because upon the earth ye execute judgement on the righteous.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:11: And He will summon to testify against you every cloud and mist and dew and rain; for they shall all be withheld because of you from descending upon you, and they shall be mindful of your sins.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:12: And now give presents to the rain that it be not withheld from descending upon you, nor yet the dew, when it has received gold and silver from you that it may descend.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:1: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:4: In those days the angels shall descend into the secret places And gather together into one place all those who brought down sin, And the El Elyon (Most High) will arise on that day of judgement To execute great judgement amongst sinners.
live.enoch|1-enoch|100:13: When the hoar-frost and snow with their chilliness, and all the snow- storms with all their plagues fall upon you, in those days ye shall not be able to stand before them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:7: And at His reproof it is afraid and dries up, and all its fish die and all that is in it; but ye sinners that are on the earth fear Him not.
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:8: Has He not made the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein? Who has given understanding and wisdom to everything that moves on the earth and in the sea?
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:9: Do not the sailors of the ships fear the sea? Yet sinners fear not the El Elyon (Most High).
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:1: Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the El Elyon (Most High), and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence.
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:2: If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:3: And if He sends His anger upon you because of your deeds, ye cannot petition Him; for ye spake proud and insolent words against His righteousness: therefore ye shall have no peace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:4: And see ye not the sailors of the ships, how their ships are tossed to and fro by the waves, and are shaken by the winds, and are in sore trouble?
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:5: And therefore do they fear because all their goodly possessions go upon the sea with them, and they have evil forebodings of heart that the sea will swallow them and they will perish therein.
live.enoch|1-enoch|101:6: Are not the entire sea and all its waters, and all its movements, the work of the El Elyon (Most High), and has He not set limits to its doings, and confined it throughout by the sand?
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:1: In those days when He hath brought a grievous fire upon you, Whither will ye flee, and where will ye find deliverance? And when He launches forth His word against you Will you not be affrighted and fear?
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:2: And all the luminaries shall be affrighted with great fear, And all the earth shall be affrighted and tremble and be alarmed.
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:3: And all the angels shall execute their commands And shall seek to hide themselves from the presence of the Great Glory, And the children of earth shall tremble and quake; And ye sinners shall be cursed for ever, And ye shall have no peace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:4: Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous, And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:5: And grieve not if your soul into Sheol has descended in grief, And that in your life your body fared not according to your goodness, But wait for the day of the judgement of sinners And for the day of cursing and chastisement.
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:6: And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you: ‘As we die, so die the righteous, And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:7: Behold, even as we, so do they die in grief and darkness, And what have they more than we? From henceforth we are equal.
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:8: And what will they receive and what will they see for ever? Behold, they too have died, And henceforth for ever shall they see no light.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:9: I tell you, ye sinners, ye are content to eat and drink, and rob and sin, and strip men naked, and acquire wealth and see good days.
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:10: Have ye seen the righteous how their end falls out, that no manner of violence is found in them till their death?
live.enoch|1-enoch|102:11: ‘Nevertheless they perished and became as though they had not been, and their spirits descended into Sheol in tribulation.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:12: They have had dominion over us that hated us and smote us; And to those that hated us we have bowed our necks But they pitied us not.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:13: We desired to get away from them that we might escape and be at rest, But found no place whereunto we should flee and be safe from them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:14: And we complained to the rulers in our tribulation, And cried out against those who devoured us, But they did not attend to our cries And would not hearken to our voice.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:1: Now, therefore, I swear to you, the righteous, by the glory of the Great and Honoured and
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:2: Mighty One in dominion, and by His greatness I swear to you. I know a mystery And have read the heavenly tablets, And have seen the holy books, And have found written therein and inscribed regarding them:
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:3: That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them, And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness, And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours, And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:4: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:5: Woe to you, ye sinners, when ye have died, If ye die in the wealth of your sins, And those who are like you say regarding you: “Blessed are the sinners: they have seen all their days.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:6: And now they have died in prosperity and in wealth, And have not seen tribulation or murder in their life; And they have died in honour, And judgement has not been executed on them during their life.”
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:7: Know ye, that their souls will be made to descend into Sheol And they shall be wretched in their great tribulation.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:8: And into darkness and chains and a burning flame where there is grievous judgement shall your spirits enter; And the great judgement shall be for all the generations of the world. Woe to you, for ye shall have no peace.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:9: Say not in regard to the righteous and good who are in life: “In our troubled days we have toiled laboriously and experienced every trouble, And met with much evil and been consumed, And have become few and our spirit small.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:10: And we have been destroyed and have not found any to help us even with a word: We have been tortured [and destroyed], and not hoped to see life from day to day.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:11: We hoped to be the head and have become the tail: We have toiled laboriously and had no satisfaction in our toil; And we have become the food of the sinners and the unrighteous, And they have laid their yoke heavily upon us.
live.enoch|1-enoch|103:15: And they helped those who robbed us and devoured us and those who made us few; and they concealed their oppression, and they did not remove from us the yoke of those that devoured us and dispersed us and murdered us, and they concealed their murder, and remembered not that they had lifted up their hands against us.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:1: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:2: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:3: And in your cry, cry for judgement, and it shall appear to you; for all your tribulation shall be visited on the rulers, and on all who helped those who plundered you.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:4: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:5: What shall ye be obliged to do? Ye shall not have to hide on the day of the great judgement and ye shall not be found as sinners, and the eternal judgement shall be far from you for all the generations of the world.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:6: And now fear not, ye righteous, when ye see the sinners growing strong and prospering in their ways: be not companions with them, but keep afar from their violence; for ye shall become companions of the hosts of heaven.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:7: And, although ye sinners say: “All our sins shall not be searched out and be written down,” nevertheless they shall write down all your sins every day.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:8: And now I show unto you that light and darkness, day and night, see all your sins.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:9: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:10: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:11: But when they write down truthfully all my words in their languages, and do not change or minish ought from my words but write them all down truthfully—all that I first testified concerning them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:12: Then, I know another mystery, that books will be given to the righteous and the wise to become a cause of joy and uprightness and much wisdom.
live.enoch|1-enoch|104:13: And to them shall the books be given, and they shall believe in them and rejoice over them, and then shall all the righteous who have learnt therefrom all the paths of uprightness be recompensed.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|105:1: In those days Yahuah (Lord) bade (them) to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show (it) unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth.
live.enoch|1-enoch|105:2: For I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and ye shall have peace: rejoice, ye children of uprightness. Amen.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:4: And his father Lamech was afraid of him and fled, and came to his father Methuselah.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:1: And after some days my son Methuselah took a wife for his son Lamech, and she became pregnant by him and bore a son.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:2: And his body was white as snow and red as the blooming of a rose, and the hair of his head and his long locks were white as wool, and his eyes beautiful. And when he opened his eyes, he lighted up the whole house like the sun, and the whole house was very bright.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:3: And thereupon he arose in the hands of the midwife, opened his mouth, and conversed with Yahuah (Lord) of righteousness.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:5: And he said unto him: ‘I have begotten a strange son, diverse from and unlike man, and resembling the sons of the Elohim (God) of heaven; and his nature is different and he is not like us, and his eyes are as the rays of the sun, and his countenance is glorious.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:6: And it seems to me that he is not sprung from me but from the angels, and I fear that in his days a wonder may be wrought on the earth.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:7: And now, my father, I am here to petition thee and implore thee that thou mayst go to Enoch, our father, and learn from him the truth, for his dwelling-place is amongst the angels.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:8: And when Methuselah heard the words of his son, he came to me to the ends of the earth; for he had heard that I was there, and he cried aloud, and I heard his voice and I came to him. And I said unto him: ‘Behold, here am I, my son, wherefore hast thou come to me?’
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:9: And he answered and said: ‘Because of a great cause of anxiety have I come to thee, and because of a disturbing vision have I approached.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:10: And now, my father, hear me: unto Lamech my son there hath been born a son, the like of whom there is none, and his nature is not like man’s nature, and the colour of his body is whiter than snow and redder than the bloom of a rose, and the hair of his head is whiter than white wool, and his eyes are like the rays of the sun, and he opened his eyes and thereupon lighted up the whole house.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:11: And he arose in the hands of the midwife, and opened his mouth and blessed Yahuah (Lord) of heaven.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:12: And his father Lamech became afraid and fled to me, and did not believe that he was sprung from him, but that he was in the likeness of the angels of heaven; and behold I have come to thee that thou mayst make known to me the truth.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:13: And I, Enoch, answered and said unto him: ‘Yahuah (Lord) will do a new thing on the earth, and this I have already seen in a vision, and make known to thee that in the generation of my father Jared some of the angels of heaven transgressed the word of Yahuah (Lord).
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:14: And behold they commit sin and transgress the law, and have united themselves with women and commit sin with them, and have married some of them, and have begot children by them.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:15: Yea, there shall come a great destruction over the whole earth, and there shall be a deluge and a great destruction for one year.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:16: And this son who has been born unto you shall be left on the earth, and his three children shall be saved with him: when all mankind that are on the earth shall die [he and his sons shall be saved].
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:17: And they shall produce on the earth giants not according to the spirit, but according to the flesh, and there shall be a great punishment on the earth, and the earth shall be cleansed from all impurity.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:18: And now make known to thy son Lamech that he who has been born is in truth his son, and call his name Noah; for he shall be left to you, and he and his sons shall be saved from the destruction, which shall come upon the earth on account of all the sin and all the unrighteousness, which shall be consummated on the earth in his days.
live.enoch|1-enoch|106:19: And after that there shall be still more unrighteousness than that which was first consummated on the earth; for I know the mysteries of the holy ones; for He, Yahuah (Lord), has showed me and informed me, and I have read (them) in the heavenly tablets.
live.enoch|1-enoch|107:2: And now, my son, go and make known to thy son Lamech that this son, which has been born, is in truth his son, and that (this) is no lie.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|107:1: And I saw written on them that generation upon generation shall transgress, till a generation of righteousness arises, and transgression is destroyed and sin passes away from the earth, and all manner of good comes upon it.
live.enoch|1-enoch|107:3: And when Methuselah had heard the words of his father Enoch—for he had shown to him everything in secret—he returned and showed (them) to him and called the name of that son Noah; for he will comfort the earth after all the destruction.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:1: Another book which Enoch wrote for his son Methuselah and for those who will come after him, and keep the law in the last days.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:2: Ye who have done good shall wait for those days till an end is made of those who work evil, and an end of the might of the transgressors.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:3: And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:4: And I saw there something like an invisible cloud; for by reason of its depth I could not look over, and I saw a flame of fire blazing brightly, and things like shining mountains circling and sweeping to and fro.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:5: And I asked one of the holy angels who was with me and said unto him: ‘What is this shining thing? for it is not a heaven but only the flame of a blazing fire, and the voice of weeping and crying and lamentation and strong pain.’
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:6: And he said unto me: ‘This place which thou seest—here are cast the spirits of sinners and blasphemers, and of those who work wickedness, and of those who pervert everything that Yahuah (Lord) hath spoken through the mouth of the prophets—(even) the things that shall be.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:7: For some of them are written and inscribed above in the heaven, in order that the angels may read them and know that which shall befall the sinners, and the spirits of the humble, and of those who have afflicted their bodies, and been recompensed by Elohim (God); and of those who have been put to shame by wicked men:
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:8: Who love Elohim (God) and loved neither gold nor silver nor any of the good things which are in the world, but gave over their bodies to torture.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:9: Who, since they came into being, longed not after earthly food, but regarded everything as a passing breath, and lived accordingly, and Yahuah (Lord) tried them much, and their spirits were found pure so that they should bless His name.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:10: And all the blessings destined for them I have recounted in the books. And He hath assigned them their recompense, because they have been found to be such as loved heaven more than their life in the world, and though they were trodden under foot of wicked men, and experienced abuse and reviling from them and were put to shame, yet they blessed Me.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:11: And now I will summon the spirits of the good who belong to the generation of light, and I will transform those who were born in darkness, who in the flesh were not recompensed with such honour as their faithfulness deserved.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:12: And I will bring forth in shining light those who have loved My holy name, and I will seat each on the throne of his honour.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:13: And they shall be resplendent for times without number; for righteousness is the judgement of Elohim (God); for to the faithful He will give faithfulness in the habitation of upright paths.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:14: And they shall see those who were born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous shall be resplendent.
live.enoch|1-enoch|108:15: And the sinners shall cry aloud and see them resplendent, and they indeed will go where days and seasons are prescribed for them.’
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|1:1: And it came to pass in the twenty-fifth year of Jeconiah, king of Yahudah (Judah), that the word of Yahuah (Lord)
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|1:2: came to Baruch, the son of Neriah, and said to him: 'Hast thou seen all that this people are doing to Me, that the evils which these two tribes which remained have done are greater than (those of)
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|1:3: the ten tribes which were carried away captive? For the former tribes were forced by their kings to commit sin, but these two of themselves have been forcing and compelling their kings to commit
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|1:4: sin. For this reason, behold I bring evil upon this city, and upon its inhabitants, and it shall be removed from before Me for a time, and I will scatter this people among the Gentiles that they may do good to the Gentiles. And My people shall be chastened, and the time shall come when they will seek for the prosperity of their times.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|2:1: For I have said these things to thee that thou mayst bid Jeremiah, and all those that are like you, to retire from this city.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|2:2: For your works are to this city as a firm pillar, And your prayers as a strong wall.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:1: And I said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, have I come into the world for this purpose that I might see the evils of my mother? Not (so) my Lord.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:2: If I have found grace in Thy sight, first take my spirit
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:3: that I may go to my fathers and not behold the destruction of my mother. For two things vehemently constrain me: for I cannot resist Thee, and my soul, moreover, cannot behold the evils
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:5: of my mother. But one thing I will say in Thy presence, O Yahuah (Lord). What, therefore, will there be after these things? for if Thou destroyest Thy city, and deliverest up Thy land to those that hate
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:6: us, how shall the name of Yashar'el (Israel) be again remembered? Or how shall one speak of Thy praises?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:7: or to whom shall that which is in Thy law be explained? Or shall the world return to its nature (of
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:8: aforetime), and the age revert to primeval silence? And shall the multitude of souls be taken away,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|3:9: and the nature of man not again be named? And where is all that which Thou didst say to Moses regarding us?'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|4:1: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto me: 'This city shall be delivered up for a time, And the people shall be chastened during a time, And the world will not be given over to oblivion.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|4:2: [Dost thou think that this is that city of which I said: "On the palms of My hands have I graven
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|4:3: thee"? This building now built in your midst is not that which is revealed with Me, that which was prepared beforehand here from the time when I took counsel to make Paradise, and showed it to Adam before he sinned, but when he transgressed the commandment it was removed from him, as
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|4:4: also Paradise. And after these things I showed it to My servant Abraham by night among the
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|4:5: portions of the victims. And again also I showed it to Moses on Mount Sinai when I showed to him
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|4:6: the likeness of the tabernacle and all its vessels. And now, behold, it is preserved with Me, as also
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|4:7: Paradise. Go, therefore, and do as I command thee.']
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|5:1: And I answered and said: 'So then I am destined to grieve for Zion, For Thine enemies will come to this place and pollute Thy sanctuary, And lead Thine inheritance into captivity, And make themselves masters of those whom Thou hast loved, And they will depart again to the place of their idols, And will boast before them: And what wilt Thou do for Thy great name?'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|5:2: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto me: 'My name and My glory are unto all eternity; And My judgement shall maintain its right in its own time.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|5:3: And thou shalt see with thine eyes That the enemy will not overthrow Zion, Nor shall they burn Jerusalem, But be the ministers of the Judge for the time.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|5:4: But do thou go and do whatsoever I have said unto thee.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|5:5: And I went and took Jeremiah, and Adu, and Seriah, and Jabish, and Gedaliah, and all the honourable men of the people, and I led them to the valley of Cedron, and I narrated to them all that had been said to me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|5:6: And they lifted up their voice, and they all wept.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|5:7: And we sat there and fasted until the evening.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:1: And it came to pass on the morrow that, lo! the army of the Chaldees surrounded the city, and at the time of the evening, I, Baruch, left the people, and I went forth and stood by the oak.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:2: And I was grieving over Zion, and lamenting over the captivity which had come upon the people.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:3: And lo! suddenly a strong spirit raised me, and bore me aloft over the wall of Jerusalem.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:4: And I beheld, and lo! four angels standing at the four corners of the city, each of them holding a torch of fire in his hands.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:5: And another angel began to descend from heaven, and said unto them: 'Hold your lamps, and do not light them till I tell you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:6: For I am first sent to speak a word to the earth, and to place in it what Yahuah (Lord) the El Elyon (Most High) has commanded me.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:7: And I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark, and the mercy-seat, and the two tables, and the holy raiment of the priests, and the altar of incense, and the forty-eight precious stones, wherewith the priest was adorned and all the holy vessels of the tabernacle.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:8: And he spake to the earth with a loud voice: 'Earth, earth, earth, hear the word of El Gibbor (the mighty God), And receive what I commit to thee, And guard them until the last times, So that, when thou art ordered, thou mayst restore them, So that strangers may not get possession of them.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:9: For the time comes when Jerusalem also will be delivered for a time, Until it is said, that it is again restored for ever.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|6:10: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|7:1: And after these things I heard that angel saying unto those angels who held the lamps: 'Destroy, therefore, and overthrow its wall to its foundations, lest the enemy should boast and say: "We have overthrown the wall of Zion, And we have burnt the place of El Gibbor (the mighty God)."'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|7:2: And ye have seized the place where I had been standing before.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|8:1: Now the angels did as he had commanded them, and when they had broken up the corners of the walls, a voice was heard from the interior of the temple, after the wall had fallen, saying:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|8:2: 'Enter, ye enemies, And come, ye adversaries; For he who kept the house has forsaken (it).'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|8:4: And it came to pass after these things that the army of the Chaldees entered and seized the house, and all that was around it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|8:5: And they led the people away captive and slew some of them, and bound Zedekiah the king, and sent him to the king of Babylon.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|9:1: And I, Baruch, came, and Jeremiah, whose heart was found pure from sins, who had not been captured in the seizure of the city.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|9:2: And we rent our garments, we wept, and mourned, and fasted seven days.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:1: And it came to pass after seven days, that the word of Elohim (God) came to me, and said unto me: 'Tell Jeremiah to go and support the captivity of the people unto Babylon.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:2: But do thou remain here amid the desolation of Zion, and I will show to thee after these days what will befall at the end of days.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:3: And I said to Jeremiah as Yahuah (Lord) commanded me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:4: And he, indeed, departed with the people, but I, Baruch, returned and sat before the gates of the temple, and I lamented with the following lamentation over Zion and said:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:6: 'Blessed is he who was not born, Or he, who having been born, has died.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:7: But as for us who live, woe unto us, Because we see the afflictions of Zion, And what has befallen Jerusalem.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:8: I will call the Sirens from the sea, And ye Lilin, come ye from the desert, And ye Shedim and dragons from the forests: Awake and gird up your loins unto mourning, And take up with me the dirges, And make lamentation with me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:9: Ye husbandmen, sow not again; And, O earth, wherefore givest thou thy harvest fruits? Keep within thee the sweets of thy sustenance.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:10: And thou, vine, why further dost thou give thy wine; For an offering will not again be made therefrom in Zion, Nor will first-fruits again be offered.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:11: And do ye, O heavens, withhold your dew, And open not the treasuries of rain: And do thou, O sun, withhold the light of thy rays.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:12: And do thou, O moon, extinguish the multitude of thy light; For why should light rise again Where the light of Zion is darkened?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:13: And you, ye bridegrooms, enter not in, And let not the brides adorn themselves with garlands; And, ye women, pray not that ye may bear.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:14: For the barren shall above all rejoice, And those who have no sons shall be glad, And those who have sons shall have anguish.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:15: For why should they bear in pain, Only to bury in grief? Or why, again, should mankind have sons?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:16: Or why should the seed of their kind again be named, Where this mother is desolate, And her sons are led into captivity?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:17: From this time forward speak not of beauty, And discourse not of gracefulness.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:18: Moreover, ye priests, take ye the keys of the sanctuary, And cast them into the height of heaven, And give them to Yahuah (Lord) and say: "Guard Thy house Thyself, For lo! we are found false stewards."
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|10:19: And you, ye virgins, who weave fine linen And silk with gold of Ophir, Take with haste all (these) things And cast (them) into the fire, That it may bear them to Him who made them, And the flame send them to Him who created them, Lest the enemy get possession of them.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|11:1: Moreover, I, Baruch, say this against thee, Babylon: 'If thou hadst prospered, And Zion had dwelt in her glory, Yet the grief to us had been great That thou shouldst be equal to Zion.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|11:2: But now, lo! the grief is infinite, And the lamentation measureless, For lo! thou art prospered And Zion desolate.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|11:3: Who will be judge regarding these things? Or to whom shall we complain regarding that which has befallen us? O Yahuah (Lord), how hast Thou borne (it)?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|11:4: Our fathers went to rest without grief, And lo! the righteous sleep in the earth in tranquillity;
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|11:5: For they knew not this anguish, Nor yet had they heard of that which had befallen us.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|11:6: Would that thou hadst ears, O earth, And that thou hadst a heart, O dust: That ye might go and announce in Sheol, And say to the dead:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|11:7: "Blessed are ye more than we who live."'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|12:1: But I will say this as I think, And I will speak against thee, O land, which art prospering.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|12:2: The noonday does not always burn, Nor do the rays of the sun constantly give light.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|12:3: Do not expect [and hope] that thou wilt always be prosperous and rejoicing. And be not greatly uplifted and boastful.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|12:4: For assuredly in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake against thee, Which now in long-suffering is held in as it were by reins.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|12:5: And when I had said these things, I fasted seven days.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:12: For I have always benefited you. And ye have always been ungrateful for the beneficence.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:1: And it came to pass after these things, that I, Baruch, was standing upon Mount Zion, and lo! a voice came from the height and said unto me:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:2: 'Stand upon thy feet, Baruch, and hear the word of El Gibbor (the mighty God).'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:3: Because thou hast been astonied at what has befallen Zion, thou shalt therefore be assuredly preserved to the consummation of the times, that thou mayst be for a testimony.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:4: So that, if ever those prosperous cities say: 'Why hath El Gibbor (the mighty God) brought upon us this retribution?' Say
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:5: thou to them, thou and those like thee who shall have seen this evil: '(This is the evil) and retribution which is coming upon you and upon your people in its (destined) time that the nations may be thoroughly smitten.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:6: And then they shall be in anguish.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:7: And if they say at that time:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:8: For how long? Thou wilt say to them: "Ye who have drunk the strained wine, Drink ye also of its dregs, The judgement of the Lofty One Who has no respect of persons."'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:9: On this account he had aforetime no mercy on His own sons, But afflicted them as His enemies, because they sinned,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:10: Then therefore were they chastened That they might be sanctified.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:11: But now, ye peoples and nations, ye are guilty Because ye have always trodden down the earth, And used the creation unrighteously.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:1: And I answered and said: 'Lo! Thou hast shown me the method of the times, and that which shall be after these things, and Thou hast said unto me, that the retribution, which has been spoken of by Thee, shall come upon the nations.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:2: And now I know that those who have sinned are many, and they have lived in prosperity, and departed from the world, but that few nations will be left in those times, to whom those words shall be said which Thou didst say.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:3: For what advantage is there in this, or what (evil), worse than what we have seen befall us, are we to expect to see?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:4: But again I will speak in Thy presence:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:5: What have they profited who had knowledge before Thee, and have not walked in vanity as the rest of the nations, and have not said to the dead: "Give us life," but always feared Thee, and have not left Thy ways?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:6: And lo! they have been carried off, nor on their account hast Thou had mercy on Zion.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:7: And if others did evil, it was due to Zion, that on account of the works of those who wrought good works she should be forgiven, and should not be overwhelmed on account of the works of those who wrought unrighteousness.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:8: But who, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, will comprehend Thy judgement, Or who will search out the profoundness of Thy way? Or who will think out the [weight] of Thy path?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:9: Or who will be able to think out Thy incomprehensible counsel? Or who of those that are born has ever found The beginning or end of Thy wisdom?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:10: For we have all been made like a breath.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:11: For as the breath ascends involuntarily, and again dies, so it is with the nature of men, who depart not according to their own will, and know not what will befall them in the end.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:12: For the righteous justly hope for the end, and without fear depart from this habitation, because they have with Thee a store of works preserved in treasuries.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:13: On this account also these without fear leave this world, and trusting with joy they hope to receive the world which Thou hast promised them.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:14: But as for us—woe to us, who also are now shamefully entreated, and at that time look forward (only) to evils.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:15: But Thou knowest accurately what Thou hast done by means of Thy servants; for we are not able to understand that which is good as Thou art, our Creator.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:16: But again I will speak in Thy presence, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:17: When of old there was no world with its inhabitants, Thou didst devise and speak with a word, and forthwith the works of creation stood before Thee.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:18: And Thou didst say that Thou wouldst make for Thy world man as the administrator of Thy works, that it might be known that he was by no means made on account of the world, but the world on account of him.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|14:19: And now I see that as for the world which was made on account of us, lo! it abides, but we, on account of whom it was made, depart.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:1: And Yahuah (Lord) answered and said unto me: 'Thou art rightly astonied regarding the departure of man,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:2: but thou hast not judged well regarding the evils which befall those who sin.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:3: And as regards what thou hast said, that the righteous are carried off and the impious are prospered,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:4: And as regards what thou hast said: "Man knows not Thy judgement"—On this account hear, and I will speak to thee, and hearken, and I will cause thee to hear My words.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:5: Man would not rightly have understood My judgement, unless he had accepted the law, and I had instructed him in understanding.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:6: But now, because he transgressed wittingly, yea, just on this ground that he wot (thereof), he shall be tormented.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:7: And as regards what thou didst say touching the righteous, that on account of them has this world come, so also again shall that, which is to come, come on their account.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|15:8: For this world is to them a strife and a labour with much trouble; and that accordingly which is to come, a crown with great glory.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|16:1: And I answered and said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, lo! the years of this time are few and evil, and who is able in his little time to acquire that which is measureless?'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|17:1: And Yahuah (Lord) answered and said unto me: 'With the El Elyon (Most High) account is not taken of much time nor of a few years.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|17:2: For what did it profit Adam that he lived nine hundred and thirty years, and transgressed that which he was commanded?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|17:3: Therefore the multitude of time that he lived did not profit him, but brought death and cut off the years of those who were born from him.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|17:4: Or wherein did Moses suffer loss in that he lived only one hundred and twenty years, and, inasmuch as he was subject to Him who formed him, brought the law to the seed of Jacob, and lighted a lamp for the nation of Yashar'el (Israel)?'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|18:1: And I answered and said: 'He that lighted has taken from the light, and there are but few that have imitated him.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|18:2: But those many whom he has lighted have taken from the darkness of Adam and have not rejoiced in the light of the lamp.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:1: And He answered and said unto me: 'Wherefore at that time he appointed for them a covenant and said: "Behold I have placed before you life and death," And he called heaven and earth to witness against them.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:2: For he knew that his time was but short, But that heaven and earth endure always.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:3: But after his death they sinned and transgressed, Though they knew that they had the law reproving (them), And the light in which nothing could err, Also the spheres which testify, and Me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:4: Now regarding everything that is, it is I that judge, but do not thou take counsel in thy soul regarding these things, nor afflict thyself because of those which have been.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:5: For now it is the consummation of time that should be considered, whether of business, or of prosperity, or of shame, and not the beginning thereof.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:6: Because if a man be prospered in his beginnings and shamefully entreated in his old age, he forgets all the prosperity that he had.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:7: And again, if a man is shamefully entreated in his beginnings, and at his end is prospered, he remembereth not again his evil entreatment.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|19:8: And again hearken: though each one were prospered all that time—all the time from the day on which death was decreed against those who transgress—and in his end was destroyed, in vain would have been everything.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|20:1: 'Therefore, behold! the days come, And the times shall hasten more than the former, And the seasons shall speed on more than those that are past, And the years shall pass more quickly than the present (years).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|20:2: Therefore have I now taken away Zion, That I may the more speedily visit the world in its season.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|20:3: Now therefore hold fast in thy heart everything that I command thee, And seal it in the recesses of thy mind.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|20:4: And then I will show thee the judgement of My might, And My ways which are unsearchable.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|20:5: Go therefore and sanctify thyself seven days, and eat no bread, nor drink water, nor speak to anyone.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|20:6: And afterwards come to that place and I will reveal Myself to thee, and speak true things with thee, and I will give thee commandment regarding the method of the times; for they are coming and tarry not.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:1: And I went thence and sat in the valley of Cedron in a cave of the earth, and I sanctified my soul there, and I eat no bread, yet I was not hungry, and I drank no water, yet I thirsted not, and I was there till the seventh day, as He had commanded me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:2: And afterwards I came to that place where He had spoken with me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:3: And it came to pass at sunset that my soul took much thought, and I began to speak in the presence of the Mighty One, and said:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:4: 'O Thou that hast made the earth, hear me, that hast fixed the firmament by the word, and hast made firm the height of the heaven by the spirit, that hast called from the beginning of the world that which did not yet exist, and they obey Thee.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:5: Thou that hast commanded the air by Thy nod, and hast seen those things which are to be as those things which Thou art doing.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:6: Thou that rulest with great thought the hosts that stand before Thee: also the countless holy beings, which Thou didst make from the beginning, of flame and fire, which stand around Thy throne
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:7: Thou rulest with †indignation†. To Thee only does this belong that Thou shouldst do forthwith whatsoever Thou dost wish.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:8: Who causest the drops of rain to rain by number upon the earth, and alone knowest the consummation of the times before they come; have respect unto my prayer.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:9: For Thou alone art able to sustain all who are, and those who have passed away, and those who are to be, those who sin, and those who are righteous [as living (and) being past finding out].
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:10: For Thou alone dost live immortal and past finding out, and knowest the number of mankind. And if in time many have sinned, yet others not a few have been righteous.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|21:12: Thou knowest where Thou preservest the end of those who have sinned, or the consummation of those who have been righteous.
